IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_GroupVehicles.cn: 此分组出售的载具脚本. 买家会获得其选择的载具

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Inherit.en: Anything not set here comes from this entry
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Inherit.ch: 此處未設定的項目皆沿用此條目
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Inherit.cn: 此处未设置的项目都沿用此条目

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Key.en: Required. The id other definitions refer to. Cannot be changed later
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Key.ch: 必填. 其他定義所引用的 id. 之後無法變更
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Key.cn: 必填. 其他定义所引用的 id. 之后无法更改

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_KeyFixed.en: The id other definitions refer to. Fixed once created
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_KeyFixed.ch: 其他定義所引用的 id. 建立後即固定
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_KeyFixed.cn: 其他定义所引用的 id. 创建后即固定

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_LevelRange.en: Skill level, 0 to 10. Leave a box blank for no bound on that end
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_LevelRange.ch: 技能等級, 0 至 10. 某格留空表示該端不設限
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_LevelRange.cn: 技能等级, 0 到 10. 某格留空表示该端不设限

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MaxPurchases.en: Fails once the player has bought this offer this many times
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MaxPurchases.ch: 玩家購買此商品達此次數後即不符合條件
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MaxPurchases.cn: 玩家购买此商品达此次数后即不满足条件

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MaxTokens.en: Passes only while the player holds fewer bound tokens than this
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MaxTokens.ch: 僅在玩家持有的綁定代幣少於此數時符合條件
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MaxTokens.cn: 仅在玩家持有的绑定代币少于此数时满足条件

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Months.en: Only stocked during these in-game months, 1 to 12 (eg 12 for December only). Blank sells all year
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Months.ch: 僅在這些遊戲內月份上架, 1 至 12 (例如 12 表示僅限 12 月). 留空則全年販售
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Months.cn: 仅在这些游戏内月份上架, 1 到 12 (例如 12 表示仅限 12 月). 留空则全年出售

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolBlacklist.en: Barred from this pool only. Untick to restore.
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolBlacklist.ch: 僅在此物品池中禁止. 取消勾選即可恢復.
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolBlacklist.cn: 仅在此物品池中禁止. 取消勾选即可恢复.

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolDefaultPrice.en: (optional) Only used by items whose group sets no price
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolDefaultPrice.ch: (可選) 僅用於所屬分組未設定價格的物品
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolDefaultPrice.cn: (可选) 仅用于所属分组未设置价格的物品

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolEnabled.ch: 取消勾選以停用此物品池
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolEnabled.cn: 取消勾选以禁用此物品池

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolGrants.en: What buying anything from this pool gives the player. A group or an item override can change it
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolGrants.ch: 從此物品池購買任何物品時給予玩家的內容. 分組或物品覆寫可變更此設定
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolGrants.cn: 从此物品池购买任何物品时给予玩家的内容. 分组或物品覆盖可更改此设置

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolGroups.en: The groups this pool draws its items from
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolGroups.ch: 此物品池抽取物品的來源分組
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolGroups.cn: 此物品池抽取物品的来源分组

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolList.en: Select a pool and press Edit to change how often it is drawn from
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolList.ch: 選擇一個物品池並按「編輯」, 以變更其被抽取的頻率
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolList.cn: 选择一个物品池并按“编辑”, 以更改其被抽取的频率

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolWeightRow.en: How often this pool is drawn from, relative to the others in this set. 1 is the usual share, 0.5 is half of it
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolWeightRow.ch: 此物品池相對於同組其他物品池被抽取的頻率. 1 為一般比例, 0.5 為其一半
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolWeightRow.cn: 此物品池相对于同组其他物品池被抽取的频率. 1 为一般比例, 0.5 为其一半

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Powered.en: Tick if this machine only runs on electricity. It shows the unpowered sprites and cannot be opened while the power is off
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Powered.ch: 若此機台只能靠電力運作請勾選. 斷電時會顯示未通電的圖像, 且無法開啟
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Powered.cn: 若此机器只能靠电力运行请勾选. 断电时会显示未通电的贴图, 且无法打开

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PriceOverride.en: What it costs. Leave as it is to follow the template
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PriceOverride.ch: 價格. 保持不變則沿用模板
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PriceOverride.cn: 价格. 保持不变则沿用模板

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Professions.en: Starting profession keys, comma separated. The player needs any one of them
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Professions.ch: 起始職業鍵名, 以逗號分隔. 玩家只需符合其中任一項
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Professions.cn: 初始职业键名, 用逗号分隔. 玩家只需符合其中任意一项

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_RerollFrequency.en: (optional) In-game hours before this machine turns into a different shop. Blank follows the sandbox setting, 0 never changes
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_RerollFrequency.ch: (可選) 這台機器變成另一間商店前的遊戲內時數. 留空則依沙盒設定, 0 為永不改變
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_RerollFrequency.cn: (可选) 这台机器变成另一家商店前的游戏内小时数. 留空则遵循沙盒设置, 0 为永不改变

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Scope.en: Per character resets on death. Per account does not
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Scope.ch: 「每個角色」會在死亡時重設. 「每個帳號」則不會
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Scope.cn: “每个角色”会在死亡时重置. “每个账号”则不会

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SharedKey.en: (optional) Offers sharing a name share one allowance, for pick one of these, once
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SharedKey.ch: (可選) 共用同一名稱的商品共享一個額度, 用於「這些之中只能選一個, 且只能一次」
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SharedKey.cn: (可选) 使用同一名称的商品共享一个额度, 用于“这些里只能选一个, 且只能一次”

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopCategory.en: Two shops sharing a category are kept apart in the world. Blank spaces this shop against its own type only
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopCategory.ch: 共用同一分類的兩間商店在世界中會彼此保持距離. 留空則只與同類型的商店保持距離
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopCategory.cn: 共用同一分类的两家商店在世界中会彼此保持距离. 留空则只与同类型的商店保持距离

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopEnabled.en: Untick to stop this shop being placed. Machines already standing stay put
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopEnabled.ch: 取消勾選即不再放置此商店. 已經存在的機器會保留原地
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopEnabled.cn: 取消勾选即不再放置此商店. 已经存在的机器会保留在原地

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopKey.en: The shop type. Fixed once created, since placed machines refer to it
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopKey.ch: 商店類型. 建立後即固定, 因為已放置的機器會參照它
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopKey.cn: 商店类型. 创建后即固定, 因为已放置的机器会引用它

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopTitle.en: Optional. Shown instead of the key, unless this shop has a translated name
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopTitle.ch: 選填. 會取代鍵名顯示, 除非此商店有翻譯名稱
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopTitle.cn: 选填. 会代替键名显示, 除非此商店有翻译名称

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Skill.en: Perk name as the game spells it, e.g. Cooking or Aiming
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Skill.ch: 遊戲內使用的技能名稱, 例如 Cooking 或 Aiming
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Skill.cn: 游戏内使用的技能名称, 例如 Cooking 或 Aiming

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpawnCondition.en: Percent condition a bought vehicle arrives in, rolled fresh per part. Blank leaves it as the game spawned it
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpawnCondition.ch: 購得載具抵達時的耐久百分比, 每個零件各自重新擲骰. 留空則維持遊戲生成時的狀態
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpawnCondition.cn: 购得载具到达时的耐久百分比, 每个零件各自重新随机. 留空则保持游戏生成时的状态

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpawnFuel.en: Percent of the vehicle's own tank it arrives with, so one range suits a truck and a small car. Blank leaves whatever the game put in
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpawnFuel.ch: 抵達時油量佔載具自身油箱的百分比, 因此同一範圍同時適用於卡車與小型車. 留空則維持遊戲原本放入的油量
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpawnFuel.cn: 到达时油量占载具自身油箱的百分比, 因此同一范围同时适用于卡车和小型车. 留空则保持游戏原本放入的油量

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpecialOverlay.en: (optional) Second image drawn over the icon, e.g. a tier badge
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpecialOverlay.ch: (可選) 疊加在圖示上的第二張圖片, 例如等級徽章
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpecialOverlay.cn: (可选) 叠加在图标上的第二张图片, 例如等级徽章

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpecialTexture.en: (optional) PNG path under media/, or a script item name, to use as the icon
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpecialTexture.ch: (可選) media/ 下的 PNG 路徑, 或腳本物品名稱, 作為圖示使用
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpecialTexture.cn: (可选) media/ 下的 PNG 路径, 或脚本物品名称, 用作图标

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Test.en: What this condition measures. The fields below change to match
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Test.ch: 此條件檢測的項目. 下方欄位會隨之變更
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Test.cn: 此条件检测的项目. 下方字段会随之变化

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Title.en: Optional. Shown instead of the key in these lists
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Title.ch: 選填. 在這些清單中會取代鍵名顯示
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Title.cn: 选填. 在这些列表中会代替键名显示

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_TraitPick.en: Which trait to give or take away

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_VehiclePick.en: Choose one, or several for a random pick
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_VehiclePick.ch: 選擇一個, 或選擇多個以隨機挑選
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_VehiclePick.cn: 选择一个, 或选择多个以随机挑选

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_WorldAge.en: In-game hours since the world started. Leave a box blank for no bound on that end
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_WorldAge.ch: 自世界開始以來的遊戲內時數. 某一欄留空表示該端不設限
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_WorldAge.cn: 自世界开始以来的游戏内小时数. 某一栏留空表示该端不设限

IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_NoEditorAccess.en: You don't have permission to open the PhunMart editor. A server setting restricts it to a specific role.
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_NoEditorAccess.ch: 你沒有開啟 PhunMart 編輯器的權限. 伺服器設定將其限制為特定身分組.
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_NoEditorAccess.cn: 你没有打开 PhunMart 编辑器的权限. 服务器设置将其限制为特定角色.

IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_PoolAdded.en: Added %1 to this shop. Restock to see it
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_PoolAdded.ch: 已將 %1 加入此商店. 補貨後即可看到
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_PoolAdded.cn: 已将 %1 添加到此商店. 补货后即可看到

IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_PoolNotAdded.en: Created %1, but this shop's definition could not be read. Add it in the shop editor
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_PoolNotAdded.ch: 已建立 %1, 但無法讀取此商店的定義. 請在商店編輯器中加入
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_PoolNotAdded.cn: 已创建 %1, 但无法读取此商店的定义. 请在商店编辑器中添加

IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_Recompiling.en: Reloading definitions from the override files.
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_Recompiling.ch: 正在從覆寫檔重新載入定義.
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_Recompiling.cn: 正在从覆盖文件重新加载定义.

IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_BoundHint.en: Zero the bound totals as well, so nothing at all is carried forward.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_BoundHint.ch: 同時將綁定總額歸零, 不保留任何結轉.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_BoundHint.cn: 同时将绑定总额清零, 不保留任何结转.

IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_KillsHint.en: Zombie kills banked toward kill token rewards.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_KillsHint.ch: 已累計用於擊殺代幣獎勵的殭屍擊殺數.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_KillsHint.cn: 已累计用于击杀代币奖励的僵尸击杀数.

IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_PlaytimeHint.en: Hours banked toward playtime token rewards.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_PlaytimeHint.ch: 已累計用於遊戲時間代幣獎勵的時數.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_PlaytimeHint.cn: 已累计用于游戏时长代币奖励的小时数.

IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_PurchasesHint.en: Per-player purchase counts. Clearing lets buy-once offers be bought again.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_PurchasesHint.ch: 每位玩家的購買次數. 清除後, 限購一次的商品可再次購買.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_PurchasesHint.cn: 每个玩家的购买次数. 清除后, 限购一次的商品可再次购买.

IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_WalletsHint.en: Clears spendable balances. Bound totals come back, the same as any wallet reset.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_WalletsHint.ch: 清除可花用餘額. 綁定總額會恢復, 與任何錢包重設相同.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_WalletsHint.cn: 清除可用余额. 绑定总额会恢复, 与任何钱包重置相同.

IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_HideTemplates.en: Templates are not sold by anything. Other entries copy them, so editing one changes every entry that copies it. Untick to see them, listed first. Typing a filter finds them anyway.
IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_HideTemplates.ch: 模板不會由任何商店販售. 其他項目會複製它們, 因此編輯一個模板會變更所有複製它的項目. 取消勾選即可看到它們, 列在最前面. 輸入篩選文字也能找到它們.
IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_HideTemplates.cn: 模板不会由任何商店出售. 其他条目会复制它们, 因此编辑一个模板会改变所有复制它的条目. 取消勾选即可看到它们, 列在最前面. 输入筛选文字也能找到它们.

IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_OnlyChanged.en: Show only what you have customised. Blue stripe: you created it. Amber stripe: you edited one that ships with PhunMart.
IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_OnlyChanged.ch: 只顯示你自訂過的項目. 藍色條紋: 由你建立. 琥珀色條紋: 你編輯過 PhunMart 內建的項目.
IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_OnlyChanged.cn: 只显示你自定义过的条目. 蓝色条纹: 由你创建. 琥珀色条纹: 你编辑过 PhunMart 自带的条目.

IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_UsedBy.en: Click to go to what uses this.
IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_UsedBy.ch: 點選以前往使用此項目的地方.
IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_UsedBy.cn: 点击以跳转到使用此项目的地方.

IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Currency.en: Charge in an item such as money instead of the built-in change, and rescale every price to suit.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Currency.ch: 改用金錢等物品收費, 取代內建的零錢, 並重新調整所有價格以配合.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Currency.cn: 改用金钱等物品收费, 代替内置的零钱, 并重新调整所有价格以适配.

IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_NewShop.en: Set up a new machine step by step: how it looks, where it spawns, and what it stocks.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_NewShop.ch: 逐步設定一台新機器: 外觀, 生成位置以及販售內容.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_NewShop.cn: 逐步设置一台新机器: 外观, 生成位置以及出售内容.

IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Pending.en: Machines already placed keep their old stock until they restock. Lists the ones your edits have affected.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Pending.ch: 已放置的機器在補貨前會保留舊庫存. 列出受你的編輯影響的機器.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Pending.cn: 已放置的机器在补货前会保留旧库存. 列出受你的编辑影响的机器.

IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Recompile.en: Re-reads the override files from disk. Only needed after editing them by hand; saving in here already does it.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Recompile.ch: 從磁碟重新讀取覆寫檔. 只有在手動編輯後才需要; 在這裡儲存時已會自動執行.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Recompile.cn: 从磁盘重新读取覆盖文件. 只有在手动编辑后才需要; 在这里保存时已会自动执行.

IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_ResetData.en: Clear wallets, purchase history and reward tracking for everyone at once. Pick what goes; nothing is ticked to start with.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_ResetData.ch: 一次清除所有人的錢包, 購買紀錄與獎勵追蹤. 自行選擇要清除的項目; 預設不勾選任何項目.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_ResetData.cn: 一次清除所有人的钱包, 购买记录和奖励追踪. 自行选择要清除的项目; 默认不勾选任何项目.

IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_RestockAll.en: Rerolls the stock of every machine in the world at once, changing what everyone can currently buy.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_RestockAll.ch: 一次重新抽取世界中所有機器的庫存, 改變所有人目前可購買的商品.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_RestockAll.cn: 一次重新随机世界中所有机器的库存, 改变所有人当前可购买的商品.

IGUI_PhunMart_Warn_GroupNoPrice.en: No price: these will not appear in a shop unless the pool sets one
IGUI_PhunMart_Warn_GroupNoPrice.ch: 無價格: 除非物品池有設定價格, 否則這些不會出現在商店中
IGUI_PhunMart_Warn_GroupNoPrice.cn: 无价格: 除非物品池设置了价格, 否则这些不会出现在商店中

IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_FourTiles.en: Needs four names, one per facing. Found %1
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_FourTiles.ch: 需要四個名稱, 每個朝向一個. 目前找到 %1 個
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_FourTiles.cn: 需要四个名称, 每个朝向一个. 当前找到 %1 个

IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_NameChars.en: Needs at least one letter or number
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_NameChars.ch: 至少需要一個字母或數字
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_NameChars.cn: 至少需要一个字母或数字

IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_NameTaken.en: That gives the key %1, which is already taken
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_NameTaken.ch: 這會產生鍵名 %1, 但已被使用
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_NameTaken.cn: 这会生成键名 %1, 但已被占用

IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Appearance.en: Unused art gives it its own look. Copying another shop means the two are alike in the world
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Appearance.ch: 使用未用過的圖案可讓它有獨特外觀. 複製其他商店則兩者在世界中外觀相同
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Appearance.cn: 使用未用过的美术图案可让它有独特外观. 复制其他商店则两者在世界中外观相同

IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Background.en: The image behind the shop window

IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_BackgroundOther.en: Image filename from your own mod
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_BackgroundOther.ch: 你自己 MOD 中的圖片檔名
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_BackgroundOther.cn: 你自己 MOD 中的图片文件名

IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Category.en: Two shops sharing a category are kept apart in the world
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Category.ch: 共用同一分類的兩間商店在世界中會彼此保持距離
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Category.cn: 共用同一分类的两家商店在世界中会彼此保持距离

IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_MinDistance.en: Tiles from the nearest shop of this type or category. Blank follows the sandbox setting (%1)
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_MinDistance.ch: 與最近同類型或同分類商店的格數. 留空則依沙盒設定 (%1)
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_MinDistance.cn: 与最近同类型或同分类商店的格数. 留空则遵循沙盒设置 (%1)

IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Name.en: Shown to players. The key is taken from this
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Name.ch: 顯示給玩家看. 鍵名由此產生
