IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_1.en: Fuck, fuck, fuck... I really don't like the sound of that.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_1.ch: 幹, 幹, 幹… 我真的很不喜歡這個聲音.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_1.cn: 操, 操, 操… 我真不喜欢这个声音.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_2.en: Shit... sounds like the whole city is coming for my ass.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_2.ch: 靠… 聽起來整座城市都要來找我麻煩了.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_2.cn: 妈的… 听起来整座城市都冲着我来了.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_3.en: God damn it, why right now? Fight them or run?
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_3.ch: 該死, 為什麼偏偏是現在? 要打還是要跑?
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_3.cn: 该死, 为什么偏偏是现在? 打还是跑?

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_4.en: No. That's not a horde. That's a fucking wall of dead.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_4.ch: 不. 那不是屍潮. 那是一整面該死的死屍牆.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_4.cn: 不. 那不是尸潮. 那是一整堵该死的尸墙.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_5.en: This sounds like grave trouble. Should've written a will earlier.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_5.ch: 聽起來大事不妙. 早該先寫好遺囑的.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_5.cn: 听起来大事不妙. 早该先写好遗嘱的.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_6.en: Fuuuuuuck! I'll need a good bottle of whiskey after this... if I survive.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_6.ch: 幹啊啊啊啊! 這之後我得來瓶好威士忌… 如果我還活著的話.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_6.cn: 操啊啊啊啊! 这之后我得来瓶好威士忌… 如果我还活着的话.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_1.en: Fuck... I hear a horde nearby. I think they're coming here.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_1.ch: 幹… 我聽到附近有屍潮. 我想牠們正朝這裡過來.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_1.cn: 操… 我听到附近有尸潮. 我想它们正朝这里过来.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_2.en: Shit. That's not just wandering. They're heading this way!
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_2.ch: 靠. 那不只是在遊蕩. 牠們正往這邊來!
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_2.cn: 妈的. 那不只是在游荡. 它们正往这边来!

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_3.en: Great. A whole damn crowd, and of course they found me.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_3.ch: 太好了. 一整群該死的傢伙, 當然還找上我了.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_3.cn: 太好了. 一整群该死的家伙, 当然还找上我了.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_4.en: I hear them. Too many footsteps... way too close.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_4.ch: 我聽到牠們了. 太多腳步聲了… 而且太近了.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_4.cn: 我听到它们了. 脚步声太多了… 而且太近了.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_5.en: I heard something over there. I should stay careful.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_5.ch: 我聽到那邊有動靜. 我得保持警覺.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_5.cn: 我听到那边有动静. 我得保持警惕.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_6.en: Goddamn wanderers. Why can't you just die? Oh, right. They're already dead.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_6.ch: 該死的遊蕩者. 你們為什麼就不能去死? 喔, 對了. 牠們早就死了.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_6.cn: 该死的游荡者. 你们为什么就不能去死? 哦, 对了. 它们早就死了.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_7.en: Yeah, fuckers! Come and get me!
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_7.ch: 來啊, 混蛋們! 來抓我啊!
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_7.cn: 来啊, 混蛋们! 来抓我啊!

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_8.en: I like company, but not that sort of company.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_8.ch: 我喜歡有人作伴, 但不是那種作伴.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_8.cn: 我喜欢有人作伴, 但不是那种作伴.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_9.en: Hey... I know that one. Gotta give them a proper burial.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_9.ch: 嘿… 我認得那個. 得好好安葬他們.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_9.cn: 嘿… 我认得那个. 得好好安葬他们.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_1.en: Hold on... that's a moving horde. Maybe I can stay quiet.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_1.ch: 等等… 那是一群移動中的屍潮. 也許我可以保持安靜.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_1.cn: 等等… 那是一群移动中的尸潮. 也许我可以保持安静.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_2.en: Shit. They're passing through. Don't make a sound.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_2.ch: 靠. 牠們正路過. 別發出聲音.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_2.cn: 妈的. 它们正路过. 别出声.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_3.en: That's a lot of dead on the move. Better let them pass.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_3.ch: 好多死屍在移動. 最好讓牠們過去.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_3.cn: 好多尸体在移动. 最好让它们过去.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_4.en: Keep it quiet... maybe they won't notice me.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_4.ch: 保持安靜… 也許牠們不會注意到我.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_4.cn: 保持安静… 也许它们不会注意到我.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_5.en: That's my neighborhood. Hope they don't stay long. Better not provoke them.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_5.ch: 那是我家那一帶. 希望牠們別待太久. 最好別招惹牠們.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_5.cn: 那是我家那一带. 希望它们别待太久. 最好别招惹它们.

IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_6.en: Is there a parade or what? I don't feel like joining. Better stay quiet.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_6.ch: 是在遊行還是怎樣? 我可不想加入. 最好保持安靜.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_6.cn: 是在游行还是怎样? 我可不想加入. 最好保持安静.

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Use_this_disc_from_t.en: Use this disc from the password screen.
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Use_this_disc_from_t.ch: 請在密碼畫面使用這張光碟.
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Use_this_disc_from_t.cn: 请在密码界面使用这张光盘.

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_User_barn_king_gave_.en: User barn king gave every tool hut a seven out of ten
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_User_barn_king_gave_.ch: 使用者 barn king 給每間工具小屋都打了七分 (滿分十分)
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_User_barn_king_gave_.cn: 用户 barn king 给每间工具小屋都打了七分 (满分十分)

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_User_names_use_lette.en: User names use letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_User_names_use_lette.ch: 使用者名稱可使用字母, 數字, 點, 連字號或底線.
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_User_names_use_lette.cn: 用户名可使用字母, 数字, 点, 连字符或下划线.

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wanted_spare_CRT_tub.en: Wanted spare CRT tube for Model 7 cabinet
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wanted_spare_CRT_tub.ch: 徵求: Model 7 機台用的備用 CRT 映像管
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wanted_spare_CRT_tub.cn: 求购: Model 7 机柜用的备用 CRT 显像管

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wanted_working_flopp.en: Wanted working floppy drive and clean keyboard
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wanted_working_flopp.ch: 徵求: 可用的軟碟機與乾淨的鍵盤
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wanted_working_flopp.cn: 求购: 能用的软驱和干净的键盘

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Weekly_poll_best_sha.en: Weekly poll best shake flavor is still vanilla cherry
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Weekly_poll_best_sha.ch: 每週投票: 最佳奶昔口味仍是香草櫻桃
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Weekly_poll_best_sha.cn: 每周投票: 最佳奶昔口味仍是香草樱桃

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Weekly_rant_dust_is_.en: Weekly rant dust is the real enemy of beige hardware
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Weekly_rant_dust_is_.ch: 每週牢騷: 灰塵才是米色硬體真正的敵人
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Weekly_rant_dust_is_.cn: 每周吐槽: 灰尘才是米色硬件真正的敌人

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wiping_notes_and_pre.ch: 正在抹除筆記與偏好設定
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wiping_notes_and_pre.cn: 正在擦除笔记与偏好设置

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wrong_field_Sequence.ch: 欄位錯誤. 序列已重設.
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wrong_field_Sequence.cn: 字段错误. 序列已重置.

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wrong_field_Start_ag.ch: 欄位錯誤. 請重新開始.
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_Wrong_field_Start_ag.cn: 字段错误. 请重新开始.

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_settings_and_install.en: settings and installed games will be cleared.
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_settings_and_install.ch: 設定與已安裝的遊戲將被清除.
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_settings_and_install.cn: 设置和已安装的游戏将被清除.

IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_setup_is_already_in_.ch: 安裝程式已在下載資料夾中.
IGUI_ComputerMod_UI_setup_is_already_in_.cn: 安装程序已在下载文件夹中.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_1.en: The public mirrors are failing, but the old archive at %s still answers. Save what you need while it is up.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_1.ch: 公開鏡像站紛紛失效, 但位於 %s 的舊檔案庫仍有回應. 趁它還連得上, 把需要的東西存下來.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_1.cn: 公共镜像站纷纷失效, 但位于 %s 的旧档案库仍有回应. 趁它还在线, 把需要的东西保存下来.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_2.en: Someone on radio mentioned %s. It looks abandoned, but the downloads still work.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_2.ch: 有人在無線電上提到了 %s. 看起來已經荒廢, 但下載還能用.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_2.cn: 有人在无线电里提到了 %s. 看起来已经荒废, 但下载还能用.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_3.en: If you are looking for the missing manuals, try %s before the relays go dark.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_3.ch: 如果你在找那些遺失的手冊, 趁中繼站斷線前試試 %s.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_3.cn: 如果你在找那些缺失的手册, 趁中继站断线前试试 %s.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_4.en: The board at %s is still reachable. Do not waste bandwidth downloading everything.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_4.ch: %s 的留言板還連得上. 別浪費頻寬把所有東西都下載下來.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_4.cn: %s 的留言板还能连上. 别浪费带宽把所有东西都下载下来.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_5.en: I found useful scans at %s. Writing the address here in case I do not get another connection.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_5.ch: 我在 %s 找到了有用的掃描檔. 把位址寫在這裡, 以防我再也連不上線.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_Secret_5.cn: 我在 %s 找到了有用的扫描件. 把地址写在这里, 以防我再也连不上网.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_1.en: Signal check. If anyone can read this, one relay is still carrying traffic east of the county.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_1.ch: 訊號測試. 如果有人能看到這則訊息, 縣東邊還有一座中繼站在傳輸資料.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_1.cn: 信号测试. 如果有人能看到这条消息, 县东边还有一座中继站在传输数据.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_10.en: Looking to trade lamp oil and clean jars for batteries. I check this board every second evening.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_10.ch: 想用燈油和乾淨的罐子換電池. 我每隔一晚會來看一次這個留言板.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_10.cn: 想用灯油和干净的罐子换电池. 我每隔一晚会来看一次这个留言板.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_11.en: Mark blocked roads in pencil. Wrecks move, fires spread and yesterday's safe route may be closed tomorrow.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_11.ch: 用鉛筆標記封鎖的道路. 殘骸會移動, 火勢會蔓延, 昨天安全的路線明天可能就走不通了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_11.cn: 用铅笔标记封锁的道路. 残骸会移动, 火势会蔓延, 昨天安全的路线明天可能就走不通了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_12.en: Large groups of infected drift west after heavy rain. The fields are quieter for now.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_12.ch: 大雨過後, 大批感染者會往西移動. 田野暫時比較安靜.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_12.cn: 大雨过后, 大批感染者会往西游荡. 田野暂时比较安静.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_13.en: The shallow well tastes wrong after the last storm. Boil everything, even if it looks clear.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_13.ch: 上次暴風雨後, 那口淺井的水味道不對. 什麼都要煮沸, 就算看起來很清澈也一樣.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_13.cn: 上次暴风雨后, 那口浅井的水味道不对. 什么都要煮沸, 就算看起来很清澈也一样.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_14.en: Cold weather will come eventually. Collect blankets and seal broken windows before supplies are buried under snow.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_14.ch: 寒冷的天氣遲早會來. 在物資被大雪掩埋之前, 收集毯子並封好破窗.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_14.cn: 寒冷的天气迟早会来. 在物资被大雪掩埋之前, 收集毯子并封好破窗.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_15.en: Replaced a burned fuse at the relay. Connection should hold until the generator needs fuel again.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_15.ch: 換掉了中繼站一根燒壞的保險絲. 在發電機下次需要加油之前, 連線應該都撐得住.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_15.cn: 换掉了中继站一根烧坏的保险丝. 在发电机下次需要加油之前, 连接应该都撑得住.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_16.en: Someone is leaving empty cans as trail markers near the warehouses. It may be a trap, so watch the rooftops.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_16.ch: 有人在倉庫附近留下空罐當路標. 可能是陷阱, 留意屋頂.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_16.cn: 有人在仓库附近留下空罐当路标. 可能是陷阱, 注意屋顶.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_17.en: Clean wounds immediately and keep bandages dry. Infection from dirty cuts is still dangerous even without a bite.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_17.ch: 立刻清理傷口並保持繃帶乾燥. 就算沒被咬, 骯髒傷口引起的感染仍然很危險.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_17.cn: 立刻清理伤口并保持绷带干燥. 就算没被咬, 脏伤口引起的感染仍然很危险.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_18.en: Saving cabbage and tomato seed for spring. Leave a reply if you have packets worth trading.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_18.ch: 正在留高麗菜和番茄種子等春天用. 如果你有值得交換的種子包, 請留言回覆.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_18.cn: 正在留卷心菜和番茄种子等春天用. 如果你有值得交换的种子包, 请留言回复.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_19.en: I transmit at noon when fuel allows. If you answer, keep it short and never give an exact location.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_19.ch: 燃料夠的話我會在中午發送訊號. 如果你要回應, 長話短說, 絕對不要透露確切位置.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_19.cn: 燃料够的话我会在中午发送信号. 如果你要回应, 长话短说, 绝对不要透露确切位置.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_2.en: We found clean water, but the road south is packed with wrecks. Travel on foot and stay off the pavement.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_2.ch: 我們找到了乾淨的水, 但往南的路被殘骸塞滿了. 步行前進, 別走在柏油路上.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_2.cn: 我们找到了干净的水, 但往南的路被残骸堵满了. 步行前进, 别走柏油路.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_20.en: No network signal remains south of the rail yard. This relay is probably the edge of the connected area.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_20.ch: 鐵路調車場以南已經沒有任何網路訊號. 這座中繼站大概就是連線範圍的邊緣.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_20.cn: 铁路调车场以南已经没有任何网络信号. 这座中继站大概就是联网区域的边缘.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_21.en: Weekly check-in: two voices answered on radio, one new light seen at night, no safe road east.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_21.ch: 每週回報: 無線電上有兩個人回應, 夜裡看到一處新的燈光, 往東沒有安全的道路.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_21.cn: 每周报到: 无线电里有两个人回应, 夜里看到一处新的灯光, 往东没有安全的道路.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_22.en: Found fresh footprints near the creek that were not ours. Someone else is surviving out there.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_22.ch: 在小溪附近發現了不是我們留下的新鮮腳印. 外面還有其他人活著.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_22.cn: 在小溪附近发现了不是我们留下的新鲜脚印. 外面还有其他人活着.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_3.en: Three of us are still here. We only connect when the generator is running, so replies may take a while.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_3.ch: 我們這裡還剩三個人. 只有發電機運轉時才會連線, 所以回覆可能要等一陣子.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_3.cn: 我们这里还剩三个人. 只有发电机运转时才会连线, 所以回复可能要等一阵子.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_4.en: Saw lights in an upstairs window last night. If that was you, cover them before dark.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_4.ch: 昨晚看到某扇樓上的窗戶有燈光. 如果是你, 天黑前把燈遮住.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_4.cn: 昨晚看到某扇楼上的窗户有灯光. 如果是你, 天黑前把灯遮住.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_5.en: Canned food is getting hard to find. Gardens and rain barrels matter more every day.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_5.ch: 罐頭食物越來越難找了. 菜園和雨水桶一天比一天重要.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_5.cn: 罐头食品越来越难找了. 菜园和雨水桶一天比一天重要.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_6.en: Long-range radio has gone quiet again. Local relays may be all that remains of the network.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_6.ch: 遠程無線電又安靜下來了. 本地中繼站可能是網路僅存的部分.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_6.cn: 远程无线电又安静下来了. 本地中继站可能是网络仅存的部分.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_7.en: Another week, another signal check. Leave a short post if you are alive.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_7.ch: 又一週, 又一次訊號測試. 如果你還活著, 留個簡短的貼文.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_7.cn: 又一周, 又一次信号测试. 如果你还活着, 留个简短的帖子.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_8.en: Do not follow the highway signs north. The road ends in a wall of abandoned cars.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_8.ch: 別照著高速公路往北的路標走. 那條路的盡頭是一堵由棄置車輛堆成的牆.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_8.cn: 别照着高速公路往北的路标走. 那条路的尽头是一堵由废弃车辆堆成的墙.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_9.en: Potatoes are growing in buckets on the roof. It is not much, but it proves we can make food without leaving the building.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_9.ch: 屋頂上的水桶裡種著馬鈴薯. 雖然不多, 但證明我們不用離開大樓也能生產食物.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_9.cn: 屋顶上的水桶里种着土豆. 虽然不多, 但证明我们不用离开大楼也能生产食物.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.en: We will check the location again after the next weather change.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.ch: 下次天氣變化後我們會再去確認那個地點.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.cn: 下次天气变化后我们会再去确认那个地点.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.en: Mark it on paper because the route may not remain safe.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.ch: 把它標在紙上, 因為那條路線不一定會一直安全.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.cn: 把它标在纸上, 因为那条路线不一定会一直安全.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.en: Travel quietly and leave before the light starts to fade.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.ch: 安靜移動, 並在天色開始變暗前離開.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.cn: 安静移动, 并在天色开始变暗前离开.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.en: A small group can use it, but a crowd would attract trouble.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.ch: 一小群人可以使用, 但人一多就會招來麻煩.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.cn: 一小群人可以使用, 但人一多就会招来麻烦.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.en: Fuel and clean water are still the limits on how long anyone can stay.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.ch: 燃料和乾淨的水仍然決定了任何人能待多久.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.cn: 燃料和干净的水仍然决定了任何人能待多久.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.en: Leave a short reply if conditions change before our next connection.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.ch: 如果在我們下次連線前情況有變, 請留個簡短回覆.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.cn: 如果在我们下次连线前情况有变, 请留个简短回复.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.en: We are not sharing an exact camp location over the board.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.ch: 我們不會在留言板上公開營地的確切位置.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.cn: 我们不会在留言板上公开营地的确切位置.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.en: The infected wander through irregularly, so wait and watch before approaching.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.ch: 感染者會不定時遊蕩經過, 所以靠近之前先等待觀察.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.cn: 感染者会不定时游荡经过, 所以靠近之前先等待观察.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.en: This may help someone who reaches the area later in the season.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.ch: 這也許能幫助這一季稍晚才抵達這一帶的人.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Deta.cn: 这也许能帮助这一季稍晚才抵达这一带的人.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: Rain barrels behind the brick apartments are full and the upper lids are still sealed.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 磚造公寓後方的雨水桶都裝滿了, 上蓋也仍然密封著.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 砖砌公寓后方的雨水桶都装满了, 上盖也仍然密封着.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: Dry seed packets were found inside metal drawers at the farm supply office.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 在農資用品店辦公室的金屬抽屜裡找到了乾燥的種子包.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 在农资用品店办公室的金属抽屉里找到了干燥的种子包.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: Bicycles can pass the vehicle pileup beside the highway without drawing much attention.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 騎腳踏車可以穿過公路旁的連環車禍現場, 不太會引起注意.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 骑自行车可以穿过公路旁的连环车祸现场, 不太会引起注意.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: The creek north of the tracks is clear upstream but contaminated below the wrecked tanker.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 鐵軌北邊的小溪上游很乾淨, 但在那輛撞毀的油罐車下游已經受到汙染.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 铁轨北边的小溪上游很干净, 但在那辆撞毁的油罐车下游已经受到污染.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: A two-person watch rotation kept the courtyard quiet through the last three nights.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 兩人一組輪班守夜, 讓庭院在過去三個晚上都保持平靜.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 两人一组轮班守夜, 让庭院在过去三个晚上都保持平静.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: A covered trade cache has been placed beneath the fallen sign near the county road.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 縣道附近倒下的招牌底下放了一個有遮蔽的交易物資點.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 县道附近倒下的招牌底下放了一个有遮蔽的交易物资点.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: The backup generator at the service building runs cleanly after replacing its cracked fuel line.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 服務大樓的備用發電機換掉破裂的油管後, 運轉得很順.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 服务大楼的备用发电机换掉破裂的油管后, 运转得很顺.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: The western fields are quiet at dawn, with only a few infected near the tree line.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 西邊的田地在黎明時很安靜, 只有樹林邊緣有幾個感染者.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 西边的田地在黎明时很安静, 只有树林边缘有几个感染者.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: A locked cabinet in the small clinic still holds bandages, disinfectant and sealed gloves.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 小診所裡一個上鎖的櫃子還放著繃帶, 消毒劑和密封的手套.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 小诊所里一个上锁的柜子还放着绷带, 消毒剂和密封的手套.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: The north warehouse has useful hand tools, but the loading floor is unstable near the office wall.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 北邊倉庫有實用的手工具, 但靠近辦公室牆邊的裝卸區地板不穩.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 北边仓库有实用的手工工具, 但靠近办公室墙边的装卸区地板不稳.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: The old bridge can be crossed on foot if you stay beside the southern railing.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 只要沿著南側欄杆走, 就能徒步走過那座舊橋.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 只要沿着南侧栏杆走, 就能徒步通过那座旧桥.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: The relay mast is working again after cleaning corrosion from the battery contacts.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 清掉電池接點上的鏽蝕後, 中繼天線塔又能運作了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 清掉电池触点上的锈蚀后, 中继天线塔又能运作了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: Thin cooking smoke appeared on the ridge for three evenings and vanished before sunrise.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 山脊上連續三個傍晚出現了淡淡的炊煙, 在日出前就消失了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 山脊上连续三个傍晚出现了淡淡的炊烟, 在日出前就消失了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.en: Cold nights are arriving earlier, and several empty houses still have intact fireplaces.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.ch: 寒冷的夜晚來得越來越早, 有幾間空屋的壁爐還完好無損.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_aftermath_Scen.cn: 寒冷的夜晚来得越来越早, 有几间空屋的壁炉还完好无损.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_1.en: There are people in the street attacking anyone who falls. This is real. Turn off your lights and stay quiet.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_1.ch: 街上有人在攻擊任何倒下的人. 這是真的. 把燈關掉, 保持安靜.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_1.cn: 街上有人在攻击任何倒下的人. 这是真的. 把灯关掉, 保持安静.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_10.en: If this post goes through, the network is still alive somewhere. People are not answering anymore.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_10.ch: 如果這篇貼文發得出去, 表示網路在某處還活著. 大家已經不再回應了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_10.cn: 如果这篇帖子发得出去, 说明网络在某处还活着. 大家已经不再回应了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_11.en: We barricaded the store, but the glass will not hold another rush. Moving upstairs while we still can.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_11.ch: 我們把店封起來了, 但玻璃撐不住下一波衝擊. 趁還能走, 我們先上樓.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_11.cn: 我们把店封起来了, 但玻璃撑不住下一波冲击. 趁还能走, 我们先上楼.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_12.en: Fire jumped from the clinic roof to the building next door. There are no crews left to stop it.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_12.ch: 火從診所屋頂延燒到隔壁大樓. 已經沒有消防隊能阻止了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_12.cn: 火从诊所屋顶蔓延到隔壁大楼. 已经没有消防队能阻止了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_13.en: Someone keeps calling for help from the intersection. Every time a person goes out, more of them appear.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_13.ch: 有人一直在十字路口呼救. 每次有人出去, 就會冒出更多它們.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_13.cn: 有人一直在十字路口呼救. 每次有人出去, 就会冒出更多它们.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_14.en: The last school bus is overturned by the rail crossing. Do not take that road.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_14.ch: 最後一班校車翻覆在鐵路平交道旁. 別走那條路.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_14.cn: 最后一班校车翻倒在铁路道口旁. 别走那条路.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_15.en: Gunshots solve one problem and bring twenty more. Use them only if you have no other choice.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_15.ch: 開槍解決一個問題, 卻會引來二十個. 除非別無選擇, 否則不要開槍.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_15.cn: 开枪解决一个问题, 却会引来二十个. 除非别无选择, 否则不要开枪.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_16.en: No ambulances, no police, no fire department. Whatever supplies you have are all you are getting.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_16.ch: 沒有救護車, 沒有警察, 沒有消防隊. 你手上有多少物資, 就只有那麼多.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_16.cn: 没有救护车, 没有警察, 没有消防队. 你手上有多少物资, 就只有那么多.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_17.en: Our shop doors gave way. I am leaving tools behind and taking only water, fuel and the truck.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_17.ch: 我們店的門被攻破了. 我要丟下工具, 只帶水, 燃料和卡車走.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_17.cn: 我们店的门被攻破了. 我要丢下工具, 只带水, 燃料和卡车走.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_18.en: We are trapped above the second floor. The stairwell is full of them and the fire escape is damaged.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_18.ch: 我們被困在二樓以上. 樓梯間擠滿了它們, 逃生梯也壞了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_18.cn: 我们被困在二楼以上. 楼梯间挤满了它们, 消防梯也坏了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_19.en: A helicopter circled twice without landing. People ran into the street and drew a crowd of infected behind them.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_19.ch: 一架直升機盤旋了兩圈沒有降落. 人們衝到街上, 身後引來一大群感染者.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_19.cn: 一架直升机盘旋了两圈没有降落. 人们冲到街上, 身后引来一大群感染者.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_2.en: The checkpoint is gone. Cars are burning on both sides of the road and nobody is directing traffic.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_2.ch: 檢查哨沒了. 道路兩側的車都在燃燒, 也沒有人在指揮交通.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_2.cn: 检查站没了. 道路两侧的车都在燃烧, 也没有人在指挥交通.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_20.en: Save your radio batteries. Most stations are dead and the few remaining signals repeat old recordings.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_20.ch: 省著用收音機的電池. 大部分電台都沒訊號了, 剩下的幾個也只是在重播舊錄音.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_20.cn: 省着用收音机的电池. 大部分电台都没信号了, 剩下的几个也只是在重播旧录音.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_21.en: The evacuation convoy never made it past the interchange. Do not follow the abandoned buses.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_21.ch: 撤離車隊根本沒能穿過交流道. 別跟著那些被丟棄的巴士走.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_21.cn: 撤离车队根本没能通过立交桥. 别跟着那些被丢弃的公交车走.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_22.en: The supermarket is completely overrun. There is food in smaller houses if you can enter without making noise.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_22.ch: 超市完全被佔領了. 小一點的房子裡還有食物, 前提是你能不出聲地進去.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_22.cn: 超市完全被占领了. 小一点的房子里还有食物, 前提是你能不出声地进去.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_23.en: My neighbor died last night and stood back up this morning. Stop waiting for this to make sense.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_23.ch: 我的鄰居昨晚死了, 今天早上又站起來了. 別再等著這一切變得合理了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_23.cn: 我的邻居昨晚死了, 今天早上又站起来了. 别再等着这一切变得合理了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_24.en: The eastern bridge is burning and part of the span has collapsed. There is no route through downtown.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_24.ch: 東邊的橋在燃燒, 部分橋身已經坍塌. 已經沒有路能穿過市中心了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_24.cn: 东边的桥在燃烧, 部分桥身已经坍塌. 已经没有路能穿过市中心了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_25.en: This board takes longer to load every hour. Copy down useful addresses before the connection disappears.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_25.ch: 這個留言板每過一小時就載入得更慢. 趁連線還沒斷, 把有用的地址抄下來.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_25.cn: 这个留言板每过一小时就加载得更慢. 趁连接还没断, 把有用的地址抄下来.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_26.en: If your generator is outside, shut it down before refueling. The sound carries farther than you think.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_26.ch: 如果你的發電機放在室外, 加油前先關掉. 聲音會傳得比你想像的更遠.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_26.cn: 如果你的发电机放在室外, 加油前先关掉. 声音会传得比你想象的更远.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_27.en: We waited as long as we could. My family is leaving before sunrise. I hope somebody reading this gets out too.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_27.ch: 我們已經盡可能地等了. 我家人會在日出前離開. 希望看到這篇的人也能逃出去.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_27.cn: 我们已经尽可能地等了. 我家人会在日出前离开. 希望看到这篇的人也能逃出去.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_3.en: We are leaving through the back roads. If the bridge is blocked, we will try the old service road.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_3.ch: 我們要走小路離開. 如果橋被堵住, 我們會試試那條舊的維修道路.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_3.cn: 我们要走小路离开. 如果桥被堵住, 我们会试试那条旧的维修道路.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_4.en: They do not stay down unless the head is destroyed. I wish I was making this up.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_4.ch: 除非頭被破壞, 否則它們倒下後還會再站起來. 我真希望這是我編的.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_4.cn: 除非头被破坏, 否则它们倒下后还会再站起来. 我真希望这是我编的.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_5.en: Water pressure just stopped. Fill every container you have while anything is still coming from the tap.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_5.ch: 水壓剛剛沒了. 趁水龍頭還流得出東西, 把你所有的容器都裝滿.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_5.cn: 水压刚刚没了. 趁水龙头还流得出东西, 把你所有的容器都装满.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_6.en: Military frequencies are mostly silent. A repeating transmission says major routes are compromised.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_6.ch: 軍用頻率幾乎都沒有聲音了. 一段重複播放的訊息說主要道路都已失守.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_6.cn: 军用频率几乎都没有声音了. 一段重复播放的信息说主要道路都已失守.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_7.en: Is anyone on this board actually safe? Please answer with your town, not your address.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_7.ch: 這個留言板上真的有人安全嗎? 請回覆你所在的城鎮, 不要回覆你的地址.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_7.cn: 这个留言板上真的有人安全吗? 请回复你所在的城镇, 不要回复你的地址.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_8.en: The hospital is burning. I cannot reach my brother anymore.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_8.ch: 醫院在燃燒. 我再也聯絡不上我哥哥了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_8.cn: 医院在燃烧. 我再也联系不上我哥哥了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_9.en: Do not use sirens or car horns. The noise pulls them in from blocks away.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_9.ch: 不要用警笛或汽車喇叭. 那種噪音會把好幾個街區外的它們都引過來.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_9.cn: 不要用警笛或汽车喇叭. 那种噪音会把好几个街区外的它们都引过来.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_1.en: There are no emergency crews left in sight.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_1.ch: 眼前已經看不到任何緊急救援人員了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_1.cn: 眼前已经看不到任何紧急救援人员了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_2.en: Noise draws more of them before anyone can clear a path.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_2.ch: 在任何人清出一條路之前, 噪音就會引來更多它們.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_2.cn: 在任何人清出一条路之前, 噪音就会引来更多它们.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_3.en: Anyone still moving through the area should stay out of the open.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_3.ch: 還在這一帶移動的人, 都應該避開空曠處.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_3.cn: 还在这一带移动的人, 都应该避开空旷处.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_4.en: We watched several survivors turn back and disappear between the buildings.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_4.ch: 我們看到好幾個倖存者轉身折返, 消失在建築物之間.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_4.cn: 我们看到好几个幸存者转身折返, 消失在建筑物之间.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_5.en: The safest route from yesterday is already unusable.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_5.ch: 昨天最安全的路線已經不能走了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_5.cn: 昨天最安全的路线已经不能走了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_6.en: If this board stays online, post a warning before anyone else walks into it.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_6.ch: 如果這個留言板還能連上, 在其他人誤闖之前先貼個警告.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Detail_6.cn: 如果这个留言板还在线, 在其他人误闯之前先发个警告.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_1.en: Fire has crossed the downtown block and the smoke is hiding movement at street level.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_1.ch: 大火已經蔓延過市中心街區, 煙霧遮住了街道上的動靜.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_1.cn: 大火已经蔓延过市中心街区, 烟雾遮住了街道上的动静.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_2.en: The infected packed against the road barrier until the fencing folded into the traffic lane.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_2.ch: 感染者擠在道路護欄上, 直到圍欄被壓垮倒進車道.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_2.cn: 感染者挤在道路护栏上, 直到围栏被压垮倒进车道.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_3.en: People in the apartment building pulled furniture into the stairwell and cut the lights.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_3.ch: 公寓大樓裡的人把家具拖進樓梯間, 還把燈都關了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_3.cn: 公寓大楼里的人把家具拖进楼梯间, 还把灯都关了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_4.en: The warehouse doors are open and armed groups are dragging crates into pickup trucks.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_4.ch: 倉庫的門開著, 武裝團體正把一箱箱物資拖上小貨卡.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_4.cn: 仓库的门开着, 武装团伙正把一箱箱物资拖上皮卡.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_5.en: The evacuation line broke apart when the lead vehicles tried to turn around.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_5.ch: 前導車輛試圖迴轉時, 撤離車隊就整個散掉了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_5.cn: 前导车辆试图掉头时, 撤离车队就整个散掉了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_6.en: The telephone exchange is dark, but one pay phone outside keeps ringing by itself.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_6.ch: 電話交換局一片漆黑, 但外面有一座公用電話一直自己響個不停.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_6.cn: 电话交换局一片漆黑, 但外面有一部公用电话一直自己响个不停.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_7.en: Freight cars are blocking the rail yard while infected move between them in large groups.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_7.ch: 貨運車廂堵住了調車場, 感染者成群地在車廂之間移動.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_7.cn: 货运车厢堵住了调车场, 感染者成群地在车厢之间移动.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_8.en: Every house on Cedar Street is silent except one alarm that has been sounding for hours.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_8.ch: 雪松街上的每一棟房子都一片死寂, 只有一個警報器已經響了好幾個小時.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_chaos_Scene_8.cn: 雪松街上的每一栋房子都一片死寂, 只有一个警报器已经响了好几个小时.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_1.en: Did anyone else lose cable for a minute? Mine came back, but every local channel is showing the same county notice.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_1.ch: 有人的有線電視也斷了一下嗎? 我的恢復了, 但每個地方頻道都在播同一則縣府公告.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_1.cn: 有人的有线电视也断了一下吗? 我的恢复了, 但每个本地频道都在播同一条县政府公告.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_10.en: Our grocery delivery never arrived this morning. The manager says the truck was turned around at the county line.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_10.ch: 我們的雜貨今天早上一直沒送到. 經理說貨車在縣界被擋回去了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_10.cn: 我们的杂货今天早上一直没送到. 经理说货车在县界被挡回去了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_11.en: County used to run emergency drills every summer. This does not look like any drill I remember.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_11.ch: 縣裡以前每年夏天都會辦緊急演習. 這看起來不像我記得的任何一次演習.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_11.cn: 县里以前每年夏天都会办紧急演习. 这看起来不像我记得的任何一次演习.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_12.en: Rumor at school says classes might be cancelled tomorrow. Teachers were told not to discuss it with students.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_12.ch: 學校在傳明天可能會停課. 老師們被告知不要跟學生討論這件事.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_12.cn: 学校在传明天可能会停课. 老师们被告知不要跟学生讨论这件事.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_13.en: Long-distance calls connect for a few seconds and then drop. Local calls still work sometimes.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_13.ch: 長途電話接通幾秒就斷了. 市內電話有時候還打得通.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_13.cn: 长途电话接通几秒就断了. 市内电话有时候还打得通.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_14.en: We sold out of masks before lunch. Please stop shouting at the counter staff; we do not have more in the back.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_14.ch: 口罩午餐前就賣光了. 請不要再對櫃檯人員大吼, 我們後面也沒有庫存了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_14.cn: 口罩午饭前就卖光了. 请不要再对柜台人员大吼, 我们后面也没有库存了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_15.en: There is no severe weather in the forecast. Whatever is causing the outages, it is not a storm.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_15.ch: 天氣預報裡沒有任何惡劣天氣. 不管停電是什麼造成的, 都不是暴風雨.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_15.cn: 天气预报里没有任何恶劣天气. 不管停电是什么造成的, 都不是暴风雨.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_16.en: Highway patrol came through asking every shop how many tow trucks were running. They would not say why.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_16.ch: 公路巡警來問了每家店有幾台拖吊車還能跑. 他們不肯說為什麼.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_16.cn: 公路巡警来问了每家店有几辆拖车还能跑. 他们不肯说为什么.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_17.en: The daycare called for early pickup. They said several employees failed to arrive for work.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_17.ch: 托兒所打電話叫家長提早接小孩. 他們說有好幾個員工沒來上班.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_17.cn: 托儿所打电话叫家长提早接孩子. 他们说有好几个员工没来上班.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_18.en: Three helicopters crossed town heading south. Too high to see markings, but they were moving fast.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_18.ch: 三架直升機往南飛越鎮上. 飛得太高看不到標誌, 但速度很快.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_18.cn: 三架直升机往南飞越镇上. 飞得太高看不到标志, 但速度很快.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_19.en: Our office sent everyone home before noon. They told us to take our files but leave the computers on.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_19.ch: 公司中午前就讓所有人回家了. 他們叫我們帶走文件, 但電腦要開著.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_19.cn: 公司中午前就让所有人回家了. 他们叫我们带走文件, 但电脑要开着.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_2.en: Traffic is backed up past the school. If you are heading into town, take the long way around.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_2.ch: 車潮一路堵到學校後面. 如果你要進城, 繞遠路吧.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_2.cn: 车流一路堵到学校后面. 如果你要进城, 绕远路吧.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_20.en: Lunch crowd is full of people trading rumors. Nobody has heard the same story twice.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_20.ch: 午餐時間的人潮都在交換小道消息. 沒有人聽到的說法是一樣的.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_20.cn: 午饭时间的人群都在交换小道消息. 没有人听到的说法是一样的.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_21.en: The library is closing early. Do not worry about due dates until regular hours resume.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_21.ch: 圖書館提早關門了. 在恢復正常開放時間前, 不用擔心借書到期.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_21.cn: 图书馆提早关门了. 在恢复正常开放时间前, 不用担心借书到期.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_22.en: Package routes east of town are suspended. Anything already on a truck may be returned to the depot.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_22.ch: 鎮東邊的包裹配送路線暫停了. 已經在貨車上的東西可能會被退回物流站.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_22.cn: 镇东边的包裹配送路线暂停了. 已经在货车上的东西可能会被退回物流站.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_23.en: If you own a battery radio, check it now. Local stations are already having trouble staying on air.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_23.ch: 如果你有電池收音機, 現在就檢查一下. 地方電台已經快撐不住播出了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_23.cn: 如果你有电池收音机, 现在就检查一下. 本地电台已经快撑不住播出了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_3.en: The pharmacy line is out the door. People keep saying it is just a bad flu, so why is everyone buying masks?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_3.ch: 藥局排隊的人都排到門外了. 大家一直說只是嚴重的流感, 那為什麼每個人都在買口罩?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_3.cn: 药店排队的人都排到门外了. 大家一直说只是严重的流感, 那为什么每个人都在买口罩?

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_4.en: Is tonight's game cancelled or not? The radio keeps cutting away before they say anything useful.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_4.ch: 今晚的比賽到底有沒有取消? 收音機每次都在講到重點前就切掉.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_4.cn: 今晚的比赛到底有没有取消? 收音机每次都在讲到重点前就切掉.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_5.en: Power blinked twice on our block. Save whatever you are working on before it happens again.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_5.ch: 我們這個街區停電閃了兩次. 在再發生之前, 先把手邊在做的東西儲存起來.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_5.cn: 我们这个街区停电闪了两次. 在再发生之前, 先把手头在做的东西保存起来.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_6.en: The emergency broadcast says to stay calm and avoid unnecessary travel. No evacuation order has been issued.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_6.ch: 緊急廣播說要保持冷靜, 避免不必要的外出. 目前尚未發布撤離命令.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_6.cn: 紧急广播说要保持冷静, 避免不必要的外出. 目前尚未发布撤离命令.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_7.en: My brother works near the hospital. He says ambulances have been arriving nonstop since before sunrise.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_7.ch: 我哥在醫院附近上班. 他說從日出前開始, 救護車就一台接一台地來.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_7.cn: 我哥在医院附近上班. 他说从日出前开始, 救护车就一辆接一辆地来.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_8.en: Does anyone know why the pay phones are all busy? I cannot get through to my parents in Louisville.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_8.ch: 有人知道為什麼公用電話都占線嗎? 我打不通在路易斯維爾的爸媽.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_8.cn: 有人知道为什么公用电话都占线吗? 我打不通在路易斯维尔的爸妈.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_9.en: The gas station has a line around the block. Half the people there are filling spare cans.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_9.ch: 加油站排隊的車繞了街區一圈. 一半的人都在裝備用油桶.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_9.cn: 加油站排队的车绕了街区一圈. 一半的人都在装备用油桶.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Detail_.en: People are treating it like a temporary inconvenience, but the mood is changing.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Detail_.ch: 大家把這當成暫時的不便, 但氣氛正在改變.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Detail_.cn: 大家把这当成暂时的不便, 但气氛正在改变.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_1.en: The bank closed its lobby before lunch and moved every employee away from the front windows.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_1.ch: 銀行午餐前就關閉了大廳, 並讓所有員工遠離前面的窗戶.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_1.cn: 银行午饭前就关闭了大厅, 并让所有员工远离前面的窗户.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_2.en: The bus depot cancelled two routes without posting a replacement schedule.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_2.ch: 公車總站取消了兩條路線, 卻沒有公布替代時刻表.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_2.cn: 公交总站取消了两条线路, 却没有公布替代时刻表.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_3.en: County offices are stacking file boxes in the hallway and sending temporary staff home.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_3.ch: 縣府辦公室把檔案箱堆在走廊上, 還讓臨時人員回家.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_3.cn: 县政府办公室把档案箱堆在走廊上, 还让临时人员回家.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_4.en: The grocery store limited water and canned food to two cases per customer.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_4.ch: 雜貨店限制每位顧客的飲用水和罐頭食品最多只能買兩箱.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_4.cn: 杂货店限制每位顾客的饮用水和罐头食品最多只能买两箱.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_5.en: Telephone repair crews were called back to their yard before finishing today's service calls.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_5.ch: 電話維修人員在完成今天的維修工作前, 就被叫回了站場.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_5.cn: 电话维修人员在完成今天的维修工作前, 就被叫回了场站.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_6.en: The local radio station asked volunteers to bring spare batteries and extension cords.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_6.ch: 地方電台請志工帶備用電池和延長線過去.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_6.cn: 本地电台请志愿者带备用电池和插线板过去.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_7.en: The animal shelter stopped accepting strays and asked owners to keep pets indoors.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_7.ch: 動物收容所停止收容流浪動物, 並請飼主把寵物留在室內.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_normal_Scene_7.cn: 动物收容所停止收容流浪动物, 并请主人把宠物留在室内.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_1.en: The school sent everyone home. One of the buses never arrived and nobody at the office will answer.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_1.ch: 學校讓所有人回家了. 其中一輛校車一直沒到, 辦公室也沒人接電話.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_1.cn: 学校让所有人回家了. 其中一辆校车一直没到, 办公室也没人接电话.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_10.en: My son has a fever but no bites. The emergency number rings once and disconnects. What am I supposed to do?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_10.ch: 我兒子發燒了, 但沒有被咬. 緊急電話響一聲就斷了. 我該怎麼辦?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_10.cn: 我儿子发烧了, 但没有被咬. 急救电话响一声就断了. 我该怎么办?

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_11.en: An abandoned car rolled into our lot with blood on the driver's door. Nobody has come looking for it.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_11.ch: 一輛無人的車溜進了我們的停車場, 駕駛座車門上有血. 一直沒人來找它.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_11.cn: 一辆无人的车溜进了我们的停车场, 驾驶座车门上有血. 一直没人来找它.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_12.en: There is screaming behind the clinic and something keeps hitting the side entrance from inside.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_12.ch: 診所後面傳來尖叫聲, 還有東西一直從裡面撞著側門.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_12.cn: 诊所后面传来尖叫声, 还有东西一直从里面撞着侧门.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_13.en: Both roads toward the county line are blocked now. People are turning around and driving across fields.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_13.ch: 通往縣界的兩條路現在都封了. 大家紛紛掉頭, 直接開車穿過田地.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_13.cn: 通往县界的两条路现在都封了. 大家纷纷掉头, 直接开车穿过田地.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_14.en: The emergency shelter at the school is locked. A note on the door says to remain at home.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_14.ch: 學校的緊急避難所鎖起來了. 門上的字條說要待在家裡.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_14.cn: 学校的紧急避难所锁起来了. 门上的字条说要待在家里.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_15.en: Television keeps repeating the same message, but the footage behind the anchor is getting worse.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_15.ch: 電視一直重複播同樣的訊息, 但主播背後的畫面越來越糟.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_15.cn: 电视一直重复播同样的信息, 但主播背后的画面越来越糟.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_16.en: Antibiotics will not fix this. We tried to explain that before the crowd broke the front windows.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_16.ch: 抗生素治不了這個. 在人群打破前窗之前, 我們就試著解釋過了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_16.cn: 抗生素治不了这个. 在人群打破前窗之前, 我们就试着解释过了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_17.en: A coworker collapsed in the parking lot and attacked the people helping him. Police never arrived.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_17.ch: 一個同事在停車場倒下, 然後攻擊了去幫他的人. 警察一直沒來.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_17.cn: 一个同事在停车场倒下, 然后攻击了去帮他的人. 警察一直没来.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_18.en: Power has been off for an hour. We are cooking what will spoil and giving it away at the back door.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_18.ch: 已經停電一個小時了. 我們把會壞掉的東西煮一煮, 從後門送出去.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_18.cn: 已经停电一个小时了. 我们把会坏掉的东西煮一煮, 从后门送出去.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_19.en: My delivery van was surrounded near the courthouse. I left it running and got out through an alley.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_19.ch: 我的送貨廂型車在法院附近被包圍了. 我讓它繼續發動著, 從一條小巷逃了出來.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_19.cn: 我的送货面包车在法院附近被包围了. 我让它继续发动着, 从一条小巷逃了出来.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_2.en: Police closed the main road. I saw people running between cars near the checkpoint.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_2.ch: 警察封鎖了主要道路. 我看到有人在檢查哨附近的車子之間奔跑.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_2.cn: 警察封锁了主要道路. 我看到有人在检查站附近的车子之间奔跑.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_20.en: Families are sheltering in the reading room. We pushed shelves against the glass doors.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_20.ch: 好幾個家庭躲在閱覽室裡. 我們把書架推去擋住玻璃門.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_20.cn: 好几个家庭躲在阅览室里. 我们把书架推去挡住玻璃门.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_21.en: Every dog on our street has been barking since sunset. Now some of them have stopped all at once.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_21.ch: 從日落開始, 我們這條街上的狗全都在叫. 現在有些突然同時安靜了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_21.cn: 从日落开始, 我们这条街上的狗全都在叫. 现在有些突然同时安静了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_22.en: The dark column north of town is smoke, not cloud cover. Wind is carrying it east.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_22.ch: 鎮北邊那道黑色柱狀物是煙, 不是雲. 風正把它往東吹.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_22.cn: 镇北边那道黑色柱状物是烟, 不是云. 风正把它往东吹.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_23.en: The AM station ended mid-sentence. One weak signal is still repeating instructions to boil water.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_23.ch: AM 電台講到一半就斷了. 還有一個微弱的訊號在重複播放把水煮沸的指示.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_23.cn: AM 电台讲到一半就断了. 还有一个微弱的信号在重复播放把水煮沸的指示.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_3.en: Do not go to the clinic. The doors are locked and the parking lot is completely full.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_3.ch: 不要去診所. 門鎖上了, 停車場也完全停滿了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_3.cn: 不要去诊所. 门锁上了, 停车场也完全停满了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_4.en: They are saying bites now. Not fever, bites. What kind of sickness spreads through bites?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_4.ch: 他們現在說是咬傷. 不是發燒, 是咬傷. 什麼樣的病會透過咬傷傳染?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_4.cn: 他们现在说是咬伤. 不是发烧, 是咬伤. 什么样的病会通过咬伤传染?

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_5.en: Someone is pounding on the house across the street. The owners will not open the door.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_5.ch: 有人在猛敲對街那棟房子. 屋主不肯開門.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_5.cn: 有人在猛敲对街那栋房子. 房主不肯开门.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_6.en: Shortwave traffic reports trouble in more than one town. This is not limited to Knox County.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_6.ch: 短波通訊回報不只一個城鎮出了問題. 這不只限於諾克斯縣.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_6.cn: 短波通讯报告不止一个城镇出了问题. 这不仅限于诺克斯县.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_7.en: The television signal is gone. If anyone still has radio news, please post what you hear.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_7.ch: 電視訊號沒了. 如果還有人能收到廣播新聞, 請把你聽到的貼上來.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_7.cn: 电视信号没了. 如果还有人能收到广播新闻, 请把你听到的发上来.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_8.en: My brother finally called. He said to lock every door and not let anyone inside, even if they look injured.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_8.ch: 我哥終於打電話來了. 他說要把每扇門都鎖上, 不要讓任何人進來, 就算對方看起來受了傷也一樣.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_8.cn: 我哥终于打电话来了. 他说要把每扇门都锁上, 不要让任何人进来, 就算对方看起来受了伤也一样.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_9.en: Soldiers are checking cars near the bridge. They turned us back without explaining where we should go.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_9.ch: 士兵在橋附近檢查車輛. 他們把我們趕回頭, 卻沒說我們該去哪裡.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_9.cn: 士兵在桥附近检查车辆. 他们把我们赶回头, 却没说我们该去哪里.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.en: Nobody in charge will explain what triggered the response.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.ch: 負責的人沒有一個肯解釋是什麼引發了這次應變行動.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.cn: 负责的人没有一个肯解释是什么引发了这次应急行动.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.en: The crowd gets more frightened each time another emergency vehicle passes.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.ch: 每當又有一輛緊急車輛經過, 人群就變得更加驚恐.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.cn: 每当又有一辆紧急车辆经过, 人群就变得更加惊恐.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.en: People are leaving on foot because traffic is no longer moving.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.ch: 因為車流已經完全不動, 大家開始徒步離開.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.cn: 因为车流已经完全不动, 大家开始徒步离开.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.en: Anyone nearby should keep their distance and find another route.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.ch: 附近的人都應該保持距離, 另找其他路線.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Detai.cn: 附近的人都应该保持距离, 另找其他路线.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.en: A second checkpoint appeared on the highway and officers are searching every vehicle.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.ch: 公路上出現了第二個檢查站, 警員正在搜查每一輛車.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.cn: 公路上出现了第二个检查站, 警员正在搜查每一辆车.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.en: Hospital staff put tents in the parking lot, then moved everyone back inside without warning.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.ch: 醫院人員在停車場搭起帳篷, 接著又毫無預警地把所有人移回室內.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.cn: 医院人员在停车场搭起帐篷, 接着又毫无预警地把所有人移回室内.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.en: The school shelter opened for less than an hour before guards locked the outer gates.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.ch: 學校避難所開放不到一小時, 警衛就鎖上了外側大門.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.cn: 学校避难所开放不到一小时, 警卫就锁上了外侧大门.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.en: The supermarket stopped selling food after a fight spread from the checkout line.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.ch: 結帳隊伍爆發的打鬥蔓延開來後, 超市就停止販售食物了.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.cn: 结账队伍爆发的斗殴蔓延开来后, 超市就停止售卖食物了.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.en: Sheriff cars keep passing toward downtown with lights on and no sirens.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.ch: 警長辦公室的警車不斷駛向市中心, 開著警示燈卻沒鳴警笛.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.cn: 警长办公室的警车不断驶向市中心, 开着警灯却没鸣警笛.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.en: Technicians climbed the radio tower this morning and came down carrying equipment cases.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.ch: 技術人員今早爬上無線電塔, 下來時帶著幾個設備箱.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Board_outbreak_Scene.cn: 技术人员今早爬上无线电塔, 下来时带着几个设备箱.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_1.en: Hey, random add, but do I know you from the county board? Everything around town is acting strange today.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_1.ch: 嘿, 突然加你有點唐突, 不過我們是不是在本縣留言板上見過? 今天鎮上一切都怪怪的.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_1.cn: 嘿, 突然加你有点冒昧, 不过我们是不是在本县留言板上见过? 今天镇上一切都怪怪的.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_2.en: Sorry if I added the wrong person. Have you heard why the roads near the hospital are blocked?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_2.ch: 如果加錯人了, 抱歉. 你有聽說醫院附近的道路為什麼被封鎖了嗎?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_2.cn: 如果加错人了, 抱歉. 你有听说医院附近的道路为什么被封锁了吗?

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_3.en: Hi. The phone lines are busy and this is the only service that still connects. Is it normal where you are?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_3.ch: 嗨. 電話線路一直忙線, 只剩這個服務還能連上. 你那邊還正常嗎?
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day1_3.cn: 嗨. 电话线路一直占线, 只剩这个服务还能连上. 你那边还正常吗?

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_1.en: Thanks for accepting. People here are saying the sickness makes them violent. Lock your doors tonight.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_1.ch: 謝謝你接受邀請. 這裡的人說這種病會讓人變得暴力. 今晚記得把門鎖好.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_1.cn: 谢谢你通过好友申请. 这里的人说这种病会让人变得暴力. 今晚记得把门锁好.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_2.en: The news stopped giving details. If you hear anything reliable, stay inside and keep a radio nearby.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_2.ch: 新聞不再透露細節了. 如果你聽到可靠的消息, 就待在室內, 收音機放在身邊.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_2.cn: 新闻不再透露细节了. 如果你听到可靠的消息, 就待在室内, 收音机放在身边.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_3.en: I added anyone who looked local. My family is trying to decide whether to leave before the roads close.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_3.ch: 我把看起來像本地人的都加了. 我家人正在考慮要不要趁道路封閉前離開.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day2_3.cn: 我把看起来像本地人的都加了. 我家人正在考虑要不要趁道路封闭前离开.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_1.en: The phones are dead here. We are leaving town before dark. Do not go near anyone who has been bitten.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_1.ch: 這裡電話都不通了. 我們天黑前就要離開鎮上. 別靠近任何被咬過的人.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_1.cn: 这里电话都不通了. 我们天黑前就要离开镇上. 别靠近任何被咬过的人.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_2.en: I can hear sirens everywhere and nobody is answering emergency calls. Find somewhere quiet and stay there.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_2.ch: 到處都聽得到警笛聲, 緊急電話卻沒人接. 找個安靜的地方待著別動.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_2.cn: 到处都听得到警笛声, 紧急电话却没人接. 找个安静的地方待着别动.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_3.en: They broke through the store entrance. I am moving to the back roads now. Good luck, whoever you are.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_3.ch: 他們衝破了商店入口. 我現在要改走鄉間小路. 祝你好運, 不管你是誰.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day3_3.cn: 他们冲破了商店入口. 我现在要改走乡间小路. 祝你好运, 不管你是谁.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_1.en: This may be my last connection. They are in the street and the power keeps failing. Do not come looking for me.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_1.ch: 這可能是我最後一次連線了. 他們就在街上, 電力也一直斷斷續續. 別來找我.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_1.cn: 这可能是我最后一次连线了. 他们就在街上, 电力也一直断断续续. 别来找我.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_2.en: We are shutting the generator down after this message. Noise brings them closer. Stay alive.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_2.ch: 傳完這則訊息我們就要關掉發電機. 噪音會把他們引過來. 好好活下去.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_2.cn: 发完这条消息我们就要关掉发电机. 噪音会把他们引过来. 好好活下去.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_3.en: Almost everyone on my contact list has gone offline. If you can read this, keep moving and avoid the main roads.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_3.ch: 我的聯絡人幾乎都離線了. 如果你看得到這則訊息, 繼續移動, 避開主要道路.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Chat_day4_3.cn: 我的联系人几乎都离线了. 如果你看得到这条消息, 继续移动, 避开主要道路.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_1.en: Your Value Club account qualifies for special prices on batteries, bottled water and household storage. Bring this message to any participating location.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_1.ch: 您的 Value Club 會員帳戶可享電池, 瓶裝水與家用收納用品特價. 請攜帶此訊息至任一參與門市.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_1.cn: 您的 Value Club 会员账户可享电池, 瓶装水和家用收纳用品特价. 请携带此信息前往任一参与门店.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_2.en: Summer cabins are still available near the lake. Reserve two nights and receive the third night free. Telephone confirmation required.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_2.ch: 湖畔的夏季小屋仍有空房. 預訂兩晚即贈送第三晚免費住宿. 需電話確認.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_2.cn: 湖畔的夏季小屋仍有空房. 预订两晚即赠送第三晚免费住宿. 需电话确认.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_3.en: New kitchen organizers, tool cabinets and weather radios are now available by mail order. Ask about our twelve-month payment plan.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_3.ch: 全新廚房收納用品, 工具櫃與氣象收音機現已開放郵購. 歡迎洽詢十二個月分期付款方案.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_3.cn: 全新厨房收纳用品, 工具柜和气象收音机现已开放邮购. 欢迎咨询十二个月分期付款方案.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_4.en: Schedule a complimentary tire and battery inspection this week. Offer valid while appointment slots remain.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_4.ch: 本週預約免費輪胎與電瓶檢查. 優惠至預約名額額滿為止.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_4.cn: 本周预约免费轮胎和电瓶检查. 优惠至预约名额约满为止.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_5.en: Rent any new release and choose a second tape at no charge. Late fees and membership rules still apply.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_5.ch: 租借任一新片, 即可免費多選一捲錄影帶. 逾期費與會員規定仍然適用.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_Advertisement_5.cn: 租借任一新片, 即可免费多选一盘录像带. 逾期费与会员规定仍然适用.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fire_1_Body.en: Complete the engine and breathing apparatus checklist before the next shift change. Report missing seals immediately.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fire_1_Body.ch: 下次換班前完成消防車與呼吸器檢查表. 如有密封件遺失請立即回報.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fire_1_Body.cn: 下次换班前完成消防车和呼吸器检查表. 如有密封件缺失请立即上报.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fire_2_Body.en: Saturday's mutual aid drill begins at 0700. Bring turnout gear and a working portable radio.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fire_2_Body.ch: 週六的聯合支援演練於 0700 開始. 請攜帶消防衣與可正常運作的攜帶式無線電.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fire_2_Body.cn: 周六的联合支援演练于 0700 开始. 请携带消防战斗服和能正常使用的便携式无线电.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fitness_1_Body.en: An instructor is needed for two evening classes this week. Reply if you can cover either session.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fitness_1_Body.ch: 本週有兩堂晚間課程需要講師. 如果你能代其中任一堂, 請回覆.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fitness_1_Body.cn: 本周有两节晚间课程需要教练. 如果你能代其中任意一节, 请回复.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fitness_2_Body.en: The new conditioning plan is available at the front desk. Review hydration guidance before outdoor sessions.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fitness_2_Body.ch: 新的體能訓練計畫已放在櫃檯. 戶外課程前請先看過補水指引.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_fitness_2_Body.cn: 新的体能训练计划已放在前台. 户外课程前请先查看补水指南.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_food_1_Body.en: The morning delivery is expected early. Cold items must be checked and stored before regular preparation begins.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_food_1_Body.ch: 早上的貨預計會提早送達. 冷藏品必須在一般備料開始前檢查並收妥.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_food_1_Body.cn: 早上的货预计会提早送达. 冷藏品必须在常规备料开始前检查并入库.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_food_2_Body.en: The county food safety refresher is scheduled for Thursday. Bring your current certification card.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_food_2_Body.ch: 縣食品安全複訓訂於週四舉行. 請攜帶你目前有效的證照卡.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_food_2_Body.cn: 县食品安全复训定于周四举行. 请携带你当前有效的证书卡.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_general_1_Body.en: New clerical, warehouse and maintenance openings were posted this morning. Applications are available at the county office.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_general_1_Body.ch: 今早公布了新的文書, 倉儲與維修職缺. 申請表可至縣政府辦公室索取.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_general_1_Body.cn: 今早公布了新的文员, 仓储和维修岗位. 申请表可到县政府办公室领取.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_general_2_Body.en: Registration is open for evening courses in first aid, home repair and basic computing. Space is limited.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_general_2_Body.ch: 晚間急救, 居家修繕與基礎電腦課程開放報名. 名額有限.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_general_2_Body.cn: 晚间急救, 家居维修和基础电脑课程开放报名. 名额有限.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_medical_1_Body.en: Additional clinical coverage is needed this week. Reply with your certification and the hours you can work.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_medical_1_Body.ch: 本週需要額外的臨床人力. 請回覆你的證照與可上班的時段.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_medical_1_Body.cn: 本周需要额外的临床人手. 请回复你的资质证书和可上班的时段.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_medical_2_Body.en: The infection control refresher has been moved to the main conference room. Attendance will be recorded.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_medical_2_Body.ch: 感染控制複訓已改至主會議室舉行. 將記錄出席情形.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_medical_2_Body.cn: 感染控制复训已改到主会议室举行. 将记录出勤情况.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_outdoors_1_Body.en: Recent rain has damaged several access roads. Use the north trail and report fallen trees when you return.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_outdoors_1_Body.ch: 最近的雨使數條聯外道路受損. 請走北側步道, 回來時回報倒下的樹木.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_outdoors_1_Body.cn: 最近的降雨使数条通行道路受损. 请走北侧小径, 返回时上报倒下的树木.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_outdoors_2_Body.en: Line, seed, gloves and water purification tablets are discounted for registered field workers this week.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_outdoors_2_Body.ch: 本週登記在案的野外工作者可享釣線, 種子, 手套與淨水藥片折扣.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_outdoors_2_Body.cn: 本周登记在册的野外工作者可享鱼线, 种子, 手套和净水药片折扣.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_police_1_Body.en: Several patrol shifts still need coverage. Confirm your availability with the desk before this afternoon's briefing.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_police_1_Body.ch: 還有幾個巡邏班次需要人手. 請在今天下午的勤前簡報前向值班台確認你能否上班.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_police_1_Body.cn: 还有几个巡逻班次需要人手. 请在今天下午的简报会前向值班台确认你能否到岗.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_police_2_Body.en: The revised evidence intake sheet is now in use. Old forms will not be accepted after Friday.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_police_2_Body.ch: 修訂後的證物收件單已開始使用. 週五之後不再受理舊表單.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_police_2_Body.cn: 修订后的证物登记单已开始使用. 周五之后不再受理旧表格.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_trades_1_Body.en: Three maintenance calls remain unassigned. Check the work board for locations and required parts.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_trades_1_Body.ch: 還有三筆維修叫修尚未指派. 請檢視工作看板上的地點與所需零件.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_trades_1_Body.cn: 还有三个维修工单尚未分配. 请查看工作看板上的地点和所需零件.

IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_trades_2_Body.en: Wire, fasteners and replacement blades arrived this morning. Professional account holders may reserve stock by phone.
IGUI_ComputerMod_SP_Mail_trades_2_Body.ch: 電線, 扣件與替換刀片今早到貨. 專業帳戶持有人可來電預留庫存.

IGUI_JSGuide_Battery_More.ch: 電池會隨使用年限損失容量. 損耗速率由沙盒選項設定, 因此你可以讓電池更耐用.

IGUI_JSGuide_Battery_Text.en: <SIZE:medium> Storing power <LINE> <SIZE:small> Power is stored in deep-cycle batteries: a 200Ah cell, a 400Ah cell, a DIY build, or a wired car battery. Create a battery bank to house them - its total capacity grows with every battery you install.
IGUI_JSGuide_Battery_Text.ch: <SIZE:medium> 儲存電力 <LINE> <SIZE:small> 電力儲存在深循環電池中: 200Ah 電池、400Ah 電池、自製電池或已接線車電池. 製作一個蓄電池組來容納它們 - 每安裝一顆電池, 總容量就會增加.
IGUI_JSGuide_Battery_Text.cn: <SIZE:medium> 储存电力 <LINE> <SIZE:small> 电力储存在深循环电池中: 200Ah电池、400Ah电池、自制电池或已接线汽车电池. 制作一个蓄电池组来容纳它们 - 每安装一块电池, 总容量就会增加.

IGUI_JSGuide_Panels_More.en: A finished panel can be split back into its parts if you need to recover materials or relocate it.
IGUI_JSGuide_Panels_More.ch: 完成的太陽能板可以拆回部件, 方便回收材料或搬遷位置.
IGUI_JSGuide_Panels_More.cn: 完成的太阳能板可以拆回部件, 方便回收材料或迁移位置.

IGUI_JSGuide_Panels_Text.en: <SIZE:medium> Building panels <LINE> <SIZE:small> Craft solar panel parts, then assemble them into a flat (roof), wall-mounted, or floor-mounted panel. An inverter converts the raw output into usable power. <LINE> <LINE> Panels only generate when placed outdoors with a clear view of the sky.
IGUI_JSGuide_Panels_Text.ch: <SIZE:medium> 建造太陽能板 <LINE> <SIZE:small> 先製作太陽能板部件, 再組裝成平面 (屋頂)、壁掛式或落地式太陽能板. 逆變器會將原始輸出轉換為可用電力. <LINE> <LINE> 太陽能板只有放在室外且能清楚看到天空時才會發電.
IGUI_JSGuide_Panels_Text.cn: <SIZE:medium> 建造太阳能板 <LINE> <SIZE:small> 先制作太阳能板部件, 再组装成平面 (屋顶)、壁挂式或落地式太阳能板. 逆变器会将原始输出转换为可用电力. <LINE> <LINE> 太阳能板只有放在室外且能清楚看到天空时才会发电.

IGUI_JSGuide_PowerBank_More.en: Open the battery bank's status window to monitor everything. Its Summary, Details, and Debug tabs show panel status, battery level, and troubleshooting tools.
IGUI_JSGuide_PowerBank_More.ch: 開啟蓄電池組的狀態視窗即可監控一切. 其中的摘要、詳情與除錯分頁會顯示太陽能板狀態、電池電量與故障排除工具.
IGUI_JSGuide_PowerBank_More.cn: 打开蓄电池组的状态窗口即可监控一切. 其中的摘要、详情与调试选项卡会显示太阳能板状态、电池电量与故障排除工具.

IGUI_JSGuide_PowerBank_Text.en: <SIZE:medium> Wiring it together <LINE> <SIZE:small> Place a power bank to tie your panels and batteries into a generator your base can run on. Connect each solar panel to the battery bank, then activate the power bank to begin charging and supplying power.
IGUI_JSGuide_PowerBank_Text.ch: <SIZE:medium> 連接整套系統 <LINE> <SIZE:small> 放置一座電源站, 將太陽能板與電池整合成可供基地使用的發電機. 將每塊太陽能板連接到蓄電池組, 然後啟動電源站, 開始充電並供電.
IGUI_JSGuide_PowerBank_Text.cn: <SIZE:medium> 连接整套系统 <LINE> <SIZE:small> 放置一座电源站, 将太阳能板与电池整合成可供基地使用的发电机. 将每块太阳能板连接到蓄电池组, 然后启动电源站, 开始充电并供电.

IGUI_JSGuide_Start_More.en: Sandbox options let you tune solar efficiency, charge speed, battery degrade, and how often pre-built solar gear spawns in the world.
IGUI_JSGuide_Start_More.ch: 沙盒選項可調整太陽能效率、充電速度、電池損耗, 以及預製太陽能設備在世界中的生成頻率.
IGUI_JSGuide_Start_More.cn: 沙盒选项可调整太阳能效率、充电速度、电池损耗, 以及预制太阳能设备在世界中的生成频率.

IGUI_JSGuide_Start_Text.en: <SIZE:medium> Off-grid solar power <LINE> <SIZE:small> Jeeve's Solar Arrays lets you harvest sunlight to run your base without fuel. The basic loop: build solar panels, set up a battery bank with deep-cycle batteries, connect the panels, then draw the stored power. <LINE> <LINE> Start by reading 'New Advancements: Energy From The Sun' to learn every recipe you need.
IGUI_JSGuide_Start_Text.ch: <SIZE:medium> 離網太陽能發電 <LINE> <SIZE:small> Jeeve 的太陽能陣列讓你收集陽光, 不需燃料就能為基地供電. 基本流程: 建造太陽能板, 架設裝有深循環電池的蓄電池組, 連接太陽能板, 然後使用儲存的電力. <LINE> <LINE> 先閱讀「新進展: 來自太陽的能源」來學會所需的所有配方.
IGUI_JSGuide_Start_Text.cn: <SIZE:medium> 离网太阳能发电 <LINE> <SIZE:small> Jeeve的太阳能阵列让你收集阳光, 无需燃料就能为基地供电. 基本流程: 建造太阳能板, 设置装有深循环电池的蓄电池组, 连接太阳能板, 然后使用储存的电力. <LINE> <LINE> 先阅读“新进展: 来自太阳的能源”来学会所需的所有配方.

IGUI_JSGuide_Start_Title.ch: Jeeve 的太陽能陣列 - 入門指南
IGUI_JSGuide_Start_Title.cn: Jeeve的太阳能阵列 - 入门指南

IGUI_JSGuide_Trouble_More.en: The drain calculation method and charge frequency can both be changed in the sandbox options to match how your server plays.
IGUI_JSGuide_Trouble_More.ch: 耗電計算方式與充電頻率都可以在沙盒選項中更改, 以配合你伺服器的玩法.
IGUI_JSGuide_Trouble_More.cn: 耗电计算方式与充电频率都可以在沙盒选项中更改, 以配合你服务器的玩法.

IGUI_JSGuide_Trouble_Text.en: <SIZE:medium> No power? <LINE> <SIZE:small> Work through the checklist: panels are outdoors with clear sky; enough panels are connected; it is daytime with real sunlight; the power bank has been activated; and every panel is connected to the battery bank. A solar failsafe can keep critical power flowing when charge runs low.
IGUI_JSGuide_Trouble_Text.ch: <SIZE:medium> 沒有電? <LINE> <SIZE:small> 逐項檢查: 太陽能板位於室外且天空無遮擋; 連接了足夠的太陽能板; 現在是有真正日照的白天; 電源站已啟動; 每塊太陽能板都已連接到蓄電池組. 太陽能故障保護器可在電量偏低時維持關鍵供電.
IGUI_JSGuide_Trouble_Text.cn: <SIZE:medium> 没有电? <LINE> <SIZE:small> 逐项检查: 太阳能板位于室外且天空无遮挡; 连接了足够的太阳能板; 现在是有真正日照的白天; 电源站已启动; 每块太阳能板都已连接到蓄电池组. 太阳能故障保护器可在电量偏低时维持关键供电.

IGUI_NPCFW_Bark_108_1.cn: 好了, 书就先读到这里.

IGUI_NPCFW_Bark_118_1.en: I should write some of this down.

IGUI_PD_ScanTooFar.ch: 太遠了. 靠近一點才能檢查.
IGUI_PD_ScanTooFar.cn: 太远了. 靠近一点才能查看.

IGUI_PD_ScanTrustDesc.en: How close this %1 is to trusting you enough to come along. Feeding it is what builds this up; bad food tears it down.
IGUI_PD_ScanTrustDesc.ch: 這隻%1對你的信任程度, 決定牠是否願意跟你走. 餵食能提升信任; 劣質食物則會降低信任.
IGUI_PD_ScanTrustDesc.cn: 这只%1对你的信任程度, 决定它是否愿意跟你走. 喂食能提升信任; 劣质食物则会降低信任.

IGUI_PD_TrickCooldown.en: %1 just did that, give it a moment
IGUI_PD_TrickCooldown.ch: %1 剛做過, 讓牠歇一會兒
IGUI_PD_TrickCooldown.cn: %1 刚做过, 让它歇一会儿

IGUI_PD_TrickDistractDesc.en: The pet draws attention on purpose to pull zombies toward itself. It costs stress, and the horde goes for the pet.
IGUI_PD_TrickDistractDesc.ch: 寵物會刻意引起注意, 把殭屍引向自己. 代價是壓力上升, 而且屍群會衝向寵物.
IGUI_PD_TrickDistractDesc.cn: 宠物会刻意引起注意, 把僵尸引向自己. 代价是压力上升, 而且尸群会冲向宠物.

IGUI_PD_TrickFetch.en: Fetch an item while you sleep

IGUI_PD_TrickFetchArmed.en: %1 will look for %2 while you sleep.

IGUI_PD_TrickFetchDesc.en: Hold an item and the pet memorizes it. Every time you sleep it goes out looking on its own and can come back with one, stowed in the saddlebags. Once a day, and the rarer the item the longer it takes. Needs saddlebags.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchDesc.ch: 手持一件物品讓寵物記住它. 之後你每次睡覺時, 牠會自己出門尋找, 並可能帶回一件收進馱袋. 每天一次, 物品越稀有花的時間越久. 需要馱袋.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchDesc.cn: 手持一件物品让宠物记住它. 之后你每次睡觉时, 它会自己出门寻找, 并可能带回一件收进驮袋. 每天一次, 物品越稀有花的时间越久. 需要驮袋.

IGUI_PD_TrickFetchNoItem.en: Hold the item you want the pet to look for.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchNoItem.ch: 請手持你想讓寵物尋找的物品.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchNoItem.cn: 请手持你想让宠物寻找的物品.

IGUI_PD_TrickFetchStopDesc.en: It will no longer look for the item.

IGUI_PD_TrickFetchUnknown.en: %1 would not know where to look for %2.

IGUI_PD_TrickGotoBad.en: %1 cannot be sent to that spot
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoBad.ch: 無法派 %1 前往該地點
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoBad.cn: 无法派 %1 前往该地点

IGUI_PD_TrickGotoDesc.en: Send the pet to a chosen tile and have it hold there.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoDesc.ch: 派寵物前往指定地格並在該處待命.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoDesc.cn: 派宠物前往指定地块并在该处待命.

IGUI_PD_TrickGotoFar.ch: 太遠了, 無法派 %1 前往
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoFar.cn: 太远了, 无法派 %1 前往

IGUI_PD_TrickGotoPick.en: Click where to send the pet. Right click cancels.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoPick.ch: 點選要派寵物前往的位置. 右鍵取消.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoPick.cn: 点击要派宠物前往的位置. 右键取消.

IGUI_PD_TrickLocked.ch: 服從等級 %1 時解鎖 (目前 %2).
IGUI_PD_TrickLocked.cn: 服从等级 %1 时解锁 (当前 %2).

IGUI_PD_TrickLockedHalo.en: %1 does not know that trick yet (Obedience %2)

IGUI_PD_TrickNeedsBag.ch: 需要寵物身上裝備馱袋.
IGUI_PD_TrickNeedsBag.cn: 需要宠物身上装备驮袋.

IGUI_PD_TrickSniffDesc.en: Hold an item and the pet memorizes its scent. From then on it warns you and goes to it whenever one is nearby.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffDesc.ch: 手持一件物品讓寵物記住它的氣味. 之後只要附近有同樣的物品, 牠就會提醒你並前往該物品所在處.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffDesc.cn: 手持一件物品让宠物记住它的气味. 之后只要附近有同样的物品, 它就会提醒你并前往该物品所在处.

IGUI_PD_TrickSniffNoItem.en: Hold the item you want the pet to smell.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffNoItem.ch: 請手持你想讓寵物嗅聞的物品.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffNoItem.cn: 请手持你想让宠物嗅闻的物品.

IGUI_PD_TrickSniffStopDesc.en: Forgets the memorized scent and stops warning you about it.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffStopDesc.ch: 忘記記住的氣味, 也不再為此提醒你.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffStopDesc.cn: 忘记记住的气味, 也不再为此提醒你.

IGUI_PD_TrickSoon.ch: 將在未來的更新中推出.
IGUI_PD_TrickSoon.cn: 将在未来的更新中推出.

IGUI_PD_VetAbxFailed.en: The antibiotics were not enough for %1. Try another dose.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxFailed.ch: 抗生素對 %1 的效果不夠. 再試一劑.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxFailed.cn: 抗生素对 %1 的效果不够. 再试一剂.

IGUI_PD_VetAbxHuman.en: %1 took the human antibiotics, they are not as effective.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxHuman.ch: %1 服下了人用抗生素, 效果沒那麼好.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxHuman.cn: %1 服下了人用抗生素, 效果没那么好.

IGUI_PD_VetAbxLate.en: Human antibiotics are too weak for %1 now. It needs veterinary antibiotics.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxLate.ch: 人用抗生素現在對 %1 來說太弱了. 牠需要獸用抗生素.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxLate.cn: 人用抗生素现在对 %1 来说太弱了. 它需要兽用抗生素.

IGUI_PD_VetAbxWeak.en: %1 took the antibiotics, but they did not take.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxWeak.ch: %1 服下了抗生素, 但沒有起效.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxWeak.cn: %1 服下了抗生素, 但没有起效.

IGUI_PD_VetAllergen.ch: %1 對 %2 產生了過敏反應.
IGUI_PD_VetAllergen.cn: %1 对 %2 产生了过敏反应.

IGUI_PD_VetAlready.ch: 這隻%1的傷口已經包紮好了.
IGUI_PD_VetAlready.cn: 这只%1的伤口已经包扎好了.

IGUI_PD_VetCond_fracture_infected.ch: 爪子骨折, 傷口感染
IGUI_PD_VetCond_fracture_infected.cn: 爪子骨折, 伤口感染

IGUI_PD_VetCritical.en: %1 is critical and needs antibiotics fast!
IGUI_PD_VetCritical.ch: %1 情況危急, 急需抗生素!
IGUI_PD_VetCritical.cn: %1 情况危急, 急需抗生素!

IGUI_PD_VetDying.en: %1 is dying. Antibiotics now, or serum to buy time.
IGUI_PD_VetDying.ch: %1 快死了. 立刻給抗生素, 或用血清爭取時間.
IGUI_PD_VetDying.cn: %1 快死了. 立刻给抗生素, 或用血清争取时间.

IGUI_PD_VetFever.en: %1 has a fever. The infection is getting worse.
IGUI_PD_VetFever.ch: %1 發燒了. 感染正在惡化.
IGUI_PD_VetFever.cn: %1 发烧了. 感染正在恶化.

IGUI_PD_VetGrass.en: %1 chewed the grass and feels a bit better.
IGUI_PD_VetGrass.ch: %1 嚼了些草, 感覺好一點了.
IGUI_PD_VetGrass.cn: %1 嚼了些草, 感觉好一点了.

IGUI_PD_VetInfected.en: The %1's wound got infected. It won't heal until treated.
IGUI_PD_VetInfected.ch: 這隻%1的傷口感染了. 不治療就不會癒合.
IGUI_PD_VetInfected.cn: 这只%1的伤口感染了. 不治疗就不会愈合.

IGUI_PD_VetInfestCured.en: %1 is free of fleas and ticks.
IGUI_PD_VetInfestCured.ch: %1 身上的跳蚤與壁蝨已清除.
IGUI_PD_VetInfestCured.cn: %1 身上的跳蚤和蜱虫已清除.

IGUI_PD_VetNeedCalm.en: The %1 won't hold still. Pet it first.
IGUI_PD_VetNeedCalm.ch: %1 不肯乖乖待著. 先摸摸牠吧.
IGUI_PD_VetNeedCalm.cn: %1 不肯老实待着. 先摸摸它吧.

IGUI_PD_VetNeedSterile.en: An infected wound needs a sterile bandage or a disinfectant.
IGUI_PD_VetNeedSterile.ch: 感染的傷口需要已消毒繃帶或消毒劑.
IGUI_PD_VetNeedSterile.cn: 感染的伤口需要绷带 (消毒) 或消毒剂.

IGUI_PD_VetNoNeed.en: %1 does not need that right now.

IGUI_PD_VetNothing.en: The %1 has no wound to treat.

IGUI_PD_VetNothingToDo.ch: 目前沒有可給予的東西
IGUI_PD_VetNothingToDo.cn: 目前没有可给予的东西

IGUI_PD_VetPaused.en: Recovery paused while stored in the kennel.
IGUI_PD_VetPaused.ch: 存放在狗舍期間暫停恢復.
IGUI_PD_VetPaused.cn: 存放在狗舍期间暂停恢复.

IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_deworm.en: The dewormer clears the parasites a few hours in, and keeps new ones away for 30 days.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_deworm.ch: 驅蟲藥會在幾小時後清除寄生蟲, 並在 30 天內防止再次感染.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_deworm.cn: 驱虫药会在几小时后清除寄生虫, 并在 30 天内防止再次感染.

IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_immune.en: Wounds do not get infected and spoiled food or stale water do not upset the stomach while the vaccine lasts.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_immune.ch: 疫苗有效期間, 傷口不會感染, 吃到腐壞食物或喝到不新鮮的水也不會鬧肚子.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_immune.cn: 疫苗有效期间, 伤口不会感染, 吃了变质食物或喝了不新鲜的水也不会闹肚子.

IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_prev.en: Nothing new takes hold while the protection lasts.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_prev.ch: 防護期間不會染上新的病症.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_prev.cn: 防护期间不会染上新的病症.

IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_serum.en: The serum holds the infection back for a day. It does not cure anything.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_serum.ch: 血清可壓制感染一天. 但本身無法治癒任何病症.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_serum.cn: 血清可压制感染一天. 但本身无法治愈任何病症.

IGUI_PD_VetRow_immune.ch: 已接種疫苗, 剩餘 %1 天
IGUI_PD_VetRow_immune.cn: 已接种疫苗, 剩余 %1 天

IGUI_PD_VetRow_prev.ch: 已預防 %1, 剩餘 %2 天
IGUI_PD_VetRow_prev.cn: 已预防 %1, 剩余 %2 天

IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_critical.ch: 情況危急, 請盡快治療.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_critical.cn: 情况危急, 请尽快治疗.

IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_cut.ch: 流血並持續失去生命值.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_cut.cn: 流血并持续损失生命值.

IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_cut_open.ch: 開放性傷口, 已不再流血.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_cut_open.cn: 开放性伤口, 已不再流血.

IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_fever.en: Running hot, needs to drink more water.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_fever.ch: 體溫偏高, 需要多喝水.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_fever.cn: 体温偏高, 需要多喝水.

IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_fleas.en: Gets stressed, it can turn into an allergy.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_fleas.ch: 會感到壓力, 並可能演變成過敏.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_fleas.cn: 会感到压力, 并可能发展为过敏.

IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_flu.en: Walks slower and needs to drink more water.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_flu.ch: 行走變慢, 且需要多喝水.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_flu.cn: 行走变慢, 且需要多喝水.

IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_gastro.en: Gets hungry and thirsty twice as fast.

IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_heartworm.en: Walks slowly, runs a fever, loses health and refuses orders.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_heartworm.ch: 行走緩慢, 發燒, 失去生命值且不服從命令.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_heartworm.cn: 行走缓慢, 发烧, 损失生命值且不服从命令.

IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_ticks.en: Gets stressed, it can turn into an allergy.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_ticks.ch: 會感到壓力, 並可能演變成過敏.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_ticks.cn: 会感到压力, 并可能发展为过敏.

IGUI_PD_VetTodo_allergy.en: It passes on its own; the Companion Dogs allergy medicine makes it faster.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_allergy.ch: 會自行消退, 使用同伴犬過敏藥可加快速度.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_allergy.cn: 会自行消退, 使用同伴犬过敏药可加快速度.

IGUI_PD_VetTodo_cut.en: Bandage it. A sterile bandage or a disinfectant keeps infection away, and rest heals it faster.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_cut.ch: 用繃帶包紮. 已消毒繃帶或消毒劑可預防感染, 休息能加快癒合.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_cut.cn: 用绷带包扎. 绷带 (消毒) 或消毒剂可预防感染, 休息能加快愈合.

IGUI_PD_VetTodo_flu.en: Plenty of water, the fever comes with it. Antibiotics and the vaccine help.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_flu.ch: 多喝水, 發燒是伴隨症狀. 抗生素與疫苗有幫助.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_flu.cn: 多喝水, 发烧是伴随症状. 抗生素和疫苗会有帮助.

IGUI_PD_VetTodo_fracture.en: It takes longer than a wound and needs a dressing too.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_fracture.ch: 比傷口需要更長時間, 也需要包紮.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_fracture.cn: 比伤口需要更长时间, 也需要包扎.

IGUI_PD_VetTodo_gastro.en: Keep the water coming, it passes with time. Grass speeds the recovery up.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_gastro.ch: 持續供水, 時間久了就會好. 吃草可加快恢復.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_gastro.cn: 持续供水, 过段时间就会好. 吃草可加快恢复.

IGUI_PD_VetTodo_heartworm.en: It drains health slowly and needs the heartworm medicine.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_heartworm.ch: 會緩慢消耗生命值, 需要心絲蟲藥.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_heartworm.cn: 会缓慢消耗生命值, 需要心丝虫药.

IGUI_PD_VetTodo_infected.en: It clears on its own in 2 days. Companion Dogs antibiotics cut that to 12 h, human ones to 24 h.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_infected.ch: 2 天內會自行痊癒. 同伴犬抗生素可縮短至 12 小時, 人用抗生素則為 24 小時.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_infected.cn: 2 天内会自行痊愈. 同伴犬抗生素可缩短至 12 小时, 人用抗生素则为 24 小时.

IGUI_PD_VetTodo_infest.en: It needs the Companion Dogs flea and tick medicine.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_infest.ch: 需要同伴犬跳蚤與壁蝨藥.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_infest.cn: 需要同伴犬跳蚤和蜱虫药.

IGUI_PD_VetTodo_sprain.en: It passes in a day while it keeps moving, faster if it rests.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_sprain.ch: 持續活動時一天內會好轉, 休息則更快.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_sprain.cn: 持续活动时一天内会好转, 休息则更快.

IGUI_PD_VetTodo_worms.en: It needs a dewormer, it never clears on its own.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_worms.ch: 需要驅蟲藥, 不會自行痊癒.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_worms.cn: 需要驱虫药, 不会自行痊愈.

IGUI_PD_WarnOldSave.en: Companion Dogs was enabled on a save that already existed.\nEverything works normally. Stray dogs are placed as you travel and parts of the map load in, so they show up in areas you have already explored as well as in new ones.\nTravel around a little and you will start finding them.
IGUI_PD_WarnOldSave.ch: 同伴犬是在已存在的存檔中啟用的.\n一切運作正常. 流浪狗會隨著你移動與地圖區塊載入而放置, 因此牠們會出現在你已探索過的區域以及新的區域.\n四處走走, 你就會開始發現牠們.
IGUI_PD_WarnOldSave.cn: 同伴犬是在已有的存档中启用的.\n一切运行正常. 流浪狗会随着你的移动和地图区块加载而放置, 因此它们会出现在你已探索过的区域以及新区域中.\n四处走走, 你就会开始发现它们.

IGUI_PD_WarnRigMissing.en: Companion Dogs could not load the dog animations.\nThis happens when the mod was not enabled in the main menu, and the dogs will render deformed.\nQuit to the main menu, make sure Companion Dogs is enabled there, then load your save again.
IGUI_PD_WarnRigMissing.ch: 同伴犬無法載入狗的動畫.\n這是因為未在主選單中啟用此 MOD, 狗的模型會變形.\n請退回主選單, 確認已在那裡啟用同伴犬, 然後重新載入存檔.
IGUI_PD_WarnRigMissing.cn: 同伴犬无法加载狗的动画.\n这是因为未在主菜单中启用此 MOD, 狗的模型会变形.\n请退回主菜单, 确认已在那里启用同伴犬, 然后重新加载存档.

IGUI_PD_Weak.en: The %1 is weak from going too long without meat.
IGUI_PD_Weak.ch: %1 太久沒吃肉, 身體變得虛弱.
IGUI_PD_Weak.cn: %1 太久没吃肉, 身体变得虚弱.

IGUI_SoapZ_MissingProtection.en: I need safety goggles and gloves equipped.
IGUI_SoapZ_MissingProtection.ch: 我需要戴上安全護目鏡和手套.
IGUI_SoapZ_MissingProtection.cn: 我需要戴上护目镜和手套.

IGUI_BUUI_Empty.ch: 這裡沒有可打包的物品
IGUI_BUUI_Empty.cn: 这里没有可打包的物品

IGUI_BUUI_EmptyMerge.ch: 這裡沒有可合併的物品
IGUI_BUUI_EmptyMerge.cn: 这里没有可合并的物品

IGUI_BUUI_EmptyUnbundle.ch: 這裡沒有可拆包的物品
IGUI_BUUI_EmptyUnbundle.cn: 这里没有可拆包的物品

IGUI_WAS_AccentButtonsFullyRecolourOnReo.ch: 強調色: %1 (重新開啟後按鈕才會完全換色)
IGUI_WAS_AccentButtonsFullyRecolourOnReo.cn: 强调色: %1 (重新打开后按钮才会完全换色)

IGUI_WAS_AddAllPasswordConnectedUsersTo.en: Add all password-connected users to the whitelist.
IGUI_WAS_AddAllPasswordConnectedUsersTo.ch: 將所有以密碼連線的使用者加入白名單.
IGUI_WAS_AddAllPasswordConnectedUsersTo.cn: 将所有通过密码连接的用户添加到白名单.

IGUI_WAS_AddRemoveTheSelectedActionOn.en: Add/remove the selected action on the Quick favourites tab.
IGUI_WAS_AddRemoveTheSelectedActionOn.ch: 在「快速收藏」分頁新增/移除所選動作.
IGUI_WAS_AddRemoveTheSelectedActionOn.cn: 在“快速收藏”标签页添加/移除所选动作.

IGUI_WAS_AddRemoveTheSelectedItemIn.en: Add/remove the selected item in the * Favorites category.
IGUI_WAS_AddRemoveTheSelectedItemIn.ch: 在 * 收藏類別中新增/移除所選物品.
IGUI_WAS_AddRemoveTheSelectedItemIn.cn: 在 * 收藏类别中添加/移除所选物品.

IGUI_WAS_AddTheSelectedPlayerToThe.en: Add the selected player to the whitelist.
IGUI_WAS_AddTheSelectedPlayerToThe.ch: 將所選玩家加入白名單.
IGUI_WAS_AddTheSelectedPlayerToThe.cn: 将所选玩家添加到白名单.

IGUI_WAS_AdminGMFullPowerBlueHighlighted.en: Admin & GM = full power. Blue (highlighted) = allowed.
