IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_leave.cn: 不会演变成其他更严重的病症.

IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_note.en: TEMP on the report is the number. Under 36.0 it turns red.
IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_note.ch: 報告上的體溫就是要看的數值. 低於 36.0 會變紅.
IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_note.cn: 报告上的体温就是要看的数值. 低于 36.0 会变红.

IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_step1.en: Get warm: indoors, near a fire, in warmer clothes, out of the rain.
IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_step1.ch: 取暖: 進到室內、靠近火堆、換上保暖衣物、避開雨.
IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_step1.cn: 取暖: 进到室内、靠近火堆、换上保暖衣物、避开雨.

IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_step2.en: It clears by itself once temperature is back over 36.7 C.
IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_step2.ch: 體溫回到 36.7 C 以上就會自行解除.
IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_step2.cn: 体温回到 36.7 C 以上就会自行解除.

IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_what.en: Core temperature has dropped below where the heart is comfortable.
IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_what.ch: 核心體溫已降到心臟無法適應的程度.
IGUI_CU_Guide_hypothermia_what.cn: 核心体温已降到心脏无法适应的程度.

IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_does.en: The brain takes damage that climbs, and the mind goes with it.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_does.ch: 大腦損傷持續加劇, 神智也隨之流失.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_does.cn: 大脑损伤持续加剧, 神智也随之流失.

IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_find.ch: 鋸子: 五金行、車庫、工具箱.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_find.cn: 锯子: 五金店、车库、工具箱.

IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_leave.en: Nothing worse. It also never stops on its own.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_leave.ch: 不會演變成其他更嚴重的病症. 但它也永遠不會自行停止.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_leave.cn: 不会演变成其他更严重的病症. 但它也永远不会自行停止.

IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_note.en: Brain damage does not heal. Whatever is lost by the time you get the hole drilled stays lost.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_note.ch: 大腦損傷不會痊癒. 在你鑽好孔之前失去的, 就永遠失去了.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_note.cn: 大脑损伤不会痊愈. 在你钻好孔之前失去的, 就永远失去了.

IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_step1.en: Get a saw -- the same one amputation uses.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_step1.ch: 準備一把鋸子——就是截肢用的那種.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_step1.cn: 准备一把锯子——就是截肢用的那种.

IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_step2.ch: 右鍵, 健康, 頭部.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_step2.cn: 右键, 健康, 头部.

IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_step3.en: Procedures > Trepan the skull. It plays as the amputation minigame and it is the hardest thing in the mod.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_step3.ch: 醫療處置 > 在顱骨上鑽孔. 以截肢小遊戲進行, 也是本模組中最難的操作.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_step3.cn: 医疗处置 > 在颅骨上钻孔. 以截肢小游戏进行, 也是本模组中最难的操作.

IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_step4.en: Somebody else with First Aid should do this if anyone can.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_step4.ch: 如果可以, 最好由其他會急救的人來做.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_step4.cn: 如果可以, 最好由其他会急救的人来做.

IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_what.en: Bleeding inside the skull, with nowhere for it to go.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_what.ch: 顱內出血, 血無處可去.
IGUI_CU_Guide_intracranial_bleed_what.cn: 颅内出血, 血无处可去.

IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_does.en: The rot poisons the liver and kidneys slowly.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_does.ch: 腐爛組織會慢慢毒害肝臟和腎臟.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_does.cn: 腐烂组织会慢慢毒害肝脏和肾脏.

IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_find.en: Any blade will do: kitchen knives, hunting knives, scalpels.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_find.ch: 任何刀刃都行: 廚房刀、獵刀、手術刀.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_find.cn: 任何刀刃都行: 厨房刀、猎刀、手术刀.

IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_leave.ch: 約六小時後轉為敗血症.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_leave.cn: 约六小时后转为脓毒症.

IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_note.en: It only ever appears on a stump left open for half a day. Cauterizing promptly means never seeing it.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_note.ch: 只會出現在開放超過半天的截肢斷端上. 及時燒灼止血就永遠不會遇到.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_note.cn: 只会出现在开放超过半天的截肢断端上. 及时烧灼止血就永远不会遇到.

IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_step1.en: Cauterize the stump if you have not -- heat a blade in a fire and seal it. That is what stops new ones.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_step1.ch: 如果還沒燒灼斷端, 就去做——把刀在火裡燒熱再封住傷口. 這樣才能阻止新的壞死.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_step1.cn: 如果还没烧灼断端, 就去做——把刀在火里烧热再封住伤口. 这样才能阻止新的坏死.

IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_step2.en: With a blade in your inventory, right-click, Health, the part, then Procedures > Debride the wound.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_step2.ch: 物品欄裡有刀時, 右鍵, 健康, 該部位, 然後 醫療處置 > 為傷口清創.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_step2.cn: 物品栏里有刀时, 右键, 健康, 该部位, 然后 医疗处置 > 为伤口清创.

IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_what.en: Tissue on an amputation stump that was never sealed has died.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_what.ch: 從未封住的截肢斷端上的組織已經壞死.
IGUI_CU_Guide_necrosis_what.cn: 从未封住的截肢断端上的组织已经坏死.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_does.en: The lungs drain steadily and endurance goes with them: you tire faster and recover slower.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_does.ch: 肺部持續衰退, 耐力也隨之下降: 你更容易疲勞, 恢復也更慢.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_does.cn: 肺部持续衰退, 耐力也随之下降: 你更容易疲劳, 恢复也更慢.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_find.ch: 抗生素: 藥局、診所、醫院.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_find.cn: 抗生素: 药店、诊所、医院.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_leave.en: It does not become anything worse. It simply does not stop.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_leave.ch: 它不會轉變成更糟的病症. 只是不會停止.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_leave.cn: 它不会转变成更糟的病症. 只是不会停止.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_note.en: It needs damaged lungs AND either a fever or an infected wound to start. Fixing the wound stops new ones.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_note.ch: 需要肺部受損, 而且同時有發燒或傷口感染才會開始. 處理好傷口就不會再出現新的.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_note.cn: 需要肺部受损, 而且同时有发烧或伤口感染才会开始. 处理好伤口就不会再出现新的.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_step1.ch: 取得抗生素 (本體的 Base.Antibiotics).
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_step1.cn: 获取抗生素 (原版的 Base.Antibiotics).

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_step2.en: Right-click them in your inventory and take them.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_step2.ch: 在物品欄中右鍵點選並服用.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_step2.cn: 在物品栏中右键点击并服用.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_step3.en: That clears it outright -- there is no minigame.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_step3.ch: 這樣就能直接治好——沒有小遊戲.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_step3.cn: 这样就能直接治好——没有小游戏.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_what.en: An infection has settled in lungs that were already damaged.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_what.ch: 感染已在原本就受損的肺部落地生根.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumonia_what.cn: 感染已在原本就受损的肺部扎根.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_does.en: Saturation falls hard, blood pressure falls with it, and both the lung and the heart take damage every minute.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_does.ch: 血氧飽和度急遽下降, 血壓也跟著下跌, 肺和心臟每分鐘都會受損.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_does.cn: 血氧饱和度急剧下降, 血压也跟着下跌, 肺和心脏每分钟都会受损.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_find.en: Decompression Needles: Medical clinics, hospital lockers and shelves, ambulances and army bunker medical rooms. Four uses to a pack.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_find.ch: 減壓針: 診所、醫院置物櫃與架子、救護車, 以及軍事地堡的醫務室. 每包可用四次.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_find.cn: 减压针: 诊所、医院储物柜与架子、救护车, 以及军事地堡的医务室. 每包可用四次.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_leave.en: Nothing. It does not get better and it does not become something else -- it just keeps going until the heart stops.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_leave.ch: 沒有. 它不會好轉, 也不會轉變成別的病症——只會一直持續到心臟停止.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_leave.cn: 没有. 它不会好转, 也不会转变成别的病症——只会一直持续到心脏停止.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_note.en: This is the most urgent thing in the mod. If it is on the list and you have no needle, find one now.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_note.ch: 這是本模組中最緊急的狀況. 如果它出現在清單上而你沒有針, 立刻去找一支.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_note.cn: 这是本模组中最紧急的状况. 如果它出现在列表上而你没有针, 立刻去找一支.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step1.en: Get a Decompression Needle. You cannot fix this without one.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step1.ch: 取得減壓針. 沒有它就無法處理.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step1.cn: 获取减压针. 没有它就无法处理.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step2.en: Right-click yourself, Health, then the upper torso.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step2.ch: 右鍵點選自己, 健康, 然後選上身.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step2.cn: 右键点击自己, 健康, 然后选上身.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step3.en: Procedures > Decompress the chest. It plays as the syringe minigame -- hold the plunger in the band.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step3.ch: 醫療處置 > 進行胸腔減壓. 以注射小遊戲進行——把推桿保持在區間內.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step3.cn: 医疗处置 > 进行胸腔减压. 以注射小游戏进行——把推杆保持在区间内.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step4.en: Watch the report. Saturation should climb back within a minute.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step4.ch: 留意報告. 血氧飽和度應該會在一分鐘內回升.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_step4.cn: 注意报告. 血氧饱和度应该会在一分钟内回升.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_what.en: Air has got into the chest cavity and cannot get out. Each breath pushes more in, and the pressure is crushing the lung and the heart beside it.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_what.ch: 空氣進入胸腔且無法排出. 每次呼吸都會擠進更多空氣, 壓力正壓迫著肺部與一旁的心臟.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pneumothorax_what.cn: 空气进入胸腔且无法排出. 每次呼吸都会挤进更多空气, 压力正压迫着肺部和旁边的心脏.

IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_d.en: Shakier hands and reduced oxygen delivery until your blood recovers.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_d.ch: 雙手更容易顫抖, 供氧能力下降, 直到血液恢復為止.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_d.cn: 双手更容易颤抖, 供氧能力下降, 直到血液恢复为止.

IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_f.en: Food, water, clean dressings and emergency bleeding control.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_f.ch: 食物、水、乾淨的敷料與緊急止血用品.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_f.cn: 食物、水、干净的敷料和紧急止血用品.

IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_l.en: Further bleeding can lead to shock.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_l.ch: 再繼續失血可能導致休克.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_l.cn: 继续失血可能导致休克.

IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_n.en: Saline supports circulation but is not a replacement for lost blood cells.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_n.ch: 生理食鹽水能維持循環, 但無法取代流失的血球.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_n.cn: 生理盐水能维持循环, 但无法替代流失的血细胞.

IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_s.en: Stop the bleeding and dress your wounds.
Eat, drink and rest. Recovery follows restoration of your blood volume.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_s.ch: 進食、喝水並休息. 血量恢復後就會跟著痊癒.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_s.cn: 进食、喝水并休息. 血容量恢复后便会随之康复.

IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_w.en: Significant blood loss has left you weak.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_w.ch: 大量失血讓你身體虛弱.
IGUI_CU_Guide_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia_w.cn: 大量失血让你身体虚弱.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_does.en: Pain, stiffness and less steady hands; extended use damages tissue.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_does.ch: 疼痛、僵硬, 雙手較不穩定; 長時間使用會損傷組織.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_does.cn: 疼痛、僵硬, 双手不够稳定; 长时间使用会损伤组织.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_find.en: A dressing, and the Remove tourniquet entry on the treated limb.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_find.ch: 敷料, 以及受處理肢體上的「解開止血帶」選項.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_find.cn: 敷料, 以及受处理肢体上的“解开止血带”选项.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_leave.en: After two game hours, the tourniquet steadily damages the limb.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_leave.ch: 遊戲時間兩小時後, 止血帶會持續損傷該肢體.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_leave.cn: 游戏时间两小时后, 止血带会持续损伤该肢体.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_note.en: The pressure condition clears on removal; existing pain and damage still need recovery.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_note.ch: 移除後壓迫狀態即解除; 已造成的疼痛與損傷仍需時間恢復.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_note.cn: 移除后压迫状态即解除; 已造成的疼痛和损伤仍需时间恢复.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_step2.en: Right-click the limb in Health and remove the tourniquet.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_step2.ch: 在健康面板中右鍵點選該肢體, 移除止血帶.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_step2.cn: 在健康面板中右键点击该肢体, 移除止血带.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_step3.en: Check for resumed bleeding and let the injured limb recover.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_step3.ch: 檢查是否再次出血, 並讓受傷的肢體恢復.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_step3.cn: 检查是否再次出血, 并让受伤的肢体恢复.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_what.en: A tourniquet has been left on long enough to injure the limb.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_what.ch: 止血帶綁得太久, 已經傷及肢體.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pressure_injury_what.cn: 止血带绑得太久, 已经伤及肢体.

IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_does.en: Flashbacks out of nowhere: panic, the world closing in, the misery back all at once. More of them with the dead close by or another body in sight. Nightmares that wake them. The low mood never quite lifts.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_does.ch: 毫無預警的閃回: 恐慌、世界彷彿向自己逼近, 痛苦一下子全部湧回. 附近有死者或看見其他屍體時發作更頻繁. 惡夢會把人驚醒. 低落的情緒始終揮之不去.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_does.cn: 毫无预兆的闪回: 恐慌、世界仿佛向自己逼近, 痛苦一下子全部涌回. 附近有死者或看到其他尸体时发作更频繁. 噩梦会把人惊醒. 低落的情绪始终挥之不去.

IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_find.en: Antidepressants and beta blockers: pharmacies, medical clinics, bathroom cabinets.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_find.ch: 抑鬱藥與乙型阻斷劑: 藥局、診所、浴室櫃.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_find.cn: 抗抑郁药和β-阻断剂: 药店、诊所、浴室柜.

IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_leave.en: It stays. It does not get worse on its own.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_leave.ch: 它會一直存在. 不會自行惡化.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_leave.cn: 它会一直存在. 不会自行恶化.

IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_note.en: It sets in hours after what caused it, not at the time. The Desensitized and the Brave shake it off more often; the Cowardly carry it heavier.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_note.ch: 它在誘因發生數小時後才出現, 而不是當下. 具有「麻木」與「勇敢」特質者較常擺脫它; 「懦弱」者則承受得更沉重.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_note.cn: 它在诱因发生数小时后才出现, 而不是当时. 具有“麻木不仁”和“无所畏惧”特质的人更常摆脱它; “畏首畏尾”的人则承受得更沉重.

IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step1.en: There is no cure. Nothing on the problem list or in any bottle makes it go away.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step1.ch: 無法治癒. 問題清單上的任何處置、任何藥瓶裡的東西都無法讓它消失.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step1.cn: 无法治愈. 问题列表上的任何处置、任何药瓶里的东西都无法让它消失.

IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step2.en: Antidepressants take the edge off: fewer flashbacks, and weaker ones.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step2.ch: 抑鬱藥能緩和症狀: 閃回次數更少, 強度也更弱.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step2.cn: 抗抑郁药能缓和症状: 闪回次数更少, 强度也更弱.

IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step3.en: Beta blockers do the same while they last.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step3.ch: 乙型阻斷劑在藥效期間也有相同效果.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step3.cn: β-阻断剂在药效期间也有相同效果.

IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step4.en: Keep company, keep busy, and sleep somewhere safe.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step4.ch: 有人陪伴、讓自己忙碌, 並在安全的地方睡覺.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_step4.cn: 有人陪伴、让自己忙起来, 并在安全的地方睡觉.

IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_what.en: Something they saw has lodged in them and will not leave: a friend's body, a friend eaten alive, somebody trying to end their own life.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_what.ch: 他們目睹的某些事深植心中, 揮之不去: 朋友的屍體、朋友被活活吃掉、有人試圖結束自己的生命.
IGUI_CU_Guide_ptsd_what.cn: 他们目睹的某些事深埋心中, 挥之不去: 朋友的尸体、朋友被活活吃掉、有人试图结束自己的生命.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_does.en: The lungs take heavy damage, the heart strains, and saturation drops through the floor.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_does.ch: 肺部受到嚴重損傷, 心臟負荷過重, 血氧飽和度一落千丈.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_does.cn: 肺部受到严重损伤, 心脏负荷过重, 血氧饱和度一落千丈.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_find.en: Warfarin: Medical clinics, hospital lockers and shelves, ambulances and army bunker medical rooms.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_find.ch: 華法林: 診所、醫院置物櫃與架子、救護車, 以及軍事地堡的醫務室.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_find.cn: 华法林: 诊所、医院储物柜与架子、救护车, 以及军事地堡的医务室.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_leave.en: Nothing worse. It also does not stop on its own.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_leave.ch: 不會演變成其他更嚴重的病症. 但它也不會自行停止.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_leave.cn: 不会演变成其他更严重的病症. 但它也不会自行停止.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_note.en: This is the one to prevent rather than treat. Taking Warfarin for the clot in the leg costs one pill.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_note.ch: 這種病要靠預防而非治療. 在腿部血栓階段服用華法林只需一顆藥.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_note.cn: 这种病要靠预防而非治疗. 在腿部血栓阶段服用华法林只需一片药.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_step2.en: Sit still. Nothing you do physically helps and everything you do physically costs oxygen you have not got.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_step2.ch: 坐著別動. 任何身體活動都沒有幫助, 只會消耗你本就缺乏的氧氣.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_step2.cn: 坐着别动. 任何身体活动都没有帮助, 只会消耗你本就缺乏的氧气.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_what.en: The clot has broken loose and lodged in the lungs.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_what.ch: 血栓已經脫落, 卡在肺部.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_embolism_what.cn: 血栓已经脱落, 堵在肺部.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_does.en: The lungs take slow damage and saturation sits low.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_does.ch: 肺部持續緩慢受損, 血氧飽和度維持在低檔.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_does.cn: 肺部持续缓慢受损, 血氧饱和度维持在低位.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_find.en: Furosemide: Medical clinics, hospital lockers and shelves, ambulances and army bunker medical rooms.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_find.ch: 呋塞米: 診所、醫院置物櫃與架子、救護車, 以及軍事碉堡的醫務室.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_find.cn: 呋塞米: 诊所、医院储物柜和货架、救护车, 以及军事掩体的医务室.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_leave.en: Nothing worse, but it will not lift while the heart is bad.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_leave.ch: 不會演變成其他更嚴重的病症, 但只要心臟狀況不佳就不會消退.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_leave.cn: 不会演变成其他更严重的病症, 但只要心脏状况不佳就不会消退.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_note.en: It clears by itself once heart health is back above 66%%, so the real fix is whatever is wrong with the heart.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_note.ch: 心臟健康度回到 66%% 以上後會自行消退, 所以真正的解法是處理心臟的問題.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_note.cn: 心脏健康度回到 66%% 以上后会自行消退, 所以真正的解决办法是处理心脏的问题.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_step1.ch: 取得呋塞米 (本模組的利尿劑).
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_step1.cn: 获取呋塞米 (本模组的利尿剂).

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_step2.en: Right-click it in your inventory and take it.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_step2.ch: 在物品欄中右鍵點選它並服用.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_step2.cn: 在物品栏中右键点击它并服用.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_step3.en: Drink afterwards. It takes water off all of you, not just the chest.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_step3.ch: 之後記得喝水. 它會排出你全身的水分, 而不只是胸腔.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_step3.cn: 之后记得喝水. 它会排出你全身的水分, 而不只是胸腔.

IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_what.en: The heart is too weak to clear the lungs and fluid is backing up into them.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_what.ch: 心臟太過虛弱, 無法清空肺部, 液體正倒流積聚在肺中.
IGUI_CU_Guide_pulmonary_oedema_what.cn: 心脏太过虚弱, 无法清空肺部, 液体正回流积聚在肺中.

IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_does.en: Every breath costs pain, and the lung underneath takes a little damage each minute it goes unsupported.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_does.ch: 每次呼吸都會疼痛, 而且只要沒有固定, 底下的肺部每分鐘都會受到些許損傷.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_does.cn: 每次呼吸都会疼痛, 而且只要没有固定, 下面的肺部每分钟都会受到些许损伤.

IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_find.en: Bandages: medicine cabinets, first aid kits, clinics. Or tear up any sheet or clothing for rags -- for strapping a chest a rag is as good as a bandage.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_find.ch: 繃帶: 藥櫃、急救箱、診所. 也可以把任何床單或衣物撕成碎布, 用來固定胸部時, 碎布和繃帶一樣好用.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_find.cn: 绷带: 药柜、急救箱、诊所. 也可以把任何床单或衣物撕成碎布条, 用来固定胸部时, 碎布条和绷带一样好用.

IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_leave.en: After about five hours, a tension pneumothorax -- which is the one that kills people in minutes.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_leave.ch: 約五小時後會演變成張力性氣胸, 那可是幾分鐘內就能致命的.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_leave.cn: 约五小时后会发展为张力性气胸, 那可是几分钟内就能致命的.

IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_note.en: It also clears on its own once the upper torso is back above 88%% health, so healing the chest normally works too.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_note.ch: 上半身健康度回到 88%% 以上後也會自行消失, 所以正常治療胸部同樣有效.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_note.cn: 上半身健康度回到 88%% 以上后也会自行消失, 所以正常治疗胸部同样有效.

IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step1.en: Have a bandage, ripped sheet or rag in your inventory.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step1.ch: 物品欄中要有繃帶、碎布或破布.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step1.cn: 物品栏中要有绷带、碎布条或破布.

IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step2.en: Right-click yourself, Health, then the upper torso.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step2.ch: 右鍵點選自己, 健康, 然後選上身.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step2.cn: 右键点击自己, 健康, 然后选上身.

IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step3.en: Procedures > Strap the chest. It plays as the bandage minigame.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step3.ch: 「醫療處置 > 包紮固定胸部」. 會進入包紮小遊戲.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step3.cn: “医疗处置 > 包扎固定胸部”. 会进入包扎小游戏.

IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step4.en: Do it cleanly. A botched strap leaves it half-done and you will have to strap it again.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step4.ch: 要做得確實. 固定失敗只會完成一半, 你得重新再綁一次.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_step4.cn: 要做得到位. 固定失败只会完成一半, 你得重新再绑一次.

IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_what.en: The ribs over the lung are broken. Nothing is torn yet.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_what.ch: 肺部上方的肋骨斷了. 目前還沒有撕裂傷.
IGUI_CU_Guide_rib_fracture_what.cn: 肺部上方的肋骨断了. 目前还没有撕裂伤.

IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_does.en: The kidneys, liver and gut all take damage, and it climbs the longer it is untreated. Endurance drains.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_does.ch: 腎臟、肝臟與腸道都會受損, 拖得越久損傷越重. 耐力持續流失.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_does.cn: 肾脏、肝脏和肠道都会受损, 拖得越久损伤越重. 耐力持续流失.

IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_find.ch: 抗生素: 藥局、診所、醫院.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_find.cn: 抗生素: 药店、诊所、医院.

IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_leave.en: Septic shock, after about eighteen hours. That one is much harder to come back from.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_leave.ch: 約十八小時後會演變成敗血性休克. 那就難以挽回得多了.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_leave.cn: 约十八小时后会发展为脓毒性休克. 那就难以挽回得多了.

IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_note.en: This never arrives out of nowhere. A wound infection sits on the list for hours first, the wound runs a fever, and the report says so the whole time. Treat the infection and this never happens.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_note.ch: 這絕不會毫無預警地出現. 傷口感染會先在清單上掛好幾個小時, 傷口會發熱, 報告也會一直提醒你. 治好感染就絕不會發生.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_note.cn: 这绝不会毫无预兆地出现. 伤口感染会先在列表上挂好几个小时, 伤口会发热, 报告也会一直提示. 治好感染就绝不会发生.

IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_step1.en: Get Antibiotics and take them. That clears it.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_step1.ch: 取得抗生素並服用. 這樣就能治好.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_step1.cn: 获取抗生素并服用. 这样就能治好.

IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_step2.en: Deal with the wound that caused it as well -- debride it, or dress it properly -- or you will get it again.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_step2.ch: 也要處理引發它的傷口 (清創, 或妥善包紮), 否則還會再犯.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_step2.cn: 也要处理引发它的伤口 (清创, 或妥善包扎), 否则还会再犯.

IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_step3.en: If blood pressure has fallen too, run saline as well.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_step3.ch: 如果血壓也下降了, 也要輸注生理食鹽水.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_step3.cn: 如果血压也下降了, 还要输注生理盐水.

IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_what.en: An infection that was in a wound is now in the blood.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_what.ch: 原本在傷口的感染, 現在已進入血液.
IGUI_CU_Guide_sepsis_what.cn: 原本在伤口的感染, 现在已进入血液.

IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_does.en: Kidneys, liver, heart and brain all take heavy damage every minute.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_does.ch: 腎臟、肝臟、心臟與大腦每分鐘都在承受嚴重損傷.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_does.cn: 肾脏、肝脏、心脏和大脑每分钟都在承受严重损伤.

IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_find.en: Antibiotics: pharmacies, medical clinics, hospitals. Saline: Medical clinics, hospital lockers and shelves, ambulances and army bunker medical rooms.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_find.ch: 抗生素: 藥房、診所、醫院. 生理食鹽水: 診所、醫院置物櫃與架子、救護車, 以及軍用地堡的醫務室.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_find.cn: 抗生素: 药房、诊所、医院. 生理盐水: 诊所、医院储物柜和货架、救护车, 以及军用地堡的医务室.

IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_leave.en: Nothing worse, because there is nothing worse.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_leave.ch: 不會更糟了, 因為沒有比這更糟的了.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_leave.cn: 不会更糟了, 因为没有比这更糟的了.

IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_note.en: If you are reading this entry because it is on your list, the honest answer is that you are probably not going to make it. Get somebody else to do it -- a second player can run the line while you take the pills.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_note.ch: 如果你是因為清單上出現這一項才來看這段, 老實說, 你大概撐不過去了. 找別人來處理: 另一名玩家可以幫你打點滴, 你則負責吃藥.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_note.cn: 如果你是因为列表上出现这一项才来看这段, 老实说, 你大概撑不过去了. 找别人来处理: 另一名玩家可以帮你输液, 你则负责吃药.

IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_step2.en: A Bag of Saline through Procedures > Run fluids.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_step2.ch: 透過「處置 > 輸液」輸注一袋生理食鹽水.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_step2.cn: 通过“处置 > 输液”输注一袋生理盐水.

IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_step3.en: Both. Either alone will not hold it.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_step3.ch: 兩者都要. 單靠其中一種撐不住.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_step3.cn: 两者都要. 单靠其中一种撑不住.

IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_what.en: The infection has taken the whole body with it. Everything is failing at once.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_what.ch: 感染已蔓延全身. 所有器官同時衰竭.
IGUI_CU_Guide_septic_shock_what.cn: 感染已蔓延全身. 所有器官同时衰竭.

IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_does.en: Every muscle in the body starts to lock. Pain rises on every body part at once and steadiness collapses.
IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_does.ch: 全身肌肉開始僵直. 身體各部位同時疼痛加劇, 穩定度大幅下降.
IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_does.cn: 全身肌肉开始僵直. 身体各部位同时疼痛加剧, 稳定度大幅下降.

IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_find.ch: 抗生素: 藥局、診所、醫院.
IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_find.cn: 抗生素: 药店、诊所、医院.

IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_leave.en: Nothing worse. It does not stop on its own.
IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_leave.ch: 不會更糟. 但不會自行停止.
IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_leave.cn: 不会更糟. 但不会自行停止.

IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_note.en: A wound that has been cauterized cannot cause it. Searing a filthy wound is ugly and it works.
IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_note.ch: 燒灼過的傷口不會引發它. 燒灼骯髒的傷口雖然難看, 但很有效.
IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_note.cn: 烧灼过的伤口不会引发它. 烧灼肮脏的伤口虽然难看, 但很有效.

IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_step1.ch: 抗生素. 其他東西都對它無效.
IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_step1.cn: 抗生素. 其他东西都对它无效.

IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_what.en: It started in a dirty wound that was never cleaned or seared.
IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_what.ch: 起因是一個從未清潔或燒灼過的髒傷口.
IGUI_CU_Guide_tetanus_what.cn: 起因是一个从未清洁或烧灼过的脏伤口.

IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_does.en: The wound runs a fever and hurts more each hour. The vanilla health panel will call the part infected too.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_does.ch: 傷口發熱, 且每小時都會更痛. 原版健康面板也會將該部位標示為感染.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_does.cn: 伤口发热, 且每小时都会更痛. 原版健康面板也会将该部位标为感染.

IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_find.en: Disinfectant and alcohol wipes: medicine cabinets, clinics. Bandages the same, or tear up a clean sheet. Antibiotics: pharmacies and hospitals.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_find.ch: 瓶裝消毒水與酒精棉片: 藥櫃、診所. 繃帶也一樣, 或撕開乾淨的床單. 抗生素: 藥房與醫院.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_find.cn: 消毒剂和酒精湿巾: 药品柜、诊所. 绷带也一样, 或者撕开干净的窗帘布. 抗生素: 药房和医院.

IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_leave.en: Sepsis, if it is still there in about a day.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_leave.ch: 若約一天後仍未好轉, 就會演變成敗血症.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_leave.cn: 若约一天后仍未好转, 就会发展为脓毒症.

IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_note.en: The single most useful habit in this mod is bandaging cuts with something clean and disinfecting before you do. An unwashed, unbandaged wound is the only way this starts -- unless you took Immunocompromised, in which case a dressing only slows it and antibiotics are the whole plan.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_note.ch: 在本模組中最有用的習慣, 就是先消毒, 再用乾淨的東西包紮傷口. 未清洗、未包紮的傷口是唯一的感染途徑, 除非你選了「免疫力低下」, 那樣的話敷料只能延緩感染, 全得靠抗生素.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_note.cn: 在本模组中最有用的习惯, 就是先消毒, 再用干净的东西包扎伤口. 未清洗、未包扎的伤口是唯一的感染途径, 除非你选了“免疫功能低下”, 那样的话敷料只能延缓感染, 全得靠抗生素.

IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_step1.en: Easiest: clean and dress it. Disinfect the part (alcohol wipe, disinfectant or alcohol) and put a CLEAN bandage on it. A dirty rag does not count.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_step1.ch: 最簡單: 清潔並包紮. 消毒該部位 (酒精棉片、瓶裝消毒水或酒精), 再綁上「乾淨」的繃帶. 髒碎布不算數.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_step1.cn: 最简单: 清洁并包扎. 消毒该部位 (酒精湿巾、消毒剂或酒精), 再绑上“干净”的绷带. 脏碎布条不算数.

IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_step2.en: Or cut it out: with a blade in your inventory, right-click, Health, the part, then Procedures > Debride the wound.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_step2.ch: 或者把它切除: 物品欄中有刀刃時, 右鍵點選, 選擇健康, 再選該部位, 然後選擇「處置 > 清創傷口」.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_step2.cn: 或者把它切除: 物品栏中有刀刃时, 右键点击, 选择健康, 再选该部位, 然后选择“处置 > 清创伤口”.

IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_step3.en: Or take Antibiotics, which clears it without touching the wound.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_step3.ch: 或服用抗生素, 不必處理傷口就能治好.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_step3.cn: 或服用抗生素, 不必处理伤口就能治好.

IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_what.en: A wound nobody washed out has gone bad. This is the warning shot for sepsis.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_what.ch: 沒人清洗過的傷口惡化了. 這是敗血症的警訊.
IGUI_CU_Guide_wound_infection_what.cn: 没人清洗过的伤口恶化了. 这是脓毒症的预警.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Goal.en: Peel it, put the pad over the cut, and press it down.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Goal.ch: 撕開背紙, 將棉墊蓋在傷口上, 再壓緊.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Goal.cn: 撕开背纸, 把棉垫盖在伤口上, 再压紧.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Step1.en: Drag each half of the backing outward, off the plaster.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Step1.ch: 將兩半背紙各自向外拖曳, 從OK繃上撕下.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Step1.cn: 将两半背纸分别向外拖动, 从创可贴上撕下.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Step2.en: Pick up the plaster and put the white pad over the cut.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Step2.ch: 拿起OK繃, 將白色棉墊蓋在傷口上.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Step2.cn: 拿起创可贴, 把白色棉垫盖在伤口上.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Step3.en: Run your finger along each sticky wing until it is all stuck down.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Step3.ch: 用手指沿著每一側黏膠翼抹過, 直到完全貼牢.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Step3.cn: 用手指沿着每一侧粘胶翼抹过, 直到完全贴牢.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Watch.en: The pad beside the cut does nothing. Lifting it to try again costs it some of its stick.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Watch.ch: 棉墊貼在傷口旁邊是沒用的. 撕起來重貼會降低黏性.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Adhesive_Watch.cn: 棉垫贴在伤口旁边是没用的. 撕起来重贴会降低粘性.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Goal.en: Open the airway, then clear the mouth.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Goal.ch: 打開呼吸道, 再清理口腔.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Goal.cn: 打开气道, 再清理口腔.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Step1.en: Click and hold the chin and lift it, tipping the head back until the line is green.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Step1.ch: 按住下巴並往上抬, 讓頭部後仰, 直到線條變成綠色.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Step1.cn: 按住下巴并往上抬, 让头部后仰, 直到线条变成绿色.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Step2.en: Click and hold each clump in the mouth and draw it out and away.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Step2.ch: 按住口中的每一團異物, 將它拉出並移開.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Step2.cn: 按住口中的每一团异物, 把它拉出并移开.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Watch.en: Pushing a clump back toward the throat makes it worse. Too far back strains the neck.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Watch.ch: 把異物往喉嚨方向推會讓情況更糟. 頭仰得太後會拉傷脖子.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Airway_Watch.cn: 把异物往喉咙方向推会让情况更糟. 头仰得太后会拉伤脖子.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Amputation_Goal.en: Take the limb off, in as few passes as you can.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Amputation_Goal.ch: 盡量用最少的鋸動次數截下肢體.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Amputation_Goal.cn: 尽量用最少的锯动次数截下肢体.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Amputation_Step1.en: Click and hold on the saw.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Amputation_Step2.en: Drag back and forth across the limb.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Amputation_Step3.en: Keep the stroke long and on the line.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Amputation_Step3.ch: 每一下都要拉長, 並沿著線條走.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Amputation_Step3.cn: 每一下都要拉长, 并保持在线上.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Amputation_Watch.en: The stump will bleed hard. Have a heated blade ready to cauterize it before you start, not after.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Amputation_Watch.ch: 殘肢會大量出血. 開始前就要準備好加熱的刀刃以便燒灼止血, 別等到之後.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Amputation_Watch.cn: 残肢会大量出血. 开始前就要准备好加热的刀刃用于烧灼止血, 别等到之后.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Goal.en: Wrap the wound. Use as much of the roll as you think it needs.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Goal.ch: 包紮傷口. 依你認為需要的量使用繃帶捲.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Goal.cn: 包扎伤口. 按你认为需要的量使用绷带卷.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Step1.en: Click and hold the roll to pick it up.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Step2.en: Take it round and round the limb -- any shape, the same way round.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Step2.ch: 繞著肢體一圈圈纏繞, 形狀不拘, 但要朝同一方向.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Step2.cn: 绕着肢体一圈圈缠绕, 形状不限, 但要朝同一方向.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Step3.en: Let go and press SPACE (or TIE IT OFF) when it is enough.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Step3.ch: 纏夠了就放開, 按下空白鍵 (或「打結」).
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Step3.cn: 缠够了就松开, 按下空格键 (或“打结”).

IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Watch.en: More turns stay clean longer. The less First Aid you have, the more it needs: fill the COVER gauge to the ENOUGH mark. What you don't use stays on the roll.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Watch.ch: 纏越多圈, 保持乾淨越久. 急救技能越低, 需要纏的越多: 將「覆蓋」量表填到「足夠」標記. 沒用完的會留在繃帶捲上.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bandaging_Watch.cn: 缠的圈数越多, 保持干净越久. 急救技能越低, 需要缠的越多: 把“覆盖”量表填到“足够”标记. 没用完的会留在绷带卷上.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Goal.en: Insert the tweezers and lift the bullet without losing your grip.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Goal.ch: 插入鑷子, 夾穩子彈並取出.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Goal.cn: 插入镊子, 夹稳子弹并取出.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Step1.en: Hold at the top of the guide above the wound.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Step1.ch: 在傷口上方導引線的頂端按住.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Step1.cn: 在伤口上方引导线的顶端按住.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Step2.en: Lower slowly until the bullet is gripped.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Step2.ch: 緩緩下移, 直到夾住子彈.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Step2.cn: 缓缓下移, 直到夹住子弹.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Step3.en: Keep holding and lift straight up; release once it is out.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Step3.ch: 持續按住並垂直往上提; 取出後再放開.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Step3.cn: 持续按住并垂直往上提; 取出后再松开.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Watch.en: Fast or sideways movement drops the bullet back into the flesh. First Aid steadies your hand.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Watch.ch: 移動太快或往旁邊偏, 子彈會掉回肉裡. 急救技能能讓你的手更穩.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Bullet_Watch.cn: 移动太快或往旁边偏, 子弹会掉回肉里. 急救技能能让你的手更稳.

IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Goal.en: Cool the burn, then lay a clean cloth on it.
IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Goal.ch: 冷卻燒傷處, 再蓋上乾淨的布.
IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Goal.cn: 冷却烧伤处, 再盖上干净的布.

IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Step1.en: Hold the button over a glowing spot to drip cool water on it.
IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Step1.ch: 在發光的點上按住按鍵, 滴上冷水.
IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Step1.cn: 在发光的点上按住按键, 滴上冷水.

IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Step2.en: Cool every glowing spot until the HEAT bar is empty.
IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Step2.ch: 冷卻每一個發光點, 直到「熱度」條清空.
IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Step2.cn: 冷却每一个发光点, 直到“热度”条清空.

IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Step3.en: Then hold the button with the cloth over the middle of the burn until it settles.
IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Step3.ch: 接著將布放在燒傷處中央並按住按鍵, 直到穩定下來.
IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Step3.cn: 接着把布放在烧伤处中央并按住按键, 直到稳定下来.

IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Watch.en: Moving the cloth about on the burn rubs the blisters open. Hold still.
IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Watch.ch: 在燒傷處移動布會把水泡磨破. 保持不動.
IGUI_CU_Howto_BurnCare_Watch.cn: 在烧伤处移动布会把水泡磨破. 保持不动.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Goal.en: Seal every bleeding vessel with the hot blade.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Goal.ch: 用燒熱的刀刃封住每一條出血的血管.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Goal.cn: 用烧热的刀刃封住每一条出血的血管.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Step1.en: Hold the blade on a bleeder to sear it.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Step1.ch: 將刀刃按在出血點上燒灼.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Step1.cn: 把刀刃按在出血点上烧灼.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Step2.en: Lift off as the heart beats -- press between beats.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Step2.ch: 心跳時抬起, 在兩次心跳之間按下.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Step2.cn: 心跳时抬起, 在两次心跳之间按下.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Watch.en: When the limb trembles, lift. It is about to jerk, and holding through it burns what you were trying to save.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Watch.ch: 肢體顫抖時就抬起. 它即將抽動, 這時繼續按著會燒傷你想保住的組織.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Cauterize_Watch.cn: 肢体颤抖时就抬起. 它即将抽动, 这时继续按着会烧伤你想保住的组织.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Goal.en: Shock a heart that is in a rhythm worth shocking.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Goal.ch: 只對適合電擊的心律進行電擊.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Goal.cn: 只对适合电击的心律进行电击.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Step1.en: Drag both pads onto their marks on the chest.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Step1.ch: 將兩片電極片拖曳到胸口上的標記處.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Step1.cn: 把两片电极片拖到胸口上的标记处.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Step2.en: Hold the mouse button. The gauge on the right fills.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Step2.ch: 按住滑鼠按鍵. 右側量表會逐漸充滿.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Step2.cn: 按住鼠标按键. 右侧量表会逐渐充满.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Step3.en: Let go while the needle is inside the marked band. The caption over the gauge says when.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Step3.ch: 在指示針位於標記區間內時放開. 量表上方的提示會告訴你時機.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Step3.cn: 在指针位于标记区间内时松开. 量表上方的提示会告诉你时机.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Watch.en: Shocking a heart that is beating normally is how you stop one. Read the rhythm on the monitor first.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Watch.ch: 電擊正常跳動的心臟, 只會讓它停止. 先看清楚監視器上的心律.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Defibrillator_Watch.cn: 电击正常跳动的心脏, 只会让它停跳. 先看清监护仪上的心律.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Goal.en: Soak the swab, then dab every speck of dirt out of the wound.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Goal.ch: 浸濕棉棒, 再把傷口裡的每一點髒汙都輕點清除.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Goal.cn: 浸湿棉签, 再把伤口里的每一点污垢都轻点清除.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Step1.en: Click and hold the bottle, move it over the swab, and hold it there until the swab is soaked.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Step1.ch: 按住瓶子, 移到棉棒上方並停住, 直到棉棒浸濕.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Step1.cn: 按住瓶子, 移到棉签上方并停住, 直到棉签浸湿.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Step2.en: Let go of the bottle and click the swab to pick it up.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Step2.ch: 放開瓶子, 點選棉棒將它拿起.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Step2.cn: 松开瓶子, 点击棉签把它拿起.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Step3.en: Click each marked speck to dab it away. Yellow pus takes two dabs.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Step3.ch: 點選每個標記的髒點將它擦除. 黃色膿液需要點兩下.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Step3.cn: 点击每个标记的脏点把它擦除. 黄色脓液需要点两下.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Watch.en: Dab, don't scrub: dragging it fast hurts. When the SWAB bar is empty, dab the bottle to wet it again. Alcohol wipes skip this game.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Watch.ch: 輕點, 不要用力擦: 快速拖曳會很痛. 「棉棒」條空了時, 點一下瓶子重新沾濕. 使用酒精棉片可跳過這個小遊戲.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Disinfect_Watch.cn: 轻点, 不要用力擦: 快速拖动会很痛. 当“棉签”条空了时, 点一下瓶子重新沾湿. 使用酒精湿巾可跳过这个小游戏.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Dislocation_Goal.en: Line the bone up with the socket and ease it home.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dislocation_Goal.ch: 將骨頭對準關節窩, 再輕輕推回原位.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dislocation_Goal.cn: 把骨头对准关节窝, 再轻轻推回原位.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Dislocation_Step2.en: Pull it clear of the joint first.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Dislocation_Step3.en: Line it up with the mark, then ease it back in.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dislocation_Step3.ch: 對準標記, 再輕輕推回去.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dislocation_Step3.cn: 对准标记, 再轻轻推回去.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Dislocation_Watch.en: Forcing it in off-line is what does the damage. Clear, line up, then in.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dislocation_Watch.ch: 沒對準就硬塞才會造成傷害. 先拉開, 再對準, 然後推入.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dislocation_Watch.cn: 没对准就硬塞才会造成伤害. 先拉开, 再对准, 然后推入.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Goal.en: Open the body, lift the ribs, and name what is inside.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Goal.ch: 剖開屍體, 掀起肋骨, 辨認裡面的器官.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Goal.cn: 剖开尸体, 掀起肋骨, 辨认里面的器官.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Step1.en: Cut the Y: each shoulder to the breastbone, then straight down. Hold on the start mark and follow the line.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Step1.ch: 切出 Y 字形: 從兩側肩膀切到胸骨, 再直直往下. 在起點標記上按住, 沿著線條切.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Step1.cn: 切出 Y 字形: 从两侧肩膀切到胸骨, 再笔直往下. 在起点标记上按住, 沿着线条切.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Step2.en: Drag each side of the cut outward to lay the skin back, then click every marked rib.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Step2.ch: 將切口兩側向外拖曳翻開皮膚, 再點選每一根標記的肋骨.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Step2.cn: 把切口两侧向外拖动翻开皮肤, 再点击每一根标记的肋骨.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Step3.en: Drag the ribs up and off, then click each organ as it is asked for.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Step3.ch: 將肋骨往上拖曳移除, 再依指示點選各個器官.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Step3.cn: 把肋骨往上拖动移除, 再按提示点击各个器官.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Watch.en: A slip cuts your own hand, and the dead can carry the infection: wear gloves. A wrong organ costs you; every right one teaches you something.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Watch.ch: 手一滑就會割傷自己, 而死者可能帶有感染: 戴上手套. 點錯器官會有懲罰; 每點對一個都能學到東西.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Dissection_Watch.cn: 手一滑就会割伤自己, 而死者可能带有感染: 戴上手套. 点错器官会受罚; 每点对一个都能学到东西.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Goal.en: Cut along the line to let the pressure out.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Goal.ch: 沿著線切開以釋放壓力.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Goal.cn: 沿着线切开以释放压力.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Step1.en: Click and hold on the start mark.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Step2.en: Draw the blade along the dashed line to the cross at the end.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Step2.ch: 沿著虛線拉動刀刃, 一直到終點的叉號.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Step2.cn: 沿着虚线拉动刀刃, 一直到终点的叉号.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Step3.en: If you let go, pick it up again where the cut ends.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Step3.ch: 如果放開了, 就從切口的結尾處重新開始.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Step3.cn: 如果松开了, 就从切口的末端重新开始.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Watch.en: Off the line cuts what didn't need cutting; too fast goes too deep.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Watch.ch: 偏離線條會切到不該切的地方; 太快會切得太深.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Incision_Watch.cn: 偏离线条会切到不该切的地方; 太快会切得太深.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Goal.en: Get the dose into the mouth and none of it on the floor.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Goal.ch: 把藥量全倒進嘴裡, 別灑到地上.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Goal.cn: 把药量全倒进嘴里, 别洒到地上.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Step1.en: Move the bottle over the open mouth.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Step1.ch: 將藥瓶移到張開的嘴巴上方.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Step1.cn: 把药瓶移到张开的嘴巴上方.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Step2.en: Hold the mouse button to tip it.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Step2.ch: 按住滑鼠按鍵使其傾斜.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Step2.cn: 按住鼠标按键使其倾斜.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Step3.en: Let go when enough has come out.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Watch.en: Pills fall straight down. Tip it while it is off to one side and you lose them.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Watch.ch: 藥丸會直直往下掉. 若在偏向一側時傾倒, 藥丸就會掉光.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Pill_Watch.cn: 药丸会直直往下掉. 如果偏向一侧时倾倒, 药丸就会掉光.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Goal.en: Cover the marked patch round the wound with the paste.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Goal.ch: 用藥膏塗滿傷口周圍的標記區域.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Goal.cn: 用药膏涂满伤口周围的标记区域.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Step1.en: Click the bowl to take some paste on your fingers.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Step1.ch: 點選碗, 用手指沾取一些藥膏.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Step1.cn: 点击碗, 用手指蘸取一些药膏.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Step2.en: Click and hold, and draw your fingers over the marked patch.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Step2.ch: 按住並用手指抹過標記區域.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Step2.cn: 按住并用手指抹过标记区域.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Step3.en: When your fingers are empty, go back to the bowl.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Step3.ch: 手指上的藥膏用完時, 再回到碗裡沾取.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Step3.cn: 手指上的药膏用完时, 再回到碗里蘸取.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Watch.en: Paste spread outside the patch is wasted. Rubbing hard and fast hurts.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Watch.ch: 塗在區域外的藥膏都浪費了. 又用力又快地塗抹會很痛.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Poultice_Watch.cn: 涂在区域外的药膏都浪费了. 又用力又快地涂抹会很痛.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Goal.en: Seat the socket on the stump and strap it.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Goal.ch: 將接受腔套在殘肢上並綁緊.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Goal.cn: 把接受腔套在残肢上并绑紧.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Step1.en: Drag the socket's open end to the end of the stump, level with it.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Step1.ch: 將接受腔的開口端拖曳到殘肢末端, 並與其對齊.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Step1.cn: 把接受腔的开口端拖到残肢末端, 并与其对齐.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Step2.en: Slide it on until it seats.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Step2.ch: 將它套上, 直到完全就位.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Step2.cn: 把它套上, 直到完全就位.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Watch.en: Shoving it on hard pinches the stump. Taking it off: undo the buckles and draw it off, easily.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Watch.ch: 硬塞上去會夾痛殘肢. 取下時: 解開扣環, 再輕輕拉出.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Prosthetic_Watch.cn: 硬塞上去会夹痛残肢. 取下时: 解开扣环, 再轻轻拉出.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Goal.en: Fold it into a pad, press it on until the bleeding gives, and tie it on.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Goal.ch: 將它摺成一塊墊子, 壓住直到出血緩和, 再綁緊.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Goal.cn: 把它折成一块垫子, 压住直到出血缓和, 再绑紧.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Step1.en: Drag the right edge across onto the left, then the top edge down onto the bottom.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Step1.ch: 將右側邊緣拖過來疊到左側, 再將上緣往下疊到下緣.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Step1.cn: 将右侧边缘拖过来叠到左侧, 再将上缘往下叠到下缘.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Step2.en: Drag the pad onto the wound and hold it there, still, until the ring fills.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Step2.ch: 將敷墊拖到傷口上並按住不動, 直到圓環填滿.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Step2.cn: 将敷垫拖到伤口上并按住不动, 直到圆环填满.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Step3.en: Take the left end over the pad to the right, then the right end back over to the left.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Step3.ch: 將左端越過敷墊拉到右邊, 再將右端拉回左邊.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Step3.cn: 将左端越过敷垫拉到右边, 再将右端拉回左边.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Watch.en: Moving the pad about lets the pressure go. Yanking the ends ties it on too tight.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Watch.ch: 敷墊亂動會讓壓力流失. 猛拉兩端會綁得太緊.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Rag_Watch.cn: 敷垫乱动会让压力流失. 猛拉两端会绑得太紧.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Shrapnel_Goal.en: Get the glass, the bullet or the dead tissue out cleanly.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Shrapnel_Goal.ch: 乾淨俐落地取出玻璃, 子彈或壞死組織.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Shrapnel_Goal.cn: 干净利落地取出玻璃, 子弹或坏死组织.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Shrapnel_Step1.en: Click and hold on the piece.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Shrapnel_Step2.en: Draw it out slowly and straight.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Shrapnel_Watch.en: Pulling fast tears the wound open. Tweezers raise the speed you can get away with.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Shrapnel_Watch.ch: 拉得太快會撕裂傷口. 用鑷子能容許更快的速度.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Shrapnel_Watch.cn: 拉得太快会撕裂伤口. 用镊子能容许更快的速度.

IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Goal.en: Untie the knots, then lift the boards away.
IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Goal.ch: 先解開繩結, 再把夾板移開.
IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Goal.cn: 先解开绳结, 再把夹板移开.

IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Step1.en: Click and hold a knot and tug it sideways until it comes undone.
IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Step1.ch: 點選並按住繩結, 往側邊拉扯直到鬆開.
IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Step1.cn: 点击并按住绳结, 往侧边拉扯直到松开.

IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Step3.en: Click and hold each board and ease it away from the limb.
IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Step3.ch: 點選並按住每塊夾板, 慢慢將它從肢體上移開.
IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Step3.cn: 点击并按住每块夹板, 慢慢将它从肢体上移开.

IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Watch.en: Lifting the boards fast jolts the break underneath. Slowly.
IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Watch.ch: 夾板移得太快會震到底下的骨折處. 要慢.
IGUI_CU_Howto_SplintOff_Watch.cn: 夹板移得太快会震到底下的骨折处. 要慢.

IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Goal.en: Snip each stitch, then draw the thread out.
IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Goal.ch: 剪斷每一針, 再把縫線抽出.
IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Goal.cn: 剪断每一针, 再把缝线抽出.

IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Step1.en: Click the snip mark just beside a knot to cut that stitch.
IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Step1.ch: 點選線結旁的剪切標記, 剪斷那一針.
IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Step1.cn: 点击线结旁的剪切标记, 剪断那一针.

IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Step2.en: Click and hold the knot, and draw it up and away from the wound.
IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Step2.ch: 點選並按住線結, 往上拉離傷口.
IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Step2.cn: 点击并按住线结, 往上拉离伤口.

IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Step3.en: Do the same for every stitch.

IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Watch.en: Snipping off the mark nicks the skin. Pulling the thread fast tugs at the wound.
IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Watch.ch: 剪偏標記會劃傷皮膚. 縫線抽得太快會扯動傷口.
IGUI_CU_Howto_StitchOut_Watch.cn: 剪偏标记会划伤皮肤. 缝线抽得太快会扯动伤口.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Goal.en: Close the wound with a row of even stitches.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Goal.ch: 用一排均勻的縫線縫合傷口.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Goal.cn: 用一排均匀的缝线缝合伤口.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Step1.en: Click and hold at the upper mark to push the needle in.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Step1.ch: 在上方標記處點選並按住, 將針刺入.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Step1.cn: 在上方标记处点击并按住, 将针刺入.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Step2.en: Drag under the wound to the lower mark and release.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Step2.ch: 從傷口下方拖到下方標記處再放開.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Step2.cn: 从伤口下方拖到下方标记处再松开.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Step3.en: Pull the thread snug -- firmly, not hard.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Step3.ch: 把縫線拉緊 -- 要穩, 別用力過猛.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Step3.cn: 把缝线拉紧 -- 要稳, 别用力过猛.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Watch.en: Speed is what hurts. A needle holder lets you go faster; without one, take your time.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Watch.ch: 速度才是造成疼痛的原因. 有持針器可以縫快一點; 沒有的話就慢慢來.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Stitching_Watch.cn: 速度才是造成疼痛的原因. 有持针钳可以缝快一点; 没有的话就慢慢来.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Syringe_Goal.en: Push the plunger to the marked band and stop there.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Syringe_Goal.ch: 將推桿推到標示的區間就停下.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Syringe_Goal.cn: 将推杆推到标示的区间就停下.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Syringe_Step1.en: Click and hold on the plunger.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Syringe_Step2.en: Push down. The barrel shows how much has gone in.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Syringe_Step2.ch: 往下推. 針筒會顯示注入了多少.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Syringe_Step2.cn: 往下推. 针筒会显示注入了多少.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Syringe_Watch.en: Past the band is the whole syringe, and that is an overdose. With a painkiller already in the blood, the safe band is narrower.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Syringe_Watch.ch: 超過區間就是整支針筒的量, 那就是用藥過量. 若血液中已有止痛藥, 安全區間會更窄.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Syringe_Watch.cn: 超过区间就是整支针筒的量, 那就是用药过量. 若血液中已有止痛药, 安全区间会更窄.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Goal.en: Stop the bleeding: strap it above the wound and twist it tight.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Goal.ch: 止血: 綁在傷口上方並轉緊.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Goal.cn: 止血: 绑在伤口上方并转紧.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Step1.en: Drag the tourniquet onto the marked band, above the wound.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Step1.ch: 將止血帶拖到傷口上方的標示區.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Step1.cn: 将止血带拖到伤口上方的标示区.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Step2.en: Click and hold the rod and turn it round until the gauge is in the green.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Step2.ch: 點選並按住絞棒轉動, 直到量表進入綠色區.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Step2.cn: 点击并按住绞棒转动, 直到量表进入绿色区.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Step3.en: Let go, then click the clip to lock it.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Step3.ch: 放開, 再點選扣環將它鎖住.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Step3.cn: 松开, 再点击卡扣将它锁住.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Watch.en: Past the green it is crushing the limb. Taking one off: unclip it, turn the rod back slowly, then drag it off.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Watch.ch: 超過綠色區就會壓壞肢體. 拆除時: 解開扣環, 慢慢把絞棒轉回去, 再把它拖下來.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Tourniquet_Watch.cn: 超过绿色区就会压坏肢体. 拆除时: 解开卡扣, 慢慢把绞棒转回去, 再把它拖下来.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Goal.en: Unwind the dressing, the opposite way to how it went on.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Goal.ch: 沿著包紮時的反方向解開敷料.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Goal.cn: 沿着包扎时的反方向解开敷料.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Step1.en: Click and hold the loose end.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Step1.ch: 點選並按住鬆脫的一端.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Step1.cn: 点击并按住松脱的一端.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Step2.en: Take it round and round the limb, following the arrows. Any shape will do.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Step2.ch: 跟著箭頭繞著肢體一圈一圈轉. 怎麼繞都行.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Step2.cn: 跟着箭头绕着肢体一圈一圈转. 怎么绕都行.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Step3.en: Keep going until every turn is off.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Step3.ch: 持續繞到每一圈都解開為止.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Step3.cn: 持续绕到每一圈都解开为止.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Watch.en: A dressing on a bleeding or dirty wound is stuck by its last turn (dark red). Go slowly over that part or it tears the wound open.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Watch.ch: 出血或骯髒傷口上的敷料, 最後一圈會黏住 (深紅色). 那一段要慢慢來, 否則會撕裂傷口.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Unwrap_Watch.cn: 出血或肮脏伤口上的敷料, 最后一圈会粘住 (深红色). 那一段要慢慢来, 否则会撕裂伤口.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_acute_kidney_injury.en: Hardly passing water, swollen, the heart skipping.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_acute_kidney_injury.ch: 幾乎尿不出來, 身體浮腫, 心跳不規律.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_acute_kidney_injury.cn: 几乎尿不出来, 身体浮肿, 心跳不规律.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_aspiration.en: Wet coughing and choking, as if something went down the wrong way.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_aspiration.ch: 濕咳又嗆到, 好像有東西吞進了氣管.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_aspiration.cn: 湿咳又呛到, 好像有东西吞进了气管.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_compartment_syndrome.en: A limb swollen hard and tight, the pain far worse than it should be.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_compartment_syndrome.ch: 肢體腫得又硬又緊, 痛得遠超出應有的程度.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_compartment_syndrome.cn: 肢体肿得又硬又紧, 痛得远超出应有的程度.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_concussion.en: Foggy and sick after a blow to the head.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_concussion.ch: 頭部受到撞擊後昏沉想吐.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_concussion.cn: 头部受到撞击后昏沉想吐.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_deep_vein_thrombosis.en: One leg hot, swollen and aching deep inside.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_deep_vein_thrombosis.ch: 一條腿發熱, 腫脹, 深處隱隱作痛.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_deep_vein_thrombosis.cn: 一条腿发热, 肿胀, 深处隐隐作痛.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_dehydration.en: Dry mouth, headache, dizzy when standing.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_dehydration.ch: 口乾, 頭痛, 站起來就頭暈.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_dehydration.cn: 口干, 头痛, 站起来就头晕.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_haemorrhagic_shock.en: Cold, clammy, a racing weak pulse after losing a lot of blood.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_haemorrhagic_shock.ch: 大量失血後渾身發冷, 濕黏, 脈搏又快又弱.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_haemorrhagic_shock.cn: 大量失血后浑身发冷, 湿黏, 脉搏又快又弱.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_hyperthermia.ch: 全身發燙, 滿臉通紅, 而且不再流汗.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_hyperthermia.cn: 全身发烫, 满脸通红, 而且不再出汗.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_hypoglycaemia.ch: 冒汗, 發抖, 頭昏眼花.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_hypoglycaemia.cn: 冒汗, 发抖, 头昏眼花.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_hypothermia.en: Cold to the core and shivering hard.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_hypothermia.ch: 冷到骨子裡, 抖個不停.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_hypothermia.cn: 冷到骨子里, 抖个不停.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_intracranial_bleed.en: A blow to the head that is getting worse, not better.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_intracranial_bleed.ch: 頭部受到撞擊, 情況越來越糟而不是好轉.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_intracranial_bleed.cn: 头部受到撞击, 情况越来越糟而不是好转.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_necrosis.en: The flesh round a wound has gone dark and smells.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_necrosis.ch: 傷口周圍的肉變黑發臭.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_necrosis.cn: 伤口周围的肉变黑发臭.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pneumonia.en: A deep, wet cough and a fever that sits in the chest.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pneumonia.ch: 深沉的濕咳, 加上悶在胸口的發燒.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pneumonia.cn: 深沉的湿咳, 加上闷在胸口的发烧.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pneumothorax.en: Short of breath and getting worse, one side of the chest not moving.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pneumothorax.ch: 呼吸越來越急促, 一側胸口沒有起伏.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pneumothorax.cn: 呼吸越来越急促, 一侧胸口没有起伏.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia.en: Pale, shaky and short of strength since the bleeding.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia.ch: 出血之後就臉色蒼白, 發抖, 渾身無力.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia.cn: 出血之后就脸色苍白, 发抖, 浑身无力.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pressure_injury.en: The limb below the tourniquet is aching and going numb.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pressure_injury.ch: 止血帶下方的肢體疼痛並逐漸麻木.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pressure_injury.cn: 止血带下方的肢体疼痛并逐渐麻木.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_ptsd.en: Something seen that keeps coming back.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_ptsd.ch: 曾目睹的某些事一再浮現.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_ptsd.cn: 曾目睹的某些事一再浮现.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pulmonary_embolism.en: A stabbing pain in the chest and no breath, out of nowhere.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pulmonary_embolism.ch: 毫無預警地胸口刺痛, 喘不過氣.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pulmonary_embolism.cn: 毫无预警地胸口刺痛, 喘不过气.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pulmonary_oedema.en: Breathless and bubbling, worse lying down.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pulmonary_oedema.ch: 喘不過氣, 胸中咕嚕作響, 躺下更嚴重.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_pulmonary_oedema.cn: 喘不过气, 胸中咕噜作响, 躺下更严重.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_rib_fracture.en: Every breath catches on something in the chest.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_rib_fracture.ch: 每次呼吸胸口都像卡到東西.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_rib_fracture.cn: 每次呼吸胸口都像卡到东西.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_sepsis.en: Burning up, confused, a heart that won't slow down.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_sepsis.ch: 全身發燙, 神智不清, 心跳怎樣都慢不下來.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_sepsis.cn: 全身发烫, 神志不清, 心跳怎样都慢不下来.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_septic_shock.en: Feverish and grey, the pulse fading, everything shutting down.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_septic_shock.ch: 發燒, 臉色灰敗, 脈搏漸弱, 全身機能逐漸停擺.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_septic_shock.cn: 发烧, 脸色灰败, 脉搏渐弱, 全身机能逐渐停摆.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_tetanus.en: The jaw and the muscles stiffening, spasms coming in waves.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_tetanus.ch: 下顎和肌肉僵硬, 一陣陣抽搐.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_tetanus.cn: 下颌和肌肉僵硬, 一阵阵抽搐.

IGUI_CU_LayWhy_wound_infection.en: A wound gone hot, red, swollen and weeping.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_wound_infection.ch: 傷口發熱, 紅腫, 還在滲液.
IGUI_CU_LayWhy_wound_infection.cn: 伤口发热, 红肿, 还在渗液.

IGUI_CU_Lay_haemorrhagic_shock.ch: 發冷, 灰白, 逐漸虛脫 (?)
IGUI_CU_Lay_haemorrhagic_shock.cn: 发冷, 灰白, 逐渐虚脱 (?)

IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_DrawEachClumpOutOfTheM.en: Draw each clump out of the mouth.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_DrawEachClumpOutOfTheM.ch: 把每一團異物從嘴裡拉出來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_DrawEachClumpOutOfTheM.cn: 把每一团异物从嘴里拉出来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_LiftTheChinTipTheHeadB.en: Lift the chin: tip the head back until the line is green.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_LiftTheChinTipTheHeadB.ch: 抬起下巴: 讓頭往後仰, 直到線條變綠.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_LiftTheChinTipTheHeadB.cn: 抬起下巴: 让头往后仰, 直到线条变绿.

IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_TakeAClumpFromTheMouth.en: Take a clump from the mouth.

IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_TakeTheChinAndLiftItTi.en: Take the chin and lift it, tipping the head back until the line turns green.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_TakeTheChinAndLiftItTi.ch: 托住下巴往上抬, 讓頭往後仰, 直到線條變綠.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_TakeTheChinAndLiftItTi.cn: 托住下巴往上抬, 让头往后仰, 直到线条变绿.

IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_ThenTakeEachClumpInThe.en: Then take each clump in the mouth and draw it out and away.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_ThenTakeEachClumpInThe.ch: 接著抓住嘴裡的每一團異物, 往外拉出移開.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_ThenTakeEachClumpInThe.cn: 接着抓住嘴里的每一团异物, 往外拉出移开.

IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_TipTheHeadBackFirstOpe.en: Tip the head back first -- open the airway.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_TipTheHeadBackFirstOpe.ch: 先讓頭往後仰 -- 暢通呼吸道.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_TipTheHeadBackFirstOpe.cn: 先让头往后仰 -- 畅通气道.

IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_TooFarYouLlHurtTheNeck.en: Too far -- you'll hurt the neck.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_TooFarYouLlHurtTheNeck.ch: 太過頭了 -- 會傷到脖子.
IGUI_CU_MG_Airway_TooFarYouLlHurtTheNeck.cn: 太过头了 -- 会伤到脖子.

IGUI_CU_MG_Amputation_MakeSureToStopTheB.en: Make sure to stop the bleeding after.

IGUI_CU_MG_Amputation_SlowDownTheBladeIs.en: Slow down -- the blade is binding.
IGUI_CU_MG_Amputation_SlowDownTheBladeIs.ch: 慢一點 -- 鋸片卡住了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Amputation_SlowDownTheBladeIs.cn: 慢一点 -- 锯片卡住了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Amputation_TheBladeJammedInTh.en: The blade jammed in the bone.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_ClickAndHoldTheRollTo.en: Click and hold the roll to pick it up.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_GetItAllTheWayRoundOn.en: Get it all the way round once first.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_GrabTheRollAndTakeItR.en: Grab the roll and take it round the limb, any shape. As many turns as you like.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_GrabTheRollAndTakeItR.ch: 抓住繃帶捲繞著肢體轉, 怎麼繞都行. 要繞幾圈都可以.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_GrabTheRollAndTakeItR.cn: 抓住绷带卷绕着肢体转, 怎么绕都行. 要绕几圈都可以.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_KeepGoingTheSameWayRo.en: Keep going the same way round.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_LetGoAndPressSPACEToT.en: Let go and press SPACE to tie it off. Less First Aid needs more turns.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_LetGoAndPressSPACEToT.ch: 放開並按 SPACE 打結固定. 急救等級越低需要繞越多圈.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_LetGoAndPressSPACEToT.cn: 松开并按 SPACE 打结固定. 急救等级越低需要绕越多圈.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_RoundTheArmNotThrough.en: Round the arm, not through it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_RoundTheArmNotThrough.ch: 繞著手臂轉, 不是穿過去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_RoundTheArmNotThrough.cn: 绕着手臂转, 不是穿过去.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_SPACEToTieItOffOrPick.en: SPACE to tie it off -- or pick it up and keep going.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_SPACEToTieItOffOrPick.ch: 按 SPACE 打結固定 -- 或拿起來繼續繞.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_SPACEToTieItOffOrPick.cn: 按 SPACE 打结固定 -- 或拿起来继续绕.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_SlowDownYouReWrapping.en: Slow down -- you're wrapping it loose.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_SlowDownYouReWrapping.ch: 慢一點 -- 你繞得太鬆了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_SlowDownYouReWrapping.cn: 慢一点 -- 你绕得太松了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_TiedOffWithDuration.ch: 打結固定了. 可保持乾淨%1.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_TiedOffWithDuration.cn: 打结固定了. 可保持干净%1.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_WholeRollWithDuration.en: That's the whole roll. Stays clean %1.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_WholeRollWithDuration.ch: 整捲都用完了. 可保持乾淨%1.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bandage_WholeRollWithDuration.cn: 整卷都用完了. 可保持干净%1.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_BulletGrippedLiftSlowl.en: Bullet gripped. Lift slowly and keep straight.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_BulletGrippedLiftSlowl.ch: 夾住子彈了. 慢慢往上提, 保持筆直.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_BulletGrippedLiftSlowl.cn: 夹住子弹了. 慢慢往上提, 保持笔直.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_HoldAboveTheWoundSlowl.en: Hold above the wound; slowly lower the tweezers into the marked channel.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_HoldAboveTheWoundSlowl.ch: 拿在傷口上方; 慢慢將鑷子放進標示的通道.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_HoldAboveTheWoundSlowl.cn: 拿在伤口上方; 慢慢将镊子放进标示的通道.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_LostYourGripStartTheIn.en: Lost your grip. Start the insertion again.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_LostYourGripStartTheIn.ch: 沒夾穩. 重新開始插入.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_LostYourGripStartTheIn.cn: 没夹稳. 重新开始插入.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_SlowerTheTissueIsTeari.ch: 慢一點. 組織在撕裂.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_SlowerTheTissueIsTeari.cn: 慢一点. 组织在撕裂.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_StartAtTheTopOfTheGuid.en: Start at the top of the guide.

IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_ThenLiftStraightUpASli.en: Then lift straight up. A slip drops the bullet back into the flesh.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_ThenLiftStraightUpASli.ch: 然後筆直往上提. 一滑手子彈就會掉回肉裡.
IGUI_CU_MG_Bullet_ThenLiftStraightUpASli.cn: 然后笔直往上提. 一滑手子弹就会掉回肉里.

IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_CooledNowLayTheCloth.en: Cooled. Now lay the cloth over it, and hold still.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_CooledNowLayTheCloth.ch: 冷卻好了. 現在把布蓋上去, 並保持不動.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_CooledNowLayTheCloth.cn: 冷却好了. 现在把布盖上去, 并保持不动.

IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_DripItOnTheGlowingSp.en: Drip it on the glowing spots.

IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_HoldTheButtonOverAGl.en: Hold the button over a glowing spot to drip water on it.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_HoldTheButtonOverAGl.ch: 在發亮的地方按住按鍵, 滴水上去.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_HoldTheButtonOverAGl.cn: 在发亮的地方按住按键, 滴水上去.

IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_HoldTheButtonToDripC.en: Hold the button to drip cool water. Cool every glowing spot.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_HoldTheButtonToDripC.ch: 按住按鍵滴下冷水. 把每個發亮的地方都降溫.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_HoldTheButtonToDripC.cn: 按住按键滴下冷水. 把每个发亮的地方都降温.

IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_HoldTheButtonWithThe.en: Hold the button with the cloth over the middle of the burn.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_HoldTheButtonWithThe.ch: 讓布蓋在燒傷中央並按住按鍵.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_HoldTheButtonWithThe.cn: 让布盖在烧伤中央并按住按键.

IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_ThenHoldTheClothStil.en: Then hold the cloth still over the burn until it settles. Don't rub.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_ThenHoldTheClothStil.ch: 然後把布穩穩蓋在燒傷上, 直到穩定下來. 不要搓.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_ThenHoldTheClothStil.cn: 然后把布稳稳盖在烧伤上, 直到稳定下来. 不要搓.

IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_YouReRubbingTheBlist.en: You're rubbing the blisters. Hold it still.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_YouReRubbingTheBlist.ch: 你在搓破水泡. 保持不動.
IGUI_CU_MG_BurnCare_YouReRubbingTheBlist.cn: 你在搓破水泡. 保持不动.

IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_ItBlewThroughLiftFo.en: It blew through -- lift for the beat.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_ItBlewThroughLiftFo.ch: 血衝破了 -- 心跳時要抬起.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_ItBlewThroughLiftFo.cn: 血冲破了 -- 心跳时要抬起.

IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_ItJerkedTheBladeSki.ch: 它抽動了 -- 刀刃滑開了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_ItJerkedTheBladeSki.cn: 它抽动了 -- 刀刃滑开了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_ItSTensingLiftTheBl.ch: 它在繃緊 -- 抬起刀刃!
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_ItSTensingLiftTheBl.cn: 它在绷紧 -- 抬起刀刃!

IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_SealEachVesselWithT.en: Seal each vessel with the blade. Lift for the heartbeat, press between.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_SealEachVesselWithT.ch: 用刀刃封住每條血管. 心跳時抬起, 間隔時按下.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_SealEachVesselWithT.cn: 用刀刃封住每条血管. 心跳时抬起, 间隔时按下.

IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_TheBigOneFirstWhenT.en: The big one first. When the limb trembles, lift -- it's going to jerk.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_TheBigOneFirstWhenT.ch: 先處理最大的那條. 肢體一發抖就抬起 -- 它要抽動了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_TheBigOneFirstWhenT.cn: 先处理最大的那条. 肢体一发抖就抬起 -- 它要抽动了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_TheBladeIsCoolingIt.en: The blade is cooling -- it seals slower now.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_TheBladeIsCoolingIt.ch: 刀刃在變冷 -- 現在封得比較慢.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_TheBladeIsCoolingIt.cn: 刀刃在变冷 -- 现在封得比较慢.

IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_TheBladeWentColdHea.en: The blade went cold. Heat it again.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_TheBladeWentColdHea.ch: 刀刃冷掉了. 再加熱一次.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_TheBladeWentColdHea.cn: 刀刃冷掉了. 再加热一次.

IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_TooDeepYouReCooking.ch: 太深了 -- 你在把它燒熟.
IGUI_CU_MG_Cauterize_TooDeepYouReCooking.cn: 太深了 -- 你在把它烧熟.

IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_HoldToChargeLetGoInside.en: Hold to charge. Let go inside the band.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_HoldToChargeLetGoInside.ch: 按住充電. 在區間內放開.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_HoldToChargeLetGoInside.cn: 按住充电. 在区间内松开.

IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_PutBothPadsOnTheMarks.en: Put both pads on the marks.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_PutBothPadsOnTheMarks.ch: 把兩片電極片都貼到標記上.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_PutBothPadsOnTheMarks.cn: 把两片电极片都贴到标记上.

IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_ThatIsNotOnTheMark.en: That is not on the mark.

IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_ThisHeartIsDoingItsJobA.en: This heart is doing its job. A shock will stop it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_ThisHeartIsDoingItsJobA.ch: 這顆心臟還在正常運作. 電擊會讓它停下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_ThisHeartIsDoingItsJobA.cn: 这颗心脏还在正常工作. 电击会让它停下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_TooMuchDumpItAndStartAg.en: Too much. Dump it and start again.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_TooMuchDumpItAndStartAg.ch: 過量了. 洩掉電荷重新來過.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_TooMuchDumpItAndStartAg.cn: 过量了. 泄掉电荷重新来过.

IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_TooSlowWhateverWasGoing.en: Too slow. Whatever was going to happen has happened.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_TooSlowWhateverWasGoing.ch: 太慢了. 該發生的都已經發生了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_TooSlowWhateverWasGoing.cn: 太慢了. 该发生的都已经发生了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_YouHeldItPastTheTopThe.en: You held it past the top. The charge blew.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_YouHeldItPastTheTopThe.ch: 你按過了頂點. 電荷燒掉了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Defib_YouHeldItPastTheTopThe.cn: 你按过了顶点. 电荷烧掉了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_ClickAndHoldTheBott.en: Click and hold the bottle, then move it over the swab.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_ClickAndHoldTheBott.ch: 按住瓶子, 然後移到棉棒上方.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_ClickAndHoldTheBott.cn: 按住瓶子, 然后移到棉签上方.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_ClickEachMarkedSpec.en: Click each marked speck to dab it out. Dab, don't scrub.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_ClickEachMarkedSpec.ch: 點選每個標記的髒點把它沾掉. 用沾的, 不要用擦的.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_ClickEachMarkedSpec.cn: 点击每个标记的脏点把它蘸掉. 用蘸的, 不要用擦的.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_ClickTheSwabToPickI.en: Click the swab to pick it up.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_MostlyCleanItWillHa.en: Mostly clean. It will have to do.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_MostlyCleanItWillHa.ch: 大致乾淨了. 只能這樣了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_MostlyCleanItWillHa.cn: 大致干净了. 只能这样了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_NothingThereDabTheM.en: Nothing there. Dab the marked specks.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_NothingThereDabTheM.ch: 那裡沒東西. 沾標記的髒點.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_NothingThereDabTheM.cn: 那里没东西. 蘸标记的脏点.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_PickUpTheBottleAndH.en: Pick up the bottle and hold it over the swab to soak it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_PickUpTheBottleAndH.ch: 拿起瓶子, 舉在棉棒上方把它浸濕.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_PickUpTheBottleAndH.cn: 拿起瓶子, 举在棉签上方把它浸湿.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_SoakItFirstHoldTheB.en: Soak it first: hold the bottle over it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_SoakItFirstHoldTheB.ch: 先浸濕: 把瓶子舉在它上方.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_SoakItFirstHoldTheB.cn: 先浸湿: 把瓶子举在它上方.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_SoakedLetGoOfTheBot.en: Soaked. Let go of the bottle and pick up the swab.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_SoakedLetGoOfTheBot.ch: 浸濕了. 放開瓶子, 拿起棉棒.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_SoakedLetGoOfTheBot.cn: 浸湿了. 松开瓶子, 拿起棉签.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_TheSwabIsDryDabTheB.en: The swab is dry. Dab the bottle to wet it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_TheSwabIsDryDabTheB.ch: 棉棒乾了. 碰一下瓶子沾濕它.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_TheSwabIsDryDabTheB.cn: 棉签干了. 碰一下瓶子蘸湿它.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_ThenPickUpTheSwabAn.en: Then pick up the swab and click each speck of dirt to dab it out.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_ThenPickUpTheSwabAn.ch: 然後拿起棉棒, 點選每個髒點把它沾掉.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_ThenPickUpTheSwabAn.cn: 然后拿起棉签, 点击每个脏点把它蘸掉.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_TooRoughDabDonTScru.ch: 太粗魯了. 用沾的, 不要用擦的.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_TooRoughDabDonTScru.cn: 太粗暴了. 用蘸的, 不要用擦的.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_WhenTheSwabRunsDryD.en: When the swab runs dry, dab the bottle to wet it again.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_WhenTheSwabRunsDryD.ch: 棉棒乾掉時, 碰一下瓶子再把它沾濕.
IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_WhenTheSwabRunsDryD.cn: 棉签干掉时, 碰一下瓶子再把它蘸湿.

IGUI_CU_MG_Disinfect_YouRePouringItOnThe.en: You're pouring it on the floor.

IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_BoneOnBonePullItC.en: Bone on bone -- pull it clear first.
IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_BoneOnBonePullItC.ch: 骨頭頂著骨頭 -- 先把它拉開.
IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_BoneOnBonePullItC.cn: 骨头顶着骨头 -- 先把它拉开.

IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_HitTheBoneIntoThe.en: Hit the bone into the correct spot to correct dislocation.
IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_HitTheBoneIntoThe.ch: 把骨頭撞回正確位置來矯正脫臼.
IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_HitTheBoneIntoThe.cn: 把骨头撞回正确位置来矫正脱臼.

IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_PullItClearLineIt.en: Pull it clear, line it up, then ease it back in.
IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_PullItClearLineIt.ch: 先拉開, 對準, 再慢慢推回去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_PullItClearLineIt.cn: 先拉开, 对准, 再慢慢推回去.

IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_YouCouldnTGetItBa.en: You couldn't get it back in.

IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_YouGroundTheJoint.ch: 你把關節磨得血肉模糊.
IGUI_CU_MG_Dislocation_YouGroundTheJoint.cn: 你把关节磨得血肉模糊.

IGUI_CU_MG_DoneAnyway.en: Done anyway - badly. Something went wrong with it.
IGUI_CU_MG_DoneAnyway.ch: 還是完成了 - 但很糟. 出了點問題.
IGUI_CU_MG_DoneAnyway.cn: 还是完成了 - 但很糟. 出了点问题.

IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_ClickAndHoldOnTheSta.en: Click and hold on the start mark.

IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_PickTheBladeUpWhereT.en: Pick the blade up where the cut ends.
IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_PickTheBladeUpWhereT.ch: 在切口結束的地方重新拿起刀.
IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_PickTheBladeUpWhereT.cn: 在切口结束的地方重新拿起刀.

IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_PickTheBladeUpWhereT.en: Pick the blade up where the cut ends and carry on.
IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_PickTheBladeUpWhereT.ch: 在切口結束處拿起刀片繼續.
IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_PickTheBladeUpWhereT.cn: 在切口结束处拿起刀片继续.

IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_SetTheBladeOnTheStar.en: Set the blade on the start mark and draw it along the line to the end.
IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_SetTheBladeOnTheStar.ch: 把刀片放在起點標記上, 沿著線拉到終點.
IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_SetTheBladeOnTheStar.cn: 把刀片放在起点标记上, 沿着线拉到终点.

IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_SetTheBladeOnTheStar.en: Set the blade on the start mark.

IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_SteadyAndOnTheLineTo.en: Steady and on the line. Too fast and it goes too deep.
IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_SteadyAndOnTheLineTo.ch: 穩穩沿著線走. 太快會切太深.
IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_SteadyAndOnTheLineTo.cn: 稳稳沿着线走. 太快会切太深.

IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_TheBladeCameOutPickI.en: The blade came out. Pick it up where the cut ends.
IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_TheBladeCameOutPickI.ch: 刀片滑出來了. 在切口結束處把它拿起來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Incision_TheBladeCameOutPickI.cn: 刀片滑出来了. 在切口结束处把它拿起来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Pill_HintWithMedicine.en: Pills drop straight down. Don't spill %1.
IGUI_CU_MG_Pill_HintWithMedicine.ch: 藥丸會直直往下掉. 別灑了%1.
IGUI_CU_MG_Pill_HintWithMedicine.cn: 药丸会直直往下掉. 别洒了%1.

IGUI_CU_MG_Pill_HoldTheBottleOverTheMout.en: Hold the bottle over the mouth, then hold click to tip it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Pill_HoldTheBottleOverTheMout.ch: 把瓶子拿到嘴巴上方, 然後按住點選把它傾斜.
IGUI_CU_MG_Pill_HoldTheBottleOverTheMout.cn: 把瓶子拿到嘴巴上方, 然后按住点击把它倾斜.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_ClickTheBowlToTakeSo.en: Click the bowl to take some paste, then hold and spread it over the marked patch.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_ClickTheBowlToTakeSo.ch: 點選碗沾取一些藥膏, 然後按住並塗抹在標記區域上.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_ClickTheBowlToTakeSo.cn: 点击碗蘸取一些药膏, 然后按住并涂抹在标记区域上.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_ClickTheBowlToTakeSo.en: Click the bowl to take some paste.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_GentlyPressItOnDonTR.en: Gently. Press it on, don't rub.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_GentlyPressItOnDonTR.ch: 輕一點. 壓上去, 不要揉.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_GentlyPressItOnDonTR.cn: 轻一点. 压上去, 不要揉.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_HoldAndDrawYourFinge.en: Hold and draw your fingers over the marked patch.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_HoldAndDrawYourFinge.ch: 按住並用手指劃過標記區域.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_HoldAndDrawYourFinge.cn: 按住并用手指划过标记区域.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_PatchyButItSOn.ch: 塗得不均勻, 但總算敷上了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_PatchyButItSOn.cn: 涂得不均匀, 但总算敷上了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_WhenYourFingersAreEm.en: When your fingers are empty, go back to the bowl.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_WhenYourFingersAreEm.ch: 手指上的藥膏用完時, 再回到碗裡沾取.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_WhenYourFingersAreEm.cn: 手指上的药膏用完时, 再回到碗里蘸取.

IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_YourFingersAreEmptyT.en: Your fingers are empty. Take some from the bowl.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_YourFingersAreEmptyT.ch: 你手指上沒東西. 從碗裡沾一些.
IGUI_CU_MG_Poultice_YourFingersAreEmptyT.cn: 你手指上没东西. 从碗里蘸一些.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_BringTheSocketSOpe.en: Bring the socket's open end to the end of the stump, level with it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_BringTheSocketSOpe.ch: 把接受腔的開口端移到殘肢末端, 與它對齊.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_BringTheSocketSOpe.cn: 把接受腔的开口端移到残肢末端, 与它对齐.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.en: Click both buckles to undo the straps.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.ch: 點選兩個扣環解開綁帶.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.cn: 点击两个扣环解开绑带.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.en: Click both buckles to undo them.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.ch: 點選兩個扣環把它們解開.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ClickBothBucklesTo.cn: 点击两个扣环把它们解开.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_DragTheSocketSOpen.en: Drag the socket's open end to the end of the stump.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_DragTheSocketSOpen.ch: 把接受腔的開口端拖曳到殘肢末端.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_DragTheSocketSOpen.cn: 把接受腔的开口端拖到残肢末端.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_EasyItSDraggingAtT.en: Easy -- it's dragging at the scar.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_EasyItSDraggingAtT.ch: 輕一點 -- 它在拉扯疤痕.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_EasyItSDraggingAtT.cn: 轻一点 -- 它在拉扯疤痕.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_EasyItSPinchingThe.ch: 輕一點 -- 它夾到殘肢了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_EasyItSPinchingThe.cn: 轻一点 -- 它夹到残肢了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndDr.en: Hold the socket and draw it off to the right.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndDr.ch: 握住接受腔, 往右拉出來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndDr.cn: 握住接受腔, 往右拉出来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndSl.en: Hold the socket and slide it onto the stump.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndSl.ch: 握住接受腔, 把它套上殘肢.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_HoldTheSocketAndSl.cn: 握住接受腔, 把它套上残肢.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_SeatedNowTheBuckle.ch: 到位了. 接下來扣扣環.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_SeatedNowTheBuckle.cn: 到位了. 接下来扣扣环.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_SlideItOnUntilItSe.en: Slide it on until it seats, then click both buckles.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_SlideItOnUntilItSe.ch: 套到底卡住為止, 然後點選兩個扣環.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_SlideItOnUntilItSe.cn: 套到底卡住为止, 然后点击两个扣环.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ThenDrawTheSocketO.en: Then draw the socket off the stump, easily.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ThenDrawTheSocketO.ch: 然後輕輕把接受腔從殘肢上拉下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_ThenDrawTheSocketO.cn: 然后轻轻把接受腔从残肢上拉下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_UndoneDrawItOffThe.en: Undone. Draw it off the stump.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_UndoneDrawItOffThe.ch: 解開了. 把它從殘肢上拉下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Prosthetic_UndoneDrawItOffThe.cn: 解开了. 把它从残肢上拉下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_SelfHarm_YourHandShakesHarder.en: Your hand shakes harder every time.
IGUI_CU_MG_SelfHarm_YourHandShakesHarder.ch: 你的手每次都抖得更厲害.
IGUI_CU_MG_SelfHarm_YourHandShakesHarder.cn: 你的手每次都抖得更厉害.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_DrawEachStitchThroug.en: Draw each stitch through slowly. Going too fast will hurt.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_DrawEachStitchThroug.ch: 慢慢把每一針拉出來. 太快會很痛.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_DrawEachStitchThroug.cn: 慢慢把每一针拉出来. 太快会很痛.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_HoldStillThisPartSti.ch: 別動. 這步會有點刺痛.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_HoldStillThisPartSti.cn: 别动. 这步会有点刺痛.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_ItTwistedOutOfYourFi.en: It twisted out of your fingers.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_KeepItStraightYouReL.en: Keep it straight -- you're levering it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_KeepItStraightYouReL.ch: 保持筆直 -- 你在撬它.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_KeepItStraightYouReL.cn: 保持笔直 -- 你在撬它.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_LetSClearUpTheGlassS.en: Let's clear up the glass shards next time...
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_LetSClearUpTheGlassS.ch: 下次先把碎玻璃清乾淨吧…
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_LetSClearUpTheGlassS.cn: 下次先把碎玻璃清干净吧…

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_PullTheShrapnelOutSl.en: Pull the shrapnel out slowly. Going too fast will hurt.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_PullTheShrapnelOutSl.ch: 慢慢把碎片拉出來. 太快會很痛.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_PullTheShrapnelOutSl.cn: 慢慢把碎片拉出来. 太快会很痛.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingANeedleHolderWi.en: Using a needle holder will bypass the speed limit.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingANeedleHolderWi.ch: 使用持針器可以不受速度限制.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingANeedleHolderWi.cn: 使用持针钳可以不受速度限制.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingTweezersWillByp.en: Using tweezers will bypass the speed limit.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingTweezersWillByp.ch: 使用鑷子可以不受速度限制.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_UsingTweezersWillByp.cn: 使用镊子可以不受速度限制.

IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_YouToreTheStitchStra.en: You tore the stitch straight out.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_YouToreTheStitchStra.ch: 你把縫線直接扯出來了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Shrapnel_YouToreTheStitchStra.cn: 你把缝线直接扯出来了.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_CarefulTheBreakIsSt.en: Careful -- the break is still healing.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_CarefulTheBreakIsSt.ch: 小心 -- 骨折還在癒合.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_CarefulTheBreakIsSt.cn: 小心 -- 骨折还在愈合.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_EasyLiftItSlowly.ch: 輕一點. 慢慢抬起來.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_EasyLiftItSlowly.cn: 轻一点. 慢慢抬起来.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_LooseNowLiftTheBoar.en: Loose. Now lift the boards away.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_LooseNowLiftTheBoar.ch: 鬆開了. 現在把木板移開.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_LooseNowLiftTheBoar.cn: 松开了. 现在把木板移开.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeABoardAndEaseIt.en: Take a board and ease it away from the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeABoardAndEaseIt.ch: 拿一塊木板, 慢慢從肢體上移開.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeABoardAndEaseIt.cn: 拿一块木板, 慢慢从肢体上移开.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeAKnotAndTugItSi.en: Take a knot and tug it sideways.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeAKnotAndTugItSi.ch: 抓住一個結, 往側邊拉.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeAKnotAndTugItSi.cn: 抓住一个结, 往侧边拉.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeEachKnotAndTugI.en: Take each knot and tug it loose, sideways.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeEachKnotAndTugI.ch: 抓住每個結, 往側邊拉鬆.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_TakeEachKnotAndTugI.cn: 抓住每个结, 往侧边拉松.

IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_ThenTakeEachBoardAn.en: Then take each board and ease it away from the limb, slowly.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_ThenTakeEachBoardAn.ch: 然後拿起每塊木板, 慢慢從肢體上移開.
IGUI_CU_MG_SplintOff_ThenTakeEachBoardAn.cn: 然后拿起每块木板, 慢慢从肢体上移开.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickASnipMarkBesid.en: Click a snip mark beside a knot.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickASnipMarkBesid.ch: 點選線結旁的剪線標記.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickASnipMarkBesid.cn: 点击线结旁的剪线标记.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickTheSnipMarkBes.en: Click the snip mark beside each knot to cut the stitch.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickTheSnipMarkBes.ch: 點選每個線結旁的剪線標記來剪斷縫線.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ClickTheSnipMarkBes.cn: 点击每个线结旁的剪线标记来剪断缝线.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_GentlyItSTuggingAtT.en: Gently. It's tugging at the wound.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_GentlyItSTuggingAtT.ch: 輕一點. 它在拉扯傷口.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_GentlyItSTuggingAtT.cn: 轻一点. 它在拉扯伤口.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_HalfOfThemAreStillI.en: Half of them are still in.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnipOnTheMarkBeside.en: Snip on the mark beside a knot.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnipOnTheMarkBeside.ch: 從線結旁的標記處剪下.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnipOnTheMarkBeside.cn: 从线结旁的标记处剪下.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnippedNowDrawTheTh.en: Snipped. Now draw the thread out.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnippedNowDrawTheTh.ch: 剪斷了. 現在把線抽出來.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_SnippedNowDrawTheTh.cn: 剪断了. 现在把线抽出来.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_TakeTheSnippedKnotA.en: Take the snipped knot and draw it out.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_TakeTheSnippedKnotA.ch: 夾住剪斷的線結, 把它抽出來.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_TakeTheSnippedKnotA.cn: 夹住剪断的线结, 把它抽出来.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ThenTakeTheKnotWith.en: Then take the knot with the tweezers and draw the thread out, gently.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ThenTakeTheKnotWith.ch: 然後用鑷子夾住線結, 輕輕把線抽出來.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_ThenTakeTheKnotWith.cn: 然后用镊子夹住线结, 轻轻把线抽出来.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_UpAndAwayFromTheWou.en: Up and away from the wound.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_UpAndAwayFromTheWou.ch: 往上, 朝遠離傷口的方向.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_UpAndAwayFromTheWou.cn: 往上, 朝远离伤口的方向.

IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_YouNickedTheSkinSni.en: You nicked the skin. Snip right beside the knot.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_YouNickedTheSkinSni.ch: 你劃破了皮膚. 要緊貼著線結旁邊剪.
IGUI_CU_MG_StitchOut_YouNickedTheSkinSni.cn: 你划破了皮肤. 要紧贴着线结旁边剪.

IGUI_CU_MG_Stopped.ch: 已停止 - 什麼都沒做
IGUI_CU_MG_Stopped.cn: 已停止 - 什么都没做

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_AllTheWayThroughToTheL.en: All the way through to the lower mark.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_HoldStillThisPartSting.ch: 別動. 這步會有點刺痛.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_HoldStillThisPartSting.cn: 别动. 这步会有点刺痛.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ItRippedThroughTheSkin.en: It ripped through the skin. Put it in again.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ItRippedThroughTheSkin.ch: 針撕裂了皮膚. 重新刺入.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ItRippedThroughTheSkin.cn: 针撕裂了皮肤. 重新刺入.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_KeepUnderTheWoundYouRe.en: Keep under the wound -- you're tearing it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_KeepUnderTheWoundYouRe.ch: 保持在傷口下方, 你正在撕裂它.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_KeepUnderTheWoundYouRe.cn: 保持在伤口下方, 你正在撕裂它.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_PushTheNeedleInAtTheUp.en: Push the needle in at the upper mark, draw it under the wound to the lower one.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_PushTheNeedleInAtTheUp.ch: 從上方標記把針刺入, 從傷口底下穿到下方標記.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_PushTheNeedleInAtTheUp.cn: 从上方标记把针刺入, 从伤口底下穿到下方标记.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_SlowlyWithoutANeedleHo.en: Slowly, without a needle holder. Then pull the thread snug.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_SlowlyWithoutANeedleHo.ch: 沒有持針器, 要慢慢來. 然後把線拉緊.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_SlowlyWithoutANeedleHo.cn: 没有持针钳, 要慢慢来. 然后把线拉紧.

IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ThenPullTheThreadSnugN.en: Then pull the thread snug -- not too hard.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ThenPullTheThreadSnugN.ch: 然後把線拉緊, 別太用力.
IGUI_CU_MG_Suture_ThenPullTheThreadSnugN.cn: 然后把线拉紧, 别太用力.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_AlreadyInBlood.en: There is still %1 in you. Anything more lands on top of it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_AlreadyInBlood.ch: 你體內還有 %1. 再打任何劑量都會疊加上去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_AlreadyInBlood.cn: 你体内还有 %1. 再打任何剂量都会叠加上去.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_HoldItSteadyTheNeedle.en: Hold it steady -- the needle's in.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_HoldItSteadyTheNeedle.ch: 穩住, 針已經扎進去了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_HoldItSteadyTheNeedle.cn: 稳住, 针已经扎进去了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_NotEnoughYetPushItInA.en: Not enough yet -- push it in again.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_NotEnoughYetPushItInA.ch: 劑量還不夠, 再推一次.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_NotEnoughYetPushItInA.cn: 剂量还不够, 再推一次.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PastTheBandIsTheWhole.en: Past the band is the whole syringe. That is an overdose.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PastTheBandIsTheWhole.ch: 超過刻度帶就是整支注射器的量. 那會過量.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PastTheBandIsTheWhole.cn: 超过刻度带就是整支注射器的量. 那会过量.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PushSyringeDownToInje.en: Push syringe down to inject. Make sure to check the dosage.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PushSyringeDownToInje.ch: 往下推注射器進行注射. 務必確認劑量.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_PushSyringeDownToInje.cn: 往下推注射器进行注射. 务必确认剂量.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TooMuchYouPushedStrai.en: Too much -- you pushed straight past the dose.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TooMuchYouPushedStrai.ch: 太多了, 你直接推過了劑量.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TooMuchYouPushedStrai.cn: 太多了, 你直接推过了剂量.

IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TookTooLongTheNeedleI.en: Took too long. The needle is done for.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TookTooLongTheNeedleI.ch: 拖太久了. 這根針廢了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Syringe_TookTooLongTheNeedleI.cn: 拖太久了. 这根针废了.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickAndDragTheTou.en: Click and drag the tourniquet onto the marked band.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickAndDragTheTou.ch: 點選並拖曳止血帶到標記區域上.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickAndDragTheTou.cn: 点击并将止血带拖到标记区域上.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickTheClipToLock.en: Click the clip to lock it.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickTheClipToRele.en: Click the clip to release it.
Click the clip to release it, then turn the rod back, slowly.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickTheClipToRele.ch: 點選扣環將它鬆開, 然後慢慢把絞棒轉回去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ClickTheClipToRele.cn: 点击卡扣将其松开, 然后慢慢把绞棒转回去.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_DragTheTourniquetO.en: Drag the tourniquet onto the marked band, above the wound.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_DragTheTourniquetO.ch: 將止血帶拖到傷口上方的標示區.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_DragTheTourniquetO.cn: 将止血带拖到伤口上方的标示区.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_NotOnTheWoundOrBel.en: Not on the wound or below it. Above it -- between it and the heart.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_NotOnTheWoundOrBel.ch: 不是綁在傷口上或傷口下方. 要在上方, 介於傷口與心臟之間.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_NotOnTheWoundOrBel.cn: 不是绑在伤口上或伤口下方. 要在上方, 介于伤口与心脏之间.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnIfNotLockedWell.ch: 綁上了, 只是沒鎖好.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnIfNotLockedWell.cn: 绑上了, 只是没锁好.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnNowTakeTheRodAnd.en: On. Now take the rod and turn it.
