IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnNowTakeTheRodAnd.ch: 綁好了. 現在握住絞棒轉動它.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnNowTakeTheRodAnd.cn: 绑好了. 现在握住绞棒转动它.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnTheMarkedBandAcr.en: On the marked band, across the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnTheMarkedBandAcr.ch: 放在標記區域上, 橫跨肢體.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_OnTheMarkedBandAcr.cn: 放在标记区域上, 横跨肢体.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ReleasedNowTurnThe.en: Released. Now turn the rod back, slowly.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ReleasedNowTurnThe.ch: 已鬆開. 現在慢慢把絞棒轉回去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ReleasedNowTurnThe.cn: 已松开. 现在慢慢把绞棒转回去.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlackSlideItOffThe.en: Slack. Slide it off the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlackSlideItOffThe.ch: 鬆了. 把它從肢體上滑下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlackSlideItOffThe.cn: 松了. 把它从肢体上滑下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlowlyTheBloodIsRu.en: Slowly -- the blood is rushing back.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlowlyTheBloodIsRu.ch: 慢一點, 血液正在回流.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_SlowlyTheBloodIsRu.cn: 慢一点, 血液正在回流.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TakeTheRodAndTurnI.en: Take the rod and turn it round.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TakeTheStrapAndDra.en: Take the strap and drag it off the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TakeTheStrapAndDra.ch: 抓住綁帶, 把它從肢體上拉下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TakeTheStrapAndDra.cn: 抓住绑带, 把它从肢体上拉下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ThatSItLetGoAndCli.en: That's it. Let go and click the clip.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ThatSItLetGoAndCli.ch: 就是這樣. 放手後點選扣環.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_ThatSItLetGoAndCli.cn: 就是这样. 松手后点击卡扣.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TooTightItSCrushin.en: Too tight. It's crushing the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TooTightItSCrushin.ch: 太緊了. 它正在壓壞肢體.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TooTightItSCrushin.cn: 太紧了. 它正在压坏肢体.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodBackTheO.en: Turn the rod back the other way, slowly.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodBackTheO.ch: 把絞棒往反方向慢慢轉回去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodBackTheO.cn: 把绞棒往反方向慢慢转回去.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodUntilThe.en: Turn the rod until the gauge is in the green, then click the clip.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodUntilThe.ch: 轉動絞棒直到量表進入綠色區域, 然後點選扣環.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_TurnTheRodUntilThe.cn: 转动绞棒直到量表进入绿色区域, 然后点击卡扣.

IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_WhenItIsSlackDragT.en: When it is slack, drag the strap off the limb.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_WhenItIsSlackDragT.ch: 等它鬆了, 再把綁帶從肢體上拉下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Tourniquet_WhenItIsSlackDragT.cn: 等它松了, 再把绑带从肢体上拉下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_AnyShapeWillDoKeepGoin.en: Any shape will do. Keep going until it is all off.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_AnyShapeWillDoKeepGoin.ch: 怎麼繞都行. 一直拆到全部拆下來為止.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_AnyShapeWillDoKeepGoin.cn: 怎么绕都行. 一直拆到全部拆下来为止.

IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_GrabTheLooseEndAndUnwi.en: Grab the loose end and unwind it round the limb, the other way.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_GrabTheLooseEndAndUnwi.ch: 抓住鬆脫的一端, 沿著肢體反方向繞開.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_GrabTheLooseEndAndUnwi.cn: 抓住松脱的一端, 沿着肢体反方向绕开.

IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_GrabTheLooseEndOfTheDr.en: Grab the loose end of the dressing.

IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_ItSStuckToTheWoundEase.en: It's stuck to the wound. Ease it off.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_ItSStuckToTheWoundEase.ch: 它黏在傷口上了. 慢慢撕下來.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_ItSStuckToTheWoundEase.cn: 它粘在伤口上了. 慢慢撕下来.

IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_TheLastTurnIsStuckToTh.en: The last turn is stuck to the wound (dark red). Go slowly over it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_TheLastTurnIsStuckToTh.ch: 最後一圈黏在傷口上 (暗紅色). 慢慢拆過去.
IGUI_CU_MG_Unwrap_TheLastTurnIsStuckToTh.cn: 最后一圈粘在伤口上 (暗红色). 慢慢拆过去.

IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_1_Desc.en: Nothing hurts. Everything is a long way off.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_1_Desc.ch: 什麼都不痛了. 一切都離得好遠.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_1_Desc.cn: 什么都不痛了. 一切都离得好远.

IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_2_Desc.en: Your feet are somewhere below you. It's fine.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_2_Desc.ch: 你的腳在下面某個地方. 沒關係.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_2_Desc.cn: 你的脚在下面某个地方. 没关系.

IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_3_Desc.en: You have never felt better. None of it matters any more.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_3_Desc.ch: 你從沒感覺這麼好過. 一切都不重要了.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_3_Desc.cn: 你从没感觉这么好过. 一切都不重要了.

IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_4_Desc.en: You are barely here, and there is nowhere better to be.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_4_Desc.ch: 你幾乎不在這裡了, 而這裡就是最好的地方.
IGUI_CU_Moodle_High_4_Desc.cn: 你几乎不在这里了, 而这里就是最好的地方.

IGUI_CU_Moodle_Miserable_Desc.en: How does it feel knowing everyone is dead and there's no hope for you...?
IGUI_CU_Moodle_Miserable_Desc.ch: 知道所有人都死了, 你也毫無希望, 是什麼感覺…?
IGUI_CU_Moodle_Miserable_Desc.cn: 知道所有人都死了, 你也毫无希望, 是什么感觉…?

IGUI_CU_Note_Hypoxic.en: Not enough oxygen reaching the brain.

IGUI_CU_Note_Rhythm.en: The heart is out of rhythm.

IGUI_CU_Note_Shock.en: Pressure too low. This is shock.
IGUI_CU_Note_Shock.ch: 血壓過低. 這是休克.
IGUI_CU_Note_Shock.cn: 血压过低. 这是休克.

IGUI_CU_Note_Thin.en: Thin blood. Wounds will not close.
IGUI_CU_Note_Thin.ch: 血液太稀. 傷口無法閉合.
IGUI_CU_Note_Thin.cn: 血液太稀. 伤口无法闭合.

IGUI_CU_Options_Censor.ch: 隱藏「痛苦不堪」發作的敏感內容
IGUI_CU_Options_Censor.cn: 屏蔽“痛苦不堪”发作的敏感内容

IGUI_CU_Options_Censor_Tooltip.en: Low-mood episodes without self-harm or suicide: the character vomits instead, and when Miserable has a fibrillation attack first.
IGUI_CU_Options_Censor_Tooltip.ch: 低落情緒發作時不出現自殘或自殺: 角色改為嘔吐, 處於「痛苦不堪」狀態時則會先發生一次纖顫發作.
IGUI_CU_Options_Censor_Tooltip.cn: 低落情绪发作时不出现自残或自杀: 角色改为呕吐, 处于“痛苦不堪”状态时则会先发生一次纤颤发作.

IGUI_CU_Options_Moodles.ch: 顯示 Casualties Undead 的狀態圖示
IGUI_CU_Options_Moodles.cn: 显示 Casualties Undead 的状态图标

IGUI_CU_Options_Moodles_Tooltip.en: Hide this mod's moodles without disabling its medical conditions.
IGUI_CU_Options_Moodles_Tooltip.ch: 隱藏本模組的狀態圖示, 但不停用其醫療狀況.
IGUI_CU_Options_Moodles_Tooltip.cn: 隐藏本模组的状态图标, 但不禁用其医疗状况.

IGUI_CU_Options_Ring_Tooltip.en: The sound that builds as a character comes apart. Off by default - it is a symptom, not a warning, and nobody should have to listen to one they did not ask for.
IGUI_CU_Options_Ring_Tooltip.ch: 角色逐漸崩潰時越來越響的聲音. 預設關閉 - 這是症狀而非警告, 沒有人該被迫聽自己沒要求的聲音.
IGUI_CU_Options_Ring_Tooltip.cn: 角色逐渐崩溃时越来越响的声音. 默认关闭 - 这是症状而非警告, 没有人该被迫听自己没要求的声音.

IGUI_CU_Options_Vision.ch: 脫水與失血造成的視線模糊
IGUI_CU_Options_Vision.cn: 脱水与失血造成的视线模糊

IGUI_CU_Options_Vision_Tooltip.en: Use the game's focus blur when severely dehydrated or low on blood.
IGUI_CU_Options_Vision_Tooltip.ch: 嚴重脫水或失血過多時, 使用遊戲的對焦模糊效果.
IGUI_CU_Options_Vision_Tooltip.cn: 严重脱水或失血过多时, 使用游戏的对焦模糊效果.

IGUI_CU_Rag_DoneRough.ch: 綁上了. 勉強撐得住.
IGUI_CU_Rag_DoneRough.cn: 绑上了. 勉强撑得住.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Fold1.en: Fold the right edge across onto the left.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Fold2.en: Now fold the top edge down onto the bottom.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Fold2.ch: 現在把上邊往下摺到底邊.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Fold2.cn: 现在把上边往下折到底边.

IGUI_CU_Rag_FoldSub.en: Drag the edge all the way over.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Loose.ch: 綁得太鬆. 幾乎撐不住.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Loose.cn: 绑得太松. 几乎撑不住.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Press.en: Press the pad onto the wound and hold it there.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Press.ch: 把墊布壓在傷口上並按住.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Press.cn: 把垫布压在伤口上并按住.

IGUI_CU_Rag_PressSub.en: Keep still until the ring fills.
IGUI_CU_Rag_PressSub.ch: 保持不動, 直到圓環填滿.
IGUI_CU_Rag_PressSub.cn: 保持不动, 直到圆环填满.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Stemmed.en: The bleeding's easing. Tie it on.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Stemmed.ch: 出血減緩了. 把它綁上.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Stemmed.cn: 出血减缓了. 把它绑上.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Tie1.en: Take the left end over the pad.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Tie2.en: Now the right end back over.

IGUI_CU_Rag_Tight.ch: 太用力了 - 勒進肉裡了.
IGUI_CU_Rag_Tight.cn: 太用力了 - 勒进肉里了.

IGUI_CU_SeeToDo.en: To-do list: how to fix these
IGUI_CU_SeeToDo.ch: 待辦清單: 如何處理這些問題
IGUI_CU_SeeToDo.cn: 待办清单: 如何处理这些问题

IGUI_CU_Terms_HowToLearn.en: Its name, what it does and how it is fixed come from knowing the term: read a First Aid book or a medical journal, practise First Aid, or dissect a body.
IGUI_CU_Terms_HowToLearn.ch: 要知道它的名稱, 作用與處理方式, 得先認識這個術語: 閱讀急救書籍或醫學期刊, 練習急救, 或解剖屍體.
IGUI_CU_Terms_HowToLearn.cn: 要知道它的名称, 作用与处理方式, 得先认识这个术语: 阅读急救书籍或医学期刊, 练习急救, 或解剖尸体.

IGUI_CU_Terms_Unknown.en: YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT THIS IS

IGUI_CU_Why_acute_kidney_injury.en: The kidneys have stopped clearing anything.
IGUI_CU_Why_acute_kidney_injury.ch: 腎臟已經無法排除任何東西.
IGUI_CU_Why_acute_kidney_injury.cn: 肾脏已经无法排出任何东西.

IGUI_CU_Why_aspiration.en: There is vomit in the lungs. Clear the airway.
IGUI_CU_Why_aspiration.ch: 肺裡有嘔吐物. 清理呼吸道.
IGUI_CU_Why_aspiration.cn: 肺里有呕吐物. 清理气道.

IGUI_CU_Why_compartment_syndrome.en: The limb is swelling inside its own sheath.
IGUI_CU_Why_compartment_syndrome.ch: 肢體在自身的筋膜內腫脹.
IGUI_CU_Why_compartment_syndrome.cn: 肢体在自身的筋膜内肿胀.

IGUI_CU_Why_concussion.en: The head is not right. Rest it.
IGUI_CU_Why_concussion.ch: 頭部不太對勁. 好好休息.
IGUI_CU_Why_concussion.cn: 头部不太对劲. 好好休息.

IGUI_CU_Why_deep_vein_thrombosis.en: A clot in a leg that has not moved.
IGUI_CU_Why_deep_vein_thrombosis.ch: 久未活動的腿裡形成了血栓.
IGUI_CU_Why_deep_vein_thrombosis.cn: 久未活动的腿里形成了血栓.

IGUI_CU_Why_dehydration.en: The blood is too thick to move and too thin to clot.
IGUI_CU_Why_dehydration.ch: 血液濃稠得流不動, 卻又稀得無法凝結.
IGUI_CU_Why_dehydration.cn: 血液浓稠得流不动, 却又稀得无法凝结.

IGUI_CU_Why_haemorrhagic_shock.en: Not enough blood left to pump. Volume, now.
IGUI_CU_Why_haemorrhagic_shock.ch: 剩下的血不夠心臟泵送. 立刻補充血容量.
IGUI_CU_Why_haemorrhagic_shock.cn: 剩下的血不够心脏泵送. 立刻补充血容量.

IGUI_CU_Why_hypoglycaemia.en: Nothing left to burn. The hands are going.
IGUI_CU_Why_hypoglycaemia.ch: 身體已沒有能燃燒的了. 雙手開始不聽使喚.
IGUI_CU_Why_hypoglycaemia.cn: 身体已没有能燃烧的了. 双手开始不听使唤.

IGUI_CU_Why_hypothermia.en: Cold enough that the heart is getting irritable.
IGUI_CU_Why_hypothermia.ch: 冷到心臟開始躁動不安.
IGUI_CU_Why_hypothermia.cn: 冷到心脏开始躁动不安.

IGUI_CU_Why_intracranial_bleed.en: Bleeding inside the skull, with nowhere to go.
IGUI_CU_Why_intracranial_bleed.ch: 顱內出血, 血液無處可去.
IGUI_CU_Why_intracranial_bleed.cn: 颅内出血, 血液无处可去.

IGUI_CU_Why_necrosis.en: The tissue is dead and rotting on them.
IGUI_CU_Why_necrosis.ch: 組織已經壞死, 正在腐爛.
IGUI_CU_Why_necrosis.cn: 组织已经坏死, 正在腐烂.

IGUI_CU_Why_pneumonia.ch: 肺部正在積液. 需要抗生素.
IGUI_CU_Why_pneumonia.cn: 肺部正在积液. 需要抗生素.

IGUI_CU_Why_pneumothorax.en: Air in the chest, crushing the lung. This one is now.
IGUI_CU_Why_pneumothorax.ch: 胸腔內有空氣, 正在壓迫肺部. 必須立刻處理.
IGUI_CU_Why_pneumothorax.cn: 胸腔内有空气, 正在压迫肺部. 必须立刻处理.

IGUI_CU_Why_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia.en: Blood loss is weakening your hands and oxygen delivery. Control bleeding, eat and rest.
IGUI_CU_Why_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia.ch: 失血使你的雙手無力, 輸氧能力下降. 止血, 進食並休息.
IGUI_CU_Why_posthaemorrhagic_anaemia.cn: 失血使你的双手无力, 输氧能力下降. 止血, 进食并休息.

IGUI_CU_Why_pressure_injury.en: Tourniquet pressure is injuring the limb. Dress the wound and remove the tourniquet.
IGUI_CU_Why_pressure_injury.ch: 止血帶的壓力正在傷害肢體. 包紮傷口並取下止血帶.
IGUI_CU_Why_pressure_injury.cn: 止血带的压力正在伤害肢体. 包扎伤口并取下止血带.

IGUI_CU_Why_ptsd.en: What they saw keeps coming back. It does not go away; medicine softens it.
IGUI_CU_Why_ptsd.ch: 看過的景象不斷重現. 它不會消失, 藥物能減輕它.
IGUI_CU_Why_ptsd.cn: 看过的景象不断重现. 它不会消失, 药物能减轻它.

IGUI_CU_Why_pulmonary_embolism.en: The clot has gone to the lungs.

IGUI_CU_Why_pulmonary_oedema.en: The heart is backing up into the lungs.
IGUI_CU_Why_pulmonary_oedema.ch: 心臟的血液回堵到肺部.
IGUI_CU_Why_pulmonary_oedema.cn: 心脏的血液淤积到肺部.

IGUI_CU_Why_rib_fracture.en: Every breath grinds. Strap the chest.
IGUI_CU_Why_rib_fracture.ch: 每次呼吸都在摩擦作痛. 固定胸部.
IGUI_CU_Why_rib_fracture.cn: 每次呼吸都在摩擦作痛. 固定胸部.

IGUI_CU_Why_sepsis.en: The infection is in the blood.

IGUI_CU_Why_septic_shock.en: Everything is shutting down at once.

IGUI_CU_Why_tetanus.en: The muscles are locking. It started in a dirty wound.
IGUI_CU_Why_tetanus.ch: 肌肉正在僵直. 起因是骯髒的傷口.
IGUI_CU_Why_tetanus.cn: 肌肉正在僵直. 起因是肮脏的伤口.

IGUI_PhunZones_ALife_tooltip.en: Requires the Project A-Life NPCs mod. Block Spawns stops A-Life NPCs spawning in this zone; any that walk in, such as friendly ones, are left alone. A-Life NPCs are never moved or removed by the Zeds setting
IGUI_PhunZones_ALife_tooltip.ch: 需要 Project A-Life NPCs 模組. 「阻止生成」會讓 A-Life NPC 不在此區域生成; 自行走進來的 NPC (例如友善的 NPC) 則不受影響. 「殭屍」設定永遠不會移出或移除 A-Life NPC
IGUI_PhunZones_ALife_tooltip.cn: 需要 Project A-Life NPCs 模组. “阻止生成”会阻止 A-Life NPC 在此区域生成; 自行走进来的 NPC (例如友好的 NPC) 则不受影响. “僵尸”设置永远不会移出或移除 A-Life NPC

IGUI_PhunZones_MapBorder_tooltip.en: Colour of this zone's outline on the player's map and minimap, e.g. #FF8000 or 255,128,0. Leave empty for no outline
IGUI_PhunZones_MapBorder_tooltip.ch: 此區域在玩家地圖與小地圖上的外框顏色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空則不顯示外框
IGUI_PhunZones_MapBorder_tooltip.cn: 此区域在玩家地图和小地图上的轮廓颜色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空则不显示轮廓

IGUI_PhunZones_MapFill_tooltip.en: Colour this zone is shaded with on the player's map and minimap, e.g. #FF8000 or 255,128,0. Leave empty for no shading
IGUI_PhunZones_MapFill_tooltip.ch: 此區域在玩家地圖與小地圖上的填充顏色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空則不填色
IGUI_PhunZones_MapFill_tooltip.cn: 此区域在玩家地图和小地图上的填充颜色, 例如 #FF8000 或 255,128,0. 留空则不填充

IGUI_PhunZones_MapOpacity_tooltip.en: How opaque the map fill is, from 0 (invisible) to 100 (solid). Defaults to 30 when a fill colour is set
IGUI_PhunZones_MapOpacity_tooltip.ch: 地圖填色的不透明程度, 從 0 (完全透明) 到 100 (完全不透明). 設定填充顏色時預設為 30
IGUI_PhunZones_MapOpacity_tooltip.cn: 地图填充的不透明程度, 从 0 (完全透明) 到 100 (完全不透明). 设置填充颜色时默认为 30

IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_MoveSpawn.ch: 生成時移出 (允許遊蕩進入)
IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_MoveSpawn.cn: 生成时移出 (允许游荡进入)

IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_RemoveSpawn.ch: 生成時移除 (允許遊蕩進入)
IGUI_PhunZones_ZedAction_RemoveSpawn.cn: 生成时移除 (允许游荡进入)

IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_LocationsHint.en: Manage saved marks. Equip this grimoire and set Recall active to travel.
IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_LocationsHint.ch: 管理已儲存的標記. 裝備這本魔法書並將「召回」設為啟用即可傳送.
IGUI_DeadMagic_Review_LocationsHint.cn: 管理已保存的标记. 装备这本魔法书并将“召回”设为激活即可传送.

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Destructible.en: Whether players can destroy this shop's machines with a sledgehammer. Server default follows the sandbox option. Admins can always destroy them
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Destructible.ch: 玩家能否用大鎚破壞此商店的機台. 伺服器預設值依照沙盒選項. 管理員一律可以破壞
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Destructible.cn: 玩家能否用大锤破坏此商店的机器. 服务器默认值遵循沙盒选项. 管理员始终可以破坏

IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Moveable.en: Whether players can pick up this shop's machines and place them elsewhere. Server default follows the sandbox option. Admins can always move them
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Moveable.ch: 玩家能否拾起此商店的機台並放到其他地方. 伺服器預設值依照沙盒選項. 管理員一律可以移動
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Moveable.cn: 玩家能否拿起此商店的机器并放到其他地方. 服务器默认值遵循沙盒选项. 管理员始终可以移动

IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_NoItemForShop.en: %1 has no machine item, so it cannot be installed by hand
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_NoItemForShop.ch: %1 沒有機台物品, 因此無法手動安裝
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_NoItemForShop.cn: %1 没有机器物品, 因此无法手动安装

IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_ShopDisabled.en: %1 is disabled. Enable it before placing one
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_ShopDisabled.ch: %1 已停用. 請先啟用再放置
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_ShopDisabled.cn: %1 已禁用. 请先启用再放置

IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_SpawnedShopItem.en: %1 added to your inventory. Right-click it to install
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_SpawnedShopItem.ch: %1 已加入你的物品欄. 對它按右鍵即可安裝
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_SpawnedShopItem.cn: %1 已添加到你的物品栏. 右键点击它即可安装

IGUI_RNPC_06a04b96.en: You don't have any recruits yet.

IGUI_RNPC_0784bfc5.en: Armed locals. They patrol the back roads and set up checkpoints.
IGUI_RNPC_0784bfc5.ch: 武裝的當地人. 他們在鄉間小路巡邏, 還設了檢查哨.
IGUI_RNPC_0784bfc5.cn: 武装的当地人. 他们在乡间小路巡逻, 还设了检查站.

IGUI_RNPC_1471b212.en: Regular people trying to get by. They scavenge, board up and trade.
IGUI_RNPC_1471b212.ch: 努力活下去的普通人. 他們搜刮物資、封堵門窗, 也做交易.
IGUI_RNPC_1471b212.cn: 努力活下去的普通人. 他们搜刮物资、封堵门窗, 也做交易.

IGUI_RNPC_15fa3ccb.en: On their own. They camp out, scavenge and keep to themselves.
IGUI_RNPC_15fa3ccb.ch: 獨來獨往. 他們在野外紮營、搜刮物資, 不跟別人打交道.
IGUI_RNPC_15fa3ccb.cn: 独来独往. 他们在野外扎营、搜刮物资, 不跟别人打交道.

IGUI_RNPC_172f270d.en: No jobs yet. Ask a faction for work.
IGUI_RNPC_172f270d.ch: 還沒有任何委託. 去找派系要工作吧.
IGUI_RNPC_172f270d.cn: 还没有任何委托. 去找派系要活儿干吧.

IGUI_RNPC_1cedd073.en: Hostile. They hold a base and rob whoever they can.
IGUI_RNPC_1cedd073.ch: 敵對. 他們佔據一處據點, 能搶誰就搶誰.
IGUI_RNPC_1cedd073.cn: 敌对. 他们占据一处据点, 能抢谁就抢谁.

IGUI_RNPC_33097578.en: Not yet. We need to know you better first.
IGUI_RNPC_33097578.ch: 還不行. 我們得先多了解你一點.
IGUI_RNPC_33097578.cn: 还不行. 我们得先多了解你一点.

IGUI_RNPC_37dbf6d9.en: Their base got raided a day or two ago.
IGUI_RNPC_37dbf6d9.ch: 他們的據點一兩天前被襲擊了.
IGUI_RNPC_37dbf6d9.cn: 他们的据点一两天前被袭击了.

IGUI_RNPC_3cceb325.en: Then swear to it, and you are one of us. We look after our own.
IGUI_RNPC_3cceb325.ch: 那就發誓吧, 你就是我們的一份子了. 我們會照顧自己人.
IGUI_RNPC_3cceb325.cn: 那就发誓吧, 你就是我们的一员了. 我们会照顾自己人.

IGUI_RNPC_4045b1ef.en: Go in peace. You cannot come back for a while.
IGUI_RNPC_4045b1ef.ch: 平安地走吧. 你暫時不能回來.
IGUI_RNPC_4045b1ef.cn: 平安地走吧. 你暂时不能回来.

IGUI_RNPC_4ff2d227.en: Just back from a raid on %1.

IGUI_RNPC_549fdec8.en: One of our own turned on us %1. We threw them out.
IGUI_RNPC_549fdec8.ch: %1 我們自己人背叛了我們. 我們把那人趕出去了.
IGUI_RNPC_549fdec8.cn: %1 我们自己人背叛了我们. 我们把那人赶出去了.

IGUI_RNPC_5656a0de.en: A cult out in the country. They think the world was judged.
IGUI_RNPC_5656a0de.ch: 鄉下的一個邪教. 他們認為世界已經受了審判.
IGUI_RNPC_5656a0de.cn: 乡下的一个邪教. 他们认为世界已经受到了审判.

IGUI_RNPC_5984de80.en: You left us. It is too soon to come back.
IGUI_RNPC_5984de80.ch: 你離開了我們. 現在回來還太早.
IGUI_RNPC_5984de80.cn: 你离开了我们. 现在回来还太早.

IGUI_RNPC_6282ff8f.en: Well armed soldiers. They clear buildings and set up checkpoints.
IGUI_RNPC_6282ff8f.ch: 武裝精良的士兵. 他們清理建築, 還設了檢查哨.
IGUI_RNPC_6282ff8f.cn: 武装精良的士兵. 他们清理建筑, 还设了检查站.

IGUI_RNPC_65ba6f5d.en: The %1 need %2. Take these to any of their people. Do not sell them.
IGUI_RNPC_65ba6f5d.ch: %1 需要 %2. 把這些交給他們任何一個人. 不准賣掉.
IGUI_RNPC_65ba6f5d.cn: %1 需要 %2. 把这些交给他们任何一个人. 不许卖掉.

IGUI_RNPC_66259fb7.en: That order is switched off on this server.
IGUI_RNPC_66259fb7.ch: 此伺服器已停用這項命令.
IGUI_RNPC_66259fb7.cn: 此服务器已禁用这项命令.

IGUI_RNPC_69a87f65.en: You kept your word. Here is your pay.
IGUI_RNPC_69a87f65.ch: 你信守了承諾. 這是你的報酬.
IGUI_RNPC_69a87f65.cn: 你信守了承诺. 这是你的报酬.

IGUI_RNPC_7e175935.en: Our people keep dying near %1. Go and look, then come back and tell us what you saw.
IGUI_RNPC_7e175935.ch: 我們的人一直在 %1 附近送命. 去看看, 然後回來告訴我們你看到了什麼.
IGUI_RNPC_7e175935.cn: 我们的人一直在 %1 附近送命. 去看看, 然后回来告诉我们你看到了什么.

IGUI_RNPC_7e7f3ef7.en: There's a big group of the dead near %1. Put down %2 of them and come back.
IGUI_RNPC_7e7f3ef7.ch: %1 附近有一大群死人. 解決掉其中 %2 隻再回來.
IGUI_RNPC_7e7f3ef7.cn: %1 附近有一大群死人. 干掉其中 %2 只再回来.

IGUI_RNPC_8cc76863.en: Welcome. We look after our own.
IGUI_RNPC_8cc76863.ch: 歡迎. 我們會照顧自己人.
IGUI_RNPC_8cc76863.cn: 欢迎. 我们会照顾自己人.

IGUI_RNPC_903c284b.en: Hungry. Their group is low on food.
IGUI_RNPC_903c284b.ch: 餓著肚子. 他們的團體糧食不足.
IGUI_RNPC_903c284b.cn: 饿着肚子. 他们的团体粮食不足.

IGUI_RNPC_9085f622.ch: 被咬了. 看起來病了.
IGUI_RNPC_9085f622.cn: 被咬了. 看起来病了.

IGUI_RNPC_a7bccf3c.en: The dead are gathering near %1. Put down %2 of them, then come back to us.
IGUI_RNPC_a7bccf3c.ch: 死者正在 %1 附近聚集. 解決其中 %2 個, 然後回來找我們.
IGUI_RNPC_a7bccf3c.cn: 死者正在 %1 附近聚集. 解决其中 %2 个, 然后回来找我们.

IGUI_RNPC_ae8a1357.en: They set ambushes where the traffic is and make you pay to pass.
IGUI_RNPC_ae8a1357.ch: 他們在人來人往的地方設埋伏, 要你付錢才放行.
IGUI_RNPC_ae8a1357.cn: 他们在人来人往的地方设埋伏, 要你付钱才能通过.

IGUI_RNPC_b07eac92.en: That's theirs. Thank you. Here's your pay.
IGUI_RNPC_b07eac92.ch: 這是那人的東西. 謝謝你. 這是你的報酬.
IGUI_RNPC_b07eac92.cn: 这是那人的东西. 谢谢你. 这是你的报酬.

IGUI_RNPC_b4636fd8.en: From the %1? Thank you. Tell them we are grateful.
IGUI_RNPC_b4636fd8.ch: %1 送來的? 謝謝你. 替我們轉達感謝.
IGUI_RNPC_b4636fd8.cn: %1 送来的? 谢谢你. 替我们转达感谢.

IGUI_RNPC_b92a2ad4.en: What's left of the county police. They patrol and run checkpoints.
IGUI_RNPC_b92a2ad4.ch: 縣警察的殘部. 他們負責巡邏, 也管檢查哨.
IGUI_RNPC_b92a2ad4.cn: 县警察的残部. 他们负责巡逻, 也管检查站.

IGUI_RNPC_c5189dac.en: You are one of us, and we trust you.
IGUI_RNPC_c5189dac.ch: 你是我們的一份子, 我們信任你.
IGUI_RNPC_c5189dac.cn: 你是我们的一员, 我们信任你.

IGUI_RNPC_cd3d2441.en: You brought it back to us. Bless you.
IGUI_RNPC_cd3d2441.ch: 你把它帶回來給我們了. 願主保佑你.
IGUI_RNPC_cd3d2441.cn: 你把它带回来给我们了. 愿主保佑你.

IGUI_RNPC_d83c7f70.en: They loot the towns and trade what they find, mostly tools and parts.
IGUI_RNPC_d83c7f70.ch: 他們搜刮城鎮, 拿找到的東西去交易, 大多是工具和零件.
IGUI_RNPC_d83c7f70.cn: 他们搜刮城镇, 拿找到的东西去交易, 大多是工具和零件.

IGUI_RNPC_d8d8ace1.en: The %1 are short on %2. Take these to any of their people, and don't sell them.
IGUI_RNPC_d8d8ace1.ch: %1 缺 %2. 把這些交給他們任何一個人, 別拿去賣.
IGUI_RNPC_d8d8ace1.cn: %1 缺 %2. 把这些交给他们任何一个人, 别拿去卖.

IGUI_RNPC_da3ed49a.en: %1 died out near %2. Their %3 should still be on the body. Bring it back to us.
IGUI_RNPC_da3ed49a.ch: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 應該還在屍體上. 把它帶回來給我們.
IGUI_RNPC_da3ed49a.cn: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 应该还在尸体上. 把它带回来给我们.

IGUI_RNPC_dcb1e8c7.en: %1 died near %2. Their %3 is still with the body. Please bring it back to us.
IGUI_RNPC_dcb1e8c7.ch: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 還在遺體身邊. 請把它帶回來給我們.
IGUI_RNPC_dcb1e8c7.cn: %1 死在 %2 附近. 那人的 %3 还在遗体身边. 请把它带回来给我们.

IGUI_RNPC_e3173147.en: Farmers out in the country. They grow food and patrol the back roads.
IGUI_RNPC_e3173147.ch: 鄉下的農夫. 他們種糧食, 也在鄉間小路巡邏.
IGUI_RNPC_e3173147.cn: 乡下的农民. 他们种粮食, 也在乡间小路巡逻.

IGUI_RNPC_e8cdf1ab.en: Doctors and nurses. They treat people and are always low on medicine.
IGUI_RNPC_e8cdf1ab.ch: 醫生和護士. 他們替人治療, 藥品總是不夠用.
IGUI_RNPC_e8cdf1ab.cn: 医生和护士. 他们给人治病, 药品总是不够用.

IGUI_RNPC_ef28e8f3.en: The %1 sold us out %2. We don't trust them anymore.
IGUI_RNPC_ef28e8f3.ch: %1 %2 出賣了我們. 我們不再信任他們了.
IGUI_RNPC_ef28e8f3.cn: %1 %2 出卖了我们. 我们不再信任他们了.

IGUI_RNPC_f1f307ae.en: Fine. Go on, then. Don't come back for a while.
IGUI_RNPC_f1f307ae.ch: 好. 那就走吧. 這陣子別回來.
IGUI_RNPC_f1f307ae.cn: 好. 那就走吧. 这阵子别回来.

IGUI_RNPC_f5693aa4.en: %1 of the %2 led the raid on us. Find them and kill them.
IGUI_RNPC_f5693aa4.ch: %2 的 %1 帶頭襲擊了我們. 找到那傢伙, 殺了他.
IGUI_RNPC_f5693aa4.cn: %2 的 %1 带头袭击了我们. 找到那家伙, 杀了他.

IGUI_RNPC_f7d3e48c.en: You're one of them, and they trust you.
IGUI_RNPC_f7d3e48c.ch: 你是他們的一份子, 他們信任你.
IGUI_RNPC_f7d3e48c.cn: 你是他们的一员, 他们信任你.

IGUI_RNPC_f7edca19.en: %1 of the %2 led the raid on us. We want them dead. Find them.
IGUI_RNPC_f7edca19.ch: %2 的 %1 帶頭襲擊了我們. 我們要那傢伙的命. 把人找出來.
IGUI_RNPC_f7edca19.cn: %2 的 %1 带头袭击了我们. 我们要那家伙的命. 把人找出来.

IGUI_RNPC_ff3998e6.en: Firefighters still working out of their station. They help people out.
IGUI_RNPC_ff3998e6.ch: 仍以消防隊為據點工作的消防員. 他們會幫人一把.
IGUI_RNPC_ff3998e6.cn: 仍以消防站为据点工作的消防员. 他们会帮人一把.

IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceApplyTabTip.en: Save only the active tab and close Setup. Unsaved changes in the other tab are discarded; Cancel discards both drafts.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceApplyTabTip.ch: 只儲存目前分頁並關閉設定. 另一個分頁中未儲存的變更會被捨棄; 按「取消」則會捨棄兩份草稿.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceApplyTabTip.cn: 仅保存当前标签页并关闭设置. 另一个标签页中未保存的更改将被丢弃; 点击“取消”则会丢弃两份草稿.

IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceCopyTip.en: Copy appearance only. Uses a separate clipboard from rules.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceCopyTip.ch: 只複製外觀. 與規則使用不同的剪貼簿.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceCopyTip.cn: 仅复制外观. 与规则使用不同的剪贴板.

IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceInvalid.en: Invalid appearance. Check the name, color and item badge.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceInvalid.ch: 外觀無效. 請檢查名稱、顏色與物品徽章.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceInvalid.cn: 外观无效. 请检查名称、颜色和物品徽章.

IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceMixed.ch: 選取的容器外觀不一致.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceMixed.cn: 选中的容器外观不一致.

IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceNameTip.en: Display name, up to 28 characters. Empty restores the original name.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceNameTip.ch: 顯示名稱, 最多 28 個字元. 留空則還原原始名稱.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceNameTip.cn: 显示名称, 最多 28 个字符. 留空则恢复原始名称.

IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearancePasteTip.en: Paste appearance into this draft. Apply saves it.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearancePasteTip.ch: 將外觀貼上到此草稿. 按「套用」後才會儲存.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearancePasteTip.cn: 将外观粘贴到此草稿. 点击“应用”后才会保存.

IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceResetTip.en: Restore the original name and background, and remove the item badge when you click Apply.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceResetTip.ch: 按下「套用」時, 還原原始名稱與背景, 並移除物品徽章.
IGUI_RPGInventory_AppearanceResetTip.cn: 点击“应用”时, 恢复原始名称和背景, 并移除物品徽章.

IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerCancel.ch: 取消動作 / 展開堆疊
IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerCancel.cn: 取消动作 / 展开堆叠

IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerEquipmentPan.ch: 顯示 / 隱藏裝備面板
IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerEquipmentPan.cn: 显示 / 隐藏装备面板

IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerLayoutHint.en: D-pad: adjust | A: confirm | B: cancel
IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerLayoutHint.ch: 方向鍵: 調整 | A: 確認 | B: 取消
IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerLayoutHint.cn: 方向键: 调整 | A: 确认 | B: 取消

IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerLeftModifier.en: Hold L1 + Up/Down: container; Left/Right: column
IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerLeftModifier.ch: 按住 L1 + 上/下: 容器; 左/右: 欄
IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerLeftModifier.cn: 按住 L1 + 上/下: 容器; 左/右: 列

IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerSelectionAll.ch: 按住 R1 + A: 全選
IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerSelectionAll.cn: 按住 R1 + A: 全选

IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerSelectionCle.ch: 按住 R1 + B: 清除選取
IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerSelectionCle.cn: 按住 R1 + B: 清除选择

IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerSelectionRan.ch: 按住 R1 + 方向鍵: 選取範圍
IGUI_RPGInventory_ControllerSelectionRan.cn: 按住 R1 + 方向键: 选择范围

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpActivate.en: Press: open item context or activate the focused control, heading, container, nested arrow or lock.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpActivate.ch: 按下: 開啟物品右鍵選單, 或啟動目前焦點所在的控制項、標題、容器、子容器箭頭或鎖定鈕.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpActivate.cn: 按下: 打开物品右键菜单, 或激活当前焦点所在的控件、标题、容器、子容器箭头或锁定按钮.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpAll.en: Hold the right shoulder + confirm: select all items in the current view.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpAll.ch: 按住右肩鍵 + 確認鍵: 選取目前畫面中的所有物品.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpAll.cn: 按住右肩键 + 确认键: 选择当前视图中的所有物品.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpCancel.en: Press: cancel an ongoing action; otherwise expand/collapse a stack or heading, or clear selection.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpCancel.ch: 按下: 取消進行中的動作; 若無動作, 則展開/收合堆疊或標題, 或清除選取.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpCancel.cn: 按下: 取消进行中的动作; 若无动作, 则展开/折叠堆叠或标题, 或清除选择.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpClear.en: Hold the right shoulder + cancel: clear selection.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpClear.ch: 按住右肩鍵 + 取消鍵: 清除選取.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpClear.cn: 按住右肩键 + 取消键: 清除选择.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpColumns.en: Hold the left shoulder + D-pad left/right: previous/next column.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpColumns.ch: 按住左肩鍵 + 方向鍵左/右: 上一欄/下一欄.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpColumns.cn: 按住左肩键 + 方向键左/右: 上一列/下一列.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpCommandList.en: Commands also contains destinations, container selection/combination, locks, reordering, all/range selection, transfer all, search, sorting, grid/list, stacks, container actions, equipment, rules and layout.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpCommandList.ch: 「指令」中還有: 目的地、容器選取/合併、鎖定、重新排序、全選/範圍選取、全部轉移、搜尋、排序、格狀/清單、堆疊、容器動作、裝備、規則與版面配置.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpCommandList.cn: “命令”中还包含: 目标、容器选择/合并、锁定、重新排序、全选/范围选择、全部转移、搜索、排序、网格/列表、堆叠、容器动作、装备、规则和布局.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpCommands.en: Click and release the right stick: open Commands, including this help.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpCommands.ch: 按下並放開右搖桿: 開啟「指令」 (包含本說明).
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpCommands.cn: 按下并松开右摇杆: 打开“命令” (包括本帮助).

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpContainers.en: Hold the left shoulder + D-pad up/down: previous/next container.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpContainers.ch: 按住左肩鍵 + 方向鍵上/下: 上一個/下一個容器.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpContainers.cn: 按住左肩键 + 方向键上/下: 上一个/下一个容器.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpEdit.en: Confirm: activate button, toggle checkbox or edit text using the native controller keyboard.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpEdit.ch: 確認鍵: 按下按鈕、切換核取方塊, 或用遊戲內建的控制器鍵盤編輯文字.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpEdit.cn: 确认键: 按下按钮、切换复选框, 或用游戏自带的手柄键盘编辑文本.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpExit.en: Press: close the inventory and return to the game.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpExit.ch: 按下: 關閉物品欄並回到遊戲.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpExit.cn: 按下: 关闭物品栏并返回游戏.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpFooter.en: Left/right: page  |  Up/down: scroll  |  Cancel: close
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpFooter.ch: 左/右: 換頁  |  上/下: 捲動  |  取消: 關閉
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpFooter.cn: 左/右: 翻页  |  上/下: 滚动  |  取消: 关闭

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpHelpClose.en: Cancel or the X at the top right closes help and restores the previous game speed.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpHelpClose.ch: 按取消鍵或右上角的 X 會關閉說明, 並恢復先前的遊戲速度.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpHelpClose.cn: 按取消键或右上角的 X 会关闭帮助, 并恢复之前的游戏速度.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpHelpPages.en: In this help: D-pad left/right or either shoulder changes page. Mouse: use the bottom arrows.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpHelpPages.ch: 在本說明中: 方向鍵左/右或任一肩鍵可換頁. 滑鼠: 使用底部的箭頭.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpHelpPages.cn: 在本帮助中: 方向键左/右或任一肩键可翻页. 鼠标: 使用底部的箭头.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpHelpScroll.en: D-pad up/down or mouse wheel scrolls when the page does not fit.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpHelpScroll.ch: 頁面無法完整顯示時, 可用方向鍵上/下或滑鼠滾輪捲動.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpHelpScroll.cn: 页面显示不全时, 可用方向键上/下或鼠标滚轮滚动.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpLayoutAdjust.en: In Move / Resize: D-pad adjusts the window position or size.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpLayoutAdjust.ch: 在「移動」/「調整大小」中: 方向鍵可調整視窗位置或大小.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpLayoutAdjust.cn: 在“移动”/“调整大小”中: 方向键可调整窗口位置或大小.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpLayoutCancel.en: Cancel: undo the current layout adjustment.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpLayoutCancel.ch: 取消鍵: 復原目前的版面調整.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpLayoutCancel.cn: 取消键: 撤销当前的布局调整.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpLayoutConfirm.ch: 確認鍵: 保留版面調整.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpLayoutConfirm.cn: 确认键: 保留布局调整.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpLayoutOpen.en: Commands > Window layout: pin/unpin, move, resize or reset layout.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpLayoutOpen.ch: 指令 > 視窗版面配置: 釘選/取消釘選、移動、調整大小或重設版面配置.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpLayoutOpen.cn: 命令 > 窗口布局: 固定/取消固定、移动、调整大小或重置布局.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpMenuBack.en: Cancel or D-pad left: return from a submenu; cancel at the root closes the menu.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpMenuBack.ch: 取消鍵或方向鍵左: 從子選單返回; 在最上層按取消會關閉選單.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpMenuBack.cn: 取消键或方向键左: 从子菜单返回; 在顶层菜单按取消会关闭菜单.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpMenuRows.en: D-pad up/down: choose an option in a context menu or Commands.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpMenuRows.ch: 方向鍵上/下: 在右鍵選單或「指令」中選擇選項.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpMenuRows.cn: 方向键上/下: 在右键菜单或“命令”中选择选项.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpModalBack.en: Cancel: close Settings / Smart Transfer Setup and return to inventory.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpModalBack.ch: 取消鍵: 關閉「設定」/「智慧轉移設定」並回到物品欄.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpModalBack.cn: 取消键: 关闭“设置”/“智能转移设置”并返回物品栏.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpMultiplayer.ch: 多人遊戲: 伺服器仍持續運作
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpMultiplayer.cn: 多人游戏: 服务器仍在运行

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpNative.en: Menu/Start and View/Back retain the game commands outside this help.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpNative.ch: 在本說明以外, Menu/Start 與 View/Back 鍵維持遊戲原本的功能.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpNative.cn: 在本帮助之外, Menu/Start 和 View/Back 键保留游戏原有功能.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpNavigate.en: D-pad: move through items. At an edge, move to the next panel or column; vertically, pass through headings.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpNavigate.ch: 方向鍵: 在物品間移動. 到達邊緣時移至下一個面板或欄; 垂直移動時會經過標題.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpNavigate.cn: 方向键: 在物品间移动. 到达边缘时移到下一个面板或列; 纵向移动时会经过标题.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpRange.en: Hold the right shoulder + D-pad: extend or shrink a selection range, preserving the earlier selection.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpRange.ch: 按住右肩鍵 + 方向鍵: 擴大或縮小選取範圍, 並保留先前的選取.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpRange.cn: 按住右肩键 + 方向键: 扩大或缩小选择范围, 并保留之前的选择.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpSelect.en: Short click of the left stick: toggle selection of the focused item on release.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpSelect.ch: 短按左搖桿: 放開時切換目前焦點物品的選取狀態.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpSelect.cn: 短按左摇杆: 松开时切换当前焦点物品的选择状态.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpSettings.en: Settings / Smart Transfer Setup: up/down moves between controls. Left/right adjusts a slider or changes a list choice.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpSettings.ch: 「設定」/「智慧轉移設定」: 上/下在控制項之間移動. 左/右可調整滑桿或變更清單選項.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpSettings.cn: “设置”/“智能转移设置”: 上/下在控件之间移动. 左/右可调整滑块或更改列表选项.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpShoulders.en: A shoulder button alone does not switch containers or skip panels. The right shoulder is the selection modifier.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpShoulders.ch: 單按肩鍵不會切換容器或跳過面板. 右肩鍵是選取用的組合鍵.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpShoulders.cn: 单按肩键不会切换容器或跳过面板. 右肩键是选择用的组合键.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpSubmenu.en: Confirm activates the option; D-pad right opens its submenu. Repeat for deeper submenus.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpSubmenu.ch: 確認鍵啟動選項; 方向鍵右開啟其子選單. 更深層的子選單依此類推.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpSubmenu.cn: 确认键激活选项; 方向键右打开其子菜单. 更深层的子菜单依此类推.

IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpTransfer.en: Press: transfer the selected items, or the focused item.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpTransfer.ch: 按下: 轉移選取的物品, 或目前焦點所在的物品.
IGUI_RPGInventory_HelpTransfer.cn: 按下: 转移选中的物品, 或当前焦点所在的物品.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Goal.en: Set five pieces of scrap wood along the frame, then bind every joint with duct tape.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Goal.ch: 把五塊廢木材沿著框架擺好, 再用布膠帶纏緊每個接合處.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Goal.cn: 把五块废木材沿着框架摆好, 再用管道胶带缠紧每个接合处.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step1.en: Take hold of a piece and drag it onto its place on the frame. It snaps in when it is close.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step1.ch: 抓住一塊木材, 拖曳到框架上對應的位置. 靠得夠近時就會自動卡上.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step1.cn: 抓住一块木材, 拖到框架上对应的位置. 靠得够近时就会自动卡上.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step2.en: Once all five are in, hold on a joint and work the mouse up and down over it to wind the tape on.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step2.ch: 五塊都放好後, 在接合處按住滑鼠並上下來回移動, 把膠帶纏上去.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step2.cn: 五块都放好后, 在接合处按住鼠标并上下来回移动, 把胶带缠上去.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step3.en: Every joint takes about the same: wind until it is done, then the next.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step3.ch: 每個接合處所需的工夫都差不多: 纏到好為止, 再換下一個.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Step3.cn: 每个接合处所需的功夫都差不多: 缠到好为止, 再换下一个.

IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Watch.en: Yanking tears the tape and loses what was wound; straying off the joint sticks it to nothing. A sloppy job starts the prosthetic part worn.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Watch.ch: 猛拉會扯破膠帶, 已纏好的部分也會白費; 偏離接合處, 膠帶就黏不到東西. 做得馬虎, 義肢一開始就會帶有磨損.
IGUI_CU_Howto_Crude_Watch.cn: 猛拉会扯破胶带, 已缠好的部分也会白费; 偏离接合处, 胶带就粘不到东西. 做得马虎, 假肢一开始就会带有磨损.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_FallsApart.en: It falls apart in your hands.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint.en: Drag each piece of scrap wood onto its place along the frame.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint.ch: 把每塊廢木材拖曳到框架上對應的位置.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint.cn: 把每块废木材拖到框架上对应的位置.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint2.en: Then wind tape round every joint: hold, and work up and down over it.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint2.ch: 然後在每個接合處纏上膠帶: 按住, 並在上面上下來回移動.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Hint2.cn: 然后在每个接合处缠上胶带: 按住, 并在上面上下来回移动.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_HoldOnAJoint.en: Hold on a joint, and work up and down.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_HoldOnAJoint.ch: 按住一個接合處, 上下來回移動.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_HoldOnAJoint.cn: 按住一个接合处, 上下来回移动.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NotThere.en: That is not where it goes.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NowTheTape.en: All the pieces are in. Now the tape.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NowTheTape.ch: 木材都放好了. 接下來纏膠帶.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_NowTheTape.cn: 木材都放好了. 接下来缠胶带.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_TakeAPiece.en: Take hold of a piece of wood.

IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Torn.ch: 輕一點 - 膠帶扯破了.
IGUI_CU_MG_Crude_Torn.cn: 轻一点 - 胶带扯破了.

IGUI_CU_Stump_Crude.ch: %1已截肢: 已裝上木製義肢 (剩餘 %2%%)
IGUI_CU_Stump_Crude.cn: %1已截肢: 已装上木制假肢 (剩余 %2%%)

IGUI_MSW_Unload_DataMissing.en: Stored vehicle data is missing or corrupted.
IGUI_MSW_Unload_DataMissing.ch: 儲存的車輛資料遺失或已損毀.
IGUI_MSW_Unload_DataMissing.cn: 存储的车辆数据丢失或已损坏.

IGUI_MSW_Unload_NoSpace.en: Not enough space to unload the vehicle.
IGUI_MSW_Unload_NoSpace.ch: 空間不足, 無法卸下車輛.
IGUI_MSW_Unload_NoSpace.cn: 空间不足, 无法卸下车辆.

IGUI_MSW_Unload_NoSpawnSquare.en: Cannot find a valid unload position.
IGUI_MSW_Unload_NoSpawnSquare.ch: 找不到有效的卸車位置.
IGUI_MSW_Unload_NoSpawnSquare.cn: 找不到有效的卸车位置.

IGUI_MSW_Unload_RestoreFailed.en: Unloading failed while restoring vehicle parts. Slot data was kept.
IGUI_MSW_Unload_RestoreFailed.ch: 還原車輛零件時卸車失敗. 已保留槽位資料.
IGUI_MSW_Unload_RestoreFailed.cn: 恢复车辆零件时卸车失败. 已保留槽位数据.

IGUI_MSW_Unload_SlotEmpty.en: No stored vehicle in this slot.
IGUI_MSW_Unload_SlotEmpty.ch: 此槽位沒有儲存的車輛.
IGUI_MSW_Unload_SlotEmpty.cn: 此槽位没有存储的车辆.

IGUI_MSW_Unload_SpawnFailed.en: Failed to spawn unloaded vehicle. Missing mod or script?
IGUI_MSW_Unload_SpawnFailed.ch: 無法生成卸下的車輛. 是否缺少模組或腳本?
IGUI_MSW_Unload_SpawnFailed.cn: 无法生成卸下的车辆. 是否缺少模组或脚本?

IGUI_GGS_AimBlurSwitchTooltip.en: Darkens and softens peripheral vision while aiming through an optic.
IGUI_GGS_AimBlurSwitchTooltip.ch: 透過光學瞄具瞄準時, 使周邊視野變暗並柔化.
IGUI_GGS_AimBlurSwitchTooltip.cn: 通过光学瞄具瞄准时, 使周边视野变暗并柔化.

IGUI_GGS_ScopeMarksSwitchTooltip.en: Shows scope reticle marks and the moving aim marker.
IGUI_GGS_ScopeMarksSwitchTooltip.ch: 顯示瞄準鏡的準星標記與移動中的瞄準標記.
IGUI_GGS_ScopeMarksSwitchTooltip.cn: 显示瞄准镜的准星标记与移动的瞄准标记.

IGUI_DeadMagic_CastFail_RitualDisabled.ch: 本伺服器無法使用此儀式
IGUI_DeadMagic_CastFail_RitualDisabled.cn: 本服务器无法使用此仪式

IGUI_DeadMagic_CastFail_SpellDisabled.ch: 本伺服器無法使用此法術
IGUI_DeadMagic_CastFail_SpellDisabled.cn: 本服务器无法使用此法术

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_AdultAnimationP.en: Allows visible/direct private animation playback when adult content is enabled.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_AdultAnimationP.ch: 啟用成人內容時, 允許直接可見地播放私密動畫.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_AdultAnimationP.cn: 启用成人内容时, 允许直接可见地播放私密动画.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_AdultContentEna.en: Allows the private adult add-on scene gateway and adult scene consequences where installed.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_AdultContentEna.ch: 若已安裝私密成人附加模組, 允許其場景入口與成人場景後續影響.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_AdultContentEna.cn: 若已安装私密成人附加模组, 允许其场景入口与成人场景后续影响.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_ChildrenEnabled.en: Allows child actor, child presentation, child needs, and child care/follow systems.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_ChildrenEnabled.ch: 允許兒童角色、兒童外觀呈現、兒童需求與兒童照護/跟隨系統.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_ChildrenEnabled.cn: 允许儿童角色、儿童外观呈现、儿童需求与儿童照顾/跟随系统.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_Description.en: Client overrides for save Sandbox defaults. Use Sandbox default to return control to the save.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_Description.ch: 客戶端覆寫存檔的沙盒預設值. 選擇「使用沙盒預設值」即可將控制權交還給存檔.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_Description.cn: 客户端覆盖存档的沙盒默认值. 选择“使用沙盒默认值”即可将控制权交还给存档.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_DesireAttractio.en: Allows desire scoring, attraction item bonuses, hygiene-attraction signals, and scanner/scorer bonuses.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_DesireAttractio.ch: 允許慾望評分、吸引力物品加成、衛生吸引力訊號與掃描/評分加成.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_DesireAttractio.cn: 允许欲望评分、吸引力物品加成、卫生吸引力信号与扫描/评分加成.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyMoodEffec.en: Allows family emotion hub, effect ledger, bond mood/stress/panic adjustments, and scene bonding effects.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyMoodEffec.ch: 允許家庭情緒中樞、效果紀錄、羈絆的情緒/壓力/恐慌調整與場景羈絆效果.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyMoodEffec.cn: 允许家庭情绪中枢、效果记录、羁绊的情绪/压力/恐慌调整与场景羁绊效果.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyRelatedIt.en: Allows related context actions such as protection, lactation aid, and attraction/hygiene bonus item actions.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyRelatedIt.ch: 允許相關的右鍵動作, 例如避孕措施、泌乳輔助, 以及吸引力/衛生加成物品動作.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_FamilyRelatedIt.cn: 允许相关的右键动作, 例如避孕措施、泌乳辅助, 以及吸引力/卫生加成物品动作.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InfantsEnabled_.en: Allows newborn creation and BabyCare infant systems. Existing baby items are not deleted.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InfantsEnabled_.ch: 允許產生新生兒與嬰兒照護系統. 既有的嬰兒物品不會被刪除.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InfantsEnabled_.cn: 允许生成新生儿与婴儿护理系统. 现有的婴儿物品不会被删除.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InseminationEna.en: Allows private-scene conception attempts. Requires adult content and pregnancy.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InseminationEna.ch: 允許在私密場景中嘗試受孕. 需要啟用成人內容與懷孕.
IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_InseminationEna.cn: 允许在私密场景中尝试受孕. 需要启用成人内容与怀孕.

IGUI_TDDUPFamilyControls_IntimacyDialogu.en: Choose where brief private-scene reactions appear.

IGUI_PhunZones_MutantSpawn_tooltip.en: Requires The Mutants mod. Percentage (0-100, decimals allowed) of zombies that become this mutant when they spawn in this zone. Leave empty to use the sandbox setting; 0 stops this mutant spawning here. Mutants that wander in from elsewhere are not affected
IGUI_PhunZones_MutantSpawn_tooltip.ch: 需要 The Mutants 模組. 在此區域生成的殭屍中, 會變成此種變異體的百分比 (0-100, 可用小數). 留空則使用沙盒設定; 設為 0 則此變異體不會在此生成. 從其他地方遊蕩進來的變異體不受影響
IGUI_PhunZones_MutantSpawn_tooltip.cn: 需要 The Mutants 模组. 在此区域生成的僵尸中, 会变成此种变异体的百分比 (0-100, 可用小数). 留空则使用沙盒设置; 设为 0 则此变异体不会在此生成. 从其他地方游荡进来的变异体不受影响

IGUI_Wounds_ArrestHow.en: Only chest compressions and a defibrillator can bring you back.
IGUI_Wounds_ArrestHow.ch: 只有胸部按壓和電擊器能把你救回來.
IGUI_Wounds_ArrestHow.cn: 只有胸外按压和除颤器能把你救回来.

IGUI_Wounds_BulletSealed.en: The wound has closed over the bullet.
IGUI_Wounds_BulletSealed.ch: 傷口已把子彈封在裡面了.
IGUI_Wounds_BulletSealed.cn: 伤口已把子弹封在里面了.

IGUI_Wounds_CarDoorBlocked.ch: 對方那側的車門被擋住了.
IGUI_Wounds_CarDoorBlocked.cn: 他们那侧的车门被挡住了.

IGUI_Wounds_CarFar.en: Bring them right up to a door.

IGUI_Wounds_CarMoving.en: The car has to be standing still.

IGUI_Wounds_DefibFailed.ch: 沒有心律. 再次充電.
IGUI_Wounds_DefibFailed.cn: 没有心律. 再次充电.

IGUI_Wounds_DefibNotNeeded.en: Their heart is beating - a shock won't help.
IGUI_Wounds_DefibNotNeeded.ch: 對方心臟還在跳 - 電擊沒有用.
IGUI_Wounds_DefibNotNeeded.cn: 他们的心脏还在跳 - 电击没有用.

IGUI_Wounds_ExtractBlind.en: Grip the bullet and pull it straight out
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractBlind.ch: 夾住子彈, 直接拔出來
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractBlind.cn: 夹住子弹, 直接拔出来

IGUI_Wounds_ExtractIn.en: Grip the bullet and draw it out along the line
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractIn.ch: 夾住子彈, 沿著線拉出來
IGUI_Wounds_ExtractIn.cn: 夹住子弹, 沿着线拉出来

IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlive.en: Still breathing. Someone beside you can bring you round.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlive.ch: 還有呼吸. 身旁有人就能把你喚醒.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlive.cn: 还有呼吸. 身边有人就能把你唤醒.

IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlone.en: Left alone, you will come to for a few minutes - stop the bleeding then.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlone.ch: 若無人在旁, 你會短暫清醒幾分鐘 - 趁那時止血.
IGUI_Wounds_FaintAlone.cn: 如果身边没人, 你会短暂清醒几分钟 - 趁那时止血.

IGUI_Wounds_FaintLucid.en: You come to - stop the bleeding!
IGUI_Wounds_FaintLucid.ch: 你醒過來了 - 快止血!
IGUI_Wounds_FaintLucid.cn: 你醒过来了 - 快止血!

IGUI_Wounds_MenuDefibTip.en: Their heart has stopped. Each shock costs a charge, and each one after the first is less likely to work.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuDefibTip.ch: 對方心跳已停止. 每次電擊會消耗一格電量, 而第一次之後的每次電擊成功率都會降低.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuDefibTip.cn: 他们的心跳已停止. 每次电击会消耗一格电量, 而第一次之后的每次电击成功率都会降低.

IGUI_Wounds_MenuReviveTip.en: Their heart has stopped. Compressions buy time and rarely restart it; a defibrillator is the real way back.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuReviveTip.ch: 對方心跳已停止. 按壓能爭取時間, 但很少能讓心臟重新跳動; 電擊器才是真正的救命手段.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuReviveTip.cn: 他们的心跳已停止. 按压能争取时间, 但很少能让心脏重新跳动; 除颤器才是真正的救命手段.

IGUI_Wounds_MenuRouseTip.en: Only once nothing is bleeding. Gets them on their feet for about an hour; it does not put any blood back.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuRouseTip.ch: 須先止住所有出血. 能讓對方起身行動約一小時; 但不會補回任何血液.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuRouseTip.cn: 必须先止住所有出血. 能让他们站起来活动约一小时; 但不会补回任何血液.

IGUI_Wounds_MenuTowTip.en: They come along the ground behind you. No running, and it wears you out fast; raising a weapon, stairs and cars make you let go.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuTowTip.ch: 對方會被你拖在地上走. 無法奔跑, 而且體力消耗很快; 舉起武器, 上下樓梯或上車都會讓你放手.
IGUI_Wounds_MenuTowTip.cn: 他们会被你拖着在地上走. 无法奔跑, 而且体力消耗很快; 举起武器, 上下楼梯或上车都会让你松手.

IGUI_Wounds_NoExtractTissue.en: The bullet is too deep in the tissue - pack the wound and take antibiotics.
IGUI_Wounds_NoExtractTissue.ch: 子彈卡在組織深處 - 填塞傷口並服用抗生素.
IGUI_Wounds_NoExtractTissue.cn: 子弹卡在组织深处 - 填塞伤口并服用抗生素.

IGUI_Wounds_NoStitchBullet.en: You don't stitch a gunshot wound - flush it and pack it.
IGUI_Wounds_NoStitchBullet.ch: 槍傷不能縫合 - 要沖洗後再填塞.
IGUI_Wounds_NoStitchBullet.cn: 枪伤不能缝合 - 要冲洗后再填塞.

IGUI_Wounds_PackingDone.en: The wound has closed - the packing comes away.
IGUI_Wounds_PackingDone.ch: 傷口已癒合 - 填塞物脫落了.
IGUI_Wounds_PackingDone.cn: 伤口已愈合 - 填塞物脱落了.

IGUI_Wounds_ReviveBleeding.en: They are still bleeding - stop it first.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveBleeding.ch: 對方仍在流血 - 先止血.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveBleeding.cn: 他们还在流血 - 先止血.

IGUI_Wounds_ReviveKeep.en: The heart is still stopped. Keep going.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveKeep.ch: 心臟仍未恢復跳動. 繼續.
IGUI_Wounds_ReviveKeep.cn: 心脏仍未恢复跳动. 继续.

IGUI_Wounds_TamponadeNeed.en: Requires a bandage or ripped sheets

IGUI_Wounds_TrimLift.cn: 用刀尖挑出切下的组织条

IGUI_Wounds_TrimNoTweezers.en: No tweezers - the edge will not hold still.

IGUI_Wounds_TrimNoTweezers.cn: 没有镊子 - 边缘固定不住.

IGUI_Wounds_TrimSnip.cn: 沿着坏死组织的边缘剪

IGUI_CrumpledNoteReaded.en: <TEXT> The lady is giving me a strange look from the terrace. <LINE> I think he realized I went into the boss's office. <LINE> She knows about the card. <LINE> I hid the object in the only place that damned woman wouldn't dare climb up to... <LINE> on the top floor of the <ORANGE> <SPACE> SV Communications Tower. <LINE> <TEXT> If something happens to me, let them look there. <LINE> I don't have much time left...
IGUI_CrumpledNoteReaded.ch: <TEXT> 那位女士在露臺上用奇怪的眼神看著我. <LINE> 我想她已經發現我進過老闆的辦公室了. <LINE> 她知道卡片的事. <LINE> 我把東西藏在那個該死的女人唯一不敢爬上去的地方… <LINE> 就在 <ORANGE> <SPACE> SV 通訊塔的頂樓. <LINE> <TEXT> 如果我出了什麼事, 叫他們去那裡找. <LINE> 我剩下的時間不多了…
IGUI_CrumpledNoteReaded.cn: <TEXT> 那位女士在露台上用奇怪的眼神看着我. <LINE> 我想她已经发现我进过老板的办公室了. <LINE> 她知道卡片的事. <LINE> 我把东西藏在了那个该死的女人唯一不敢爬上去的地方… <LINE> 就在 <ORANGE> <SPACE> SV 通信塔的顶楼. <LINE> <TEXT> 如果我出了什么事, 让他们去那里找. <LINE> 我剩下的时间不多了…

Base.Enfield1917._note: #326 上游改值：型號由「Enfield 1917」正名為「M1917 Enfield」，制式編號的 M 前綴屬關鍵型號資訊，現值遺漏故 change；沿用檔案內此系列以拉丁原文保留槍名的做法（Mauser 98 步槍等），不改寫為恩菲爾德。

Base.MosinNagant1891._note: #326 上游改值：型號由「1891」正名為「M1891」，屬關鍵編號差異；同檔另有 Base.Mosin_Nagant「莫辛-納甘M91/30」，本鍵維持拉丁拼寫以免與該條混淆。

Base.P90Clip._note: 2026-10-03 裁決: GaelGunStore 寫 Magazine for FN P90 (50 rounds) (script 的 AmmoType 是 9mm), Brita 的 script 寫 5.7x28mm P90 Magazine, 都是 P90 專用彈匣, 是同一種物品. 雙方口徑寫法不同, 現值原本就沒寫口徑; Brita 的 script 原始檔不在本地下載中, 無法確認容量是否同為 50 發, 所以拿掉「(50 發)」, 改成對兩方都成立的「FN P90 彈匣」. 容量仍會顯示在物品資訊中.

Print_Text_Fortune10_info.ch: 「一步一步走, 也能走得很遠.」
Print_Text_Fortune10_info.cn: “一步一步走, 也能走得很远.”

Print_Text_Fortune2_info.en: 'Live this day as if it were your last.'
Print_Text_Fortune2_info.ch: 「把今天當成生命的最後一天來過.」
Print_Text_Fortune2_info.cn: “把今天当成生命的最后一天来过.”

Print_Text_Fortune3_info.en: 'There are no regrets in life. Just lessons.'
Print_Text_Fortune3_info.ch: 「人生沒有後悔, 只有教訓.」
Print_Text_Fortune3_info.cn: “人生没有后悔, 只有教训.”

Print_Text_Fortune8_info.en: 'What's the point of being if you're not being yourself?'
Print_Text_Fortune8_info.ch: 「若不能做自己, 活著又有什麼意義?」
Print_Text_Fortune8_info.cn: “若不能做自己, 活着又有什么意义?”

Print_Text_Fortune9_info.en: 'What good are wings, without the courage to fly.'
Print_Text_Fortune9_info.ch: 「沒有飛翔的勇氣, 翅膀又有何用.」
Print_Text_Fortune9_info.cn: “没有飞翔的勇气, 翅膀又有何用.”

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.en: Ideal Weight Lose Grace Period Hours Speed Multiplier
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.ch: 理想體重失去寬限時數累積倍率
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.cn: 理想体重失去宽限小时数累积倍率

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.en: How fast you earn 'grace period' hours that later are used up before you lose the trait if you're not between 75-85 weight. Default multiplier of 1 earns you 1 grace period hour for every 12h of keeping weight 78-82 (Basically 0.0834 grace hours for each 1h). Higher multiplier = faster gain of grace hours. Lower multiplier = slower gain of grace hours.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.ch: 你累積寬限時數的速度; 當體重不在75-85之間時, 這些時數會先被消耗, 用完後才會失去此特質. 預設倍率1代表體重維持在78-82時, 每12小時累積1小時寬限時數 (即每1小時約累積0.0834小時). 倍率越高, 寬限時數累積越快; 倍率越低則累積越慢.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.cn: 你积累宽限小时数的速度; 当体重不在75-85之间时, 这些小时数会先被消耗, 用完后才会失去此特质. 默认倍率1代表体重保持在78-82时, 每12小时积累1小时宽限小时数 (即每1小时约积累0.0834小时). 倍率越高, 宽限小时数积累越快; 倍率越低则积累越慢.

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightLos.ch: 計數器上最多可以累積多少小時; 當你的體重不在75-85之間時, 這些時數會先被消耗, 之後才會失去理想體重特質
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightLos.cn: 计数器上最多可以积累多少小时; 当你的体重不在75-85之间时, 这些小时数会先被消耗, 之后才会失去理想体重特质

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_UnwaveringCoun.en: This is internal counter that needs to be reached before you get the trait. Each injury below belt adds to counter every 10 min. Deep Wound > Laceration > Burn/Fracture > Scratch > Bleeding. For example, having burns on 1 bodypart below belt would result in getting around +2.3 on counter in 24h. Having 1 fracture gives around +3 in 24h.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_UnwaveringCoun.ch: 這是需要達到的內部計數器數值, 達到後才會獲得此特質. 腰部以下的每處傷勢每10分鐘都會增加計數. 深傷口 > 撕裂傷 > 燒傷/骨折 > 抓傷 > 流血. 例如, 腰部以下1個身體部位有燒傷, 24小時內計數器約+2.3; 有1處骨折則24小時約+3.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_UnwaveringCoun.cn: 这是需要达到的内部计数器数值, 达到后才会获得此特质. 腰部以下的每处伤势每10分钟都会增加计数. 深伤口 > 撕裂伤 > 烧伤/骨折 > 抓伤 > 流血. 例如, 腰部以下1个身体部位有烧伤, 24小时内计数器约+2.3; 有1处骨折则24小时约+3.

Sandbox_XVirus_AdminSpawnOnly_tooltip.en: When enabled, the X-Virus will not spawn in loot anywhere. Only admins can spawn it via the item picker or /additem. Useful for servers that want the virus available but tightly controlled. Changes take effect after a server restart.
Sandbox_XVirus_AdminSpawnOnly_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, X病毒不會出現在任何戰利品中. 只有管理員能透過物品選擇器或 /additem 生成它. 適合想保留此病毒但嚴格控管的伺服器. 變更會在伺服器重新啟動後生效.
Sandbox_XVirus_AdminSpawnOnly_tooltip.cn: 启用后, X病毒不会出现在任何战利品中. 只有管理员能通过物品选择器或 /additem 生成它. 适合想保留此病毒但严格管控的服务器. 变更会在服务器重新启动后生效.

Sandbox_XVirus_AlreadyInfected_tooltip.en: What happens when a player uses the X-Virus while already infected. No Effect = virus is wasted. Grant Mutations = grants mutation traits without re-infecting.
Sandbox_XVirus_AlreadyInfected_tooltip.ch: 玩家在已感染狀態下使用 X病毒時的結果. 無效果 = 浪費一劑病毒. 授予突變 = 不重新感染, 僅授予突變特質.
Sandbox_XVirus_AlreadyInfected_tooltip.cn: 玩家在已感染状态下使用 X病毒时的结果. 无效果 = 浪费一剂病毒. 授予突变 = 不重新感染, 仅授予突变特质.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitCorpses_tooltip.en: Grants immunity to stress from corpses on injection. Re-injecting with different settings updates the trait. Random = coin flip per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitCorpses_tooltip.ch: 注射後可免疫屍體造成的壓力. 以不同設定重新注射會更新該特質. 隨機 = 每位玩家各擲一次硬幣決定.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitCorpses_tooltip.cn: 注射后可免疫尸体造成的压力. 以不同设置重新注射会更新该特质. 随机 = 每位玩家各掷一次硬币决定.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitDexterity_tooltip.en: Modifies item transfer speed on injection. Dextrous = 2x faster. All Thumbs = 2x slower. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitDexterity_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變物品搬運速度. 眼疾手快 = 快 2 倍. 笨手笨腳 = 慢 2 倍. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitDexterity_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变物品搬运速度. 眼疾手快 = 快 2 倍. 笨手笨脚 = 慢 2 倍. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitFear_tooltip.en: Modifies fear response on injection. Brave = halved stress. Cowardly = doubled stress. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitFear_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變恐懼反應. 無所畏懼 = 壓力減半. 畏首畏尾 = 壓力加倍. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitFear_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变恐惧反应. 无所畏惧 = 压力减半. 畏首畏尾 = 压力加倍. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitLearning_tooltip.en: Modifies research speed on injection. Fast = 30% faster. Slow = 30% slower. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitLearning_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變研究速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 減慢 30%%. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitLearning_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变研究速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 减慢 30%%. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitReading_tooltip.en: Modifies reading speed on injection. Fast = 30% faster. Slow = 30% slower. Random = picks one per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitReading_tooltip.ch: 注射後改變閱讀速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 減慢 30%%. 隨機 = 每位玩家各挑一項.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitReading_tooltip.cn: 注射后改变阅读速度. 快 = 加快 30%%. 慢 = 减慢 30%%. 随机 = 每位玩家各挑一项.

Sandbox_XVirus_TraitVision_tooltip.en: Grants wider vision arc on injection. Re-injecting with different settings updates the trait. Random = coin flip per player.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitVision_tooltip.ch: 注射後獲得更寬的視野範圍. 以不同設定重新注射會更新該特質. 隨機 = 每位玩家各擲一次硬幣決定.
Sandbox_XVirus_TraitVision_tooltip.cn: 注射后获得更宽的视野范围. 以不同设置重新注射会更新该特质. 随机 = 每位玩家各掷一次硬币决定.

Sandbox_XVirus_VirusRarity_tooltip.en: Controls how often the X-Virus spawns in loot. Common = 2x spawn rate, Uncommon = 1x, Rare = 0.4x (default), Very Rare = 0.15x. Changes take effect after a server restart. Ignored if Admin Spawn Only is enabled.
Sandbox_XVirus_VirusRarity_tooltip.ch: 控制 X病毒在戰利品中出現的頻率. 常見 = 2 倍生成率, 不常見 = 1 倍, 稀少 = 0.4 倍 (預設), 非常稀少 = 0.15 倍. 變更會在伺服器重新啟動後生效. 若已啟用僅限管理員生成, 則忽略此設定.
Sandbox_XVirus_VirusRarity_tooltip.cn: 控制 X病毒在战利品中出现的频率. 常见 = 2 倍生成率, 不常见 = 1 倍, 稀少 = 0.4 倍 (默认), 非常稀少 = 0.15 倍. 变更会在服务器重新启动后生效. 若已启用仅限管理员生成, 则忽略此设置.

Sandbox_ammomaker_CraftingSpeed_tooltip.en: Adjust crafting speed for all Ammo Maker recipes
Sandbox_ammomaker_CraftingSpeed_tooltip.ch: 調整彈藥製造系統所有配方的製作速度.
Sandbox_ammomaker_CraftingSpeed_tooltip.cn: 调整弹药制造系统所有配方的制作速度.

Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_EnhancedRainEx.en: Rain now increases wetness progressively. Prolonged high wetness amplifies cold damage indirectly; rain does not cause direct illness.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_EnhancedRainEx.ch: 淋雨會逐漸提高潮濕度. 長時間維持高潮濕度會間接放大寒冷造成的傷害; 雨水本身不會直接致病.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_EnhancedRainEx.cn: 淋雨会逐渐提高潮湿度. 长时间维持高潮湿度会间接放大寒冷造成的伤害; 雨水本身不会直接致病.

Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_LightningAttra.en: If true, lightning strikes emit a strong world sound that attracts zombies like a global meta event. Default: off.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_LightningAttra.ch: 啟用時, 落雷會發出強烈的世界音效, 像全域事件一樣吸引殭屍. 預設: 停用.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_LightningAttra.cn: 启用时, 落雷会发出强烈的世界音效, 像全局事件一样吸引僵尸. 默认: 禁用.

Sandbox_Printer3D_EnablePrintingFailures.en: Allows 3D printers to suffer jams, print failures, and extrusion errors.
Sandbox_Printer3D_EnablePrintingFailures.ch: 允許3D印表機發生堵塞, 列印失敗與擠出錯誤.
Sandbox_Printer3D_EnablePrintingFailures.cn: 允许3D打印机发生堵塞, 打印失败与挤出错误.

Sandbox_Printer3D_PrintingFailureMultipl.en: Adjusts the chance of failures during printing.
Sandbox_Printer3D_PrintingFailureMultipl.ch: 調整列印過程中發生失敗的機率.
Sandbox_Printer3D_PrintingFailureMultipl.cn: 调整打印过程中发生失败的几率.

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableGodRays_Too.en: When enabled, sun rays will be visually rendered on the screen during sunrise and sunset, depending on the sun's position.
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableGodRays_Too.ch: 啟用後, 日出與日落期間會依據太陽位置在畫面上繪製陽光光束.
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableGodRays_Too.cn: 启用后, 日出与日落期间会依据太阳位置在画面上绘制阳光光束.

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableStormMood_T.en: When enabled, storms can push a cinematic desaturation + darker ambient mood (with smooth fade).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableStormMood_T.ch: 啟用後, 暴風雨可帶來電影感的降低飽和度與更陰暗的環境氛圍 (含平滑淡入淡出).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableStormMood_T.cn: 启用后, 暴风雨可带来电影感的降低饱和度与更阴暗的环境氛围 (含平滑淡入淡出).

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset.ch: 暴風雨氛圍去飽和預設
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset.cn: 暴风雨氛围去饱和预设

Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset_T.en: Choose how strong the storm desaturation should be: Soft, Recommended, Night of the Living Dead (Black & White).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset_T.ch: 選擇暴風雨去飽和的強度: 柔和, 建議, 活死人之夜 (黑白).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset_T.cn: 选择暴风雨去饱和的强度: 柔和, 建议, 活死人之夜 (黑白).

Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.ch: 對流過渡強度 (1.0 = 基礎)
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.cn: 对流过渡强度 (1.0 = 基础)

Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.en: Smoothes the warming-rate cliff right at normal body temperature. 1.0 is baseline. 0 disables the bridge, warming up from cold to normal feels fast, but heating past normal in hot air feels much slower.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.ch: 平滑正常體溫附近的升溫速率斷崖. 1.0 為基礎值. 0 會停用此過渡, 從寒冷回升到正常體溫感覺很快, 但在熱空氣中升到正常體溫以上則會慢得多.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt.cn: 平滑正常体温附近的升温速率断崖. 1.0 为基础值. 0 会禁用此过渡, 从寒冷回升到正常体温感觉很快, 但在热空气中升到正常体温以上则会慢得多.

Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.ch: 各身體部位保溫偏重 (預設 0.30)
Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.cn: 各身体部位保温偏重 (默认 0.30)

Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.en: Controls how strongly uneven loadouts (e.g. parka + bare legs) deviate from the simple body-wide average. 0.0 = pure average (all parts treated equally); 1.0 = always pulled toward the weakest part in cold and the most-trapping part in heat. 0.30 is the recommended middle ground.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.ch: 控制不均衡的穿著 (例如厚外套 + 光著腿) 偏離全身平均值的程度. 0.0 = 純平均 (所有部位一視同仁); 1.0 = 寒冷時始終偏向最薄弱的部位, 炎熱時始終偏向最悶熱的部位. 0.30 是建議的折衷值.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi.cn: 控制不均衡的穿着 (例如厚外套 + 光着腿) 偏离全身平均值的程度. 0.0 = 纯平均 (所有部位一视同仁); 1.0 = 寒冷时始终偏向最薄弱的部位, 炎热时始终偏向最闷热的部位. 0.30 是建议的折衷值.

Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM.ch: 升溫速率上限 (°C 每分鐘)
Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM.cn: 升温速率上限 (°C 每分钟)

Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM_.en: Hard ceiling on how fast body temperature can rise from environmental warming (warm air, heaters, hot drinks combined). 0.5 °C/min is the default. Lower for slower recovery from cold; raise for instant warm-up at fires.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM_.ch: 體溫因環境加溫 (暖空氣, 暖爐, 熱飲的綜合作用) 而上升速度的硬性上限. 預設為 0.5 °C/分鐘. 調低可讓從寒冷中恢復得更慢; 調高則可在火堆旁瞬間回暖.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM_.cn: 体温因环境加温 (暖空气, 暖炉, 热饮的综合作用) 而上升速度的硬性上限. 默认为 0.5 °C/分钟. 调低可让从寒冷中恢复得更慢; 调高则可在火堆旁瞬间回暖.

Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnAnimals.ch: 第六感特質對動物生效
Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnAnimals.cn: 第六感特质对动物生效

Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.cn: 第六感特质对丧尸生效

Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.en: That's the point of the mod, right !?
Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.ch: 這就是這個模組的重點, 對吧!?
Sandbox_Moodles_SixthSenseWorksOnZombies.cn: 这就是这个模组的重点, 对吧!?

When enabled, buildings and vehicles destroyed by tanks and artillery will produce ash
This option also affects artillery support

啟用後, 被戰車與砲擊摧毀的建築和車輛會產生灰燼

此选项同时影响炮兵支援.

Sandbox_FloorHit_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 直升机撞墙时会降低部件状态.

Sandbox_HeliGasMultiples_tooltip.ch: 直升機的油耗將乘以此數值, 數值越大, 燃料消耗越快.
Sandbox_HeliGasMultiples_tooltip.cn: 直升机的油耗将乘以此数值, 数值越大, 燃料消耗越快.

Sandbox_RepairWhenSpawn_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 坦克/直升机在生成时会被修复.

Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower2_tooltip.en:
Affects how quickly resistant antibodies eliminate the zombie virus from the body after activation in the stage.
-This trait is acquired by injecting the level 4 vaccine;
-If potency = 6, then ~5% infection is removed per hour;
-If potency = 12, then ~10% infection is removed per hour;
-If potency = 24, then ~20% infection is removed per hour.
Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower2_tooltip.ch:
影響抗性抗體在該階段啟動後, 從體內清除殭屍病毒的速度.
-此特質透過注射第 4 級疫苗取得;
-效力 = 6 時, 每小時清除約 5%% 的感染度;
-效力 = 12 時, 每小時清除約 10%% 的感染度;
-效力 = 24 時, 每小時清除約 20%% 的感染度.
Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower2_tooltip.cn:
影响抗性抗体在该阶段启动后, 从体内清除僵尸病毒的速度.
-此特质通过注射第 4 级疫苗获得;
-效力 = 6 时, 每小时清除约 5%% 的感染度;
-效力 = 12 时, 每小时清除约 10%% 的感染度;
-效力 = 24 时, 每小时清除约 20%% 的感染度.

Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower_tooltip.en:
Affects at which infection stage the resistant antibodies activate.
-This trait is acquired by injecting the level 4 vaccine;
-TERMINAL - when infected over 80%, health drains, high chance of death;
-PRETERMINAL - when infected over 60% (nausea, fever)(RECOMMENDED!);
-MODERATE - when infected over 40% (mild nausea);
-INITIAL - when infected over 20% (no symptoms).
Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower_tooltip.ch:
影響抗性抗體在哪個感染階段啟動.
-此特質透過注射第 4 級疫苗取得;
-末期 - 感染度超過 80%% 時啟動, 生命值會流失, 死亡機率極高;
-瀕末期 - 感染度超過 60%% 時啟動 (噁心、發燒)(推薦!);
-中期 - 感染度超過 40%% 時啟動 (輕微噁心);
-初期 - 感染度超過 20%% 時啟動 (無症狀).
Sandbox_zReV2_AntibodyPower_tooltip.cn:
影响抗性抗体在哪个感染阶段启动.
-此特质通过注射第 4 级疫苗获得;
-末期 - 感染度超过 80%% 时启动, 生命值会流失, 死亡几率极高;
-濒末期 - 感染度超过 60%% 时启动 (恶心、发烧)(推荐!);
-中期 - 感染度超过 40%% 时启动 (轻微恶心);
-初期 - 感染度超过 20%% 时启动 (无症状).

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand.cn: 研究 - 进度加成. 数值:

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand_tooltip.en:
Only works for the vaccine improvement research type "PROGRESSIVE CHANCE" and "FULL RESEARCH"!
-In case of failed research, increases the result by a randomizer depending on this number (hereafter referred to as X);
-The formula works as:
Rand(X, X*2) for research up to level 2;
Rand(X*0.75, X*1.5) for research up to level 3;
Rand(X*0.5, X) for research up to level 4!
-Rounded up to the nearest whole number;
-Simply put: the randomizer decreases for researching a new vaccine by ~30% on average.
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand_tooltip.ch:
僅對疫苗改良研究類型「累進機率」與「完整研究」有效!
-研究失敗時, 會依此數值 (以下稱為 X) 以隨機值提升結果;
-公式如下:
研究至第 2 級為 Rand(X, X*2);
研究至第 3 級為 Rand(X*0.75, X*1.5);
研究至第 4 級為 Rand(X*0.5, X)!
-結果無條件進位為整數;
-簡單來說: 研究更高等級疫苗時, 隨機值平均約降低 30%%.
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchRand_tooltip.cn:
仅对疫苗改良研究类型“累进几率”与“完整研究”有效!
-研究失败时, 会依此数值 (以下称为 X) 以随机值提升结果;
-公式如下:
研究至第 2 级为 Rand(X, X*2);
研究至第 3 级为 Rand(X*0.75, X*1.5);
研究至第 4 级为 Rand(X*0.5, X)!
-结果向上取整为整数;
-简单来说: 研究更高等级疫苗时, 随机值平均约降低 30%%.

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType.ch: 研究 - 疫苗改良. 類型:
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType.cn: 研究 - 疫苗改良. 类型:

Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.en:
Choice of result type for improving (researching) new vaccine levels.
-PROGRESSIVE CHANCE - on failure, the next success chance increases (accumulates);
-STATIC CHANCE - fixed percentage chance of success (30,20,14% from second to fourth);
-FULL RESEARCH - there is a hidden progress bar for study (100 units, conditionally, each research fills the bar).
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.ch:
改良 (研究) 新疫苗等級時的結果判定類型.
-累進機率 - 失敗時, 下一次的成功機率會提升 (可累積);
-固定機率 - 固定的成功百分比 (第二至第四級分別為 30, 20, 14%%);
-完整研究 - 存在一條隱藏的研究進度條 (概念上為 100 點, 每次研究會填充進度).
Sandbox_zReV2_ResearchType_tooltip.cn:
改良 (研究) 新疫苗等级时的结果判定类型.
-累进几率 - 失败时, 下一次的成功几率会提升 (可累积);
-固定几率 - 固定的成功百分比 (第二至第四级分别为 30, 20, 14%%);
-完整研究 - 存在一条隐藏的研究进度条 (概念上为 100 点, 每次研究会填充进度).

Sandbox_TakeABathAndShower_RemainingWate.cn: 随机化停水后的剩余水量. <LINE> 数值越高, 设定的剩余水量被减少的幅度越大.

Sandbox_LFO_StartWithLFGrey_tooltip.en: Start with a Legendary Fanny Pack (Grey) in your inventory.
Sandbox_LFO_StartWithLFGrey_tooltip.ch: 開局背包裡有一個傳奇腰包 (灰).
Sandbox_LFO_StartWithLFGrey_tooltip.cn: 开局背包里有一个传奇腰包 (灰).

Sandbox_LSO_StartWithLSGrey_tooltip.en: Start with a Legendary Satchel (Grey) in your inventory.
Sandbox_LSO_StartWithLSGrey_tooltip.ch: 開局背包裡有一個傳奇挎包 (灰).
Sandbox_LSO_StartWithLSGrey_tooltip.cn: 开局背包里有一个传奇挎包 (灰).

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours_tooltip.en: A jar of sugar water or honey left on the ground away from any hive turns into a Wild Yeast Starter after this many hours. 48 = current (two days). 0 = never. Jars within reach of a hive are drunk by the bees instead and never sour.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours_tooltip.ch: 放在地上且遠離任何蜂箱的糖水罐或蜂蜜罐, 經過這麼多小時後會變成野生酵母引子. 48 = 目前值 (兩天). 0 = 永不. 位於蜂箱範圍內的罐子會被蜜蜂喝掉, 永遠不會發酸.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours_tooltip.cn: 放在地上且远离任何蜂箱的糖水罐或蜂蜜罐, 经过这么多小时后会变成野生酵母引子. 48 = 当前值 (两天). 0 = 永不. 位于蜂箱范围内的罐子会被蜜蜂喝掉, 永远不会发酸.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HoneycombYieldMultipl.en: Scales how many filled combs each production cycle adds. 1.0 = current (2-4), 2.0 = double. The hive still holds no more than its cells.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HoneycombYieldMultipl.ch: 調整每個生產週期新增多少滿載的蜂巢. 1.0 = 目前值 (2-4), 2.0 = 兩倍. 蜂箱能容納的數量仍以其巢房上限為準.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HoneycombYieldMultipl.cn: 调整每个生产周期新增多少满载的蜂巢. 1.0 = 当前值 (2-4), 2.0 = 两倍. 蜂箱能容纳的数量仍以其巢房上限为准.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationSpeed.en: Scales how fast mead barrels ferment through Young, Normal, Aged (and Spoiled). 1.0 = current pacing, 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed. Applies to batches already fermenting.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationSpeed.ch: 調整蜂蜜酒桶經過新釀, 正常, 熟成 (以及變質) 各階段的發酵速度. 1.0 = 目前節奏, 2.0 = 兩倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 對已在發酵的批次同樣生效.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadFermentationSpeed.cn: 调整蜂蜜酒桶经过新酿, 正常, 熟成 (以及变质) 各阶段的发酵速度. 1.0 = 当前节奏, 2.0 = 两倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 对已在发酵的批次同样生效.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.en: Bee and larvae growth per cycle
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.ch: 每週期蜜蜂與幼蟲成長量
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.cn: 每周期蜜蜂与幼虫成长量

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HibernationTemperatur.en: At or below this temperature the bees hibernate and the hive stops. 7 = current. Lower it for hardier bees, raise it for a shorter season.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HibernationTemperatur.ch: 溫度達到或低於此值時, 蜜蜂會進入冬眠, 蜂箱停止運作. 7 = 目前值. 調低代表蜜蜂更耐寒, 調高則產季更短.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HibernationTemperatur.cn: 温度达到或低于此值时, 蜜蜂会进入冬眠, 蜂箱停止运行. 7 = 当前值. 调低代表蜜蜂更耐寒, 调高则产季更短.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_BeeStingsEnabled_tool.en: When off, angry bees are still shown but never sting - no health damage, poison or swelling. For relaxed servers.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_BeeStingsEnabled_tool.ch: 關閉時, 憤怒的蜜蜂仍會出現, 但永遠不會螫人 - 不造成生命損傷, 中毒或腫脹. 適合輕鬆向的伺服器.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_BeeStingsEnabled_tool.cn: 关闭时, 愤怒的蜜蜂仍会出现, 但永远不会蜇人 - 不造成生命损伤, 中毒或肿胀. 适合轻松向的服务器.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_RoyalJellyHours_toolt.en: How long a full, queenless hive takes to make royal jelly. 72 = current (three days).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_RoyalJellyHours_toolt.ch: 一個滿載且沒有蜂后的蜂箱需要多久才能產出蜂王乳. 72 = 目前值 (三天).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_RoyalJellyHours_toolt.cn: 一个满载且没有蜂后的蜂箱需要多久才能产出蜂王浆. 72 = 当前值 (三天).

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.en: How many working hours one litre of stored sugar water buys. 24 = a full day of work per litre. The bees only drink while they are actually working, so a hive halted by rain or frost loses nothing from its supply. A hive holding any sugar water forages as if there were an ordinary spread of flowers around it - enough to keep working through winter or a poor biome, but no better than a decent summer.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.ch: 蜂箱儲存的一公升糖水能換得多少工作時數. 24 = 每公升可支撐整整一天的工作. 蜜蜂只在實際工作時才會飲用, 因此因下雨或結霜而停擺的蜂箱不會消耗存量. 只要蜂箱裡還有糖水, 採集效果就等同周圍有一般水準的花叢 - 足以撐過冬季或貧瘠的生態環境, 但也不會優於條件不錯的夏季.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.cn: 蜂箱储存的一升糖水能换得多少工作时长. 24 = 每升可支撑整整一天的工作. 蜜蜂只在实际工作时才会饮用, 因此因下雨或结霜而停摆的蜂箱不会消耗存量. 只要蜂箱里还有糖水, 采集效果就等同周围有一般水准的花丛 - 足以撑过冬季或贫瘠的生态环境, 但也不会优于条件不错的夏季.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.en: Scales how long a bee smoker keeps a hive calm. 1.0 = current, 2.0 = smoke lasts twice as long.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.ch: 調整蜂箱燻煙器讓蜂箱保持鎮定的時間. 1.0 = 目前值, 2.0 = 煙霧效果持續兩倍長.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.cn: 调整蜂箱熏烟器让蜂箱保持镇定的时间. 1.0 = 当前值, 2.0 = 烟雾效果持续两倍长.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.en: Scales how many bees and larvae each production cycle adds. 1.0 = current, 2.0 = double. Kept separate from honeycomb so honey and colony can be tuned apart.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.ch: 調整每個生產週期新增多少蜜蜂與幼蟲. 1.0 = 目前值, 2.0 = 兩倍. 與蜂巢產量分開設定, 讓蜂蜜與蜂群可以各自調整.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_ColonyGrowthMultiplie.cn: 调整每个生产周期新增多少蜜蜂与幼虫. 1.0 = 当前值, 2.0 = 两倍. 与蜂巢产量分开设置, 让蜂蜜与蜂群可以各自调整.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.ch: 蜜蜂憤怒持續時間倍率
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.cn: 蜜蜂愤怒持续时间倍率

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedBoostMultipli.en: Extra production while a hive is fed, on top of the forage the sugar water stands in for. 1.15 = 15%% faster, 1.0 = no bonus at all (the forage rescue still applies). Rain, snow and freezing still stop the hive no matter how well fed it is.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedBoostMultipli.ch: 蜂箱獲得餵食時的額外產量, 疊加在糖水所替代的蜜源之上. 1.15 = 快 15%%, 1.0 = 完全沒有加成 (糖水替代蜜源的保底仍然生效). 不論餵得多飽, 下雨, 下雪與結凍依然會讓蜂箱停止運作.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedBoostMultipli.cn: 蜂箱获得喂食时的额外产量, 叠加在糖水所替代的蜜源之上. 1.15 = 快 15%%, 1.0 = 完全没有加成 (糖水替代蜜源的保底仍然生效). 不论喂得多饱, 下雨, 下雪与结冻依然会让蜂箱停止运行.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.en: Sugar water: working hours per litre
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.ch: 糖水: 每公升可支撐的工作時數
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveFeedHoursPerLitre.cn: 糖水: 每升可支撑的工作时长

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadSpoilageEnabled_t.en: When disabled, a batch left too long holds at Aged quality forever instead of turning Spoiled.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadSpoilageEnabled_t.ch: 停用時, 放置過久的批次會永遠停留在熟成品質, 而不會變質.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_MeadSpoilageEnabled_t.cn: 禁用时, 放置过久的批次会永远停留在熟成品质, 而不会变质.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.en: Scales how long bees stay angry after you disturb or crack open hives and nests. 1.0 = current, 0 = they calm down almost immediately, 2.0 = twice as long.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.ch: 調整你擾動或敲開蜂巢與蜂窩後, 蜜蜂持續憤怒的時間. 1.0 = 目前值, 0 = 幾乎立刻平息, 2.0 = 兩倍長.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_AngryBeesDurationMult.cn: 调整你扰动或敲开蜂巢与蜂窝后, 蜜蜂持续愤怒的时间. 1.0 = 当前值, 0 = 几乎立刻平息, 2.0 = 两倍长.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.ch: 燻煙鎮定持續時間倍率
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_SmokeDurationMultipli.cn: 熏烟镇定持续时间倍率

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours.en: Jars left out sour into yeast after (hours)
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours.ch: 罐子放置多久後發酸成酵母 (小時)
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_JarSourHours.cn: 罐子放置多久后发酸成酵母 (小时)

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.en: How long placed queen larvae take to become a new queen. 48 = current (two days).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.ch: 放入的蜂后幼蟲需要多久才會長成新蜂后. 48 = 目前值 (兩天).
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLarvaeRaiseHours.cn: 放入的蜂后幼虫需要多久才会长成新蜂后. 48 = 当前值 (两天).

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance_toolti.en: Chance a harvest that collects honeycomb also yields propolis. 0.30 = current (30%%), 0 = never, 1.0 = always.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance_toolti.ch: 採收蜂巢時同時獲得蜂膠的機率. 0.30 = 目前值 (30%%), 0 = 永不, 1.0 = 必定獲得.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance_toolti.cn: 采收蜂巢时同时获得蜂胶的概率. 0.30 = 当前值 (30%%), 0 = 永不, 1.0 = 必定获得.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenForageWeightMult.en: Scales how often Queen Bees appear while foraging, in every zone. 1.0 = default scarcity (roughly one queen per 2-5 in-game hours of daytime foraging in forest zones, in season Apr-Oct, none Dec-Mar). 2.0 = about twice as common. 0 = queens never appear from foraging.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenForageWeightMult.ch: 調整所有區域中採集時遇到蜂后的頻率. 1.0 = 預設稀有度 (在森林區域白天採集, 產季 4 至 10 月時, 大約每 2-5 個遊戲小時出現一隻蜂后, 12 至 3 月完全不會出現). 2.0 = 約兩倍常見. 0 = 採集永遠不會找到蜂后.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenForageWeightMult.cn: 调整所有区域中采集时遇到蜂后的频率. 1.0 = 默认稀有度 (在森林区域白天采集, 产季 4 至 10 月时, 大约每 2-5 个游戏小时出现一只蜂后, 12 至 3 月完全不会出现). 2.0 = 约两倍常见. 0 = 采集永远不会找到蜂后.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveProductionSpeedMu.en: How fast a working hive fills its comb and grows. 1.0 = current pacing, 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed. Weather, temperature, flowers and feeding still apply on top.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveProductionSpeedMu.ch: 運作中的蜂箱填滿蜂巢與成長的速度. 1.0 = 目前節奏, 2.0 = 兩倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 天氣, 溫度, 花叢與餵食的影響仍會疊加其上.
Sandbox_HydeCoBees_HiveProductionSpeedMu.cn: 运行中的蜂箱填满蜂巢与成长的速度. 1.0 = 当前节奏, 2.0 = 两倍速, 0.5 = 半速. 天气, 温度, 花丛与喂食的影响仍会叠加其上.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_PropolisChance.cn: 采收时获得蜂胶的概率

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLifespanDays_too.en: How many days a queen lays before she needs replacing. 7 = current. Longer games may want 14-30. Applies to queens inserted or raised after the change.

Sandbox_HydeCoBees_QueenLifespanDays_too.cn: 蜂后能产卵几天后才需要更换. 7 = 当前值. 长期游玩的存档可考虑 14-30. 仅对修改后放入或培育出的蜂后生效.

Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_PauseWhileDriv.ch: 所有線上玩家都在載具裡時略過全域事件掃描, 並停止本模組對駕駛者的高溫、淋雨與強制風效更新. 進行中的天氣會保留, 絕不會被清除.

Sandbox_WorkingKnowledge_ConsumeOnRead_t.en: When enabled, a document is destroyed once it has been read, so it cannot be passed to another survivor. Intended for multiplayer servers that do not want a single copy training the whole group. Default: off.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowLifestyleManag.en: Compatibility toggle for Lifestyle: Hobbies. When disabled (default), traits that Lifestyle awards or removes from skill progression are excluded from recording, claiming, and loot journals. Restore the Lifestyle skill XP and let Lifestyle recalculate these traits. Enable only if you want journals to control the traits directly.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowLifestyleManag.ch: 與 Lifestyle: Hobbies 的相容開關. 停用時 (預設), 由 Lifestyle 依技能進度授予或移除的特質會從記錄, 領取與戰利品日記中排除. 請還原 Lifestyle 技能經驗值, 並讓 Lifestyle 重新計算這些特質. 僅在你希望由日記直接控制這些特質時才啟用.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowLifestyleManag.cn: 与 Lifestyle: Hobbies 的兼容开关. 禁用时 (默认), 由 Lifestyle 按技能进度授予或移除的特质会从记录, 领取和战利品日记中排除. 请还原 Lifestyle 技能经验值, 并让 Lifestyle 重新计算这些特质. 仅在你希望由日记直接控制这些特质时才启用.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillLearningTimeSc.ch: 每項技能固定時間 (舊版)
Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillLearningTimeSc.cn: 每项技能固定时间 (旧版)

Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillLearningTimeSc.ch: 可恢復總經驗值 (LG 風格)
Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillLearningTimeSc.cn: 可恢复总经验值 (LG 风格)

Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillLearningTimeSc.en: Controls how the learning time for each skill is calculated. Flat uses one base time per skill. Level Progress charges for the levels and partial levels actually recovered. Total XP charges from the skill's own XP curve, similar to LG Skill Journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillLearningTimeSc.ch: 控制每項技能學習時間的計算方式. 固定時間對每項技能使用同一基準時間. 等級進度依實際恢復的等級與部分等級計時. 總經驗值依該技能自身的經驗曲線計時, 類似 LG Skill Journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillLearningTimeSc.cn: 控制每项技能学习时间的计算方式. 固定时间对每项技能使用同一基准时间. 等级进度按实际恢复的等级与部分等级计时. 总经验值按该技能自身的经验曲线计时, 类似 LG Skill Journal.

Sandbox_HydeCoClay_PorcelainYieldMultipl.ch: 每件衛浴設備的瓷器產量
Sandbox_HydeCoClay_PorcelainYieldMultipl.cn: 每件卫浴洁具的瓷器产量

Sandbox_HydeCoClay_PorcelainYieldMultipl.en: Scales how many porcelain chunks a smashed toilet, sink or bathtub is worth. A toilet gives 4 to 9 at the default setting, a sink 3 to 7, a bathtub 8 to 15.
Sandbox_HydeCoClay_PorcelainYieldMultipl.ch: 調整打碎馬桶、水槽或浴缸能得到多少瓷塊. 預設值下馬桶給 4 到 9 塊, 水槽 3 到 7 塊, 浴缸 8 到 15 塊.
Sandbox_HydeCoClay_PorcelainYieldMultipl.cn: 调整打碎马桶、水槽或浴缸能得到多少瓷块. 默认设置下马桶给 4 到 9 块, 水槽 3 到 7 块, 浴缸 8 到 15 块.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_EnableSubOwners_.en: The safehouse owner can promote members to Sub-owner. Sub-owners can add and remove regular members, but cannot remove the owner, remove other sub-owners, change the owner or release the safehouse.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_EnableSubOwners_.ch: 安全屋屋主可以將成員升任為副屋主. 副屋主可以新增與移除普通成員, 但不能移除屋主或其他副屋主, 也不能變更屋主或放棄安全屋.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_EnableSubOwners_.cn: 安全屋屋主可以将成员升任为副屋主. 副屋主可以添加和移除普通成员, 但不能移除屋主或其他副屋主, 也不能更改屋主或放弃安全屋.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionAllowed.en: Roles that can freely expand and shrink. Comma-separated, example: Apoiador,VIP. The user role is ignored here.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionAllowed.ch: 可自由擴建和縮小的角色. 以逗號分隔, 例如: Apoiador,VIP.user 角色在此處會被忽略.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionAllowed.cn: 可自由扩建和缩小的角色. 用逗号分隔, 例如: Apoiador,VIP. 此处忽略user角色.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionBlockRo.en: When enabled, any expansion over configured road tiles is blocked.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionBlockRo.ch: 啟用後, 任何跨越已設定道路地塊的擴建都會被阻擋.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionBlockRo.cn: 启用后, 任何跨越已配置道路地块的扩建都会被阻止.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionBlocked.en: Comma-separated road floor sprites. Only used when Block roads is enabled.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionBlocked.ch: 以逗號分隔的道路地面貼圖. 僅在啟用「禁止擴建至道路」時使用.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionBlocked.cn: 用逗号分隔的道路地面贴图. 仅在启用'禁止扩建至道路'时使用.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionEnabled.en: Enables or disables the Better Safehouse expansion module.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionEnabled.ch: 啟用或停用更好的安全屋擴建模組.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionEnabled.cn: 启用或禁用更好的安全屋扩建模块.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionMaxTota.ch: 擴建後安全屋最大面積
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionMaxTota.cn: 扩建后安全屋最大面积

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionMaxTota.en: Hard cap for the final safehouse area after expansion (W*H tiles). Applies only to supporter/user expansion. 0 = no total size cap.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionMaxTota.ch: 擴建後最終安全屋區域的硬性上限 (W*H地塊).僅適用於贊助者/使用者擴建.0=無總面積上限.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionMaxTota.cn: 扩建后最终安全屋区域的硬性上限 (W*H地块). 仅适用于赞助者/用户扩建. 0=无总面积上限.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionRoleMax.en: Extra-tile limit above the original safehouse for supporter/roles.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionRoleMax.ch: 贊助者/角色在原始安全屋基礎上可增加的額外地塊上限.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionRoleMax.cn: 赞助者/角色在原始安全屋基础上可增加的额外地块上限.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionRoleSte.en: How many tiles each supporter/role click changes. Does not affect user.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionRoleSte.ch: 贊助者/角色每次點選變更的地塊數. 不影響使用者.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionRoleSte.cn: 赞助者/角色每次点击改变的地块数. 不影响用户.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserBor.en: Enables the independent user system. It does not depend on allowed roles.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserBor.ch: 啟用獨立的使用者系統. 不依賴允許的角色.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserBor.cn: 启用独立的用户系统. 不依赖于允许的角色.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserMax.en: How many tiles user can push outward on each border from the original safehouse. Example: 1 turns 10x10 into 12x12.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserMax.ch: 使用者可從原始安全屋每條邊界向外推出的地塊數. 例如: 1會將10x10變為12x12.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserMax.cn: 用户可从原始安全屋每条边界向外推出的地块数. 例如: 1会将10x10变为12x12.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MaxSubOwners.ch: 每個安全屋的副屋主上限
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MaxSubOwners.cn: 每个安全屋的副屋主上限

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MaxSubOwners_too.en: Maximum number of Sub-owners each safehouse can have. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MaxSubOwners_too.ch: 每個安全屋可擁有的副屋主數量上限.0=無限.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MaxSubOwners_too.cn: 每个安全屋可拥有的副屋主最大数量. 0=无限.

Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_SingleRespawnSaf.en: When a player enables respawn in one safehouse, Better Safehouse removes that player from the respawn list of all other safehouses.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_SingleRespawnSaf.ch: 當玩家在某個安全屋啟用重生後, 更好的安全屋會將該玩家從所有其他安全屋的重生清單中移除.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_SingleRespawnSaf.cn: 当玩家在一个安全屋启用重生后, 更好的安全屋会将该玩家从所有其他安全屋的重生列表中移除.

Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_EnableFirstFloorZ.cn: 巡之丘高中强制生成僵尸

Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_EnableFirstFloorZ.en: When enabled, zombies will be forcibly on the ground floor of Megurigaoka High when someone spawns there. Experimental and may be removed later.
Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_EnableFirstFloorZ.ch: 啟用後，當有人在巡之丘高中出生時，一樓會強制出現殭屍。實驗性功能，之後可能移除。
Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_EnableFirstFloorZ.cn: 启用后，当有人在巡之丘高中出生时，一楼会强制出现僵尸。实验性功能，之后可能移除。

Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_EnableRainReactio.en: When enabled, zombies retain some habits from their previous lives.
Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_EnableRainReactio.ch: 啟用後，殭屍會保留一些生前的習慣。
Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_EnableRainReactio.cn: 启用后，僵尸会保留一些生前的习惯。

Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_InfectionRework_t.en: When inflicted with the zombie infection, extra effects such as exhaustion, nausea, and pain will be inflicted. Also enables a 'cure' vaccine which can be rarely found...
Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_InfectionRework_t.ch: 感染殭屍病毒後，會額外出現疲憊、噁心、疼痛等效果。同時啟用一種僅有極低機率找到的解藥疫苗……
Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_InfectionRework_t.cn: 感染僵尸病毒后，会额外出现疲惫、恶心、疼痛等效果。同时启用一种仅有极低概率找到的解药疫苗……

Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_RainReactionPlaye.en: Determines the radius around the player in which zombies shelter from the rain. Lower this if you are experiencing lag spikes during rain.
Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_RainReactionPlaye.ch: 決定以玩家為中心、殭屍會躲雨的半徑範圍。如果下雨時出現卡頓，請調低此值。
Sandbox_ProjectGurashi_RainReactionPlaye.cn: 决定以玩家为中心、僵尸会躲雨的半径范围。如果下雨时出现卡顿，请调低此值。

Sandbox_SVRPClassicBowsLocal_FixedAiming.cn: 设置弓与弩计算命中率时使用的最低瞄准等级 (0-10). 如果角色的瞄准等级低于此值, 则改用该数值.

Sandbox_AutoAll_EnableOpen_tooltip.cn: -1 交由每位玩家自行决定, 0 对所有人强制关闭, 1 强制开启. 默认为 -1, 不做任何改变.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AutoOptOutUnready.ch: 自動排除未就緒的玩家
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AutoOptOutUnready.cn: 自动排除未准备的玩家

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AutoOptOutUnready.en:
Once a teammate readies, players who make no choice for one real minute are left out of the deployment. Readying or unreadying restarts this timer.

Players in the deployment vehicle must choose for themselves.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AutoOptOutUnready.ch:
一旦有隊友就緒, 1 分鐘現實時間內未做任何選擇的玩家就不會加入這次部署. 就緒或取消就緒都會重新計時.

已在部署車輛內的玩家必須自行選擇.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_AutoOptOutUnready.cn:
一旦有队友就绪, 1 分钟现实时间内未做任何选择的玩家就不会加入这次部署. 就绪或取消就绪都会重新计时.

已在部署车辆内的玩家必须自行选择.

Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EscalatingHordeWa.ch:
僅限一般突襲. 自由漫遊改用 24 小時間隔, 再加上情報中心的加成.

將週期性的完整屍潮改為五波逐次升級的威脅: 每一波分別為屍潮規模的 20%%, 50%%, 100%%, 150%%, 200%%. 預設間隔 20 分鐘, 從第一波到最後一波共需 80 遊戲內分鐘. 可用「屍潮波次間隔」調整間隔. 最後一波之後, 100%% 規模的殭屍波次會每 20 遊戲內分鐘持續出現, 直到所有突襲參與者撤離或死亡.

越後面的波次衝刺者越多. NPC 替換小隊使用所選的來源模組, 同樣依其設定規模的百分比縮放, 且出現機率提高.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EscalatingHordeWa.cn:
仅限普通突袭. 自由漫游改用 24 小时间隔, 再加上情报中心的加成.

将周期性的完整尸潮改为五波逐次升级的威胁: 每一波分别为尸潮规模的 20%%, 50%%, 100%%, 150%%, 200%%. 默认间隔 20 分钟, 从第一波到最后一波共需 80 游戏内分钟. 可用“尸潮波次间隔”调整间隔. 最后一波之后, 100%% 规模的僵尸波次会每 20 游戏内分钟持续出现, 直到所有突袭参与者撤离或死亡.

越靠后的波次冲刺者越多. NPC 替换小队使用所选的来源模组, 同样按其设定规模的百分比缩放, 且出现概率提高.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EscalatingHordeWa.en:
Normal Raids only. Free Roam uses a 24-hour interval plus the Intel Center bonus.

Replaces repeating full hordes with five increasingly dangerous waves: 20%%, 50%%, 100%%, 150%%, then 200%% of Horde Size per wave. The default 20-minute spacing takes 80 in-game minutes from the first wave to the last. Use Horde Wave Interval to change their spacing. After the final wave, 100%% zombie waves continue every 20 in-game minutes until all raid participants extract or die.

Later waves have more sprinters. NPC replacements use the selected provider, follow the same percentages of their configured size and become more likely.
Sandbox_ExtractionMode_EscalatingHordeWa._note:
修改鍵：上游把三波 20/30/50 改寫為五波 20/50/100/150/200%%、加入 80 分鐘總時長與最後一波之後每 20 分鐘重複的說明，並新增 

 第二段。沿現有譯文的屍潮/衝刺者/替換小隊用詞改寫，六個字面百分號維持 %% 形式（與 EN 相同數量），並保留 

。
