Sandbox_JD_MED_MedsPicks_tooltip.cn: 从物品池中选取几种不重复的药品.

Sandbox_JD_MED_MedsQty_tooltip.en: Base amount of each medication. Actual quantity varies from -1 to +3 of this value.
Sandbox_JD_MED_MedsQty_tooltip.ch: 每種藥品的基本數量. 實際數量會在此數值的 -1 到 +3 之間變動.
Sandbox_JD_MED_MedsQty_tooltip.cn: 每种药品的基础数量. 实际数量会在此数值的 -1 到 +3 之间浮动.

Sandbox_JD_MED_SupplyPicks.ch: 醫療: 不重複醫療用品種類
Sandbox_JD_MED_SupplyPicks.cn: 医疗: 不重复医疗用品种类

Sandbox_JD_MED_SupplyPicks_tooltip.en: How many unique medical supplies to pick from the pool.
Sandbox_JD_MED_SupplyPicks_tooltip.ch: 從物品池中選取幾種不重複的醫療用品.
Sandbox_JD_MED_SupplyPicks_tooltip.cn: 从物品池中选取几种不重复的医疗用品.

Sandbox_JD_MED_SupplyQty.ch: 醫療: 醫療用品數量
Sandbox_JD_MED_SupplyQty.cn: 医疗: 医疗用品数量

Sandbox_JD_MED_SupplyQty_tooltip.en: Base amount of each supply. Actual quantity varies from -1 to +3 of this value.
Sandbox_JD_MED_SupplyQty_tooltip.ch: 每種醫療用品的基本數量. 實際數量會在此數值的 -1 到 +3 之間變動.
Sandbox_JD_MED_SupplyQty_tooltip.cn: 每种医疗用品的基础数量. 实际数量会在此数值的 -1 到 +3 之间浮动.

Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoCartonChance.ch: 軍用: 整箱彈藥機率
Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoCartonChance.cn: 军用: 整箱弹药几率

Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoCartonChance_tooltip.en: Percent chance that an ammo pick which landed on a carton stays a carton instead of becoming that calibre's box. A carton opens to 12 boxes (240 rounds), a box to 20. 0 = boxes only, 100 = cartons as often as boxes.
Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoCartonChance_tooltip.ch: 抽中整箱彈藥時維持整箱, 而不變成該口徑盒裝彈藥的機率百分比. 一整箱可開出 12 盒 (240 發), 一盒為 20 發. 0 = 只有盒裝, 100 = 整箱與盒裝出現頻率相同.
Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoCartonChance_tooltip.cn: 抽中整箱弹药时保持整箱, 而不变成该口径盒装弹药的几率百分比. 一整箱可开出 12 盒 (240 发), 一盒为 20 发. 0 = 只有盒装, 100 = 整箱与盒装出现频率相同.

Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoCartonQty.ch: 軍用: 每種彈藥整箱數
Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoCartonQty.cn: 军用: 每种弹药整箱数

Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoCartonQty_tooltip.en: How many cartons spawn for an ammo type that stays a carton. Exact - cartons take no quantity variance, unlike boxes.
Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoCartonQty_tooltip.ch: 維持整箱的彈藥種類會生成幾箱. 數量固定——整箱不像盒裝那樣有數量浮動.
Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoCartonQty_tooltip.cn: 保持整箱的弹药种类会生成几箱. 数量固定——整箱不像盒装那样有数量浮动.

Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoPicks.ch: 軍用: 不重複彈藥種類
Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoPicks.cn: 军用: 不重复弹药种类

Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoPicks_tooltip.en: How many unique ammo types to pick. Ammo matching prioritizes rounds for the firearms in this crate.
Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoPicks_tooltip.ch: 選取幾種不重複的彈藥. 彈藥會優先搭配此補給箱內槍械所用的子彈.
Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoPicks_tooltip.cn: 选取几种不重复的弹药. 弹药会优先匹配此补给箱内枪械所用的子弹.

Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoQty_tooltip.en: Base amount of each ammo type. Actual quantity varies from -1 to +3 of this value.
Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoQty_tooltip.ch: 每種彈藥的基本數量. 實際數量會在此數值的 -1 到 +3 之間變動.
Sandbox_JD_MIL_AmmoQty_tooltip.cn: 每种弹药的基础数量. 实际数量会在此数值的 -1 到 +3 之间浮动.

Sandbox_JD_MIL_FirearmPicks_tooltip.en: How many unique firearms to pick. Each spawns exactly 1 copy plus 2 matching magazines (or extra ammo for shotguns).
Sandbox_JD_MIL_FirearmPicks_tooltip.ch: 選取幾把不重複的槍械. 每把只生成 1 把, 另附 2 個相符的彈匣 (霰彈槍則改為額外彈藥).
Sandbox_JD_MIL_FirearmPicks_tooltip.cn: 选取几把不重复的枪械. 每种只生成 1 把, 另附 2 个匹配的弹匣 (霰弹枪则改为额外弹药).

Sandbox_JD_MIL_GearPicks.ch: 軍用: 不重複裝備種類
Sandbox_JD_MIL_GearPicks.cn: 军用: 不重复装备种类

Sandbox_JD_MIL_GearPicks_tooltip.en: How many unique gear items (armor, backpacks, clothing) to pick. Each spawns exactly 1 copy.
Sandbox_JD_MIL_GearPicks_tooltip.ch: 選取幾種不重複的裝備物品 (護甲, 背包, 衣物). 每種只生成 1 件.
Sandbox_JD_MIL_GearPicks_tooltip.cn: 选取几种不重复的装备物品 (护甲, 背包, 衣物). 每种只生成 1 件.

Sandbox_JD_MarkerRange_tooltip.en: Players within this range see a directional marker.
Sandbox_JD_MarkerRange_tooltip.ch: 在此範圍內的玩家會看到方向標記.
Sandbox_JD_MarkerRange_tooltip.cn: 在此范围内的玩家会看到方向标记.

Sandbox_JD_PersonalDropClearance_tooltip.en: How much open space a personal airdrop needs around its landing tile so the crate never clips a wall or building. 0 checks only the landing tile; 1 (default) requires a clear 3x3; higher values demand more open ground and can make crowded areas harder to drop into.
Sandbox_JD_PersonalDropClearance_tooltip.ch: 個人空投在落點周圍需要多少開闊空間, 以免補給箱卡進牆壁或建築物. 0 只檢查落點本身; 1 (預設) 需要 3x3 的淨空範圍; 數值越高需要越大的開闊地面, 擁擠區域可能較難空投.
Sandbox_JD_PersonalDropClearance_tooltip.cn: 个人空投在落点周围需要多少开阔空间, 以免补给箱卡进墙壁或建筑物. 0 只检查落点本身; 1 (默认) 需要 3x3 的净空范围; 数值越高需要越大的开阔地面, 拥挤区域可能更难空投.

Sandbox_JD_RadioEnabled_tooltip.en: Allow Airdrop Radio items to spawn in the world and be used by players to call in supply drops.
Sandbox_JD_RadioEnabled_tooltip.ch: 允許空投無線電物品在世界中生成, 並讓玩家用來呼叫補給空投.
Sandbox_JD_RadioEnabled_tooltip.cn: 允许空投无线电物品在世界中生成, 并让玩家用来呼叫补给空投.

Sandbox_JD_RadioSpawnRate.ch: 空投無線電: 生成率
Sandbox_JD_RadioSpawnRate.cn: 空投无线电: 生成率

Sandbox_JD_RadioSpawnRate_tooltip.en: Relative spawn weight (1 = extremely rare, 100 = common). Default 10.
Sandbox_JD_RadioSpawnRate_tooltip.ch: 相對生成權重 (1 = 極為稀有, 100 = 常見). 預設 10.
Sandbox_JD_RadioSpawnRate_tooltip.cn: 相对生成权重 (1 = 极为稀有, 100 = 常见). 默认 10.

Sandbox_JD_RequireReachableCell_tooltip.en: Refuses to drop a crate on map cells that are not connected to any spawn region. Mods that give a vehicle a walk-in interior work by teleporting you onto a separate map of their own, so a drop called from inside one used to land out there, behind walls, on ground you could never reach. Leave this on unless drops stop working on an unusual map layout, where turning it off restores the previous behaviour.
Sandbox_JD_RequireReachableCell_tooltip.ch: 拒絕在未連接任何出生區域的地圖區塊上空投補給箱. 讓載具擁有可走入內部空間的 MOD, 是把你傳送到它們自己的獨立地圖上, 因此過去從這類內部呼叫的空投會落在那裡的牆後, 你永遠到不了的地面上. 除非空投在特殊地圖配置上失效, 否則請保持開啟; 關閉後會恢復先前的行為.
Sandbox_JD_RequireReachableCell_tooltip.cn: 拒绝在未连接任何出生区域的地图区块上空投补给箱. 让载具拥有可走入内部空间的 MOD, 是把你传送到它们自己的独立地图上, 因此过去从这类内部呼叫的空投会落在那里的墙后, 你永远到不了的地面上. 除非空投在特殊地图布局上失效, 否则请保持开启; 关闭后会恢复之前的行为.

Sandbox_JD_SE_AlarmRadius_tooltip.en: Audible range of the crate alarm at the event site. A single alarm plays for all three crates. Default 100.
Sandbox_JD_SE_AlarmRadius_tooltip.ch: 事件地點補給箱警報的可聽範圍. 三個補給箱只會播放一個警報. 預設 100.
Sandbox_JD_SE_AlarmRadius_tooltip.cn: 事件地点补给箱警报的可听范围. 三个补给箱只会播放一个警报. 默认 100.

Sandbox_JD_SE_Clearance_tooltip.en: How much clear space each supply crate requires around its footprint. 2 (default) requires a clear 5x5. Higher demands more open ground so crates land well away from walls; lower makes tight spots usable.
Sandbox_JD_SE_Clearance_tooltip.ch: 每個補給箱占地周圍需要多少淨空空間. 2 (預設) 需要 5x5 的淨空範圍. 數值越高需要越大的開闊地面, 讓補給箱落在遠離牆壁處; 數值越低則可使用較狹窄的地點.
Sandbox_JD_SE_Clearance_tooltip.cn: 每个补给箱占地周围需要多少净空空间. 2 (默认) 需要 5x5 的净空范围. 数值越高需要越大的开阔地面, 让补给箱落在远离墙壁处; 数值越低则可使用较狭窄的地点.

Sandbox_JD_SE_CrateSpread_tooltip.en: How far the three supply crates spread out from the event center before each searches for open ground. Larger values scatter the crates over a wider area. Default 15.
Sandbox_JD_SE_CrateSpread_tooltip.ch: 三個補給箱從事件中心向外分散的距離, 之後各自再尋找開闊地面. 數值越大, 補給箱散布的範圍越廣. 預設 15.
Sandbox_JD_SE_CrateSpread_tooltip.cn: 三个补给箱从事件中心向外分散的距离, 之后各自再寻找开阔地面. 数值越大, 补给箱散布的范围越广. 默认 15.

Sandbox_JD_SE_DespawnHours_tooltip.en: Hours before supply event crates disappear. Timer starts when the event is scheduled, not when players arrive. Default 24.
Sandbox_JD_SE_DespawnHours_tooltip.ch: 補給事件補給箱消失前的小時數. 計時從事件排定時開始, 而非玩家抵達時. 預設 24.
Sandbox_JD_SE_DespawnHours_tooltip.cn: 补给事件补给箱消失前的小时数. 计时从事件排定时开始, 而非玩家到达时. 默认 24.

Sandbox_JD_SE_Enabled_tooltip.en: Large-scale supply events at fixed map locations. Three boosted crates (Military, Food, Medical) spawn with heavy zombie resistance. Events are server-wide and broadcast to all players.
Sandbox_JD_SE_Enabled_tooltip.ch: 在固定地圖地點發生的大型補給事件. 會生成三個強化補給箱 (軍用, 食物, 醫療), 並有大量殭屍阻擋. 事件為全伺服器範圍, 並會廣播給所有玩家.
Sandbox_JD_SE_Enabled_tooltip.cn: 在固定地图地点发生的大型补给事件. 会生成三个强化补给箱 (军用, 食物, 医疗), 并有大量僵尸阻挡. 事件为全服务器范围, 并会广播给所有玩家.

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_DrinkPicks.ch: 食物/飲料: 不重複飲料種類
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_DrinkPicks.cn: 食物/饮料: 不重复饮料种类

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_DrinkPicks_tooltip.en: Unique drink items in the Supply Event Food/Drink crate. The Loot Multiplier scales this on top.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_DrinkPicks_tooltip.ch: 補給事件食物/飲料補給箱中不重複的飲料種類數. 戰利品倍率會在此之上再加乘.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_DrinkPicks_tooltip.cn: 补给事件食物/饮料补给箱中不重复的饮料种类数. 战利品倍率会在此之上再加乘.

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_DrinkQty.ch: 食物/飲料: 飲料數量
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_DrinkQty.cn: 食物/饮料: 饮料数量

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_DrinkQty_tooltip.en: Base amount of each drink in the Supply Event Food/Drink crate. Actual quantity varies from -1 to +3 of this value, then scaled by the Loot Multiplier.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_DrinkQty_tooltip.ch: 補給事件食物/飲料箱中每種飲料的基礎數量. 實際數量會在此值的 -1 到 +3 之間浮動, 再乘上戰利品倍率.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_DrinkQty_tooltip.cn: 补给事件食物/饮料箱中每种饮料的基础数量. 实际数量会在此值的 -1 到 +3 之间浮动, 再乘以战利品倍率.

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_FoodPicks.ch: 食物/飲料: 不重複食物種類
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_FoodPicks.cn: 食物/饮料: 不重复食物种类

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_FoodPicks_tooltip.en: Unique food items in the Supply Event Food/Drink crate. The Loot Multiplier scales this on top.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_FoodPicks_tooltip.ch: 補給事件食物/飲料箱中不重複的食物種類數. 戰利品倍率會在此基礎上再加乘.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_FoodPicks_tooltip.cn: 补给事件食物/饮料箱中不重复的食物种类数. 战利品倍率会在此基础上再加乘.

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_FoodQty.ch: 食物/飲料: 食物數量
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_FoodQty.cn: 食物/饮料: 食物数量

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_FoodQty_tooltip.en: Base amount of each food item in the Supply Event Food/Drink crate. Actual quantity varies from -1 to +3 of this value, then scaled by the Loot Multiplier.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_FoodQty_tooltip.ch: 補給事件食物/飲料箱中每種食物的基礎數量. 實際數量會在此值的 -1 到 +3 之間浮動, 再乘上戰利品倍率.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_FoodQty_tooltip.cn: 补给事件食物/饮料箱中每种食物的基础数量. 实际数量会在此值的 -1 到 +3 之间浮动, 再乘以战利品倍率.

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishablePicks.ch: 食物/飲料: 不重複易腐物品種類
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishablePicks.cn: 食物/饮料: 不重复易腐物品种类

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishablePicks_tooltip.en: Unique perishable items in the Supply Event Food/Drink crate. Only used when Include Perishables is enabled. The Loot Multiplier scales this on top.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishablePicks_tooltip.ch: 補給事件食物/飲料箱中不重複的易腐物品種類數. 僅在啟用「包含易腐物品」時使用. 戰利品倍率會在此基礎上再加乘.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishablePicks_tooltip.cn: 补给事件食物/饮料箱中不重复的易腐物品种类数. 仅在启用“包含易腐物品”时使用. 战利品倍率会在此基础上再加乘.

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishableQty.ch: 食物/飲料: 易腐物品數量
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishableQty.cn: 食物/饮料: 易腐物品数量

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishableQty_tooltip.en: Base amount of each perishable in the Supply Event Food/Drink crate. Actual quantity varies from -1 to +3, then scaled by the Loot Multiplier. Only used when Include Perishables is enabled.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishableQty_tooltip.ch: 補給事件食物/飲料箱中每種易腐物品的基礎數量. 實際數量會在 -1 到 +3 之間浮動, 再乘上戰利品倍率. 僅在啟用「包含易腐物品」時使用.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishableQty_tooltip.cn: 补给事件食物/饮料箱中每种易腐物品的基础数量. 实际数量会在 -1 到 +3 之间浮动, 再乘以战利品倍率. 仅在启用“包含易腐物品”时使用.

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishablesEnabled.ch: 食物/飲料: 包含易腐物品
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishablesEnabled.cn: 食物/饮料: 包含易腐物品

Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishablesEnabled_tool.en: Add a perishables sub-category to the Supply Event Food/Drink crate. Drops arrive fresh (full freshness regardless of world age), then perish naturally. Off by default.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishablesEnabled_tool.ch: 在補給事件食物/飲料箱中加入易腐物品子類別. 空投物資送達時是新鮮的 (無論世界經過多久都是完全新鮮), 之後會自然腐壞. 預設關閉.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FD_PerishablesEnabled_tool.cn: 在补给事件食物/饮料箱中加入易腐物品子类别. 空投物资送达时是新鲜的 (无论世界经过多久都是完全新鲜), 之后会自然腐坏. 默认关闭.

Sandbox_JD_SE_FrequencyDayMax_tooltip.en: Maximum in-game days between supply events. Default 14 (2 weeks). Exact hour within the day-range is randomized.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FrequencyDayMax_tooltip.ch: 兩次補給事件之間最多相隔的遊戲天數. 預設 14 (2 週). 天數範圍內的確切時刻為隨機.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FrequencyDayMax_tooltip.cn: 两次补给事件之间最多相隔的游戏天数. 默认 14 (2 周). 天数范围内的确切时刻为随机.

Sandbox_JD_SE_FrequencyDayMin_tooltip.en: Minimum in-game days between supply events. Default 7 (1 week). Exact hour within the day-range is randomized.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FrequencyDayMin_tooltip.ch: 兩次補給事件之間最少相隔的遊戲天數. 預設 7 (1 週). 天數範圍內的確切時刻為隨機.
Sandbox_JD_SE_FrequencyDayMin_tooltip.cn: 两次补给事件之间最少相隔的游戏天数. 默认 7 (1 周). 天数范围内的确切时刻为随机.

Sandbox_JD_SE_LootMultiplier_tooltip.en: Boost multiplier applied to all three event crates. Higher values increase item picks and quantities. Default 2x.
Sandbox_JD_SE_LootMultiplier_tooltip.ch: 套用到全部三個事件補給箱的加成倍率. 數值越高, 物品種類與數量越多. 預設 2 倍.
Sandbox_JD_SE_LootMultiplier_tooltip.cn: 应用于全部三个事件补给箱的加成倍率. 数值越高, 物品种类与数量越多. 默认 2 倍.

Sandbox_JD_SE_LureDuration_tooltip.en: In-game minutes of zombie lure pulses after all zombies have spawned. Keeps zombies moving toward the event site. Default 60.
Sandbox_JD_SE_LureDuration_tooltip.ch: 所有殭屍生成完畢後, 持續發出殭屍引誘脈衝的遊戲內分鐘數. 讓殭屍持續往事件地點移動. 預設 60.
Sandbox_JD_SE_LureDuration_tooltip.cn: 所有僵尸生成完毕后, 持续发出僵尸引诱脉冲的游戏内分钟数. 让僵尸持续往事件地点移动. 默认 60.

Sandbox_JD_SE_LureRadius_tooltip.en: Radius of zombie attraction pulses at the event center. Larger values draw zombies from further away. Default 300.
Sandbox_JD_SE_LureRadius_tooltip.ch: 事件中心殭屍吸引脈衝的半徑. 數值越大, 能從越遠的地方引來殭屍. 預設 300.
Sandbox_JD_SE_LureRadius_tooltip.cn: 事件中心僵尸吸引脉冲的半径. 数值越大, 能从越远的地方引来僵尸. 默认 300.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_KitChance.en: Medical: First Aid Kit / Bag Chance (%%)
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_KitChance.ch: 醫療: 急救箱/醫療包機率 (%%)
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_KitChance.cn: 医疗: 急救箱/医疗救护包几率 (%%)

Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_KitChance_tooltip.en: Percent chance the Supply Event Medical crate also contains one first aid kit or medical bag. 0 disables it, 100 always includes one.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_KitChance_tooltip.ch: 補給事件醫療箱額外內含一個急救箱或醫療包的機率 (百分比). 0 為停用, 100 為必定包含.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_KitChance_tooltip.cn: 补给事件医疗箱额外内含一个急救箱或医疗救护包的概率 (百分比). 0 为禁用, 100 为必定包含.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_MedsPicks.ch: 醫療: 不重複藥品種類
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_MedsPicks.cn: 医疗: 不重复药品种类

Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_MedsPicks_tooltip.en: Unique medications in the Supply Event Medical crate. The Loot Multiplier scales this on top.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_MedsPicks_tooltip.ch: 補給事件醫療箱中不重複的藥品種類數. 戰利品倍率會在此基礎上再加乘.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_MedsPicks_tooltip.cn: 补给事件医疗箱中不重复的药品种类数. 战利品倍率会在此基础上再加乘.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_MedsQty_tooltip.en: Base amount of each medication in the Supply Event Medical crate. Actual quantity varies from -1 to +3 of this value, then scaled by the Loot Multiplier.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_MedsQty_tooltip.ch: 補給事件醫療箱中每種藥品的基礎數量. 實際數量會在此值的 -1 到 +3 之間浮動, 再乘上戰利品倍率.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_MedsQty_tooltip.cn: 补给事件医疗箱中每种药品的基础数量. 实际数量会在此值的 -1 到 +3 之间浮动, 再乘以战利品倍率.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_SupplyPicks.ch: 醫療: 不重複醫療用品種類
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_SupplyPicks.cn: 医疗: 不重复医疗用品种类

Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_SupplyPicks_tooltip.en: Unique medical supplies in the Supply Event Medical crate. The Loot Multiplier scales this on top.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_SupplyPicks_tooltip.ch: 補給事件醫療箱中不重複的醫療用品種類數. 戰利品倍率會在此基礎上再加乘.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_SupplyPicks_tooltip.cn: 补给事件医疗箱中不重复的医疗用品种类数. 战利品倍率会在此基础上再加乘.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_SupplyQty.ch: 醫療: 醫療用品數量
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_SupplyQty.cn: 医疗: 医疗用品数量

Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_SupplyQty_tooltip.en: Base amount of each medical supply in the Supply Event Medical crate. Actual quantity varies from -1 to +3 of this value, then scaled by the Loot Multiplier.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_SupplyQty_tooltip.ch: 補給事件醫療箱中每種醫療用品的基礎數量. 實際數量會在此值的 -1 到 +3 之間浮動, 再乘上戰利品倍率.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MED_SupplyQty_tooltip.cn: 补给事件医疗箱中每种医疗用品的基础数量. 实际数量会在此值的 -1 到 +3 之间浮动, 再乘以战利品倍率.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoCartonChance.ch: 軍用: 整箱彈藥機率
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoCartonChance.cn: 军用: 整箱弹药几率

Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoCartonChance_toolt.en: Percent chance that an ammo pick which landed on a carton stays a carton in the Supply Event Military crate, instead of becoming that calibre's box. A carton opens to 12 boxes (240 rounds), a box to 20. 0 = boxes only, 100 = cartons as often as boxes.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoCartonChance_toolt.ch: 補給事件軍用箱中, 抽到整箱彈藥的項目維持為整箱, 而不轉為該口徑盒裝彈藥的機率 (百分比). 一整箱可拆成 12 盒 (240 發), 一盒 20 發. 0 = 只有盒裝, 100 = 整箱與盒裝出現頻率相同.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoCartonChance_toolt.cn: 补给事件军用箱中, 抽到整箱弹药的项目保持为整箱, 而不转为该口径盒装弹药的概率 (百分比). 一整箱可拆成 12 盒 (240 发), 一盒 20 发. 0 = 只有盒装, 100 = 整箱与盒装出现频率相同.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoCartonQty.ch: 軍用: 每種彈藥整箱數
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoCartonQty.cn: 军用: 每种弹药整箱数

Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoCartonQty_tooltip.en: How many cartons spawn for an ammo type that stays a carton in the Supply Event Military crate. Exact - cartons take no quantity variance. The Loot Multiplier scales this on top.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoCartonQty_tooltip.ch: 補給事件軍用箱中, 維持為整箱的彈藥類型會生成幾箱. 數量固定 - 整箱不套用數量浮動. 戰利品倍率會在此基礎上再加乘.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoCartonQty_tooltip.cn: 补给事件军用箱中, 保持为整箱的弹药类型会生成几箱. 数量固定 - 整箱不应用数量浮动. 战利品倍率会在此基础上再加乘.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoPicks.ch: 軍用: 不重複彈藥種類
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoPicks.cn: 军用: 不重复弹药种类

Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoPicks_tooltip.en: Unique ammo types in the Supply Event Military crate. Matching prioritizes rounds for the firearms in the crate. The Loot Multiplier scales this on top.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoPicks_tooltip.ch: 補給事件軍用箱中不重複的彈藥類型數. 會優先挑選箱內槍械可用的彈藥. 戰利品倍率會在此基礎上再加乘.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoPicks_tooltip.cn: 补给事件军用箱中不重复的弹药类型数. 会优先挑选箱内枪械可用的弹药. 战利品倍率会在此基础上再加乘.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoQty_tooltip.en: Base amount of each ammo type in the Supply Event Military crate. Actual quantity varies from -1 to +3 of this value, then scaled by the Loot Multiplier.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoQty_tooltip.ch: 補給事件軍用箱中每種彈藥的基礎數量. 實際數量會在此值的 -1 到 +3 之間浮動, 再乘上戰利品倍率.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_AmmoQty_tooltip.cn: 补给事件军用箱中每种弹药的基础数量. 实际数量会在此值的 -1 到 +3 之间浮动, 再乘以战利品倍率.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_FirearmPicks_tooltip.en: Unique firearms in the Supply Event Military crate. Each spawns 1 copy plus matching magazines (or extra ammo for shotguns). The Loot Multiplier scales this on top.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_FirearmPicks_tooltip.ch: 補給事件軍用箱中不重複的槍械種類數. 每種生成 1 把, 並附上對應的彈匣 (霰彈槍則附額外彈藥). 戰利品倍率會在此基礎上再加乘.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_FirearmPicks_tooltip.cn: 补给事件军用箱中不重复的枪械种类数. 每种生成 1 把, 并附上对应的弹匣 (霰弹枪则附额外弹药). 战利品倍率会在此基础上再加乘.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_GearPicks.ch: 軍用: 不重複裝備種類
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_GearPicks.cn: 军用: 不重复装备种类

Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_GearPicks_tooltip.en: Unique gear items (armor, backpacks, clothing) in the Supply Event Military crate. Each spawns 1 copy. The Loot Multiplier scales this on top.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_GearPicks_tooltip.ch: 補給事件軍用箱中不重複的裝備種類數 (護甲, 背包, 衣物). 每種生成 1 件. 戰利品倍率會在此基礎上再加乘.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MIL_GearPicks_tooltip.cn: 补给事件军用箱中不重复的装备种类数 (护甲, 背包, 衣物). 每种生成 1 件. 战利品倍率会在此基础上再加乘.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MaxSearch_tooltip.en: How far each supply crate may search outward from its spread position to find genuinely open ground. Higher values almost guarantee all three crates land in the open (never inside a building), at the cost of a larger event footprint. Default 50.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MaxSearch_tooltip.ch: 每個補給箱從分散位置往外搜尋真正空曠地面的最大距離. 數值越高, 越能確保三個補給箱都落在空曠處 (絕不會落入建築物內), 代價是事件範圍更大. 預設 50.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MaxSearch_tooltip.cn: 每个补给箱从分散位置往外搜索真正空旷地面的最大距离. 数值越高, 越能确保三个补给箱都落在空旷处 (绝不会落入建筑物内), 代价是事件范围更大. 默认 50.

Sandbox_JD_SE_MoodleRange_tooltip.en: Distance at which the Supply Event moodle appears for players. Default 1000.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MoodleRange_tooltip.ch: 玩家在多遠距離內會出現補給事件狀態圖示. 預設 1000.
Sandbox_JD_SE_MoodleRange_tooltip.cn: 玩家在多远距离内会出现补给事件状态图标. 默认 1000.

Sandbox_JD_SE_SpawnDuration.ch: 殭屍生成持續時間 (分鐘)
Sandbox_JD_SE_SpawnDuration.cn: 僵尸生成持续时间 (分钟)

Sandbox_JD_SE_SpawnDuration_tooltip.en: In-game minutes over which zombies gradually spawn after players arrive. Default 60.
Sandbox_JD_SE_SpawnDuration_tooltip.ch: 玩家抵達後, 殭屍逐步生成所花費的遊戲內分鐘數. 預設 60.
Sandbox_JD_SE_SpawnDuration_tooltip.cn: 玩家抵达后, 僵尸逐步生成所花费的游戏内分钟数. 默认 60.

Sandbox_JD_SE_StartDay_tooltip.en: First in-game day supply events can begin. Default 14.
Sandbox_JD_SE_StartDay_tooltip.ch: 補給事件最早可開始的遊戲天數. 預設 14.
Sandbox_JD_SE_StartDay_tooltip.cn: 补给事件最早可开始的游戏天数. 默认 14.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieCount_tooltip.en: Total zombies spawned at the event site when players arrive. Max 500. Default 200.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieCount_tooltip.ch: 玩家抵達時在事件地點生成的殭屍總數. 上限 500. 預設 200.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieCount_tooltip.cn: 玩家抵达时在事件地点生成的僵尸总数. 上限 500. 默认 200.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieRadiusMax_tooltip.en: Maximum distance from event center where zombies spawn. Default 80.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieRadiusMax_tooltip.ch: 殭屍生成位置距事件中心的最大距離. 預設 80.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieRadiusMax_tooltip.cn: 僵尸生成位置距事件中心的最大距离. 默认 80.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieRadiusMin_tooltip.en: Minimum distance from event center where zombies spawn. Default 30.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieRadiusMin_tooltip.ch: 殭屍生成位置距事件中心的最小距離. 預設 30.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieRadiusMin_tooltip.cn: 僵尸生成位置距事件中心的最小距离. 默认 30.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightCivilian.ch: 殭屍類型: 平民權重
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightCivilian.cn: 僵尸类型: 平民权重

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightCivilian_toolt.en: Relative chance an event zombie wears a civilian outfit (medical, trades, generic, inmate, etc.). Low-value loot. Raise it to make event corpses less rewarding relative to the crates. 0 disables the category. Default 10.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightCivilian_toolt.ch: 事件殭屍穿著平民服裝 (醫護, 工匠, 一般, 囚犯等) 的相對機率. 戰利品價值低. 提高此值可讓事件屍體相對於補給箱更沒油水. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 10.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightCivilian_toolt.cn: 事件僵尸穿着平民服装 (医护, 工匠, 一般, 囚犯等) 的相对概率. 战利品价值低. 提高此值可让事件尸体相对于补给箱更没油水. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 10.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightHostile.ch: 殭屍類型: 敵對者/掠奪者權重
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightHostile.cn: 僵尸类型: 敌对者/掠夺者权重

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightHostile_toolti.en: Relative chance an event zombie wears a bandit, raider, biker, thug, or punk outfit. 0 disables the category. Default 15.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightHostile_toolti.ch: 事件殭屍穿著土匪, 掠奪者, 機車騎士, 暴徒或龐克服裝的相對機率. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 15.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightHostile_toolti.cn: 事件僵尸穿着土匪, 掠夺者, 摩托车手, 暴徒或朋克服装的相对概率. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 15.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightMilitary.ch: 殭屍類型: 軍人權重
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightMilitary.cn: 僵尸类型: 军人权重

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightMilitary_toolt.en: Relative chance an event zombie wears a military outfit (Army camo, service uniform, Veteran, Ghillie). These carry the most valuable lootable gear, which can out-value the crates. Lower it to reduce loot piñatas. 0 disables the category. Default 30. Includes the Army instructor outfit.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightMilitary_toolt.ch: 事件殭屍穿著軍裝 (陸軍迷彩, 常服, 退伍軍人, 吉利服) 的相對機率. 他們身上帶有最值錢的可搜刮裝備, 價值可能超過補給箱. 降低此值可減少「行走的寶箱」. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 30. 包含陸軍教官服裝.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightMilitary_toolt.cn: 事件僵尸穿着军装 (陆军迷彩, 常服, 退伍军人, 吉利服) 的相对概率. 他们身上带有最值钱的可搜刮装备, 价值可能超过补给箱. 降低此值可减少“行走的宝箱”. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 30. 包含陆军教官服装.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman.en: Supply Event - Zombie Type: Outdoorsman Weight
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman.ch: 補給事件 - 殭屍類型: 戶外人士權重
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman.cn: 补给事件 - 僵尸类型: 户外人士权重

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman_to.en: Relative chance a supply-event zombie wears a ranger, hunter, or private-militia outfit. Was part of the old combined Tactical weight. 0 disables the category. Default 7.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman_to.ch: 補給事件殭屍穿著巡山員, 獵人或民兵服裝的相對機率. 原屬於舊版合併的「戰術」權重. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 7.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman_to.cn: 补给事件僵尸穿着护林员, 猎人或民兵服装的相对概率. 原属于旧版合并的“战术”权重. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 7.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity.ch: 殭屍類型: 警察/保全權重
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity.cn: 僵尸类型: 警察/保安权重

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity.en: Relative chance an event zombie wears a police, riot, security, prison-guard, or fireman outfit. Also high-value loot. 0 disables the category. Default 25. Includes SWAT, sheriff's deputy and the full fireman suit.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity.ch: 事件殭屍穿著警察, 鎮暴, 保全, 獄警或消防員服裝的相對機率. 同樣是高價值戰利品. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 25. 包含 SWAT, 警長副手與全套消防服.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity.cn: 事件僵尸穿着警察, 防暴, 保安, 狱警或消防员服装的相对概率. 同样是高价值战利品. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 25. 包含 SWAT, 副警长与全套消防服.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightSurvivalist.en: Supply Event - Zombie Type: Survivalist Weight
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightSurvivalist.ch: 補給事件 - 殭屍類型: 生存專家權重
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightSurvivalist.cn: 补给事件 - 僵尸类型: 生存专家权重

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightSurvivalist_to.en: Relative chance a supply-event zombie wears one of the five Survivalist outfits - the survivor look, carrying packs, tools and boots. Separate from Outdoorsman so survivors can be weighted on their own. 0 disables the category. Default 13.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightSurvivalist_to.ch: 補給事件殭屍穿著五套生存專家服裝之一的相對機率 - 倖存者造型, 帶著背包, 工具和靴子. 與戶外人士分開, 以便單獨調整倖存者的權重. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 13.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZombieWeightSurvivalist_to.cn: 补给事件僵尸穿着五套生存专家服装之一的相对概率 - 幸存者造型, 带着背包, 工具和靴子. 与户外人士分开, 以便单独调整幸存者的权重. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 13.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneDanger_tooltip.en: Danger level shown by the drop's zone moodle: 1 low (shield), 2 medium (warning), 3 high (skull). Default 3.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneDanger_tooltip.ch: 空投區域狀態圖示顯示的危險等級: 1 低 (盾牌), 2 中 (警告), 3 高 (骷髏). 預設 3.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneDanger_tooltip.cn: 空投区域状态图标显示的危险等级: 1 低 (盾牌), 2 中 (警告), 3 高 (骷髅). 默认 3.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneEnabled.ch: 空投周圍的危險/PvP 區域
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneEnabled.cn: 空投周围的危险/PvP 区域

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneEnabled_tooltip.en: Creates a temporary Jeeve's Zones danger/PvP zone around each supply drop, removed when the event ends. Requires Jeeve's Zones installed; otherwise has no effect. Default ON.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneEnabled_tooltip.ch: 在每次補給空投周圍建立暫時的 Jeeve's Zones 危險/PvP 區域, 事件結束時移除. 需要安裝 Jeeve's Zones, 否則無效果. 預設開啟.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneEnabled_tooltip.cn: 在每次补给空投周围创建临时的 Jeeve's Zones 危险/PvP 区域, 事件结束时移除. 需要安装 Jeeve's Zones, 否则无效果. 默认开启.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZonePvP_tooltip.en: If ON, the drop's zone is flagged PvP (a hot pocket on an otherwise-safe map when Default-PvP is off). Requires the server PVP setting ON to have any effect. Default ON.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZonePvP_tooltip.ch: 開啟時, 空投區域會標記為 PvP (在預設 PvP 關閉的安全地圖上形成一塊熱區). 需要伺服器 PVP 設定開啟才會生效. 預設開啟.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZonePvP_tooltip.cn: 开启时, 空投区域会标记为 PvP (在默认 PvP 关闭的安全地图上形成一块热区). 需要服务器 PVP 设置开启才会生效. 默认开启.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneRadius_tooltip.en: Half-size of the drop's danger/PvP zone, in tiles from the center. 60 covers a 120x120 area. Match it to your zombie spawn radius so the fighting stays inside the marked zone. Default 60.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneRadius_tooltip.ch: 空投危險/PvP 區域的半邊長, 以距中心的格數計. 60 可涵蓋 120x120 的範圍. 請與殭屍生成半徑相符, 讓戰鬥維持在標記區域內. 預設 60.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneRadius_tooltip.cn: 空投危险/PvP 区域的半边长, 以距中心的格数计. 60 可覆盖 120x120 的范围. 请与僵尸生成半径相符, 让战斗保持在标记区域内. 默认 60.

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneShowOnMap.ch: 在地圖上顯示空投區域
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneShowOnMap.cn: 在地图上显示空投区域

Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneShowOnMap_tooltip.en: If ON, the drop's danger/PvP zone is drawn on the player world map. If OFF, the zone still applies (PvP, danger moodle, zombies) but is hidden from the map, so players feel it without seeing the outline. Requires Jeeve's Zones installed. Default ON.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneShowOnMap_tooltip.ch: 開啟時, 空投的危險/PvP 區域會繪製在玩家的世界地圖上. 關閉時, 區域仍然生效 (PvP, 危險狀態圖示, 殭屍), 但不會顯示在地圖上, 玩家能感受到卻看不到範圍輪廓. 需要安裝 Jeeve's Zones. 預設開啟.
Sandbox_JD_SE_ZoneShowOnMap_tooltip.cn: 开启时, 空投的危险/PvP 区域会绘制在玩家的世界地图上. 关闭时, 区域仍然生效 (PvP, 危险状态图标, 僵尸), 但不会显示在地图上, 玩家能感受到却看不到范围轮廓. 需要安装 Jeeve's Zones. 默认开启.

Sandbox_JD_TM_MeleePicks.ch: 工具/近戰: 不重複近戰武器
Sandbox_JD_TM_MeleePicks.cn: 工具/近战: 不重复近战武器

Sandbox_JD_TM_MeleePicks_tooltip.en: How many unique melee weapons to pick. Each spawns exactly 1 copy.
Sandbox_JD_TM_MeleePicks_tooltip.ch: 要挑選幾種不重複的近戰武器. 每種只生成 1 把.
Sandbox_JD_TM_MeleePicks_tooltip.cn: 要挑选几种不重复的近战武器. 每种只生成 1 把.

Sandbox_JD_TM_ToolPicks.ch: 工具/近戰: 不重複工具
Sandbox_JD_TM_ToolPicks.cn: 工具/近战: 不重复工具

Sandbox_JD_TM_ToolPicks_tooltip.en: How many unique tools to pick. Each spawns exactly 1 copy.
Sandbox_JD_TM_ToolPicks_tooltip.ch: 要挑選幾種不重複的工具. 每種只生成 1 件.
Sandbox_JD_TM_ToolPicks_tooltip.cn: 要挑选几种不重复的工具. 每种只生成 1 件.

Sandbox_JD_ZombieCount_tooltip.en: Number of zombies that spawn around the crate when it lands. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieCount_tooltip.ch: 補給箱落地時在周圍生成的殭屍數量. 設為 0 即停用.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieCount_tooltip.cn: 补给箱落地时在周围生成的僵尸数量. 设为 0 即禁用.

Sandbox_JD_ZombieRadiusMax_tooltip.en: Maximum radius around the crate where zombies spawn. Each zombie picks a random radius between min and max.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieRadiusMax_tooltip.ch: 補給箱周圍殭屍生成的最大半徑. 每隻殭屍會在下限與上限之間隨機選一個半徑.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieRadiusMax_tooltip.cn: 补给箱周围僵尸生成的最大半径. 每只僵尸会在下限与上限之间随机选一个半径.

Sandbox_JD_ZombieRadiusMin_tooltip.en: Minimum radius around the crate where zombies spawn.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieRadiusMin_tooltip.ch: 補給箱周圍殭屍生成的最小半徑.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieRadiusMin_tooltip.cn: 补给箱周围僵尸生成的最小半径.

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightCivilian.ch: 殭屍類型: 平民權重
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightCivilian.cn: 僵尸类型: 平民权重

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightCivilian_tooltip.en: Relative chance an airdrop zombie wears a civilian outfit (medical, trades, generic, inmate, etc.). Low-value loot. Raise it to make airdrop corpses less rewarding. 0 disables the category. Default 45.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightCivilian_tooltip.ch: 空投殭屍穿著平民服裝 (醫護, 工匠, 一般, 囚犯等) 的相對機率. 戰利品價值低. 提高此值可讓空投屍體更沒油水. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 45.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightCivilian_tooltip.cn: 空投僵尸穿着平民服装 (医护, 工匠, 一般, 囚犯等) 的相对概率. 战利品价值低. 提高此值可让空投尸体更没油水. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 45.

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightHostile.ch: 殭屍類型: 敵對者/掠奪者權重
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightHostile.cn: 僵尸类型: 敌对者/掠夺者权重

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightHostile_tooltip.en: Relative chance an airdrop zombie wears a bandit, raider, biker, thug, or punk outfit. 0 disables the category. Default 10.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightHostile_tooltip.ch: 空投殭屍穿著土匪, 掠奪者, 機車騎士, 暴徒或龐克服裝的相對機率. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 10.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightHostile_tooltip.cn: 空投僵尸穿着土匪, 掠夺者, 摩托车手, 暴徒或朋克服装的相对概率. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 10.

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightMilitary.ch: 殭屍類型: 軍人權重
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightMilitary.cn: 僵尸类型: 军人权重

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightMilitary_tooltip.en: Relative chance an airdrop zombie wears a military outfit (Army camo, service uniform, Veteran, Ghillie). These carry the most valuable lootable gear. Lower it to stop airdrop corpses out-valuing the crate. 0 disables the category. Default 15. Includes the Army instructor outfit.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightMilitary_tooltip.ch: 空投殭屍穿著軍裝 (陸軍迷彩, 常服, 退伍軍人, 吉利服) 的相對機率. 他們身上帶有最值錢的可搜刮裝備. 降低此值可避免空投屍體的價值超過補給箱. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 15. 包含陸軍教官服裝.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightMilitary_tooltip.cn: 空投僵尸穿着军装 (陆军迷彩, 常服, 退伍军人, 吉利服) 的相对概率. 他们身上带有最值钱的可搜刮装备. 降低此值可避免空投尸体的价值超过补给箱. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 15. 包含陆军教官服装.

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman.ch: 殭屍類型: 戶外人士權重
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman.cn: 僵尸类型: 户外人士权重

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman_toolt.en: Relative chance an airdrop zombie wears a ranger, hunter, or private-militia outfit. Was part of the old combined Tactical weight. 0 disables the category. Default 5.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman_toolt.ch: 空投殭屍穿著巡山員, 獵人或民兵服裝的相對機率. 原屬於舊版合併的「戰術」權重. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 5.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightOutdoorsman_toolt.cn: 空投僵尸穿着护林员, 猎人或民兵服装的相对概率. 原属于旧版合并的“战术”权重. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 5.

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity.ch: 殭屍類型: 警察/保全權重
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity.cn: 僵尸类型: 警察/保安权重

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity_to.en: Relative chance an airdrop zombie wears a police, riot, security, prison-guard, or fireman outfit. Also high-value loot. 0 disables the category. Default 15. Includes SWAT, sheriff's deputy and the full fireman suit.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity_to.ch: 空投殭屍穿著警察, 鎮暴, 保全, 獄警或消防員服裝的相對機率. 同樣是高價值戰利品. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 15. 包含 SWAT, 警長副手與全套消防服.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightPoliceSecurity_to.cn: 空投僵尸穿着警察, 防暴, 保安, 狱警或消防员服装的相对概率. 同样是高价值战利品. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 15. 包含 SWAT, 副警长与全套消防服.

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightSurvivalist.ch: 殭屍類型: 生存專家權重
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightSurvivalist.cn: 僵尸类型: 生存专家权重

Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightSurvivalist_toolt.en: Relative chance an airdrop zombie wears one of the five Survivalist outfits - the survivor look, carrying packs, tools and boots. Separate from Outdoorsman so survivors can be weighted on their own. 0 disables the category. Default 10.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightSurvivalist_toolt.ch: 空投殭屍穿著五套生存專家服裝之一的相對機率 - 倖存者造型, 帶著背包, 工具和靴子. 與戶外人士分開, 以便單獨調整倖存者的權重. 0 為停用此類別. 預設 10.
Sandbox_JD_ZombieWeightSurvivalist_toolt.cn: 空投僵尸穿着五套生存专家服装之一的相对概率 - 幸存者造型, 带着背包, 工具和靴子. 与户外人士分开, 以便单独调整幸存者的权重. 0 为禁用此类别. 默认 10.

Sandbox_PhunZones_ExemptModGM_tooltip.en: Extends 'Staff ignore zone restrictions' to the Moderator, GM and Overseer roles as well as Admin. Has no effect unless that option is on.
Sandbox_PhunZones_ExemptModGM_tooltip.ch: 除管理員外, 也將「管理人員無視區域限制」套用到版主, GM 與監督員角色. 需開啟該選項才有效果.
Sandbox_PhunZones_ExemptModGM_tooltip.cn: 除管理员外, 也将“管理人员无视区域限制”应用到版主, GM 和监督员角色. 需开启该选项才有效果.

Sandbox_PhunZones_ManageNoPvpZones_toolt.en: When on, safe zones are registered with the games own non-pvp zone list. Turn it off to manage that list by hand through the admin panel instead - PhunZones will then remove the zones it created.
Sandbox_PhunZones_ManageNoPvpZones_toolt.ch: 開啟時, 安全區會加入遊戲本身的非 PvP 區域清單. 關閉則改由管理面板手動管理該清單 - 屆時趣味區域會移除它所建立的區域.
Sandbox_PhunZones_ManageNoPvpZones_toolt.cn: 开启时, 安全区会注册到游戏自身的非 PvP 区域列表. 关闭则改为通过管理面板手动管理该列表 - 届时趣味区域会移除它创建的区域.

Sandbox_PhunZones_StaffExempt.ch: 管理人員無視區域限制
Sandbox_PhunZones_StaffExempt.cn: 管理人员无视区域限制

Sandbox_PhunZones_StaffExempt_tooltip.en: When on, staff are not blocked by a zone's No Building, No Placing, No Pickup, No Scrapping, No Destruction, No Safehouse or No Players settings. By itself this covers the Admin role only - tick 'Include Moderator and GM' to widen it. No Fire and safe zones are never exempted: neither check has a player to let through.
Sandbox_PhunZones_StaffExempt_tooltip.ch: 開啟時, 管理人員不受區域的禁止建造, 禁止放置, 禁止拾取, 禁止拆解, 禁止破壞, 禁止安全屋或禁止玩家設定阻擋. 此選項本身僅涵蓋管理員角色 - 勾選「包含版主與 GM」可擴大範圍. 禁止用火與安全區永遠不會豁免: 這兩項檢查都沒有可放行的玩家.
Sandbox_PhunZones_StaffExempt_tooltip.cn: 开启时, 管理人员不受区域的禁止建造, 禁止放置, 禁止拾取, 禁止拆解, 禁止破坏, 禁止安全屋或禁止玩家设置阻挡. 此选项本身仅涵盖管理员角色 - 勾选“包括版主和 GM”可扩大范围. 禁止用火和安全区永远不会豁免: 这两项检查都没有可放行的玩家.

Sandbox_DynamicZ_AlwaysShowLeaderNameTex.en: Shows and continuously refreshes the archetype label over nearby leaders so it remains visible, including while driving. This setting is not overridden by the quick preset.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AlwaysShowLeaderNameTex.ch: 在附近領袖頭上顯示並持續更新原型標籤, 讓它保持可見, 包括駕駛時. 此設定不會被快速預設覆蓋.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_AlwaysShowLeaderNameTex.cn: 在附近领袖头上显示并持续刷新原型标签, 使其保持可见, 包括驾驶时. 此设置不会被快速预设覆盖.

Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableDebugOverlay_tool.en: Shows the Dynamic Evolution Z status overlay while debug mode is enabled. Disable it to keep debug commands available without the on-screen overlay.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableDebugOverlay_tool.ch: 在偵錯模式啟用時顯示動態進化 Z 狀態疊加層. 停用它可保留偵錯指令, 但不顯示螢幕上的疊加層.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_EnableDebugOverlay_tool.cn: 在调试模式启用时显示动态进化 Z 状态覆盖层. 禁用它可保留调试命令, 但不显示屏幕上的覆盖层.

Sandbox_DynamicZ_PauseAIWhileDriving_too.en: Pauses Dynamic Evolution Z batch AI when every active player is travelling in a vehicle, plus local leader scans for the driver. Vanilla zombie AI remains active.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_PauseAIWhileDriving_too.ch: 當所有活躍玩家都在載具中行駛時, 暫停動態進化 Z 的批次 AI, 以及針對駕駛者的本地領袖掃描. 原版殭屍 AI 仍保持運作.
Sandbox_DynamicZ_PauseAIWhileDriving_too.cn: 当所有活跃玩家都在载具中行驶时, 暂停动态进化 Z 的批处理 AI, 以及针对驾驶者的本地领袖扫描. 原版僵尸 AI 仍保持运行.

Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_EnableBreathingM.en: When enabled, gas masks, respirators and sealed suits make running and sprinting cost more endurance.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_EnableBreathingM.ch: 啟用後, 防毒面具, 呼吸器與密封防護服會讓奔跑和衝刺消耗更多耐力.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_EnableBreathingM.cn: 启用后, 防毒面具, 呼吸器和密封防护服会让奔跑和冲刺消耗更多耐力.

Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_PhysicalLoadScal.en: Scales how much worn gear slows endurance recovery and makes exertion cost more. 1.0 is the default, 0 turns the weight effect off, 2.0 doubles it.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_PhysicalLoadScal.ch: 調整穿戴裝備減緩耐力恢復, 以及增加出力消耗的程度. 1.0 為預設, 0 關閉重量效果, 2.0 為兩倍.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_PhysicalLoadScal.cn: 调整穿戴装备减缓耐力恢复, 以及增加用力消耗的程度. 1.0 为默认, 0 关闭重量效果, 2.0 为两倍.

Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeDamageEna.en: When enabled, legacy direct HP damage is processed in realtime OnTick instead of minute ticks.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeDamageEna.ch: 啟用後, 傳統直接生命值傷害會在 OnTick 中即時處理, 而非每分鐘處理.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeDamageEna.cn: 启用后, 传统直接生命伤害会在 OnTick 中实时处理, 而非每分钟处理.

Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeMaxHealth.ch: 傳統即時每秒生命值傷害上限
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeMaxHealth.cn: 传统实时每秒生命伤害上限

Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeMaxHealth.en: Maximum legacy HP damage that can be applied per second in realtime mode.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeMaxHealth.ch: 即時模式下每秒可套用的傳統生命值傷害上限.
Sandbox_ToxicSky_LegacyRealtimeMaxHealth.cn: 实时模式下每秒可应用的传统生命伤害上限.

Sandbox_PhunMart_ChangeDropMode_tooltip.en: How a zombie's coin drop reaches the player. This only picks the form it arrives in: the drop chance and the min/max amounts above still apply to all three, as does any per-zone tuning from PhunZones.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChangeDropMode_tooltip.ch: 殭屍掉落的硬幣如何交到玩家手上. 這只決定送達的形式: 上方的掉落機率與最小/最大數量對三種方式都適用, PhunZones 的各區域調整也一樣.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChangeDropMode_tooltip.cn: 僵尸掉落的硬币如何到达玩家手中. 这只决定到达的形式: 上方的掉落概率与最小/最大数量对三种方式都适用, PhunZones 的各区域调整也一样.

Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletOnDeath.en: What happens to a balance on death
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletOnDeath.ch: 死亡時餘額的處理方式
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletOnDeath.cn: 死亡时余额的处理方式

Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletOnDeath_tooltip.en: Dropped leaves a wallet on the ground where the player died, to be walked back for, scaled by the return rate below. It lands on the ground rather than on the corpse so that a zombie wandering into a zone that clears zombies cannot carry it off. Kept moves the balance straight to the next character, with nothing to recover. Lost wipes it. Bound pools such as tokens are restored to their allowance in all three.
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletOnDeath_tooltip.ch: 「掉落」會在玩家死亡處的地面留下一個錢包, 需要走回去取回, 金額依下方的返還比例調整. 錢包會落在地面而非屍體上, 以免殭屍走進會清除殭屍的區域時把它帶走. 「保留」會將餘額直接轉移到下一個角色, 無需取回. 「遺失」則會將其清空. 代幣等綁定資金池在三種方式下都會恢復到其額度.
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletOnDeath_tooltip.cn: “掉落”会在玩家死亡处的地面留下一个钱包, 需要走回去取回, 金额按下方的返还比例调整. 钱包会落在地面而不是尸体上, 以免僵尸走进会清除僵尸的区域时把它带走. “保留”会将余额直接转移到下一个角色, 无需取回. “丢失”则会将其清空. 代币等绑定资金池在三种方式下都会恢复到其额度.

Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_AppetiteRate.en: Multiplies how quickly hunger returns. Stacks with Project Zomboid's Stats Decrease setting. Does not change calorie burn or weight. 1.0 keeps the intended NMS balance.
Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_AppetiteRate.ch: 調整飢餓感回來的速度. 會與 Project Zomboid 的「狀態數值降低」設定疊加. 不會改變熱量消耗或體重. 1.0 為 NMS 預期的平衡.
Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_AppetiteRate.cn: 调整饥饿感回来的速度. 会与 Project Zomboid 的“状态减少速度”设置叠加. 不会改变热量消耗或体重. 1.0 为 NMS 预期的平衡.

Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_EnergyBurnMu.en: Multiplies how quickly calories are burned during rest, movement, work, and sleep. This affects the energy reserve and long-term weight change. 1.0 keeps the intended NMS balance.
Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_EnergyBurnMu.ch: 調整休息, 移動, 工作與睡眠時燃燒熱量的速度. 這會影響能量儲備與長期體重變化. 1.0 為 NMS 預期的平衡.
Sandbox_NutritionMakesSense_EnergyBurnMu.cn: 调整休息, 移动, 工作和睡眠时燃烧热量的速度. 这会影响能量储备与长期体重变化. 1.0 为 NMS 预期的平衡.

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleA.en: If enabled and Lifestyle: Hobbies is installed, completed ambitions are recorded to a personal data disk and marked completed again on recovery. Only the completion is restored, not partial progress; choose which completed ambitions are active from Lifestyle's own ambitions menu.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleA.ch: 啟用且已安裝 Lifestyle: Hobbies 時, 已完成的志向會記錄到個人資料軟碟片, 並在恢復時重新標記為已完成. 只會還原完成狀態, 不含部分進度. 請從 Lifestyle 本身的志向選單選擇要啟用哪些已完成的志向.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleA.cn: 启用且已安装 Lifestyle: Hobbies 时, 已完成的志向会记录到个人数据磁盘, 并在恢复时重新标记为已完成. 只会还原完成状态, 不包括部分进度. 请在 Lifestyle 自带的志向菜单中选择要激活哪些已完成的志向.

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.en: If enabled and Lifestyle: Hobbies is installed, the researched improvement levels on each discovered invention come back with it. Requires Recover Lifestyle Inventions, since an improvement needs an invention to sit on. This is the long half of the invention grind, which is why it is separate and off by default. A restore can leave a character holding more special improvements than their Inventing level would let them research from scratch.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.ch: 啟用且已安裝 Lifestyle: Hobbies 時, 每項已發現發明上研究過的改良等級也會一併恢復. 需要同時啟用「恢復 Lifestyle 發明」, 因為改良必須依附於發明. 這是發明養成中最耗時的部分, 因此獨立成一個選項並預設關閉. 恢復後, 角色持有的特殊改良數量可能超過其發明等級從頭研究所能達到的數量.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.cn: 启用且已安装 Lifestyle: Hobbies 时, 每项已发现发明上研究过的改良等级也会一并恢复. 需要同时启用“恢复 Lifestyle 发明”, 因为改良必须依附于发明. 这是发明养成中最耗时的部分, 因此单独作为一个选项并默认关闭. 恢复后, 角色持有的特殊改良数量可能超过其发明等级从头研究所能达到的数量.

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.en: If enabled and Lifestyle: Hobbies is installed, every invention and toy discovered at the invention workbench is recorded to a personal data disk and known again on recovery. Discovery only: the researched improvements are a separate option, Recover Lifestyle Improvements. All-or-nothing, so the recovery percentage does not apply.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.ch: 啟用且已安裝 Lifestyle: Hobbies 時, 在發明工作臺發現的每項發明與玩具都會記錄到個人資料軟碟片, 並在恢復時重新習得. 僅限發現: 研究過的改良是另一個選項「恢復 Lifestyle 改良」. 此項為全有或全無, 因此不套用恢復百分比.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleI.cn: 启用且已安装 Lifestyle: Hobbies 时, 在发明工作台发现的每项发明和玩具都会记录到个人数据磁盘, 并在恢复时重新掌握. 仅限发现: 研究过的改良是另一个选项“恢复 Lifestyle 改良”. 此项为全有或全无, 因此不适用恢复百分比.

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.ch: 恢復 Lifestyle 隱藏技能
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.cn: 恢复 Lifestyle 隐藏技能

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.en: If enabled and Lifestyle: Hobbies is installed, hidden skills (Yoga, Inventing, Ping Pong) are recorded to a personal data disk and restored on recovery like other skills, using the default recovery percentage. Matches the Jeeve's Journals option of the same name: the disk and the journal record and recover the same things.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.ch: 啟用且已安裝 Lifestyle: Hobbies 時, 隱藏技能 (瑜伽, 發明, 桌球) 會記錄到個人資料軟碟片, 並在恢復時像其他技能一樣以預設恢復百分比還原. 與 Jeeve's Journals 的同名選項一致: 軟碟片與日誌記錄及恢復的內容相同.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.cn: 启用且已安装 Lifestyle: Hobbies 时, 隐藏技能 (瑜伽, 发明, 乒乓球) 会记录到个人数据磁盘, 并在恢复时像其他技能一样按默认恢复百分比还原. 与 Jeeve's Journals 的同名选项一致: 磁盘与日志记录和恢复的内容相同.

Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.en: If enabled and Lifestyle: Hobbies is installed, every song the character has learned on every instrument is recorded to a personal data disk and learned again on recovery. A song is all-or-nothing, so the recovery percentage does not apply to it. Songs are rebuilt from the catalogue the installed version of Lifestyle ships, so one that has since been renamed or removed simply does not return.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.ch: 啟用且已安裝 Lifestyle: Hobbies 時, 角色在每種樂器上學會的每首歌曲都會記錄到個人資料軟碟片, 並在恢復時重新學會. 歌曲為全有或全無, 因此不套用恢復百分比. 歌曲會依目前安裝的 Lifestyle 版本所附的曲目清單重建, 之後被改名或移除的歌曲將不會恢復.
Sandbox_JG_PersonalDiskRecoverLifestyleS.cn: 启用且已安装 Lifestyle: Hobbies 时, 角色在每种乐器上学会的每首歌曲都会记录到个人数据磁盘, 并在恢复时重新学会. 歌曲为全有或全无, 因此不适用恢复百分比. 歌曲会根据当前安装的 Lifestyle 版本自带的曲目列表重建, 之后被改名或移除的歌曲将不会恢复.

Sandbox_CSZ_Option_BlockStreetTiles.en: Block street/highway floor tiles in safehouse selections
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_BlockStreetTiles.ch: 禁止在安全屋選取範圍中包含街道/公路地板地塊
Sandbox_CSZ_Option_BlockStreetTiles.cn: 禁止在安全屋选择范围中包含街道/公路地板地块

Sandbox_PZLinux_DarkWebSharedCatalogEnab.en: Enabled: two server-wide offers refresh every 24 in-game hours and disappear for everyone when purchased.<LINE>Disabled: restores the original per-player Dark Web purchase catalog.
Sandbox_PZLinux_DarkWebSharedCatalogEnab.ch: 啟用: 兩項全伺服器共用的商品每 24 遊戲小時重新整理一次, 任何人購買後即對所有人消失.<LINE>停用: 恢復原本每位玩家各自的暗網購買目錄.
Sandbox_PZLinux_DarkWebSharedCatalogEnab.cn: 启用: 两项全服务器共享的商品每 24 游戏小时刷新一次, 任何人购买后即对所有人消失.<LINE>禁用: 恢复原本每位玩家各自的暗网购买目录.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.en: Allow any knife to fillet fish
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.ch: 允許用任何刀具切魚片
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.cn: 允许用任何刀具切鱼片

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.en: Off: vanilla sharp knives and meat cleavers only. On: allows all vanilla handheld knives, including butter and plastic knives.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.ch: 關閉: 僅限原版利刃與切肉刀. 開啟: 允許使用所有原版手持刀具, 包括奶油刀與塑膠刀.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_AllowAnyKnifeFi.cn: 关闭: 仅限原版锋利刀具和剁肉刀. 开启: 允许使用所有原版手持刀具, 包括黄油刀和塑料刀.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_ForageDensityPe.en: Controls global forage density from 100 to 1,000 percent. 100 is vanilla and recommended for smooth performance. Extremely high values may cause serious stuttering.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_ForageDensityPe.ch: 控制全域搜尋密度, 範圍為 100 到 1,000 百分比. 100 為原版數值, 建議使用以維持流暢效能. 極高數值可能導致嚴重卡頓.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_ForageDensityPe.cn: 控制全局搜寻密度, 范围为 100 到 1,000 百分比. 100 为原版数值, 推荐使用以保证流畅性能. 极高数值可能导致严重卡顿.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceForageVisib.en: Controls both how often rice appears and how easily it is detected. 100 is occasional, 500 is much more common, and 1,000 is very frequent.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceForageVisib.ch: 同時控制稻米出現的頻率與被發現的難易度. 100 為偶爾出現, 500 為更常見, 1,000 為非常頻繁.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceForageVisib.cn: 同时控制稻米出现的频率与被发现的难易程度. 100 为偶尔出现, 500 为更加常见, 1,000 为非常频繁.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageC.en: Legacy setting. Effective rice chance is capped at 15 and rice is crops-only.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageC.ch: 舊版設定. 實際稻米機率上限為 15, 且稻米僅屬於農作物類.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageC.cn: 旧版设置. 实际稻米几率上限为 15, 且稻米仅属于农作物类.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.en: Legacy setting. Maximum rice found from one forage icon.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.ch: 舊版設定. 單一搜尋圖示可找到的最多稻米數量.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.cn: 旧版设置. 单个搜寻图标可找到的最多稻米数量.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.en: Legacy setting. Minimum rice found from one forage icon.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.ch: 舊版設定. 單一搜尋圖示可找到的最少稻米數量.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageM.cn: 旧版设置. 单个搜寻图标可找到的最少稻米数量.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageV.en: Legacy setting. Controls how easy rice is to spot while foraging.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageV.ch: 舊版設定. 控制搜尋時稻米被發現的難易度.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_RiceSeedForageV.cn: 旧版设置. 控制搜寻时稻米被发现的难易程度.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageCh.en: Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageCh.ch: 舊版設定. 海藻搜尋已停用, 現在只能透過放置的漁網捕獲海藻.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageCh.cn: 旧版设置. 海藻搜寻已禁用, 现在只能通过放置的渔网捕获海藻.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageMa.en: Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageMa.ch: 舊版設定. 海藻搜尋已停用, 現在只能透過放置的漁網捕獲海藻.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageMa.cn: 旧版设置. 海藻搜寻已禁用, 现在只能通过放置的渔网捕获海藻.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageMi.en: Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageMi.ch: 舊版設定. 海藻搜尋已停用, 現在只能透過放置的漁網捕獲海藻.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageMi.cn: 旧版设置. 海藻搜寻已禁用, 现在只能通过放置的渔网捕获海藻.

Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageVi.en: Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageVi.ch: 舊版設定. 海藻搜尋已停用, 現在只能透過放置的漁網捕獲海藻.
Sandbox_FishingExpansion_SeaweedForageVi.cn: 旧版设置. 海藻搜寻已禁用, 现在只能通过放置的渔网捕获海藻.

Sandbox_BWOA.AngelProximity_tooltip.en: Extra help in discovering unique points of interest.
Sandbox_BWOA.AngelProximity_tooltip.ch: 額外協助你發現獨特的興趣點.
Sandbox_BWOA.AngelProximity_tooltip.cn: 额外帮助你发现独特的兴趣点.

Sandbox_BWOA.ArkGeneratorFuelConsumption.en: Controls how much fuel the Ark generators consume.
Sandbox_BWOA.ArkGeneratorFuelConsumption.ch: 控制方舟發電機消耗燃料的多寡.
Sandbox_BWOA.ArkGeneratorFuelConsumption.cn: 控制方舟发电机消耗燃料的多少.

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option1.en: Very fast rise + Very slow decay
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option1.ch: 極快上升 + 極慢衰減
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option1.cn: 极快上升 + 极慢衰减

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option2.ch: 快速上升 + 緩慢衰減
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option2.cn: 快速上升 + 缓慢衰减

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option4.ch: 緩慢上升 + 快速衰減
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option4.cn: 缓慢上升 + 快速衰减

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option5.en: Very slow rise + very fast decay
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option5.ch: 極慢上升 + 極快衰減
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_option5.cn: 极慢上升 + 极快衰减

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_tooltip.en: Controls the rise and decay speed of the fallout period
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_tooltip.ch: 控制落塵期的上升與衰減速度
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutCurve_tooltip.cn: 控制沉降期的上升与衰减速度

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutEnds_tooltip.en: Impacts radiation and weather conditions duration as well as the duration of the storyline.
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutEnds_tooltip.ch: 影響輻射與天候狀況的持續時間, 以及劇情的持續時間.
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutEnds_tooltip.cn: 影响辐射与天气状况的持续时间, 以及剧情的持续时间.

Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutStarted_tooltip.en: Impacts initial radiation and weather conditions.
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutStarted_tooltip.ch: 影響初始的輻射與天候狀況.
Sandbox_BWOA.FalloutStarted_tooltip.cn: 影响初始的辐射与天气状况.

Sandbox_BWOA.HostileGroupSize_tooltip.en: Determines the typical size of hostile survivor groups.
Sandbox_BWOA.HostileGroupSize_tooltip.ch: 決定敵對倖存者群體的一般規模.
Sandbox_BWOA.HostileGroupSize_tooltip.cn: 决定敌对幸存者群体的一般规模.

Sandbox_BWOA.MemoryRegain_tooltip.en: Player can regain some skills over time or by interacting with certain objects.
Sandbox_BWOA.MemoryRegain_tooltip.ch: 玩家能隨時間經過, 或與特定物件互動來恢復部分技能.
Sandbox_BWOA.MemoryRegain_tooltip.cn: 玩家能随时间推移, 或与特定物体互动来恢复部分技能.

Sandbox_BWOA.ResidueScrap_tooltip.en: Controls how much scrap materials exist in the world.
Sandbox_BWOA.ResidueScrap_tooltip.ch: 控制世界中廢料材料的數量.
Sandbox_BWOA.ResidueScrap_tooltip.cn: 控制世界中废料材料的数量.

Sandbox_BWOA.RetroRadiation_tooltip.en: Player inventory can get radiated from ground items.
Sandbox_BWOA.RetroRadiation_tooltip.ch: 玩家物品欄可能會被地上的物品輻射汙染.
Sandbox_BWOA.RetroRadiation_tooltip.cn: 玩家物品栏可能会被地上的物品辐射污染.

Sandbox_BWOA.ShelterOccurance_tooltip.en: Impacts how often random procedurally generated basements will occur. These are independent from normal basements.
Sandbox_BWOA.ShelterOccurance_tooltip.ch: 影響隨機程序生成地下室的出現頻率. 這些地下室與一般地下室各自獨立.
Sandbox_BWOA.ShelterOccurance_tooltip.cn: 影响随机程序生成地下室的出现频率. 这些地下室与普通地下室相互独立.

Sandbox_BWOA.SkeletonReanimation_tooltip.en: (MAY LEAD TO GAME CRASH!) Skeletons have some chance of reanimation.
Sandbox_BWOA.SkeletonReanimation_tooltip.ch: (可能導致遊戲當機!) 骷髏有一定機率復活.
Sandbox_BWOA.SkeletonReanimation_tooltip.cn: (可能导致游戏崩溃!) 骷髅有一定几率复活.

Sandbox_BWOA.TemperatureDrop_tooltip.en: Controls how cold the nuclear winter is.
Sandbox_BWOA.TemperatureDrop_tooltip.ch: 控制核子冬天的寒冷程度.
Sandbox_BWOA.TemperatureDrop_tooltip.cn: 控制核冬天的寒冷程度.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_Debug_tooltip.en: Print verbose [TaMOOgotchi] logs to console.txt. Useful when reporting bugs.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_Debug_tooltip.ch: 將詳細的 [TaMOOgotchi] 日誌輸出到 console.txt. 回報錯誤時很有用.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_Debug_tooltip.cn: 将详细的 [TaMOOgotchi] 日志输出到 console.txt. 报告错误时很有用.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_DecayMultiplier_tool.en: Higher = stats drop faster. 1.0 is the default rate.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_DecayMultiplier_tool.ch: 越高 = 數值下降越快. 1.0 為預設速率.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_DecayMultiplier_tool.cn: 越高 = 数值下降越快. 1.0 为默认速率.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_GainTweenRate.ch: 數值條增加速度 (單位/秒)
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_GainTweenRate.cn: 数值条增加速度 (单位/秒)

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_GainTweenRate_toolti.en: How fast the bars visually fill after FEED/PLAY/etc.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_GainTweenRate_toolti.ch: 餵食/玩耍等動作後數值條在畫面上填滿的速度.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_GainTweenRate_toolti.cn: 喂食/玩耍等动作后数值条在画面上填满的速度.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_LossTweenRate.ch: 數值條減少速度 (單位/秒)
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_LossTweenRate.cn: 数值条减少速度 (单位/秒)

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_LossTweenRate_toolti.en: How fast the bars visually drop after action-induced losses.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_LossTweenRate_toolti.ch: 動作造成數值減少後, 數值條在畫面上下降的速度.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_LossTweenRate_toolti.cn: 动作造成数值减少后, 数值条在画面上下降的速度.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_SpawnMultiplier_tool.en: Multiplier applied to TaMOOgotchi loot weights in containers / vehicles. 0 disables world spawning, 1.0 is default, higher = more common.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_SpawnMultiplier_tool.ch: 套用於容器/車輛中電子牛戰利品權重的倍率. 0 = 停用世界生成, 1.0 為預設, 越高 = 越常見.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_SpawnMultiplier_tool.cn: 应用于容器/车辆中电子牛战利品权重的倍率. 0 = 禁用世界生成, 1.0 为默认, 越高 = 越常见.

Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_StarterEgg_tooltip.en: If enabled, every new character spawns with a TaMOOgotchi in their inventory.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_StarterEgg_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 每個新角色出生時物品欄中都會有一隻電子牛.
Sandbox_TaMOOgotchi_StarterEgg_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 每个新角色出生时物品栏中都会有一只电子牛.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmFixe.ch: 災變屍潮固定觸發時刻
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmFixe.cn: 灾变尸潮固定触发时刻

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmFixe.en: Used only in Fixed days and hour mode. Uses the 24-hour clock: 22 means 10:00 PM.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmFixe.ch: 僅用於「固定天數與時刻」模式. 使用24小時制: 22 代表晚上10:00.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmFixe.cn: 仅用于“固定天数与时刻”模式. 使用24小时制: 22 代表晚上10:00.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmFixe.en: Used only in Fixed days and hour mode.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmFixe.ch: 僅用於「固定天數與時刻」模式.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmFixe.cn: 仅用于“固定天数与时刻”模式.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmMaxD.en: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent across restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmMaxD.ch: 僅用於「隨機間隔」模式. 擲出的期限在重新啟動後仍會保留.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmMaxD.cn: 仅用于“随机间隔”模式. 随机出的期限在重启后仍会保留.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmMinD.en: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent across restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmMinD.ch: 僅用於「隨機間隔」模式. 擲出的期限在重新啟動後仍會保留.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmMinD.cn: 仅用于“随机间隔”模式. 随机出的期限在重启后仍会保留.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmSche.en: Random interval uses the minimum and maximum day settings. Fixed mode uses the fixed interval in days and fixed hour. The selected deadline survives save and server restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmSche.ch: 隨機間隔使用最小與最大天數設定. 固定模式使用固定間隔天數與固定時刻. 選定的期限在存檔與伺服器重新啟動後仍會保留.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmSche.cn: 随机间隔使用最小与最大天数设置. 固定模式使用固定间隔天数与固定时刻. 选定的期限在存档与服务器重启后仍会保留.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_DisableAtNigh.en: Applies only to the normal horde. If its persistent deadline occurs during the configured night window, that occurrence is skipped and the next one is scheduled.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_DisableAtNigh.ch: 僅適用於普通屍潮. 若其保留的期限落在設定的夜間時段內, 該次將被跳過並排定下一次.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_DisableAtNigh.cn: 仅适用于普通尸潮. 若其保留的期限落在设置的夜间时段内, 该次将被跳过并安排下一次.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableDirecti.en: Controls the direction indicator for normal, wandering and cataclysm hordes. The all-notifications master switch can disable every player-facing warning at once.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableDirecti.ch: 控制普通, 遊蕩與災變屍潮的方向指示器. 「所有通知」總開關可一次停用所有面向玩家的警示.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableDirecti.cn: 控制普通, 游荡与灾变尸潮的方向指示器. “所有通知”总开关可一次禁用所有面向玩家的警示.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableEventNo.ch: 啟用所有屍潮事件通知
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableEventNo.cn: 启用所有尸潮事件通知

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableEventNo.en: Master switch for player-facing warnings from real events: direction indicators, warning audio, survivor lines and the cataclysm screen effect. Gameplay attraction sounds used by zombie AI are not disabled.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableEventNo.ch: 真實事件產生之玩家警示的總開關: 方向指示器, 警告音效, 倖存者臺詞與災變屍潮螢幕特效. 殭屍AI使用的遊戲性吸引音效不會被停用.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableEventNo.cn: 真实事件产生的玩家警示总开关: 方向指示器, 警告音效, 幸存者台词与灾变尸潮屏幕特效. 僵尸AI使用的游戏性吸引音效不会被禁用.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableWarning.en: Controls audible player warnings for normal, wandering and cataclysm hordes. This does not disable the inaudible world-sound event used to attract zombie AI.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableWarning.ch: 控制普通, 遊蕩與災變屍潮的玩家可聽見警告. 這不會停用用於吸引殭屍AI的無聲世界音效事件.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableWarning.cn: 控制普通, 游荡与灾变尸潮的玩家可听见警告. 这不会禁用用于吸引僵尸AI的无声世界音效事件.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MaxSpawnHours.en: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent and is not rerolled when the save or server is restarted.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MaxSpawnHours.ch: 僅用於「隨機間隔」模式. 擲出的期限會保留, 存檔或伺服器重新啟動時不會重新擲出.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MaxSpawnHours.cn: 仅用于“随机间隔”模式. 随机出的期限会保留, 存档或服务器重启时不会重新随机.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MinSpawnHours.en: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent and is not rerolled when the save or server is restarted.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MinSpawnHours.ch: 僅用於「隨機間隔」模式. 擲出的期限會保留, 存檔或伺服器重新啟動時不會重新擲出.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MinSpawnHours.cn: 仅用于“随机间隔”模式. 随机出的期限会保留, 存档或服务器重启时不会重新随机.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalFixedHo.ch: 普通屍潮固定觸發時刻
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalFixedHo.cn: 普通尸潮固定触发时刻

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalFixedHo.en: Used only in Fixed days and hour mode. Uses the 24-hour clock: 22 means 10:00 PM. The event runs on the first scheduler check at or after this hour.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalFixedHo.ch: 僅用於「固定天數與時刻」模式. 使用24小時制: 22 代表晚上10:00. 事件會在此時刻當下或之後的第一次排程檢查時執行.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalFixedHo.cn: 仅用于“固定天数与时刻”模式. 使用24小时制: 22 代表晚上10:00. 事件会在此时刻当时或之后的第一次计划检查时执行.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalFixedIn.en: Used only in Fixed days and hour mode. For example, 7 triggers a normal horde every seven in-game days.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalFixedIn.ch: 僅用於「固定天數與時刻」模式. 例如, 7 表示每七個遊戲日觸發一次普通屍潮.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalFixedIn.cn: 仅用于“固定天数与时刻”模式. 例如, 7 表示每七个游戏日触发一次普通尸潮.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalSchedul.en: Random interval uses the minimum and maximum hour settings. Fixed mode uses the fixed interval in days and fixed hour. The selected deadline is stored in the save and survives restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalSchedul.ch: 隨機間隔使用最小與最大小時數設定. 固定模式使用固定間隔天數與固定時刻. 選定的期限會儲存在存檔中, 重新啟動後仍會保留.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_NormalSchedul.cn: 随机间隔使用最小与最大小时数设置. 固定模式使用固定间隔天数与固定时刻. 选定的期限会保存在存档中, 重启后仍会保留.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingFixe.ch: 遊蕩屍潮固定觸發時刻
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingFixe.cn: 游荡尸潮固定触发时刻

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingFixe.en: Used only in Fixed days and hour mode. Set this to 22 for 10:00 PM.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingFixe.ch: 僅用於「固定天數與時刻」模式. 設為 22 代表晚上10:00.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingFixe.cn: 仅用于“固定天数与时刻”模式. 设为 22 代表晚上10:00.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingFixe.en: Used only in Fixed days and hour mode. Set this to 1 for one wandering horde every in-game day.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingFixe.ch: 僅用於「固定天數與時刻」模式. 設為 1 代表每個遊戲日出現一次遊蕩屍潮.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingFixe.cn: 仅用于“固定天数与时刻”模式. 设为 1 代表每个游戏日出现一次游荡尸潮.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingMaxH.en: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent across restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingMaxH.ch: 僅用於「隨機間隔」模式. 擲出的期限在重新啟動後仍會保留.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingMaxH.cn: 仅用于“随机间隔”模式. 随机出的期限在重启后仍会保留.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingMinH.en: Used only in Random interval mode. The rolled deadline is persistent across restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingMinH.ch: 僅用於「隨機間隔」模式. 擲出的期限在重新啟動後仍會保留.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingMinH.cn: 仅用于“随机间隔”模式. 随机出的期限在重启后仍会保留.

Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingSche.en: Random interval uses the minimum and maximum hour settings. Fixed mode uses the fixed interval in days and fixed hour. The selected deadline survives save and server restarts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingSche.ch: 隨機間隔使用最小與最大小時數設定. 固定模式使用固定間隔天數與固定時刻. 選定的期限在存檔與伺服器重新啟動後仍會保留.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingSche.cn: 随机间隔使用最小与最大小时数设置. 固定模式使用固定间隔天数与固定时刻. 选定的期限在存档与服务器重启后仍会保留.

Sandbox_CommonSense_PartsHighlighter_too.en: Displays vehicle-part condition colors on the vehicle dashboard.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PartsHighlighter_too.ch: 在車輛儀表板上以顏色顯示車輛零件狀態.
Sandbox_CommonSense_PartsHighlighter_too.cn: 在车辆仪表盘上以颜色显示车辆零件状态.

Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand.en: Enable Remove Bullet by Hand Action
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand.ch: 啟用徒手取出子彈動作
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand.cn: 启用徒手取出子弹动作

Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHandA.ch: 自訂取出子彈動畫 (無法使用)
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHandA.cn: 自定义取出子弹动画 (不可用)

Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHandA.en: Reserved compatibility option. The experimental custom animation is disabled on Build 42.20.2 because it can invalidate the multiplayer animation checksum. The action above remains available without it.
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHandA.ch: 保留的相容性選項. 實驗性的自訂動畫在 Build 42.20.2 中已停用, 因為它可能導致多人模式動畫校驗碼失效. 上方的動作不需要它仍可使用.
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHandA.cn: 保留的兼容性选项. 实验性的自定义动画在 Build 42.20.2 中已禁用, 因为它可能导致多人模式动画校验和失效. 上方的动作不需要它仍可使用.

Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand_.en: Enables the action that removes lodged bullets by hand from the health panel. The action is disabled by default, returns a bloody bullet and worsens the wound.
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand_.ch: 啟用從健康面板徒手取出卡在體內子彈的動作. 此動作預設為停用, 會得到一顆沾血的子彈並使傷口惡化.
Sandbox_CommonSense_RemoveBulletsByHand_.cn: 启用从健康面板徒手取出卡在体内子弹的动作. 此动作默认禁用, 会得到一颗沾血的子弹并使伤口恶化.

Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_AdminRemotePlayerAct.en: Allows admins to use Medical Check, Check Stats, and Trade from the player list without the normal distance limit.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_AdminRemotePlayerAct.ch: 允許管理員從玩家清單使用醫療檢查, 檢視屬性與交易, 不受一般距離限制.
Sandbox_EBFAdminFix_AdminRemotePlayerAct.cn: 允许管理员从玩家列表使用医疗检查, 查看属性和交易, 不受常规距离限制.

Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_CrowbarMechanic_.en: Master switch for EBF crowbar actions. Turn this off when another mod, such as Better Lockpicking, should handle crowbar and lockpicking interactions.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_CrowbarMechanic_.ch: EBF撬棍操作的總開關. 若要由其他模組 (例如 Better Lockpicking) 處理撬棍與開鎖互動, 請關閉此選項.
Sandbox_EBFSensoFencing_CrowbarMechanic_.cn: EBF撬棍操作的总开关. 若要由其他模组 (例如 Better Lockpicking) 处理撬棍和开锁互动, 请关闭此选项.

Sandbox_MilitaryTents_LootSpawnPercent.ch: 帳篷包戰利品生成機率 (%%)
Sandbox_MilitaryTents_LootSpawnPercent.cn: 帐篷包战利品生成几率 (%%)

Sandbox_MilitaryTents_LootSpawnPercent_t.en: Per-container chance that a filled military tent pack appears in eligible military or ranger/camping containers. 0 disables loot spawns entirely. Default: 10.
Sandbox_MilitaryTents_LootSpawnPercent_t.ch: 每個容器在符合條件的軍事或護林員/露營容器中出現裝滿的軍用帳篷包的機率. 0 會完全停用戰利品生成. 預設: 10.
Sandbox_MilitaryTents_LootSpawnPercent_t.cn: 每个符合条件的军事或护林员/露营容器中出现装满的军用帐篷包的几率. 0 会完全禁用战利品生成. 默认: 10.

Sandbox_ZT_ApiKey.ch: Anthropic API 金鑰 (第二階段)
Sandbox_ZT_ApiKey.cn: Anthropic API 密钥 (第二阶段)

Sandbox_ZT_ApiKey_tooltip.en: Server-only. WARNING: sandbox values replicate to all clients in MP. Whitelist-only servers only.
Sandbox_ZT_ApiKey_tooltip.ch: 僅限伺服器. 警告: 多人模式下沙盒數值會同步到所有客戶端. 僅限白名單伺服器使用.
Sandbox_ZT_ApiKey_tooltip.cn: 仅限服务器. 警告: 多人模式下沙盒数值会同步到所有客户端. 仅限白名单服务器使用.

Sandbox_ZT_DailyCallCap_tooltip.en: Hard limit on brain calls per real-world day. 0 disables the cap.
Sandbox_ZT_DailyCallCap_tooltip.ch: 每個現實日大腦呼叫次數的硬性上限. 0 為停用上限.
Sandbox_ZT_DailyCallCap_tooltip.cn: 每个现实日大脑调用次数的硬性上限. 0 为禁用上限.

Sandbox_ZT_Model_tooltip.en: Default Sonnet. Haiku is cheapest, Opus is smartest.
Sandbox_ZT_Model_tooltip.ch: 預設為 Sonnet. Haiku 最便宜, Opus 最聰明.
Sandbox_ZT_Model_tooltip.cn: 默认为 Sonnet. Haiku 最便宜, Opus 最聪明.

Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldDispenserBiofuel.ch: 世界加油機初始生物燃料量
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldDispenserBiofuel.cn: 世界加油机初始生物燃料量

Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldDispenserBiofuel_tool.en: Determines how much biofuel world-spawned dispensers contain initially. Player-built dispensers always start empty.
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldDispenserBiofuel_tool.ch: 決定世界中生成的加油機初始含有多少生物燃料. 玩家建造的加油機一律從空的開始.
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldDispenserBiofuel_tool.cn: 决定世界中生成的加油机初始含有多少生物燃料. 玩家建造的加油机总是从空的开始.

Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldDoubleBarrelLiquidCha.en: Chance for double-barrel containers found in the world to contain liquid. Player-built containers always start empty.
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldDoubleBarrelLiquidCha.ch: 世界中找到的雙桶容器裝有液體的機率. 玩家建造的容器一律從空的開始.
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldDoubleBarrelLiquidCha.cn: 世界中找到的双桶容器装有液体的几率. 玩家建造的容器总是从空的开始.

Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldIndustrialTankLiquidC.en: Chance for industrial tanks found in the world to contain ethanol or biofuel. Player-built tanks always start empty.
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldIndustrialTankLiquidC.ch: 世界中找到的工業儲槽裝有乙醇或生物燃料的機率. 玩家建造的儲槽一律從空的開始.
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldIndustrialTankLiquidC.cn: 世界中找到的工业储罐装有乙醇或生物燃料的几率. 玩家建造的储罐总是从空的开始.

Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldMetalDrumLiquidChance.en: Chance for metal drums found in the world to contain liquid. This includes grey, orange, and green drums supported by the mod.
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldMetalDrumLiquidChance.ch: 世界中找到的金屬油桶裝有液體的機率. 包含此模組支援的灰色, 橙色與綠色油桶.
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldMetalDrumLiquidChance.cn: 世界中找到的金属油桶装有液体的几率. 包括此模组支持的灰色, 橙色和绿色油桶.

Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldWoodenBarrelLiquidCha.en: Chance for wooden barrels found in the world to contain liquid. Player-built barrels always start empty.
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldWoodenBarrelLiquidCha.ch: 世界中找到的木桶裝有液體的機率. 玩家建造的木桶一律從空的開始.
Sandbox_IDBFS_WorldWoodenBarrelLiquidCha.cn: 世界中找到的木桶装有液体的几率. 玩家建造的木桶总是从空的开始.

Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootBook_tooltip.ch:

Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootBook_tooltip.cn:

Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootConsumable_tooltip.en:

Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootConsumable_tooltip.ch:
調整消耗品的生成率.
原始預設值為 5
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootConsumable_tooltip.cn:
调整消耗品的生成率.
原始默认值为 5

Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootGenericWeapon_toolti.en:
Adjust weapons spawn rate for the generic UmaBoid weapons.
5 being the original default rate
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootGenericWeapon_toolti.ch:
調整賽馬娘一般武器的生成率.
原始預設值為 5
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootGenericWeapon_toolti.cn:
调整赛马娘普通武器的生成率.
原始默认值为 5

Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootHeavyWeapon_tooltip.en:
Adjust weapons spawn rate for the heavy and stronger UmaBoid weapons.
5 being the original default rate
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootHeavyWeapon_tooltip.ch:
調整賽馬娘重型及較強武器的生成率.
原始預設值為 5
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootHeavyWeapon_tooltip.cn:
调整赛马娘重型及较强武器的生成率.
原始默认值为 5

Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootMagicWeapon_tooltip.en:
Adjust weapons spawn rate for the magical UmaBoid weapons.
This includes Grass wonder's and Daiwa Scarlet's Staff.
5 being the original default rate
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootMagicWeapon_tooltip.ch:
調整賽馬娘魔法武器的生成率.
包含草上飛和大和赤驥的法杖.
原始預設值為 5
Sandbox_UmaBoid_LootMagicWeapon_tooltip.cn:
调整赛马娘魔法武器的生成率.
包含草上飞和大和赤骥的法杖.

MarriageCompanion_CloseDefensePushEnable.en: Allows local defensive shoves only when spouse is guarding at close range.

MarriageCompanion_MedicalNonCombatCondit.ch: 啟用依實際情況觸發的非戰鬥病症, 例如脫水、冷熱曝露、腸胃疾病、感冒、空氣刺激與恢復期疲勞. 不會隨機發病.
MarriageCompanion_MedicalNonCombatCondit.cn: 启用依实际情况触发的非战斗病症, 例如脱水、冷热暴露、肠胃疾病、感冒、空气刺激和恢复期疲劳. 不会随机发病.

MarriageCompanion_RelaxActivityFrequency.en: How often the spouse chooses optional Relax leisure, media, reading, home visits, and casual Relax chatter. 0 disables optional leisure/chatter; 60 is the current default; 100 is the most eager. Survival needs, safety, sleep, cold care, hygiene, injury response, and emergencies ignore this slider.

MarriageCompanion_RelaxActivityFrequency.cn: 配偶选择进行可选的休闲放松、媒体、阅读、在家中四处走动和日常闲聊的频率. 0 会禁用可选休闲/闲聊; 60 为当前默认值; 100 为最积极. 生存需求、安全、睡眠、御寒照料、卫生、伤势处理和紧急情况不受此滑块影响.

Sandbox_MarriageCompanion_MedicalDownedM.ch: 允許瀕死傷勢或五處未癒合的非致命重傷, 使配偶進入可恢復的「倒地」狀態.
Sandbox_MarriageCompanion_MedicalDownedM.cn: 允许濒死伤势或五处未愈合的非致命重伤, 使配偶进入可恢复的“倒地”状态.

Sandbox_MarriageCompanion_MedicalInjuryS.en: Records evidence-based spouse injuries and enables the custom medical ledger. Turning this off stops new custom injuries; existing ledger data is preserved.
Sandbox_MarriageCompanion_MedicalInjuryS.ch: 依據實際情況記錄配偶傷勢, 並啟用自訂醫療紀錄. 關閉後不再產生新的自訂傷勢; 既有紀錄資料會保留.
Sandbox_MarriageCompanion_MedicalInjuryS.cn: 依据实际情况记录配偶伤势, 并启用自定义医疗记录. 关闭后不再产生新的自定义伤势; 现有记录数据会保留.

Sandbox_MarriageCompanion_MedicalNonComb.en: Enable evidence-driven non-combat ailments such as dehydration, thermal exposure, GI illness, common cold, airborne irritation, and recovery fatigue. No random ailments.
Sandbox_MarriageCompanion_MedicalNonComb.ch: 啟用依實際情況觸發的非戰鬥病症, 例如脫水、冷熱曝露、腸胃疾病、感冒、空氣刺激與恢復期疲勞. 不會隨機發病.
Sandbox_MarriageCompanion_MedicalNonComb.cn: 启用依实际情况触发的非战斗病症, 例如脱水、冷热暴露、肠胃疾病、感冒、空气刺激和恢复期疲劳. 不会随机发病.

Survival needs, cold/fire care, security, sleep, and emergencies ignore this setting.

Sandbox_RelaxActivityFrequency_tooltip.en: Controls optional Relax leisure, media opportunities, and casual spouse chatter. 0 disables optional leisure/chatter, 50 is roughly the HF07 rhythm, and 100 is about twice as eager. Hunger, thirst, injury, cold/fire care, security, sleep, and emergencies are not reduced by this setting.
Sandbox_RelaxActivityFrequency_tooltip.ch: 控制選擇性的休閒放鬆、媒體機會與配偶日常閒聊. 0 會停用選擇性休閒/閒聊, 50 大約是 HF07 的節奏, 100 則約為兩倍積極. 飢餓、口渴、受傷、禦寒/生火照料、安全、睡眠與緊急狀況不會因此設定而減少.
Sandbox_RelaxActivityFrequency_tooltip.cn: 控制可选的休闲放松、媒体机会和配偶日常闲聊. 0 会禁用可选休闲/闲聊, 50 大约是 HF07 的节奏, 100 则约为两倍积极. 饥饿、口渴、受伤、御寒/生火照料、安全、睡眠和紧急情况不会因此设置而减少.

Sandbox_TDDUP_DialoguePortraitImages_too.en: When off, Portrait Chat keeps the movable text boxes but hides the live character face panels.
Sandbox_TDDUP_DialoguePortraitImages_too.ch: 關閉時, 頭像對話仍保留可移動的文字框, 但會隱藏即時角色臉部面板.
Sandbox_TDDUP_DialoguePortraitImages_too.cn: 关闭时, 头像对话仍保留可移动的文本框, 但会隐藏实时角色脸部面板.

Sandbox_MedicalCustomHealthcareItems_too.en: Allows TDDUP custom medical supplies in treatment and custom loot injection. Vanilla supplies and clean water remain available where supported.
Sandbox_MedicalCustomHealthcareItems_too.ch: 允許在治療與自訂戰利品注入中使用 TDDUP 自訂醫療用品. 在支援的情況下, 原版用品與乾淨的水仍可使用.
Sandbox_MedicalCustomHealthcareItems_too.cn: 允许在治疗和自定义战利品注入中使用 TDDUP 自定义医疗用品. 在支持的情况下, 原版用品和干净的水仍可使用.

Sandbox_MedicalDownedMechanic_tooltip.en: Allows near-fatal injuries or five open non-fatal substantial injuries to put the spouse into the recoverable DOWNED state.
Sandbox_MedicalDownedMechanic_tooltip.ch: 允許瀕死傷勢或五處未癒合的非致命重傷, 使配偶進入可恢復的「倒地」狀態.
Sandbox_MedicalDownedMechanic_tooltip.cn: 允许濒死伤势或五处未愈合的非致命重伤, 使配偶进入可恢复的“倒地”状态.

Sandbox_MedicalInjurySystem_tooltip.en: Records evidence-based spouse injuries and enables the custom medical ledger. Turning this off stops new custom injuries; existing ledger data is preserved.
Sandbox_MedicalInjurySystem_tooltip.ch: 依據實際情況記錄配偶傷勢, 並啟用自訂醫療紀錄. 關閉後不再產生新的自訂傷勢; 既有紀錄資料會保留.
Sandbox_MedicalInjurySystem_tooltip.cn: 依据实际情况记录配偶伤势, 并启用自定义医疗记录. 关闭后不再产生新的自定义伤势; 现有记录数据会保留.

Sandbox_MedicalNonCombatConditions_toolt.en: Observes evidence-backed non-combat health conditions. No random conditions.
Sandbox_MedicalNonCombatConditions_toolt.ch: 觀察有實際依據的非戰鬥健康狀況. 不會隨機發病.
Sandbox_MedicalNonCombatConditions_toolt.cn: 观察有实际依据的非战斗健康状况. 不会随机发病.

Sandbox_SlowGasMaskFiltersB42_EnableMult.en: Allows the server to apply slower filter wear in multiplayer games. Disable only if a server has a conflict with another mod.
Sandbox_SlowGasMaskFiltersB42_EnableMult.ch: 允許伺服器在多人遊戲中套用較慢的濾芯消耗. 僅在伺服器與其他 MOD 衝突時才停用.
Sandbox_SlowGasMaskFiltersB42_EnableMult.cn: 允许服务器在多人游戏中应用较慢的滤芯消耗. 仅在服务器与其他 MOD 冲突时才禁用.

Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_CraftingSpeed_tool.en: Adjusts only the duration of Salvage Works crafting actions. Very Fast = quarter duration; Fast = half duration; Normal = intended duration; Slow = double duration. Vanilla recipes and recipes from other mods are not affected.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_CraftingSpeed_tool.ch: 僅調整回收工坊製作動作的耗時. 非常快 = 四分之一耗時; 快 = 一半耗時; 普通 = 原定耗時; 緩慢 = 兩倍耗時. 本體配方與其他模組的配方不受影響.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_CraftingSpeed_tool.cn: 仅调整回收工坊制作动作的耗时. 非常快 = 四分之一耗时; 快 = 一半耗时; 普通 = 原定耗时; 缓慢 = 两倍耗时. 原版配方与其他模组的配方不受影响.

Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_RecyclingYieldMult.en: Controls how many materials are recovered when recycling. 1.00 = normal yield, 0.50 = half yield, 2.00 = double yield. Item condition and the character’s relevant skill still influence the final result.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_RecyclingYieldMult.ch: 控制回收時能取回多少材料. 1.00 = 正常產量, 0.50 = 一半產量, 2.00 = 兩倍產量. 物品狀況與角色的相關技能仍會影響最終結果.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_RecyclingYieldMult.cn: 控制回收时能取回多少材料. 1.00 = 正常产量, 0.50 = 一半产量, 2.00 = 两倍产量. 物品状况与角色的相关技能仍会影响最终结果.

Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_SkillRequirements_.en: Yes: Salvage Works recipes use their intended skill levels. No: skill levels do not block the mod's recipes. Materials, tools, and workstations are still required. After changing this option, in single-player quit and reload the game. In multiplayer, restart the server for the change to take effect.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_SkillRequirements_.ch: 是: 回收工坊配方使用原定的技能等級. 否: 技能等級不會限制本模組的配方. 仍需要材料、工具與工作臺. 變更此選項後, 單人遊戲請退出並重新載入遊戲. 多人遊戲請重新啟動伺服器才會生效.
Sandbox_ScrapSurvival_SkillRequirements_.cn: 是: 回收工坊配方使用原定的技能等级. 否: 技能等级不会限制本模组的配方. 仍需要材料、工具与工作台. 更改此选项后, 单人游戏请退出并重新加载游戏. 多人游戏请重启服务器才会生效.

Sandbox_TheButchersTable_FishDryDays_too.cn: 鱼在肉架上晾干所需的游戏内天数 (鱼片与整条鱼). 默认 3.

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_AutoSelfCare_too.en: Allows NPCs to automatically eat, drink, and sleep. Emergency bandaging remains enabled.

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_DisableNPCBumpin.ch: 停用 NPC 碰撞推擠
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_DisableNPCBumpin.cn: 禁用 NPC 碰撞推挤

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_DisableNPCBumpin.en: Disables the vanilla bump animation between NPCs and other human characters while preserving normal collision. Zombie collisions are unchanged.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_DisableNPCBumpin.ch: 停用 NPC 與其他人類角色之間的原版碰撞推擠動畫, 同時保留正常碰撞. 與殭屍的碰撞不受影響.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_DisableNPCBumpin.cn: 禁用 NPC 与其他人类角色之间的原版碰撞推挤动画, 同时保留正常碰撞. 与僵尸的碰撞不受影响.

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMActions.ch: 啟用 LLM NPC 行動
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMActions.cn: 启用 LLM NPC 行动

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMActions.en: Requires LLM Conversations. Typed requests can direct faction members to fetch, deliver, move, work, fight, or drive. Game code validates every action. Persistent changes and bulk transfers require a typed yes/no confirmation. Single-player/host only. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMActions.ch: 需要啟用 LLM 對話. 輸入的請求可指揮陣營成員去拿取、運送、移動、工作、戰鬥或駕駛. 每個行動都會經由遊戲程式驗證. 永久性變更與大量轉移需要輸入是/否確認. 僅限單人遊戲/主機. 預設為停用.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMActions.cn: 需要启用 LLM 对话. 输入的请求可指挥阵营成员去拿取、运送、移动、工作、战斗或驾驶. 每个行动都会经由游戏代码验证. 永久性变更和批量转移需要输入是/否确认. 仅限单人游戏/主机. 默认禁用.

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_FatigueRate_tool.en: How quickly NPC fatigue increases. 0 disables fatigue gain, 0.5 is half speed, and 2 is double speed.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_FatigueRate_tool.ch: NPC 疲勞增加的速度. 0 表示不會增加疲勞, 0.5 為一半速度, 2 為兩倍速度.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_FatigueRate_tool.cn: NPC 疲劳增加的速度. 0 表示不会增加疲劳, 0.5 为一半速度, 2 为两倍速度.

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_HungerRate_toolt.en: How quickly NPC hunger increases. 0 disables hunger gain, 0.5 is half speed, and 2 is double speed.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_HungerRate_toolt.ch: NPC 飢餓增加的速度. 0 表示不會增加飢餓, 0.5 為一半速度, 2 為兩倍速度.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_HungerRate_toolt.cn: NPC 饥饿增加的速度. 0 表示不会增加饥饿, 0.5 为一半速度, 2 为两倍速度.

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_SleepThreshold_t.en: Fatigue level from 0 to 1 where NPCs automatically go to sleep.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_SleepThreshold_t.ch: NPC 自動入睡的疲勞程度, 範圍 0 到 1.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_SleepThreshold_t.cn: NPC 自动入睡的疲劳程度, 范围 0 到 1.

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_ThirstRate_toolt.en: How quickly NPC thirst increases. 0 disables thirst gain, 0.5 is half speed, and 2 is double speed.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_ThirstRate_toolt.ch: NPC 口渴增加的速度. 0 表示不會增加口渴, 0.5 為一半速度, 2 為兩倍速度.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_ThirstRate_toolt.cn: NPC 口渴增加的速度. 0 表示不会增加口渴, 0.5 为一半速度, 2 为两倍速度.

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMConvers.en: Optional typed NPC conversations. Before launching PZ, open ProjectRemnantsSetup.exe, choose a provider and model on the LLM Companion tab, then click Configure and Start. Keep the app running while playing. When disabled, no LLM systems run.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMConvers.ch: 可選的 NPC 文字對話. 啟動 PZ 前, 先開啟 ProjectRemnantsSetup.exe, 在 LLM Companion 分頁選擇供應商與模型, 然後點選 Configure and Start. 遊玩期間請保持該程式執行. 停用時不會執行任何 LLM 系統.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMConvers.cn: 可选的 NPC 文字对话. 启动 PZ 前, 先打开 ProjectRemnantsSetup.exe, 在 LLM Companion 标签页选择提供商和模型, 然后点击 Configure and Start. 游玩期间请保持该程序运行. 禁用时不会运行任何 LLM 系统.

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMRelatio.ch: 啟用動態 LLM 人際關係
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMRelatio.cn: 启用动态 LLM 人际关系

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMRelatio.en: Allows delivered LLM conversations to shape hidden personal trust, warmth, respect, fear, and memories. Requires LLM Conversations. It never changes factions, orders, jobs, combat, or party state.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMRelatio.ch: 允許已送出的 LLM 對話影響隱藏的個人信任、好感、尊敬、恐懼與記憶. 需要啟用 LLM 對話. 它永遠不會改變陣營、命令、工作、戰鬥或隊伍狀態.
Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_EnableLLMRelatio.cn: 允许已发送的 LLM 对话影响隐藏的个人信任、好感、尊重、恐惧和记忆. 需要启用 LLM 对话. 它永远不会改变阵营、命令、工作、战斗或队伍状态.

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_SafehouseAlertRa.en: Maximum distance safehouse residents can hear another resident warn about a nearby threat. 0 disables shared safehouse alerts.

Sandbox_ProjectRemnants_SafehouseAlertRa.cn: 安全屋居民能听见其他居民警告附近威胁的最大距离. 0 表示禁用安全屋共享警报.
