Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_FirefighterWaterAmo.ch: 每個間隔為每個集雨桶增加的水量. 此數值會隨基地指派的消防員人數疊加.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_FirefighterWaterAmo.cn: 每个间隔为每个雨水收集桶增加的水量. 此数值会随基地分配的消防员人数叠加.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_FirefighterWaterInt.ch: 消防員集雨桶補水間隔 (小時)
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_FirefighterWaterInt.cn: 消防员雨水收集桶补水间隔 (小时)

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_FirefighterWaterInt.en: How often fire officers assigned to a base add water to rain collector barrels in that base.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_FirefighterWaterInt.ch: 指派到基地的消防員多久為該基地的集雨桶補水一次.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_FirefighterWaterInt.cn: 分配到基地的消防员多久为该基地的雨水收集桶补水一次.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_GeneratorCareInterv.en: How often electricians and engineers maintain generators in the base.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_GeneratorCareInterv.ch: 電工與工程師多久保養基地內的發電機一次.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_GeneratorCareInterv.cn: 电工和工程师多久保养基地内的发电机一次.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_GeneratorFuelAmount.en: Fuel amount added per generator each interval. This stacks with the number of electricians and engineers assigned to the base.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_GeneratorFuelAmount.ch: 每個間隔為每台發電機補充的燃料量. 此數值會隨基地指派的電工與工程師人數疊加.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_GeneratorFuelAmount.cn: 每个间隔为每台发电机补充的燃料量. 此数值会随基地分配的电工和工程师人数叠加.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_GeneratorRepairAmou.en: Condition amount repaired per generator each interval. This stacks with the number of electricians and engineers assigned to the base.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_GeneratorRepairAmou.ch: 每個間隔每台發電機修復的耐久度. 此數值會隨基地指派的電工與工程師人數疊加.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_GeneratorRepairAmou.cn: 每个间隔每台发电机修复的耐久度. 此数值会随基地分配的电工和工程师人数叠加.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_MaxCommunitySize_to.en: The maximum total number of community NPCs, including base members and companions.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_MaxCommunitySize_to.ch: 社群 NPC 的總數上限, 包含基地成員與同伴.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_MaxCommunitySize_to.cn: 社区 NPC 的总数上限, 包括基地成员和同伴.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_MaxCompanionSize_to.en: The maximum number of companion NPCs that can follow you at the same time.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_MaxCompanionSize_to.ch: 同時可以跟隨你的同伴 NPC 數量上限.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_MaxCompanionSize_to.cn: 同时可以跟随你的同伴 NPC 数量上限.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCConversationCool.ch: NPC 對話冷卻時間 (分鐘)
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCConversationCool.cn: NPC 对话冷却时间 (分钟)

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCConversationCool.en: How long before the same NPC can provide conversation relief again. Set to 0 for no cooldown.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCConversationCool.ch: 同一名 NPC 需要多久才能再次透過對話紓解情緒. 設為 0 則無冷卻.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCConversationCool.cn: 同一个 NPC 需要多久才能再次通过对话缓解情绪. 设为 0 则无冷却.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCConversationReli.en: How much stress, boredom, and unhappiness are reduced when talking with an NPC. Stress is reduced as a percent; boredom and unhappiness are reduced as values.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCConversationReli.ch: 與 NPC 交談時減少多少壓力, 無聊與不快樂. 壓力以百分比減少; 無聊與不快樂以數值減少.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCConversationReli.cn: 与 NPC 交谈时减少多少压力, 无聊和不快乐. 压力按百分比减少; 无聊和不快乐按数值减少.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCDoorClosingDelay.en: Delay before an NPC closes a nearby door after passing through it.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCDoorClosingDelay.ch: NPC 穿過門後, 關上附近房門前的延遲時間.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCDoorClosingDelay.cn: NPC 穿过门后, 关上附近房门前的延迟时间.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCDoorClosingMode_.en: Choose whether NPCs automatically close nearby open doors shortly after passing through them. Disabled while in combat or while someone is near the door.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCDoorClosingMode_.ch: 選擇 NPC 穿過門後是否會在短時間內自動關上附近開著的門. 戰鬥中或有人在門附近時停用.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NPCDoorClosingMode_.cn: 选择 NPC 穿过门后是否会在短时间内自动关上附近开着的门. 战斗中或有人在门附近时禁用.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcArmedProfessionG.ch: 武裝職業 NPC 持槍機率 (%%)
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcArmedProfessionG.cn: 武装职业 NPC 持枪几率 (%%)

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcArmedProfessionG.en: Chance for police officers, security guards, veterans, and park rangers to spawn with a firearm. Default is 100%%.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcArmedProfessionG.ch: 警官, 保全警衛, 老兵與護林員生成時攜帶槍械的機率. 預設為 100%%.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcArmedProfessionG.cn: 警官, 警卫, 退伍军人和护林员生成时携带枪械的几率. 默认为 100%%.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcBaseHealingAmoun.en: Health amount recovered per hour for base members and companions within a base. Unloaded recovery only applies to base members.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcBaseHealingAmoun.ch: 基地成員與位於基地內的同伴每小時恢復的生命值. 未載入時的恢復只適用於基地成員.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcBaseHealingAmoun.cn: 基地成员和位于基地内的同伴每小时恢复的生命值. 未加载时的恢复仅适用于基地成员.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcCivilianGunChanc.ch: 平民 NPC 持槍機率 (%%)
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcCivilianGunChanc.cn: 平民 NPC 持枪几率 (%%)

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcCivilianGunChanc.en: Chance for civilian occupation NPCs to spawn with a firearm. Default is 30%%.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcCivilianGunChanc.ch: 平民職業 NPC 生成時攜帶槍械的機率. 預設為 30%%.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcCivilianGunChanc.cn: 平民职业 NPC 生成时携带枪械的几率. 默认为 30%%.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcGodMode_option2.ch: 僅限流浪者與基地 NPC
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcGodMode_option2.cn: 仅限流浪者和基地 NPC

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcGodMode_tooltip.en: Applies god mode to NPCs with the selected affiliation. Use this if you want to prevent selected NPCs from dying or being injured.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcGodMode_tooltip.ch: 對所選所屬類型的 NPC 套用上帝模式. 若想防止所選 NPC 死亡或受傷, 請使用此選項.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcGodMode_tooltip.cn: 对所选所属类型的 NPC 应用上帝模式. 如果想防止所选 NPC 死亡或受伤, 请使用此选项.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcSpeakChance_tool.en: The chance for NPCs to speak automatically when near the player.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcSpeakChance_tool.ch: NPC 在玩家附近時自動說話的機率.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcSpeakChance_tool.cn: NPC 在玩家附近时自动说话的几率.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcTreatmentBandage.en: Choose which bandage type NPCs use when treating injuries. If set to Ripped Sheets, NPCs will use a Sterilized Bandage or Bandage from their inventory if they have one.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcTreatmentBandage.ch: 選擇 NPC 治療傷口時使用的繃帶種類. 若設為碎布, NPC 物品欄中若有已消毒繃帶或繃帶, 仍會使用它們.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_NpcTreatmentBandage.cn: 选择 NPC 治疗伤口时使用的绷带种类. 如果设为碎布条, NPC 物品栏中若有绷带 (消毒) 或绷带, 仍会使用它们.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_OccupationScavengeC.en: Chance for each occupation to bring back an item from its occupation-specific loot tables. This is rolled separately for each occupation.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_OccupationScavengeC.ch: 各職業從其專屬戰利品表帶回一件物品的機率. 每個職業分別判定.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_OccupationScavengeC.cn: 各职业从其专属战利品表带回一件物品的几率. 每个职业单独判定.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ScavengeIntervalHou.en: How often community members scavenge for items while at the base.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ScavengeIntervalHou.ch: 社群成員在基地時多久搜刮一次物品.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ScavengeIntervalHou.cn: 社区成员在基地时多久搜刮一次物品.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_SecurityGuardPatrol.ch: 保全警衛巡邏等待時間 (小時)
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_SecurityGuardPatrol.cn: 警卫巡逻等待时间 (小时)

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_SecurityGuardPatrol.en: How many in-game hours security guards wait at each guard position. Set to 0 for no wait, or -1 to disable patrol cycling and keep guards at their assigned position.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_SecurityGuardPatrol.ch: 保全警衛在每個警戒位置等待的遊戲內時數. 設為 0 則不等待, 設為 -1 則停用巡邏輪替, 讓警衛留在指派的位置.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_SecurityGuardPatrol.cn: 警卫在每个警戒位置等待的游戏内小时数. 设为 0 则不等待, 设为 -1 则禁用巡逻轮换, 让警卫留在分配的位置.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowNpcNameplates_t.en: If checked, NPC names are shown above their heads when the player is within 5 tiles. Speech bubbles replace the name while displayed.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowNpcNameplates_t.ch: 勾選後, 玩家在 5 格內時, NPC 頭頂會顯示名稱. 顯示對話泡泡時會取代名稱.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowNpcNameplates_t.cn: 勾选后, 玩家在 5 格范围内时, NPC 头顶会显示名称. 显示对话气泡时会替代名称.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowRecruitedMapMar.ch: 已招募 NPC 地圖標記
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowRecruitedMapMar.cn: 已招募 NPC 地图标记

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowRecruitedMapMar.en: If checked, companions are shown in blue and base NPCs in green on the world map and minimap.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowRecruitedMapMar.ch: 勾選後, 同伴會以藍色, 基地 NPC 以綠色顯示在世界地圖與小地圖上.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowRecruitedMapMar.cn: 勾选后, 同伴以蓝色, 基地 NPC 以绿色显示在世界地图和小地图上.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowWandererMapMark.ch: 流浪者 NPC 地圖標記
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowWandererMapMark.cn: 流浪者 NPC 地图标记

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowWandererMapMark.en: If checked, wanderer NPCs are shown on the world map and minimap with red markers.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowWandererMapMark.ch: 勾選後, 流浪者 NPC 會以紅色標記顯示在世界地圖與小地圖上.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_ShowWandererMapMark.cn: 勾选后, 流浪者 NPC 会以红色标记显示在世界地图和小地图上.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_VehicleRepairAmount.en: Condition amount repaired per vehicle part each interval. This stacks with the number of mechanics assigned to the base.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_VehicleRepairAmount.ch: 每個間隔每個車輛零件修復的耐久度. 此數值會隨基地指派的機工人數疊加.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_VehicleRepairAmount.cn: 每个间隔每个车辆零件修复的耐久度. 此数值会随基地分配的汽修工人数叠加.

Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_VehicleRepairInterv.en: How often mechanics repair vehicles in the base.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_VehicleRepairInterv.ch: 機工多久維修基地內的車輛一次.
Sandbox_NotAlone_NPC_VehicleRepairInterv.cn: 汽修工多久维修基地内的车辆一次.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalConditionLo.en: Whether high bloodlust increases chance to lose weapon condition on hit, while also adding more Maintenance experience.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalConditionLo.ch: 高嗜血值是否會增加擊中時武器損失耐久度的機率, 同時提供更多維護經驗.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalConditionLo.cn: 高嗜血值是否会增加命中时武器损失耐久度的几率, 同时提供更多维护经验.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalDamageWithB.en: Whether to deal additional damage for hits with bare hands.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalDamageWithB.ch: 徒手攻擊時是否造成額外傷害.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalDamageWithB.cn: 徒手攻击时是否造成额外伤害.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalDamageWorks.ch: 額外傷害適用於遠距攻擊

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalDamageWorks.en: Whether to deal additional damage when shooting with firearms.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalDamageWorks.ch: 使用槍械射擊時是否造成額外傷害.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AdditionalDamageWorks.cn: 使用枪械射击时是否造成额外伤害.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AffectIncomingDamage_.en: Whether your bloodlust level may change how much damage you take.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AffectIncomingDamage_.ch: 你的嗜血值是否會改變你承受的傷害.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AffectIncomingDamage_.cn: 你的嗜血值是否会改变你承受的伤害.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsBloodl.cn: 抗抑郁药嗜血值压制量

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsBloodl.en:
How much bloodlust is suppressed as result of taking antidepressants. It can be stacked.

Bloodlust is suppressed gradually as antidepressants kick in (uses fade in time).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsBloodl.ch:
服用抑鬱藥後壓制的嗜血值. 可以疊加.

抑鬱藥起效時會逐漸壓制嗜血值 (使用起效時間).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsBloodl.cn:
服用抗抑郁药后压制的嗜血值. 可以叠加.

抗抑郁药起效时会逐渐压制嗜血值 (使用起效时间).

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsDurati.en:
How many game world minutes antidepressants effects last.

1020 is 17 hours.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsDurati.ch:
抑鬱藥效果持續多少遊戲世界分鐘.

1020 為 17 小時.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsDurati.cn:
抗抑郁药效果持续多少游戏世界分钟.

1020 为 17 小时.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsFadeIn.en:
How many game world minutes it takes for the antidepressants effect to reach maximum intensity.
In vanilla they start to reduce unhappiness only after 2 hours.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsFadeIn.ch:
抑鬱藥效果達到最大強度需要多少遊戲世界分鐘.
原版中它們要 2 小時後才開始減少憂鬱.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsFadeIn.cn:
抗抑郁药效果达到最大强度需要多少游戏世界分钟.
原版中它们要 2 小时后才开始减少忧郁.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsFadeOu.en:
This many minutes before the base duration runs out, the antidepressants effects start to decline.
This is counted from base duration; e.g. with duration of 1020 and fade out time of 360,
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsFadeOu.ch:
在基礎持續時間結束前的這麼多分鐘, 抑鬱藥效果開始減弱.
此數值從基礎持續時間起算; 例如持續時間 1020, 消退時間 360,
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsFadeOu.cn:
在基础持续时间结束前的这么多分钟, 抗抑郁药效果开始减弱.
此数值从基础持续时间起算; 例如持续时间 1020, 消退时间 360,

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsIntrus.ch: 抑鬱藥侵入性思維修正
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsIntrus.cn: 抗抑郁药侵入性思维修正

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsIntrus.en: Intensity of intrusive thoughts is multiplied by this while antidepressants are active.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsIntrus.ch: 抑鬱藥生效期間, 侵入性思維的強度會乘以此數值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsIntrus.cn: 抗抑郁药生效期间, 侵入性思维的强度会乘以此数值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsKillCr.cn: 抗抑郁药杀戮渴望修正

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsKillCr.en:
Modifier for bloodlust increase due to kill craving while antidepressants are active.

0.1 means your bloodlust increases only at 10%% rate.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsKillCr.ch:
抑鬱藥生效期間, 殺戮渴望造成的嗜血值增長修正.

0.1 表示你的嗜血值只以 10%% 的速度增長.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsKillCr.cn:
抗抑郁药生效期间, 杀戮渴望造成的嗜血值增长修正.

0.1 表示你的嗜血值只以 10%% 的速度增长.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsKillSa.cn: 抗抑郁药杀戮满足修正

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsKillSa.en:
Modifier for bloodlust increase/decrease on hits and kills while antidepressants are active.

0.5 means they change your bloodlust by only 50%% of normal rate.

Doesn't affect bloodlust reduced by instakills.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsKillSa.ch:
抑鬱藥生效期間, 擊中與擊殺時嗜血值增減的修正.

0.5 表示它們只以正常速度的 50%% 改變你的嗜血值.

不影響秒殺所減少的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsKillSa.cn:
抗抑郁药生效期间, 命中和击杀时嗜血值增减的修正.

0.5 表示它们只以正常速度的 50%% 改变你的嗜血值.

不影响秒杀所减少的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsMoodDe.cn: 抗抑郁药情绪减益修正

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsMoodDe.en:
Modifier for mood debuffs due to kill craving while antidepressants are active.

0.1 means your bloodlust increases only at 10%% rate.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsMoodDe.ch:
抑鬱藥生效期間, 殺戮渴望造成的情緒減益修正.

0.1 表示你的嗜血值只以 10%% 的速度增長.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsMoodDe.cn:
抗抑郁药生效期间, 杀戮渴望造成的情绪减益修正.

0.1 表示你的嗜血值只以 10%% 的速度增长.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsRedVis.cn: 抗抑郁药红色视野修正

Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsRedVis.en: Intensity of vision redness is multiplied by this while antidepressants are active.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsRedVis.ch: 抑鬱藥生效期間, 視野泛紅的強度會乘以此數值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_AntidepressantsRedVis.cn: 抗抑郁药生效期间, 视野泛红的强度会乘以此数值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersBloodlust.ch: 乙型阻斷劑嗜血值壓制量

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersBloodlust.en:
How much bloodlust is suppressed as result of taking beta blockers. It can be stacked.

Bloodlust is suppressed gradually as beta blockers kick in (uses fade in time).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersBloodlust.ch:
服用乙型阻斷劑後壓制的嗜血值. 可以疊加.

乙型阻斷劑起效時會逐漸壓制嗜血值 (使用起效時間).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersBloodlust.cn:
服用β-阻断剂后压制的嗜血值. 可以叠加.

β-阻断剂起效时会逐渐压制嗜血值 (使用起效时间).

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersDuration_.en:
How many game world minutes beta blockers effects last.

600 is 10 hours.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersDuration_.ch:
乙型阻斷劑效果持續多少遊戲世界分鐘.

600 為 10 小時.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersDuration_.cn:
β-阻断剂效果持续多少游戏世界分钟.

600 为 10 小时.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersFadeInTim.en:
How many game world minutes it takes for the beta blockers effect to reach maximum intensity.
In vanilla they start to reduce unhappiness only after 2 hours.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersFadeInTim.ch:
乙型阻斷劑效果達到最大強度需要多少遊戲世界分鐘.
原版中它們要 2 小時後才開始減少憂鬱.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersFadeInTim.cn:
β-阻断剂效果达到最大强度需要多少游戏世界分钟.
原版中它们要 2 小时后才开始减少忧郁.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersFadeOutTi.en:
This many minutes before the base duration runs out, the beta blockers effects start to decline.
This is counted from base duration; e.g. with duration of 1020 and fade out time of 360,
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersFadeOutTi.ch:
在基礎持續時間結束前的這麼多分鐘, 乙型阻斷劑效果開始減弱.
此數值從基礎持續時間起算; 例如持續時間 1020, 消退時間 360,
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersFadeOutTi.cn:
在基础持续时间结束前的这么多分钟, β-阻断剂效果开始减弱.
此数值从基础持续时间起算; 例如持续时间 1020, 消退时间 360,

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersKillCravi.ch: 乙型阻斷劑殺戮渴望修正

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersKillCravi.en:
Modifier for bloodlust increase due to kill craving while beta blockers are active.

0.1 means your bloodlust increases only at 10%% rate.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersKillCravi.ch:
乙型阻斷劑生效期間, 殺戮渴望造成的嗜血值增長修正.

0.1 表示你的嗜血值只以 10%% 的速度增長.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersKillCravi.cn:
β-阻断剂生效期间, 杀戮渴望造成的嗜血值增长修正.

0.1 表示你的嗜血值只以 10%% 的速度增长.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersKillSatis.ch: 乙型阻斷劑殺戮滿足修正

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersKillSatis.en:
Modifier for bloodlust increase/decrease on hits and kills while beta blockers are active.

0.4 means they change your bloodlust by only 40%% of normal rate.

Doesn't affect bloodlust reduced by instakills.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersKillSatis.ch:
乙型阻斷劑生效期間, 擊中與擊殺時嗜血值增減的修正.

0.4 表示它們只以正常速度的 40%% 改變你的嗜血值.

不影響秒殺所減少的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersKillSatis.cn:
β-阻断剂生效期间, 命中和击杀时嗜血值增减的修正.

0.4 表示它们只以正常速度的 40%% 改变你的嗜血值.

不影响秒杀所减少的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersLossOfCon.en: Beta Blockers Loss Of Control Modifier

Modifier for loss of control chances and progression while beta blockers are active.

0.25 basically means you'll lose control only 25%% as often.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersLossOfCon.ch:
乙型阻斷劑生效期間, 失控機率與進程的修正.

0.25 大致表示你失控的頻率只有 25%%.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersLossOfCon.cn:
β-阻断剂生效期间, 失控几率和进程的修正.

0.25 大致表示你失控的频率只有 25%%.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersPhrasesCh.ch: 乙型阻斷劑喊叫機率修正

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersPhrasesCh.en:
How much active beta-blockers reduce the chance of your character shouting on bloodlust actions, e.g. instakills.
(Without beta-blockers the chance is always 100%%)

Note that this modifier, like all others, is reached smoothly as beta blockers kick in (fade in time).

Also note that this doesn't affect loss of control phrases, as they are purely informational and don't attract zombies.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersPhrasesCh.ch:
生效中的乙型阻斷劑能降低多少你的角色在嗜血行動 (例如秒殺) 時喊叫的機率.
(沒有乙型阻斷劑時機率永遠為 100%%)

請注意, 此修正值與其他修正值一樣, 會隨乙型阻斷劑起效而平滑達到 (起效時間).

另請注意, 這不影響失控時的台詞, 因為它們純粹是提示資訊, 不會吸引殭屍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BetaBlockersPhrasesCh.cn:
生效中的β-阻断剂能降低多少你的角色在嗜血行动 (例如秒杀) 时喊叫的几率.
(没有β-阻断剂时几率始终为 100%%)

请注意, 此修正值与其他修正值一样, 会随着β-阻断剂起效而平滑达到 (起效时间).

另请注意, 这不影响失控时的台词, 因为它们纯粹是提示信息, 不会吸引僵尸.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessForBloodyKi.ch: 血腥擊殺所需沾血程度
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessForBloodyKi.cn: 血腥击杀所需沾血程度

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessForBloodyKi.en: Minimum overall bloodiness for a kill to be scored as bloody.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessForBloodyKi.ch: 擊殺被計為血腥擊殺所需的最低整體沾血程度.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessForBloodyKi.cn: 击杀被计为血腥击杀所需的最低整体沾血程度.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessForFrenzy_t.en:
How bloody overall you must be to start progressing towards frenzy.

You may set this beyond 100%% if you intend to require at least some freshness.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessForFrenzy_t.ch:
整體沾血程度需要多高才會開始朝狂暴推進.

若你打算至少要求一定的新鮮度, 可將此值設為超過 100%%.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessForFrenzy_t.cn:
整体沾血程度需要多高才会开始朝狂暴推进.

如果你打算至少要求一定的新鲜度, 可将此值设为超过 100%%.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessFreshnessFr.ch: 沾血新鮮度狂暴進程指數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessFreshnessFr.cn: 沾血新鲜度狂暴进程指数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessFreshnessFr.en:
Determines how strongly bloodiness freshness accelerates progress toward frenzy.

At 4, 50%% freshness doubles the rate of frenzy progression, while 100%% freshness quadruples it.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessFreshnessFr.ch:
決定沾血新鮮度對狂暴進程的加速程度.

設為 4 時, 50%% 新鮮度會使狂暴進程速度加倍, 100%% 新鮮度則變為四倍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessFreshnessFr.cn:
决定沾血新鲜度对狂暴进程的加速程度.

设为 4 时, 50%% 新鲜度会使狂暴进程速度加倍, 100%% 新鲜度则变为四倍.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessFreshnessMu.en:
How much bloodiness freshness makes bloodiness count as more.

0.5 means 100%% freshness counts like +50%% more of bloodiness.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessFreshnessMu.ch:
沾血新鮮度會讓沾血程度多算多少.

0.5 表示 100%% 新鮮度等同多算 +50%% 沾血程度.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessFreshnessMu.cn:
沾血新鲜度会让沾血程度多算多少.

0.5 表示 100%% 新鲜度等同多算 +50%% 沾血程度.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessImpactOnMoo.ch: 沾血程度對情緒減益的影響
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessImpactOnMoo.cn: 沾血程度对情绪减益的影响

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessImpactOnMoo.en:
How much your bloodiness reduces the time it takes to reach 100%% unhappiness/stress/boredom.

0.5 means 50%% quicker worst mood if 100%% bloody.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessImpactOnMoo.ch:
你的沾血程度能縮短多少達到 100%% 憂鬱/壓力/無聊所需的時間.

0.5 表示若 100%% 沾血, 最差情緒會快 50%% 到來.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodinessImpactOnMoo.cn:
你的沾血程度能缩短多少达到 100%% 忧郁/压力/无聊所需的时间.

0.5 表示若 100%% 沾血, 最差情绪会快 50%% 到来.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustAdditionalDa.en:
How much additional damage to deal at instakill bloodlust level in frenzy.

The bonus increases smoothly as bloodlust rises, reaching the value you set at the bloodlust level required for instakill.

With bloodlust required for instakill set to 90 and default additional damage of 0.75,
you'll deal 0.75 bonus damage at 90 bloodlust, 0.375 at 45 bloodlust, etc.

Max zombie health is 2.0.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustAdditionalDa.ch:
狂暴狀態下, 嗜血值達到秒殺門檻時造成的額外傷害.

加成會隨嗜血值上升平滑增加, 在達到秒殺所需嗜血值時達到你設定的數值.

若秒殺所需嗜血值設為 90, 額外傷害為預設的 0.75,
則在嗜血值 90 時造成 0.75 額外傷害, 嗜血值 45 時為 0.375, 以此類推.

殭屍最大生命值為 2.0.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustAdditionalDa.cn:
狂暴状态下, 嗜血值达到秒杀门槛时造成的额外伤害.

加成会随嗜血值上升平滑增加, 在达到秒杀所需嗜血值时达到你设置的数值.

若秒杀所需嗜血值设为 90, 额外伤害为默认的 0.75,
则在嗜血值 90 时造成 0.75 额外伤害, 嗜血值 45 时为 0.375, 以此类推.

僵尸最大生命值为 2.0.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustAdditionalDa.en:
How much additional damage to deal at instakill bloodlust level.

The bonus increases smoothly as bloodlust rises, reaching the value you set at the bloodlust level required for instakill.

With bloodlust required for instakill set to 90 and default additional damage of 0.5,
you'll deal 0.5 bonus damage at 90 bloodlust, 0.25 at 45 bloodlust, etc.

Max zombie health is 2.0.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustAdditionalDa.ch:
嗜血值達到秒殺門檻時造成的額外傷害.

加成會隨嗜血值上升平滑增加, 在達到秒殺所需嗜血值時達到你設定的數值.

若秒殺所需嗜血值設為 90, 額外傷害為預設的 0.5,
則在嗜血值 90 時造成 0.5 額外傷害, 嗜血值 45 時為 0.25, 以此類推.

殭屍最大生命值為 2.0.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustAdditionalDa.cn:
嗜血值达到秒杀门槛时造成的额外伤害.

加成会随嗜血值上升平滑增加, 在达到秒杀所需嗜血值时达到你设置的数值.

若秒杀所需嗜血值设为 90, 额外伤害为默认的 0.5,
则在嗜血值 90 时造成 0.5 额外伤害, 嗜血值 45 时为 0.25, 以此类推.

僵尸最大生命值为 2.0.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustChangeDestre.en:
Proportion of bloodlust change from hits/kills to add as stress reduction.

With 5, it'll take 20 bloodlust increased/decreased to go from 100%% stress to absolute chill.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustChangeDestre.ch:
擊中/擊殺造成的嗜血值變化中, 轉換為壓力降低的比例.

設為 5 時, 嗜血值增減 20 即可從 100%% 壓力降到完全放鬆.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustChangeDestre.cn:
击中/击杀造成的嗜血值变化中, 转换为压力降低的比例.

设为 5 时, 嗜血值增减 20 即可从 100%% 压力降到完全放松.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustChangeHappin.en:
Proportion of bloodlust change from hits/kills to add as unhappiness reduction.

With 2, it'll take 50 bloodlust increased/decreased to go from depression to happiness.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustChangeHappin.ch:
擊中/擊殺造成的嗜血值變化中, 轉換為憂鬱降低的比例.

設為 2 時, 嗜血值增減 50 即可從沮喪變為快樂.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustChangeHappin.cn:
击中/击杀造成的嗜血值变化中, 转换为忧郁降低的比例.

设为 2 时, 嗜血值增减 50 即可从抑郁变为快乐.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustConditionLos.en:
Maximum multiplier for the chance to lose weapon condition on hit.

It multiplies whatever your current chance to lose weapon durability is (base weapon chance + maintenance correction).
Ex. if you have 0 skills and weapon base chance is 10%%, 1.5 multiplier turns it into 15%%.

The multiplier smoothly increases starting from 1.0 to this value as bloodlust rises, reaching the set multiplier at 100%% bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustConditionLos.ch:
擊中時武器損耗耐久機率的最大倍率.

它會乘上你目前武器損耗耐久的機率 (武器基礎機率 + 維護技能修正).
例: 若你技能為 0, 武器基礎機率為 10%%, 1.5 倍率會使其變為 15%%.

倍率會隨嗜血值上升從 1.0 平滑增加, 在嗜血值 100%% 時達到設定值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustConditionLos.cn:
击中时武器损耗耐久几率的最大倍率.

它会乘上你当前武器损耗耐久的几率 (武器基础几率 + 维护技能修正).
例: 若你技能为 0, 武器基础几率为 10%%, 1.5 倍率会使其变为 15%%.

倍率会随嗜血值上升从 1.0 平滑增加, 在嗜血值 100%% 时达到设置值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustForExertionB.en:
Minimum bloodlust to start buffering exertion at.

Note that in frenzy your exertion is always buffered.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustForExertionB.ch:
開始累積勞累的最低嗜血值.

注意: 狂暴時勞累一律會被累積.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustForExertionB.cn:
开始累积劳累的最低嗜血值.

注意: 狂暴时劳累总是会被累积.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustForPanicImmu.en:
You won't panic when above this bloodlust.

You'll also recover from panic significantly faster the closer you are to immunity.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustForPanicImmu.ch:
嗜血值高於此值時你不會恐慌.

越接近免疫門檻, 從恐慌中恢復的速度也會明顯加快.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustForPanicImmu.cn:
嗜血值高于此值时你不会恐慌.

越接近免疫门槛, 从恐慌中恢复的速度也会明显加快.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustLevelForMood.en:
Bloodlust after which unhappiness, stress and boredom starts to increase if you aren't fighting.

The increase starts small, and reaches its maximum at 100%% bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustLevelForMood.ch:
嗜血值超過此值後, 若你沒有戰鬥, 憂鬱, 壓力與無聊會開始增加.

增加幅度一開始很小, 在嗜血值 100%% 時達到最大.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustLevelForMood.cn:
嗜血值超过此值后, 若你没有战斗, 忧郁, 压力和无聊会开始增加.

增加幅度一开始很小, 在嗜血值 100%% 时达到最大.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustOverreducedF.ch: 進入狂暴所需超額消耗嗜血值
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustOverreducedF.cn: 进入狂暴所需超额消耗嗜血值

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustOverreducedF.en: You must reduce this much bloodlust (via hits/kills) while having no bloodlust to go into frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustOverreducedF.ch: 在嗜血值為零時, 你必須 (透過擊中/擊殺) 再消耗這麼多嗜血值才會進入狂暴.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustOverreducedF.cn: 在嗜血值为零时, 你必须 (通过击中/击杀) 再消耗这么多嗜血值才会进入狂暴.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustSuppression_.en: Whether bloodlust reduced as result of taking pills, curling up, or hugging the plushie is remembered.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustSuppression_.ch: 是否記住因服藥, 蜷縮身體或擁抱絨毛玩偶而降低的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodlustSuppression_.cn: 是否记住因服药, 蜷缩身体或拥抱毛绒玩偶而降低的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayBelow.ch: 血腥擊殺衰減沾血門檻
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayBelow.cn: 血腥击杀衰减沾血门槛

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayBelow.en: Bloody kills will decay every hour at this bloodiness.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayBelow.ch: 沾血程度降至此值時, 血腥擊殺數每小時會衰減.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayBelow.cn: 沾血程度降至此值时, 血腥击杀数每小时会衰减.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayInSle.en: Whether to decay bloody kills while you're sleeping.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayInSle.ch: 睡覺時是否讓血腥擊殺數衰減.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayInSle.cn: 睡觉时是否让血腥击杀数衰减.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayPerHo.ch: 每小時血腥擊殺衰減量
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayPerHo.cn: 每小时血腥击杀衰减量

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayPerHo.en: How many bloody kills are removed every hour if you're not bloody.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayPerHo.ch: 若你身上沒有沾血, 每小時移除多少血腥擊殺數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsDecayPerHo.cn: 若你身上没有沾血, 每小时移除多少血腥击杀数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsToEarn.ch: 獲得特質所需血腥擊殺數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsToEarn.cn: 获得特质所需血腥击杀数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsToEarn_too.en: How many bloody kills it takes to earn the trait.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsToEarn_too.ch: 需要多少血腥擊殺才能獲得此特質.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BloodyKillsToEarn_too.cn: 需要多少血腥击杀才能获得此特质.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_BufferExertionAfter_t.en:
Once you reach this level of exertion, start passively storing it.

25 is when first exertion moodle "Out of Breath" appears.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BufferExertionAfter_t.ch:
勞累達到此程度後, 開始被動累積勞累.

25 時會出現第一個勞累狀態「有點喘氣」.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_BufferExertionAfter_t.cn:
劳累达到此程度后, 开始被动累积劳累.

25 时会出现第一个劳累状态“气喘吁吁”.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ChanceToStopDeathRamp.en: Chance To Stop Death Rampage On Kill
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ChanceToStopDeathRamp.ch: 擊殺時停止死亡暴走機率
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ChanceToStopDeathRamp.cn: 击杀时停止死亡暴走几率

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ChanceToStopDeathRamp.en:
Percentage chance to recover from death rampage on kill.

With 0.56%% chance, it'll take you ~180 kills on average to recover.
Given -0.55 health every minute in combat that's 1 kill every single minute.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ChanceToStopDeathRamp.ch:
擊殺時從死亡暴走中恢復的百分比機率.

機率為 0.56%% 時, 平均約需 180 次擊殺才能恢復.
以戰鬥中每分鐘 -0.55 生命值計算, 等於每分鐘都要擊殺 1 隻.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ChanceToStopDeathRamp.cn:
击杀时从死亡暴走中恢复的百分比几率.

几率为 0.56%% 时, 平均约需 180 次击杀才能恢复.
按战斗中每分钟 -0.55 生命值计算, 相当于每分钟都要击杀 1 只.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConditionLossMaintena.ch: 耐久損耗維護經驗倍率
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConditionLossMaintena.cn: 耐久损耗维护经验倍率

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConditionLossMaintena.en:
Multiplier for the bonus experience you get for increased chance to lose condition.

If your current condition loss multiplier is 2.0, you'll get twice the experience on each hit,
which is then multiplied by this number.

So 0.6 means you get 60%% of the bonus experience.

Note that in vanilla you get experience only half of the time (50%% chance), 0.5 xp multiplier kinda simulates that.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConditionLossMaintena.ch:
因耐久損耗機率提高而獲得的額外經驗倍率.

若你目前的耐久損耗倍率為 2.0, 每次擊中都會獲得兩倍經驗,
再乘上此數值.

因此 0.6 代表你會獲得 60%% 的額外經驗.

注意: 原版中你只有一半機率獲得經驗 (50%% 機率), 0.5 經驗倍率大致模擬了這點.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConditionLossMaintena.cn:
因耐久损耗几率提高而获得的额外经验倍率.

若你当前的耐久损耗倍率为 2.0, 每次击中都会获得两倍经验,
再乘以此数值.

因此 0.6 代表你会获得 60%% 的额外经验.

注意: 原版中你只有一半几率获得经验 (50%% 几率), 0.5 经验倍率大致模拟了这一点.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConsiderCarDriveOverA.en: Consider Car Drive Over As Combat
Whether killing zombies by driving over them is considered as hits (Used for fightless combat bloodlust increase).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConsiderCarDriveOverA.ch: 開車輾過殭屍將其擊殺是否視為擊中 (用於戰鬥中未命中任何目標時的嗜血值增加機制).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConsiderCarDriveOverA.cn: 开车碾过僵尸将其击杀是否视为击中 (用于战斗中未命中任何目标时的嗜血值增加机制).

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConsiderShovesAndStom.en: Consider Shoves And Stomps As Hits
Whether shoving and stomping are considered as hits (Used for fightless combat bloodlust increase).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConsiderShovesAndStom.ch: 推擊與踩踏是否視為擊中 (用於戰鬥中未命中任何目標時的嗜血值增加機制).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ConsiderShovesAndStom.cn: 推击与踩踏是否视为击中 (用于战斗中未命中任何目标时的嗜血值增加机制).

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingBase.en:
Base swing speed bonus during Attacking outburst, when there is no progress towards Locked In.

0.4 means +40%% speed.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingBase.ch:
攻擊發作期間, 尚未累積任何殺紅眼進度時的基礎揮擊速度加成.

0.4 代表速度 +40%%.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingBase.cn:
攻击发作期间, 尚未积累任何杀红眼进度时的基础挥击速度加成.

0.4 代表速度 +40%%.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingBonu.ch: 攻擊瞄準移動速度加成
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingBonu.cn: 攻击瞄准移动速度加成

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingBonu.en:
Movement speed bonus during Attacking outburst while aiming.

0.3 means +30%% speed.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingBonu.ch:
攻擊發作期間瞄準時的移動速度加成.

0.3 代表速度 +30%%.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingBonu.cn:
攻击发作期间瞄准时的移动速度加成.

0.3 代表速度 +30%%.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingBonu.en:
Movement speed bonus during Attacking outburst.

0.1 means +10%% speed.

Doesn't apply to aiming - it has its own bonus below.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingBonu.ch:
攻擊發作期間的移動速度加成.

0.1 代表速度 +10%%.

不適用於瞄準 - 瞄準有下方的獨立加成.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingBonu.cn:
攻击发作期间的移动速度加成.

0.1 代表速度 +10%%.

不适用于瞄准 - 瞄准有下方的独立加成.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingChan.en:
When you're already experiencing Following outburst, adds this much to Attacking chance.
Note that the final chance still depends on bloodlust level.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingChan.ch:
當你已處於尾隨發作時, 攻擊機率增加此數值.
注意: 最終機率仍取決於嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingChan.cn:
当你已处于尾随发作时, 攻击几率增加此数值.
注意: 最终几率仍取决于嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingChan.en:
When you're already experiencing Tracking outburst, adds this much to Attacking chance.
Note that the final chance still depends on bloodlust level.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingChan.ch:
當你已處於追蹤發作時, 攻擊機率增加此數值.
注意: 最終機率仍取決於嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingChan.cn:
当你已处于追踪发作时, 攻击几率增加此数值.
注意: 最终几率仍取决于嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingChan.en:
The chance for Attacking outburst to occur.

Tested every "Targeting Test Every" real seconds,
after you don't attack a zombie within your range while aiming for "Attacking Targeting Time" real seconds.

The chance will start at 0%% at min bloodlust, then increase linearly up to this value at max bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingChan.ch:
攻擊發作的發生機率.

當你瞄準攻擊範圍內的殭屍卻持續「攻擊瞄準時間」真實秒數未出手後,
每隔「瞄準判定間隔」真實秒數判定一次.

機率在最低嗜血值時從 0%% 開始, 線性增加至最高嗜血值時的此數值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingChan.cn:
攻击发作的发生几率.

当你瞄准攻击范围内的僵尸却持续“攻击瞄准时间”真实秒数未出手后,
每隔“瞄准判定间隔”真实秒数判定一次.

几率在最低嗜血值时从 0%% 开始, 线性增加至最高嗜血值时的此数值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.en:
Whether to force equip a melee weapon if you're not holding one.
Otherwise Attacking outburst will end.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.ch:
若你沒有拿著近戰武器, 是否強制裝備一把.
否則攻擊發作會結束.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.cn:
若你没有拿着近战武器, 是否强制装备一把.
否则攻击发作会结束.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.ch: 攻擊強制瞄準最長時間
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.cn: 攻击强制瞄准最长时间

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.en: Maximum real seconds you'll be forced to aim when Attacking outburst occurs.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.ch: 攻擊發作時你被強制瞄準的最長真實秒數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.cn: 攻击发作时你被强制瞄准的最长真实秒数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.ch: 攻擊強制瞄準最短時間
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.cn: 攻击强制瞄准最短时间

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.en: Minimum real seconds you'll be forced to aim when Attacking outburst occurs.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.ch: 攻擊發作時你被強制瞄準的最短真實秒數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingForc.cn: 攻击发作时你被强制瞄准的最短真实秒数.

Flat attack range bonus for involuntary attacks during Attacking outburst.

ONLY FOR INVOLUNTARY SWINGS! Does not apply to you hitting manually.

1 means involuntary attacks can hit 1 tiles farther.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingIncr.ch:
攻擊發作期間非自主攻擊的固定攻擊距離加成.

僅適用於非自主揮擊! 你手動攻擊時不適用.

1 代表非自主攻擊可多打到 1 格遠.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingIncr.cn:
攻击发作期间非自主攻击的固定攻击距离加成.

仅适用于非自主挥击! 你手动攻击时不适用.

1 代表非自主攻击可多打到 1 格远.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMaxB.en: Bloodlust level at which max Attacking chance is reached.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMaxB.ch: 達到最高攻擊機率的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMaxB.cn: 达到最高攻击几率的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMaxS.en: Maximum involuntarily swings Attacking will last for.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMaxS.ch: 攻擊發作最多持續的非自主揮擊次數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMaxS.cn: 攻击发作最多持续的非自主挥击次数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMinB.en: Bloodlust level above which Attacking may occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMinB.ch: 嗜血值高於此值時才可能發生攻擊發作.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMinB.cn: 嗜血值高于此值时才可能发生攻击发作.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMinS.en: Minimum involuntarily swings Attacking will last for.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMinS.ch: 攻擊發作最少持續的非自主揮擊次數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingMinS.cn: 攻击发作最少持续的非自主挥击次数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingOutb.en: Whether there is a chance for your character to start attacking without your input.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingOutb.ch: 你的角色是否有機率在你未操作的情況下自行開始攻擊.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingOutb.cn: 你的角色是否有几率在你未操作的情况下自行开始攻击.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingPeak.en:
Swing speed bonus during Attacking outburst at 100%% Locked In progress.

Actual swing speed is increased smoothly up to this value as you get closer to Locked In.

0.8 means +80%% speed.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingPeak.ch:
殺紅眼進度達 100%% 時, 攻擊發作期間的揮擊速度加成.

實際揮擊速度會隨你越接近殺紅眼而平滑增加至此數值.

0.8 代表速度 +80%%.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingPeak.cn:
杀红眼进度达 100%% 时, 攻击发作期间的挥击速度加成.

实际挥击速度会随你越接近杀红眼而平滑增加至此数值.

0.8 代表速度 +80%%.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingTarg.en: Once Attacking Targeting Time is reached, the chance is tested every time this many real seconds pass.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingTarg.ch: 達到攻擊瞄準時間後, 每經過這麼多真實秒數判定一次機率.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingTarg.cn: 达到攻击瞄准时间后, 每经过这么多真实秒数判定一次几率.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingTarg.en: When you don't attack a zombie for this much time while aiming at it (given you can hit it), Attacking outburst has a chance to occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingTarg.ch: 當你瞄準殭屍 (且在攻擊範圍內) 卻這麼久沒有攻擊時, 攻擊發作就有機率發生.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_AttackingTarg.cn: 当你瞄准僵尸 (且在攻击范围内) 却这么久没有攻击时, 攻击发作就有几率发生.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_CanGoToSleepR.en: Can Go To Sleep Right After Nightmare

Whether to allow going right back to sleeping after having a nightmare.
Otherwise, vanilla rules apply - you won't be able to sleep for an hour after waking up.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_CanGoToSleepR.ch:
是否允許做完惡夢後立刻回去睡覺.
否則套用原版規則 - 醒來後一小時內無法入睡.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_CanGoToSleepR.cn:
是否允许做完噩梦后立刻回去睡觉.
否则沿用原版规则 - 醒来后一小时内无法入睡.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_CheckFailedTa.cn: 每隔这么多真实秒数检查一次失败目标是否可抵达.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingActi.cn: 尾随主动阶段最短真实秒数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingActi.en: Minimum real seconds active phase may last for.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingActi.ch: 主動階段最少持續的真實秒數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingActi.cn: 主动阶段最少持续的真实秒数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingActi.en: Following Active Min Tiles From Zombie

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingActi.cn: 尾随主动阶段与僵尸最小距离 (格)

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingActi.cn: 主动尾随阶段时, 最近的僵尸必须距离多少格.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingAfte.ch: 尾隨開始前最長閒置時間
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingAfte.cn: 尾随开始前最长闲置时间

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingAfte.cn: 闲置尾随开始前, 你必须闲置的最长真实秒数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingAfte.cn: 尾随开始前最短闲置时间

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingAfte.ch: 閒置尾隨開始前, 你必須閒置的最短真實秒數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingAfte.cn: 闲置尾随开始前, 你必须闲置的最短真实秒数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingEndT.en: Chance to immediately start Tracking when Following ends.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingEndT.ch: 尾隨結束時立即開始追蹤的機率.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingEndT.cn: 尾随结束时立即开始追踪的几率.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingIdle.en: Following Idle Min Tiles From Zombie
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingIdle.ch: 尾隨閒置階段與殭屍最小距離 (格)
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingIdle.cn: 尾随闲置阶段与僵尸最小距离 (格)

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingIdle.en: How many tiles away a closest zombie must be for idle following phase.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingIdle.ch: 閒置尾隨階段時, 最近的殭屍必須距離多少格.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingIdle.cn: 闲置尾随阶段时, 最近的僵尸必须距离多少格.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMaxB.en: Bloodlust level at which max following chance is reached.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMaxB.ch: 達到最高尾隨機率的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMaxB.cn: 达到最高尾随几率的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMaxI.en: Maximum in-game minutes following may last.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMaxI.ch: 尾隨最多可持續的遊戲內分鐘數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMaxI.cn: 尾随最多可持续的游戏内分钟数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMinB.en: Bloodlust level above which following may occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMinB.ch: 嗜血值高於此值時才可能發生尾隨.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMinB.cn: 嗜血值高于此值时才可能发生尾随.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMinI.en: Minimum in-game minutes following may last.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMinI.ch: 尾隨最少持續的遊戲內分鐘數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMinI.cn: 尾随最少持续的游戏内分钟数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMove.en: Following Movement Attempt Moves For Seconds
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMove.ch: 尾隨移動嘗試持續秒數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMove.cn: 尾随移动尝试持续秒数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMove.en: During active phase, pressing a movement key will keep you moving towards closest zombie for this many seconds after the key is released.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingMove.ch: 主動階段時, 按下移動鍵後即使放開按鍵, 你仍會朝最近的殭屍持續移動這麼多秒.
