Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingOutb.en:
Your character may walk towards a zombie. Consists of two phases:
1. Active: Any movement input moves you towards closest zombie.
2. Idle: You move towards closest zombie if you're idle.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingOutb.ch:
你的角色可能會走向殭屍. 分為兩個階段:
1. 主動: 任何移動操作都會讓你朝最近的殭屍移動.
2. 閒置: 你閒置時會自行朝最近的殭屍移動.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_FollowingOutb.cn:
你的角色可能会走向僵尸. 分为两个阶段:
1. 主动: 任何移动操作都会让你朝最近的僵尸移动.
2. 闲置: 你闲置时会自行朝最近的僵尸移动.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_ForgetFailedT.en: Forget zombies/squares that you weren't able to go to after this many real minutes.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_ForgetFailedT.ch: 經過這麼多真實分鐘後, 遺忘無法抵達的殭屍/格子.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_ForgetFailedT.cn: 经过这么多真实分钟后, 遗忘无法抵达的僵尸/格子.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.en: Involuntary Hit To Locked In Max Progress
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.ch: 非自主擊中殺紅眼最大進度
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.cn: 非自主击中杀红眼最大进度

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.en:
Maximum progress to add for each involuntary swing that lands during Attacking outburst.
Upon reaching 100 you'll get Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.ch:
攻擊發作期間每次命中的非自主揮擊, 最多增加的進度.
達到 100 時你會進入殺紅眼.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.cn:
攻击发作期间每次命中的非自主挥击, 最多增加的进度.
达到 100 时你会进入杀红眼.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.en: Involuntary Hit To Locked In Min Progress
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.ch: 非自主擊中殺紅眼最小進度
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.cn: 非自主击中杀红眼最小进度

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.en:
Minimum progress to add for each involuntary swing that lands during Attacking outburst.
Upon reaching 100 you'll get Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.ch:
攻擊發作期間每次命中的非自主揮擊, 最少增加的進度.
達到 100 時你會進入殺紅眼.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.cn:
攻击发作期间每次命中的非自主挥击, 最少增加的进度.
达到 100 时你会进入杀红眼.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.en: Involuntary Hit To Locked In Progress Decay After
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.ch: 非自主擊中殺紅眼進度衰減延遲
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.cn: 非自主击中杀红眼进度衰减延迟

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.en: After this many real seconds pass since last involuntary hit, start decaying the progress towards Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.ch: 距上次非自主擊中經過這麼多真實秒數後, 開始衰減殺紅眼進度.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.cn: 距上次非自主击中经过这么多真实秒数后, 开始衰减杀红眼进度.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.en: Involuntary Hit To Locked In Progress Decay Per Second
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.ch: 非自主擊中殺紅眼進度每秒衰減量
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.cn: 非自主击中杀红眼进度每秒衰减量

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.en: How much progress towards Locked In to remove every in-game world minute after you stop letting your character attack on their own.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.ch: 在你停止讓角色自行攻擊後, 每遊戲世界分鐘移除的殺紅眼進度.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_InvoluntaryHi.cn: 在你停止让角色自行攻击后, 每游戏世界分钟移除的杀红眼进度.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBonus.en:
Movement speed bonus during Locked In outburst.

0.05 means +5%% speed.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBonus.ch:
殺紅眼發作期間的移動速度加成.

0.05 代表速度 +5%%.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBonus.cn:
杀红眼发作期间的移动速度加成.

0.05 代表速度 +5%%.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBonus.en:
Swing speed bonus during Locked In outburst.

0.7 means +70%% speed.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBonus.ch:
殺紅眼發作期間的揮擊速度加成.

0.7 代表速度 +70%%.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBonus.cn:
杀红眼发作期间的挥击速度加成.

0.7 代表速度 +70%%.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBuffe.en: Locked In Buffered Exertion To Stop
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBuffe.ch: 停止殺紅眼的累積勞累門檻
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBuffe.cn: 停止杀红眼的累积劳累阈值

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBuffe.en: Percentage of exertion buffer fullness after which Locked In will be stopped.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBuffe.ch: 累積勞累緩衝的填滿百分比達此值後, 殺紅眼會停止.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInBuffe.cn: 累积劳累缓冲的填满百分比达此值后, 杀红眼会停止.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.ch: 殺紅眼時強制裝備武器
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.cn: 杀红眼时强制装备武器

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.en:
Whether to force equip a melee weapon if you're not holding one.
Otherwise Locked In outburst will end.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.ch:
若你沒有拿著近戰武器, 是否強制裝備一把.
否則殺紅眼發作會結束.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.cn:
若你没有拿着近战武器, 是否强制装备一把.
否则杀红眼发作会结束.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.en: Locked In Forced Movement Only If Can See Zombie
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.ch: 殺紅眼僅在看見殭屍時強制移動
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.cn: 杀红眼仅在看见僵尸时强制移动

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.en: Whether you'll only be forced into killing if you can see closest zombie.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.ch: 是否只有在看得見最近的殭屍時, 才會被強制去擊殺.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.cn: 是否只有在看得见最近的僵尸时, 才会被强制去击杀.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.en: Locked In Forced Movement Zombie Distance
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.ch: 殺紅眼強制移動殭屍距離
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.cn: 杀红眼强制移动僵尸距离

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.en:
While Locked In, getting this close to a zombie will force you to kill it - character will move and attack on their own.
Note that this behavior is also forced if a zombie gets within your attack range.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.ch:
殺紅眼時, 靠近殭屍到此距離就會被強制擊殺它 - 角色會自行移動並攻擊.
注意: 若殭屍進入你的攻擊範圍, 也會強制觸發此行為.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInForce.cn:
杀红眼时, 靠近僵尸到此距离就会被强制击杀它 - 角色会自行移动并攻击.
注意: 若僵尸进入你的攻击范围, 也会强制触发此行为.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtK.en: Locked In Hurt Knock Down Chance
Percentage of zombies that will be knocked down when you get hurt while Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtK.ch: 殺紅眼時受傷, 會被擊倒的殭屍百分比.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtK.cn: 杀红眼时受伤, 会被击倒的僵尸百分比.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtP.ch: 殺紅眼受傷推開範圍 (格)
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtP.cn: 杀红眼受伤推开范围 (格)

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtP.en: Zombies within this many tiles to player will be pushed back when you get hurt while Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtP.ch: 殺紅眼時受傷, 距離玩家此格數內的殭屍會被推開.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtP.cn: 杀红眼时受伤, 距离玩家此格数内的僵尸会被推开.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtZ.ch: 殺紅眼受傷推開殭屍數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtZ.cn: 杀红眼受伤推开僵尸数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtZ.en: Maximum number of zombies pushed back when you get hurt while Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtZ.ch: 殺紅眼時受傷, 最多推開的殭屍數量.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInHurtZ.cn: 杀红眼时受伤, 最多推开的僵尸数量.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInIncre.en:
Flat attack range bonus for involuntary attacks during Locked In outburst.

1.5 means involuntary attacks can hit 1.5 tiles farther.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInIncre.ch:
殺紅眼發作期間非自主攻擊的固定攻擊距離加成.

1.5 代表非自主攻擊可多打到 1.5 格遠.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInIncre.cn:
杀红眼发作期间非自主攻击的固定攻击距离加成.

1.5 代表非自主攻击可多打到 1.5 格远.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxBu.en: If your exertion buffer is this percentage full, Locked In won't begin.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxBu.ch: 若你的累積勞累緩衝已滿到此百分比, 殺紅眼不會開始.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxBu.cn: 若你的累积劳累缓冲已满到此百分比, 杀红眼不会开始.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxId.en: Locked In Max Idle Time To Go
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxId.ch: 殺紅眼最長閒置出擊時間
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxId.cn: 杀红眼最长闲置出击时间

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxId.en: Maximum real seconds that must pass since you moved for character to start going towards zombies while Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxId.ch: 殺紅眼時, 自你上次移動後必須經過的最長真實秒數, 角色才會開始走向殭屍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxId.cn: 杀红眼时, 自你上次移动后必须经过的最长真实秒数, 角色才会开始走向僵尸.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxKi.en: Maximum kill count to stop Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxKi.ch: 停止殺紅眼的最高擊殺數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMaxKi.cn: 停止杀红眼的最高击杀数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinId.en: Locked In Min Idle Time To Go
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinId.ch: 殺紅眼最短閒置出擊時間
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinId.cn: 杀红眼最短闲置出击时间

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinId.en: Minimum real seconds that must pass since you moved for character to start going towards zombies while Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinId.ch: 殺紅眼時, 自你上次移動後必須經過的最短真實秒數, 角色才會開始走向殭屍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinId.cn: 杀红眼时, 自你上次移动后必须经过的最短真实秒数, 角色才会开始走向僵尸.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinKi.en: Minimum kill count to stop Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinKi.ch: 停止殺紅眼的最低擊殺數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinKi.cn: 停止杀红眼的最低击杀数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinSw.en:
You'll always swing at least this fast while Locked In, no matter the injuries and endurance.

Vanilla range is 0.8 to 1.6.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinSw.ch:
殺紅眼時, 無論受傷與耐力如何, 你的揮擊速度至少會是此數值.

原版範圍為 0.8 到 1.6.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInMinSw.cn:
杀红眼时, 无论受伤与耐力如何, 你的挥击速度至少会是此数值.

原版范围为 0.8 到 1.6.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInOutbu.en:
Whether letting yourself be consumed by Attacking outburst may result in losing control over your movement as well.
The character will find and kill zombies on their own.
Can only happen in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInOutbu.ch:
是否讓自己被攻擊發作吞噬時, 也可能失去對移動的控制.
角色會自行尋找並擊殺殭屍.
只會在狂暴時發生.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInOutbu.cn:
是否让自己被攻击发作吞噬时, 也可能失去对移动的控制.
角色会自行寻找并击杀僵尸.
只会在狂暴时发生.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInRunIf.en: While Locked In and further than this many tiles from a zombie, the character will run when going for them.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInRunIf.ch: 殺紅眼時, 若與殭屍的距離超過這麼多格, 角色衝向牠們時會奔跑.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInRunIf.cn: 杀红眼时, 若与僵尸的距离超过这么多格, 角色冲向它们时会奔跑.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.en: Locked In Shove Knock Down Chance
Percentage of zombies that will be knocked down when you shove while Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.ch: 殺紅眼時推擊, 會被擊倒的殭屍百分比.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.cn: 杀红眼时推击, 会被击倒的僵尸百分比.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.ch: 殺紅眼推擊推開範圍 (格)
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.cn: 杀红眼推击推开范围 (格)

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.en: Zombies within this many tiles to player will be pushed back when you shove while Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.ch: 殺紅眼時推擊, 距離玩家這麼多格內的殭屍會被推開.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.cn: 杀红眼时推击, 距离玩家这么多格内的僵尸会被推开.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.ch: 殺紅眼推擊推開殭屍數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.cn: 杀红眼推击推开僵尸数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.en: Maximum number of zombies pushed back when you shove while Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.ch: 殺紅眼時推擊, 最多可推開的殭屍數量.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInShove.cn: 杀红眼时推击, 最多可推开的僵尸数量.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStare.en:
When you get forced to go kill a zombie, for this many seconds the character will just stand still, staring at it.
The character will still attack immediately once the zombie is within attack range.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStare.ch:
被迫去擊殺殭屍時, 角色會先站著不動盯著牠這麼多秒.
殭屍一進入攻擊範圍, 角色仍會立即攻擊.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStare.cn:
被迫去击杀僵尸时, 角色会先站着不动盯着它这么多秒.
僵尸一进入攻击范围, 角色仍会立即攻击.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.en:
Real seconds between checking whether your character seems to be unable to reach any zombies, which would end Locked In.

Only checked if all targets were unreachable and you can't control your movement.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.ch:
每隔這麼多現實秒數, 檢查角色是否似乎無法抵達任何殭屍, 若是則結束殺紅眼.

只在所有目標都無法抵達且你無法控制移動時檢查.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.cn:
每隔这么多现实秒数, 检查角色是否似乎无法抵达任何僵尸, 若是则结束杀红眼.

只在所有目标都无法抵达且你无法控制移动时检查.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.en: Locked In Stuck If No Clear Zombies Only
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.ch: 殺紅眼僅在無可直達殭屍時判定卡住
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.cn: 杀红眼仅在无可直达僵尸时判定卡住

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.en: Whether you won't be considered stuck if there is any zombie you can see and go to in straight line without any obstacles.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.ch: 若有任何你看得到、且能直線無障礙走過去的殭屍, 是否不判定為卡住.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.cn: 若有任何你看得到、且能直线无障碍走过去的僵尸, 是否不判定为卡住.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.en: Locked In Stuck If Not Hit For
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.ch: 殺紅眼未攻擊判定卡住秒數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.cn: 杀红眼未攻击判定卡住秒数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.en: Consider the character stuck if they haven't attacked for this many seconds while not under your control.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.ch: 角色不受你控制時, 若這麼多秒都沒有攻擊, 就判定角色卡住.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInStuck.cn: 角色不受你控制时, 若这么多秒都没有攻击, 就判定角色卡住.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInUntou.en: Locked In Untouchable Period After Stop
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInUntou.ch: 殺紅眼結束後無敵時間
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInUntou.cn: 杀红眼结束后无敌时间

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInUntou.en: Once Locked In outburst ends and you regain control, for this many real seconds zombies will be unable to hit you.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInUntou.ch: 殺紅眼發作結束並恢復控制後, 這麼多現實秒數內殭屍無法擊中你.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LockedInUntou.cn: 杀红眼发作结束并恢复控制后, 这么多现实秒数内僵尸无法击中你.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LossOfControl.en:
Whether it's possible for your character to act on their own at high bloodlust.

This is a global toggle for all loss of control / outburst events.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LossOfControl.ch:
嗜血值高時, 角色是否可能自行行動.

這是所有失去控制/發作事件的總開關.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_LossOfControl.cn:
嗜血值高时, 角色是否可能自行行动.

这是所有失去控制/发作事件的总开关.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxArmStiffne.en:
Having more than this muscle strain on any of your arms will stop only Locked In.
But it'll only stop after all other parts have full strain, thus making redistribution to them impossible.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxArmStiffne.ch:
任一手臂的肌肉拉傷超過此值時, 只會停止殺紅眼.
但只會在其他所有部位都已完全拉傷、無法再轉移時才停止.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxArmStiffne.cn:
任一手臂的肌肉拉伤超过此值时, 只会停止杀红眼.
但只会在其他所有部位都已完全拉伤、无法再转移时才停止.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxBodyTemper.en:
If your body temperature is higher than this, stop outbursts.
See https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Hyperthermia
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxBodyTemper.ch:
體溫高於此值時, 停止發作.
參見 https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Hyperthermia
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxBodyTemper.cn:
体温高于此值时, 停止发作.
参见 https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Hyperthermia

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxExertion_t.en:
Having more than this exertion will stop outbursts.
See https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Endurance
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxExertion_t.ch:
勞累超過此值時會停止發作.
參見 https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Endurance
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxExertion_t.cn:
劳累超过此值时会停止发作.
参见 https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Endurance

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxFatigue_to.en:
Having more than this fatigue will stop outbursts.
See https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Tired
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxFatigue_to.ch:
疲勞超過此值時會停止發作.
參見 https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Tired
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxFatigue_to.cn:
疲劳超过此值时会停止发作.
参见 https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Tired

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxHunger_too.en:
Having more than this hunger will stop outbursts.
70 is when you start starving to death.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxHunger_too.ch:
飢餓超過此值時會停止發作.
達到 70 時會開始餓死.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxHunger_too.cn:
饥饿超过此值时会停止发作.
达到 70 时会开始饿死.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxMinutesOut.en: Max Minutes Out Of Combat To Stop Attacking
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxMinutesOut.ch: 脫離戰鬥停止攻擊最長分鐘數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxMinutesOut.cn: 脱离战斗停止攻击最长分钟数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxMinutesOut.en: Maximum in-game world minutes that must pass since you went out of combat to stop Attacking.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxMinutesOut.ch: 脫離戰鬥後, 停止攻擊發作前最多需經過的遊戲內分鐘數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxMinutesOut.cn: 脱离战斗后, 停止攻击发作前最多需经过的游戏内分钟数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxPathfindDi.en:
Zombies the character can go to must be at least within this many tiles.

Actual tiles travelled might be more because of obstacles - this is just a straight-line distance measure.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxPathfindDi.ch:
角色能前往的殭屍至少須在這麼多格內.

因障礙物, 實際走的格數可能更多 - 這只是直線距離.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxPathfindDi.cn:
角色能前往的僵尸至少须在这么多格内.

因障碍物, 实际走的格数可能更多 - 这只是直线距离.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxPoison_too.en:
Having more than this sickness will stop outbursts.
10 poison is when you start taking poison damage.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxPoison_too.ch:
中毒超過此值時會停止發作.
中毒達 10 時開始受到中毒傷害.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxPoison_too.cn:
中毒超过此值时会停止发作.
中毒达 10 时开始受到中毒伤害.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxSecondsSin.en: Max Seconds Since Hit To Stop Locked In
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxSecondsSin.ch: 停止殺紅眼的未攻擊最長秒數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxSecondsSin.cn: 停止杀红眼的未攻击最长秒数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxSecondsSin.en: Maximum real seconds that must pass without your character attacking anyone to stop Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxSecondsSin.ch: 角色未攻擊任何人, 停止殺紅眼前最多需經過的現實秒數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxSecondsSin.cn: 角色未攻击任何人, 停止杀红眼前最多需经过的现实秒数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxSickness_t.en:
Having more than this sickness will stop outbursts.
Fever and damage starts at 90.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxSickness_t.ch:
病況超過此值時會停止發作.
達到 90 時開始發燒並受到傷害.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxSickness_t.cn:
病况超过此值时会停止发作.
达到 90 时开始发烧并受到伤害.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxThirst_too.en:
Having more than this thirst will stop outbursts.
85 is when you start dying of thirst.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxThirst_too.ch:
口渴超過此值時會停止發作.
達到 85 時會開始渴死.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxThirst_too.cn:
口渴超过此值时会停止发作.
达到 85 时会开始渴死.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxZombiesNea.en: Max Zombies Nearby To Lock In
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxZombiesNea.ch: 觸發殺紅眼的附近殭屍上限
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxZombiesNea.cn: 触发杀红眼的附近僵尸上限

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxZombiesNea.en: If there are more than this zombies within "Zombies Nearby Tiles" (See "Bloodlust Overwhelming" tab), don't start Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxZombiesNea.ch: 若「附近殭屍格數」(見「壓倒性嗜血」分頁) 內的殭屍多於此數, 不會開始殺紅眼.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MaxZombiesNea.cn: 若“附近僵尸格数” (见“压倒性嗜血”选项卡) 内的僵尸多于此数, 不会开始杀红眼.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinBodyTemper.en:
If your body temperature is less than this, stop outbursts.
See https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Hypothermia
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinBodyTemper.ch:
體溫低於此值時, 停止發作.
參見 https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Hypothermia
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinBodyTemper.cn:
体温低于此值时, 停止发作.
参见 https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Hypothermia

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinHealth_too.en: Having your health less than this will stop outbursts.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinHealth_too.ch: 生命值低於此值時會停止發作.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinHealth_too.cn: 生命值低于此值时会停止发作.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinMinutesOut.en: Min Minutes Out Of Combat To Stop Attacking
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinMinutesOut.ch: 脫離戰鬥停止攻擊最短分鐘數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinMinutesOut.cn: 脱离战斗停止攻击最短分钟数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinMinutesOut.en: Minimum in-game world minutes that must pass since you went out of combat to stop Attacking.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinMinutesOut.ch: 脫離戰鬥後, 停止攻擊發作前至少需經過的遊戲內分鐘數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinMinutesOut.cn: 脱离战斗后, 停止攻击发作前至少需经过的游戏内分钟数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinSecondsSin.en: Min Seconds Since Hit To Stop Locked In
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinSecondsSin.ch: 停止殺紅眼的未攻擊最短秒數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinSecondsSin.cn: 停止杀红眼的未攻击最短秒数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinSecondsSin.en: Minimum real seconds that must pass without your character attacking anyone to stop Locked In.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinSecondsSin.ch: 角色未攻擊任何人, 停止殺紅眼前至少需經過的現實秒數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinSecondsSin.cn: 角色未攻击任何人, 停止杀红眼前至少需经过的现实秒数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinSleepTimeF.en: Minimum in-game hours the character must sleep for before a nightmare can occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinSleepTimeF.ch: 角色至少須睡滿這麼多遊戲內小時, 才可能做惡夢.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_MinSleepTimeF.cn: 角色至少须睡满这么多游戏内小时, 才可能做噩梦.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareFati.en: How much fatigue is added (positive) or removed (negative) when bloodlust nightmare occurs.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareFati.ch: 發生嗜血惡夢時增加 (正值) 或減少 (負值) 的疲勞.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareFati.cn: 发生嗜血噩梦时增加 (正值) 或减少 (负值) 的疲劳.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareJump.en: Chance to play zombie surprise sound when waking up due to having a nightmare from bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareJump.ch: 因嗜血惡夢驚醒時, 播放殭屍突襲音效的機率.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareJump.cn: 因嗜血噩梦惊醒时, 播放僵尸突袭音效的几率.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMaxB.en: Bloodlust level at which max nightmare chance is reached.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMaxB.ch: 達到最大惡夢機率的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMaxB.cn: 达到最大噩梦几率的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMaxC.en:
Maximum chance for nightmare to occur, tested every in-game minute while sleeping.

The chance will start at 0%% at min bloodlust, then increase linearly up to this value at max bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMaxC.ch:
惡夢發生的最大機率, 睡眠中每遊戲內分鐘判定一次.

機率在最低嗜血值時從 0%% 開始, 隨嗜血值線性增加, 於最大嗜血值時達到此值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMaxC.cn:
噩梦发生的最大几率, 睡眠中每游戏内分钟判定一次.

几率在最低嗜血值时从 0%% 开始, 随嗜血值线性增加, 于最大嗜血值时达到此值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMaxS.en: Suppressed bloodlust at which max additional nightmare chance is reached.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMaxS.ch: 達到最大額外惡夢機率的壓抑嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMaxS.cn: 达到最大额外噩梦几率的压抑嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMinB.en: Bloodlust level above which nightmare may occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMinB.ch: 嗜血值高於此值時可能做惡夢.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMinB.cn: 嗜血值高于此值时可能做噩梦.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMinS.en: Suppressed bloodlust additional nightmares chance starts at.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMinS.ch: 壓抑嗜血值達此值時開始有額外惡夢機率.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareMinS.cn: 压抑嗜血值达此值时开始有额外噩梦几率.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareStre.en:
How much stress is added (positive) or removed (negative) when bloodlust nightmare occurs.
(Vanilla nightmares add 50 stress)
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareStre.ch:
發生嗜血惡夢時增加 (正值) 或減少 (負值) 的壓力.
(本體惡夢增加 50 壓力)
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareStre.cn:
发生嗜血噩梦时增加 (正值) 或减少 (负值) 的压力.
(原版噩梦增加 50 压力)

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareSupp.en: How much of suppressed bloodlust is still counted towards Nightmare chance.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareSupp.ch: 壓抑嗜血值中仍計入惡夢機率的比例.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareSupp.cn: 压抑嗜血值中仍计入噩梦几率的比例.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareSupp.ch: 壓抑嗜血值造成的惡夢最大額外機率
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareSupp.cn: 压抑嗜血值造成的噩梦最大额外几率

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareSupp.en: Maximum additional chance for nightmare to occur, tested every in-game minute while sleeping.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareSupp.ch: 惡夢發生的最大額外機率, 睡眠中每遊戲內分鐘判定一次.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareSupp.cn: 噩梦发生的最大额外几率, 睡眠中每游戏内分钟判定一次.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareToFo.en:
Chance for bloodlust nightmare to resolve into following outburst.
(Bloodlust must be above the minimum required for Following.)

Tested before Tracking, and if succeeded won't be overwritten by it.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareToFo.ch:
嗜血惡夢轉為尾隨發作的機率.
(嗜血值須高於尾隨所需的最低值.)

在追蹤之前判定, 若成功則不會被追蹤覆蓋.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareToFo.cn:
嗜血噩梦转为尾随发作的几率.
(嗜血值须高于尾随所需的最低值.)

在追踪之前判定, 若成功则不会被追踪覆盖.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareToTr.en:
Chance for bloodlust nightmare to resolve into tracking outburst.
(Bloodlust must be above the minimum required for Tracking.)

Tested only if Following chance failed.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareToTr.ch:
嗜血惡夢轉為追蹤發作的機率.
(嗜血值須高於追蹤所需的最低值.)

只在尾隨判定失敗時才判定.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareToTr.cn:
嗜血噩梦转为追踪发作的几率.
(嗜血值须高于追踪所需的最低值.)

只在尾随判定失败时才判定.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareUnha.en: How much unhappiness is added (positive) or removed (negative) when bloodlust nightmare occurs.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareUnha.ch: 發生嗜血惡夢時增加 (正值) 或減少 (負值) 的憂鬱.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmareUnha.cn: 发生嗜血噩梦时增加 (正值) 或减少 (负值) 的忧郁.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmaresInC.en:
Whether nightmares can happen when sleeping in a vehicle.
The character will forcefully exit it when waking up.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmaresInC.ch:
在車輛中睡覺時是否會做惡夢.
醒來時角色會被迫下車.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_NightmaresInC.cn:
在车辆中睡觉时是否会做噩梦.
醒来时角色会被迫下车.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_Nightmares_to.en: Whether there is a chance to have a special nightmare while sleeping at high bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_Nightmares_to.ch: 嗜血值高時睡覺, 是否有機率做特殊惡夢.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_Nightmares_to.cn: 嗜血值高时睡觉, 是否有几率做特殊噩梦.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_RePathingMs_t.en: Real milliseconds between redoing pathing when you're already going to someone.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_RePathingMs_t.ch: 已在前往某人途中時, 重新尋路的間隔現實毫秒數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_RePathingMs_t.cn: 已在前往某人途中时, 重新寻路的间隔现实毫秒数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_RedistributeA.ch: 手臂肌肉拉傷轉移門檻
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_RedistributeA.cn: 手臂肌肉拉伤转移阈值

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_RedistributeA.en: When Locked in, any muscle strain above this on arm parts will be moved to other parts of your body, as long as they aren't fully stiff already.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_RedistributeA.ch: 殺紅眼時, 手臂部位超過此值的肌肉拉傷會轉移到身體其他部位, 只要那些部位尚未完全拉傷.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_RedistributeA.cn: 杀红眼时, 手臂部位超过此值的肌肉拉伤会转移到身体其他部位, 只要那些部位尚未完全拉伤.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.en: Start Tracking After Idle When Locked In
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.ch: 殺紅眼閒置後開始追蹤
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.cn: 杀红眼闲置后开始追踪

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.en: Once this percentage of idle time passes, the character will turn towards closest zombie.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.ch: 閒置時間經過此百分比後, 角色會轉向最近的殭屍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.cn: 闲置时间经过此百分比后, 角色会转向最近的僵尸.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.en: Start Tracking After Inactivity When Following
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.ch: 尾隨無動作後開始追蹤
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.cn: 尾随无动作后开始追踪

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.en: Once this percentage of inactivity time passes, the character will turn towards closest zombie.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.ch: 無動作時間經過此百分比後, 角色會轉向最近的殭屍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StartTracking.cn: 无动作时间经过此百分比后, 角色会转向最近的僵尸.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StopOnOpenNec.ch: 頸部傷口未處理時停止
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StopOnOpenNec.cn: 颈部伤口未处理时停止

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StopOnOpenNec.en: Whether to stop outbursts if you have a neck injury of any type that is bleeding, or isn't bandaged or the bandage is dirty.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StopOnOpenNec.ch: 若頸部有任何類型的傷口正在流血、未包紮或繃帶髒了, 是否停止發作.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_StopOnOpenNec.cn: 若颈部有任何类型的伤口正在流血、未包扎或绷带脏了, 是否停止发作.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.ch: 壓抑嗜血值最大殭屍距離
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.cn: 压抑嗜血值最大僵尸距离

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.en: At this distance to zombies, the modifier starts to gradually take effect.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.ch: 與殭屍距離達此值時, 修正值開始逐漸生效.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.cn: 与僵尸距离达此值时, 修正值开始逐渐生效.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.ch: 壓抑嗜血值最小殭屍距離
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.cn: 压抑嗜血值最小僵尸距离

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.en: At this distance to zombies, the modifier reaches its configured value.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.ch: 與殭屍距離達此值時, 修正值達到設定值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.cn: 与僵尸距离达此值时, 修正值达到设置值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.en:
How much of suppressed bloodlust is still counted towards loss of control chances.

0.2 means 20%% of suppressed bloodlust is counted.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.ch:
壓抑嗜血值中仍計入失去控制機率的比例.

0.2 表示計入 20%% 的壓抑嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_SuppressedBlo.cn:
压抑嗜血值中仍计入失去控制几率的比例.

0.2 表示计入 20%% 的压抑嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingIdleT.en: Tracking Idle Time If Near Vehicle
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingIdleT.ch: 靠近車輛時追蹤閒置時間
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingIdleT.cn: 靠近车辆时追踪闲置时间

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingIdleT.en: Adds this many seconds to idle time that must pass if you're near a car.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingIdleT.ch: 靠近車輛時, 所需閒置時間增加這麼多秒.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingIdleT.cn: 靠近车辆时, 所需闲置时间增加这么多秒.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxBl.en: Bloodlust level at which max tracking chance is reached.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxBl.ch: 達到最大追蹤機率的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxBl.cn: 达到最大追踪几率的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxCh.en:
Maximum chance for tracking to occur, tested every in-game minute.

The chance will start at 0%% at min bloodlust, then increase linearly up to this value at max bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxCh.ch:
追蹤發生的最大機率, 每遊戲內分鐘判定一次.

機率在最低嗜血值時從 0%% 開始, 隨嗜血值線性增加, 於最大嗜血值時達到此值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxCh.cn:
追踪发生的最大几率, 每游戏内分钟判定一次.

几率在最低嗜血值时从 0%% 开始, 随嗜血值线性增加, 于最大嗜血值时达到此值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxId.en: Maximum idle time that must pass before the character will turn towards zombies when Tracking.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxId.ch: 追蹤時, 角色轉向殭屍前最多需經過的閒置時間.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxId.cn: 追踪时, 角色转向僵尸前最多需经过的闲置时间.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxMi.en: Maximum in-game minutes tracking may last.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxMi.ch: 追蹤最多可持續的遊戲內分鐘數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMaxMi.cn: 追踪最多可持续的游戏内分钟数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinBl.en: Bloodlust level above which tracking may occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinBl.ch: 嗜血值高於此值時可能發生追蹤.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinBl.cn: 嗜血值高于此值时可能发生追踪.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinHi.ch: 追蹤看不見殭屍最小格數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinHi.cn: 追踪看不见僵尸最小格数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinHi.en: Closest zombie that you cannot see must be this many tiles away from you for tracking to occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinHi.ch: 你看不見的最近殭屍須距離你這麼多格, 才會發生追蹤.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinHi.cn: 你看不见的最近僵尸须距离你这么多格, 才会发生追踪.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinId.en: Minimum idle time that must pass before the character will turn towards zombies when Tracking.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinId.ch: 追蹤時, 角色轉向殭屍前至少需經過的閒置時間.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinId.cn: 追踪时, 角色转向僵尸前至少需经过的闲置时间.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinMi.en: Minimum in-game minutes tracking may last.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinMi.ch: 追蹤至少持續的遊戲內分鐘數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinMi.cn: 追踪至少持续的游戏内分钟数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinVi.ch: 追蹤看得見殭屍最小格數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinVi.cn: 追踪看得见僵尸最小格数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinVi.en: Closest zombie that you can see must be this many tiles away from you for tracking to occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinVi.ch: 你看得見的最近殭屍須距離你這麼多格, 才會發生追蹤.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMinVi.cn: 你看得见的最近僵尸须距离你这么多格, 才会发生追踪.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMovem.en: Tracking Movement Lock Min Tiles From Zombie
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMovem.ch: 追蹤移動鎖定最小殭屍距離
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMovem.cn: 追踪移动锁定最小僵尸距离

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMovem.en: Minimum tiles to closest zombie for tracking movement lock to happen.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMovem.ch: 發生追蹤移動鎖定時, 與最近殭屍的最小格數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMovem.cn: 发生追踪移动锁定时, 与最近僵尸的最小格数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMovem.en: When tracking occurs, for how many real seconds you won't be able to control your character as it stands still, looking in direction of closest zombie.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMovem.ch: 發生追蹤時, 你有多少現實秒數無法控制角色, 角色會站著不動, 看向最近殭屍的方向.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingMovem.cn: 发生追踪时, 你有多少现实秒数无法控制角色, 角色会站着不动, 看向最近僵尸的方向.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingOutbu.en:
Your character may turn to face a zombie. Consists of two phases:
1. Movement Lock: You cannot move or look away.
2. Idle: Your character will turn towards zombie when you stand still for a bit.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingOutbu.ch:
角色可能會轉身面向殭屍. 分為兩個階段:
1. 移動鎖定: 你無法移動或移開視線.
2. 閒置: 你站著不動一會兒, 角色就會轉向殭屍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingOutbu.cn:
角色可能会转身面向僵尸. 分为两个阶段:
1. 移动锁定: 你无法移动或移开视线.
2. 闲置: 你站着不动一会儿, 角色就会转向僵尸.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingRequi.en: How many real seconds since last player activity must pass for tracking to occur.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingRequi.ch: 距離玩家上次動作須經過多少現實秒數, 才會發生追蹤.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingRequi.cn: 距离玩家上次动作须经过多少现实秒数, 才会发生追踪.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingStopC.en: Chance to stop tracking when you're aiming, tested every in-game world minute.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingStopC.ch: 瞄準時停止追蹤的機率, 每遊戲內分鐘判定一次.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingStopC.cn: 瞄准时停止追踪的几率, 每游戏内分钟判定一次.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingStopI.en: Tracking Stop If Zombie Within Tiles
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingStopI.ch: 殭屍在格數內時停止追蹤
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingStopI.cn: 僵尸在格数内时停止追踪

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingStopI.en: Once tracking is active, if closest zombie is visible and is closer than this many tiles, don't track it.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingStopI.ch: 追蹤啟動後, 若最近的殭屍可見且距離小於這麼多格, 就不追蹤牠.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingStopI.cn: 追踪启动后, 若最近的僵尸可见且距离小于这么多格, 就不追踪它.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.en:
Maximum chance for Tracking to evolve into Following, tested every in-game minute, if player is moving.

The chance will start at 0%% at min bloodlust, then increase linearly up to this value at max bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.ch:
玩家移動時, 追蹤演變為尾隨的最大機率, 每遊戲內分鐘判定一次.

機率在最低嗜血值時從 0%% 開始, 隨嗜血值線性增加, 於最大嗜血值時達到此值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.cn:
玩家移动时, 追踪演变为尾随的最大几率, 每游戏内分钟判定一次.

几率在最低嗜血值时从 0%% 开始, 随嗜血值线性增加, 于最大嗜血值时达到此值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.en: Tracking To Following Min Tiles From Hidden Zombie
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.ch: 追蹤轉尾隨看不見殭屍最小格數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.cn: 追踪转尾随看不见僵尸最小格数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.en: Minimum distance zombie you don't see must be for Tracking to evolve into Following.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.ch: 追蹤演變為尾隨時, 你看不見的殭屍須距離的最小距離.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.cn: 追踪演变为尾随时, 你看不见的僵尸须距离的最小距离.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.en: Tracking To Following Min Tiles From Visible Zombie
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.ch: 追蹤轉尾隨看得見殭屍最小格數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.cn: 追踪转尾随看得见僵尸最小格数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.en: Minimum distance visible zombie must be for Tracking to evolve into Following.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.ch: 追蹤演變為尾隨時, 看得見的殭屍須距離的最小距離.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_Control_TrackingToFol.cn: 追踪演变为尾随时, 看得见的僵尸须距离的最小距离.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpBloodlustLimit_.en:
If "Curl Up Bloodlust Per Minute" is negative, this is the minimum bloodlust below which curling up won't reduce bloodlust.
Otherwise, this is the maximum bloodlust above which curling up won't add bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpBloodlustLimit_.ch:
若「每分鐘蜷縮嗜血值」為負值, 此為最低嗜血值, 低於此值時蜷縮不再降低嗜血值.
否則此為最大嗜血值, 高於此值時蜷縮不再增加嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpBloodlustLimit_.cn:
若“每分钟蜷缩嗜血值”为负值, 此为最低嗜血值, 低于此值时蜷缩不再降低嗜血值.
否则此为最大嗜血值, 高于此值时蜷缩不再增加嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpBloodlustPerMin.en:
How much bloodlust to remove (negative) or add (positive) every game world minute while you're curled up.
Note that removing bloodlust counts as bloodlust suppression and will have consequences.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpBloodlustPerMin.ch:
蜷縮時每遊戲內分鐘減少 (負值) 或增加 (正值) 的嗜血值.
注意, 減少嗜血值算是壓抑嗜血值, 會有後果.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpBloodlustPerMin.cn:
蜷缩时每游戏内分钟减少 (负值) 或增加 (正值) 的嗜血值.
注意, 减少嗜血值算是压抑嗜血值, 会有后果.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpKillCravingBloo.en: Curl Up Kill Craving Bloodlust Modifier
Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpKillCravingBloo.ch: 蜷縮殺戮渴望嗜血值修正
Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpKillCravingBloo.cn: 蜷缩杀戮渴望嗜血值修正

Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpKillCravingBloo.en:
Modifier for bloodlust increase due to kill craving while curled up.

0.2 means your bloodlust increases only at 20%% rate.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpKillCravingBloo.ch:
蜷縮時, 因殺戮渴望而增加嗜血值的修正值.

0.2 表示嗜血值只以 20%% 的速度增加.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_CurlUpKillCravingBloo.cn:
蜷缩时, 因杀戮渴望而增加嗜血值的修正值.

0.2 表示嗜血值只以 20%% 的速度增加.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageCombatHea.en: Death Rampage Combat Health Per Minute
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageCombatHea.ch: 死亡暴走戰鬥中每分鐘生命值
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageCombatHea.cn: 死亡暴走战斗中每分钟生命值

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageCombatHea.en:
How much health is added (positive) or removed (negative) every minute in combat on death rampage.

-0.55 means you'll live for up to ~3 hours if you're in combat the whole time.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageCombatHea.ch:
死亡暴走時, 戰鬥中每分鐘增加 (正值) 或減少 (負值) 的生命值.

-0.55 表示若全程都在戰鬥, 你最多能活約 3 小時.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageCombatHea.cn:
死亡暴走时, 战斗中每分钟增加 (正值) 或减少 (负值) 的生命值.

-0.55 表示若全程都在战斗, 你最多能活约 3 小时.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageDamageMul.en:
Frenzy bonus damage is multiplied by this number on death rampage.

1.0 means no change, 0.0 means remove the bonus completely, 0.5 to reduce it to 50%%, 2.0 to double it, etc.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageDamageMul.ch:
死亡暴走時, 狂暴的額外傷害會乘以此數.

1.0 表示不變, 0.0 表示完全移除加成, 0.5 減為 50%%, 2.0 加倍, 依此類推.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageDamageMul.cn:
死亡暴走时, 狂暴的额外伤害会乘以此数.

1.0 表示不变, 0.0 表示完全移除加成, 0.5 减为 50%%, 2.0 加倍, 依此类推.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtKnock.en: Death Rampage Hurt Knock Down Chance
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtKnock.ch: 死亡暴走受擊擊倒機率
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtKnock.cn: 死亡暴走受击击倒几率

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtKnock.en: Percentage of zombies that will be knocked down when you get hit while on death rampage.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtKnock.ch: 死亡暴走時被擊中, 會被擊倒的殭屍百分比.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtKnock.cn: 死亡暴走时被击中, 会被击倒的僵尸百分比.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtPushT.ch: 死亡暴走受擊推開格數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtPushT.cn: 死亡暴走受击推开格数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtPushT.en: Zombies within this many tiles to player will be pushed back when you get hit while on death rampage.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtPushT.ch: 死亡暴走時被擊中, 距離玩家這麼多格內的殭屍會被推開.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtPushT.cn: 死亡暴走时被击中, 距离玩家这么多格内的僵尸会被推开.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtZombi.ch: 死亡暴走受擊推開殭屍數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtZombi.cn: 死亡暴走受击推开僵尸数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtZombi.en: Maximum number of zombies pushed back when you get hit while on death rampage.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtZombi.ch: 死亡暴走時被擊中, 最多可推開的殭屍數量.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageHurtZombi.cn: 死亡暴走时被击中, 最多可推开的僵尸数量.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageMovementS.ch: 死亡暴走移動速度倍率
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageMovementS.cn: 死亡暴走移动速度倍率

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageMovementS.en:
Frenzy bonus movement speed is multiplied by this number on death rampage.

1.0 means no change, 0.0 means remove the bonus completely, 0.5 to reduce it to 50%%, 2.0 to double it, etc.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageMovementS.ch:
死亡暴走時, 狂暴的額外移動速度會乘以此數.

1.0 表示不變, 0.0 表示完全移除加成, 0.5 減為 50%%, 2.0 加倍, 依此類推.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageMovementS.cn:
死亡暴走时, 狂暴的额外移动速度会乘以此数.

1.0 表示不变, 0.0 表示完全移除加成, 0.5 减为 50%%, 2.0 加倍, 依此类推.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageOnDragDow.en: Whether you go into death rampage when dying to "Drag Down".
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageOnDragDow.ch: 被「拉倒」致死時是否進入死亡暴走.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageOnDragDow.cn: 被“放倒”致死时是否进入死亡暴走.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageOutOfComb.en: Death Rampage Out Of Combat Health Per Minute
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageOutOfComb.ch: 死亡暴走非戰鬥中每分鐘生命值變化
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageOutOfComb.cn: 死亡暴走非战斗中每分钟生命值变化

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageOutOfComb.en:
How much health is added (positive) or removed (negative) every minute out of combat on death rampage.

-3.33 means you're guaranteed to die within ~30 minutes out of combat.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageOutOfComb.ch:
死亡暴走期間, 非戰鬥狀態下每分鐘增加 (正值) 或減少 (負值) 的生命值.

-3.33 表示非戰鬥狀態下約 30 分鐘內必定死亡.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageOutOfComb.cn:
死亡暴走期间, 非战斗状态下每分钟增加 (正值) 或减少 (负值) 的生命值.

-3.33 表示非战斗状态下约 30 分钟内必定死亡.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageSoundRadi.ch: 死亡暴走聲音範圍倍率
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageSoundRadi.cn: 死亡暴走声音范围倍率

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageSoundRadi.en:
Radius of all sounds emitted by this mod (e.g. on instakill) are multiplied by this number on death rampage.

1.0 means no change, 0.0 means remove sound completely, 0.5 to reduce radius to 50%%, 2.0 to double it, etc.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageSoundRadi.ch:
死亡暴走期間, 本 MOD 發出的所有聲音 (例如秒殺時) 範圍都會乘以此數值.

1.0 表示不變, 0.0 表示完全移除聲音, 0.5 表示範圍降至 50%%, 2.0 表示加倍, 依此類推.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageSoundRadi.cn:
死亡暴走期间, 本模组发出的所有声音 (例如秒杀时) 范围都会乘以此数值.

1.0 表示不变, 0.0 表示完全移除声音, 0.5 表示范围降至 50%%, 2.0 表示翻倍, 以此类推.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageSwingSpee.ch: 死亡暴走揮擊速度倍率
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageSwingSpee.cn: 死亡暴走挥击速度倍率

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageSwingSpee.en:
Frenzy bonus swing speed is multiplied by this number on death rampage.

1.0 means no change, 0.0 means remove the bonus completely, 0.5 to reduce it to 50%%, 2.0 to double it, etc.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageSwingSpee.ch:
死亡暴走期間, 狂暴的額外揮擊速度會乘以此數值.

1.0 表示不變, 0.0 表示完全移除加成, 0.5 表示降至 50%%, 2.0 表示加倍, 依此類推.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampageSwingSpee.cn:
死亡暴走期间, 狂暴的额外挥击速度会乘以此数值.

1.0 表示不变, 0.0 表示完全移除加成, 0.5 表示降至 50%%, 2.0 表示翻倍, 以此类推.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampage_tooltip.en:
Whether to enter into death rampage whenever you're about to die in combat.

You'll still end up dying, but at least you can take a few more zeds with you.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampage_tooltip.ch:
在戰鬥中即將死亡時是否進入死亡暴走.

你最終還是會死, 但至少能多拉幾隻殭屍陪葬.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DeathRampage_tooltip.cn:
在战斗中即将死亡时是否进入死亡暴走.

你最终还是会死, 但至少能多拉几只僵尸陪葬.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_DebugControls_tooltip.en:
Whether to show debug actions (like trigger a loss of control event) in debug panel.

Debug panel can be enabled in Mod Options (Go to Options - Mods - scroll to "Bloodlust Overwhelming")
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DebugControls_tooltip.ch:
是否在除錯面板中顯示除錯動作 (例如觸發失控事件).

除錯面板可在 MOD 選項中啟用 (前往 選項 - 模組 - 捲動至「Bloodlust Overwhelming」)
Sandbox_BloodlustO_DebugControls_tooltip.cn:
是否在调试面板中显示调试动作 (例如触发失控事件).

调试面板可在模组选项中启用 (前往 选项 - 模组 - 滚动至“Bloodlust Overwhelming”)

Sandbox_BloodlustO_EarnIt_tooltip.en: Whether it's possible to earn the trait.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_EarnIt_tooltip.ch: 是否可以在遊戲中獲得此特質.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_EarnIt_tooltip.cn: 是否可以在游戏中获得此特质.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionBufferedPerMi.en:
How much of exertion to store every minute.

With 2 it'll take 50 minutes to store 100 exertion.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionBufferedPerMi.ch:
每分鐘要儲存多少勞累.

設為 2 時, 需要 50 分鐘才能儲存 100 勞累.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionBufferedPerMi.cn:
每分钟要储存多少劳累.

设为 2 时, 需要 50 分钟才能储存 100 劳累.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionBufferingMult.en:
How much of the removed exertion is stored for later.

1.5 means you'll be later reliving 50%% more exertion than you actually stored.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionBufferingMult.ch:
被移除的勞累中有多少會儲存起來留待之後.

1.5 表示之後你要承受的勞累會比實際儲存的多 50%%.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionBufferingMult.cn:
被移除的劳累中有多少会储存起来留待之后.

1.5 表示之后你要承受的劳累会比实际储存的多 50%%.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferedPer.en:
How much of stored exertion to unleash back every minute.

With 3 it'll take ~30 minutes to unleash back 100 exertion.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferedPer.ch:
每分鐘要將多少已儲存的勞累釋放回來.

設為 3 時, 約需 30 分鐘才能釋放回 100 勞累.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferedPer.cn:
每分钟要将多少已储存的劳累释放回来.

设为 3 时, 约需 30 分钟才能释放回 100 劳累.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingCa.en:
Proportion of calories to burn based on unleashed exertion.

With 27, going from max calories (3700) to minimum (-2200) takes ~218 exertion,
or 100 exertion to go from max calories (3700) to weight loss territory (1000).

For reference, you'd have to keep swinging non-stop
for ~13 game world hours to go from 3700 to -2200,
or for ~6 game world hours to go from 3700 to 1000.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingCa.ch:
依釋放的勞累燃燒卡路里的比例.

設為 27 時, 從最高卡路里 (3700) 降到最低 (-2200) 約需 218 勞累,
從最高卡路里 (3700) 降到體重下降區間 (1000) 則需 100 勞累.

作為參考, 你得不停揮擊
約 13 個遊戲世界小時才能從 3700 降到 -2200,
或約 6 個遊戲世界小時從 3700 降到 1000.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingCa.cn:
按释放的劳累燃烧卡路里的比例.

设为 27 时, 从最高卡路里 (3700) 降到最低 (-2200) 约需 218 劳累,
从最高卡路里 (3700) 降到体重下降区间 (1000) 则需 100 劳累.

作为参考, 你得不停挥击
约 13 个游戏世界小时才能从 3700 降到 -2200,
或约 6 个游戏世界小时从 3700 降到 1000.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingHu.en:
Proportion of hunger to add based on unleashed exertion.

0.3 means every 100 of exertion unleashed adds 30%% hunger.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingHu.ch:
依釋放的勞累增加飢餓的比例.

0.3 表示每釋放 100 勞累會增加 30%% 飢餓.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingHu.cn:
按释放的劳累增加饥饿的比例.

0.3 表示每释放 100 劳累会增加 30%% 饥饿.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingSt.en:
Proportion of muscle strain to spread across your whole body based on unleashed exertion.

0.8 means every 100 of exertion unleashed adds 80 strain.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingSt.ch:
依釋放的勞累分散到全身的肌肉拉傷比例.

0.8 表示每釋放 100 勞累會增加 80 肌肉拉傷.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingSt.cn:
按释放的劳累分散到全身的肌肉拉伤比例.

0.8 表示每释放 100 劳累会增加 80 肌肉拉伤.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingTh.en:
Proportion of thirst to add based on unleashed exertion.

0.4 means every 100 of exertion unleashed adds 40%% thirst.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingTh.ch:
依釋放的勞累增加口渴的比例.

0.4 表示每釋放 100 勞累會增加 40%% 口渴.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ExertionUnbufferingTh.cn:
按释放的劳累增加口渴的比例.

0.4 表示每释放 100 劳累会增加 40%% 口渴.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightBufferExertionAf.en:
Once you reach this level of exertion, all hits and kills will buffer some exertion.

50 is when second exertion moodle "High Exertion" appears.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightBufferExertionAf.ch:
勞累達到此程度後, 所有命中與擊殺都會累積部分勞累.

50 是第二階勞累狀態「喘得厲害」出現的時候.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightBufferExertionAf.cn:
劳累达到此程度后, 所有命中与击杀都会累积部分劳累.

50 是第二级劳累状态“高强度运动”出现的时候.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightExertionBufferMa.ch: 戰鬥勞累累積最大倍率
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightExertionBufferMa.cn: 战斗劳累累积最大倍率

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightExertionBufferMa.en:
Bloodlust change due to hits/kills is converted to exertion you'll buffer by multiplying by this.
Multiplier once you're at "Bloodlust For Exertion Buffering" and above.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightExertionBufferMa.ch:
命中/擊殺造成的嗜血值變化乘以此數值, 換算成你要累積的勞累.
此為嗜血值達到「累積勞累所需嗜血值」及以上時的倍率.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightExertionBufferMa.cn:
命中/击杀造成的嗜血值变化乘以此数值, 换算成你要累积的劳累.
此为嗜血值达到“累积劳累所需嗜血值”及以上时的倍率.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightExertionBufferMi.ch: 戰鬥勞累累積最小倍率
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightExertionBufferMi.cn: 战斗劳累累积最小倍率

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightExertionBufferMi.en:
Bloodlust change due to hits/kills is converted to exertion you'll buffer by multiplying by this.
Multiplier at 0 bloodlust, scaled linearly up to max as your bloodlust reaches "Bloodlust For Exertion Buffering".
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightExertionBufferMi.ch:
命中/擊殺造成的嗜血值變化乘以此數值, 換算成你要累積的勞累.
此為嗜血值 0 時的倍率, 隨嗜血值接近「累積勞累所需嗜血值」線性提升至最大倍率.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightExertionBufferMi.cn:
命中/击杀造成的嗜血值变化乘以此数值, 换算成你要累积的劳累.
此为嗜血值 0 时的倍率, 随嗜血值接近“累积劳累所需嗜血值”线性提升至最大倍率.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatAfterM.ch: 戰鬥中未命中觸發分鐘數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatAfterM.cn: 战斗中未命中触发分钟数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatAfterM.en: Spending this much time in combat without hitting anyone will start increasing your bloodlust (If not in frenzy).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatAfterM.ch: 在戰鬥中經過這麼久都沒打中任何目標, 嗜血值就會開始上升 (未處於狂暴時).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatAfterM.cn: 在战斗中经过这么久都没打中任何目标, 嗜血值就会开始上升 (未处于狂暴时).

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatBloodl.ch: 戰鬥中未命中每分鐘嗜血值
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatBloodl.cn: 战斗中未命中每分钟嗜血值

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatBloodl.en:
How much bloodlust to add every minute you aren't hitting anyone in combat.

With 3, it'll take 33 minutes to reach 100 bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatBloodl.ch:
戰鬥中每分鐘沒打中任何目標時增加的嗜血值.

設為 3 時, 需要 33 分鐘才會達到 100 嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatBloodl.cn:
战斗中每分钟没打中任何目标时增加的嗜血值.

设为 3 时, 需要 33 分钟才会达到 100 嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatBloodl.en: Whether your bloodlust will increase without fighting while driving.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatBloodl.ch: 駕駛時沒有戰鬥是否也會增加嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FightlessCombatBloodl.cn: 驾驶时没有战斗是否也会增加嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyBacklashPerMinu.en:
How much of backlash to apply every in-game minute once frenzy ends.

Each instakill in frenzy adds 1.0 to backlash.

With 0.5 it'll take ~3.3 in-game hours to apply backlash for 100 instakills.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyBacklashPerMinu.ch:
狂暴結束後, 每遊戲分鐘施加多少反噬.

狂暴中每次秒殺會增加 1.0 反噬.

設為 0.5 時, 100 次秒殺的反噬約需 3.3 遊戲小時才會施加完畢.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyBacklashPerMinu.cn:
狂暴结束后, 每游戏分钟施加多少反噬.

狂暴中每次秒杀会增加 1.0 反噬.

设为 0.5 时, 100 次秒杀的反噬约需 3.3 游戏小时才会施加完毕.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyConditionLossMu.en:
Maximum multiplier for the chance to lose weapon condition on hit while in frenzy.

It multiplies whatever your current chance to lose weapon durability is (base weapon chance + maintenance correction).
Ex. if you have 0 skills and weapon base chance is 10%%, 2.0 multiplier turns it into 20%%.

The multiplier smoothly increases starting from 1.0 to this value as bloodlust rises, reaching the set multiplier at 100%% bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyConditionLossMu.ch:
狂暴中命中時武器耐久損耗機率的最大倍率.

此倍率會乘上你目前的武器耐久損耗機率 (武器基礎機率 + 維護修正).
例: 若你技能為 0, 武器基礎機率為 10%%, 2.0 倍率會使其變為 20%%.

隨嗜血值上升, 倍率會從 1.0 平滑提升至此數值, 在嗜血值 100%% 時達到設定倍率.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyConditionLossMu.cn:
狂暴中命中时武器耐久损耗几率的最大倍率.

此倍率会乘上你当前的武器耐久损耗几率 (武器基础几率 + 维护修正).
例: 若你技能为 0, 武器基础几率为 10%%, 2.0 倍率会使其变为 20%%.

随嗜血值上升, 倍率会从 1.0 平滑提升至此数值, 在嗜血值 100%% 时达到设定倍率.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHitBloodlustInc.en: Every generic hit increases this much bloodlust in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHitBloodlustInc.ch: 狂暴中每次一般命中增加的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHitBloodlustInc.cn: 狂暴中每次一般命中增加的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtBloodlustCh.en: How much bloodlust to increase/decrease when you get hit by a zombie in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtBloodlustCh.ch: 狂暴中被殭屍擊中時增加/減少的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtBloodlustCh.cn: 狂暴中被僵尸击中时增加/减少的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeAtBl.ch: 狂暴受傷反擊嗜血值門檻
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeAtBl.cn: 狂暴受伤反击嗜血值门槛

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeAtBl.en: In frenzy, getting hit with this much bloodlust will instakill the attacker and push back other zombies around.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeAtBl.ch: 狂暴中, 嗜血值達到此數值時被擊中, 會秒殺攻擊者並擊退周圍其他殭屍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeAtBl.cn: 狂暴中, 嗜血值达到此数值时被击中, 会秒杀攻击者并击退周围其他僵尸.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeDama.en:
How much damage to deal to an attacker when you get hit in frenzy.

Max zombie health is 2.0, so 2 damage will instakill whoever attacked you.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeDama.ch:
狂暴中被擊中時對攻擊者造成多少傷害.

殭屍最大生命值為 2.0, 因此 2 點傷害會秒殺攻擊你的殭屍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeDama.cn:
狂暴中被击中时对攻击者造成多少伤害.

僵尸最大生命值为 2.0, 因此 2 点伤害会秒杀攻击你的僵尸.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeKnoc.en: Frenzy Hurt Revenge Knock Down Chance
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeKnoc.ch: 狂暴受傷反擊擊倒機率
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeKnoc.cn: 狂暴受伤反击击倒几率

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeKnoc.en: Percentage of zombies that will be knocked down when you get hit in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeKnoc.ch: 狂暴中被擊中時, 會被擊倒的殭屍百分比.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeKnoc.cn: 狂暴中被击中时, 会被击倒的僵尸百分比.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengePush.ch: 狂暴受傷反擊擊退格數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengePush.cn: 狂暴受伤反击击退格数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengePush.en: Zombies within this many tiles to player will be pushed back when you get hit in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengePush.ch: 狂暴中被擊中時, 距離玩家此格數內的殭屍會被擊退.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengePush.cn: 狂暴中被击中时, 距离玩家此格数内的僵尸会被击退.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeZomb.ch: 狂暴受傷反擊擊退殭屍數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeZomb.cn: 狂暴受伤反击击退僵尸数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeZomb.en: Maximum number of zombies pushed back when you get hit in frenzy.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeZomb.ch: 狂暴中被擊中時, 最多擊退的殭屍數量.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtRevengeZomb.cn: 狂暴中被击中时, 最多击退的僵尸数量.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtSoundRadius.en:
Zombies this many tiles away will be attracted to player in frenzy that just got hit.

For reference, shout sound radius is 30. See pzwiki.net/wiki/Noise
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtSoundRadius.ch:
狂暴中的玩家被擊中時, 此格數範圍內的殭屍會被吸引過來.

作為參考, 喊叫的聲音範圍為 30. 詳見 pzwiki.net/wiki/Noise
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyHurtSoundRadius.cn:
狂暴中的玩家被击中时, 此格数范围内的僵尸会被吸引过来.

作为参考, 喊叫的声音范围为 30. 详见 pzwiki.net/wiki/Noise

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillAreaDa.en:
How much damage to additionally spread evenly to nearby zombies while instakilling in frenzy.

Max zombie health is 2.0.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillAreaDa.ch:
狂暴中秒殺時, 額外平均分配給附近殭屍的傷害.

殭屍最大生命值為 2.0.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillAreaDa.cn:
狂暴中秒杀时, 额外平均分配给附近僵尸的伤害.

僵尸最大生命值为 2.0.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillAreaRa.en: Maximum tiles from instakilled zombie in which others will be affected.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillAreaRa.ch: 以被秒殺的殭屍為中心, 其他殭屍受影響的最大格數.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillAreaRa.cn: 以被秒杀的僵尸为中心, 其他僵尸受影响的最大格数.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.en:
How much calories will be burned for each instakill in frenzy.

With 90, going from max calories (3700) to minimum (-2200) takes 65 instakills,
or 30 instakills to go from max calories (3700) to weight loss territory (1000).

For reference, you'd have to keep swinging non-stop
for ~13 game world hours to go from 3700 to -2200,
or for ~6 game world hours to go from 3700 to 1000.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.ch:
狂暴中每次秒殺會燃燒多少卡路里.

設為 90 時, 從最高卡路里 (3700) 降到最低 (-2200) 需要 65 次秒殺,
從最高卡路里 (3700) 降到體重下降區間 (1000) 則需 30 次秒殺.

作為參考, 你得不停揮擊
約 13 個遊戲世界小時才能從 3700 降到 -2200,
或約 6 個遊戲世界小時從 3700 降到 1000.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.cn:
狂暴中每次秒杀会燃烧多少卡路里.

设为 90 时, 从最高卡路里 (3700) 降到最低 (-2200) 需要 65 次秒杀,
从最高卡路里 (3700) 降到体重下降区间 (1000) 则需 30 次秒杀.

作为参考, 你得不停挥击
约 13 个游戏世界小时才能从 3700 降到 -2200,
或约 6 个游戏世界小时从 3700 降到 1000.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.en:
How much fatigue will be added for each instakill in frenzy.

With 2.5 it'll take ~40 instakills for 100%% fatigue.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.ch:
狂暴中每次秒殺會增加多少疲勞.

設為 2.5 時, 約 40 次秒殺就會達到 100%% 疲勞.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.cn:
狂暴中每次秒杀会增加多少疲劳.

设为 2.5 时, 约 40 次秒杀就会达到 100%% 疲劳.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.en:
How much hunger will be added for each instakill in frenzy.

With 3.33 it'll take ~30 instakills for 100%% hunger.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.ch:
狂暴中每次秒殺會增加多少飢餓.

設為 3.33 時, 約 30 次秒殺就會達到 100%% 飢餓.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.cn:
狂暴中每次秒杀会增加多少饥饿.

设为 3.33 时, 约 30 次秒杀就会达到 100%% 饥饿.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.ch: 狂暴秒殺反噬肌肉拉傷
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.cn: 狂暴秒杀反噬肌肉拉伤

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.en:
How much muscle strain will be spread across your whole body for each instakill in frenzy.

One body part can hold 100 strain.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.ch:
狂暴中每次秒殺會有多少肌肉拉傷分散到全身.

每個身體部位最多可承受 100 肌肉拉傷.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.cn:
狂暴中每次秒杀会有多少肌肉拉伤分散到全身.

每个身体部位最多可承受 100 肌肉拉伤.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.en:
How much thirst will be added for each instakill in frenzy.

With 5 it'll take ~20 instakills for 100%% thirst.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.ch:
狂暴中每次秒殺會增加多少口渴.

設為 5 時, 約 20 次秒殺就會達到 100%% 口渴.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FrenzyInstakillBackla.cn:
狂暴中每次秒杀会增加多少口渴.

设为 5 时, 约 20 次秒杀就会达到 100%% 口渴.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FreshBloodinessDecayM.en:
Defines how to decay bloodiness freshness.

"Total" - remove *at most* per-minute freshness across the whole body and all equipped items.
"Individual" - remove per-minute freshness from each body part and equipped item independently.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FreshBloodinessDecayM.ch:
設定沾血新鮮度的衰減方式.

「總計」- 每分鐘在全身與所有裝備物品間 *最多* 移除設定的新鮮度.
「個別」- 每個身體部位與裝備物品各自獨立地每分鐘移除設定的新鮮度.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FreshBloodinessDecayM.cn:
设定沾血新鲜度的衰减方式.

“总计”- 每分钟在全身与所有装备物品间 *最多* 移除设定的新鲜度.
“单独”- 每个身体部位与装备物品各自独立地每分钟移除设定的新鲜度.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_FreshBloodinessDecayP.en:
How much bloodiness freshness to remove every minute.

Bloodiness freshness is on 0 to 100 scale.
It acts more like "Fresh Bloodiness" - same as bloodiness, but decays with time.
It's tracked separately, and no actual bloodiness is removed.

With default 0.83 and "Total" decay mode, it would take ~24 hours for 100%% overall bloodiness to go stale.
In "Individual" mode same bloodiness would decay in ~2 hours.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FreshBloodinessDecayP.ch:
每分鐘要移除多少沾血新鮮度.

沾血新鮮度的範圍為 0 到 100.
它比較像「新鮮沾血程度」- 與沾血程度相同, 但會隨時間衰減.
它是分開追蹤的, 不會移除實際的沾血程度.

預設 0.83 並使用「總計」衰減模式時, 100%% 的整體沾血程度約需 24 小時才會變得不新鮮.
使用「個別」模式時, 同樣的沾血程度約 2 小時就會衰減完.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_FreshBloodinessDecayP.cn:
每分钟要移除多少沾血新鲜度.

沾血新鲜度的范围为 0 到 100.
它更像“新鲜沾血程度”- 与沾血程度相同, 但会随时间衰减.
它是单独追踪的, 不会移除实际的沾血程度.

默认 0.83 并使用“总计”衰减模式时, 100%% 的整体沾血程度约需 24 小时才会变得不新鲜.
使用“单独”模式时, 同样的沾血程度约 2 小时就会衰减完.

With 0.25, +100%% bloodiness on any individual body part, clothing or weapon will add 25 bloodlust.

設為 0.25 時, 任一身體部位, 衣物或武器的沾血程度 +100%% 會增加 25 嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_GettingBloodyBloodlus.cn:

设为 0.25 时, 任一身体部位, 衣物或武器的沾血程度 +100%% 会增加 25 嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_IncomingDamageEffectM.cn: 开始影响你承受伤害的最低嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_IncomingDamageMultipl.en:
The multiplier for the all damage you take.

Starts from nothing at minimum bloodlust, smoothly reaches this value at max bloodlust.

- Positive: Damage you take is reduced to the set value.
Ex. 0.8 means you take only 80%% of damage.

- Negative: Damage you take is multiplied by the value.
Ex. -2.0 means you take double the damage.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_IncomingDamageMultipl.ch:
你受到所有傷害的倍率.

在嗜血值最低時沒有效果, 在嗜血值最高時平滑達到此數值.

- 正值: 你受到的傷害減少為設定值.
例: 0.8 表示你只受到 80%% 的傷害.

- 負值: 你受到的傷害乘以此數值.
例: -2.0 表示你受到雙倍傷害.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_IncomingDamageMultipl.cn:

- 正值: 你受到的伤害减少为设定值.
例: 0.8 表示你只受到 80%% 的伤害.

- 负值: 你受到的伤害乘以此数值.
例: -2.0 表示你受到双倍伤害.

秒殺時, 此格數內的殭屍會被吸引到玩家身邊.

Finally, your tiny lil' pistolittle can annihilate a zombie out of existence even when it barely touched its pinky.

射擊殭屍時是否可以秒殺.

射击僵尸时是否可以秒杀.

终于, 你那把小不点手枪就算只擦到僵尸的小指, 也能把它轰得灰飞烟灭.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingAfterMaxHo.cn: 达到最大时数后的杀戮渴望

Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingAfterMaxHo.cn: 达到最大未击杀时数后, 每小时增加多少嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingBloodiness.cn: 杀戮渴望沾血程度系数

How much your bloodiness reduces the time it takes to reach 100%% bloodlust.

0.5 means 50%% less time at 100%% bloodiness.

你的沾血程度能縮短多少達到 100%% 嗜血值所需的時間.

0.5 表示在 100%% 沾血程度時所需時間減少 50%%.

你的沾血程度能缩短多少达到 100%% 嗜血值所需的时间.

0.5 表示在 100%% 沾血程度时所需时间减少 50%%.

How much low health increases the time it takes to reach 100%% bloodlust.

2.0 means on 50%% health it takes ~3 times longer to reach 100%% bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingHealthExpo.ch:
低生命值會延長多少達到 100%% 嗜血值所需的時間.

低生命值会延长多少达到 100%% 嗜血值所需的时间.

2.0 表示在 50%% 生命值时, 达到 100%% 嗜血值所需时间约为 3 倍.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingMaxHoursEx.cn: 杀戮渴望最大时数指数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingMaxHoursEx.en:
Determines when most of the bloodlust is added.

1 = linear increase, >1 higher increase the more time passes, <1 lower increase the more time passes.

For 36 hours until max bloodlust and exponent 3, first 1%% bloodlust is reached at 7th hour, 50%% at 29th hour and 100%% at 36th hour.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingMaxHoursEx.ch:
決定大部分嗜血值在何時增加.

1 = 線性增加, >1 = 時間越久增加越多, <1 = 時間越久增加越少.

若達到最大嗜血值需 36 小時且指數為 3, 第 7 小時達到 1%% 嗜血值, 第 29 小時達到 50%%, 第 36 小時達到 100%%.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingMaxHoursEx.cn:
决定大部分嗜血值在何时增加.

1 = 线性增加, >1 = 时间越久增加越多, <1 = 时间越久增加越少.

若达到最大嗜血值需 36 小时且指数为 3, 第 7 小时达到 1%% 嗜血值, 第 29 小时达到 50%%, 第 36 小时达到 100%%.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingMaxHours_t.en: How many in-game hours without killing it takes to reach maximum bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingMaxHours_t.ch: 未擊殺多少遊戲內小時後達到最大嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingMaxHours_t.cn: 未击杀多少游戏内小时后达到最大嗜血值.

1.0 表示 100%% 陳舊的血跡會讓你 50%% 的沾血程度視為 100%% 沾血程度.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KillCravingStaleBlood.cn:

Sandbox_BloodlustO_KnifeHitBloodlustRedu.cn: 刀械命中嗜血值减少量

Sandbox_BloodlustO_KnifeHitBloodlustRedu.ch: 每次用刀械命中減少此數量的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KnifeHitBloodlustRedu.cn: 每次用刀械命中减少此数量的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_KnifeKillBloodlustRed.ch: 刀械擊殺嗜血值減少量
Sandbox_BloodlustO_KnifeKillBloodlustRed.cn: 刀械击杀嗜血值减少量

At 100%% bloodlust, it will take this in-game hours to reach 100%% unhappiness.

在 100%% 嗜血值時, 需要多少遊戲內小時才會達到 100%% 不開心.

在 100%% 嗜血值时, 需要多少游戏内小时才会达到 100%% 不开心.

在狂暴中達到 100%% 嗜血值時, 你的移動速度會加快多少.

在狂暴中达到 100%% 嗜血值时, 你的移动速度会加快多少.
(速度会随嗜血值上升平滑增加.)

0.25 表示在 100%% 嗜血值时快 25%%. 在 50%% 嗜血值时你会快 12.5%%.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MaxBloodlustFrenzyWea.cn: 最大嗜血值狂暴武器速度提升

How much faster you swing your weapon while in frenzy as you reach 100%% bloodlust.
(The speed increases smoothly as bloodlust rises.)

0.25 means 25%% faster at 100%% bloodlust. At 50%% bloodlust you'll swing 12.5%% faster.

在狂暴中達到 100%% 嗜血值時, 你揮動武器的速度會加快多少.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_MaxBloodlustFrenzyWea.cn:
在狂暴中达到 100%% 嗜血值时, 你挥动武器的速度会加快多少.
(速度会随嗜血值上升平滑增加.)

Sandbox_BloodlustO_RangedKillBloodlustRe.cn: 远程击杀嗜血值减少量

Sandbox_BloodlustO_RangedKillBloodlustRe.cn: 每次远程击杀 (使用枪械) 减少此数量的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_SendIntoFrenzyOnceEar.cn: 获得此特质的瞬间, 是否将嗜血值拉满并进入狂暴.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpHitBloodlustRedu.ch: 利器命中嗜血值減少量
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpHitBloodlustRedu.cn: 利器命中嗜血值减少量

Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpHitBloodlustRedu.en: Every hit with sharp weapons (spears, axes, blades) reduces this much bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpHitBloodlustRedu.ch: 每次用利器 (矛, 斧頭, 刀刃) 命中減少此數量的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpHitBloodlustRedu.cn: 每次用利器 (矛, 斧头, 刀刃) 命中减少此数量的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpKillBloodlustRed.ch: 利器擊殺嗜血值減少量
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpKillBloodlustRed.cn: 利器击杀嗜血值减少量

Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpKillBloodlustRed.en: Every kill with sharp weapons (spears, axes, blades) reduces this much bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpKillBloodlustRed.ch: 每次用利器 (矛, 斧頭, 刀刃) 擊殺減少此數量的嗜血值.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SharpKillBloodlustRed.cn: 每次用利器 (矛, 斧头, 刀刃) 击杀减少此数量的嗜血值.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_SleepingPillsDuration.en: For how long sleeping pills effects are active.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_SleepingPillsNightmar.en:
Nightmares chance is multiplied by this when sleeping pills are active.

0.1 means you'll experience nightmares only 10%% as often.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SleepingPillsNightmar.ch:
安眠藥生效時, 惡夢機率乘以此數值.

0.1 表示你做惡夢的頻率只有 10%%.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SleepingPillsNightmar.cn:
安眠药生效时, 噩梦几率乘以此数值.

0.1 表示你做噩梦的频率只有 10%%.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_StartDeathRampageIfBe.en: Start Death Rampage If Below Health

If you fall below this health while in combat, death rampage begins.

Note that if this is set too low there might not be a chance to prevent your death
as your health drops from, for example, 5%%, straight to death.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_StartDeathRampageIfBe.ch:
若你在戰鬥中生命值低於此值, 就會開始死亡暴走.

注意: 若此值設得太低, 可能來不及阻止你的死亡,
因為你的生命值可能從例如 5%% 直接掉到死亡.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_StartDeathRampageIfBe.cn:
若你在战斗中生命值低于此值, 就会开始死亡暴走.

注意: 若此值设得太低, 可能来不及阻止你的死亡,
因为你的生命值可能从例如 5%% 直接掉到死亡.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_SuppressedBloodlustFo.ch: 最大疼痛所需壓抑嗜血值
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SuppressedBloodlustFo.cn: 最大疼痛所需压抑嗜血值

Sandbox_BloodlustO_SuppressedBloodlustFo.en: At this suppressed bloodlust amount the Chest and Head pain reaches max ("Agony" moodle).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SuppressedBloodlustFo.ch: 壓抑的嗜血值達到此數量時, 胸部與頭部疼痛達到最大 (「痛不欲生」狀態).
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SuppressedBloodlustFo.cn: 压抑的嗜血值达到此数量时, 胸部与头部疼痛达到最大 (“痛不欲生”状态).

Sandbox_BloodlustO_SuppressedBloodlustTo.ch: 阻止秒殺的壓抑嗜血值
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SuppressedBloodlustTo.cn: 阻止秒杀的压抑嗜血值

Sandbox_BloodlustO_SuppressedBloodlustTo.en: Above this amount of bloodlust suppressed, you won't be able to instakill until you use up the suppressed bloodlust.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SuppressedBloodlustTo.ch: 壓抑的嗜血值超過此數量時, 在你耗盡壓抑的嗜血值之前將無法秒殺.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_SuppressedBloodlustTo.cn: 压抑的嗜血值超过此数量时, 在你耗尽压抑的嗜血值之前将无法秒杀.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_TilesUntilSeenZombieF.en: Tiles Until Seen Zombie For In Combat
Sandbox_BloodlustO_TilesUntilSeenZombieF.ch: 可見殭屍判定戰鬥中格數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_TilesUntilSeenZombieF.cn: 可见僵尸判定战斗中格数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_TilesUntilSeenZombieF.en: Tiles until closest zombie the player can see to be considered "in combat".
Sandbox_BloodlustO_TilesUntilSeenZombieF.ch: 玩家可見的最近殭屍在此格數內時, 視為「戰鬥中」.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_TilesUntilSeenZombieF.cn: 玩家可见的最近僵尸在此格数内时, 视为“战斗中”.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_TilesUntilZombieForIn.en: Tiles Until Zombie For In Combat
Tiles until closest zombie that is hidden behind something for player to be considered "in combat".
Sandbox_BloodlustO_TilesUntilZombieForIn.ch: 被物體遮擋的最近殭屍在此格數內時, 玩家視為「戰鬥中」.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_TilesUntilZombieForIn.cn: 被物体遮挡的最近僵尸在此格数内时, 玩家视为“战斗中”.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_UnsuppressBloodlustMo.ch: 解除壓抑嗜血值修正值
Sandbox_BloodlustO_UnsuppressBloodlustMo.cn: 解除压抑嗜血值修正值

Sandbox_BloodlustO_UnsuppressBloodlustMo.en:
Bloodlust changed from hits/kills is used up this much to remove suppressed bloodlust instead of reducing your current bloodlust.

0.6 means 60%% of bloodlust change is used up.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_UnsuppressBloodlustMo.ch:
命中/擊殺造成的嗜血值變化中, 有此比例會用來消除壓抑的嗜血值, 而不是減少你目前的嗜血值.

0.6 表示 60%% 的嗜血值變化會被用掉.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_UnsuppressBloodlustMo.cn:
命中/击杀造成的嗜血值变化中, 有此比例会用来消除压抑的嗜血值, 而不是减少你当前的嗜血值.

0.6 表示 60%% 的嗜血值变化会被用掉.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponBreakInstakillA.ch: 武器損壞秒殺觸發嗜血值
Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponBreakInstakillA.cn: 武器损坏秒杀触发嗜血值

Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponBreakInstakillA.en: Bloodlust level above which breaking your weapon will instakill whoever you hit.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponBreakInstakillA.ch: 嗜血值高於此等級時, 武器損壞會秒殺你擊中的目標.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponBreakInstakillA.cn: 嗜血值高于此等级时, 武器损坏会秒杀你击中的目标.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponBreakInstakillS.ch: 武器損壞秒殺聲音範圍
Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponBreakInstakillS.cn: 武器损坏秒杀声音范围

Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponBreakInstakillS.en:
Zombies this many tiles away will be attracted to player on instakill caused by your weapon breaking.

For reference, shout sound radius is 30. See pzwiki.net/wiki/Noise
Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponBreakInstakillS.ch:
因武器損壞觸發秒殺時, 此格數內的殭屍會被吸引到玩家身邊.

參考: 喊叫的聲音範圍為 30. 詳見 pzwiki.net/wiki/Noise
Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponBreakInstakillS.cn:
因武器损坏触发秒杀时, 此格数内的僵尸会被吸引到玩家身边.

参考: 喊叫的声音范围为 30. 详见 pzwiki.net/wiki/Noise

Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponConditionLossDa.ch: 武器耐久損耗傷害倍率
Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponConditionLossDa.cn: 武器耐久损耗伤害倍率

Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponConditionLossDa.en:
Multiplier for the additional damage when your weapon loses condition.

1.0 means no additional damage due to condition loss,
3.0 means 3x the additional damage on condition loss.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponConditionLossDa.ch:
武器損耗耐久時額外傷害的倍率.

1.0 表示耐久損耗不會造成額外傷害,
3.0 表示耐久損耗時造成 3 倍額外傷害.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponConditionLossDa.cn:
武器损耗耐久时额外伤害的倍率.

1.0 表示耐久损耗不会造成额外伤害,
3.0 表示耐久损耗时造成 3 倍额外伤害.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponConditionLossKn.en: Whether losing a condition on weapon will knock down whichever zombie you hit last.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponConditionLossKn.ch: 武器損耗耐久時, 是否擊倒你最後擊中的殭屍.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_WeaponConditionLossKn.cn: 武器损耗耐久时, 是否击倒你最后击中的僵尸.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ZombiesNearbyTiles_to.en: Every zombie within this many tiles is considered close.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ZombiesNearbyTiles_to.ch: 此格數內的殭屍都視為接近.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ZombiesNearbyTiles_to.cn: 此格数内的僵尸都视为接近.

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ZombiesScanEveryTicks.ch: 殭屍掃描間隔 Tick 數
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ZombiesScanEveryTicks.cn: 僵尸扫描间隔 Tick 数

Sandbox_BloodlustO_ZombiesScanEveryTicks.en: Ticks between scanning closest zombies. Don't change if you don't know what you're doing.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ZombiesScanEveryTicks.ch: 掃描最近殭屍之間的 Tick 數. 若不清楚用途請勿更改.
Sandbox_BloodlustO_ZombiesScanEveryTicks.cn: 扫描最近僵尸之间的 Tick 数. 若不清楚用途请勿更改.

Sandbox_EPR_WaterRestoration_tooltip.en: Lets the water treatment plant be repaired to bring water back. When off, the plant cannot be repaired and water shuts off everywhere as normal, while power restoration keeps working.
Sandbox_EPR_WaterRestoration_tooltip.ch: 允許修復水廠以恢復供水. 關閉時, 水廠無法修復, 自來水會照常在各地停止供應, 而電力恢復功能仍可正常運作.
Sandbox_EPR_WaterRestoration_tooltip.cn: 允许修复水厂以恢复供水. 关闭时, 水厂无法修复, 自来水会照常在各地停止供应, 而电力恢复功能仍可正常运作.

Sandbox_Title_DansOPWeapons_Cash.ch: D商店 - 現金 / 第0級
Sandbox_Title_DansOPWeapons_Cash.cn: D商店 - 现金 / 第0级

Sandbox_SunIsGone_Aftermath_tooltip.en: The ground keeps giving up its heat. Crops take the frost, the animals follow, and staying warm becomes the whole problem.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_Aftermath_tooltip.ch: 大地不斷流失熱量. 作物先遭霜凍, 動物隨後, 保暖成了唯一的難題.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_Aftermath_tooltip.cn: 大地不断流失热量. 作物先遭霜冻, 动物随后, 保暖成了唯一的难题.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdBurnsFuel_tooltip.en: At sixty below a fire is fighting a much bigger gradient and burns through fuel to stay lit. You never lose the ability to make fire - you lose the ability to leave one burning all night for free.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdBurnsFuel_tooltip.ch: 在零下六十度時, 火要對抗大得多的溫差, 會更快燒光燃料才能維持不滅. 你永遠不會失去生火的能力 - 失去的是讓火免費燒一整晚的能力.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdBurnsFuel_tooltip.cn: 在零下六十度时, 火要对抗大得多的温差, 会更快烧光燃料才能维持不灭. 你永远不会失去生火的能力 - 失去的是让火免费烧一整晚的能力.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdFloor_tooltip.en: The temperature falls towards this and never quite arrives. It halves the remaining distance roughly every twenty days.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdFloor_tooltip.ch: 氣溫會朝這個值下降, 但永遠不會真正到達. 大約每二十天, 剩餘差距會減半.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdFloor_tooltip.cn: 气温会朝这个值下降, 但永远不会真正到达. 大约每二十天, 剩余差距会减半.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdKillsZombies_toolt.en: Below about -25 the dead start dropping where they stand, and they stay where they fall. Give it long enough and the county is bodies in the snow and nothing else.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdKillsZombies_toolt.ch: 低於約 -25 度時, 死者會在原地倒下, 並一直躺在倒下之處. 時間夠久的話, 整個縣只剩雪中的屍體, 別無他物.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdKillsZombies_toolt.cn: 低于约-25度时, 死者会在原地倒下, 并一直躺在倒下之处. 时间够久的话, 整个县只剩雪中的尸体, 别无他物.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdZombies_tooltip.en: Dead tissue does not move well at twenty below. They slow as the world cools - and they loosen up again near anything warm.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdZombies_tooltip.ch: 死去的組織在零下二十度時活動不靈. 它們會隨著世界變冷而變慢 - 靠近溫暖的東西時又會重新活絡起來.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ColdZombies_tooltip.cn: 死去的组织在零下二十度时活动不灵. 它们会随着世界变冷而变慢 - 靠近温暖的东西时又会重新活络起来.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_CutUtilities.en: Cut power and water at hour zero

Sandbox_SunIsGone_CutUtilities_tooltip.en: The grid dies the moment the sun does. It was never an outage - the draw went somewhere else.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_CutUtilities_tooltip.ch: 太陽一消失, 電網就跟著死去. 這從來不是停電 - 電力被抽到別處去了.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_CutUtilities_tooltip.cn: 太阳一消失, 电网就跟着死去. 这从来不是停电 - 电力被抽到别处去了.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_Darkness_tooltip.en: How complete the dark is. 100 is a sky with nothing left in it. Lower this if you cannot see enough to play.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_Darkness_tooltip.ch: 黑暗的徹底程度. 100 代表天空中什麼都不剩. 如果你看不清楚而無法遊玩, 請調低此值.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_Darkness_tooltip.cn: 黑暗的彻底程度. 100代表天空中什么都不剩. 如果你看不清楚而无法游玩, 请调低此值.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_DeadAir_tooltip.en: Nothing is heating the ground, so nothing is moving the air. The wind dies out and the cold ground fogs over.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_DeadAir_tooltip.ch: 沒有東西在加熱地面, 也就沒有東西在推動空氣. 風會停歇, 寒冷的地面會起霧.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_DeadAir_tooltip.cn: 没有东西在加热地面, 也就没有东西在推动空气. 风会停歇, 寒冷的地面会起雾.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_DebugLogging.ch: 將診斷資訊寫入主控台
Sandbox_SunIsGone_DebugLogging.cn: 将诊断信息写入控制台

Sandbox_SunIsGone_DebugLogging_tooltip.en: Prints the cold, thinning and fuel numbers once a minute. Only useful if something looks wrong and you want to know which system is doing it.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_DebugLogging_tooltip.ch: 每分鐘輸出一次寒冷、殭屍削減與燃料數值. 只有在情況看起來不對、想知道是哪個系統造成時才有用.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_DebugLogging_tooltip.cn: 每分钟输出一次寒冷、僵尸削减与燃料数值. 只有在情况看起来不对、想知道是哪个系统造成时才有用.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_EmptyPrepDay_tooltip.en: Remove every zombie until the sun goes. Knox is silent and completely still, and nothing tells you why.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_EmptyPrepDay_tooltip.ch: 在太陽消失前移除所有殭屍. 諾克斯縣寂靜無聲、完全靜止, 沒有任何東西告訴你原因.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_EmptyPrepDay_tooltip.cn: 在太阳消失前移除所有僵尸. 诺克斯县寂静无声、完全静止, 没有任何东西告诉你原因.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_FreezeBarrels_tooltip.en: Below freezing, open barrels and collectors slowly give up whatever is in them - and stop being a way to bank the snowfall. Snow has to be carried in and melted instead.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_FreezeBarrels_tooltip.ch: 低於冰點時, 開放的桶子與集水器會慢慢失去裡面的東西 - 不再能用來囤積降雪. 必須改為把雪搬進來融化.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_FreezeBarrels_tooltip.cn: 低于冰点时, 开放的桶与集水器会慢慢失去里面的东西 - 不再能用来囤积降雪. 必须改为把雪搬进来融化.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_FuelBurnScale_tooltip.en: Scales the extra fuel deep cold costs you. 0 turns the penalty off without disabling the rest.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_FuelBurnScale_tooltip.ch: 調整嚴寒讓你額外消耗的燃料. 0 會關閉此懲罰, 但不影響其他功能.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_FuelBurnScale_tooltip.cn: 调整严寒让你额外消耗的燃料. 0会关闭此惩罚, 但不影响其他功能.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_HordeDecay_tooltip.en: Each night's horde as a share of the one before. They are freezing out there, and it shows.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_HordeDecay_tooltip.ch: 每晚的屍潮相對於前一晚的比例. 它們在外面逐漸凍死, 看得出來.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_HordeDecay_tooltip.cn: 每晚的尸潮相对于前一晚的比例. 它们在外面逐渐冻死, 看得出来.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_HordeFirstNight_toolti.en: How many should be coming for you on the night the sun goes out. Scaled by your own population setting.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_HordeFirstNight_toolti.ch: 太陽熄滅那一晚應該有多少殭屍朝你而來. 會依你的人口設定縮放.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_HordeFirstNight_toolti.cn: 太阳熄灭那一晚应该有多少僵尸朝你而来. 会依你的人口设置缩放.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_MeltSnow_tooltip.en: Hour zero takes the taps, and after the last snowfall nothing comes out of the sky. Snow has to be carried in from outside and melted beside a fire.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_MeltSnow_tooltip.ch: 零時會帶走自來水, 而最後一場雪下完後, 天空不會再落下任何東西. 必須從外面把雪搬進來, 在火旁融化.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_MeltSnow_tooltip.cn: 零时会带走自来水, 而最后一场雪下完后, 天空不会再落下任何东西. 必须从外面把雪搬进来, 在火旁融化.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_MidnightHordes_tooltip.en: Every midnight the dead turn and walk at you. The first night is everything the county still has; it only sends more if the county cannot muster enough on its own.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_MidnightHordes_tooltip.ch: 每到午夜, 死者都會轉身朝你走來. 第一晚是全縣剩下的所有殭屍; 只有在全縣自己湊不夠時才會額外派出更多.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_MidnightHordes_tooltip.cn: 每到午夜, 死者都会转身朝你走来. 第一晚是全县剩下的所有僵尸; 只有在全县自己凑不够时才会额外派出更多.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_MusicIndoorsOnly_toolt.en: Step outside and the music stops. Out there nothing is scoring this. Get back under a roof, or into a car, and it comes back.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_MusicIndoorsOnly_toolt.ch: 一走出室外音樂就停止. 外面沒有任何東西為這一切配樂. 回到屋頂下或車裡, 音樂就會回來.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_MusicIndoorsOnly_toolt.cn: 一走出室外音乐就停止. 外面没有任何东西为这一切配乐. 回到屋顶下或车里, 音乐就会回来.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_PrepDays.en: Extra days before the sun goes
Sandbox_SunIsGone_PrepDays.ch: 太陽消失前的額外天數
Sandbox_SunIsGone_PrepDays.cn: 太阳消失前的额外天数

Sandbox_SunIsGone_PrepDays_tooltip.en: It always happens at midnight. 0 means the very next 00:00 - the rest of your first day. Raise this to add whole days on top. You are given no countdown in game - that is the point.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_PrepDays_tooltip.ch: 它總是在午夜發生. 0 代表緊接著的下一個 00:00 - 也就是你第一天剩下的時間. 調高此值可再加上整天數. 遊戲中不會給你任何倒數 - 這正是重點.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_PrepDays_tooltip.cn: 它总是在午夜发生. 0代表紧接着的下一个00:00 - 也就是你第一天剩下的时间. 调高此值可再加上整天数. 游戏中不会给你任何倒计时 - 这正是重点.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_ReturnCount_tooltip.en: A floor, not a fixed number. The mod counts how many the county actually held during the preparation day - under your population multiplier, your preset, your map - and sends back whatever is larger. On Apocalypse in a town that is a town's worth.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ReturnCount_tooltip.ch: 這是下限, 不是固定數字. 模組會統計準備日期間全縣實際有多少殭屍 - 依你的人口倍率、預設與地圖 - 並送回兩者中較大的數量. 在末日模式下, 一座城鎮就是一整座城鎮的量.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ReturnCount_tooltip.cn: 这是下限, 不是固定数字. 模组会统计准备日期间全县实际有多少僵尸 - 依你的人口倍率、预设与地图 - 并送回两者中较大的数量. 在启示录模式下, 一座城镇就是一整座城镇的量.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_SilenceBroadcasts_tool.en: At hour zero every station the game shipped with goes off the band for good - news, talk, emergency broadcast, all of it. Other mods' stations are left alone, and VHS tapes still play.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_SilenceBroadcasts_tool.ch: 零時一到, 遊戲內建的所有電台都會永久停播 - 新聞、談話、緊急廣播, 全部都是. 其他模組的電台不受影響, VHS 錄影帶也仍可播放.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_SilenceBroadcasts_tool.cn: 零时一到, 游戏内置的所有电台都会永久停播 - 新闻、谈话、紧急广播, 全部都是. 其他模组的电台不受影响, VHS录像带也仍可播放.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_SnowArc_tooltip.en: The sky still holds its water when the sun goes. It comes down as snow, all of it, and then the sky is empty for good.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_SnowArc_tooltip.ch: 太陽消失時, 天空仍含著水氣. 它會全部化為雪落下, 之後天空就永遠空無一物.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_SnowArc_tooltip.cn: 太阳消失时, 天空仍含着水汽. 它会全部化为雪落下, 之后天空就永远空无一物.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_SnowCoverage_tooltip.en: How buried the world ends up. The snow only ever builds; at these temperatures it never goes.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_SnowCoverage_tooltip.ch: 世界最終被埋得多深. 積雪只會增加; 在這種溫度下永遠不會融化.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_SnowCoverage_tooltip.cn: 世界最终被埋得多深. 积雪只会增加; 在这种温度下永远不会融化.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_SnowDays_tooltip.en: How long it takes the sky to empty. After this nothing falls again, and nothing melts either.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_SnowDays_tooltip.ch: 天空要多久才會下空. 之後不會再有任何東西落下, 也不會有任何東西融化.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_SnowDays_tooltip.cn: 天空要多久才会下空. 之后不会再有任何东西落下, 也不会有任何东西融化.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_ThawRadius_tooltip.en: How far the warmth of a fire or a running generator reaches. Everything inside it moves like the cold never happened.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ThawRadius_tooltip.ch: 火堆或運轉中發電機的暖意能延伸多遠. 範圍內的一切都會像從未受凍一樣行動.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ThawRadius_tooltip.cn: 火堆或运转中发电机的暖意能延伸多远. 范围内的一切都会像从未受冻一样行动.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_ZombieMinSpeed_tooltip.en: How far the deep cold slows them. Lower is slower. This is the reward for going out into the worst of it.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ZombieMinSpeed_tooltip.ch: 嚴寒能讓它們慢到什麼程度. 數值越低越慢. 這是你冒險深入最嚴酷環境的回報.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ZombieMinSpeed_tooltip.cn: 严寒能让它们慢到什么程度. 数值越低越慢. 这是你冒险深入最严酷环境的回报.

Sandbox_SunIsGone_ZombiesReturn_tooltip.en: The county was empty all day. When the sun goes, it is not empty any more.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ZombiesReturn_tooltip.ch: 全縣一整天都空無一人. 太陽消失時, 就不再空蕩了.
Sandbox_SunIsGone_ZombiesReturn_tooltip.cn: 全县一整天都空无一人. 太阳消失时, 就不再空荡了.

Sandbox_CBB_ExtraDepositItems_tooltip.en: Adds extra item types to every looted safe deposit box. Enter full item IDs separated by commas. Leave blank to add nothing.
Sandbox_CBB_ExtraDepositItems_tooltip.ch: 為每個被搜刮的銀行保管箱新增額外的物品種類. 輸入完整物品 ID, 以逗號分隔. 留空則不新增.
Sandbox_CBB_ExtraDepositItems_tooltip.cn: 为每个被搜刮的银行保管箱添加额外的物品种类. 输入完整物品ID, 以逗号分隔. 留空则不添加.

Sandbox_CBB_ExtraSafeItems_tooltip.en: Adds extra item types to every looted bank safe. Enter full item IDs separated by commas, for example: Base.Pistol,Base.GoldBar. Leave blank to add nothing.
Sandbox_CBB_ExtraSafeItems_tooltip.ch: 為每個被搜刮的銀行保險箱新增額外的物品種類. 輸入完整物品 ID, 以逗號分隔, 例如: Base.Pistol,Base.GoldBar. 留空則不新增.
Sandbox_CBB_ExtraSafeItems_tooltip.cn: 为每个被搜刮的银行保险柜添加额外的物品种类. 输入完整物品ID, 以逗号分隔, 例如: Base.Pistol,Base.GoldBar. 留空则不添加.

Sandbox_CBB_KeySpawnChance_tooltip.en: Chance for a Bank Safe Key to spawn somewhere inside each bank. A successful bank will receive one key in a suitable desk, counter or filing cabinet. 0% disables key spawning. Default: 65%.
Sandbox_CBB_KeySpawnChance_tooltip.ch: 每間銀行內生成一把銀行保險櫃鑰匙的機率. 成功時, 該銀行會在合適的辦公桌、櫃檯或檔案櫃中放入一把鑰匙. 0%% 會停用鑰匙生成. 預設: 65%%.
Sandbox_CBB_KeySpawnChance_tooltip.cn: 每间银行内生成一把银行保险柜钥匙的几率. 成功时, 该银行会在合适的办公桌、柜台或文件柜中放入一把钥匙. 0%%会禁用钥匙生成. 默认: 65%%.

Sandbox_CBB_LootMultiplier.ch: 保險箱與保管箱戰利品倍率
Sandbox_CBB_LootMultiplier.cn: 保险柜与保管箱战利品倍率

Sandbox_CBB_LootMultiplier_tooltip.en: Controls how much loot is generated when opening bank safes and safe deposit boxes. 1.0 = normal loot, 2.0 = roughly double. Higher values also increase the chance of some valuables appearing.
Sandbox_CBB_LootMultiplier_tooltip.ch: 控制開啟銀行保險箱與保管箱時生成的戰利品數量. 1.0 = 正常, 2.0 = 約兩倍. 數值越高, 出現貴重物品的機率也越高.
Sandbox_CBB_LootMultiplier_tooltip.cn: 控制打开银行保险柜与保管箱时生成的战利品数量. 1.0 = 正常, 2.0 = 约两倍. 数值越高, 出现贵重物品的几率也越高.

Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours.en: Safe & Deposit Box Loot Respawn Time
Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours.ch: 保險箱與保管箱戰利品重生時間
Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours.cn: 保险柜与保管箱战利品重生时间

Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours_tooltip.en: Number of in-game hours before looted bank safes and safe deposit boxes can contain loot again. Set to 0 to disable loot respawning. Default: 0.
Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours_tooltip.ch: 被搜刮過的銀行保險箱與保管箱需經過多少遊戲內小時才能再次出現戰利品. 設為 0 可停用戰利品重生. 預設: 0.
Sandbox_CBB_LootResetHours_tooltip.cn: 被搜刮过的银行保险柜与保管箱需经过多少游戏内小时才能再次出现战利品. 设为0可禁用战利品重生. 默认: 0.

Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys.en: Keys Only Work at Their Own Bank
Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys.ch: 鑰匙僅限所屬銀行使用
Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys.cn: 钥匙仅限所属银行使用

Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys_tooltip.en: When enabled, a Bank Safe Key only opens safes and deposit boxes at the bank where that key was found. When disabled, any Bank Safe Key can be used at any bank.
