Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys_tooltip.ch: 啟用時, 銀行保險櫃鑰匙只能開啟發現該鑰匙那間銀行的保險箱與保管箱. 停用時, 任何銀行保險櫃鑰匙都能在任何銀行使用.
Sandbox_CBB_UniqueKeys_tooltip.cn: 启用时, 银行保险柜钥匙只能打开发现该钥匙那间银行的保险柜与保管箱. 禁用时, 任何银行保险柜钥匙都能在任何银行使用.

Sandbox_SZ_OpenDoorChance_tooltip.en:
Percent of sentient zombies that work a door handle instead of
pounding on it. Rolled once per zombie.
Locked and barricaded doors are always thumped as normal, so
locking up is still a real defence.
Separate from the vanilla "Door Opening" lore setting -- if both
are above zero, both apply.
Sandbox_SZ_OpenDoorChance_tooltip.ch:
具有感知能力的殭屍中會轉動門把而非
猛力捶門的百分比. 每隻殭屍判定一次.
上鎖和設置路障的門一律照常被捶打, 因此
鎖門依然是真正有效的防禦.
此設定獨立於原版「開門」殭屍特性設定 -- 若兩者
皆大於零, 兩者同時生效.
Sandbox_SZ_OpenDoorChance_tooltip.cn:
具有感知能力的僵尸中会转动门把手而非
猛力捶门的百分比. 每只僵尸判定一次.
上锁和设置路障的门一律照常被捶打, 因此
锁门依然是真正有效的防御.
此设置独立于原版“开门”僵尸特性设置 -- 若两者
都大于零, 两者同时生效.

Sandbox_OffGrid_AllowBackup_tooltip.en: Lets players convert generators into Off-Grid backups. Off stops the ones that are running and refuses new conversions; Convert to normal generator still works.
Sandbox_OffGrid_AllowBackup_tooltip.ch: 允許玩家將發電機改裝為離網備用發電機. 關閉時會停止運轉中的備用發電機並拒絕新的改裝, 「轉換為一般發電機」仍可使用.
Sandbox_OffGrid_AllowBackup_tooltip.cn: 允许玩家将发电机改装为离网备用发电机. 关闭时会停止运行中的备用发电机并拒绝新的改装, “转换为普通发电机”仍可使用.

Sandbox_OffGrid_BackupFuelUse_tooltip.en: How much gasoline a backup generator burns. 1 burns what a normal generator burns for the same appliances, or in Realistic Mode what a real generator burns. 0 is free.
Sandbox_OffGrid_BackupFuelUse_tooltip.ch: 備用發電機消耗的汽油量. 1 表示與一般發電機為相同電器供電時的耗油量相同, 在寫實模式下則與真實發電機相同. 0 表示不耗油.
Sandbox_OffGrid_BackupFuelUse_tooltip.cn: 备用发电机消耗的汽油量. 1 表示与普通发电机为相同电器供电时的耗油量相同, 在写实模式下则与真实发电机相同. 0 表示不耗油.

Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance.en: Storage barns with spare solar gear (one in)
Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance.ch: 存有備用太陽能設備的儲藏穀倉 (幾座中有一座)
Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance.cn: 存有备用太阳能设备的储藏谷仓 (几座中有一座)

Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance_tooltip.en: On newly explored ground, one hay-storage barn in this many holds a few spare panels and battery racks. 0 means none.
Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance_tooltip.ch: 在新探索的區域中, 每這麼多座儲草穀倉就有一座存放少量備用太陽能板和電池架. 0 表示沒有.
Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance_tooltip.cn: 在新探索的区域中, 每这么多座储草谷仓就有一座存放少量备用光伏板和电池架. 0 表示没有.

Sandbox_OffGrid_GridLinkRadius_tooltip.en: How far a transformer's power line can run, to the controller or to another transformer, in tiles.
Sandbox_OffGrid_GridLinkRadius_tooltip.ch: 變壓器的電力線路可延伸的距離 (連到控制器或另一台變壓器), 單位為格.
Sandbox_OffGrid_GridLinkRadius_tooltip.cn: 变压器的电力线路可延伸的距离 (连到控制器或另一台变压器), 单位为格.

Sandbox_OffGrid_RealisticMode.ch: 寫實模式 (1993 年太陽能板)
Sandbox_OffGrid_RealisticMode.cn: 写实模式 (1993 年光伏板)

Sandbox_OffGrid_RealisticMode_tooltip.en: Panels make what panels made in 1993: three modules of about 50 W to a frame, so a standard frame gives about 140 W in full sun, a quarter of the usual. Makeshift frames make about half that, premium frames a little more. Backup generators burn gasoline like real generators: 0.15 L an hour for each kW of their rating, plus 0.45 L for each kWh they deliver.
Sandbox_OffGrid_RealisticMode_tooltip.ch: 太陽能板的發電量與 1993 年的太陽能板相同: 每個框架裝三塊約 50 W 的元件, 因此標準框架在全日照下約可發電 140 W, 為一般情況的四分之一. 簡易框架約為其一半, 高級框架稍多一些. 備用發電機會像真實發電機一樣消耗汽油: 每 kW 額定功率每小時 0.15 L, 另加每輸出 1 kWh 消耗 0.45 L.
Sandbox_OffGrid_RealisticMode_tooltip.cn: 光伏板的发电量与 1993 年的光伏板相同: 每个框架装三块约 50 W 的组件, 因此标准框架在全日照下约可发电 140 W, 为通常的四分之一. 简易框架约为其一半, 高级框架稍多一些. 备用发电机会像真实发电机一样消耗汽油: 每 kW 额定功率每小时 0.15 L, 另加每输出 1 kWh 消耗 0.45 L.

Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance.en: Houses with a solar rig (one in)
Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance.ch: 設有太陽能設備的房屋 (幾棟中有一棟)
Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance.cn: 设有太阳能设备的房屋 (几栋中有一栋)

Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance_tooltip.en: On newly explored ground, one house in this many has a solar rig in the yard. 0 means none.
Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance_tooltip.ch: 在新探索的區域中, 每這麼多棟房屋就有一棟在院子裡設有太陽能設備. 0 表示沒有.
Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance_tooltip.cn: 在新探索的区域中, 每这么多栋房屋就有一栋在院子里设有太阳能设备. 0 表示没有.

Sandbox_OffGrid_TransformerLoss_tooltip.en: What each transformer draws while the system has power, even with nothing switched on.
Sandbox_OffGrid_TransformerLoss_tooltip.ch: 系統有電時, 每台變壓器即使沒有開啟任何電器也會耗用的電力.
Sandbox_OffGrid_TransformerLoss_tooltip.cn: 系统有电时, 每台变压器即使没有打开任何电器也会消耗的电力.

Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_BackpackSpawnChan.ch: Mark XI 背包生成機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_BackpackSpawnChan.cn: Mark XI 背包生成几率 (百分比)

Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_BackpackSpawnChan.en: Chance to discover the unique Mark XI backpack in eligible military storage. The backpack remains a one-time world discovery.
Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_BackpackSpawnChan.ch: 在符合條件的軍用儲物容器中發現獨特 Mark XI 背包的機率. 該背包在世界中仍只會被發現一次.
Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_BackpackSpawnChan.cn: 在符合条件的军用储物容器中发现独特 Mark XI 背包的几率. 该背包在世界中仍只会被发现一次.

Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_SupplySpawnChance.ch: 彈藥與消耗品生成機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_SupplySpawnChance.cn: 弹药与消耗品生成几率 (百分比)

Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_SupplySpawnChance.en: Controls Mark XI ammunition and life-support consumable frequency in the same military, gun-store and police containers used by the mod.
Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_SupplySpawnChance.ch: 控制 Mark XI 彈藥與維生消耗品的出現頻率, 生成於本 MOD 使用的同一批軍用、槍店與警用容器中.
Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_SupplySpawnChance.cn: 控制 Mark XI 弹药与维生消耗品的出现频率, 生成于本 MOD 使用的同一批军用、枪店与警用容器中.

Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_WatchSpawnChance.ch: 介面手錶生成機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_WatchSpawnChance.cn: 界面手表生成几率 (百分比)

Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_WatchSpawnChance_.en: Chance to discover the unique Mark XI interface watch in eligible weapon containers. The Louisville checkpoint guarantee is unchanged.
Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_WatchSpawnChance_.ch: 在符合條件的武器容器中發現獨特 Mark XI 介面手錶的機率. 路易斯維爾檢查站的保底生成不變.
Sandbox_MarkXISuitLoot_WatchSpawnChance_.cn: 在符合条件的武器容器中发现独特 Mark XI 界面手表的几率. 路易斯维尔检查站的保底生成不变.

Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M49.en: Capacity in litres for the M49A2C fuel cargo tank. Applies to newly loaded vehicles.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M49.ch: M49A2C 燃油罐體的容量 (公升). 套用於新載入的車輛.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M49.cn: M49A2C 燃油罐体的容量 (升). 适用于新加载的车辆.

Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M50.en: Capacity in litres for the M50A3 water cargo tank. Applies to newly loaded vehicles.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M50.ch: M50A3 儲水罐體的容量 (公升). 套用於新載入的車輛.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M50.cn: M50A3 储水罐体的容量 (升). 适用于新加载的车辆.

Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M96.en: Capacity in litres for the M967 fuel cargo tank. Applies to newly loaded vehicles.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M96.ch: M967 燃油罐體的容量 (公升). 套用於新載入的車輛.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_M96.cn: M967 燃油罐体的容量 (升). 适用于新加载的车辆.

Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_Pum.en: Multiplier for tanker pump transfer speed. 1 is the default speed.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_Pum.ch: 油罐車泵送輸送速度的倍率. 1 為預設速度.
Sandbox_AMGeneralTankerFunctionality_Pum.cn: 油罐车泵送输送速度的倍率. 1 为默认速度.

Sandbox_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.ch: 聖徒的枯萎手指掉落機率 (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.cn: 圣徒的枯萎手指掉落几率 (%%)

Sandbox_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.en: Chance for each killed zombie to drop one Saint's Withered Finger. Independent of Blessing Abundance and Blessings on Zombie Equipment. Default: 0.5%%. Set to 0 to disable new drops; existing fingers remain usable.
Sandbox_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.ch: 每隻被擊殺的殭屍掉落一根聖徒的枯萎手指的機率. 不受祝福豐富度與殭屍裝備祝福影響. 預設: 0.5%%. 設為 0 可停用新的掉落; 已有的手指仍可使用.
Sandbox_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.cn: 每只被击杀的僵尸掉落一根圣徒的枯萎手指的几率. 不受祝福丰富度与僵尸装备祝福影响. 默认: 0.5%%. 设为 0 可禁用新的掉落; 已有的手指仍可使用.

Sandbox_NRE_LethalEmptyShafts_tooltip.en: On by default. When on, every elevator shaft is an open pit on every floor except the one the car is parked at. Calling a car and stepping in as the doors open is always safe, but if you open a shaft door on a floor the car isn't at and walk in, you fall.
Sandbox_NRE_LethalEmptyShafts_tooltip.ch: 預設開啟. 開啟時, 除了車廂停靠的樓層外, 每一層的電梯井都是敞開的深坑. 呼叫車廂並在門開啟時走進去永遠是安全的, 但如果你在車廂不在的樓層開啟電梯井門並走進去, 就會摔下去.
Sandbox_NRE_LethalEmptyShafts_tooltip.cn: 默认开启. 开启时, 除了轿厢停靠的楼层外, 每一层的电梯井都是敞开的深坑. 呼叫轿厢并在门打开时走进去永远是安全的, 但如果你在轿厢不在的楼层打开电梯井门并走进去, 就会摔下去.

Sandbox_IAmBruceLeeNow_UseCustomSounds.cn: 使用自定义李小龙音效

Sandbox_IAmBruceLeeNow_UseCustomSounds_t.en: When enabled, martial-arts attacks use the mod's custom sound effects and finisher yell. Disable this to replace them with sounds from the base game.
Sandbox_IAmBruceLeeNow_UseCustomSounds_t.ch: 啟用時, 武術攻擊會使用此 MOD 的自訂音效與終結吶喊. 停用則改用原版遊戲的音效.
Sandbox_IAmBruceLeeNow_UseCustomSounds_t.cn: 启用时, 武术攻击会使用此 MOD 的自定义音效与终结呐喊. 禁用则改用原版游戏的音效.

Sandbox_CoolSit_GrantResting_tooltip.en:
Leaning recovers endurance at the same rate as resting on furniture, and tiredness builds more slowly.
Turn off to keep Cool Sit purely cosmetic.
Sandbox_CoolSit_GrantResting_tooltip.ch:
倚靠時以與坐在家具上休息相同的速度恢復耐力, 疲勞累積也會變慢.
關閉則讓休閒坐姿純粹作為外觀效果.
Sandbox_CoolSit_GrantResting_tooltip.cn:
倚靠时以与坐在家具上休息相同的速度恢复耐力, 疲劳积累也会变慢.
关闭则让休闲坐姿纯粹作为外观效果.

Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld.en: Realistic Suppressor System - Guns of Marz Old Version
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld.ch: 真實消音器系統: Marz的槍械 (舊版)
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld.cn: 真实消音器系统: Marz的枪械 (旧版)

Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.en: Enable Guns of Marz Old Version muzzle adapters
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.ch: 啟用Marz的槍械 (舊版) 槍口轉接器
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.cn: 启用Marz的枪械 (旧版) 枪口适配器

Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.en: WORLD-START OPTION: Choose whether the original Guns of Marz Old Version muzzle mounting adapters remain enabled. Restart required. When disabled, AR/AK/Pistol/.45 adapters cannot be mounted and are removed from GoM random spawn tables and the vanilla replacement pool.
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.ch: 開局選項: 選擇是否保留Marz的槍械 (舊版) 原有的槍口安裝轉接器. 需要重新啟動. 停用後, AR/AK/手槍/.45轉接器將無法安裝, 並會從GoM隨機生成表與原版替換池中移除.
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableMu.cn: 开局选项: 选择是否保留Marz的枪械 (旧版) 原有的枪口安装适配器. 需要重启. 禁用后, AR/AK/手枪/.45适配器将无法安装, 并会从GoM随机生成表与原版替换池中移除.

Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.en: Enable Guns of Marz Old Version suppressors
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.ch: 啟用Marz的槍械 (舊版) 消音器
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.cn: 启用Marz的枪械 (旧版) 消音器

Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.en: WORLD-START OPTION: Choose whether the original Guns of Marz Old Version suppressors remain enabled. Restart required. When disabled, GoM suppressors cannot be mounted and are removed from GoM random spawn tables.
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.ch: 開局選項: 選擇是否保留Marz的槍械 (舊版) 原有的消音器. 需要重新啟動. 停用後, GoM消音器將無法安裝, 並會從GoM隨機生成表中移除.
Sandbox_ShotgunSuppressorGoMOld_EnableSu.cn: 开局选项: 选择是否保留Marz的枪械 (旧版) 原有的消音器. 需要重启. 禁用后, GoM消音器将无法安装, 并会从GoM随机生成表中移除.

Sandbox_CHB_CompatibilityMode_tooltip.en: Experimental fallback for other power-grid mods. Use the separate LG Extended Electricity option for LG support. When enabled, CHB may accept electricity reported on the boiler square by another mod when no normal grid or directly detectable vanilla generator is found. Fuel and load accounting for external sources may differ from normal CHB operation.
Sandbox_CHB_CompatibilityMode_tooltip.ch: 針對其他電網模組的實驗性備援方案. 支援LG時請使用另外的LG Extended Electricity選項. 啟用後, 若找不到一般電網或可直接偵測的原版發電機, CHB可能會接受其他模組回報在鍋爐所在格子上的電力. 外部電源的燃料與負載計算可能與CHB一般運作不同.
Sandbox_CHB_CompatibilityMode_tooltip.cn: 针对其他电网模组的实验性后备方案. 支持LG时请使用单独的LG Extended Electricity选项. 启用后, 若找不到普通电网或可直接检测的原版发电机, CHB可能会接受其他模组报告在锅炉所在格子上的电力. 外部电源的燃料与负载计算可能与CHB正常运行不同.

Sandbox_CHB_EnableResidentialSpawn_toolt.en: Allows Home and Compact boilers to appear only in basements, generated lazily when a player enters one.
Sandbox_CHB_EnableResidentialSpawn_toolt.ch: 讓家用鍋爐與小型鍋爐只出現在地下室, 並在玩家進入時才延遲生成.
Sandbox_CHB_EnableResidentialSpawn_toolt.cn: 让家用锅炉与小型锅炉只出现在地下室, 并在玩家进入时才延迟生成.

Sandbox_CHB_EnableSystemAging_tooltip.en: Gradually increases boiler water consumption as the heating system ages after the electricity shutoff. There is no extra consumption during the first year; aging then increases over time and reaches its maximum permanent penalty by year ten. Disable this option to remove long-term system aging.
Sandbox_CHB_EnableSystemAging_tooltip.ch: 停電後, 隨著暖氣系統老化, 鍋爐的耗水量會逐漸增加. 第一年沒有額外消耗; 之後老化會隨時間加劇, 並在第十年達到最大的永久懲罰. 停用此選項即可移除長期系統老化.
Sandbox_CHB_EnableSystemAging_tooltip.cn: 停电后, 随着供暖系统老化, 锅炉的耗水量会逐渐增加. 第一年没有额外消耗; 之后老化会随时间加剧, 并在第十年达到最大的永久惩罚. 禁用此选项即可移除长期系统老化.

Sandbox_CHB_LGExtendedElectricityCompati.en: Enable CHB power compatibility with LG Extended Electricity. When enabled and LG is active, CHB may use electricity delivered to the boiler square through LG's extended network. CHB does not add this external boiler load to LG generator fuel or breaker accounting.
Sandbox_CHB_LGExtendedElectricityCompati.ch: 啟用CHB與LG Extended Electricity的電力相容. 啟用且LG正在運作時, CHB可使用透過LG擴充電網送達鍋爐所在格子的電力. CHB不會將這項外部鍋爐負載計入LG發電機的燃料或斷路器計算.
Sandbox_CHB_LGExtendedElectricityCompati.cn: 启用CHB与LG Extended Electricity的电力兼容. 启用且LG正在运行时, CHB可使用通过LG扩展电网送达锅炉所在格子的电力. CHB不会将这项外部锅炉负载计入LG发电机的燃料或断路器计算.

Sandbox_CHB_Mode_tooltip.en: Hardcore Realism uses very high power in cold weather. Normal is the recommended balance. Comfort uses a low, nearly constant draw.
Sandbox_CHB_Mode_tooltip.ch: 硬核寫實在寒冷天氣下耗電極高. 一般模式為建議的平衡設定. 舒適模式則以低且近乎恆定的功率運作.
Sandbox_CHB_Mode_tooltip.cn: 硬核写实在寒冷天气下耗电极高. 普通模式为推荐的平衡设置. 舒适模式则以低且近乎恒定的功率运行.

Sandbox_CHB_ResidentialSpawnChance.ch: 住宅鍋爐生成機率 (百分比)
Sandbox_CHB_ResidentialSpawnChance.cn: 住宅锅炉生成几率 (百分比)

Sandbox_CHB_ResidentialSpawnChance_toolt.en: Chance from 1 to 20 percent that an eligible basement receives one residential boiler when first entered.
Sandbox_CHB_ResidentialSpawnChance_toolt.ch: 符合條件的地下室首次被進入時, 獲得一座住宅鍋爐的機率, 範圍為百分之1到20.
Sandbox_CHB_ResidentialSpawnChance_toolt.cn: 符合条件的地下室首次被进入时, 获得一座住宅锅炉的几率, 范围为百分之1到20.

Sandbox_Locksmith_ActionNoise.ch: 殭屍會聽見你弄鎖的聲音
Sandbox_Locksmith_ActionNoise.cn: 僵尸会听见你弄锁的声音

Sandbox_Locksmith_ActionNoiseMultiplier_.en: Scales how far every one of this mod's actions carries. 100 is the default range, 200 is twice as far, 0 is silent. Forcing a door is the loudest act and picking a lock the quietest.
Sandbox_Locksmith_ActionNoiseMultiplier_.ch: 調整此模組每個動作的聲音傳播距離. 100為預設範圍, 200為兩倍遠, 0為無聲. 強行開門是最大聲的動作, 撬鎖則最安靜.
Sandbox_Locksmith_ActionNoiseMultiplier_.cn: 调整此模组每个动作的声音传播距离. 100为默认范围, 200为两倍远, 0为无声. 强行开门是最大声的动作, 撬锁则最安静.

Sandbox_Locksmith_ActionNoise_tooltip.en: Prying, cutting, picking, filing and re-pinning make noise that zombies can hear. Metal is louder than wood, and higher Nimble makes every attempt quieter. Turn this off to work in total silence.
Sandbox_Locksmith_ActionNoise_tooltip.ch: 撬開、剪斷、撬鎖、銼削與重新配鎖都會發出殭屍聽得見的噪音. 金屬比木頭更吵, 靈活等級越高, 每次嘗試越安靜. 關閉此選項即可完全靜音作業.
Sandbox_Locksmith_ActionNoise_tooltip.cn: 撬开、剪断、撬锁、锉削与重新配锁都会发出僵尸听得见的噪音. 金属比木头更吵, 灵活等级越高, 每次尝试越安静. 关闭此选项即可完全静音作业.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AdoptBalanceUpdates.en: Apply balance updates to existing saves
Sandbox_Locksmith_AdoptBalanceUpdates.ch: 將平衡性更新套用至現有存檔
Sandbox_Locksmith_AdoptBalanceUpdates.cn: 将平衡性更新应用到现有存档

Sandbox_Locksmith_AdoptBalanceUpdates_to.en: When an update changes one of this mod's recommended settings, your existing save adopts the new value, but only for settings you have not changed yourself. Turn this off to freeze the numbers already stored in your save. Note that the Sandbox Options screen keeps showing the stored number even while the mod uses the updated one.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AdoptBalanceUpdates_to.ch: 當更新變更此模組的某項建議設定時, 你的現有存檔會採用新數值, 但僅限你未自行變更過的設定. 關閉此選項即可凍結存檔中已儲存的數值. 請注意, 即使模組使用的是更新後的數值, 沙盒選項畫面仍會顯示已儲存的數值.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AdoptBalanceUpdates_to.cn: 当更新更改此模组的某项推荐设置时, 你的现有存档会采用新数值, 但仅限你未自行更改过的设置. 关闭此选项即可冻结存档中已保存的数值. 请注意, 即使模组使用的是更新后的数值, 沙盒选项界面仍会显示已保存的数值.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowBoltCutters.en: Allow cutting locks off with bolt cutters
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowBoltCutters.ch: 允許用斷線鉗剪斷鎖頭
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowBoltCutters.cn: 允许用断线钳剪断挂锁

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowBoltCutters_toolt.en: Lets a player cut one of this mod's padlocks off with bolt cutters, keyed or combination alike. Turn off to remove the mechanic entirely, leaving a padlock answerable only to its key, its combination or a lockpick.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowBoltCutters_toolt.ch: 讓玩家可用斷線鉗剪斷此模組的鎖頭, 無論是鑰匙鎖還是密碼鎖. 關閉即可完全移除此機制, 鎖頭只能靠鑰匙、密碼或撬鎖打開.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowBoltCutters_toolt.cn: 让玩家可用断线钳剪断此模组的挂锁, 无论是钥匙锁还是密码锁. 关闭即可完全移除此机制, 挂锁只能靠钥匙、密码或撬锁打开.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowCombinationLocks_.en: Lets a player fit a combination padlock, which takes a 4-digit code instead of a key. If off, combination locks already fitted still work and can still be removed, but no new one can be fitted. Keyed padlocks have their own switch.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowCombinationLocks_.ch: 讓玩家可安裝密碼鎖, 使用4位數密碼而非鑰匙. 關閉時, 已安裝的密碼鎖仍可使用與拆除, 但無法再安裝新的. 鑰匙鎖頭另有獨立開關.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowCombinationLocks_.cn: 让玩家可安装密码挂锁, 使用4位数密码而非钥匙. 关闭时, 已安装的密码锁仍可使用与拆除, 但无法再安装新的. 钥匙挂锁另有独立开关.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowCrowbarForce.en: Allow forcing doors with a crowbar

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowCrowbarForce_tool.en: Lets a player pry a locked door open with a crowbar. Padlocked gates are never a crowbar target. Turn off to remove the mechanic entirely.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowCrowbarForce_tool.ch: 讓玩家可用鐵撬撬開上鎖的門. 掛有鎖頭的柵門永遠無法用鐵撬撬開. 關閉即可完全移除此機制.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowCrowbarForce_tool.cn: 让玩家可用撬棍撬开上锁的门. 挂锁的栅门永远无法用撬棍撬开. 关闭即可完全移除此机制.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowDoorDestruction_t.en: If on, a door whose health is driven to zero by prying is destroyed, leaves the square and drops whatever it was made of. If off, a door's health always stops at 1 and force can never break it open. A door carrying one of this mod's padlocks is never destroyed either way.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowDoorDestruction_t.ch: 開啟時, 被撬到耐久度歸零的門會被破壞, 從格子上消失並掉落其材料. 關閉時, 門的耐久度最低停在1, 永遠無法被強行破開. 裝有此模組鎖頭的門無論如何都不會被破壞.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowDoorDestruction_t.cn: 开启时, 被撬到耐久度归零的门会被破坏, 从格子上消失并掉落其材料. 关闭时, 门的耐久度最低停在1, 永远无法被强行破开. 装有此模组挂锁的门无论如何都不会被破坏.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowInstall_tooltip.en: If off, existing locks still work but no new locks can be installed.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowInstall_tooltip.ch: 關閉時, 現有的鎖仍可使用, 但無法安裝新的鎖.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowInstall_tooltip.cn: 关闭时, 现有的锁仍可使用, 但无法安装新的锁.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyCutting_toolti.en: Lets a player file a blank key to match an unlocked lock: both Cut New Key For Lock and the blank that arms a freshly fitted padlock. Turn off and a padlock fitted afterwards can never be given a key. Vehicles have their own switch.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyCutting_toolti.ch: 讓玩家可將空白鑰匙銼成符合未上鎖之鎖的鑰匙: 包括 "為鎖配製新鑰匙" 以及啟用新裝鎖頭所用的空白鑰匙. 關閉後, 之後安裝的鎖頭將永遠無法配鑰匙. 載具另有獨立開關.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyCutting_toolti.cn: 让玩家可将空白钥匙锉成匹配未上锁之锁的钥匙: 包括 "为锁配新钥匙" 以及启用新装挂锁所用的空白钥匙. 关闭后, 之后安装的挂锁将永远无法配钥匙. 载具另有独立开关.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyRename_tooltip.en: Adds a rename entry to the right-click menu of any key, so a key ring stops being a pile of identical keys. Turn off to remove the entry; names already given are kept.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyRename_tooltip.ch: 在任何鑰匙的右鍵選單中新增重新命名選項, 讓鑰匙圈不再是一堆一模一樣的鑰匙. 關閉即可移除該選項; 已取的名稱會保留.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowKeyRename_tooltip.cn: 在任何钥匙的右键菜单中添加重命名选项, 让钥匙环不再是一堆一模一样的钥匙. 关闭即可移除该选项; 已取的名称会保留.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowLockRepair_toolti.en: Lets a player fit a replacement cylinder to a door or car door whose lock was wrecked, using a screwdriver, one scrap metal and two screws. Turn this off to make a wrecked lock permanent.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowLockRepair_toolti.ch: 讓玩家可用螺絲起子、1個廢金屬與2個螺絲, 為鎖已損壞的門或車門裝上替換鎖芯. 關閉此選項即可讓損壞的鎖永久無法修復.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowLockRepair_toolti.cn: 让玩家可用螺丝刀、1个金属废料与2个螺丝, 为锁已损坏的门或车门装上替换锁芯. 关闭此选项即可让损坏的锁永久无法修复.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowPickLocks_tooltip.en: Lets a player try a locked door with a screwdriver and a paperclip. Turn off to remove the mechanic entirely.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowPickLocks_tooltip.ch: 讓玩家可用螺絲起子與迴紋針嘗試撬開上鎖的門. 關閉即可完全移除此機制.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowPickLocks_tooltip.cn: 让玩家可用螺丝刀与回形针尝试撬开上锁的门. 关闭即可完全移除此机制.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowRepin_tooltip.en: Lets a player re-pin an unlocked padlock or doorknob onto a key they already carry, using tweezers. Turn off to remove the mechanic entirely. Vehicles have their own switch.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowRepin_tooltip.ch: 讓玩家可用鑷子將未上鎖的鎖頭或門把重新配對至身上已有的鑰匙. 關閉即可完全移除此機制. 載具另有獨立開關.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowRepin_tooltip.cn: 让玩家可用镊子将未上锁的挂锁或门把手重新匹配到身上已有的钥匙. 关闭即可完全移除此机制. 载具另有独立开关.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowSecurityDoorBreac.en: If on, the barred metal doors at police stations and similar buildings can be picked and pried like any other locked door, only harder. If off, they refuse both outright and neither entry appears on them at all.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowSecurityDoorBreac.ch: 開啟時, 警察局及類似建築中的鐵柵金屬門可像其他上鎖的門一樣被撬鎖與撬開, 只是更困難. 關閉時, 兩者都會被直接拒絕, 門上也完全不會出現這兩個選項.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowSecurityDoorBreac.cn: 开启时, 警察局及类似建筑中的铁栅金属门可像其他上锁的门一样被撬锁与撬开, 只是更困难. 关闭时, 两者都会被直接拒绝, 门上也完全不会出现这两个选项.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowVehicleForcing_to.en: Lets a player pry a locked car door or trunk open with a crowbar, using the same odds, the same endurance cost and the same Strength XP as forcing a house door. The lock is left permanently broken and can never be locked again, and the part takes some damage. Forcing doors with a crowbar must be allowed as well.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowVehicleForcing_to.ch: 讓玩家可用鐵撬撬開上鎖的車門或後車廂, 成功率、耐力消耗與力量經驗皆與強行打開房門相同. 鎖會永久損壞且再也無法上鎖, 該部件也會受到一些損傷. 必須同時允許用鐵撬強行開門.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowVehicleForcing_to.cn: 让玩家可用撬棍撬开上锁的车门或后备箱, 成功率、耐力消耗与力量经验皆与强行打开房门相同. 锁会永久损坏且再也无法上锁, 该部件也会受到一些损伤. 必须同时允许用撬棍强行开门.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowVehicleKeying_too.en: Lets a player re-pin a car's locks to a vehicle key they already carry, or cut a new car key from a blank. Both require standing at a door that is already unlocked.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowVehicleKeying_too.ch: 允許玩家為車鎖重新配鎖, 改為對應身上已有的車鑰匙, 或用空白鑰匙配製一把新的車鑰匙. 兩者都必須站在已解鎖的車門旁.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowVehicleKeying_too.cn: 允许玩家为车锁重新配锁, 改为对应身上已有的汽车钥匙, 或用空白钥匙配一把新的汽车钥匙. 两者都必须站在已解锁的车门旁.

Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowVehiclePicking_to.en: Lets a player pick a locked car door, trunk or hood with a screwdriver and a paperclip, with the same odds, the same tool wear and the same XP as a house lock. Lockpicking must be allowed as well.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowVehiclePicking_to.ch: 允許玩家用螺絲起子和迴紋針撬開上鎖的車門, 後車廂或引擎蓋, 成功率, 工具耗損與經驗值都和房屋門鎖相同. 同時也必須允許撬鎖.
Sandbox_Locksmith_AllowVehiclePicking_to.cn: 允许玩家用螺丝刀和回形针撬开上锁的车门, 后备箱或引擎盖, 成功率, 工具损耗与经验值都和房屋门锁相同. 同时也必须允许撬锁.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterBaseChance_t.en: Base success chance to cut off a lock with bolt cutters, before Strength bonus.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterBaseChance_t.ch: 用斷線鉗剪斷鎖的基礎成功率, 未計入力量加成.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterBaseChance_t.cn: 用断线钳剪断锁的基础成功率, 未计入力量加成.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterDegradeOnUse.en: Bolt cutters lose condition on every attempt to cut a lock, and lose more condition on a failed attempt. Off reverts to the old behaviour: only a failed attempt damages them.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterDegradeOnUse.ch: 每次嘗試剪鎖都會降低斷線鉗的耐久度, 失敗時降低更多. 關閉則恢復舊行為: 只有失敗時才會損壞斷線鉗.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterDegradeOnUse.cn: 每次尝试剪锁都会降低断线钳的耐久度, 失败时降低更多. 关闭则恢复旧行为: 只有失败时才会损坏断线钳.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterEnduranceCos.en: Endurance spent by one cutting attempt, before Fitness and Strength reduce it. Endurance runs from 0 to 1, so 0.02 is two per cent of a full bar.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterEnduranceCos.ch: 每次剪鎖嘗試消耗的耐力, 未計入體格與力量的減免. 耐力範圍為 0 到 1, 因此 0.02 代表滿條的百分之二.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterEnduranceCos.cn: 每次剪锁尝试消耗的耐力, 未计入体格与力量的减免. 耐力范围为 0 到 1, 因此 0.02 代表满条的百分之二.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterFailXp.ch: 剪鎖失敗的力量經驗值
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterFailXp.cn: 剪锁失败的力量经验值

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterFailXpChance.ch: 剪鎖失敗獲得經驗的機率 (%%)
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterFailXpChance.cn: 剪锁失败获得经验的几率 (%%)

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterFailXpChance.en: Chance that a failed cut awards its Strength XP at all.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterFailXpChance.ch: 剪鎖失敗時是否給予力量經驗值的機率.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterFailXpChance.cn: 剪锁失败时是否给予力量经验值的几率.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterFailXp_toolt.en: Strength XP awarded for a failed cut, the way a failed lockpick already pays a little.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterFailXp_toolt.ch: 剪鎖失敗時給予的力量經驗值, 就像撬鎖失敗也會給一點經驗一樣.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterFailXp_toolt.cn: 剪锁失败时给予的力量经验值, 就像撬锁失败也会给一点经验一样.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterMaxChance_to.en: Upper cap on the bolt cutter success chance.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterMinTimeTicks.en: Floor on the cutting time; the Strength time reduction can never take a cut below this.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterMinTimeTicks.ch: 剪鎖時間的下限; 力量帶來的時間縮減永遠不會讓剪鎖時間低於此值.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterMinTimeTicks.cn: 剪锁时间的下限; 力量带来的时间缩减永远不会让剪锁时间低于此值.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterPerStrength.ch: 每級力量的斷線鉗成功率加成
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterPerStrength.cn: 每级力量的断线钳成功率加成

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterPerStrength_.en: Added success chance (%%) per level of the Strength perk.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterPerStrength_.ch: 每級力量技能增加的成功率 (%%).
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterPerStrength_.cn: 每级力量技能增加的成功率 (%%).

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterTimePerStren.en: Bolt cutter time saved per Strength
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterTimePerStren.ch: 每級力量縮短的斷線鉗時間
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterTimePerStren.cn: 每级力量缩短的断线钳时间

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterTimePerStren.en: Ticks removed from the cutting time for each level of the Strength perk. Higher Strength cuts faster.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterTimePerStren.ch: 每級力量技能從剪鎖時間中扣除的 tick 數. 力量越高, 剪得越快.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterTimePerStren.cn: 每级力量技能从剪锁时间中扣除的 tick 数. 力量越高, 剪得越快.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterTimeTicks_to.en: How long a single cutting attempt takes.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterTimeTicks_to.ch: 單次剪鎖嘗試所需的時間.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterTimeTicks_to.cn: 单次剪锁尝试所需的时间.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearBaseChan.en: Chance that one cutting attempt wears the bolt cutters, at Strength 0. A failed attempt rolls this twice.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearBaseChan.ch: 力量為 0 時, 單次剪鎖嘗試使斷線鉗磨損的機率. 失敗時會判定兩次.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearBaseChan.cn: 力量为 0 时, 单次剪锁尝试使断线钳磨损的几率. 失败时会判定两次.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearMaxChanc.en: Upper cap on the bolt cutter wear chance.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearMaxChanc.ch: 斷線鉗磨損機率的上限.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearMaxChanc.cn: 断线钳磨损几率的上限.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearMinChanc.en: Floor on the bolt cutter wear chance.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearMinChanc.ch: 斷線鉗磨損機率的下限.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearMinChanc.cn: 断线钳磨损几率的下限.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearPerStren.en: Bolt cutter wear chance per Strength
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearPerStren.ch: 每級力量降低的斷線鉗磨損機率
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearPerStren.cn: 每级力量降低的断线钳磨损几率

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearPerStren.en: Wear chance (%%) removed per level of the Strength perk. A stronger pair of hands chews the tool less.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearPerStren.ch: 每級力量技能降低的磨損機率 (%%). 手勁越大, 工具耗損越少.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterWearPerStren.cn: 每级力量技能降低的磨损几率 (%%). 手劲越大, 工具损耗越少.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterXpChance_too.en: Chance that a successful cut awards Strength XP at all. Keeps cutting from becoming the fastest way to grind Strength.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterXpChance_too.ch: 成功剪鎖時是否給予力量經驗值的機率. 避免剪鎖成為練力量最快的方法.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterXpChance_too.cn: 成功剪锁时是否给予力量经验值的几率. 避免剪锁成为刷力量最快的方法.

Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterXp_tooltip.en: Strength XP awarded for cutting off a lock somebody else installed. Cutting your own lock never pays.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterXp_tooltip.ch: 剪斷他人安裝的鎖時給予的力量經驗值. 剪斷自己的鎖永遠不給經驗.
Sandbox_Locksmith_BoltCutterXp_tooltip.cn: 剪断他人安装的锁时给予的力量经验值. 剪断自己的锁永远不给经验.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarBaseChance_tool.en: Success chance for a single forcing attempt before the Strength bonus.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarBaseChance_tool.ch: 單次強行開門嘗試的成功率, 未計入力量加成.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarBaseChance_tool.cn: 单次强行开门尝试的成功率, 未计入力量加成.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarBreakLockChance.en: Chance a successful pry wrecks the lock (%%)
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarBreakLockChance.ch: 撬門成功時破壞門鎖的機率 (%%)
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarBreakLockChance.cn: 撬门成功时破坏门锁的几率 (%%)

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarBreakLockChance.en: When a crowbar forces a door open, this is the chance its lock is wrecked in the process. A wrecked lock cannot be locked again until someone repairs it. Set to 0 to leave every forced door lockable.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarBreakLockChance.ch: 用鐵撬強行撬開門時, 門鎖在過程中被破壞的機率. 被破壞的鎖在有人修好之前無法再上鎖. 設為 0 則所有被撬開的門都能再上鎖.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarBreakLockChance.cn: 用撬棍强行撬开门时, 门锁在过程中被破坏的几率. 被破坏的锁在有人修好之前无法再上锁. 设为 0 则所有被撬开的门都能再上锁.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDamageBaseChanc.en: Chance that a single pry marks the door at all, for an unskilled character. Nimble, Strength and Fitness all lower it, with Nimble counting three times as much as either of the others.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDamageBaseChanc.ch: 對毫無技能的角色而言, 單次撬門在門上留下損傷的機率. 靈活, 力量與體格都會降低此機率, 其中靈活的影響是另外兩者的三倍.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDamageBaseChanc.cn: 对毫无技能的角色而言, 单次撬门在门上留下损伤的几率. 灵活, 力量与体格都会降低此几率, 其中灵活的影响是另外两者的三倍.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDamageMaxPercen.en: Damage a marking pry does at zero skill, as a percentage of that door's own maximum health. It falls with Nimble, Strength and Fitness to the floor set by Crowbar door damage. A failed pry does a little over half as much.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDamageMaxPercen.ch: 技能為零時, 一次留下損傷的撬門所造成的傷害, 以該門自身最大耐久的百分比計. 隨靈活, 力量與體格提升而降低, 最低至「鐵撬門損傷」設定的值. 撬門失敗造成的傷害略高於一半.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDamageMaxPercen.cn: 技能为零时, 一次留下损伤的撬门所造成的伤害, 以该门自身最大耐久的百分比计. 随灵活, 力量与体格提升而降低, 最低至“撬棍门损伤”设定的值. 撬门失败造成的伤害略高于一半.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDamageMinChance.en: Floor on the chance that a pry marks the door, reached at maximum Nimble, Strength and Fitness.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDamageMinChance.ch: 撬門在門上留下損傷的機率下限, 在靈活, 力量與體格皆達到最高時達成.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDamageMinChance.cn: 撬门在门上留下损伤的几率下限, 在灵活, 力量与体格均达到最高时达成.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDoorDamagePerce.en: Damage each forcing attempt does to the door, as a percentage of that door's own maximum health. The door is never destroyed: its health always stops at 1.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDoorDamagePerce.ch: 每次強行開門對門造成的傷害, 以該門自身最大耐久的百分比計. 門永遠不會被摧毀: 耐久最低停在 1.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarDoorDamagePerce.cn: 每次强行开门对门造成的伤害, 以该门自身最大耐久的百分比计. 门永远不会被摧毁: 耐久最低停在 1.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarEnduranceCost_t.en: Endurance spent by one forcing attempt, before Fitness and Strength reduce it. Endurance runs from 0 to 1, so 0.03 is three per cent of a full bar. A tired character is also less likely to succeed, but is never stopped from trying.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarEnduranceCost_t.ch: 每次強行開門消耗的耐力, 未計入體格與力量的減免. 耐力範圍為 0 到 1, 因此 0.03 代表滿條的百分之三. 疲累的角色成功率也較低, 但仍然可以嘗試.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarEnduranceCost_t.cn: 每次强行开门消耗的耐力, 未计入体格与力量的减免. 耐力范围为 0 到 1, 因此 0.03 代表满条的百分之三. 疲惫的角色成功率也较低, 但仍然可以尝试.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarFailXp.ch: 撬門失敗的力量經驗值
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarFailXp.cn: 撬门失败的力量经验值

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarFailXpChance.ch: 撬門失敗獲得經驗的機率 (%%)
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarFailXpChance.cn: 撬门失败获得经验的几率 (%%)

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarFailXpChance_to.en: Chance that a failed forcing attempt awards its Strength XP at all.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarFailXpChance_to.ch: 強行開門失敗時是否給予力量經驗值的機率.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarFailXpChance_to.cn: 强行开门失败时是否给予力量经验值的几率.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarFailXp_tooltip.en: Strength XP awarded for a failed forcing attempt.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarFailXp_tooltip.ch: 強行開門失敗時給予的力量經驗值.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarFailXp_tooltip.cn: 强行开门失败时给予的力量经验值.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarMaxChance_toolt.en: Upper cap on the forcing success chance. Deliberately below the bolt cutter cap.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarMaxChance_toolt.ch: 強行開門成功率的上限. 刻意設得比斷線鉗的上限低.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarMaxChance_toolt.cn: 强行开门成功率的上限. 刻意设得比断线钳的上限低.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarPerStrength.ch: 每級力量的鐵撬成功率加成
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarPerStrength.cn: 每级力量的撬棍成功率加成

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarPerStrength_too.en: Added success chance (%%) per level of the Strength perk.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarPerStrength_too.ch: 每級力量技能增加的成功率 (%%).
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarPerStrength_too.cn: 每级力量技能增加的成功率 (%%).

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarRequiresKnowled.en: If on, only a character who has learned to copy building keys may force a door. Off by default -- prying a door open is common sense, not locksmithing.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarRequiresKnowled.ch: 開啟時, 只有學會複製建築鑰匙的角色才能強行開門. 預設關閉——撬開一扇門是常識, 不是鎖匠技術.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarRequiresKnowled.cn: 开启时, 只有学会复制建筑钥匙的角色才能强行开门. 默认关闭——撬开一扇门是常识, 不是锁匠技术.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarVehiclePartDama.en: Condition points a forcing attempt takes off the car door or trunk that was pried, whether or not the lock gives. A part's condition never falls below 1, so forcing can never destroy one outright.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarVehiclePartDama.ch: 每次強行撬開時, 從被撬的車門或後車廂扣除的耐久點數, 無論鎖是否被撬開. 零件耐久永遠不會低於 1, 所以強行撬開永遠不會直接毀掉零件.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarVehiclePartDama.cn: 每次强行撬开时, 从被撬的车门或后备箱扣除的耐久点数, 无论锁是否被撬开. 零件耐久永远不会低于 1, 所以强行撬开永远不会直接毁掉零件.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarWearBaseChance_.en: Chance that one forcing attempt wears the crowbar, at Strength 0. A failed attempt rolls this twice.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarWearBaseChance_.ch: 力量為 0 時, 單次強行開門使鐵撬磨損的機率. 失敗時會判定兩次.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarWearBaseChance_.cn: 力量为 0 时, 单次强行开门使撬棍磨损的几率. 失败时会判定两次.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarWearMaxChance_t.en: Upper cap on the crowbar wear chance.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarWearMinChance_t.en: Floor on the crowbar wear chance.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarWearPerStrength.ch: 每級力量降低的鐵撬磨損機率
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarWearPerStrength.cn: 每级力量降低的撬棍磨损几率

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarWearPerStrength.en: Wear chance (%%) removed per level of the Strength perk.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarWearPerStrength.ch: 每級力量技能降低的磨損機率 (%%).
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarWearPerStrength.cn: 每级力量技能降低的磨损几率 (%%).

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarXpChance_toolti.en: Chance that a successful force awards Strength XP at all.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarXpChance_toolti.ch: 強行開門成功時是否給予力量經驗值的機率.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarXpChance_toolti.cn: 强行开门成功时是否给予力量经验值的几率.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarXp_tooltip.en: Strength XP awarded the first time a character forces a given door.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarXp_tooltip.ch: 角色第一次強行撬開某扇門時給予的力量經驗值.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CrowbarXp_tooltip.cn: 角色第一次强行撬开某扇门时给予的力量经验值.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CutRequiresKnowledge_t.en: Bolt cutting a lock off requires having read the magazine that teaches CopyBuildingKey (or the Burglar profession), the same as lock picking. Off by default -- cutting a lock is a mechanical task, not a locksmithing one.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutRequiresKnowledge_t.ch: 用斷線鉗剪掉鎖需要讀過教授「複製建築鑰匙」的雜誌 (或為竊賊職業), 與撬鎖相同. 預設關閉——剪鎖是機械作業, 不是鎖匠技術.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutRequiresKnowledge_t.cn: 用断线钳剪掉锁需要读过教授“复制建筑钥匙”的杂志 (或为窃贼职业), 与撬锁相同. 默认关闭——剪锁是机械作业, 不是锁匠技术.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyBaseChanc.ch: 配製車鑰匙基礎成功率 (%%)
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyBaseChanc.cn: 配汽车钥匙基础成功率 (%%)

Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyBaseChanc.en: Chance of cutting a working car key from a blank at Nimble 0. A failed cut still uses up the blank and wears the small file set twice over. Set this to 100 to restore the behaviour of earlier versions, where the cut always succeeded.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyBaseChanc.ch: 靈活為 0 時, 用空白鑰匙配製出可用車鑰匙的機率. 失敗仍會用掉空白鑰匙, 並使小型銼刀套裝雙倍磨損. 設為 100 可恢復舊版本的行為, 即每次都必定成功.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyBaseChanc.cn: 灵活为 0 时, 用空白钥匙配出可用汽车钥匙的几率. 失败仍会用掉空白钥匙, 并使小型锉刀套装双倍磨损. 设为 100 可恢复旧版本的行为, 即每次都必定成功.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyMaxChance.ch: 配製車鑰匙最高成功率 (%%)
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyMaxChance.cn: 配汽车钥匙最高成功率 (%%)

Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyMaxChance.en: Upper limit on the car key cutting chance, however high Nimble goes.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyMaxChance.ch: 配製車鑰匙成功率的上限, 無論靈活多高.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyMaxChance.cn: 配汽车钥匙成功率的上限, 无论灵活多高.

Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyPerNimble.en: Car key cutting chance per Nimble level
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyPerNimble.ch: 每級靈活的配製車鑰匙成功率加成
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyPerNimble.cn: 每级灵活的配汽车钥匙成功率加成

Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyPerNimble.en: Success chance added for every level of Nimble. At the default values the cut becomes a certainty at Nimble 4.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyPerNimble.ch: 每級靈活增加的成功率. 在預設值下, 靈活 4 級時必定成功.
Sandbox_Locksmith_CutVehicleKeyPerNimble.cn: 每级灵活增加的成功率. 在默认值下, 灵活 4 级时必定成功.

Sandbox_Locksmith_Enabled_tooltip.en: Master switch. When off, no install/lock/unlock/remove options appear.
Sandbox_Locksmith_Enabled_tooltip.ch: 總開關. 關閉時不會出現任何安裝/上鎖/解鎖/移除選項.
Sandbox_Locksmith_Enabled_tooltip.cn: 总开关. 关闭时不会出现任何安装/上锁/解锁/移除选项.

Sandbox_Locksmith_FileSetDegradeOnUse.en: Small file set degrades on use
Sandbox_Locksmith_FileSetDegradeOnUse.ch: 小型銼刀套裝使用時會磨損
Sandbox_Locksmith_FileSetDegradeOnUse.cn: 小型锉刀套装使用时会磨损

Sandbox_Locksmith_FileSetDegradeOnUse_to.en: The small file set loses condition every time a key is cut with it, and loses more on a failed car key cut. Off stops the file set wearing out at all.
Sandbox_Locksmith_FileSetDegradeOnUse_to.ch: 每次用小型銼刀套裝配製鑰匙都會降低其耐久度, 配製車鑰匙失敗時降低更多. 關閉則銼刀套裝完全不會磨損.
Sandbox_Locksmith_FileSetDegradeOnUse_to.cn: 每次用小型锉刀套装配钥匙都会降低其耐久度, 配汽车钥匙失败时降低更多. 关闭则锉刀套装完全不会磨损.

Sandbox_Locksmith_InstallTimeTicks_toolt.en: How long the install action takes. Lock/unlock/remove use short fixed times.
Sandbox_Locksmith_InstallTimeTicks_toolt.ch: 安裝動作所需的時間. 上鎖/解鎖/移除使用固定的短時間.
Sandbox_Locksmith_InstallTimeTicks_toolt.cn: 安装动作所需的时间. 上锁/解锁/移除使用固定的短时间.

Sandbox_Locksmith_OnlyOwnerCanRemove_too.en: If on, only the player who installed a lock may remove it.
Sandbox_Locksmith_OnlyOwnerCanRemove_too.ch: 開啟時, 只有安裝鎖的玩家才能移除它.
Sandbox_Locksmith_OnlyOwnerCanRemove_too.cn: 开启时, 只有安装锁的玩家才能移除它.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBaseChance_tooltip.en: Success chance for a single pick attempt before the Nimble bonus.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBaseChance_tooltip.ch: 單次撬鎖嘗試的成功率, 未計入靈活加成.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBaseChance_tooltip.cn: 单次撬锁尝试的成功率, 未计入灵活加成.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakBaseChance_to.en: Chance that a failed pick snaps the paperclip, at Nimble 0.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakBaseChance_to.ch: 靈活為 0 時, 撬鎖失敗折斷迴紋針的機率.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakBaseChance_to.cn: 灵活为 0 时, 撬锁失败折断回形针的几率.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakMaxChance_too.en: Upper cap on the chance that a failed pick snaps the paperclip.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakMaxChance_too.ch: 撬鎖失敗折斷迴紋針機率的上限.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakMaxChance_too.cn: 撬锁失败折断回形针几率的上限.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakMinChance_too.en: Floor on the break chance; the Nimble reduction can never take it below this.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakMinChance_too.ch: 折斷機率的下限; 靈活帶來的降低永遠不會讓它低於此值.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakMinChance_too.cn: 折断几率的下限; 灵活带来的降低永远不会让它低于此值.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakPerNimble.ch: 每級靈活降低的迴紋針折斷機率
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakPerNimble.cn: 每级灵活降低的回形针折断几率

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakPerNimble_too.en: Break chance (%%) removed per level of the Nimble perk. A steadier hand ruins fewer paperclips.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakPerNimble_too.ch: 每級靈活技能降低的折斷機率 (%%). 手越穩, 弄壞的迴紋針越少.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickBreakPerNimble_too.cn: 每级灵活技能降低的折断几率 (%%). 手越稳, 弄坏的回形针越少.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamageBaseChance_t.en: Chance that a failed pick wears the screwdriver, at Nimble 0. Always lower than the paperclip break chance.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamageBaseChance_t.ch: 靈活為 0 時, 撬鎖失敗使螺絲起子磨損的機率. 永遠低於迴紋針折斷機率.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamageBaseChance_t.cn: 灵活为 0 时, 撬锁失败使螺丝刀磨损的几率. 永远低于回形针折断几率.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamageMaxChance.ch: 螺絲起子損壞最高機率 (%%)

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamageMaxChance_to.en: Upper cap on the chance that a failed pick wears the screwdriver.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamageMaxChance_to.ch: 撬鎖失敗使螺絲起子磨損機率的上限.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamageMaxChance_to.cn: 撬锁失败使螺丝刀磨损几率的上限.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamageMinChance.ch: 螺絲起子損壞最低機率 (%%)

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamageMinChance_to.en: Floor on the screwdriver damage chance.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamageMinChance_to.ch: 螺絲起子損壞機率的下限.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamageMinChance_to.cn: 螺丝刀损坏几率的下限.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamagePerNimble.ch: 每級靈活降低的螺絲起子損壞機率
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamagePerNimble.cn: 每级灵活降低的螺丝刀损坏几率

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamagePerNimble_to.en: Damage chance (%%) removed per level of the Nimble perk.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamagePerNimble_to.ch: 每級靈活技能降低的損壞機率 (%%).
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickDamagePerNimble_to.cn: 每级灵活技能降低的损坏几率 (%%).

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickFailXp.ch: 撬鎖失敗的靈活經驗值
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickFailXp.cn: 撬锁失败的灵活经验值

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickFailXpChance.ch: 撬鎖失敗獲得經驗的機率 (%%)
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickFailXpChance.cn: 撬锁失败获得经验的几率 (%%)

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickFailXpChance_toolt.en: Chance that a failed pick awards its Nimble XP at all.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickFailXpChance_toolt.ch: 撬鎖失敗時是否給予靈活經驗值的機率.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickFailXpChance_toolt.cn: 撬锁失败时是否给予灵活经验值的几率.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickFailXp_tooltip.en: Nimble XP awarded for a failed pick attempt, the way vanilla pays a little for a botched vehicle part install.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickFailXp_tooltip.ch: 撬鎖失敗時給予的靈活經驗值, 就像原版安裝車輛零件失敗也會給一點經驗一樣.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickFailXp_tooltip.cn: 撬锁失败时给予的灵活经验值, 就像原版安装车辆零件失败也会给一点经验一样.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickMaxChance_tooltip.en: Upper cap on the pick success chance.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickMinTimeTicks_toolt.en: Floor on the pick time; the Nimble reduction can never take an attempt below this.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickMinTimeTicks_toolt.ch: 撬鎖時間的下限; 靈活帶來的時間縮減永遠不會讓單次嘗試低於此值.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickMinTimeTicks_toolt.cn: 撬锁时间的下限; 灵活带来的时间缩减永远不会让单次尝试低于此值.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickPerNimble.ch: 每級靈活的撬鎖成功率加成
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickPerNimble.cn: 每级灵活的撬锁成功率加成

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickPerNimble_tooltip.en: Added success chance (%%) per level of the Nimble perk.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickPerNimble_tooltip.ch: 每級靈活技能增加的成功率 (%%).
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickPerNimble_tooltip.cn: 每级灵活技能增加的成功率 (%%).

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickRequiresKnowledge_.en: If on, only a character who has learned to copy building keys may pick a lock.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickRequiresKnowledge_.ch: 開啟時, 只有學會複製建築鑰匙的角色才能撬鎖.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickRequiresKnowledge_.cn: 开启时, 只有学会复制建筑钥匙的角色才能撬锁.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickTimePerNimble.ch: 每級靈活縮短的撬鎖時間
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickTimePerNimble.cn: 每级灵活缩短的撬锁时间

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickTimePerNimble_tool.en: Ticks removed from the pick time for each level of the Nimble perk.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickTimePerNimble_tool.ch: 每級靈活技能從撬鎖時間中扣除的 tick 數.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickTimePerNimble_tool.cn: 每级灵活技能从撬锁时间中扣除的 tick 数.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickTimeTicks_tooltip.en: How long a single pick attempt takes before the Nimble reduction.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickTimeTicks_tooltip.ch: 單次撬鎖嘗試所需的時間, 未計入靈活縮減.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickTimeTicks_tooltip.cn: 单次撬锁尝试所需的时间, 未计入灵活缩减.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickXpChance_tooltip.en: Chance that a first successful pick awards Nimble XP at all. Re-picking a door you have already opened never pays.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickXpChance_tooltip.ch: 首次撬鎖成功時是否給予靈活經驗值的機率. 重新撬開已經開過的門永遠不給經驗.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickXpChance_tooltip.cn: 首次撬锁成功时是否给予灵活经验值的几率. 重新撬开已经开过的门永远不给经验.

Sandbox_Locksmith_PickXp_tooltip.en: Nimble XP awarded the first time a character picks a given door.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickXp_tooltip.ch: 角色第一次撬開某扇門時給予的靈活經驗值.
Sandbox_Locksmith_PickXp_tooltip.cn: 角色第一次撬开某扇门时给予的灵活经验值.

Sandbox_Locksmith_RefundLockOnRemove_too.en: If on, removing a gate lock returns a Gate Lock item to the player.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RefundLockOnRemove_too.ch: 開啟時, 移除柵門鎖會將一個「柵門鎖」物品退還給玩家.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RefundLockOnRemove_too.cn: 开启时, 移除栅门锁会将一个“栅门锁”物品返还给玩家.

Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockBaseChance.ch: 靈活 0 級時的修鎖機率 (%%)
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockBaseChance.cn: 灵活 0 级时的修锁几率 (%%)

Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockBaseChance_t.en: The chance of seating a replacement cylinder with no Nimble at all. Every attempt uses up the parts, win or lose.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockBaseChance_t.ch: 完全沒有靈活時裝上替換鎖芯的機率. 每次嘗試無論成敗都會用掉零件.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockBaseChance_t.cn: 完全没有灵活时装上替换锁芯的几率. 每次尝试无论成败都会用掉零件.

Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockMaxChance_to.en: The ceiling the repair chance can reach however high Nimble climbs.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockMaxChance_to.ch: 無論靈活多高, 修鎖機率所能達到的上限.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockMaxChance_to.cn: 无论灵活多高, 修锁几率所能达到的上限.

Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockPerNimble.en: Lock repair chance gained per Nimble level (%%)
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockPerNimble.ch: 每級靈活增加的修鎖機率 (%%)
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockPerNimble.cn: 每级灵活增加的修锁几率 (%%)

Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockPerNimble_to.en: Added to the base chance for each level of Nimble. At the defaults a repair is certain from Nimble 4 upward.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockPerNimble_to.ch: 每級靈活加到基礎機率上的數值. 在預設值下, 靈活 4 級以上修鎖必定成功.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairLockPerNimble_to.cn: 每级灵活加到基础几率上的数值. 在默认值下, 灵活 4 级以上修锁必定成功.

Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairRequiresKnowledg.en: Repairing a lock requires knowing how
Requires the Burglar profession or reading The Cheapskate's John Spiral - Escaping Captivity before a broken lock can be repaired. Turn this off to let anyone with the parts do it.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairRequiresKnowledg.ch: 需要竊賊職業或讀過《吝嗇鬼》中的約翰·斯派拉爾 - 逃脫囚禁, 才能修理損壞的鎖. 關閉此選項則任何擁有零件的人都能修理.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepairRequiresKnowledg.cn: 需要窃贼职业或读过《吝啬鬼》中的约翰·斯派拉尔 - 逃脱囚禁, 才能修理损坏的锁. 关闭此选项则任何拥有零件的人都能修理.

Sandbox_Locksmith_RepinRequiresKnowledge.ch: 重新配鎖需要相關知識
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepinRequiresKnowledge.cn: 重新配锁需要相关知识

Sandbox_Locksmith_RepinRequiresKnowledge.en: If on, re-pinning a lock to another key, cutting a fresh key for a door you built, and cutting the blank that arms a padlock all require having read the key-cutting magazine or being a Burglar. If off, none of them do.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepinRequiresKnowledge.ch: 開啟時, 重新配鎖以對應另一把鑰匙, 為自己建造的門配製一把新鑰匙, 以及加工用來啟用鎖頭的空白鑰匙, 都需要讀過配製鑰匙的雜誌或身為竊賊. 關閉時則都不需要.
Sandbox_Locksmith_RepinRequiresKnowledge.cn: 开启时, 重新配锁以对应另一把钥匙, 为自己建造的门配一把新钥匙, 以及加工用来启用挂锁的空白钥匙, 都需要读过配钥匙的杂志或身为窃贼. 关闭时则都不需要.

Sandbox_Locksmith_RequireScrewdriver_too.en: Design hook for requiring a screwdriver to install/remove a lock (not yet enforced).
Sandbox_Locksmith_RequireScrewdriver_too.ch: 設計預留: 安裝/移除鎖時需要螺絲起子 (尚未實裝).
Sandbox_Locksmith_RequireScrewdriver_too.cn: 设计预留: 安装/移除锁时需要螺丝刀 (尚未生效).

Sandbox_Locksmith_SecurityDoorDifficulty.en: How much harder a security door is than an ordinary one. The chance to pick it, the chance to pry it and the damage a pry does are all divided by this number, so 2.5 means about two and a half times the work. The lowest setting, 1.0, makes a security door no harder than any other door.
Sandbox_Locksmith_SecurityDoorDifficulty.ch: 安全門比一般門困難多少. 撬鎖機率, 撬門機率以及撬門造成的傷害都會除以此數值, 所以 2.5 代表大約兩倍半的工夫. 最低設定 1.0 時, 安全門不會比其他門更難.
Sandbox_Locksmith_SecurityDoorDifficulty.cn: 防盗门比普通门困难多少. 撬锁几率, 撬门几率以及撬门造成的伤害都会除以此数值, 所以 2.5 代表大约两倍半的工夫. 最低设置 1.0 时, 防盗门不会比其他门更难.

Sandbox_Locksmith_SecurityDoorsIndestruc.en: If on, a security door's health always stops at 1 and force can never break it open, even where doors can be destroyed everywhere else. Prime loot then sits behind a lock that has to be defeated rather than a frame that can be smashed.
Sandbox_Locksmith_SecurityDoorsIndestruc.ch: 開啟時, 安全門的耐久最低停在 1, 蠻力永遠無法將其破開, 即使其他地方的門都能被摧毀. 這樣頂級物資就會被一道必須破解的鎖守住, 而不是一個砸得爛的門框.
Sandbox_Locksmith_SecurityDoorsIndestruc.cn: 开启时, 防盗门的耐久最低停在 1, 蛮力永远无法将其破开, 即使其他地方的门都能被摧毁. 这样顶级物资就会被一道必须破解的锁守住, 而不是一个砸得烂的门框.

Sandbox_Locksmith_XpLatchPerObject_toolt.en: If on, once a player has successfully picked or cut a given lock, no further pick or cut attempt on it pays that player XP again, win or lose. If off, XP pays every time as before.
Sandbox_Locksmith_XpLatchPerObject_toolt.ch: 開啟時, 玩家一旦成功撬開或剪斷某個鎖, 之後對該鎖的撬鎖或剪鎖嘗試無論成敗, 都不再給該玩家經驗值. 關閉時則如以往每次都給經驗值.
Sandbox_Locksmith_XpLatchPerObject_toolt.cn: 开启时, 玩家一旦成功撬开或剪断某个锁, 之后对该锁的撬锁或剪锁尝试无论成败, 都不再给该玩家经验值. 关闭时则如以往每次都给经验值.

Sandbox_RNPC_AimOthers.en: NPC accuracy against zombies and NPCs

Sandbox_RNPC_AimOthers_tooltip.en: Percent of their usual chance to hit walkers and each other with a gun.
Sandbox_RNPC_AimOthers_tooltip.ch: NPC用槍命中行屍與彼此的機率, 以其一般機率的百分比表示.
Sandbox_RNPC_AimOthers_tooltip.cn: NPC用枪命中行尸和彼此的几率, 以其正常几率的百分比表示.

Sandbox_RNPC_AimPlayers_tooltip.en: Percent of their usual chance to hit you with a gun. 100 is normal, 0 never hits.
Sandbox_RNPC_AimPlayers_tooltip.ch: NPC用槍命中你的機率, 以其一般機率的百分比表示. 100為正常, 0為永不命中.
Sandbox_RNPC_AimPlayers_tooltip.cn: NPC用枪命中你的几率, 以其正常几率的百分比表示. 100为正常, 0为永不命中.

Sandbox_RNPC_BaseRaids_tooltip.en: Off by default. A faction that hates you and has found your base may raid it.
Sandbox_RNPC_BaseRaids_tooltip.ch: 預設關閉. 痛恨你且已找到你基地的派系可能會襲擊它.
Sandbox_RNPC_BaseRaids_tooltip.cn: 默认关闭. 痛恨你且已找到你基地的派系可能会袭击它.

Sandbox_RNPC_FactionMemory_tooltip.en: Deaths, raids and betrayals are remembered, talked about and acted on.
Sandbox_RNPC_FactionMemory_tooltip.ch: 死亡、襲擊與背叛都會被記住、談論, 並付諸行動.
Sandbox_RNPC_FactionMemory_tooltip.cn: 死亡、袭击和背叛都会被记住、谈论, 并付诸行动.

Sandbox_RNPC_FactionQuests_tooltip.en: What factions ask of players. Expanded adds jobs that come from what happened to them.
Sandbox_RNPC_FactionQuests_tooltip.ch: 派系向玩家提出的委託. 擴充會加入源自他們遭遇事件的工作.
Sandbox_RNPC_FactionQuests_tooltip.cn: 派系向玩家提出的委托. 扩展会加入源自他们遭遇事件的任务.

Sandbox_RNPC_JoinFactions_tooltip.en: A faction you stand high with offers to take you in. Members share its friends and enemies.
Sandbox_RNPC_JoinFactions_tooltip.ch: 對你評價很高的派系會邀請你加入. 成員共享該派系的盟友與敵人.
Sandbox_RNPC_JoinFactions_tooltip.cn: 对你评价很高的派系会邀请你加入. 成员共享该派系的盟友和敌人.

Sandbox_RNPC_NPCInfection_tooltip.en: A bitten NPC may sicken and rise as a walker in their own clothes.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCInfection_tooltip.ch: 被咬的NPC可能會發病, 並穿著自己的衣服變成行屍.
Sandbox_RNPC_NPCInfection_tooltip.cn: 被咬的NPC可能会发病, 并穿着自己的衣服变成行尸.

Sandbox_RNPC_Raids_tooltip.en: Factions at war rob each other's bases. Often is twice as many.
Sandbox_RNPC_Raids_tooltip.ch: 交戰中的派系會搶劫彼此的基地. 「經常」為兩倍次數.
Sandbox_RNPC_Raids_tooltip.cn: 交战中的派系会抢劫彼此的基地. “经常”为两倍次数.

Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitMeals_tooltip.en: Once a day each recruit eats from a container you marked Food, or goes hungry.
Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitMeals_tooltip.ch: 每位隊員每天會從你標記為食物的容器中進食一次, 否則就會挨餓.
Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitMeals_tooltip.cn: 每名队员每天会从你标记为食物的容器中进食一次, 否则就会挨饿.

Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitOrders_tooltip.en: Tell a recruit to wait, guard a spot or patrol round it. Off: they only follow you.
Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitOrders_tooltip.ch: 命令隊員等待、守衛某處或在其周圍巡邏. 關閉: 他們只會跟隨你.
Sandbox_RNPC_RecruitOrders_tooltip.cn: 命令队员等待、守卫某处或在其周围巡逻. 关闭: 他们只会跟随你.

Sandbox_RNPC_SeatFires_tooltip.en: Faction seats light a campfire at night and keep someone by it.
Sandbox_RNPC_SeatFires_tooltip.ch: 派系據點會在夜間點燃營火, 並留人在旁看守.
Sandbox_RNPC_SeatFires_tooltip.cn: 派系据点会在夜间点燃营火, 并留人在旁看守.

Sandbox_RNPC_StandingFade_tooltip.en: How fast your standing with a faction drifts back to where it started. Percent: 100 is normal, 0 never fades.
Sandbox_RNPC_StandingFade_tooltip.ch: 你在派系中的聲望回到初始值的速度. 百分比: 100為正常, 0為永不回歸.
Sandbox_RNPC_StandingFade_tooltip.cn: 你在派系中的声望回到初始值的速度. 百分比: 100为正常, 0为永不回归.

Sandbox_RNPC_Stops_tooltip.en: Raiders demand payment before shooting. Checkpoints check you over.
Sandbox_RNPC_Stops_tooltip.ch: 掠奪者會在開槍前要求付錢. 檢查哨會對你進行搜查.
Sandbox_RNPC_Stops_tooltip.cn: 掠夺者会在开枪前要求付钱. 检查站会对你进行搜查.

Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextColor_tooltip.en: Color of the [RNPC] line at the top of the screen.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextColor_tooltip.ch: 螢幕頂部 [RNPC] 文字的顏色.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextColor_tooltip.cn: 屏幕顶部 [RNPC] 文字的颜色.

Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextOpacity_tooltip.en: Percent. 100 is solid; lower lets the game show through.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextOpacity_tooltip.ch: 百分比. 100為完全不透明; 數值越低越能看見後方的遊戲畫面.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextOpacity_tooltip.cn: 百分比. 100为完全不透明; 数值越低越能看见后方的游戏画面.

Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextSize_tooltip.en: The [RNPC] line at the top of the screen, in solo or with no chat box.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextSize_tooltip.ch: 單人遊玩或沒有聊天框時, 顯示在螢幕頂部的 [RNPC] 文字.
Sandbox_RNPC_TopTextSize_tooltip.cn: 单人游玩或没有聊天框时, 显示在屏幕顶部的 [RNPC] 文字.

Sandbox_RNPC_WipeoutDays.en: Days before a wiped-out faction regroups
Sandbox_RNPC_WipeoutDays.ch: 被消滅的派系重新集結前的天數
Sandbox_RNPC_WipeoutDays.cn: 被消灭的派系重新集结前的天数

Sandbox_RNPC_WipeoutDays_tooltip.ch: 遊戲內天數. 預設30. 僅限暫時.
Sandbox_RNPC_WipeoutDays_tooltip.cn: 游戏内天数. 默认30. 仅限临时.

Sandbox_RNPC_Wipeouts_tooltip.en: Rare: it takes days of losses. Temporary: they may regroup later.
Sandbox_RNPC_Wipeouts_tooltip.ch: 罕見: 需要連續數天的損失. 暫時: 他們之後可能重新集結.
Sandbox_RNPC_Wipeouts_tooltip.cn: 罕见: 需要连续数天的损失. 临时: 他们之后可能重新集结.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.CaravanAccidentDe.en: Chance per abstract trader/caravan member every two in-game hours. Set to 0 to disable accidental deaths for caravans.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.CaravanAccidentDe.ch: 每兩個遊戲小時, 每名抽象商人/商隊成員的機率. 設為0可停用商隊的意外死亡.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.CaravanAccidentDe.cn: 每两个游戏小时, 每名抽象商人/商队成员的几率. 设为0可禁用商队的意外死亡.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ComponentDeconstr.en: Percentage of a component's Base.Money ingredients returned to colony storage when the component is deconstructed.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ComponentDeconstr.ch: 拆除元件時, 該元件 Base.Money 材料退還至聚落倉庫的百分比.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ComponentDeconstr.cn: 拆除组件时, 该组件 Base.Money 材料返还至聚落仓库的百分比.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ConstructionCance.en: Multiplies the proportional materials returned when unfinished construction is cancelled. 1.0 returns the full remaining fraction; 0 returns nothing.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ConstructionCance.ch: 調整取消未完成建造時按比例退還材料的倍率. 1.0退還全部剩餘比例; 0則不退還.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ConstructionCance.cn: 调整取消未完成建造时按比例返还材料的倍率. 1.0返还全部剩余比例; 0则不返还.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.EnableWeaponDamag.en: Uses each NPC's equipped weapon damage and combat skill. Disable to use legacy combat-profile damage values.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.EnableWeaponDamag.ch: 使用每名NPC裝備武器的傷害與戰鬥技能. 停用則使用舊版戰鬥設定檔的傷害值.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.EnableWeaponDamag.cn: 使用每名NPC装备武器的伤害和战斗技能. 禁用则使用旧版战斗配置的伤害值.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.LooterAccidentDea.en: Chance per abstract looter member every two in-game hours. Set to 0 to disable accidental deaths for looters.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.LooterAccidentDea.ch: 每兩個遊戲小時, 每名抽象拾荒者成員的機率. 設為0可停用拾荒者的意外死亡.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.LooterAccidentDea.cn: 每两个游戏小时, 每名抽象拾荒者成员的几率. 设为0可禁用拾荒者的意外死亡.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MobileSettlementA.en: Chance per eligible mobile-group member to join an AI-owned settlement on arrival. Colony population capacity still applies.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MobileSettlementA.ch: 流動團體中每名符合條件的成員抵達時加入AI聚落的機率. 仍受聚落人口上限限制.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MobileSettlementA.cn: 流动团体中每名符合条件的成员抵达时加入AI聚落的几率. 仍受聚落人口上限限制.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MultiplayerPopula.en: Adjusts diminishing population growth from player count and the number of distinct active sectors.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MultiplayerPopula.ch: 依玩家人數與不同活躍區域數量調整遞減的人口成長.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.MultiplayerPopula.cn: 根据玩家人数和不同活跃区域数量调整递减的人口增长.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCAmmoConsumptio.en: Requires ranged PNC NPCs to carry the firearm's ammunition in their virtual inventory and consumes one round per resolved shot.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCAmmoConsumptio.ch: 要求遠程PNC NPC在虛擬物品欄中攜帶槍械彈藥, 每次結算射擊消耗一發.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCAmmoConsumptio.cn: 要求远程PNC NPC在虚拟物品栏中携带枪械弹药, 每次结算射击消耗一发.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCDamageDealtMul.en: Scales weapon-based damage dealt by PNC NPCs. 1.0 is normal and 0 prevents weapon-based damage.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCDamageDealtMul.ch: 縮放PNC NPC造成的武器傷害. 1.0為正常, 0則不造成武器傷害.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCDamageDealtMul.cn: 缩放PNC NPC造成的武器伤害. 1.0为正常, 0则不造成武器伤害.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCInfectionMorta.ch: NPC感染致死時間 (遊戲小時)
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCInfectionMorta.cn: NPC感染致死时间 (游戏小时)

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCInfectionMorta.en: In-game hours from infection to terminal fever and death. Health declines during the later stages.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCInfectionMorta.ch: 從感染到末期發燒與死亡的遊戲內小時數. 健康會在後期階段下降.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCInfectionMorta.cn: 从感染到末期发烧和死亡的游戏内小时数. 健康会在后期阶段下降.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCMeleeWeaponSpa.en: Independent identity-seeded chance that a generated NPC receives a melee weapon. Melee and ranged rolls can both succeed.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCMeleeWeaponSpa.ch: 生成的NPC獲得近戰武器的獨立機率, 以身分作為種子. 近戰與遠程判定可同時成功.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCMeleeWeaponSpa.cn: 生成的NPC获得近战武器的独立几率, 以身份作为种子. 近战和远程判定可同时成功.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPlayerWounds_t.en: Allows PNC NPC attacks to cause pain, scratches, and bleeding on players in addition to overall health loss.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPlayerWounds_t.ch: 允許PNC NPC的攻擊除了降低整體健康外, 也會對玩家造成疼痛、抓傷與流血.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPlayerWounds_t.cn: 允许PNC NPC的攻击除了降低整体健康外, 也会对玩家造成疼痛、抓伤和流血.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPopulation_too.en: Controls automatic survivor population targets. Lowering this never deletes existing persistent survivors.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPopulation_too.ch: 控制自動倖存者人口目標. 調低此值不會刪除既有的永久倖存者.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCPopulation_too.cn: 控制自动幸存者人口目标. 调低此值不会删除现有的永久幸存者.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCRangedWeaponSp.en: Independent identity-seeded chance that a generated NPC receives a firearm and matching ammunition. Melee and ranged rolls can both succeed.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCRangedWeaponSp.ch: 生成的NPC獲得槍械與相符彈藥的獨立機率, 以身分作為種子. 近戰與遠程判定可同時成功.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCRangedWeaponSp.cn: 生成的NPC获得枪械和匹配弹药的独立几率, 以身份作为种子. 近战和远程判定可同时成功.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCReanimationSec.en: Real-time seconds between infection death and vanilla corpse reanimation.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCReanimationSec.ch: 從感染死亡到原版屍體復活之間的現實秒數.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCReanimationSec.cn: 从感染死亡到原版尸体复活之间的现实秒数.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCSupplyTransact.en: Writes one structured line for each Needs supply operation. Leave disabled during normal play for near-zero logging overhead.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCSupplyTransact.ch: 每次需求物資操作都寫入一行結構化記錄. 一般遊玩時保持停用, 記錄開銷趨近於零.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCSupplyTransact.cn: 每次需求物资操作都写入一行结构化日志. 正常游玩时保持禁用, 日志开销趋近于零.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCWeaponConditio.en: Allows equipped PNC NPC weapons to lose virtual condition when attacks hit.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCWeaponConditio.ch: 允許PNC NPC裝備的武器在攻擊命中時損失虛擬耐久度.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCWeaponConditio.cn: 允许PNC NPC装备的武器在攻击命中时损失虚拟耐久度.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieBiteChan.ch: NPC每次受傷為咬傷的機率 (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieBiteChan.cn: NPC每次受伤为咬伤的几率 (%%)

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieBiteChan.en: Chance that a successful zombie wound is a bite.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieBiteChan.ch: 殭屍成功造成的傷口為咬傷的機率.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieBiteChan.cn: 僵尸成功造成的伤口为咬伤的几率.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.en: Global multiplier for the clothing protection roll after item defense and condition are combined.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.ch: 在合併物品防禦與耐久度後, 衣物防護判定的全域倍率.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.cn: 在合并物品防御和耐久度后, 衣物防护判定的全局倍率.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.ch: NPC衣物抵擋殭屍耐久度指數
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.cn: NPC衣物抵挡僵尸耐久度指数

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.en: Controls how clothing condition reduces bite and scratch defense. Higher values make worn clothing degrade protection faster.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.ch: 控制衣物耐久度如何降低咬傷與抓傷防禦. 數值越高, 磨損衣物的防護降低越快.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.cn: 控制衣物耐久度如何降低咬伤和抓伤防御. 数值越高, 磨损衣物的防护降低越快.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.en: NPC Zombie Clothing Laceration Downgrade Threshold (%%)
Protection required for a penetrating bite or laceration to drop one wound severity step.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.ch: 穿透性咬傷或撕裂傷降低一級傷口嚴重度所需的防護.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.cn: 穿透性咬伤或撕裂伤降低一级伤口严重度所需的防护.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.en: NPC Zombie Clothing Scratch Downgrade Threshold (%%)
Protection required for a penetrating bite or laceration to become a scratch.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.ch: 穿透性咬傷或撕裂傷降為抓傷所需的防護.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.cn: 穿透性咬伤或撕裂伤降为抓伤所需的防护.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.en: NPC Zombie Clothing Penetrating Durability Loss
Item condition points lost when clothing fails and a wound penetrates.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.ch: 衣物防護失敗且傷口穿透時損失的物品耐久度.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.cn: 衣物防护失败且伤口穿透时损失的物品耐久度.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.en: NPC Zombie Clothing Safe Durability Loss
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.ch: NPC衣物安全抵擋耐久損耗
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.cn: NPC衣物安全抵挡耐久损耗

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.en: Item condition points lost when clothing successfully blocks a zombie attack.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.ch: 衣物成功抵擋殭屍攻擊時損失的物品耐久度.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieClothing.cn: 衣物成功抵挡僵尸攻击时损失的物品耐久度.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageBa.en: Low-stamina damage chance before crowd pressure. The default 0 preserves one-zombie equals 0 percent crowd contribution.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageBa.ch: 計入群聚壓力前的低耐力傷害機率. 預設0可維持單隻殭屍等於百分之0的群聚貢獻.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageBa.cn: 计入群聚压力前的低耐力伤害几率. 默认0可维持单只僵尸等于百分之0的群聚贡献.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.en: Maximum crowd contribution before stamina and skill mitigation.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.ch: 在體力與技能減免前的最大群聚貢獻.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.cn: 在体力和技能减免前的最大群聚贡献.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.en: NPC Zombie Crowd Chance per Extra Zombie (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.ch: NPC每多一隻殭屍的群聚機率 (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.cn: NPC每多一只僵尸的群聚几率 (%%)

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.en: Added damage chance for each zombie after the first inside the hit zone. The default produces 0, 5, and 10 percent for one, two, and three zombies.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.ch: 命中範圍內第一隻之後每多一隻殭屍增加的傷害機率. 預設值在一、二、三隻殭屍時分別為百分之0、5、10.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.cn: 命中范围内第一只之后每多一只僵尸增加的伤害几率. 默认值在一、二、三只僵尸时分别为百分之0、5、10.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.en: Additional quadratic crowd pressure after the third zombie. Set to 0 for a purely linear sequence.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.ch: 第三隻殭屍之後額外的二次方群聚壓力. 設為0則為純線性數列.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageCr.cn: 第三只僵尸之后额外的二次方群聚压力. 设为0则为纯线性数列.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageFi.en: Additional damage-roll mitigation across Fitness levels 0 through 10.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageFi.ch: 體格等級0至10之間額外的傷害判定減免.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageFi.cn: 体格等级0至10之间额外的伤害判定减免.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageHi.en: Same-floor radius used to count living zombies for the damage roll.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageHi.ch: 同樓層內用於計算存活殭屍數量以進行傷害判定的半徑.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageHi.cn: 同楼层内用于计算存活僵尸数量以进行伤害判定的半径.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMa.en: Upper cap on Fitness and defensive-skill mitigation.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMa.ch: 體格與防禦技能減免的上限.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMa.cn: 体格和防御技能减免的上限.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMi.ch: 體格0時的傷害判定減免.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMi.cn: 体格0时的伤害判定减免.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMo.ch: 受體力限制的NPC殭屍傷害
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMo.cn: 受体力限制的NPC僵尸伤害

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMo.en: Uses stamina immunity, crowd pressure, Fitness mitigation, clothing durability, and wound downgrading for zombie attacks on NPCs.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMo.ch: 殭屍攻擊NPC時套用體力免疫、群聚壓力、體格減免、衣物耐久度與傷口降級.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageMo.cn: 僵尸攻击NPC时使用体力免疫、群聚压力、体格减免、衣物耐久度和伤口降级.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageSt.en: NPCs above this stamina ratio cannot take zombie damage through the new resolver. Set to 1 for full-stamina-only immunity or 0 to disable the gate.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageSt.ch: 體力比例高於此值的NPC不會透過新判定機制受到殭屍傷害. 設為1則僅體力全滿時免疫, 設為0則停用此限制.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieDamageSt.cn: 体力比例高于此值的NPC不会通过新判定机制受到僵尸伤害. 设为1则仅体力全满时免疫, 设为0则禁用此限制.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieInfectio.en: Chance that an NPC bite becomes Knox infected. Set to 0 to disable infection without changing zombie attacks or bite wounds. Infected NPCs develop fever, lose health, die, and reanimate.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieInfectio.ch: NPC咬傷變成諾克斯感染的機率. 設為0可停用感染, 但不改變殭屍攻擊或咬傷. 受感染的NPC會發燒、失去健康、死亡並屍變.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieInfectio.cn: NPC咬伤变成诺克斯感染的几率. 设为0可禁用感染, 但不改变僵尸攻击或咬伤. 受感染的NPC会发烧、失去健康、死亡并尸变.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieLacerati.ch: NPC每次受傷為撕裂傷的機率 (%%)
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieLacerati.cn: NPC每次受伤为撕裂伤的几率 (%%)

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieLacerati.en: Chance that a successful non-bite result becomes a laceration; remaining wounds are scratches.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieLacerati.ch: 成功的非咬傷結果變成撕裂傷的機率; 其餘傷口為抓傷.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieLacerati.cn: 成功的非咬伤结果变成撕裂伤的几率; 其余伤口为抓伤.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieWoundCha.en: Base chance that a zombie lunge creates a wound. Armor on the struck body part reduces the final chance; failed rolls are parried.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieWoundCha.ch: 殭屍撲擊造成傷口的基礎機率. 被擊中部位的護甲會降低最終機率; 判定失敗則為格擋.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.NPCZombieWoundCha.cn: 僵尸扑击造成伤口的基础几率. 被击中部位的护甲会降低最终几率; 判定失败则为格挡.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PlayerOwnedNPCNee.en: When enabled, prolonged full hunger or thirst ailments can eventually kill player-owned NPCs. Enabled by default; disable to preserve a safe health floor.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PlayerOwnedNPCNee.ch: 啟用時, 長期極度飢餓或口渴的病症最終可能導致玩家擁有的NPC死亡. 預設啟用; 停用可保留安全的健康下限.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PlayerOwnedNPCNee.cn: 启用时, 长期极度饥饿或口渴的病症最终可能导致玩家拥有的NPC死亡. 默认启用; 禁用可保留安全的健康下限.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PlayerOwnedNPCNut.en: Simple uses hunger and thirst only. Realism also simulates player-style calories, carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, weight, and activity-based metabolism.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PlayerOwnedNPCNut.ch: 簡單僅使用飢餓與口渴. 擬真另會模擬與玩家相同的卡路里、碳水化合物、蛋白質、脂質、體重, 以及依活動量計算的代謝.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PlayerOwnedNPCNut.cn: 简单仅使用饥饿和口渴. 真实还会模拟与玩家相同的卡路里、碳水化合物、蛋白质、脂类、体重, 以及基于活动量的代谢.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PopulationGenerat.en: Controls the server-side exclusion and preferred generation bands around connected players.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PopulationGenerat.ch: 控制已連線玩家周圍伺服器端的排除範圍與優先生成範圍.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PopulationGenerat.cn: 控制已连接玩家周围服务器端的排除范围和优先生成范围.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PopulationRegener.en: Controls how quickly lost roaming groups may recover after their cooldown.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PopulationRegener.ch: 控制失去的流浪團體在冷卻後恢復的速度.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.PopulationRegener.cn: 控制失去的流浪团体在冷却后恢复的速度.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioAmbientChanc.en: Chance that an eligible ambient-radio trigger produces background chatter. It is not guaranteed every interval.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioAmbientChanc.ch: 符合條件的環境無線電觸發產生背景對話的機率. 不保證每個間隔都會發生.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioAmbientChanc.cn: 符合条件的环境无线电触发产生背景对话的几率. 不保证每个间隔都会发生.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioAmbientEnabl.en: Allows harmless background chatter on the frequency without changing discovery or knowledge.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioAmbientEnabl.ch: 允許該頻率播放無害的背景閒聊, 不會改變發現進度或已知情報.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioAmbientEnabl.cn: 允许该频率播放无害的背景闲聊, 不会改变发现进度或已知情报.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioAmbientInter.en: Minimum real-time interval before a tuned radio may request another ambient transmission.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioAmbientInter.ch: 已調頻的無線電再次請求環境廣播前的最短現實時間間隔.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioAmbientInter.cn: 已调频的无线电再次请求环境广播前的最短现实时间间隔.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoveryCoo.en: Minimum in-game minutes between accepted radio scan attempts, including scans that find no usable signal.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoveryCoo.ch: 兩次有效無線電掃描之間的最短遊戲內分鐘數, 包括未找到可用訊號的掃描.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoveryCoo.cn: 两次有效无线电扫描之间的最短游戏内分钟数, 包括未找到可用信号的扫描.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoveryEna.en: Allows tuned radios to discover survivor settlements and mobile groups.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoveryEna.ch: 允許已調頻的無線電發現倖存者聚落與流動團體.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoveryEna.cn: 允许已调频的无线电发现幸存者聚落与流动团体.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoveryLin.en: Real-time spacing between spoken lines in one radio transmission. Higher values reduce overlapping broadcasts.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoveryLin.ch: 同一段無線電廣播中各句台詞之間的現實時間間隔. 數值越高, 廣播越不容易重疊.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoveryLin.cn: 同一段无线电广播中各句台词之间的现实时间间隔. 数值越高, 广播越不容易重叠.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoverySig.en: Chance that a valid scan resolves a nearby undiscovered signal after the cooldown is satisfied.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoverySig.ch: 冷卻結束後, 有效掃描找出附近未發現訊號的機率.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RadioDiscoverySig.cn: 冷却结束后, 有效扫描找出附近未发现信号的几率.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RefugeeAccidentDe.en: Chance per abstract refugee member every two in-game hours. Set to 0 to disable accidental deaths for refugees.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RefugeeAccidentDe.ch: 每名抽象難民成員每兩個遊戲小時的機率. 設為 0 可停用難民的意外死亡.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RefugeeAccidentDe.cn: 每名抽象难民成员每两个游戏小时的几率. 设为 0 可禁用难民的意外死亡.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RoamingGroupDensi.en: Controls future roaming abstract survivor-group targets.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RoamingGroupDensi.ch: 控制之後抽象倖存者流浪團體的目標數量.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.RoamingGroupDensi.cn: 控制之后抽象幸存者流浪团体的目标数量.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.SettlementDensity.en: Controls future faction settlement targets around relevant explored sectors.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.SettlementDensity.ch: 控制之後在相關已探索區域周圍的陣營聚落目標數量.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.SettlementDensity.cn: 控制之后在相关已探索区域周围的阵营聚落目标数量.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.SettlementRegener.en: Controls slow replacement of destroyed settlements. Destroyed sites retain a longer cooldown.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.SettlementRegener.ch: 控制被摧毀聚落的緩慢替補. 被摧毀的地點會保有較長的冷卻時間.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.SettlementRegener.cn: 控制被摧毁聚落的缓慢补充. 被摧毁的地点会保留较长的冷却时间.

Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ZombiesTargetDown.en: When enabled, zombies may continue targeting and deliver a final blow to incapacitated NPCs. When disabled, zombies release downed NPCs so players may revive them.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ZombiesTargetDown.ch: 啟用時, 殭屍可能會持續鎖定失去行動能力的 NPC 並給予致命一擊. 停用時, 殭屍會放過倒地的 NPC, 讓玩家可以救起他們.
Sandbox_ProjectHoomans.ZombiesTargetDown.cn: 启用时, 僵尸可能会持续锁定失去行动能力的 NPC 并给予致命一击. 禁用时, 僵尸会放过倒地的 NPC, 让玩家可以救起他们.

Sandbox_MultiplierConfig_Swimming_toolti.en: XP multiplier of the Swimming skill (True Swimming), used when the global XP multiplier is disabled.
Sandbox_MultiplierConfig_Swimming_toolti.ch: 游泳技能 (真實游泳) 的經驗倍率, 在停用全域經驗倍率時使用.
Sandbox_MultiplierConfig_Swimming_toolti.cn: 游泳技能 (真实游泳) 的经验倍率, 在关闭全局经验倍率时使用.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoBottomless_tool.en: Which profiles may keep the Infinite ammunition tick. Creator profiles only keeps it for profiles you made or edited; the shipped roster then runs dry like everyone else.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoBottomless_tool.ch: 哪些設定檔可以保留「無限彈藥」勾選. 「僅限編輯器設定檔」只對你建立或編輯過的設定檔保留; 內建角色名單則會和其他人一樣耗盡彈藥.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoBottomless_tool.cn: 哪些配置可以保留“无限弹药”勾选. “仅限编辑器配置”只对你创建或编辑过的配置保留; 自带的角色名单则会和其他人一样耗尽弹药.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoHonestDrops.en: Ammo drops follow what the NPC carried
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoHonestDrops.ch: 彈藥掉落依NPC實際攜帶量
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoHonestDrops.cn: 弹药掉落按NPC实际携带量

Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoHonestDrops_too.en: On: a body drops at most its profile's magazine limit, filled only from rounds it still carried when it died. Off: one roll per magazine the profile was issued, full, however much was fired.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoHonestDrops_too.ch: 開啟: 屍體最多掉落其設定檔的彈匣上限, 且只用死亡時仍攜帶的子彈裝填. 關閉: 依設定檔配發的每個彈匣各判定一次, 皆為滿匣, 不論射出了多少.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoHonestDrops_too.cn: 开启: 尸体最多掉落其配置的弹匣上限, 且只用死亡时仍携带的子弹装填. 关闭: 按配置配发的每个弹匣各判定一次, 均为满弹匣, 无论射出了多少.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoReserveLoads_to.en: The most spare rounds an NPC can carry for one gun, counted in loads of that gun (its magazine or tube, at least 6 rounds). It caps the spawn kit and ammunition the NPC picks up. 0 means no ceiling. Default 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoReserveLoads_to.ch: NPC為單把槍可攜帶的備用子彈上限, 以該槍的裝填量計算 (彈匣或管狀彈倉, 至少6發). 這會限制生成時的配備以及NPC撿取的彈藥. 0表示無上限. 預設6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoReserveLoads_to.cn: NPC为单把枪可携带的备用子弹上限, 以该枪的装填量计算 (弹匣或管状弹仓, 至少6发). 这会限制生成时的配备以及NPC拾取的弹药. 0表示无上限. 默认6.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoSpawnPercent_to.en: Rounds an NPC is issued at spawn, as a percent of what its profile says. 100 is the profile. Every gun keeps at least one full load. Infinite-ammo profiles are not changed.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoSpawnPercent_to.ch: NPC生成時配發的子彈數, 以其設定檔數值的百分比表示. 100即為設定檔數值. 每把槍至少保留一次完整裝填. 無限彈藥的設定檔不受影響.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.AmmoSpawnPercent_to.cn: NPC生成时配发的子弹数, 以其配置数值的百分比表示. 100即为配置数值. 每把枪至少保留一次完整装填. 无限弹药的配置不受影响.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EarlyLooters.ch: 前期掠奪者團夥 (百分比)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EarlyLooters.cn: 前期掠夺者团伙 (百分比)

Sandbox_ProjectALife.EarlyLooters_toolti.en: How often the Roadside Pickers turn up: small scavenging crews who warn you off and may hold you up, common in the first two weeks and gone by the fourth. 100 is the default weight, 0 turns them off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EarlyLooters_toolti.ch: 「路邊拾荒者」出現的頻率: 會警告你離開, 也可能打劫你的小型拾荒團夥, 在前兩週很常見, 到第四週便會消失. 100為預設權重, 0則關閉.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.EarlyLooters_toolti.cn: “路边拾荒者”出现的频率: 会警告你离开, 也可能打劫你的小型拾荒团伙, 在前两周很常见, 到第四周便会消失. 100为默认权重, 0则关闭.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.ProfessionAffectsAt.en: Allows your profession to change NPC attitudes, including profession rules set in the Creator. Off by default. Faction and folder relations still apply.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ProfessionAffectsAt.ch: 允許你的職業改變NPC的態度, 包括在編輯器中設定的職業規則. 預設關閉. 勢力與資料夾關係仍然適用.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ProfessionAffectsAt.cn: 允许你的职业改变NPC的态度, 包括在编辑器中设置的职业规则. 默认关闭. 势力与文件夹关系仍然适用.

Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeasonalDress_toolt.en: Winter adds coats, hats, gloves and scarves to empty slots; summer takes off heavy winter layers. Uniforms keep their uniform. Profiles with their own seasonal outfit sets are left as authored.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeasonalDress_toolt.ch: 冬季會在空的欄位加上外套, 帽子, 手套和圍巾; 夏季會脫掉厚重的冬季衣物. 穿制服的人維持原本制服. 擁有自訂季節服裝組的設定檔則保持原樣.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeasonalDress_toolt.cn: 冬季会在空的装备槽加上外套, 帽子, 手套和围巾; 夏季会脱掉厚重的冬季衣物. 穿制服的人保持制服不变. 拥有自定义季节服装套装的配置则保持原样.

Sandbox_CU_AmputateWithoutBite_tooltip.en: Offer amputation on any limb, not only bitten ones.
Sandbox_CU_AmputateWithoutBite_tooltip.ch: 任何肢體都可選擇截肢, 不限於被咬的肢體.
Sandbox_CU_AmputateWithoutBite_tooltip.cn: 任何肢体都可选择截肢, 不限于被咬伤的肢体.

Sandbox_CU_AmputationCureWindowHours_too.en: Hours after being infected during which amputation still cures it. 0 means no limit.
Sandbox_CU_AmputationCureWindowHours_too.ch: 感染後的這段時數內, 截肢仍能治癒感染. 0 表示無限制.
Sandbox_CU_AmputationCureWindowHours_too.cn: 感染后的这段时数内, 截肢仍能治愈感染. 0 表示无限制.

Sandbox_CU_AmputationCuresInfection_tool.en: Cutting off every bitten limb cures the zombie infection. Bites on the chest, neck or head can never be cut away.
Sandbox_CU_AmputationCuresInfection_tool.ch: 切除所有被咬的肢體即可治癒殭屍感染. 胸部、頸部或頭部的咬傷永遠無法切除.
Sandbox_CU_AmputationCuresInfection_tool.cn: 切除所有被咬的肢体即可治愈僵尸感染. 胸部、颈部或头部的咬伤永远无法切除.

Sandbox_CU_Amputation_tooltip.en: Limbs can be cut off with a saw from the Health menu. Off: no amputation option.
Sandbox_CU_Amputation_tooltip.ch: 可在健康選單用鋸子截除肢體. 關閉: 沒有截肢選項.
Sandbox_CU_Amputation_tooltip.cn: 可在健康菜单用锯子截除肢体. 关闭: 没有截肢选项.

Sandbox_CU_AntibioticsAsInjection.ch: 抗生素以注射方式使用
Sandbox_CU_AntibioticsAsInjection.cn: 抗生素以注射方式使用

Sandbox_CU_AntibioticsAsInjection_toolti.en: Antibiotics use the syringe minigame. Off: they are swallowed, with the pill minigame.
Sandbox_CU_AntibioticsAsInjection_toolti.ch: 抗生素使用注射器小遊戲. 關閉: 改為口服, 使用藥丸小遊戲.
Sandbox_CU_AntibioticsAsInjection_toolti.cn: 抗生素使用注射器小游戏. 关闭: 改为口服, 使用药丸小游戏.

Sandbox_CU_ArrestSeconds_tooltip.en: How long the countdown runs once the heart stops: the window in which a defibrillator or a last stand can still save them.
Sandbox_CU_ArrestSeconds_tooltip.ch: 心跳停止後倒數持續多久: 也就是去顫器或背水一戰仍能救回對方的時限.
Sandbox_CU_ArrestSeconds_tooltip.cn: 心跳停止后倒计时持续多久: 也就是除颤器或背水一战仍能救回对方的时间窗口.

Sandbox_CU_BiteDespairHours.en: Hours for a bite's despair to peak
Sandbox_CU_BiteDespairHours.ch: 咬傷絕望達到高峰的時數
Sandbox_CU_BiteDespairHours.cn: 咬伤绝望达到顶峰的小时数

Sandbox_CU_BiteDespairHours_tooltip.en: Game hours a bite takes to reach full despair.
Sandbox_CU_BiteDespairHours_tooltip.ch: 咬傷達到完全絕望所需的遊戲時數.
Sandbox_CU_BiteDespairHours_tooltip.cn: 咬伤达到完全绝望所需的游戏小时数.

Sandbox_CU_BiteDespair_tooltip.en: A bite that is not cut away weighs heavier every hour, until the character is as low as the infection is far along. Amputating it lifts the dread.
Sandbox_CU_BiteDespair_tooltip.ch: 未切除的咬傷每小時都更加沉重, 直到角色的低落程度與感染進展相當. 截肢可解除這份恐懼.
Sandbox_CU_BiteDespair_tooltip.cn: 未切除的咬伤每小时都更加沉重, 直到角色的低落程度与感染进展相当. 截肢可解除这份恐惧.

Sandbox_CU_BloodLossRate_tooltip.en: How fast bleeding empties the body. A deep wound already counts for seven scratches and a dressing stops most of it, so a bandaged cut barely registers. 0 stops blood loss.
Sandbox_CU_BloodLossRate_tooltip.ch: 出血使身體失血的速度. 一道深層傷口已相當於七道擦傷, 而包紮能止住大部分出血, 所以包紮過的割傷幾乎不算數. 0 為不會失血.
Sandbox_CU_BloodLossRate_tooltip.cn: 出血使身体失血的速度. 一道深层伤口已相当于七道擦伤, 而包扎能止住大部分出血, 所以包扎过的割伤几乎不算数. 0 为不会失血.

Sandbox_CU_BloodRecoveryRate_tooltip.en: How fast lost blood comes back once nothing is bleeding. It already comes back faster on a full stomach.
Sandbox_CU_BloodRecoveryRate_tooltip.ch: 沒有任何出血時, 失去的血液恢復的速度. 吃飽時本來就恢復得更快.
Sandbox_CU_BloodRecoveryRate_tooltip.cn: 没有任何出血时, 失去的血液恢复的速度. 吃饱时本来就恢复得更快.

Sandbox_CU_BodyModCompat_tooltip.en: When Tomb's Player Body is running, stumps and prosthetics are the ones cut from its bodies, so they fit its thinner limbs. Off: always the ones cut from the game's own bodies.
Sandbox_CU_BodyModCompat_tooltip.ch: 執行 Tomb's Player Body 時, 殘肢與義肢會使用從它的身體模型切出的版本, 以貼合較細的肢體. 關閉: 一律使用從遊戲原本身體模型切出的版本.
Sandbox_CU_BodyModCompat_tooltip.cn: 运行 Tomb's Player Body 时, 残肢与假肢会使用从它的身体模型切出的版本, 以贴合较细的肢体. 关闭: 一律使用从游戏原本身体模型切出的版本.

Sandbox_CU_BotchChance_tooltip.en: The chance a treatment by somebody with no First Aid has a complication. Every First Aid level takes about a tenth of it away (level 10 is a twelfth of it); a well-played minigame halves it and a sloppy one makes it up to twice as likely. With no minigame it is the First Aid chance alone. 0: only failed minigames have complications.
Sandbox_CU_BotchChance_tooltip.ch: 由毫無急救技能的人進行治療時發生併發症的機率. 每一級急救約減少十分之一 (10 級時為原本的十二分之一); 小遊戲表現良好可減半, 表現草率則最多提高到兩倍. 沒有小遊戲時只看急救機率. 0: 只有小遊戲失敗才會產生併發症.
Sandbox_CU_BotchChance_tooltip.cn: 由毫无急救技能的人进行治疗时发生并发症的几率. 每一级急救约减少十分之一 (10 级时为原本的十二分之一); 小游戏表现良好可减半, 表现草率则最多提高到两倍. 没有小游戏时只看急救几率. 0: 只有小游戏失败才会产生并发症.

Sandbox_CU_BotchInjuries.ch: 治療失誤會產生併發症
Sandbox_CU_BotchInjuries.cn: 治疗失误会产生并发症

Sandbox_CU_BotchInjuries_tooltip.en: A treatment can go wrong and still get done: a dressing too loose to stay clean, dirt stitched into a wound, a bone set crooked, a fragment left in, a torn wound, a tourniquet on too tight. Each treatment has its own. Off: a bad result only costs quality and pain.
Sandbox_CU_BotchInjuries_tooltip.ch: 治療可能出錯但仍然完成: 包紮太鬆無法保持乾淨、髒汙被縫進傷口、骨頭接歪、碎片殘留體內、傷口撕裂、止血帶綁得太緊. 每種治療都有各自的併發症. 關閉: 結果不佳只會降低品質並增加疼痛.
Sandbox_CU_BotchInjuries_tooltip.cn: 治疗可能出错但仍然完成: 包扎太松无法保持干净、污物被缝进伤口、骨头接歪、碎片残留体内、伤口撕裂、止血带绑得太紧. 每种治疗都有各自的并发症. 关闭: 结果不佳只会降低质量并增加疼痛.

Sandbox_CU_BotchPainMultiplier_tooltip.en: Scales the extra pain a botched minigame causes. 0 means no extra pain.
Sandbox_CU_BotchPainMultiplier_tooltip.ch: 調整小遊戲失誤造成的額外疼痛. 0 表示沒有額外疼痛.
Sandbox_CU_BotchPainMultiplier_tooltip.cn: 调整小游戏失误造成的额外疼痛. 0 表示没有额外疼痛.

Sandbox_CU_BuddyPreventsSelfHarm_tooltip.en: Another living player nearby, on the same floor, stops an episode from starting or finishing.
Sandbox_CU_BuddyPreventsSelfHarm_tooltip.ch: 附近同一樓層有其他活著的玩家時, 可阻止發作開始或完成.
Sandbox_CU_BuddyPreventsSelfHarm_tooltip.cn: 附近同一楼层有其他活着的玩家时, 可阻止发作开始或完成.

Sandbox_CU_BuddyRadius_tooltip.en: How close another player must be to prevent an episode.
Sandbox_CU_BuddyRadius_tooltip.ch: 其他玩家需要多近才能防止發作.
Sandbox_CU_BuddyRadius_tooltip.cn: 其他玩家需要多近才能防止发作.

Sandbox_CU_CarryPlayers_tooltip.en: Right-click someone who cannot walk (no legs, knocked down or asleep) to pick them up. It costs endurance, and the carrier cannot run or fight.
Sandbox_CU_CarryPlayers_tooltip.ch: 對無法行走的人 (沒有腿、被擊倒或睡著) 按右鍵即可將對方抱起. 這會消耗耐力, 且背負者無法奔跑或戰鬥.
Sandbox_CU_CarryPlayers_tooltip.cn: 对无法行走的人 (没有腿、被击倒或睡着) 点击右键即可将对方抱起. 这会消耗耐力, 且背负者无法奔跑或战斗.

Sandbox_CU_CauterizeTemperature_tooltip.en: How hot a blade must be, heated in a fire, to seal a stump.
Sandbox_CU_CauterizeTemperature_tooltip.ch: 刀刃在火中加熱到多燙才能封住殘肢.
Sandbox_CU_CauterizeTemperature_tooltip.cn: 刀刃在火中加热到多烫才能封住残肢.

Sandbox_CU_ClinicalConditions_tooltip.en: Serious conditions develop from injuries and neglect: collapsed lungs, sepsis, clots, kidney failure and more. Each is on the problem list with a To-do entry explaining the fix. Off: none of them happen. The options below turn single groups off.
Sandbox_CU_ClinicalConditions_tooltip.ch: 受傷與疏於照顧會引發嚴重病症: 肺塌陷、敗血症、血栓、腎衰竭等. 每種病症都會列在問題清單上, 並附有說明處置方式的待辦事項. 關閉: 這些病症都不會發生. 下方選項可個別關閉單一類別.
Sandbox_CU_ClinicalConditions_tooltip.cn: 受伤与疏于照顾会引发严重病症: 肺塌陷、败血症、血栓、肾衰竭等. 每种病症都会列在问题列表上, 并附有说明处置方式的待办事项. 关闭: 这些病症都不会发生. 下方选项可单独关闭单一类别.

Sandbox_CU_ConditionOnsetRate_tooltip.en: Scales the chance of every condition developing. 0.5 halves it; 2 doubles it.
Sandbox_CU_ConditionOnsetRate_tooltip.ch: 調整每種病症發生的機率. 0.5 為減半, 2 為加倍.
Sandbox_CU_ConditionOnsetRate_tooltip.cn: 调整每种病症发生的几率. 0.5 为减半, 2 为加倍.

Sandbox_CU_ConditionWorsenTime_tooltip.en: Multiplies how long a condition takes to become the next one. 2 gives twice as long.
Sandbox_CU_ConditionWorsenTime_tooltip.ch: 病症演變為下一階段所需時間的倍率. 2 為時間加倍.
Sandbox_CU_ConditionWorsenTime_tooltip.cn: 病症演变为下一阶段所需时间的倍率. 2 为时间加倍.
