Tooltip_MGsMRE_PureSpringWater.en:
Pure crystal-clear Spring water -Helps
To counter Stamina drain from Lipids and Alcohol
Tooltip_MGsMRE_PureSpringWater.ch:
純淨清澈的泉水, 有助於
抵銷油脂與酒精造成的耐力消耗
Tooltip_MGsMRE_PureSpringWater.cn:
纯净清澈的泉水, 有助于
抵消油脂与酒精造成的耐力消耗

Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPear.en: Salted dried bird meat coated in a cactus-fruit reduction
Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPear.ch: 鹽漬鳥肉乾, 裹上濃縮仙人掌果醬汁
Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPear.cn: 盐渍鸟肉干, 裹上浓缩仙人掌果酱汁

Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPearOpen.en: Shredded heavily salted Dried bird meat coated in a sweet Sticky cactus-fruit reduction
Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPearOpen.ch: 重鹽醃製的手撕鳥肉乾, 裹上香甜黏稠的濃縮仙人掌果醬汁
Tooltip_MGsMRE_QuailPearOpen.cn: 重盐腌制的手撕鸟肉干, 裹上香甜黏稠的浓缩仙人掌果酱汁

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadCorn.en:
Thick blackened cornbread Biscuits baked with
Wood ash and charcoal Dust to bind to ingested Rad-particles
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadCorn.ch:
厚實焦黑的玉米麵包餅乾, 烘烤時加入
木灰與炭粉, 用來吸附吃下肚的輻射微粒
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadCorn.cn:
厚实焦黑的玉米面包饼干, 烘烤时加入
木灰与炭粉, 用来吸附吃下肚的辐射微粒

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrip.en:
Blackened leathery mystery meat Strip that is rough and Fibrous weeping a dark oily Residue
Durable Wasteland survival protein -It cuts down severe Hunger but induces thirst due to its Preparation
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrip.ch:
焦黑如皮革的不明肉條, 粗糙多筋, 滲出深色的油狀殘渣
耐放的廢土求生蛋白質, 能大幅緩解飢餓, 但因製作方式會讓人口渴
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrip.cn:
焦黑如皮革的不明肉条, 粗糙多筋, 渗出深色的油状残渣
耐放的废土求生蛋白质, 能大幅缓解饥饿, 但因制作方式会让人口渴

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrips.en: Tightly wound roll of blackened Leathery mystery meat strips tied together with Rusted wire
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrips.ch: 一捲緊緊纏繞的焦黑皮革狀不明肉條, 用生鏽的鐵絲綁在一起
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadMeatStrips.cn: 一卷紧紧缠绕的焦黑皮革状不明肉条, 用生锈的铁丝绑在一起

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadRoast.en:
Chalky gray-green survival Biscuit baked from mutant Spud flour
And rendered lard -Stamped with a crude Biohazard symbol
To warn scavengers of its Questionable origin
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadRoast.ch:
以突變馬鈴薯粉與煉製豬油烘烤的
粉質灰綠色求生餅乾, 印著簡陋的生物危害標誌
警告拾荒者它來路可疑
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadRoast.cn:
用变异土豆粉与熬制猪油烘烤的
粉质灰绿色求生饼干, 印着简陋的生物危害标志
警告拾荒者它来路可疑

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadShieldDrops.en:
Rusted unsealed tin containing Smooth amber-colored translucent Spheres -They provide a
Sugary spike to conquer fatigue while the sugar Matrix coat the throat and settle internal Toxicity
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadShieldDrops.ch:
生鏽且未密封的鐵罐, 裝著光滑的琥珀色半透明圓球, 能提供
糖分衝擊以驅除疲勞, 同時糖衣能包覆喉嚨並緩和體內毒性
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadShieldDrops.cn:
生锈且未密封的铁罐, 装着光滑的琥珀色半透明圆球, 能提供
糖分冲击以驱除疲劳, 同时糖衣能包覆喉咙并缓和体内毒性

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadSoda.en:
Flat pre-collapse cola served in a Degraded plastic bottle that has turned an Unsettling
Cloudy amber color after years of Improper storage -Intense chemically sweet High-fructose corn syrup
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadSoda.ch:
沒氣的崩潰前可樂, 裝在老化的塑膠瓶裡, 因多年保存不當而變成令人不安的
混濁琥珀色, 帶有濃烈化學甜味的高果糖玉米糖漿
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadSoda.cn:
没气的崩溃前可乐, 装在老化的塑料瓶里, 因多年储存不当而变成令人不安的
浑浊琥珀色, 带有浓烈化学甜味的高果糖玉米糖浆

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStag.en: Mutated venison strips Packed with beans

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStagHot.en:
Tough thick-cut mutated Venison strips
Packed with smoked Pinto beans in a heavy Lard glaze
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStagHot.ch:
堅韌的厚切突變鹿肉條
搭配煙燻斑豆, 裹著厚厚一層豬油
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStagHot.cn:
坚韧的厚切变异鹿肉条
搭配烟熏斑豆, 裹着厚厚一层猪油

Tough thick-cut mutated Venison strips

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadStagOpen.cn:
坚韧的厚切变异鹿肉条
搭配烟熏斑豆, 裹着厚厚一层猪油

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadiatorMustard.en:
Thick pungent yellow Condiment made from crushed wild Mustard seeds
Scavenged vinegar scraps And a dash of Turmeric -It has a sharp sinus-clearing
Heat with a faint metallic Aftertaste -Perfect for masking the flavour of Stale meat
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadiatorMustard.ch:
濃稠嗆辣的黃色調味醬, 以壓碎的野生芥末籽
搜刮來的剩醋與少許薑黃製成, 帶有直衝鼻腔的強烈
辣勁與淡淡的金屬餘味, 最適合掩蓋不新鮮肉類的味道
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RadiatorMustard.cn:
浓稠呛辣的黄色调味酱, 用压碎的野生芥末籽
搜刮来的剩醋和少许姜黄制成, 带有直冲鼻腔的强烈
辣劲与淡淡的金属余味, 最适合掩盖不新鲜肉类的味道

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RaiderRation.en: Patchwork pouch made from scrap Materials -Crudely stitched and tied with thin leather strings
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RaiderRation.ch: 以廢料拼縫而成的拼布袋, 縫工粗糙, 用細皮繩綁緊
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RaiderRation.cn: 用废料拼缝而成的拼布袋, 缝工粗糙, 用细皮绳绑紧

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RainCheckEmpty.cn: 当时防水, 现在依然防水

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationBars.en:
Dense matte-grey rectangular bars Embossed with deep parallel Ridges

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationBars.ch:
緻密的霧灰色長方形條塊, 表面壓印著深深的平行
凸紋, 帶有重鹹豬油與烤酵母風味

致密的哑光灰色长方形条块, 表面压印着深深的平行
凸纹, 带有重咸猪油与烤酵母风味

Dark muddy-brown liquid Served in a heavy-duty vacuum-sealed Plastic pouch with an
Integrated thermal nozzle -Heavy gelatinous and thick Protein paste that coats the Throat
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationBroth.ch:
深泥褐色的液體, 裝在附有一體式保溫吸嘴的
重型真空密封塑膠袋中, 是厚重黏稠的膠質蛋白糊, 會裹住喉嚨
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationBroth.cn:
深泥褐色的液体, 装在带有一体式保温吸嘴的
重型真空密封塑料袋中, 是厚重黏稠的胶质蛋白糊, 会裹住喉咙

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationEnhancer.en: Quick-Apply patch to reduce Pain and Fatigue and boost Endurance

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationEnhancer.cn: 快速贴用的贴片, 可减轻疼痛与疲劳并提升耐力

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationGradeDrench.en:
Fine pale pink mineral Drink mixed from electrolyte powder -Used to combat
Severe heat exhaustion and Muscle tremors -Very salty with a sharp Synthetic citrus finish
That smells intensely of Artificial lime and chemical Purification tablets
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationGradeDrench.ch:
以電解質粉沖泡的細緻淡粉紅色礦物飲料, 用來對抗
嚴重的熱衰竭與肌肉顫抖, 非常鹹, 帶有刺激的人工柑橘尾韻
聞起來有濃烈的人工萊姆與化學淨水錠氣味
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RationGradeDrench.cn:
用电解质粉冲泡的细腻淡粉色矿物饮料, 用来对抗
严重的热衰竭与肌肉震颤, 非常咸, 带有刺激的人工柑橘余味
闻起来有浓烈的人工青柠与化学净水片气味

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RavenChews.en:
Pitch-black rubbery fruit Nuggets that taste intensely sour
Almost like Copper and Wild honey
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RavenChews.ch:
漆黑有嚼勁的水果軟糖塊, 味道極酸
幾乎像是銅與野生蜂蜜
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RavenChews.cn:
漆黑有嚼劲的水果软糖块, 味道极酸
几乎像是铜与野生蜂蜜

Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReadyCocoa.en:
Chocolate drink with a gritty High-calorie suspension that needs vigorous shaking
Forms an impenetrable Crust on the top if left sitting for more than 40 seconds
Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReadyCocoa.ch:
含有顆粒感高熱量懸浮物的巧克力飲料, 需要用力搖勻
若放置超過 40 秒, 頂部會結成一層打不穿的硬殼
Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReadyCocoa.cn:
含有颗粒感高热量悬浮物的巧克力饮料, 需要用力摇匀
如果放置超过 40 秒, 顶部会结成一层打不穿的硬壳

Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReclaimedBrew.en:
Heavy-duty crinkly Silver foil laminate pouch with an Intensely bitter roasted
Chicory root -Deeply scorched Smoky malt scraps -An unrefined earthy wood-ash undertone
And a completely sugarless Blunt finish
Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReclaimedBrew.ch:
厚實起皺的銀色鋁箔複合袋, 內含極苦的烘焙
菊苣根, 深度焦烤的煙燻麥芽碎屑, 帶有粗獷的泥土與木灰底韻
以及完全無糖的直白尾韻
Tooltip_MGsMRE_ReclaimedBrew.cn:
厚实起皱的银色铝箔复合袋, 内含极苦的烘焙
菊苣根, 深度焦烤的烟熏麦芽碎屑, 带有粗犷的泥土与木灰底韵
以及完全无糖的直白余味

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RehydratedMashFlakes.en:
Thick synthetic potato-like paste -Tastes strongly of Salt and heavy
Preservation chemicals providing a dense Carbohydrate anchor in the stomach

濃稠的合成仿馬鈴薯泥, 嚐起來有濃重的鹽味與大量
防腐化學藥劑味, 能在胃裡提供紮實的碳水化合物飽足感
Tooltip_MGsMRE_RehydratedMashFlakes.cn:
浓稠的合成仿土豆泥, 尝起来有浓重的盐味和大量
防腐化学药剂味, 能在胃里提供扎实的碳水化合物饱腹感

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RehydratedRicePilaf.en:
Hyper-compressed grain matrix packed with high-yield Jasmine rice starches
Saturated with pure lab-grown Chicken proteins -Engineered to flash-rehydrate into a
Steaming fluffy pilaf meal within Minutes when mixed with hot or cold fluid

超高壓縮的穀物基質, 富含高產量茉莉香米澱粉
並浸透純實驗室培育的雞肉蛋白, 專為快速復水設計, 與冷熱液體混合後

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RehydratedRicePilaf.cn:
超高压缩的谷物基质, 富含高产量茉莉香米淀粉
并浸透纯实验室培育的鸡肉蛋白, 专为快速复水设计, 与冷热液体混合后
数分钟内就能变成热气腾腾, 蓬松的抓饭

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RepliKit.cn: 军用级 REPLI-KIT, 内含微量分配的合成营养颗粒

高級緻密求生口糧, 專為在最嚴苛的環境中永久保存而設計

高级致密求生口粮, 专为在最严苛的环境中永久保存而设计

彈簧式自動注射器, 裝有螢光綠色的化學

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RevivalStim.cn:

兴奋剂, 用来重新启动冻结的心脏, 并消除休眠后的肌肉萎缩

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RiceBlock.en:
Dense dry grain block -Oil-treated and Ready to Eat

Tooltip_MGsMRE_RiceBlock.cn:
致密的干燥谷物块, 经油处理, 开袋即食

工業用真空套, 緊緊收縮貼合

压缩谷物的轮廓, 能无限期防潮防尘保存

The staple rations that built an empire -Issued to Legionaries on

Adds crucial fast-absorbing Protein and delivers dense calcium to support
Heavy load-bearing bone stress -This mix uses heavy milk Solids and calcium Concentrations

骨骼承受的沉重負荷壓力, 這款混合粉使用大量乳固形物與濃縮鈣
來中和經碘處理的野外用水那股苦澀金屬味

补充关键的快速吸收蛋白质, 并提供大量钙质, 以支撑

来中和经碘处理的野外用水那股苦涩金属味

Tooltip_MGsMRE_WhisperingShards.en: Translucent jagged violet Sugar shards that hum with a Faint fizzing sensation when Placed on the tongue

Tooltip_MGsMRE_WhisperingShards.cn: 半透明的锯齿状紫色糖晶碎片, 放到舌头上时会带来微弱的嘶嘶跳动感

Tooltip_MGsMRE_WildApple.en:
Reduction made from Wild crabapples -Brown sugar and Cinnamon

用來塗抹在鵪鶉胸肉乾片上

用野生海棠果、红糖和肉桂熬成的浓缩酱
用来涂抹在鹌鹑胸肉干片上

Tooltip_MGsMRE_WillowBark.en:
Dark tannin-rich tea Brewed by boiling stripped Willow bark
And charred oak chunks inside a Salvaged metal pipe over an open
Trench fire -It functions as a bitter Natural painkiller and Fever reducer
When medical Supplies have run dry

富含單寧的深色茶, 將剝下的柳樹皮
與燒焦的橡木塊放入撿來的金屬管中, 架在露天
壕溝火堆上熬煮而成, 是一種苦澀的天然止痛與退燒藥
在醫療物資耗盡時派上用場
Tooltip_MGsMRE_WillowBark.cn:
富含单宁的深色茶, 将剥下的柳树皮
和烧焦的橡木块放入捡来的金属管中, 架在露天
壕沟火堆上熬煮而成, 是一种苦涩的天然止痛与退烧药
在医疗物资耗尽时派上用场

口糧, 配發給探索古代遺跡的法師

Tooltip_OffGridBackupLectromax.en: A Lectromax generator converted for Off-Grid. It gives 4,000 W and only ever feeds the controller it is cabled to.

Tooltip_OffGridBackupLectromax.cn: 改装为离网使用的极电制造发电机. 输出 4,000 W, 且只向以电缆连接的控制器供电.

Tooltip_OffGridBackupOld.en: An old generator converted for Off-Grid. It gives 3,000 W and only ever feeds the controller it is cabled to.
Tooltip_OffGridBackupOld.ch: 改裝為離網使用的老式發電機. 輸出 3,000 W, 且只供電給以電纜連接的控制器.
Tooltip_OffGridBackupOld.cn: 改装为离网使用的老式发电机. 输出 3,000 W, 且只向以电缆连接的控制器供电.

Tooltip_OffGridBackupPremium.en: A Premium Technologies generator converted for Off-Grid. It gives 5,000 W and only ever feeds the controller it is cabled to.
Tooltip_OffGridBackupPremium.ch: 改裝為離網使用的昂科牌發電機. 輸出 5,000 W, 且只供電給以電纜連接的控制器.
Tooltip_OffGridBackupPremium.cn: 改装为离网使用的昂科牌发电机. 输出 5,000 W, 且只向以电缆连接的控制器供电.

Tooltip_OffGridBackupValuTech.en: A ValuTech generator converted for Off-Grid. It gives 2,500 W and only ever feeds the controller it is cabled to.
Tooltip_OffGridBackupValuTech.ch: 改裝為離網使用的廉科牌發電機. 輸出 2,500 W, 且只供電給以電纜連接的控制器.
Tooltip_OffGridBackupValuTech.cn: 改装为离网使用的廉科牌发电机. 输出 2,500 W, 且只向以电缆连接的控制器供电.

Tooltip_OffGridGardenLamp.en: A knee-high light with its own little panel and battery. It charges in the sun and lights the path from dusk to dawn. Needs no wiring.
Tooltip_OffGridGardenLamp.ch: 及膝高的燈, 附有自己的小型太陽能板和電池. 白天在陽光下充電, 從黃昏到黎明照亮小徑. 不需要接線.
Tooltip_OffGridGardenLamp.cn: 及膝高的灯, 带有自己的小型光伏板和电池. 白天在阳光下充电, 从黄昏到黎明照亮小路. 不需要接线.

Tooltip_OffGridStreetLamp.en: A street light on a pole, with its own panel and battery pack. It charges all day and lights the road from dusk to dawn. Needs no wiring.
Tooltip_OffGridStreetLamp.ch: 立在燈柱上的路燈, 附有自己的太陽能板和電池組. 整天充電, 從黃昏到黎明照亮道路. 不需要接線.
Tooltip_OffGridStreetLamp.cn: 立在灯杆上的路灯, 带有自己的光伏板和电池组. 整天充电, 从黄昏到黎明照亮道路. 不需要接线.

Tooltip_OffGridTransformer.en: Carries the controller's power across town. Run a cable to the controller or to another transformer. While the system has power it lights everything around it, as far as the controller reaches, and it can wire up a building.
Tooltip_OffGridTransformer.ch: 將控制器的電力輸送到鎮上各處. 從它拉一條電纜到控制器或另一台變壓器. 系統有電時, 它會為周圍所有照明與電器供電 (範圍與控制器相同), 並可為一棟建築接線.
Tooltip_OffGridTransformer.cn: 将控制器的电力输送到镇上各处. 从它拉一条电缆到控制器或另一台变压器. 系统有电时, 它会为周围所有照明和电器供电 (范围与控制器相同), 并可为一栋建筑接线.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelMixed.en: It holds something besides gasoline. Empty it first.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelMixed.ch: 裡面裝有汽油以外的東西. 請先清空.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelMixed.cn: 里面装有汽油以外的东西. 请先清空.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelTaken.en: This barrel already feeds a generator.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelTaken.ch: 此油桶已在為一台發電機供油.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelTaken.cn: 此油桶已在为一台发电机供油.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkConvert.en: Convert this generator into an Off-Grid backup generator. Once converted, you can run a cable from this generator to a controller and start managing it on the controller UI.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkConvert.ch: 將這台發電機轉換為離網備用發電機. 轉換後, 你可以從這台發電機拉一條電纜到控制器, 並開始在控制器介面上管理它.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkConvert.cn: 将这台发电机转换为离网备用发电机. 转换后, 你可以从这台发电机拉一根电缆到控制器, 并开始在控制器界面上管理它.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkFull.en: This controller already has four generators.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkFull.ch: 此控制器已連接四台發電機.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkFull.cn: 此控制器已连接四台发电机.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkHere.en: There is already a backup generator here.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkHere.ch: 這裡已經有一台備用發電機.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkHere.cn: 这里已经有一台备用发电机.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkMaster.en: Starts a generator when the batteries run low, and stops it when they are nearly full or the sun has taken over.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkMaster.ch: 電池電量低時啟動發電機, 電池快充滿或太陽能接手供電時則停止它.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkMaster.cn: 电池电量低时启动发电机, 电池快充满或太阳能接手供电时则停止它.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkModded.en: This generator model can't be converted.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkModded.ch: 此型號的發電機無法改裝.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkModded.cn: 此型号的发电机无法改装.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNeedPetrol.ch: 需要一個裝有汽油的容器.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNeedPetrol.cn: 需要一个装有汽油的容器.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoBarrel.en: No barrel of gasoline within 5 tiles. Put one nearby and fill it with gasoline.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoBarrel.ch: 5 格內沒有裝汽油的油桶. 在附近放一個油桶並裝滿汽油.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoBarrel.cn: 5 格内没有装汽油的油桶. 在附近放一个油桶并装满汽油.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoLink.en: Not connected to a controller. Run a cable from it to one.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoLink.ch: 未連接至控制器. 從它拉一條電纜到控制器.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoLink.cn: 未连接至控制器. 从它拉一条电缆到控制器.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkOutside.ch: 請先將發電機移到室外.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkOutside.cn: 请先将发电机移到室外.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkServerOff.en: Backup generators are switched off on this server.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkServerOff.ch: 此伺服器已停用備用發電機.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkServerOff.cn: 此服务器已停用备用发电机.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkSkill.en: Needs Electrical 3, or to have read Magazine: How to Use Generators.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkSkill.ch: 需要電工 3, 或已讀過「如何使用發電機」.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkSkill.cn: 需要电工 3, 或已读过“电子杂志4: 发电机使用指南”.

Tooltip_OffGrid_BkUnplug.ch: 請先中斷發電機的連接.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkUnplug.cn: 请先断开发电机的连接.

Tooltip_OffGrid_ChooseBuildings.en: Click a building or a player-built structure to add it or take it away. Anything this part reaches can be chosen.
Tooltip_OffGrid_ChooseBuildings.ch: 點選建築或玩家建造的結構以新增或移除. 此元件範圍內的任何建築都可選擇.
Tooltip_OffGrid_ChooseBuildings.cn: 点击建筑或玩家建造的结构以添加或移除. 此部件范围内的任何建筑都可选择.

Tooltip_OffGrid_Coverage.en: Coverage on your current floor. Green: supplying power. Amber: no power. Lights and appliances in reach glow green when switched on, white when switched off. Press Esc to hide.
Tooltip_OffGrid_Coverage.ch: 目前樓層的供電範圍. 綠色: 供電中. 琥珀色: 無電力. 範圍內的照明和電器開啟時呈綠色, 關閉時呈白色. 按 Esc 隱藏.
Tooltip_OffGrid_Coverage.cn: 当前楼层的供电范围. 绿色: 供电中. 琥珀色: 无电力. 范围内的照明和电器打开时呈绿色, 关闭时呈白色. 按 Esc 隐藏.

Tooltip_OffGrid_Painted.en: Painted with the Brush Tool: not a working controller.
Tooltip_OffGrid_Painted.ch: 以筆刷工具繪製: 不是可運作的控制器.
Tooltip_OffGrid_Painted.cn: 以笔刷工具绘制: 不是可运作的控制器.

Tooltip_OffGrid_TooHeavy.en: Too heavy for what you are carrying.
Tooltip_OffGrid_TooHeavy.ch: 以你目前攜帶的東西來說太重了.
Tooltip_OffGrid_TooHeavy.cn: 以你当前携带的东西来说太重了.

Tooltip_OffGrid_UnwireBuildings.en: Stops powering the buildings this part wired. Its own reach stays.
Tooltip_OffGrid_UnwireBuildings.ch: 停止為此元件接線的建築供電. 它本身的供電範圍不變.
Tooltip_OffGrid_UnwireBuildings.cn: 停止为此部件接线的建筑供电. 它本身的供电范围不变.

Tooltip_OffGrid_WireBuilding.en: Powers every floor of the building this stands in or next to, whenever the system has power. Power can reach a few tiles past its walls. Whatever runs in there draws on the batteries.
Tooltip_OffGrid_WireBuilding.ch: 系統有電時, 為此元件所在或相鄰建築的每一層樓供電. 電力可延伸到牆外幾格. 建築內運轉的任何設備都會消耗電池電量.
Tooltip_OffGrid_WireBuilding.cn: 系统有电时, 为此部件所在或相邻建筑的每一层楼供电. 电力可延伸到墙外几格. 建筑内运行的任何设备都会消耗电池电量.

Tooltip_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.en:
"When only flesh remained,
they offered that too.
Still, the hunger endured."

Moves all blessings to unblessed
equipment in the same category.
Consumed on success.
Right-click this finger to begin.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.ch:
「當只剩血肉,
他們連血肉也獻上.
然而飢渴依舊.」

將所有祝福轉移到
同類別的無祝福裝備上.
成功時消耗.
右鍵點選此手指開始.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_SaintsWitheredFinge.cn:
“当只剩血肉,
他们连血肉也献上.
然而饥渴依旧.”

将所有祝福转移到
同类别的无祝福装备上.
成功时消耗.
右键点击此手指开始.

Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferIdentify.en: Examine this item's blessings before transferring them.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferIdentify.ch: 轉移前先檢視此物品的祝福.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferIdentify.cn: 转移前先检查此物品的祝福.

Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferMaterial.en: Requires one Saint's Withered Finger in your inventory.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferMaterial.ch: 物品欄中需要一根聖徒的枯萎手指.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferMaterial.cn: 物品栏中需要一根圣徒的枯萎手指.

Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferNoTargets.en: Carry an unblessed, unequipped item of the same category that supports every blessing on this item.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferNoTargets.ch: 攜帶一件同類別、未裝備且無祝福, 並能承載此物品所有祝福的物品.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferNoTargets.cn: 携带一件同类别、未装备且无祝福, 并能承载此物品所有祝福的物品.

Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferUnequip.en: Unequip and detach this item before transferring its blessings.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferUnequip.ch: 轉移祝福前, 請先卸下並拆下此物品.
Tooltip_ProjectExile_TransferUnequip.cn: 转移祝福前, 请先卸下并拆下此物品.

Tooltip_Locksmith_AssignKey.en: Consume a blank key to cut the key for this padlock and arm the lock. Needs a blank key and a small file set; the file is kept.
Tooltip_Locksmith_AssignKey.ch: 消耗一把空白鑰匙, 配製出這個鎖頭的鑰匙並啟用此鎖. 需要空白鑰匙與小型銼刀套裝; 銼刀會保留.
Tooltip_Locksmith_AssignKey.cn: 消耗一把空白钥匙, 配出这把挂锁的钥匙并启用此锁. 需要空白钥匙和小型锉刀套装; 锉刀会保留.

Tooltip_Locksmith_ChangeCombination.en: Set a new 4-digit code. Everyone else will need the new code.
Tooltip_Locksmith_ChangeCombination.ch: 設定新的 4 位數密碼. 其他所有人都需要新密碼.
Tooltip_Locksmith_ChangeCombination.cn: 设置新的 4 位数密码. 其他所有人都需要新密码.

Tooltip_Locksmith_CreateNewKey.en: Cut a fresh key for this lock from a blank key and a small file set, reading the pin stack with tweezers. The new key becomes the only key that opens it. The lock has to be unlocked first.
Tooltip_Locksmith_CreateNewKey.ch: 用空白鑰匙和小型銼刀套裝為這個鎖配製一把新鑰匙, 並用鑷子讀取鎖芯的彈子排列. 新鑰匙將成為唯一能開啟它的鑰匙. 必須先解鎖.
Tooltip_Locksmith_CreateNewKey.cn: 用空白钥匙和小型锉刀套装为这把锁配一把新钥匙, 并用镊子读取锁芯的弹子排列. 新钥匙将成为唯一能打开它的钥匙. 必须先解锁.

Tooltip_Locksmith_CutOffLock.en: Cut this lock off with bolt cutters. Higher Strength improves the odds.
Tooltip_Locksmith_CutOffLock.ch: 用斷線鉗剪掉這個鎖. 力量越高, 成功率越高.
Tooltip_Locksmith_CutOffLock.cn: 用断线钳剪掉这把锁. 力量越高, 成功率越高.

Tooltip_Locksmith_CutOffLockKnowledge.en: Requires knowing how a lock is put together.

Tooltip_Locksmith_CutOffLockWear.en: Higher Nimble places the jaws better, so the blades last longer.
Tooltip_Locksmith_CutOffLockWear.ch: 靈活越高, 鉗口就放得越準, 刀刃也就越耐用.
Tooltip_Locksmith_CutOffLockWear.cn: 灵活越高, 钳口就放得越准, 刀刃也就越耐用.

Tooltip_Locksmith_EnterCombination.en: Type the 4-digit code to open this lock.
Tooltip_Locksmith_EnterCombination.ch: 輸入 4 位數密碼以開啟這個鎖.
Tooltip_Locksmith_EnterCombination.cn: 输入 4 位数密码以打开这把锁.

Tooltip_Locksmith_ForceDoor.en: Pry the door open with a crowbar. Higher Strength improves the odds and spares the tool. Padlocked gates need bolt cutters or a lockpick instead.
Tooltip_Locksmith_ForceDoor.ch: 用鐵撬把門撬開. 力量越高, 成功率越高, 工具也越不易損耗. 上了鎖頭的柵門則需要斷線鉗或撬鎖.
Tooltip_Locksmith_ForceDoor.cn: 用撬棍把门撬开. 力量越高, 成功率越高, 工具也越不易损耗. 上了挂锁的栅门则需要断线钳或撬锁.

Tooltip_Locksmith_ForceDoorDamage.en: Each pry may mark the door, and higher Nimble, Strength and Fitness all make that less likely. A door driven to zero health is destroyed.
Tooltip_Locksmith_ForceDoorDamage.ch: 每次撬門都可能在門上留下損傷, 而靈活, 力量與體格越高, 機率越低. 耐久降到零的門會被摧毀.
Tooltip_Locksmith_ForceDoorDamage.cn: 每次撬门都可能在门上留下损伤, 而灵活, 力量与体格越高, 几率越低. 耐久降到零的门会被摧毁.

Tooltip_Locksmith_ForceDoorEndurance.en: Forcing a lock like this is hard work. Every attempt costs endurance, and a tired character has worse odds. Higher Strength and Fitness make each attempt cost less.
Tooltip_Locksmith_ForceDoorEndurance.ch: 像這樣強行破鎖是件苦差事. 每次嘗試都會消耗耐力, 疲累的角色成功率也較低. 力量與體格越高, 每次嘗試的消耗越少.
Tooltip_Locksmith_ForceDoorEndurance.cn: 像这样强行破锁是件苦差事. 每次尝试都会消耗耐力, 疲惫的角色成功率也较低. 力量与体格越高, 每次尝试的消耗越少.

Tooltip_Locksmith_ForceDoorKnowledge.en: Requires knowing how a lock is put together.

Tooltip_Locksmith_GateKey.en: Opens and locks the gate this key was cut for. Weightless.
Tooltip_Locksmith_GateKey.ch: 開啟並鎖上這把鑰匙所對應的柵門. 無重量.
Tooltip_Locksmith_GateKey.cn: 打开并锁上这把钥匙所对应的栅门. 无重量.

Tooltip_Locksmith_GateLock.en: Install on a player-built gate to bind a unique key, letting you lock it against anyone without that key. Keep that key in your main inventory, or on a keyring there, or the Lock and Unlock options will not appear.
Tooltip_Locksmith_GateLock.ch: 安裝在玩家建造的柵門上並綁定一把專屬鑰匙, 讓沒有這把鑰匙的人都無法打開. 鑰匙要放在主物品欄, 或主物品欄裡的鑰匙圈上, 否則不會出現「上鎖」與「解鎖」選項.
Tooltip_Locksmith_GateLock.cn: 安装在玩家建造的栅门上并绑定一把专属钥匙, 让没有这把钥匙的人都无法打开. 钥匙要放在主物品栏, 或主物品栏里的钥匙环上, 否则不会出现“上锁”与“解锁”选项.

Tooltip_Locksmith_InstallCombo.en: Install a combination padlock and set a 4-digit code. Anyone who knows the code can open it.
Tooltip_Locksmith_InstallCombo.ch: 安裝密碼鎖並設定 4 位數密碼. 知道密碼的人都能打開.
Tooltip_Locksmith_InstallCombo.cn: 安装密码锁并设置 4 位数密码. 知道密码的人都能打开.

Tooltip_Locksmith_InstallLocked.en: This door is already locked. Unlock or defeat that lock before installing one of your own.
Tooltip_Locksmith_InstallLocked.ch: 這扇門已經上鎖. 請先解鎖或破壞那把鎖, 才能安裝你自己的鎖.
Tooltip_Locksmith_InstallLocked.cn: 这扇门已经上锁. 请先解锁或破坏那把锁, 才能安装你自己的锁.

Tooltip_Locksmith_KeyMag1.en: Also covers locks: cutting a spare key, re-pinning a door to a key you already carry, cutting a lock off with bolt cutters, and picking a door with a screwdriver and a paperclip.
Tooltip_Locksmith_KeyMag1.ch: 也涵蓋鎖具相關技能: 打造備用鑰匙、將門鎖重新配鎖以配合你已攜帶的鑰匙、用斷線鉗剪斷鎖, 以及用螺絲起子和迴紋針撬開門鎖.
Tooltip_Locksmith_KeyMag1.cn: 也涵盖锁具相关技能: 配制备用钥匙、将门锁重新配锁以配合你已携带的钥匙、用断线钳剪断锁, 以及用螺丝刀和回形针撬开门锁.

Tooltip_Locksmith_LockTargets.en: Gates and garage doors you find in the world work too, not just ones you built.
Tooltip_Locksmith_LockTargets.ch: 在世界中找到的柵門和車庫門也適用, 不只限於你建造的.
Tooltip_Locksmith_LockTargets.cn: 在世界中找到的栅门和车库门也适用, 不只限于你建造的.

Tooltip_Locksmith_MustBeUnlocked.en: This lock is shut. Open it first -- with its key, a lockpick or a crowbar -- before you can re-key it.
Tooltip_Locksmith_MustBeUnlocked.ch: 這把鎖是鎖上的. 必須先打開它 (用它的鑰匙、撬鎖工具或鐵撬), 才能重新配鎖.
Tooltip_Locksmith_MustBeUnlocked.cn: 这把锁是锁上的. 必须先打开它 (用它的钥匙、撬锁工具或撬棍), 才能重新配锁.

Tooltip_Locksmith_NeedsTweezers.en: Tweezers are needed to read the pin stack before a key can be cut for it.
Tooltip_Locksmith_NeedsTweezers.ch: 需要鑷子讀取鎖芯的彈子結構, 才能為它打造鑰匙.
Tooltip_Locksmith_NeedsTweezers.cn: 需要镊子读取锁芯的弹子结构, 才能为它配制钥匙.

Tooltip_Locksmith_Padlock.en: With Locksmith, this can also be installed on a player-built gate to lock it, and cut off with bolt cutters if the key is lost.
Tooltip_Locksmith_Padlock.ch: 搭配鎖匠時, 這個也能裝在玩家建造的柵門上將其上鎖, 若鑰匙遺失也能用斷線鉗剪斷.
Tooltip_Locksmith_Padlock.cn: 搭配锁匠时, 这个也能装在玩家建造的栅门上将其上锁, 若钥匙丢失也能用断线钳剪断.

Tooltip_Locksmith_PickLock.en: Work the lock with a screwdriver and a paperclip. Higher Nimble means a better chance, a faster attempt, and fewer ruined tools when it goes wrong. Even a failure teaches you something.
Tooltip_Locksmith_PickLock.ch: 用螺絲起子和迴紋針撬鎖. 靈活等級越高, 成功機率越高、嘗試速度越快, 失敗時損壞的工具也越少. 就算失敗也能學到一些東西.
Tooltip_Locksmith_PickLock.cn: 用螺丝刀和回形针撬锁. 灵活等级越高, 成功几率越高、尝试速度越快, 失败时损坏的工具也越少. 就算失败也能学到一些东西.

Tooltip_Locksmith_RepairLock.en: Fit a replacement cylinder with a screwdriver, one scrap metal and two screws. Higher Nimble means a better chance of seating it; the parts are used up whether it works or not. A door with a wrecked lock cannot be locked again until it is repaired.
Tooltip_Locksmith_RepairLock.ch: 用螺絲起子、一塊廢金屬和兩顆螺絲裝上替換鎖芯. 靈活等級越高, 裝好的機率越高; 不論成功與否零件都會消耗. 鎖已損毀的門在修好之前無法再上鎖.
Tooltip_Locksmith_RepairLock.cn: 用螺丝刀、一块金属废料和两颗螺丝装上替换锁芯. 灵活等级越高, 装好的几率越高; 不论成功与否零件都会消耗. 锁已损毁的门在修好之前无法再上锁.

Tooltip_Locksmith_Repin.en: Re-pin your installed keyed lock to an existing gate key. Requires tweezers nearby.
Tooltip_Locksmith_Repin.ch: 將你已安裝的鑰匙鎖重新配鎖, 以配合現有的柵門鑰匙. 附近需要有鑷子.
Tooltip_Locksmith_Repin.cn: 将你已安装的钥匙锁重新配锁, 以配合现有的栅门钥匙. 附近需要有镊子.

Tooltip_Locksmith_RepinExisting.en: Re-pin this lock with tweezers so a key you already carry opens it too. The key keeps everything it already opens.
Tooltip_Locksmith_RepinExisting.ch: 用鑷子為這把鎖重新配鎖, 讓你已攜帶的鑰匙也能打開它. 這把鑰匙原本能開的鎖仍然都能開.
Tooltip_Locksmith_RepinExisting.cn: 用镊子为这把锁重新配锁, 让你已携带的钥匙也能打开它. 这把钥匙原本能开的锁仍然都能开.

Tooltip_Locksmith_RepinKnowledge.en: Requires knowing how to re-pin a lock.
Tooltip_Locksmith_RepinKnowledge.ch: 需要懂得如何重新配鎖.
Tooltip_Locksmith_RepinKnowledge.cn: 需要懂得如何重新配锁.

Tooltip_Locksmith_SecurityDoor.en: This is a security door. Picking its lock and prying its frame are both far harder than on an ordinary door.
Tooltip_Locksmith_SecurityDoor.ch: 這是一扇安全門. 撬開它的鎖或撬開它的門框都比一般的門困難得多.
Tooltip_Locksmith_SecurityDoor.cn: 这是一扇防盗门. 撬开它的锁或撬开它的门框都比普通的门困难得多.

Tooltip_craft_NeedsAdvFenceframeDesc.en: Must be built on a advanced fence frame.
Tooltip_craft_NeedsAdvFenceframeDesc.ch: 必須建在進階柵欄框架上.
Tooltip_craft_NeedsAdvFenceframeDesc.cn: 必须建在进阶栅栏框架上.

Tooltip_craft_caneDoorDesc.en: Diseño de una puerta de caña. Se debe colocar en el marco de una puerta.
Tooltip_craft_caneDoorDesc.ch: 甘蔗門的設計. 必須安裝在門框上.
Tooltip_craft_caneDoorDesc.cn: 甘蔗门的设计. 必须安装在门框上.

Tooltip_craft_caneFenceGateDesc.en:
¡Cruza al otro lado de una cerca sin tener que
escalar sobre ella!
Tooltip_craft_caneFenceGateDesc.ch:
穿過柵欄到另一側, 不必
翻越它!
Tooltip_craft_caneFenceGateDesc.cn:
穿过栅栏到另一侧, 不必
翻越它!

Tooltip_CU_Anticoagulant.en: Thins the blood until a clot stops growing, and keeps it thin for about three days. Everything that was going to bleed now bleeds for longer.
Tooltip_CU_Anticoagulant.ch: 使血液變稀直到血栓停止增大, 並維持約三天. 原本就會流血的部位, 現在會流得更久.
Tooltip_CU_Anticoagulant.cn: 使血液变稀直到血栓停止增大, 并维持约三天. 原本就会流血的部位, 现在会流得更久.

Tooltip_CU_ChestNeedle.en: Fourteen gauge, long enough to reach. For a chest that is filling with air and crushing the lung inside it. Four in the pack.
Tooltip_CU_ChestNeedle.ch: 14 號針, 長度足以刺到位. 用於胸腔正在充氣、壓迫內部肺臟的情況. 一包四支.
Tooltip_CU_ChestNeedle.cn: 14 号针, 长度足以刺到位. 用于胸腔正在充气、压迫内部肺脏的情况. 一包四支.

Tooltip_CU_Crutch.en: Hold it to walk properly on one leg.
Tooltip_CU_Crutch.ch: 拿著它就能用單腿正常行走.
Tooltip_CU_Crutch.cn: 拿着它就能用单腿正常行走.

Tooltip_CU_Defibrillator.en: Pads, a capacitor and eight charges of battery. It can put a heart back into rhythm, and it can take one out of rhythm just as easily. Whoever takes the shock goes out cold either way.
Tooltip_CU_Defibrillator.ch: 電極貼片、電容器以及可電擊八次的電池. 它能讓心臟恢復正常節律, 也同樣容易讓心臟失去節律. 無論如何, 受電擊者都會昏過去.
Tooltip_CU_Defibrillator.cn: 电极片、电容器以及可电击八次的电池. 它能让心脏恢复正常节律, 也同样容易让心脏失去节律. 无论如何, 受电击者都会昏过去.

Tooltip_CU_Diuretic.en: Takes the water off a chest that is drowning from the inside. It will also take it off the rest of you, so drink.
Tooltip_CU_Diuretic.ch: 排出胸腔裡讓人從內部溺斃的積水. 它也會排掉你身體其他部位的水分, 所以要多喝水.
Tooltip_CU_Diuretic.cn: 排出胸腔里让人从内部溺毙的积水. 它也会排掉你身体其他部位的水分, 所以要多喝水.

Tooltip_CU_Fentanyl.en: Measured in specks. Nothing hurts at all for a little while. The dose band is barely there, and past it your chest locks up.
Tooltip_CU_Fentanyl.ch: 以微粒計量. 短時間內完全感覺不到任何疼痛. 安全劑量範圍極窄, 一旦超過, 你的胸口就會僵住.
Tooltip_CU_Fentanyl.cn: 以微粒计量. 短时间内完全感觉不到任何疼痛. 安全剂量范围极窄, 一旦超过, 你的胸口就会僵住.

Tooltip_CU_Heroin.en: Street cut, strength unknown. Takes the pain and the misery with it, and takes them back when it wears off. Too much and you stop breathing.
Tooltip_CU_Heroin.ch: 街頭摻雜貨, 純度不明. 能帶走疼痛與痛苦, 藥效退去時又會把它們還回來. 過量就會停止呼吸.
Tooltip_CU_Heroin.cn: 街头掺杂货, 纯度不明. 能带走疼痛与痛苦, 药效退去时又会把它们还回来. 过量就会停止呼吸.

Tooltip_CU_JournalBlood.en: Blood: losing it, running out of it, and clotting where it should not. Read it to learn the terms.
Tooltip_CU_JournalBlood.ch: 血液: 失血、血量耗竭, 以及在不該凝血的地方凝血. 閱讀以學會相關術語.
Tooltip_CU_JournalBlood.cn: 血液: 失血、血量耗竭, 以及在不该凝血的地方凝血. 阅读以学会相关术语.

Tooltip_CU_JournalChest.en: Everything that goes wrong in a chest: broken ribs, a collapsed lung, fluid, infection, what was breathed in. Read it to learn the terms.
Tooltip_CU_JournalChest.ch: 胸腔裡可能出的一切問題: 肋骨骨折、肺塌陷、積液、感染、吸入的東西. 閱讀以學會相關術語.
Tooltip_CU_JournalChest.cn: 胸腔里可能出的一切问题: 肋骨骨折、肺塌陷、积液、感染、吸入的东西. 阅读以学会相关术语.

Tooltip_CU_JournalEmergency.en: Sugar, water, kidneys and body heat: the things that kill quietly. Read it to learn the terms.
Tooltip_CU_JournalEmergency.ch: 血糖、水分、腎臟與體溫: 那些悄無聲息就能致命的東西. 閱讀以學會相關術語.
Tooltip_CU_JournalEmergency.cn: 血糖、水分、肾脏与体温: 那些悄无声息就能致命的东西. 阅读以学会相关术语.

Tooltip_CU_JournalInfection.en: Wounds that go bad, and what they go on to become. Read it to learn the terms.
Tooltip_CU_JournalInfection.ch: 惡化的傷口, 以及它們接下來會演變成什麼. 閱讀以學會相關術語.
Tooltip_CU_JournalInfection.cn: 恶化的伤口, 以及它们接下来会演变成什么. 阅读以学会相关术语.

Tooltip_CU_JournalTrauma.en: Crushed limbs, head injuries, and what the worst days leave behind in a mind. Read it to learn the terms.
Tooltip_CU_JournalTrauma.ch: 壓碎的肢體、頭部創傷, 以及最難熬的日子在心中留下的東西. 閱讀以學會相關術語.
Tooltip_CU_JournalTrauma.cn: 压碎的肢体、头部创伤, 以及最难熬的日子在心中留下的东西. 阅读以学会相关术语.

Tooltip_CU_Morphine.en: A hospital ampoule. Kills pain for a long time and has the most forgiving dose of the three. Too much is a long sleep you cannot be woken from.
Tooltip_CU_Morphine.ch: 醫院用安瓿. 止痛時間長, 是三者中劑量最寬容的. 過量就是一場叫不醒的長眠.
Tooltip_CU_Morphine.cn: 医院用安瓿. 止痛时间长, 是三者中剂量最宽容的. 过量就是一场叫不醒的长眠.

Tooltip_CU_Needed_antibiotics.en: For the infection you already have. Take it.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_antibiotics.ch: 用於你已經有的感染. 吃吧.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_antibiotics.cn: 用于你已经有的感染. 吃吧.

Tooltip_CU_Needed_anticoagulant.en: Thins the blood until the clot stops growing. Your problem list wants this.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_anticoagulant.ch: 使血液變稀直到血栓停止增大. 你的問題清單需要這個.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_anticoagulant.cn: 使血液变稀直到血栓停止增大. 你的问题列表需要这个.

Tooltip_CU_Needed_decompress.en: Lets the air out of a chest that is crushing the lung inside it. Your problem list wants this NOW.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_decompress.ch: 排出胸腔裡壓迫內部肺臟的空氣. 你的問題清單「立刻」需要這個.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_decompress.cn: 排出胸腔里压迫内部肺脏的空气. 你的问题列表“立刻”需要这个.

Tooltip_CU_Needed_diuretic.en: Takes the water off a chest that is drowning from the inside. Your problem list wants this.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_diuretic.ch: 排出胸腔裡讓人從內部溺斃的積水. 你的問題清單需要這個.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_diuretic.cn: 排出胸腔里让人从内部溺毙的积水. 你的问题列表需要这个.

Tooltip_CU_Needed_fluids.en: Runs a litre into a circulation that has nothing left in it. Your problem list wants this now.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_fluids.ch: 為已經空無一物的循環系統輸入一公升液體. 你的問題清單現在就需要這個.
Tooltip_CU_Needed_fluids.cn: 为已经空无一物的循环系统输入一升液体. 你的问题列表现在就需要这个.

Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_antibiotics.en: For a wound infection, sepsis, pneumonia or tetanus. Nothing on your problem list needs it yet.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_antibiotics.ch: 用於傷口感染、敗血症、肺炎或破傷風. 你的問題清單上目前還沒有需要它的項目.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_antibiotics.cn: 用于伤口感染、败血症、肺炎或破伤风. 你的问题列表上目前还没有需要它的项目.

Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_anticoagulant.en: For a clot in a leg, or one that has reached the lungs. Nothing needs it yet.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_anticoagulant.ch: 用於腿部血栓, 或已進入肺部的血栓. 目前還沒有需要它的情況.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_anticoagulant.cn: 用于腿部血栓, 或已进入肺部的血栓. 目前还没有需要它的情况.

Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_decompress.en: For a tension pneumothorax: a chest filling with air. Nothing on your problem list needs it yet.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_decompress.ch: 用於張力性氣胸: 胸腔正在充氣. 你的問題清單上目前還沒有需要它的項目.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_decompress.cn: 用于张力性气胸: 胸腔正在充气. 你的问题列表上目前还没有需要它的项目.

Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_diuretic.en: For pulmonary oedema: lungs filling because the heart cannot clear them. Nothing needs it yet.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_diuretic.ch: 用於肺水腫: 心臟排不掉肺裡的液體, 導致肺部積水. 目前還沒有需要用到它的情況.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_diuretic.cn: 用于肺水肿: 心脏排不掉肺里的液体, 导致肺部积水. 目前还没有需要用到它的情况.

Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_fluids.en: For haemorrhagic shock or failing kidneys - an empty circulation. Nothing on your problem list needs it yet.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_fluids.ch: 用於出血性休克或腎衰竭 - 循環血量不足. 你的病況清單上目前還沒有需要用到它的項目.
Tooltip_CU_NotNeeded_fluids.cn: 用于出血性休克或肾衰竭 - 循环血量不足. 你的病况清单上目前还没有需要用到它的项目.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_airway.ch: 不需要. 你的雙手就夠了.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_airway.cn: 不需要. 你的双手就够了.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_debride.en: Any blade - kitchen knives, hunting knives, scalpels.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_debride.ch: 任何刀刃都行 - 菜刀、獵刀、手術刀.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_debride.cn: 任何刀刃都行 - 菜刀、猎刀、手术刀.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_decompress.en: A Decompression Needle. Medical clinics, hospital lockers and shelves, ambulances and army bunker medical rooms. Four uses to a pack.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_decompress.ch: 一支減壓針. 可在診所、醫院的置物櫃與架子、救護車和軍事地堡的醫務室找到. 一包可用四次.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_decompress.cn: 一支减压针. 可在诊所、医院的储物柜与架子、救护车和军事地堡的医务室找到. 一包可用四次.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fasciotomy.en: Any blade - kitchen knives, hunting knives, scalpels.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fasciotomy.ch: 任何刀刃都行 - 菜刀、獵刀、手術刀.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fasciotomy.cn: 任何刀刃都行 - 菜刀、猎刀、手术刀.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fluids.en: A Bag of Saline. Medical clinics, hospital lockers and shelves, ambulances and army bunker medical rooms.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fluids.ch: 一袋生理食鹽水. 可在診所、醫院的置物櫃與架子、救護車和軍事地堡的醫務室找到.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_fluids.cn: 一袋生理盐水. 可在诊所、医院的储物柜与架子、救护车和军事地堡的医务室找到.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_strap.en: A bandage, ripped sheet or rag - medicine cabinets and first aid kits, or tear up any sheet or clothing.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_strap.ch: 繃帶、碎布或破布 - 可在藥櫃和急救箱找到, 或撕開任何床單或衣物.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_strap.cn: 绷带、碎布条或破布 - 可在药柜和急救箱找到, 或撕开任何床单或衣物.

Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_trepan.en: A saw - hardware stores, garages, toolboxes. The same one amputation uses.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_trepan.ch: 一把鋸子 - 五金行、車庫、工具箱. 跟截肢用的是同一種.
Tooltip_CU_ProcNeeds_trepan.cn: 一把锯子 - 五金店、车库、工具箱. 跟截肢用的是同一种.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_airway.en: Clear what somebody brought up out of their airway so they can breathe again.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_airway.ch: 清除某人吐進呼吸道的東西, 讓對方能重新呼吸.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_airway.cn: 清除某人吐进呼吸道的东西, 让对方能重新呼吸.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_debride.en: Cut the dead and dirty tissue out of a wound so the infection in it has nothing left to live on.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_debride.ch: 把傷口裡壞死與骯髒的組織切掉, 讓其中的感染無處可存.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_debride.cn: 把伤口里坏死与肮脏的组织切掉, 让其中的感染无处可存.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_decompress.en: Put a needle between the ribs to let out the air that is trapped in the chest and crushing the lung. This is the most urgent thing in the mod.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_decompress.ch: 把針插進肋骨之間, 放出困在胸腔裡、壓迫肺部的空氣. 這是本模組中最緊急的處置.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_decompress.cn: 把针插进肋骨之间, 放出困在胸腔里、压迫肺部的空气. 这是本模组中最紧急的处置.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fasciotomy.en: Cut the sheath around a swollen limb open before the pressure inside it strangles the limb.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fasciotomy.ch: 在腫脹肢體內部的壓力把它勒死之前, 切開包覆肢體的筋膜.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fasciotomy.cn: 在肿胀肢体内部的压力把它勒死之前, 切开包裹肢体的筋膜.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fluids.en: Run a litre of saline into a vein. It is not blood, but it is volume, and volume is most of a blood pressure.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fluids.ch: 把一公升生理食鹽水輸入靜脈. 它不是血, 但它是容量, 而血壓大半就靠容量.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_fluids.cn: 把一升生理盐水输入静脉. 它不是血, 但它是容量, 而血压大半就靠容量.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_strap.en: Bind the chest so the broken ribs stop grinding with every breath, and the lung underneath stops taking damage.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_strap.ch: 把胸部綁緊, 讓斷掉的肋骨不再隨每次呼吸互相摩擦, 底下的肺也不再受損.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_strap.cn: 把胸部绑紧, 让断掉的肋骨不再随每次呼吸互相摩擦, 底下的肺也不再受损.

Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_trepan.en: Drill through the skull to let out a bleed that has nowhere else to go. It is the hardest thing here and there is nothing else to try.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_trepan.ch: 在頭骨上鑽孔, 放出無處可去的顱內出血. 這是這裡最困難的處置, 而且也沒有別的辦法可試了.
Tooltip_CU_ProcWhat_trepan.cn: 在头骨上钻孔, 放出无处可去的颅内出血. 这是这里最困难的处置, 而且也没有别的办法可试了.

Tooltip_CU_ProstheticArm.en: Fits any arm amputation once the stump is cauterized.
Tooltip_CU_ProstheticArm.ch: 殘肢燒灼止血後, 可裝在任何手臂截肢處.
Tooltip_CU_ProstheticArm.cn: 残肢烧灼止血后, 可装在任何手臂截肢处.

Tooltip_CU_ProstheticLeg.en: Fits any leg amputation once the stump is cauterized.
Tooltip_CU_ProstheticLeg.ch: 殘肢燒灼止血後, 可裝在任何腿部截肢處.
Tooltip_CU_ProstheticLeg.cn: 残肢烧灼止血后, 可装在任何腿部截肢处.

Tooltip_CU_SalineBag.en: A litre of salt water and a line to put it in with. It is not blood, but it is volume, and volume is most of a blood pressure.
Tooltip_CU_SalineBag.ch: 一公升鹽水和一條輸液管. 它不是血, 但它是容量, 而血壓大半就靠容量.
Tooltip_CU_SalineBag.cn: 一升盐水和一根输液管. 它不是血, 但它是容量, 而血压大半就靠容量.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredArm.en: A whole arm. You would have to be very hungry.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredArm.ch: 一整條手臂. 你得餓到極點才會想吃.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredArm.cn: 一整条手臂. 你得饿到极点才会想吃.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredFoot.en: Somebody's foot. It would feed you.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredFoot.ch: 某人的腳. 可以拿來果腹.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredFoot.cn: 某人的脚. 可以拿来果腹.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredForearm.en: An arm from the elbow down. It would feed you for a day.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredForearm.ch: 從手肘以下的手臂. 夠你吃一天.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredForearm.cn: 从手肘以下的手臂. 够你吃一天.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredHand.en: Somebody's hand. It would feed you.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredHand.ch: 某人的手. 可以拿來果腹.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredHand.cn: 某人的手. 可以拿来果腹.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredLeg.en: A whole leg. Enough for a week, and you will think about it for longer.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredLeg.ch: 一整條腿. 夠吃一個星期, 而你會惦記它更久.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredLeg.cn: 一整条腿. 够吃一个星期, 而你会惦记它更久.

Tooltip_CU_SeveredLowerLeg.en: A leg from the knee down. There is a lot of meat on it.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredLowerLeg.ch: 從膝蓋以下的腿. 上面有很多肉.
Tooltip_CU_SeveredLowerLeg.cn: 从膝盖以下的腿. 上面有很多肉.

Tooltip_CU_Wheelchair.en: Sit in it to get about without legs, much faster than crawling, and fight from it. It cannot take stairs or climb; get out of it first.
Tooltip_CU_Wheelchair.ch: 坐上去就能在沒有腿的情況下移動, 比爬行快得多, 還能坐著戰鬥. 它無法上下樓梯或攀爬; 請先下輪椅.
Tooltip_CU_Wheelchair.cn: 坐上去就能在没有腿的情况下移动, 比爬行快得多, 还能坐着战斗. 它无法上下楼梯或攀爬; 请先下轮椅.

Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticArm.en: Scrap wood and duct tape. Fits any arm amputation once the stump is cauterized, but it is slow, it cannot climb, and it wears out and breaks.
Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticArm.ch: 廢木材加布膠帶. 殘肢燒灼止血後, 可裝在任何手臂截肢處, 但速度慢、無法攀爬, 還會磨損壞掉.
Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticArm.cn: 废木材加管道胶带. 残肢烧灼止血后, 可装在任何手臂截肢处, 但速度慢、无法攀爬, 还会磨损坏掉.

Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticLeg.en: Scrap wood and duct tape. Fits any leg amputation once the stump is cauterized, but you will limp on it and never run, it cannot climb, and it wears out and breaks.
Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticLeg.ch: 廢木材加布膠帶. 殘肢燒灼止血後, 可裝在任何腿部截肢處, 但使用它時只能跛行、無法奔跑, 也無法攀爬, 還會磨損壞掉.
Tooltip_CU_WoodenProstheticLeg.cn: 废木材加管道胶带. 残肢烧灼止血后, 可装在任何腿部截肢处, 但使用它时只能跛行、无法奔跑, 也无法攀爬, 还会磨损坏掉.

Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_jumper_po.en: Thermal polo-neck sweater used by Favalli. Provides insulation against the cold.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_jumper_po.ch: Favalli 穿的保暖高領毛衣. 能隔絕寒冷.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_jumper_po.cn: Favalli 穿的保暖高领毛衣. 能抵御寒冷.

Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_mascara2.en: Diving mask modified by Favalli. Protects the eyes and face.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_mascara2.ch: 經 Favalli 改裝的潛水面罩. 可保護眼睛與臉部.
Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_mascara2.cn: 经 Favalli 改装的潜水面罩. 可保护眼睛和面部.

Tooltip_trajeeternauta_favalli_mascara2_.en: Favalli diving mask without an installed filter.

UI_VorpallySauced_AdminTip.cn: 管理员工具. 这些操作作用于你手上的武器. 服务器会先检查你的权限等级才会应用.

UI_VorpallySauced_AdminNeedEquip.en: Equip this weapon first. Admin actions apply to whatever is in your hands.
UI_VorpallySauced_AdminNeedEquip.ch: 請先裝備這把武器. 管理員操作只會套用到你手上的東西.
UI_VorpallySauced_AdminNeedEquip.cn: 请先装备这把武器. 管理员操作只会应用到你手上的东西.

UI_VorpallySauced_AdminFullyBlooded.en: Already Blooded. There is no further tier to force.
UI_VorpallySauced_AdminFullyBlooded.ch: 已達血契. 沒有更高階可以強制了.
UI_VorpallySauced_AdminFullyBlooded.cn: 已达血契. 没有更高阶可以强制了.

UI_VorpallySauced_AdminResetConfirm.en: Strip all VorpallySauced progression from %1? Its kills and affixes are gone for good.
UI_VorpallySauced_AdminResetConfirm.ch: 要清除 %1 的所有 VorpallySauced 進度嗎? 它的擊殺數與詞綴會永久消失.
UI_VorpallySauced_AdminResetConfirm.cn: 要清除 %1 的所有 VorpallySauced 进度吗? 它的击杀数与词缀会永久消失.

UI_Blunt.ch: 一根… 雪茄皮大麻菸
UI_Blunt.cn: 一根… 雪茄皮大麻烟

UI_Spliff.ch: 一根… 混菸草大麻菸
UI_Spliff.cn: 一根… 混烟草大麻烟

UI_speech_cough1.en: I can't finish smoking this, I'll save half for later
UI_speech_cough1.ch: 這根我抽不完, 留一半等等再抽
UI_speech_cough1.cn: 这根我抽不完, 留一半等等再抽

UI_speech_cough2.en: I should probably get a drink, starting to get cottonmouth
UI_speech_cough2.ch: 我大概該喝點東西, 嘴巴開始發乾了
UI_speech_cough2.cn: 我大概该喝点东西, 嘴巴开始发干了

UI_speech_cough3.en: This is too much for me, I'm done smoking.
UI_speech_cough3.ch: 這對我來說太猛了, 我不抽了.
UI_speech_cough3.cn: 这对我来说太猛了, 我不抽了.

UI_speech_cough4.en: I think I'll have a look in the fridge, I have munchies.
UI_speech_cough4.ch: 我想去冰箱找點吃的, 我嘴饞了.
UI_speech_cough4.cn: 我想去冰箱找点吃的, 我嘴馋了.

UI_speech_cough5.ch: 天啊… 這也太強了 *咳* *咳*
UI_speech_cough5.cn: 天啊… 这也太强了 *咳* *咳*

UI_speech_cough6.en: I need to take a break from smoking.
UI_speech_cough6.ch: 我得先停一下, 別再抽了.
UI_speech_cough6.cn: 我得先停一下, 别再抽了.

UI_speech_kief.en: Looks like there's some kief under this screen...
UI_speech_kief.ch: 這個濾網下面好像有些大麻花粉…
UI_speech_kief.cn: 这个滤网下面好像有些大麻花粉…

UI_LTSProneMessage_ICantDoThis.en: I can't do that while I'm in the prone position.
UI_LTSProneMessage_ICantDoThis.ch: 我臥倒的時候沒法這麼做.
UI_LTSProneMessage_ICantDoThis.cn: 我卧倒的时候没法这么做.

UI_LTSProneMessage_ICantDoThisCrawling.en: I can't do that while I'm Crawling.
UI_LTSProneMessage_ICantDoThisCrawling.ch: 我爬行的時候沒法這麼做.
UI_LTSProneMessage_ICantDoThisCrawling.cn: 我爬行的时候没法这么做.

UI_LTSProneMessage_ICantEquipMeleeWhileP.en: I can't use that type of weapon while I'm in a prone position.
UI_LTSProneMessage_ICantEquipMeleeWhileP.ch: 我臥倒的時候沒法使用這種武器.
UI_LTSProneMessage_ICantEquipMeleeWhileP.cn: 我卧倒的时候没法使用这种武器.

UI_LTS_Error01.en: Error 01: Corrupted Data in Lethal Stealth Mod
UI_LTS_Error01.ch: 錯誤01: 致命潛行模組資料損壞
UI_LTS_Error01.cn: 错误01: 致命潜行模组数据损坏

UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_HudSize_too.en: A higher value will increase the size of the posture hud. <LINE>Recommended: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[100]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_HudSize_too.ch: 數值越高, 姿勢HUD的尺寸越大. <LINE>推薦設定: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[100]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_HudSize_too.cn: 数值越高, 姿势HUD的尺寸越大. <LINE>推荐设置: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[100]

UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowContext.en: Choose if you want to see the 'prone' option in the contextual menu. <LINE>Recommended: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[Enabled]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowContext.ch: 選擇是否在右鍵選單中顯示「臥倒」選項. <LINE>推薦設定: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[啟用]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowContext.cn: 选择是否在右键菜单中显示“卧倒”选项. <LINE>推荐设置: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[启用]

UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowHud_too.en: Choose if you want to see the posture hud. <LINE>Recommended: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[Enabled]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowHud_too.ch: 選擇是否顯示姿勢HUD. <LINE>推薦設定: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[啟用]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowHud_too.cn: 选择是否显示姿势HUD. <LINE>推荐设置: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[启用]

UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_Transparenc.en: A higher value will increase the Hud transparency. <LINE>Recommended: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[35%]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_Transparenc.ch: 數值越高, HUD的透明度越高. <LINE>推薦設定: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[35%%]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_Transparenc.cn: 数值越高, HUD的透明度越高. <LINE>推荐设置: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[35%%]

UI_ForgedByCombat_Tooltip_NextLevel.ch: 下一級: %1 次擊殺 (還差%2)
UI_ForgedByCombat_Tooltip_NextLevel.cn: 下一级: %1 次击杀 (还差%2)

UI_ForgedByCombat_description.en: Fighting skill honed through melee combat. Each zombie killed sharpens your instincts and improves your attack speed, damage, and critical chance.
UI_ForgedByCombat_description.ch: 透過近身搏鬥磨練戰鬥技巧. 每消滅一個殭屍都會提升你的直覺, 提高攻速, 傷害和暴擊率
UI_ForgedByCombat_description.cn: 通过近身搏斗磨练战斗技巧. 每消灭一个僵尸都会提升你的直觉, 提高攻速, 伤害和暴击率

UI_gain_smoker.en: I'm really craving a cigarette right about now...
UI_gain_smoker.ch: 我現在真的很想來根菸…
UI_gain_smoker.cn: 我现在真的很想来根烟…

UI_lost_stoner.en: Been a while since I last smoked some weed...

UI_regain_smoker.en: I feel like having a cigarette...

UI_speech_seed1.en: Do I see a seed in this bud?
UI_speech_seed1.ch: 這朵花蕾裡是不是有顆種子?
UI_speech_seed1.cn: 这朵花蕾里是不是有颗种子?

UI_trait_stonerdesc.en: Does not get sleepy or hungry from smoking pot, but needs more for the same effect.
UI_trait_stonerdesc.ch: 抽大麻不會想睡也不會餓, 但要抽更多才能達到同樣效果.
UI_trait_stonerdesc.cn: 抽大麻不会想睡也不会饿, 但要抽更多才能达到同样效果.

UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.en: You were hooked up on benzos before the apocalypse.
UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.ch: 末日之前你就對苯二氮平類藥物成癮了.
UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.cn: 末日之前你就对苯二氮䓬类药物成瘾了.

UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.en: You had brain damaged. Focusing is now harder.
UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.ch: 你的大腦受過損傷. 現在更難集中注意力.
UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.cn: 你的大脑受过损伤. 现在更难集中注意力.

UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.en: You are interested in drugs and made a little too much researches.
UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.ch: 你對毒品很感興趣, 而且研究得有點過頭.
UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.cn: 你对毒品很感兴趣, 而且研究得有点过头.

UI_KD_Huffer_desc.en: You like to sniff things that shouldn't be...
UI_KD_Huffer_desc.ch: 你喜歡吸一些本來不該吸的東西…
UI_KD_Huffer_desc.cn: 你喜欢吸一些本来不该吸的东西…

UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.en: You took the habit of consumming low stimulant a little too much...
UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.ch: 你養成了服用輕度興奮劑的習慣, 而且用得有點多…
UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.cn: 你养成了服用轻度兴奋剂的习惯, 而且用得有点多…

UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.en: Idk how but you're addicted to raw opium
UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.ch: 不知怎麼的, 你對生鴉片上癮了
UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.cn: 不知怎么的, 你对生鸦片上瘾了

UI_KD_Tweaker_desc.ch: 你已離不開甲基安非他命.
UI_KD_Tweaker_desc.cn: 你已离不开甲基苯丙胺.

UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.en: Your skeleton is indestructable. Doesn't mean you are.
UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.ch: 你的骨骼堅不可摧. 但你可不是.
UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.cn: 你的骨骼坚不可摧. 但你可不是.

UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.en: Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it's not real.
UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.ch: 看不見不代表它不存在.
UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.cn: 看不见不代表它不存在.

UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.en: If you have the Celerity trait you will be notified when dodging a dragdown.
UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.ch: 若你擁有神速特質, 閃避被拖倒時會收到通知.
UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.cn: 若你拥有神速特质, 闪避被拖倒时会收到通知.

UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.en: If you have the Deadshot trait you will be notified when ammo is restored.
UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.ch: 若你擁有神射手特質, 恢復彈藥時會收到通知.
UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.cn: 若你拥有神射手特质, 恢复弹药时会收到通知.

UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.en: If you have the Invisibility trait you will be notified when triggering an assassination.
UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.ch: 若你擁有隱形特質, 觸發暗殺時會收到通知.
UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.cn: 若你拥有隐形特质, 触发暗杀时会收到通知.

UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.en: If you have the Adamantium trait you will be notified when claws are extended.
UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.ch: 若你擁有亞德曼合金特質, 伸出利爪時會收到通知.
UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.cn: 若你拥有艾德曼合金特质, 伸出利爪时会收到通知.

UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.en: If you have the Telekenisis trait you will be notified when pushing a zombie back.
UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.ch: 若你擁有念力特質, 推開殭屍時會收到通知.
UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.cn: 若你拥有念力特质, 推开僵尸时会收到通知.

UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.en:
Start with an indestructable adamantium skeleton.
Pop adamantium claws when attacking unarmed.
UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.ch:
開局即擁有堅不可摧的亞德曼合金骨骼.
徒手攻擊時彈出亞德曼合金爪.
UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.cn:
开局即拥有坚不可摧的艾德曼合金骨骼.
徒手攻击时弹出艾德曼合金爪.

UI_trait_CelerityDesc.en:
Superhuman speed and reaction time.
Faster combat and recovery animations.
Faster movement and timed actions.
Chance to dodge zombie attacks.
Dextrous
UI_trait_CelerityDesc.ch:
超乎常人的速度與反應.
戰鬥與恢復動作更快.
移動與計時動作更快.
有機率閃避殭屍攻擊.
眼疾手快
UI_trait_CelerityDesc.cn:
超乎常人的速度与反应.
战斗与恢复动作更快.
移动与计时动作更快.
有几率闪避僵尸攻击.
眼疾手快

UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.en:
One shot. One kill. Every time.
Firearms degrade more slowly, and may restore ammo when fired.
Desensitized
Eagle Eyed
UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.ch:
一槍一命, 從不落空.
槍械磨損更慢, 射擊時可能恢復彈藥.
麻木不仁
目光銳利
UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.cn:
一枪一命, 从不落空.
枪械磨损更慢, 射击时可能恢复弹药.
麻木不仁
目光锐利

UI_trait_EideticDesc.en:
Perfect recall and comprehension.
Gain skill levels by reading skill books.
Automatically know all recipes.
Fast Learner
Fast Reader
UI_trait_EideticDesc.ch:
記憶與理解力完美無缺.
閱讀技能書即可提升技能等級.
自動學會所有配方.
學習神速
閱讀神速
UI_trait_EideticDesc.cn:
记忆与理解力完美无缺.
阅读技能书即可提升技能等级.
自动学会所有配方.
学习神速
阅读神速

UI_trait_FlightDesc.en:
Sky roads are faster than walking.
Double tap the vehicle key to toggle flight mode. Page Up/Down to change elevation.
Constant feather fall.
UI_trait_FlightDesc.ch:
走天路比走路快.
連按兩次載具鍵切換飛行模式. 用 Page Up/Down 調整高度.
永久羽落效果.
UI_trait_FlightDesc.cn:
走天路比走路快.
连按两次车辆键切换飞行模式. 用 Page Up/Down 调整高度.
永久羽落效果.

UI_trait_HammerDesc.en:
Explosive hammer strikes.
Will blow the pants right off you.
Works with blunt weapons.
UI_trait_HammerDesc.ch:
爆炸性的錘擊.
威力大到能把你的褲子轟飛.
適用於鈍器.
UI_trait_HammerDesc.cn:
爆炸性的锤击.
威力大到能把你的裤子轰飞.
适用于钝器.

UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.en:
Become invisible while sneaking.
Assassinate enemies while invisible.
Graceful
Inconspicuous
UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.ch:
潛行時變得隱形.
隱形時可暗殺敵人.
身輕如燕
毫不起眼
UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.cn:
潜行时变得隐形.
隐形时可暗杀敌人.
身轻如燕
毫不起眼

UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.en:
Shoot fricken' laser beams out of your eyes.
Wear any eyewear to activate. Equip from the hotbar, then point and shoot.
Eagle Eyed
UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.ch:
從眼睛射出該死的雷射光束.
戴上任何眼部裝備即可啟用. 從快捷欄裝備後瞄準射擊.
目光銳利
UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.cn:
从眼睛射出该死的激光光束.
戴上任何眼部装备即可启用. 从快捷栏装备后瞄准射击.
目光锐利

UI_trait_LastStandDesc.en: Explode in a last stand of defiance when about to be dragged down.
UI_trait_LastStandDesc.ch: 即將被拖倒時, 以最後的反抗引爆自身.
UI_trait_LastStandDesc.cn: 即将被拖倒时, 以最后的反抗引爆自身.

UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.en:
One punch. Everything dies.
Obliterate doors, trees, zombies, and zombie hordes with a single unarmed strike.
UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.ch:
一拳. 萬物皆滅.
徒手一擊即可粉碎門扉, 樹木, 殭屍與整群屍潮.
UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.cn:
一拳. 万物皆灭.
徒手一击即可粉碎门扉, 树木, 僵尸与整群尸潮.

UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.en:
Start with nigh-impenetrable plot armor.
Just don't forget to equip it.
UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.ch:
開局即擁有幾乎無法穿透的主角光環.
只是別忘了把它裝備上.
UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.cn:
开局即拥有几乎无法穿透的主角光环.
只是别忘了把它装备上.

UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.en:
Violence is a part of you now.
Increased boredom.
Boost mood with every kill.
UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.ch:
暴力已成為你的一部分.
更容易感到無聊.
每次擊殺都能提振心情.
UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.cn:
暴力已成为你的一部分.
更容易感到无聊.
每次击杀都能提振心情.

UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.en:
Wounds heal in minutes.
Never become diseased or infected.
Immune to zombification.
Fast Healer
UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.ch:
傷口幾分鐘就癒合.
永不生病或感染.
免疫殭屍化.
快速恢復
UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.cn:
伤口几分钟就愈合.
永不生病或感染.
免疫僵尸化.
快速恢复

UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.en:
Passively push zombies away with telekinetic shields.
Shout to project devastating telekinetic blasts.
Drains endurance; will fail if you get too tired.
UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.ch:
被動以念力護盾推開殭屍.
大喊即可發出毀滅性的念力衝擊波.
會消耗耐力; 太過疲勞時將會失敗.
UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.cn:
被动以念力护盾推开僵尸.
大喊即可发出毁灭性的念力冲击波.
会消耗耐力; 太过疲劳时将会失败.

UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.en:
Shout to summon the wrath of the heavens.
Only works outside.
Beware of fires!
UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.ch:
大喊即可召喚天罰.
僅能在室外使用.
小心引發火災!
UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.cn:
大喊即可召唤天罚.
仅能在室外使用.
小心引发火灾!

UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.en:
Sprint straight through your enemies. They will regret it.
Just don't run out of endurance in the middle of a horde.
UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.ch:
直接衝過敵人. 他們會後悔的.
只是別在屍潮中間耗盡耐力.
UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.cn:
直接冲过敌人. 他们会后悔的.
只是别在尸潮中间耗尽耐力.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.en: It feels your fear, and hates it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.ch: 它感受到你的恐懼, 並為此憎惡.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.cn: 它感受到你的恐惧, 并为此憎恶.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.en: Just a tool. Nothing has marked it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.ch: 不過是件工具. 還沒有任何事物在它身上留下痕跡.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.cn: 不过是件工具. 还没有任何事物在它身上留下痕迹.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.en: Rain and red run together. Nothing sticks.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.ch: 雨水與血色一同流下. 什麼也沾不住.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.cn: 雨水与血色一同流下. 什么也沾不住.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.en: Late and still. It dreams of edges it has met.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.ch: 夜深而靜. 它夢見自己交手過的每一道鋒刃.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.cn: 夜深而静. 它梦见自己交手过的每一道锋刃.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.en: It won't come clean. It doesn't try.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.ch: 它擦不乾淨. 它也不打算擦.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.cn: 它擦不干净. 它也不打算擦.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.en: Idle and indoors. It dozes against your side.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.ch: 閒置於室內. 它靠在你身側打盹.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.cn: 闲置于室内. 它靠在你身侧打盹.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.en: Blooded in the dark. It pulls toward the next one.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中飲過血. 它拉扯著奔向下一個.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中饮过血. 它拉扯着奔向下一个.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.en: Your dread strikes a spark in it, then nothing.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.ch: 你的恐懼在它體內擦出一星火花, 隨即歸於虛無.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.cn: 你的恐惧在它体内擦出一星火花, 随即归于虚无.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.en: The light goes. It feels the long dark coming on.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.ch: 天光將盡. 它感覺到漫長的黑暗正在逼近.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.cn: 天光将尽. 它感觉到漫长的黑暗正在逼近.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.en: Slick to the grip and full — and hungry anyway.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.ch: 握柄濕滑, 已然飽足——卻依舊飢渴.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.cn: 握柄湿滑, 已然饱足——却依旧饥渴.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.en: Grey at the edges — you've lasted the night. It eases.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.ch: 天邊泛起灰白——你熬過了這一夜. 它鬆弛下來.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.cn: 天边泛起灰白——你熬过了这一夜. 它松弛下来.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.en: Quiet warmth in the daylight. Content, briefly.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.ch: 日光下靜靜地溫著. 短暫地心滿意足.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.cn: 日光下静静地温着. 短暂地心满意足.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.en: Half-fed in the dark, casting for more.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中半飽, 仍四處搜尋著下一口.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中半饱, 仍四处搜寻着下一口.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.en: No voice in it — only the weight of the dead.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.ch: 它體內沒有聲音——只有亡者的重量.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.cn: 它体内没有声音——只有亡者的重量.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.en: Quiet — but it counts the dead it has made.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.ch: 靜默——但它清點著自己造就的亡者.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.cn: 静默——但它清点着自己造就的亡者.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.en: It won't settle. It paces in your hand.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.ch: 它靜不下來. 在你手中來回踱步.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.cn: 它静不下来. 在你手中来回踱步.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.en: The rain takes the blood. It lets go, for now.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.ch: 雨水帶走血跡. 它暫時鬆手了.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.cn: 雨水带走血迹. 它暂时松手了.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.en: Awake to the work now. It wants the rhythm to hold.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.ch: 它已為這場活計醒來. 它想讓這節奏持續下去.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.cn: 它已为这场活计醒来. 它想让这节奏持续下去.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.en: Clean and sheltered, it forgets what it saw.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.ch: 潔淨而有遮蔽, 它忘了自己看過什麼.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.cn: 洁净而有遮蔽, 它忘了自己看过什么.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.en: It rings between every blow. It does not want to stop.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.ch: 每一擊之間它都在鳴響. 它不想停下.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.cn: 每一击之间它都在鸣响. 它不想停下.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.en: Resting. Patient. It has all the time there is.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.ch: 歇息. 耐心. 它擁有世上全部的時間.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.cn: 歇息. 耐心. 它拥有世上全部的时间.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.en: Heavier than it was. It blames your tired arm.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.ch: 比先前更沉了. 它怪罪你疲憊的手臂.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.cn: 比先前更沉了. 它怪罪你疲惫的手臂.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.en: Clean under a dead sky. It wants that to change.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.ch: 在死寂的天空下潔淨無染. 它想改變這一點.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.cn: 在死寂的天空下洁净无染. 它想改变这一点.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.en: Too much death, too fast — it shudders to keep up.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.ch: 死亡太多, 太快——它顫抖著才勉強跟上.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.cn: 死亡太多, 太快——它颤抖着才勉强跟上.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.en: The dark leans in. It almost understands why.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.ch: 黑暗傾身逼近. 它幾乎明白了緣由.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.cn: 黑暗倾身逼近. 它几乎明白了缘由.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.en: The blood leaves a warmth it can't name.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.ch: 血留下一種它無法名狀的溫熱.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.cn: 血留下一种它无法名状的温热.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.en: Awake in the dark, listening with you.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中醒著, 與你一同傾聽.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中醒着, 与你一同倾听.

UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL.en: Double-click food eats the whole item

UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.en: When enabled, double-clicking food uses the vanilla behavior and eats the whole item instead of smart partial eating.
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.ch: 啟用後, 雙擊食物將採用原版行為, 直接吃掉整份, 而非智慧分次進食.
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.cn: 启用后, 双击食物将采用原版行为, 直接吃掉整份, 而非智能分次进食.

UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.ch: 搜尋: 忽略附帶種子
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.cn: 搜寻: 忽略附带种子

UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.en: Singleplayer: controlled only by Mod Options and overrides Sandbox. Multiplayer: controlled by the server Sandbox setting. When enabled, wild crops found through foraging still give the food item, but the automatically generated extra seed items are ignored.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.ch: 單人遊戲: 僅由模組選項控制, 並覆寫沙盒設定. 多人遊戲: 由伺服器沙盒設定控制. 啟用後, 搜尋找到的野生作物仍會給予食物物品, 但自動產生的額外種子物品會被忽略.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.cn: 单人游戏: 仅由模组选项控制, 并覆盖沙盒设置. 多人游戏: 由服务器沙盒设置控制. 启用后, 搜寻找到的野生作物仍会给予食物物品, 但自动产生的额外种子物品会被忽略.

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.en: Reload cleanup options are mutually exclusive: enable either dropping leftovers or deleting leftovers, never both. Deleting permanently removes the leftover item from your inventory.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.ch: 裝填清理選項互斥: 丟棄殘件與刪除殘件只能擇一啟用, 不可同時開啟. 刪除會將殘件從你的物品欄中永久移除.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.cn: 装填清理选项互斥: 丢弃残件与删除残件只能择一启用, 不可同时开启. 删除会将残件从你的物品栏中永久移除.

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.ch: 裝填鍵: 刪除損壞殘件
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.cn: 装填键: 删除损坏残件

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.en: Optional cleanup. Whenever a melee reload is executed by quick reload or by selecting a weapon from the hold-reload radial menu, broken melee leftovers are permanently deleted from the main inventory. This removes the leftover item from your inventory and cannot be used together with Drop Broken Leftovers.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.ch: 選用的清理功能. 每當透過快速裝填, 或從按住裝填鍵開啟的環形選單中選擇武器而執行近戰裝填時, 損壞的近戰殘件會從主物品欄中永久刪除. 此選項會將殘件從你的物品欄移除, 且不可與「丟棄損壞殘件」同時使用.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.cn: 可选的清理功能. 每当通过快速装填, 或从按住装填键打开的环形菜单中选择武器而执行近战装填时, 损坏的近战残件会从主物品栏中永久删除. 此选项会将残件从你的物品栏移除, 且不可与“丢弃损坏残件”同时使用.

UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.en: When enabled, combat-stance movement speed uses the selected Nimble limit only if your real Nimble level is higher. XP is not reduced.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.ch: 啟用後, 只有在你實際的靈活等級高於所選上限時, 戰鬥姿態的移動速度才會套用該上限. 經驗值不會減少.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.cn: 启用后, 只有在你实际的灵活等级高于所选上限时, 战斗姿态的移动速度才会应用该上限. 经验值不会减少.

UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.en: Sets the maximum effective Nimble level for combat-stance movement speed. If your real Nimble level is equal or lower, nothing is changed.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.ch: 設定戰鬥姿態移動速度所採用的靈活等級上限. 若你實際的靈活等級等於或低於此值, 則不會有任何變化.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.cn: 设定战斗姿态移动速度所采用的灵活等级上限. 若你实际的灵活等级等于或低于此值, 则不会有任何变化.

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.en: Double-click traps to add best bait
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.ch: 雙擊陷阱自動放入最佳誘餌
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.cn: 双击陷阱自动放入最佳诱饵

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.en: Double-click an empty trap to automatically use the best available fresh bait from your inventory. Rabbit bait is preferred when the trap can catch rabbits.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.ch: 雙擊空陷阱時, 自動從你的物品欄取用最佳的新鮮誘餌. 若該陷阱能捕捉兔子, 會優先使用兔子誘餌.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.cn: 双击空陷阱时, 自动从你的物品栏取用最佳的新鲜诱饵. 若该陷阱能捕捉兔子, 会优先使用兔子诱饵.

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.en: After placing a trap, automatically starts placing another trap of the same type if one is still available in your inventory.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.ch: 放置陷阱後, 若物品欄中仍有同類型陷阱, 會自動接著放置下一個.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.cn: 放置陷阱后, 若物品栏中仍有同类型陷阱, 会自动接着放置下一个.

UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.en: Color trap highlight by bait state
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.ch: 依誘餌狀態顯示陷阱高亮顏色
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.cn: 依诱饵状态显示陷阱高亮颜色

UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.en: Hovered traps use different highlight colors depending on whether they are baited, empty, or sprung.
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.ch: 滑鼠移過陷阱時, 會依已放餌, 空置或已觸發等狀態顯示不同的高亮顏色.
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.cn: 鼠标移过陷阱时, 会依已放饵, 空置或已触发等状态显示不同的高亮颜色.

UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.en: Continuously highlights nearby traps around you. Disabled by default for performance and visual clarity.
UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.ch: 持續高亮你周圍的陷阱. 為兼顧效能與畫面清晰, 預設為停用.
UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.cn: 持续高亮你周围的陷阱. 为兼顾性能与画面清晰, 默认为禁用.

UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.en: Show compact body-part warmth, wind, and protection changes in wear previews.
UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.ch: 在穿著預覽中以精簡形式顯示各身體部位的保溫, 防風和防護變化.
UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.cn: 在穿着预览中以精简形式显示各身体部位的保温, 防风和防护变化.

UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison.ch: 穿著預覽需按住快捷鍵
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison.cn: 穿着预览需按住快捷键

UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.en: Only show the inventory-hover wear preview while the keybind is pressed.
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.ch: 僅在按住快捷鍵時才顯示物品欄懸停的穿著預覽.
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.cn: 仅在按住快捷键时才显示物品栏悬停的穿着预览.

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.en: Controls diagnostic output for troubleshooting. Detailed logging may affect performance, so enable it only while reproducing an issue.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.ch: 控制用於排除問題的診斷輸出. 詳細記錄可能影響效能, 請僅在重現問題時啟用.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.cn: 控制用于排查问题的诊断输出. 详细日志可能影响性能, 请仅在复现问题时启用.

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.en: Returns materials obtained by dismantling an item to the container the dismantled item came from.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.ch: 將拆解物品所得的材料放回被拆解物品原本所在的容器.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.cn: 将拆解物品所得的材料放回被拆解物品原本所在的容器.

UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.en: You need to quit and reload to synchronize your inventory and traits
UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.ch: 你需要退出並重新載入才能同步你的物品欄與特質.
UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.cn: 你需要退出并重新加载才能同步你的物品栏与特质.

UI_ClothingType_BSizeClothes.ch: 衣櫃: B 尺寸服裝
UI_ClothingType_BSizeClothes.cn: 衣柜: B 尺寸服装

UI_trait_FashionmancerDesc.en:
Do you know what is most important in an apocalypse? style!
Start the game knowing all the clothing recipes from the Bianca Wardrobe Mod.
+1 Tailoring
UI_trait_FashionmancerDesc.ch:
你知道末日中最重要的是什麼嗎? 品味!
開局即掌握 Bianca 衣櫃模組的所有服裝配方.
+1 縫紉
UI_trait_FashionmancerDesc.cn:
你知道末日中最重要的是什么吗? 品味!
开局即掌握 Bianca 衣柜模组的所有服装配方.
+1 缝纫

UI_trait_zReAntibodiesDesc.en: Your immunity can suppress the zombie virus.
UI_trait_zReAntibodiesDesc.ch: 你的免疫系統能夠壓制殭屍病毒.
UI_trait_zReAntibodiesDesc.cn: 你的免疫系统能够压制僵尸病毒.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousBar.en: The barrel could not be identified. Try clicking it again.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousBar.ch: 無法識別該桶. 請再次點選它.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousBar.cn: 无法识别该桶. 请再次点击它.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousGen.en: The generator could not be identified. Try clicking again.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousGen.ch: 無法識別該發電機. 請再次點選.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousGen.cn: 无法识别该发电机. 请再次点击.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelAddFai.en: The barrel could not receive the liquid.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelIdMiss.en: The barrel could not be validated.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLockLo.en: The transfer was interrupted because the barrel changed state.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLockLo.ch: 由於該桶的狀態發生變化, 轉移被中斷.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLockLo.cn: 由于该桶的状态发生变化, 转移被中断.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLocked.en: Another player is already using this barrel.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLocked.ch: 另一名玩家正在使用這個桶.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLocked.cn: 另一名玩家正在使用这个桶.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelNotFou.en: The barrel is no longer available.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelRemove.en: The barrel could not provide the liquid.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelUnavai.en: The barrel must be open first.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_ClientProgre.en: The transfer lost client sync and was stopped.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_ClientProgre.ch: 轉移失去客戶端同步, 已停止.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_ClientProgre.cn: 转移失去客户端同步, 已停止.

UI_trait_slowpoke._note: issue #125：MoreTraits - Dynamic 的 MoreTraits - Dynamic.lua:284（有效分支 42.17，該檔無任何 Lua 長註解，確認為活程式碼）在移除 gimp 特質時以 getText("UI_trait_slowpoke") 顯示 halo 文字，但該鍵未定義於任何檔、任何語言。上游 EN 的 UI_trait_gimp 即為 "Slowpoke"，可判定作者誤植鍵名，故值與 UI_trait_gimp 一致（磨磨蹭蹭），非自行造詞。【同批已撤】UI_trait_lightdrink/harddrink(+desc) 曾一併登記，後查出唯一 producer MoreTraitsMainCreationMethods.lua:413-414 位於該檔第 1 行 --[[ 至第 426 行 --]] 的整檔註解內、永不執行，且 ToadTraits.txt 未以 character_trait_definition 補回，屬死鍵故移除。教訓：以 regex 掃 getText( 判定活引用時必須先排除 Lua 註解區塊。
