UI_HCB_GH_TipQueenNeedCage.en: Removing her needs an empty Queen Cage with uses left.
UI_HCB_GH_TipQueenNeedCage.ch: 要取出她, 需要一個尚有使用次數的空蜂后籠.
UI_HCB_GH_TipQueenNeedCage.cn: 要取出她, 需要一个尚有使用次数的空蜂后笼.

UI_HCB_MB_SayStarted.ch: 已開始發酵 %1 公升蜂蜜酒.
UI_HCB_MB_SayStarted.cn: 已开始发酵 %1 升蜂蜜酒.

UI_HCB_MB_ProgressDays.ch: 第 %1 天 / 約 %2 天
UI_HCB_MB_ProgressDays.cn: 第 %1 天 / 约 %2 天

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2a.en: The timeline shows the batch's life: young, fully fermented, aged, then spoiled. Hover it for exact times and strength.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2a.ch: 時間軸顯示這一批的歷程: 新酒, 完全發酵, 熟成, 最後變質. 把滑鼠移到上面可以看到確切時間和酒精濃度.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2a.cn: 时间轴显示这一批的历程: 新酒, 完全发酵, 熟成, 最后变质. 把鼠标移到上面可以看到确切时间和酒精浓度.

UI_HCB_GH_CondFreezing.en: It is freezing - the hive is hibernating.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFreezing.ch: 天氣冰凍 - 蜂箱正在冬眠.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFreezing.cn: 天气冰冻 - 蜂箱正在冬眠.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow3.en: Pour in sugar water and it stands in for flowers when forage is thin, so a hive keeps working through winter or a poor biome - though rain, snow and freezing still stop it.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow3.ch: 倒入糖水後, 蜜源稀少時它會代替花朵, 讓蜂箱在冬季或貧瘠的生態環境中繼續運作 - 不過下雨, 下雪和冰凍天氣仍然會讓它停下來.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow3.cn: 倒入糖水后, 蜜源稀少时它会代替花朵, 让蜂箱在冬季或贫瘠的生态环境中继续运行 - 不过下雨, 下雪和冰冻天气仍然会让它停下来.

UI_HCB_GH_TipFoliage.en: Flowers, crops and wild plants near the hive: %1 found. More forage means faster comb.
UI_HCB_GH_TipFoliage.ch: 蜂箱附近的花朵, 作物和野生植物: 找到 %1 株. 蜜源越多, 蜂巢就築得越快.
UI_HCB_GH_TipFoliage.cn: 蜂箱附近的花朵, 作物和野生植物: 找到 %1 株. 蜜源越多, 蜂巢就筑得越快.

UI_HCB_GH_BtnHarvestTip.en: Collect everything at once: combs, bees and larvae. Smoke first or the bees get angry.
UI_HCB_GH_BtnHarvestTip.ch: 一次收取所有東西: 蜂巢, 蜜蜂和幼蟲. 先燻煙, 否則蜜蜂會發怒.
UI_HCB_GH_BtnHarvestTip.cn: 一次收取所有东西: 蜂巢, 蜜蜂和幼虫. 先熏烟, 否则蜜蜂会发怒.

UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodAngry.en: Angry bees sting anyone close. Caused by hits or harvesting without smoke. It wears off.
UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodAngry.ch: 發怒的蜜蜂會螫附近的任何人. 起因是遭到攻擊, 或沒有燻煙就採收. 這個狀態會隨時間消退.
UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodAngry.cn: 发怒的蜜蜂会蜇附近的任何人. 起因是遭到攻击, 或没有熏烟就采收. 这个状态会随时间消退.

UI_HCB_MB_SayBottleBeforeEmpty.en: Bottle the ready mead before emptying the barrel.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottleBeforeEmpty.ch: 清空發酵桶之前, 請先把已完成的蜂蜜酒裝瓶.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottleBeforeEmpty.cn: 清空发酵桶之前, 请先把已完成的蜂蜜酒装瓶.

UI_HCB_MB_TipReadyBottleCost.en: Costs an empty glass bottle and a cork or wax cork; comes out sealed.
UI_HCB_MB_TipReadyBottleCost.ch: 需要一個空玻璃瓶和一個軟木塞或蜂蠟塞; 產出時已密封.
UI_HCB_MB_TipReadyBottleCost.cn: 需要一个空玻璃瓶和一个软木塞或蜂蜡塞; 产出时已密封.

UI_HCB_GH_TipFoliageFed.en: The sugar water you poured in is covering the shortfall for now.
UI_HCB_GH_TipFoliageFed.ch: 你倒入的糖水暫時補足了缺口.
UI_HCB_GH_TipFoliageFed.cn: 你倒入的糖水暂时补足了缺口.

UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyYeast.en: Wait until the current batch is done before changing the yeast.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyYeast.ch: 等這一批完成後才能更換酵母.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyYeast.cn: 等这一批完成后才能更换酵母.

UI_HCB_Hive_SmokerEmpty.en: The smoker is out of fuel.

UI_HCB_Hive_FeedHiveFullTip.en: This hive is already swimming in syrup. Pouring more in would just waste it.
UI_HCB_Hive_FeedHiveFullTip.ch: 這個蜂箱裡的糖水已經多到滿出來了. 再倒進去只是浪費.
UI_HCB_Hive_FeedHiveFullTip.cn: 这个蜂箱里的糖水已经多到满出来了. 再倒进去只是浪费.

UI_HCB_MB_SayUnpause.en: Unpause the game to work the barrel.
UI_HCB_MB_SayUnpause.ch: 取消遊戲暫停才能操作發酵桶.
UI_HCB_MB_SayUnpause.cn: 取消游戏暂停才能操作发酵桶.

UI_HCB_GH_OutQLBrooding.en: A new queen is growing - ready in about %1h.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQLBrooding.ch: 新的蜂后正在成長 - 大約 %1h 後完成.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQLBrooding.cn: 新的蜂后正在成长 - 大约 %1h 后完成.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBeeTake.en: Click to take her - live bees make good fishing bait.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBeeTake.ch: 點選以取出她 - 活蜜蜂是不錯的魚餌.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBeeTake.cn: 点击以取出她 - 活蜜蜂是不错的鱼饵.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1c.en: Yeast: %1 uses of a Yeast packet, or a Wild Yeast Culture.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1c.ch: 酵母: 酵母包的 %1 次用量, 或一份野生酵母培養物.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1c.cn: 酵母: 酵母包的 %1 次用量, 或一份野生酵母培养物.

UI_HCB_GH_TipOutNextComb.ch: 週期進度: %1h / 共 %2h, 速度 %3%%.
UI_HCB_GH_TipOutNextComb.cn: 周期进度: %1h / 共 %2h, 速度 %3%%.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCombs.en: Filled honeycombs stored in the hive: %1 of %2.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSameFruit.en: Add more %1 to keep this batch on one fruit profile.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSameFruit.ch: 再加入更多 %1, 讓這一批維持單一水果風味.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSameFruit.cn: 再加入更多 %1, 让这一批维持单一水果风味.

UI_HCB_MB_NeedFruit.en: %1 more fruit (or empty the barrel and brew plain)
UI_HCB_MB_NeedFruit.ch: 還需要 %1 水果 (或清空發酵桶, 改釀原味)
UI_HCB_MB_NeedFruit.cn: 还需要 %1 水果 (或清空发酵桶, 改酿原味)

UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonRates.en: At full speed a new comb fills about every %1 hours, and the hive stores up to %2 combs and %3 larvae.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonRates.ch: 全速運作時, 大約每 %1 小時會填滿一塊新蜂巢; 蜂箱最多可儲存 %2 塊蜂巢和 %3 隻幼蟲.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonRates.cn: 全速运行时, 大约每 %1 小时会填满一块新蜂巢; 蜂箱最多可储存 %2 块蜂巢和 %3 只幼虫.

UI_HCB_GH_TipQueenClickCage.en: You have a cage ready - click her to remove her now.
UI_HCB_GH_TipQueenClickCage.ch: 你已經備好蜂后籠 - 點選她就能立刻取出.
UI_HCB_GH_TipQueenClickCage.cn: 你已经备好蜂后笼 - 点击她就能立刻取出.

UI_HCB_Hive_DebugAdvanced.ch: 蜂箱時間已推進 %1 小時.
UI_HCB_Hive_DebugAdvanced.cn: 蜂箱时间已推进 %1 小时.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1a.en: Honey: %1. Click the Honey row to pour from what you carry, or drop one container on it. Bottles of honey work; you keep the glass.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1a.ch: 蜂蜜: %1. 點選蜂蜜那一列, 就能從身上攜帶的容器倒入, 或把單一容器拖放到上面. 瓶裝蜂蜜也可以; 玻璃瓶會留給你.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1a.cn: 蜂蜜: %1. 点击蜂蜜那一行, 就能从身上携带的容器倒入, 或把单一容器拖放到上面. 瓶装蜂蜜也可以; 玻璃瓶会留给你.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyFull.en: It is full right now - another jar would not fit.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyFull.ch: 目前已經滿了 - 再一罐也裝不下.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyFull.cn: 当前已经满了 - 再一罐也装不下.

UI_HCB_GH_CondFull.en: Storage is full - harvest to make room.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFull.ch: 儲存空間已滿 - 採收以騰出空間.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFull.cn: 储存空间已满 - 采收以腾出空间.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBrood.en: Brood cell. These larvae hatch into worker bees.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBrood.ch: 育蟲巢房. 這些幼蟲會孵化成工蜂.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBrood.cn: 育虫巢房. 这些幼虫会孵化成工蜂.

UI_HCB_GH_CondFog.en: Heavy fog is slowing the bees.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFog.ch: 濃霧正在減慢蜜蜂的速度.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFog.cn: 浓雾正在减慢蜜蜂的速度.

UI_HCB_MB_SayAddedFruit.en: Added fruit to the barrel. Staged fruit: %1.
UI_HCB_MB_SayAddedFruit.ch: 已將水果加入發酵桶. 已投入水果: %1.
UI_HCB_MB_SayAddedFruit.cn: 已将水果加入发酵桶. 已投入水果: %1.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply2.en: While any is left it stands in for flowers when forage is thin.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply2.ch: 只要還有剩, 蜜源稀少時它就會代替花朵.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply2.cn: 只要还有剩, 蜜源稀少时它就会代替花朵.

UI_HCB_MB_SayBottlingFailed.en: The mead could not be bottled, so nothing was used.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottlingFailed.ch: 蜂蜜酒無法裝瓶, 因此沒有消耗任何材料.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottlingFailed.cn: 蜂蜜酒无法装瓶, 因此没有消耗任何材料.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3c.en: It comes out sealed at the stage it was poured. Sealed mead never ages or spoils.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3c.ch: 產出時會密封在裝瓶當下的階段. 密封蜂蜜酒永遠不會繼續熟成或變質.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3c.cn: 产出时会密封在装瓶当下的阶段. 密封蜂蜜酒永远不会继续熟成或变质.

UI_HCB_MB_SayFruitStuck.en: That fruit could not be removed from inventory.
UI_HCB_MB_SayFruitStuck.ch: 無法從物品欄移除那個水果.
UI_HCB_MB_SayFruitStuck.cn: 无法从物品栏移除那个水果.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSyrupWorking.en: Sugar water is standing in for the flowers.

UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoHoney.en: That container has no honey left.
UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoHoney.ch: 那個容器裡沒有蜂蜜了.
UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoHoney.cn: 那个容器里没有蜂蜜了.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFruitRecipe.en: There's no mead recipe for that fruit.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFruitRecipe.ch: 那種水果沒有對應的蜂蜜酒配方.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFruitRecipe.cn: 那种水果没有对应的蜂蜜酒配方.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellQueenHours.en: The queen. About %1h of laying left. Use Remove Queen to cage her.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellQueenHours.ch: 蜂后. 大約還剩 %1h 的產卵時間. 使用「取出蜂后」把她裝籠.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellQueenHours.cn: 蜂后. 大约还剩 %1h 的产卵时间. 使用“取出蜂后”把她装笼.

UI_HCB_GH_CondKeeperBoon.ch: 你的養蜂人手藝正在發揮作用.
UI_HCB_GH_CondKeeperBoon.cn: 你的养蜂人手艺正在发挥作用.

UI_HCB_MB_TimelineYoung.en: Young mead now - fully fermented in %1.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelineYoung.ch: 目前是新酒 - %1 後完全發酵.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelineYoung.cn: 当前是新酒 - %1 后完全发酵.

UI_HCB_MB_TipReadyBottleSealed.en: Click to bottle one %1 (%2 a bottle).

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSeal.en: You need a cork or a wax cork to seal the bottle.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSeal.ch: 你需要一個軟木塞或蜂蠟塞來密封瓶子.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSeal.cn: 你需要一个软木塞或蜂蜡塞来密封瓶子.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedHoney.en: You need a container with honey.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedHoney.ch: 你需要一個裝有蜂蜜的容器.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedHoney.cn: 你需要一个装有蜂蜜的容器.

UI_HCB_MB_SayDrawFailedSealed.en: The barrel poured a bottle, but you no longer had an empty bottle and a seal for it.
UI_HCB_MB_SayDrawFailedSealed.ch: 發酵桶倒出了一瓶, 但你已經沒有空瓶和瓶塞可以裝了.
UI_HCB_MB_SayDrawFailedSealed.cn: 发酵桶倒出了一瓶, 但你已经没有空瓶和瓶塞可以装了.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow4.en: Sugar water left on the ground beside a working hive gets drunk too - the bees come out and empty it over the next few hours.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow4.ch: 放在運作中蜂箱旁地上的糖水也會被喝掉 - 蜜蜂會飛出來, 在接下來幾小時內把它喝完.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow4.cn: 放在运行中蜂箱旁地上的糖水也会被喝掉 - 蜜蜂会飞出来, 在接下来几小时内把它喝完.

UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodSmoked.en: Smoke calms the bees for about %1h and stops work on the comb. Safe to harvest.
UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodSmoked.ch: 煙霧會讓蜜蜂鎮靜大約 %1h, 並停止蜂巢作業. 這時可以安全採收.
UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodSmoked.cn: 烟雾会让蜜蜂镇静大约 %1h, 并停止蜂巢作业. 这时可以安全采收.

UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney3.en: Bottles of honey work too - you keep the glass.
UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney3.ch: 瓶裝蜂蜜也可以 - 玻璃瓶會留給你.
UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney3.cn: 瓶装蜂蜜也可以 - 玻璃瓶会留给你.

UI_HCB_GH_TipOutLarvae.en: Larvae and bees grow with the same daily cycle as comb.
UI_HCB_GH_TipOutLarvae.ch: 幼蟲和蜜蜂的成長, 與蜂巢採用相同的每日週期.
UI_HCB_GH_TipOutLarvae.cn: 幼虫和蜜蜂的成长, 与蜂巢采用相同的每日周期.

UI_HCB_MB_TipNextBottle.ch: 下一瓶還要 %1 才會完成.
UI_HCB_MB_TipNextBottle.cn: 下一瓶还要 %1 才会完成.

UI_HCB_MB_TipStartMissing.en: Fill every row first. Still needed: %1.
UI_HCB_MB_TipStartMissing.ch: 請先填滿每一列. 還需要: %1.
UI_HCB_MB_TipStartMissing.cn: 请先填满每一行. 还需要: %1.

UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterSplash.en: Poured in a splash of sugar water - barely enough to wet the tank.
UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterSplash.ch: 倒入了一點糖水 - 勉強只夠沾濕槽底.
UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterSplash.cn: 倒入了一点糖水 - 勉强只够沾湿槽底.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5a.en: Start Wild Yeast Culture from a jar of honey or sugar water. Two days later, harvest it for a Yeast packet.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5a.ch: 用一罐蜂蜜或糖水開始培養野生酵母培養物. 兩天後採收, 就能得到一包酵母.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5a.cn: 用一罐蜂蜜或糖水开始培养野生酵母培养物. 两天后采收, 就能得到一包酵母.

UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoWater.en: That container has no water left.

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStored.en: %1 - ready to bottle. It keeps as it is until you take it.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStored.ch: %1 - 已可裝瓶. 在你取出之前會維持現狀.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStored.cn: %1 - 已可装瓶. 在你取出之前会维持现状.

UI_HCB_MB_TipWater1.en: Click to pour water from everything you carry, or drop one container to pour just that.
UI_HCB_MB_TipWater1.ch: 點選以從身上所有容器倒水, 或拖放單一容器只倒那一個.
UI_HCB_MB_TipWater1.cn: 点击以从身上所有容器倒水, 或拖放单一容器只倒那一个.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSmoked.en: Smoke has stopped work on the comb.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S4a.en: Open Sealed Mead with a corkscrew or any sharp tool, then drink or pour it.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S4a.ch: 用開瓶器或任何利器開啟密封蜂蜜酒, 然後飲用或倒出.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S4a.cn: 用开瓶器或任何利器打开密封蜂蜜酒, 然后饮用或倒出.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellEmpty.en: Empty comb. The bees build here as the colony grows.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellEmpty.ch: 空蜂巢. 隨著蜂群成長, 蜜蜂會在這裡築巢.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellEmpty.cn: 空蜂巢. 随着蜂群成长, 蜜蜂会在这里筑巢.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingSmoked.en: A half-built comb. The bees will not touch it until the smoke clears.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingSmoked.ch: 一塊蓋了一半的蜂巢. 煙霧散去前蜜蜂不會去動它.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingSmoked.cn: 一块盖了一半的蜂巢. 烟雾散去前蜜蜂不会去动它.

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStages.en: Once a batch starts, its timeline shows here: young, fully fermented, aged, then spoiled.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStages.ch: 批次開始後, 時間軸會顯示在這裡: 新酒, 完全發酵, 熟成, 最後變質.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStages.cn: 批次开始后, 时间轴会显示在这里: 新酒, 完全发酵, 熟成, 最后变质.

UI_HCB_GH_OutRJProducing.ch: 蜂王乳正在形成 - 大約還要 %1 小時.
UI_HCB_GH_OutRJProducing.cn: 蜂王浆正在形成 - 大约还要 %1 小时.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedWater.en: You need a container with water.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedWater.ch: 你需要一個裝著水的容器.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedWater.cn: 你需要一个装着水的容器.

UI_HCB_Hive_PausedNoInteract.en: Unpause the game to work the hive.
UI_HCB_Hive_PausedNoInteract.ch: 取消遊戲暫停後才能操作蜂箱.
UI_HCB_Hive_PausedNoInteract.cn: 取消游戏暂停后才能操作蜂箱.

UI_HCB_GH_TipOutQueen.ch: 產卵時間剩下正好 %1 小時.
UI_HCB_GH_TipOutQueen.cn: 产卵时间剩下正好 %1 小时.

UI_HCB_Hive_FeedTankFull.en: The hive's sugar water is full - %1 litres of it. The bees have to drink some down first.
UI_HCB_Hive_FeedTankFull.ch: 蜂箱的糖水已滿 - 共 %1 公升. 得先讓蜜蜂喝掉一些.
UI_HCB_Hive_FeedTankFull.cn: 蜂箱的糖水已满 - 共 %1 升. 得先让蜜蜂喝掉一些.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1e.en: Start Fermenting unlocks when every row is full. Every batch is %1 bottles.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1e.ch: 每一行都裝滿後, 開始發酵就會解鎖. 每個批次都是 %1 瓶.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1e.cn: 每一行都装满后, 开始发酵就会解锁. 每个批次都是 %1 瓶.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3a.en: Each bottle takes an empty glass bottle plus a Cork or a Wax Cork (2 wax bits).
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3a.ch: 每瓶需要一個空玻璃瓶, 外加一個軟木塞或蜂蠟塞 (2 個蜂蠟碎塊).
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3a.cn: 每瓶需要一个空玻璃瓶, 外加一个软木塞或蜂蜡塞 (2 个蜂蜡碎块).

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineIdle1.en: The batch's timeline shows here once it starts.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineIdle1.ch: 批次開始後, 它的時間軸會顯示在這裡.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineIdle1.cn: 批次开始后, 它的时间轴会显示在这里.

UI_HCB_MB_TipFruit1.en: Optional. %1 of one kind of fruit flavors the batch - or none for plain mead.
UI_HCB_MB_TipFruit1.ch: 選用. 加入 %1 的單一種水果可為批次調味 - 不加則是原味蜂蜜酒.
UI_HCB_MB_TipFruit1.cn: 可选. 加入 %1 的单一种水果可为批次调味 - 不加则是原味蜂蜜酒.

UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyFull.en: The honey side is already full.

UI_HCB_GH_SkyRule1.ch: 下雨和下雪會讓工作暫停.
UI_HCB_GH_SkyRule1.cn: 下雨和下雪会让工作暂停.

UI_HCB_GH_OutNoQueen.en: No queen - nothing new is being made.
UI_HCB_GH_OutNoQueen.ch: 沒有蜂后 - 不會產出任何新東西.
UI_HCB_GH_OutNoQueen.cn: 没有蜂后 - 不会产出任何新东西.

UI_HCB_Hive_SmokerOutOfFuel.en: Your Bee Smoker is out of fuel. Refuel it and light it again.
UI_HCB_Hive_SmokerOutOfFuel.ch: 你的蜂箱燻煙器沒燃料了. 重新裝填燃料再點燃它.
UI_HCB_Hive_SmokerOutOfFuel.cn: 你的蜂箱熏烟器没燃料了. 重新装填燃料再点燃它.

UI_HCB_GH_BtnInsertQueenTip.en: Place a Queen Bee or caged queen from your inventory to start the hive.
UI_HCB_GH_BtnInsertQueenTip.ch: 從物品欄放入蜂后或籠中的蜂后來啟動蜂箱.
UI_HCB_GH_BtnInsertQueenTip.cn: 从物品栏放入蜂后或笼中的蜂后来启动蜂箱.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyNoJar.en: You are not carrying any sugar water.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyNoJar.ch: 你身上沒有帶任何糖水.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyNoJar.cn: 你身上没有带任何糖水.

UI_HCB_GH_OutRJReady.en: Royal jelly is ready - click its cell to collect.
UI_HCB_GH_OutRJReady.ch: 蜂王乳已經完成 - 點選它的格子來收取.
UI_HCB_GH_OutRJReady.cn: 蜂王浆已经完成 - 点击它的格子来收取.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBroodTake.en: Click to take it - larvae make good fishing bait.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBroodTake.ch: 點選以取走 - 幼蟲是不錯的釣餌.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBroodTake.cn: 点击以取走 - 幼虫是不错的钓饵.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyPartial.en: There is only room for %1 more litres - that is all this pour will take.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyPartial.ch: 只剩下 %1 公升的空間 - 這次只會倒進這麼多.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyPartial.cn: 只剩下 %1 升的空间 - 这次只会倒进这么多.

UI_HCB_GH_BtnSmokeTip.en: Calm the bees so you can work the comb safely. Burns a fifth of the smoker's fuel, and the hive stops building while the smoke lasts.
UI_HCB_GH_BtnSmokeTip.ch: 鎮靜蜜蜂, 讓你可以安全地處理蜂巢. 會燒掉燻煙器五分之一的燃料, 而且煙霧持續期間蜂箱會停止建造.
UI_HCB_GH_BtnSmokeTip.cn: 镇静蜜蜂, 让你可以安全地处理蜂巢. 会烧掉熏烟器五分之一的燃料, 而且烟雾持续期间蜂箱会停止建造.

UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeBad.en: This biome is hard on bees - it slows the hive.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeBad.ch: 這種生態環境對蜜蜂很不友善 - 會拖慢蜂箱.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeBad.cn: 这种生态环境对蜜蜂很不友善 - 会拖慢蜂箱.

UI_HCB_GH_TempRule2.ch: 拖慢蜜蜂. 嚴寒會讓
UI_HCB_GH_TempRule2.cn: 拖慢蜜蜂. 严寒会让

UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney1.en: Click to pour honey from everything you carry, or drop one container to pour just that.
UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney1.ch: 點選可倒出你身上所有的蜂蜜, 或拖入單一容器只倒那一個.
UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney1.cn: 点击可倒出你身上所有的蜂蜜, 或拖入单一容器只倒那一个.

UI_HCB_GH_OutWeatherPaused.en: Work is paused by the weather.

UI_HCB_GH_OutHibernating.en: The hive is hibernating until it warms up.
UI_HCB_GH_OutHibernating.ch: 蜂箱正在冬眠, 直到天氣回暖.
UI_HCB_GH_OutHibernating.cn: 蜂箱正在冬眠, 直到天气回暖.

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineFerment2.en: About %1 alcohol now, %2 fully fermented, %3 aged.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineFerment2.ch: 目前酒精約 %1, %2 後完全發酵, %3 後熟成.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineFerment2.cn: 当前酒精约 %1, %2 后完全发酵, %3 后熟成.

UI_HCB_MB_SayLoadedWaterItem.en: Loaded water from that container into the barrel.
UI_HCB_MB_SayLoadedWaterItem.ch: 已將那個容器裡的水倒入桶中.
UI_HCB_MB_SayLoadedWaterItem.cn: 已将那个容器里的水倒入桶中.

UI_HCB_GH_OutNextComb.ch: 下一塊蜂巢大約還要 %1 小時完成.
UI_HCB_GH_OutNextComb.cn: 下一块蜂巢大约还要 %1 小时完成.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5b.en: Or leave a jar of honey or sugar water on the ground: it sours into a starter by itself, unless a hive is close enough to drink it.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5b.ch: 或者把一罐蜂蜜或糖水放在地上: 它會自己酸化成酵母引子, 除非附近有蜂箱近到會把它喝掉.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5b.cn: 或者把一罐蜂蜜或糖水放在地上: 它会自己酸化成酵母引子, 除非附近有蜂箱近到会把它喝掉.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSuboptimal.en: The temperature is off - work is a little slower.
UI_HCB_GH_CondSuboptimal.ch: 溫度不太對 - 工作稍微慢了一些.
UI_HCB_GH_CondSuboptimal.cn: 温度不太对 - 工作稍微慢了一些.

UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleFillingSealed.en: Still fermenting - first bottle ready in %1.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleFillingSealed.ch: 還在發酵 - 第一瓶還要 %1 才能取出.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleFillingSealed.cn: 还在发酵 - 第一瓶还要 %1 才能取出.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow1.en: What moves this number: rain or snow stops all work, heavy fog slows it, freezing sends the hive into hibernation, and harsh heat wears the bees down.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow1.ch: 影響這個數字的因素: 下雨或下雪會停下所有工作, 濃霧會拖慢速度, 嚴寒會讓蜂箱進入冬眠, 酷熱則會消耗蜜蜂的體力.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow1.cn: 影响这个数字的因素: 下雨或下雪会停下所有工作, 浓雾会拖慢速度, 严寒会让蜂箱进入冬眠, 酷热则会消耗蜜蜂的体力.

UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenMissing.en: There is no queen in the hive.

UI_HCB_MB_SayWaterFull.en: The water side is already full.

UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleSealed1.en: Take one bottle out. Costs an empty glass bottle and a cork or wax cork.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleSealed1.ch: 取出一瓶. 需要一個空玻璃瓶, 以及一個軟木塞或蜂蠟塞.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleSealed1.cn: 取出一瓶. 需要一个空玻璃瓶, 以及一个软木塞或蜂蜡塞.

UI_HCB_MB_TipEmptyCell.ch: 批次發酵時會慢慢填滿.
UI_HCB_MB_TipEmptyCell.cn: 批次发酵时会慢慢填满.

UI_HCB_GH_BeeVisualsOff.ch: 蜜蜂特效: 關閉 (點選以啟用)
UI_HCB_GH_BeeVisualsOff.cn: 蜜蜂特效: 关闭 (点击以启用)

UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyWater.en: Bottle or finish the current batch before adding more water.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyWater.ch: 先把目前的批次裝瓶或處理完, 再加更多水.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyWater.cn: 先把当前的批次装瓶或处理完, 再加更多水.

UI_HCB_GH_TipLarvae.en: Larvae being raised: %1 of %2. Larvae hatch into worker bees.
UI_HCB_GH_TipLarvae.ch: 正在培育的幼蟲: %1 / %2. 幼蟲會孵化成工蜂.
UI_HCB_GH_TipLarvae.cn: 正在培育的幼虫: %1 / %2. 幼虫会孵化成工蜂.

UI_HCB_MB_SayOneFruitProfile.en: This barrel only stages one fruit profile at a time.
UI_HCB_MB_SayOneFruitProfile.ch: 這個桶一次只能備一種水果風味.
UI_HCB_MB_SayOneFruitProfile.cn: 这个桶一次只能备一种水果风味.

UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodWorking.en: The bees are calm and busy.
UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodWorking.ch: 蜜蜂很平靜, 也很忙碌.
UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodWorking.cn: 蜜蜂很平静, 也很忙碌.

UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleNoneSealed.en: Nothing to bottle yet. Start a batch first.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleNoneSealed.ch: 還沒有東西可以裝瓶. 先開始一個批次.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleNoneSealed.cn: 还没有东西可以装瓶. 先开始一个批次.

UI_HCB_MB_TimelineAged.ch: 已熟成且濃烈 - %1 後會變質.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelineAged.cn: 已熟成且浓烈 - %1 后会变质.

UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeNeutral.en: A neutral biome - no effect on the hive.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeNeutral.ch: 中性的生態環境 - 對蜂箱沒有影響.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeNeutral.cn: 中性的生态环境 - 对蜂箱没有影响.

UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBoth.en: Abundant plant life and current biome are boosting your harvest.
UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBoth.ch: 茂盛的植被和目前的生態環境都在提升你的收成.
UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBoth.cn: 茂盛的植被和当前的生态环境都在提升你的收获.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSnow.ch: 下雪讓所有工作都暫停了.
UI_HCB_GH_CondSnow.cn: 下雪让所有工作都暂停了.

UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyBottleNoRoom.en: There is not enough room left for a whole bottle of honey.
UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyBottleNoRoom.ch: 剩下的空間不夠放一整瓶蜂蜜.
UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyBottleNoRoom.cn: 剩下的空间不够放一整瓶蜂蜜.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingEta.en: The bees are building this comb. About %1h until it is full.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingEta.ch: 蜜蜂正在建造這塊蜂巢. 大約還要 %1 小時才會填滿.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingEta.cn: 蜜蜂正在建造这块蜂巢. 大约还要 %1 小时才会填满.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonNow.en: %1 is the current month. A queen lays for about %2 days before she needs replacing.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonNow.ch: 目前的月份是 %1. 蜂后大約可以產卵 %2 天, 之後就需要更換.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonNow.cn: 当前月份是 %1. 蜂后大约可以产卵 %2 天, 之后就需要更换.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFullDraw.en: This batch has not produced a full 1.0 L draw yet.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFullDraw.ch: 這個批次還沒產出滿 1.0 公升可取用的量.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFullDraw.cn: 这个批次还没产出满 1.0 升可取用的量.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply4.en: Click to pour in a jar. Jars left beside the hive get drunk too.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply4.ch: 點選可倒入一罐. 放在蜂箱旁邊的罐子也會被喝掉.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply4.cn: 点击可倒入一罐. 放在蜂箱旁边的罐子也会被喝掉.

UI_HCB_MB_TipStart1.en: Start the batch: %1 bottles from %2 honey, %3 water,
UI_HCB_MB_TipStart1.ch: 開始批次: %1 瓶, 需要 %2 蜂蜜, %3 水,
UI_HCB_MB_TipStart1.cn: 开始批次: %1 瓶, 需要 %2 蜂蜜, %3 水,

UI_HCB_MB_TimelinePrime.en: In its prime. Stronger if you wait, riskier too.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelinePrime.ch: 正值最佳狀態. 再等會更濃烈, 但風險也更高.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelinePrime.cn: 正值最佳状态. 再等会更浓烈, 但风险也更高.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedEmptyBottle.en: You need an empty glass bottle to fill.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedEmptyBottle.ch: 你需要一個空玻璃瓶來裝.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedEmptyBottle.cn: 你需要一个空玻璃瓶来装.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1b.ch: 水: %1, 用同樣的方式加入.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1b.cn: 水: %1, 用同样的方式加入.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2c.en: Bottle early for Young mead, on time for the classic, late for stronger Aged. Left past Aged it spoils - throw it out with the button.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2c.ch: 早點裝瓶可得到新酒, 準時裝瓶是經典風味, 晚一點裝瓶則是更烈的熟成款. 過了熟成期還放著就會變質 - 用按鈕把它倒掉.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2c.cn: 早点装瓶可得到新酒, 准时装瓶是经典风味, 晚一点装瓶则是更烈的熟成款. 过了熟成期还放着就会变质 - 用按钮把它倒掉.

UI_HCB_GH_TipBees.en: Honeybees living in the hive: %1 of %2. They grow with each cycle.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBees.ch: 住在蜂箱裡的蜜蜂: %1 / %2. 每個週期都會增加.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBees.cn: 住在蜂箱里的蜜蜂: %1 / %2. 每个周期都会增加.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplySplash.en: There is barely a splash of room left - that is all this pour will take.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplySplash.ch: 只剩下一點點空間 - 這次只會倒進這麼多.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplySplash.cn: 只剩下一点点空间 - 这次只会倒进这么多.

UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenDays.en: The queen is laying well - %1 days left.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenDays.ch: 蜂后產卵狀況良好 - 還剩 %1 天.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenDays.cn: 蜂后产卵状况良好 - 还剩 %1 天.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S4b.en: An empty mead bottle is a plain glass bottle again.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S4b.ch: 喝完的蜂蜜酒瓶又會變回普通玻璃瓶.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S4b.cn: 喝完的蜂蜜酒瓶又会变回普通玻璃瓶.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3b.en: Click a full bottle in the tray, or press Bottle Mead.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3b.ch: 點選托盤裡裝滿的瓶子, 或按下裝瓶蜂蜜酒.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3b.cn: 点击托盘里装满的瓶子, 或按下装瓶蜂蜜酒.

UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenHours.en: The queen is old - about %1h left.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenHours.ch: 蜂后已經老了 - 大約還剩 %1 小時.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenHours.cn: 蜂后已经老了 - 大约还剩 %1 小时.

UI_HCB_GH_SeasonCaption.en: green = queen season (wild queens can be foraged)
UI_HCB_GH_SeasonCaption.ch: 綠色 = 蜂后季節 (可以採集到野生蜂后)
UI_HCB_GH_SeasonCaption.cn: 绿色 = 蜂后季节 (可以采集到野生蜂后)

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1d.en: Fruit (optional): %1 of one kind for a flavored batch, or none for plain.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1d.ch: 水果 (選用): 加入 %1 的單一種水果做成調味批次, 不加則是原味.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1d.cn: 水果 (可选): 加入 %1 的单一种水果做成调味批次, 不加则是原味.

UI_HCB_MB_SayBottleFirst.en: Bottle the ready mead before starting another batch.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottleFirst.ch: 先把已完成的蜂蜜酒裝瓶, 再開始下一個批次.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottleFirst.cn: 先把已完成的蜂蜜酒装瓶, 再开始下一个批次.

UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyToppedOff.en: Topped the honey off. The part-used bottle keeps the rest.
UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyToppedOff.ch: 蜂蜜已加滿. 用了一部分的瓶子會留著剩下的.
UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyToppedOff.cn: 蜂蜜已加满. 用了一部分的瓶子会留着剩下的.

UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterPoured.en: Poured in %1 litres of sugar water. The hive is holding %2 litres now.
UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterPoured.ch: 倒入了 %1 公升糖水. 蜂箱現在存有 %2 公升.
UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterPoured.cn: 倒入了 %1 升糖水. 蜂箱现在存有 %2 升.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellFilled.en: Filled honeycomb - click to take one. Drink the honey, crush the empty comb into wax.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellFilled.ch: 已填滿的蜂巢 - 點選以取走一塊. 蜂蜜可以喝, 空蜂巢可以壓碎成蜂蠟.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellFilled.cn: 已填满的蜂巢 - 点击以取走一块. 蜂蜜可以喝, 空蜂巢可以压碎成蜂蜡.

UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBiome.en: This biome is boosting your harvest.
UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBiome.ch: 這種生態環境正在提升你的收成.
UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBiome.cn: 这种生态环境正在提升你的收获.

UI_HCB_MB_TipWater2.en: A batch takes %1 of clean water.
UI_HCB_MB_TipWater2.ch: 一個批次需要 %1 的乾淨水.
UI_HCB_MB_TipWater2.cn: 一个批次需要 %1 的干净水.

UI_HCB_MB_SayYeastStuck.en: That yeast could not be used.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNoDumpLive.en: You cannot dump the barrel while a live batch is fermenting.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoDumpLive.ch: 還有批次正在發酵時, 你不能倒掉桶裡的東西.

UI_OC_SessionOnlyDisplayOverrides.cn: 手动覆盖: 仅保留于本次游戏

UI_OC_SessionOnlyDisplayOverrides_toolti.en: When enabled, overrides last only until you load another save or quit. Takes effect after a reload.
UI_OC_SessionOnlyDisplayOverrides_toolti.ch: 啟用後, 覆寫只在你讀取其他存檔或離開遊戲之前有效. 重新載入後生效.
UI_OC_SessionOnlyDisplayOverrides_toolti.cn: 启用后, 覆盖只在你读取其他存档或退出游戏之前有效. 重新加载后生效.

UI_OC_ModOptions._note: EN 就是模組名本身 (Workshop 顯示名 organizedCategories: Core), 屬專有名詞; 同 mod_names_zh 慣例保留拉丁原名, 不另造中文譯名。

UI_OC_UseItemNames.ch: 使用 organizedCategories 的物品名稱
UI_OC_UseItemNames.cn: 使用 organizedCategories 的物品名称

UI_OC_UseItemNames_tooltip.en: When enabled, organizedCategories replaces item display names (Type - Permutation). Turn this off to keep vanilla and other mods' names. Takes effect after a reload.
UI_OC_UseItemNames_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, organizedCategories 會取代物品的顯示名稱 (類型 - 變體). 關閉此選項可保留原版與其他模組的名稱. 重新載入後生效.
UI_OC_UseItemNames_tooltip.cn: 启用后, organizedCategories 会替换物品的显示名称 (类型 - 变体). 关闭此选项可保留原版与其他模组的名称. 重新加载后生效.

UI_options_ScreenEffectIntensity.en: Intensity of Screen Effects when on Drugs

UI_options_ScreenEffectIntensity_tooltip.en: The HIGHER the number, the less intense the screen effects are.
UI_options_ScreenEffectIntensity_tooltip.ch: 數值越高, 畫面效果越弱.
UI_options_ScreenEffectIntensity_tooltip.cn: 数值越大, 屏幕效果越淡.

UI_trait_BenzoAddictdesc.en:
Has a Benzo Dependence.
Withdrawals at 3 (Medium), 6 (Bad), 10 (Mild) days.
If Benzo taken every 3 days, you can lose trait with no withdrawals.
Will lose trait if no Benzo (Xanax) is done for 18-20 days.
-Hunger, +Thirst, +Fatigue, -Endurance, +Panic, +Stress.
UI_trait_BenzoAddictdesc.ch:
具有苯二氮平類藥物依賴.
戒斷症狀會在第3天(中度)、第6天(嚴重)、第10天(輕度)出現.
每3天服用一次苯二氮平類藥物, 即可在不出現戒斷症狀的情況下失去此特質.
若18至20天未服用苯二氮平類藥物(贊安諾), 將失去此特質.
-飢餓, +口渴, +疲勞, -耐力, +恐慌, +壓力.
UI_trait_BenzoAddictdesc.cn:
患有苯二氮卓类药物依赖.
戒断症状会在第3天(中等)、第6天(严重)、第10天(轻微)出现.
每3天服用一次苯二氮卓类药物, 即可在不出现戒断症状的情况下移除此特质.
连续18至20天未服用苯二氮卓类药物(阿普唑仑)后, 将移除此特质.
-饥饿, +口渴, +疲劳, -耐力, +恐慌, +压力.

UI_trait_CokeHeaddesc.en:
Has a Cocaine addiction.
Withdrawals at 1 (Medium), 5 (Bad), 10 (Mild) days.
If Cocaine taken every 5 days, you can lose trait with no tier 2 withdrawals.
Will lose trait if no cocaine is done for 18-20 days.
+Hunger, +Thirst, +Fatigue, -Endurance, +Stress, +Head Pain.
UI_trait_CokeHeaddesc.ch:
具有古柯鹼成癮.
戒斷症狀會在第1天(中度)、第5天(嚴重)、第10天(輕度)出現.
每5天服用一次古柯鹼, 即可在不出現第2級戒斷症狀的情況下失去此特質.
若18至20天未服用古柯鹼, 將失去此特質.
+飢餓, +口渴, +疲勞, -耐力, +壓力, +頭痛.
UI_trait_CokeHeaddesc.cn:
患有可卡因成瘾.
戒断症状会在第1天(中等)、第5天(严重)、第10天(轻微)出现.
每5天服用一次可卡因, 即可在不出现2级戒断症状的情况下移除此特质.
连续18至20天未服用可卡因后, 将移除此特质.
+饥饿, +口渴, +疲劳, -耐力, +压力, +头痛.

UI_trait_MDMAAddictdesc.en:
In Love with MDMA.
Withdrawals at 3 (Medium), 6 (Bad), 10 (Mild) days.
If MDMA taken every 5 days, you can lose trait with no tier 2 withdrawals..
Will lose trait if no MDMA is done for 18-20 days.
-Hunger, +Thirst, +Fatigue, -Endurance, +Stress, +Head Pain.
UI_trait_MDMAAddictdesc.ch:
熱愛MDMA.
戒斷症狀會在第3天(中度)、第6天(嚴重)、第10天(輕度)出現.
每5天服用一次MDMA, 即可在不出現第2級戒斷症狀的情況下失去此特質.
若18至20天未服用MDMA, 將失去此特質.
-飢餓, +口渴, +疲勞, -耐力, +壓力, +頭痛.
UI_trait_MDMAAddictdesc.cn:
痴迷于MDMA.
戒断症状会在第3天(中等)、第6天(严重)、第10天(轻微)出现.
每5天服用一次MDMA, 即可在不出现2级戒断症状的情况下移除此特质.
连续18至20天未服用MDMA后, 将移除此特质.
-饥饿, +口渴, +疲劳, -耐力, +压力, +头痛.

+飢餓, +口渴, +疲勞, -耐力, +壓力, +頭痛.
UI_trait_MethHeaddesc.cn:
患有冰毒成瘾.
戒断症状会在第1天(中等)、第5天(严重)、第10天(轻微)出现.

连续18至20天未吸食冰毒后, 将移除此特质.
+饥饿, +口渴, +疲劳, -耐力, +压力, +头痛.

Has an Opioid Dependence.
Withdrawals at 1 (Medium), 5 (Bad), 10 (Mild) days.
If Opioid taken every 5 days, you can lose trait with no tier 2 withdrawals.
Will lose trait if no Opioids are done for 18-20 days.

UI_trait_OpioidAddictdesc.ch:
具有類鴉片藥物依賴.
戒斷症狀會在第1天(中度)、第5天(嚴重)、第10天(輕度)出現.

戒断症状会在第1天(中等)、第5天(严重)、第10天(轻微)出现.

UI_trait_ParanoidUserdesc.en:
Drugs give a panic attack for entire duration of effect.
CAN'T lose trait.
UI_trait_ParanoidUserdesc.ch:
藥效全程都會引發恐慌發作.
無法失去此特質.
UI_trait_ParanoidUserdesc.cn:
药物生效期间会一直引发惊恐发作.
无法移除此特质.

UI_trait_PotHeaddesc.en:
Loves the Weeeeed, but lower Fitness levels.
Will lose trait if no Weed is done for 18-20 days.
UI_trait_PotHeaddesc.ch:
超愛大麻, 但體格等級較低.
若18至20天未使用大麻, 將失去此特質.
UI_trait_PotHeaddesc.cn:
嗜好大麻, 但体格等级较低.
连续18至20天未使用大麻后, 将移除此特质.

UI_trait_SteroidAddictdesc.en:
Hooked on anabolic steroids.
Withdrawals at 1 (Medium), 5 (Bad), 10 (Mild) days.
Will lose trait if no steroids are taken for 18-20 days.
+Endurance while on them, -Endurance coming off.
UI_trait_SteroidAddictdesc.ch:
對同化性類固醇成癮.
戒斷症狀會在第1天(中度)、第5天(嚴重)、第10天(輕度)出現.
若18至20天未服用類固醇, 將失去此特質.
服用時+耐力, 停藥時-耐力.
UI_trait_SteroidAddictdesc.cn:
对合成代谢类固醇成瘾.
戒断症状会在第1天(中等)、第5天(严重)、第10天(轻微)出现.
连续18至20天未服用类固醇后, 将移除此特质.
使用期间+耐力, 停用后-耐力.

UI_BurdJournals_FitnessXPBlocked.en: Your current nutrition state prevents Fitness XP gain. Improve your nutrition, then try again.
UI_BurdJournals_FitnessXPBlocked.ch: 你目前的營養狀態無法獲得體格經驗值. 改善營養後再試一次.
UI_BurdJournals_FitnessXPBlocked.cn: 你当前的营养状态无法获得体格经验值. 改善营养后再试一次.

UI_BurdJournals_NoAmbitionsToRecord.ch: 沒有可記錄的已完成志向
UI_BurdJournals_NoAmbitionsToRecord.cn: 没有可记录的已完成志向

UI_BurdJournals_XPGrantMismatch.en: The game did not apply the full journal XP. Your journal claim was kept so you can try again.
UI_BurdJournals_XPGrantMismatch.ch: 遊戲未套用完整的日記經驗值. 已保留你的日記領取, 方便再試一次.
UI_BurdJournals_XPGrantMismatch.cn: 游戏未应用完整的日记经验值. 已保留你的日记领取, 方便再试一次.

UI_profdesc_HCC_Potter.en: You made a living at the wheel and the kiln. Pottery comes much faster, you keep your tools in better shape, and you already have an artisan's eye for clay and glass.
UI_profdesc_HCC_Potter.ch: 你靠陶輪和窯爐維生. 陶藝製作快上許多, 工具也保養得更好, 而且你對黏土與玻璃早已有工匠的眼光.
UI_profdesc_HCC_Potter.cn: 你靠陶轮和窑炉谋生. 陶艺制作快得多, 工具也保养得更好, 而且你对黏土和玻璃早已有匠人的眼光.

UI_profdesc_student.en: Fit and ready to take on the day.
UI_profdesc_student.ch: 體力充沛，隨時準備迎接新的一天。
UI_profdesc_student.cn: 体力充沛，随时准备迎接新的一天。

UI_profdesc_teacher.ch: 對各學科都有一定了解。
UI_profdesc_teacher.cn: 对各学科都有一定了解。

UI_trait_Cured1Desc.en: After being cured once, the infection seems unable to spread.
UI_trait_Cured1Desc.ch: 治癒過一次之後，感染似乎無法再擴散了。
UI_trait_Cured1Desc.cn: 治愈过一次之后，感染似乎无法再扩散了。

UI_OC_DisableCategorySeparators_tooltip.en: When enabled, inventory panes no longer draw a thin line between primary display categories (for example Tool vs Mechanics) when sorted by category. Takes effect immediately.
UI_OC_DisableCategorySeparators_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 物品欄在依分類排序時, 不再於主要顯示分類之間 (例如「工具」與「機械」) 繪製細分隔線. 立即生效.
UI_OC_DisableCategorySeparators_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 物品栏在按分类排序时, 不再在主要显示分类之间 (例如“工具”与“机械”) 绘制细分隔线. 立即生效.
UI_OC_DisableCategorySeparators_tooltip._note: #323: UI_OC_DisableCategorySeparators_tooltip。比照既有 UI_OC_AlphabeticalCategorySort_tooltip 的句式：CH「啟用後…物品欄的「依分類排序」…立即生效.」/ CN「启用后…物品栏的“按分类排序”…立即生效.」，引號形式也依各語別慣例（CH 用「」、CN 用“”）。display categories 沿用該組既定的「顯示分類/显示分类」，Tool/Mechanics 為原版分類名，譯為工具/機械。

UI_AA_open_nothing.ch: 這裡沒有任何還密封著的東西.
UI_AA_open_nothing.cn: 这里没有任何还密封着的东西.

UI_AA_open_notool.ch: 伸手範圍內沒有開罐器或利刃.
UI_AA_open_notool.cn: 伸手范围内没有开罐器或利刃.
UI_AA_open_notool.en: No can opener or sharp knife within reach.

UI_AA_open_option_all.ch: 開啟伸手範圍內所有罐頭與玻璃罐
UI_AA_open_option_all.cn: 打开伸手范围内所有罐头与玻璃罐
UI_AA_open_option_all.en: Open Every Can and Jar Within Reach

UI_AA_open_option_tt.ch: 依序開啟伸手範圍內 %2 當中的 %1 個. 放在容器裡的會自動取出, 開罐器只拿取一次.
UI_AA_open_option_tt.cn: 依次打开伸手范围内 %2 当中的 %1 个. 放在容器里的会自动取出, 开罐器只拿取一次.
UI_AA_open_option_tt.en: Opens %1 of the %2 within reach, one after another. Any that are in a container are fetched, and the can opener is only picked up once.

UI_AA_opt_cookSpoilFirst.ch: 優先用掉最快壞掉的食物
UI_AA_opt_cookSpoilFirst.cn: 优先用掉最快变质的食物
UI_AA_opt_cookSpoilFirst.en: Use up the food closest to spoiling

UI_AA_opt_cookSpoilFirst_tt.ch: 在可用的食材當中, 優先選擇剩餘保鮮時間最短的. 腐壞的食材永遠不會被使用, 那是另一個獨立設定.
UI_AA_opt_cookSpoilFirst_tt.cn: 在可用的食材当中, 优先选择剩余保鲜时间最短的. 腐坏的食材永远不会被使用, 那是另一个独立设置.
UI_AA_opt_cookSpoilFirst_tt.en: Among the ingredients on offer, prefers the ones with the least time left before they go stale. Nothing rotten is ever used - that is a separate setting.

UI_AA_opt_openMax.ch: 每次執行的製作次數上限
UI_AA_opt_openMax.cn: 每次运行的制作次数上限

UI_AA_opt_openMax_tt.en: Limits opening or packing operations per run. 0 means unlimited.
UI_AA_opt_openMax_tt.ch: 限制每次執行的開啟或打包次數. 0 代表不限.
UI_AA_opt_openMax_tt.cn: 限制每次运行的打开或打包次数. 0 代表不限.

UI_AA_opt_openResultsToSource.ch: 把產出的物品送回來源容器
UI_AA_opt_openResultsToSource.cn: 把产出的物品送回来源容器

UI_AA_opt_openResultsToSource_tt.en: Sends results back to the source container. Items already carried stay in the inventory.
UI_AA_opt_openResultsToSource_tt.ch: 把產出的物品送回來源容器. 已經隨身攜帶的物品則留在物品欄裡.
UI_AA_opt_openResultsToSource_tt.cn: 把产出的物品送回来源容器. 已经随身携带的物品则留在物品栏里.

UI_AA_opt_openReturnItems.ch: 結束後把開罐器放回去
UI_AA_opt_openReturnItems.cn: 结束后把开罐器放回去
UI_AA_opt_openReturnItems.en: Put the can opener back when finished

UI_AA_opt_openReturnItems_tt.ch: 整批處理完後, 把開罐器或刀子放回原本取出的容器, 只放回一次. 關閉這個選項就直接留著它.
UI_AA_opt_openReturnItems_tt.cn: 整批处理完后, 把开罐器或刀子放回原本取出的容器, 只放回一次. 关闭这个选项就直接留着它.
UI_AA_opt_openReturnItems_tt.en: Returns the can opener or knife to the container it was taken from, once, after the whole batch. Turn this off to simply keep it.

UI_AA_rip_blocked.ch: 找到了可以撕開的東西, 但目前都無法撕開. 請稍後再試.
UI_AA_rip_blocked.cn: 找到了可以撕开的东西, 但目前都无法撕开. 请稍后再试.
UI_AA_rip_blocked.en: Found things to rip, but none of them can be right now. Try again in a moment.

UI_DRJ_showXPWindow_tooltip.ch: 顯示可移動的經驗值列與經驗值飄字. <LINE>停用這個選項時, 多人遊戲的經驗值記錄仍會繼續運作.
UI_DRJ_showXPWindow_tooltip.cn: 显示可移动的经验值条与经验值飘字. <LINE>禁用这个选项时, 多人游戏的经验值记录仍会继续运行.
UI_DRJ_showXPWindow_tooltip.en: Shows a movable XP bar and XP drops. <LINE>Multiplayer XP logging remains active when this is disabled.

UI_ExtractionMode_ShowAdminSingleplayer.ch: 在單人遊戲中顯示管理員控制項
UI_ExtractionMode_ShowAdminSingleplayer.cn: 在单人游戏中显示管理员控件

UI_LPP_Opt_NeatIconTabs_TT.ch: 在 Neat Rocco's UI 面板中使用圖示頁籤 (滑鼠停留會顯示頁籤名稱). 關閉此項可改用一般的文字頁籤標題.
UI_LPP_Opt_NeatIconTabs_TT.cn: 在 Neat Rocco's UI 面板中使用图标标签页 (鼠标悬停会显示标签页名称). 关闭此项可改用普通的文字标签页标题.
UI_LPP_Opt_NeatIconTabs_TT.en: Icon tabs in the Neat Rocco's UI panel (hover shows the tab name). Turn this off for regular text tab titles.

UI_LPP_Opt_NeatIntegration.ch: 在 Neat Rocco's UI 中顯示表格
UI_LPP_Opt_NeatIntegration.cn: 在 Neat Rocco's UI 中显示表格
UI_LPP_Opt_NeatIntegration.en: Show the table inside Neat Rocco's UI

UI_LPP_Opt_NeatIntegration_TT.ch: 只有在 Neat Rocco's UI 啟用時才能使用. 當此項關閉 —— 或 Neat Rocco's UI 自身的單一視窗家畜開關關閉 —— 檢查區域會以一般面板開啟, 並顯示本模組的表格.
UI_LPP_Opt_NeatIntegration_TT.cn: 只有在 Neat Rocco's UI 启用时才能使用. 当此项关闭 —— 或 Neat Rocco's UI 自身的单个窗口牲畜开关关闭 —— 检查区域会以普通面板打开, 并显示本模组的表格.
UI_LPP_Opt_NeatIntegration_TT.en: Only usable while Neat Rocco's UI is active. When this is off — or when Neat Rocco's UI's own per-window Livestock toggle is off — Check Zone opens as the regular panel with this mod's table.

UI_LPP_Skill_TabLocked.ch: 在動物照護等級 %1 時顯示
UI_LPP_Skill_TabLocked.cn: 在动物护理等级 %1 时显示

UI_BCR_Option_ShowMenu_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 按右鍵時會在右鍵選單中顯示擊殺數獎勵的進度.
UI_BCR_Option_ShowMenu_tooltip.cn: 启用后, 点击右键时会在右键菜单中显示击杀数奖励的进度.
UI_BCR_Option_ShowMenu_tooltip.en: When enabled, right-clicking shows Body Count Rewards progress in the context menu.

UI_MM_ach_furnitureRest_d.ch: 在床、沙發或墊子上休息, 而不是躺在地板上.
UI_MM_ach_furnitureRest_d.cn: 在床、沙发或垫子上休息, 而不是躺在地板上.
UI_MM_ach_furnitureRest_d.en: Rest on a bed, couch or mat instead of the floor.

UI_MM_ach_fwoUser_d.ch: 使用真正的跑步機或臥推架 (需要 FWO).

UI_OC_DisableLootSafety.en: Let categories affect loot spawn rates
UI_OC_DisableLootSafety.ch: 讓分類影響戰利品生成率
UI_OC_DisableLootSafety.cn: 让分类影响战利品生成率

UI_OC_DisableLootSafety_tooltip.en: Build 42 picks an item's loot multiplier from its DisplayCategory, so moving an item off Tool, Material, Cooking, Gardening, FirstAid, Ammo, SkillBook and similar makes it roll against Other Loot instead. organizedCategories normally keeps those items in their original loot bucket and only changes the category you see. Enable this to let the categories reach the loot roll again, as in older versions. Takes effect immediately.
UI_OC_DisableLootSafety_tooltip.ch: Build 42 會依物品的顯示分類決定其戰利品倍率, 因此把物品移出工具, 材料, 烹飪, 園藝, 急救, 彈藥, 技能書等分類後, 它會改用「其他戰利品」的機率判定. organizedCategories 預設會讓這些物品留在原本的戰利品類別中, 只改變你看到的分類. 啟用此項可讓分類再次影響戰利品判定, 與舊版行為相同. 立即生效.
UI_OC_DisableLootSafety_tooltip.cn: Build 42 会依物品的显示分类决定其战利品倍率, 因此把物品移出工具, 材料, 烹饪, 园艺, 急救, 弹药, 技能书等分类后, 它会改用 “其他战利品” 的概率判定. organizedCategories 默认会让这些物品留在原本的战利品类别中, 只改变你看到的分类. 启用此项可让分类再次影响战利品判定, 与旧版行为相同. 立即生效.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Ancient_Desc.en: Older than anything else you carry. Nearly all of it awake.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Ancient_Desc.cn: 比你身上任何东西都更古老. 它几乎已经完全苏醒.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Dormant_Desc.en: Nothing has woken in it. A tool, and only that.
UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Dormant_Desc.ch: 它體內什麼都沒有醒來. 一件工具, 僅此而已.
UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Dormant_Desc.cn: 它体内什么都没有醒来. 一件工具, 仅此而已.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Proven_Desc.en: Past every change it can be given. What follows is only years.
UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Proven_Desc.ch: 它已越過所有能被賦予的變化. 之後留下的, 只有歲月.
UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Proven_Desc.cn: 它已越过所有能被赋予的变化. 之后留下的, 只有岁月.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Seasoned_Desc.en: It has outlived the hands that doubted it.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Seasoned_Desc.cn: 它比那些曾怀疑它的双手活得更久.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Stirring_Desc.en: The first Mark has taken. Something in it answers.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Stirring_Desc.cn: 第一道铭印已然成形. 它体内有什么回应了.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Storied_Desc.en: Others know this one by name before they see it.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Storied_Desc.cn: 别人还没见到它, 就已听过它的名字.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Tempered_Desc.en: Blooded. The Stir has settled in and will not leave.
UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Tempered_Desc.ch: 血契已成. 悸動已然安居, 不會再離開.
UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Tempered_Desc.cn: 血契已成. 悸动已然安居, 不会再离开.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Undying_Desc.en: There is nothing left in it to wake.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Undying_Desc.cn: 它体内再没有什么可以苏醒了.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Waking_Desc.en: A Bond has formed, and its trait begins to bite.

UI_VorpallySauced_Trait_Waking_Desc.cn: 羁绊已经缔结, 它的特质开始显出锋芒.

UI_Aegis_RzTooMany.cn: 区块太多: %1, 每个区域最多 %2 块. 请收回一些.

UI_AA_cook_nowater.en: There is no water source within reach that can fill this.
UI_AA_cook_nowater.ch: 伸手範圍內沒有可以裝滿它的水源.
UI_AA_cook_nowater.cn: 伸手范围内没有可以装满它的水源.

UI_AA_cook_option_water_tt.en: Fills the pot from a water source within four tiles first, then fills the dish on its own with the best ingredients within reach. Recipe limit: %1 ingredients.
UI_AA_cook_option_water_tt.ch: 先從四格內的水源把鍋子裝滿水, 然後自動用伸手範圍內最好的食材把這道菜填滿. 配方上限: %1種食材.
UI_AA_cook_option_water_tt.cn: 先从四格内的水源把锅装满水, 然后自动用伸手范围内最好的食材把这道菜填满. 配方上限: %1种食材.

UI_AA_cook_tainted.en: Only tainted water in reach. The taint does not carry into the finished dish.
UI_AA_cook_tainted.ch: 伸手範圍內只有受汙染的水. 汙染不會帶進完成的菜餚裡.
UI_AA_cook_tainted.cn: 伸手范围内只有受污染的水. 污染不会带进完成的菜里.

UI_AA_exercise_off.en: Auto training stopped: Auto Exercise is switched off.
UI_AA_exercise_off.ch: 自動訓練已停止: 自動鍛鍊已關閉.
UI_AA_exercise_off.cn: 自动训练已停止: 自动锻炼已关闭.

UI_AA_med_blocked.en: %1 wound(s) need a tool you do not have. Left undressed so you can still treat them.
UI_AA_med_blocked.ch: 有%1處傷口需要你沒有的工具. 已保持未包紮, 讓你之後還能自己處理.
UI_AA_med_blocked.cn: 有%1处伤口需要你没有的工具. 已保持未包扎, 让你之后还能自己处理.

UI_AA_med_noclean.en: %1 wound(s) have no clean bandage. Left undressed rather than dressed with a dirty one.
UI_AA_med_noclean.ch: 有%1處傷口沒有乾淨的繃帶. 寧可不包紮, 也不用髒繃帶包.
UI_AA_med_noclean.cn: 有%1处伤口没有干净的绷带. 宁可不包扎, 也不用脏绷带包.

UI_AA_open_blocked.en: Found things to open, but none of them can be right now. Try again in a moment.
UI_AA_open_blocked.ch: 找到可以開啟的東西, 但目前都無法開啟. 稍後再試一次.
UI_AA_open_blocked.cn: 找到可以打开的东西, 但目前都无法打开. 稍后再试一次.

UI_AA_opt_cookFillWater.en: Fill an empty pot with water first

UI_AA_opt_cookFillWater_tt.en: Offers Auto Cook on an empty pot or mug when there is a sink, barrel or well within reach. The pot is filled with the game’s own Fill action, so it costs the same water as filling it by hand.
UI_AA_opt_cookFillWater_tt.ch: 伸手範圍內有洗手台, 雨水桶或水井時, 空鍋子或空杯子上也會提供自動烹飪選項. 鍋子是用遊戲本身的裝水動作裝滿的, 所以耗水量和手動裝水一樣.
UI_AA_opt_cookFillWater_tt.cn: 伸手范围内有水池, 雨水桶或水井时, 空锅或空杯子上也会提供自动烹饪选项. 锅是用游戏本身的装水动作装满的, 所以耗水量和手动装水一样.

UI_AA_opt_cookReach.en: How far to look for ingredients, in tiles
UI_AA_opt_cookReach.ch: 搜尋食材的範圍, 以格為單位
UI_AA_opt_cookReach.cn: 搜索食材的范围, 以格为单位

UI_AA_opt_cookReach_tt.en: Tiles to search for cupboards, counters and fridges when cooking. Walls and locked crates still stop the search at any setting, so this only widens where it can already reach. Higher settings make right clicking a pot slower, because the sweep grows with the square of the distance.
UI_AA_opt_cookReach_tt.ch: 烹飪時搜尋櫥櫃, 檯面與冰箱的格數. 不管設多少, 牆壁和上鎖的板條箱一樣會擋住搜尋, 所以這只是把原本就能到的範圍放大. 設得越高, 右鍵點選鍋子就越慢, 因為掃描量隨距離的平方成長.
UI_AA_opt_cookReach_tt.cn: 烹饪时搜索橱柜, 台面与冰箱的格数. 不管设多少, 墙壁和上锁的板条箱一样会挡住搜索, 所以这只是把原本就能到的范围放大. 设得越高, 右键点击锅就越慢, 因为扫描量随距离的平方增长.

UI_AA_opt_dismantleSkipFavorite_tt.en: Items flagged as favourite are left alone. With this off, one favourited watch stops the whole batch rather than being skipped.
UI_AA_opt_dismantleSkipFavorite_tt.ch: 標記為收藏的物品不會被動到. 關閉時, 一隻標記收藏的手錶就會讓整批作業停下, 而不是跳過它.
UI_AA_opt_dismantleSkipFavorite_tt.cn: 标记为收藏的物品不会被动到. 关闭时, 一只标记收藏的手表就会让整批作业停下, 而不是跳过它.

UI_AA_opt_healthFloor.en: Auto Mechanics: stop below this health when heavily loaded
UI_AA_opt_healthFloor.ch: 自動技工: 負重過重時低於此健康值就停止
UI_AA_opt_healthFloor.cn: 自动技工: 负重过重时低于此健康值就停止

UI_AA_opt_healthFloor_tt.en: Auto Mechanics is the one job that keeps working while you take damage, because a mechanic carrying a tyre and four tools strains constantly and that is the job rather than a wound. This is the bottom under that: below this health AND carrying a heavy load, it stops anyway. No other job is ever stopped for weight. Needs “Stop when taking damage” ticked. Set to 0 to switch this rule off.
UI_AA_opt_healthFloor_tt.ch: 自動技工是唯一在你受到傷害時仍會繼續的作業, 因為技工扛著一條輪胎和四樣工具本來就會持續耗損, 那是工作本身造成的, 不是傷口. 這個設定是它的底線: 健康值低於此數值, 而且同時處於負重過重狀態時, 它還是會停下. 其他作業一律不會因為負重而停止. 需要勾選「受到傷害時停止」. 設為0可關閉這條規則.
UI_AA_opt_healthFloor_tt.cn: 自动技工是唯一在你受到伤害时仍会继续的作业, 因为技工扛着一条轮胎和四样工具本来就会持续消耗, 那是工作本身造成的, 不是伤口. 这个设置是它的底线: 健康值低于此数值, 而且同时处于负重过重状态时, 它还是会停下. 其他作业一律不会因为负重而停止. 需要勾选“受到伤害时停止”. 设为0可关闭这条规则.

UI_AA_opt_ignoreNpcs.en: Ignore NPCs that are not hunting you

UI_AA_opt_ignoreNpcs_tt.en: Every NPC mod builds its characters as zombies, so the game counts your own companion as one. With this on, only real zombies and NPCs that have you as their target stop a job.
UI_AA_opt_ignoreNpcs_tt.ch: 每個NPC模組都把角色做成殭屍類別, 所以遊戲會把你自己的同伴也算成殭屍. 啟用時, 只有真正的殭屍和以你為目標的NPC才會讓作業停止.
UI_AA_opt_ignoreNpcs_tt.cn: 每个NPC模组都把角色做成僵尸类别, 所以游戏会把你自己的同伴也算成僵尸. 启用时, 只有真正的僵尸和以你为目标的NPC才会让作业停止.

UI_AA_opt_medSplint_tt.en: Uses a splint, or a plank and a ripped sheet, on a broken limb before dressing it - the same rules the Health window follows. Never the head or the torso.
UI_AA_opt_medSplint_tt.ch: 在包紮前, 先用夾板, 或木板加碎布固定斷掉的四肢 - 規則和健康視窗一樣. 絕不處理頭部或軀幹.
UI_AA_opt_medSplint_tt.cn: 在包扎前, 先用夹板, 或木板加碎布条固定断掉的四肢 - 规则和健康窗口一样. 绝不处理头部或躯干.

UI_AA_opt_vhsBooksOnly.en: Only tapes with enough skill-book XP bonus
UI_AA_opt_vhsBooksOnly.ch: 只看技能書經驗加成足夠的錄影帶
UI_AA_opt_vhsBooksOnly.cn: 只看技能书经验加成足够的录像带

UI_AA_opt_vhsBooksOnly_tt.en: A tape’s XP is multiplied by the skill book’s bonus, and its lines are spent whether or not the book bonus is ready. Turn this on to use the minimum bonus below. Skills with no book in the game are always watched.
UI_AA_opt_vhsBooksOnly_tt.ch: 錄影帶的經驗值會乘上技能書的加成, 而且不管書本加成是否就緒, 錄影帶的內容都一樣會被消耗掉. 啟用後會改用下方的最低加成門檻. 遊戲裡沒有對應書本的技能一律照常觀看.
UI_AA_opt_vhsBooksOnly_tt.cn: 录像带的经验值会乘上技能书的加成, 而且不管书本加成是否就绪, 录像带的内容都一样会被消耗掉. 启用后会改用下方的最低加成门槛. 游戏里没有对应书本的技能一律照常观看.

UI_AA_repair_nomatch.en: %1 hole(s) need a material you do not have.
UI_AA_repair_nomatch.ch: 有%1處破洞需要你沒有的材料.
UI_AA_repair_nomatch.cn: 有%1处破洞需要你没有的材料.

UI_AA_steril_blocked.en: Found things to sterilize, but none of them can be right now. Try again in a moment.
UI_AA_steril_blocked.ch: 找到可以消毒的東西, 但目前都無法消毒. 稍後再試一次.
UI_AA_steril_blocked.cn: 找到可以消毒的东西, 但目前都无法消毒. 稍后再试一次.

UI_AA_vhs_done_partial.en: Finished: %1 tapes watched, %2 stopped part way through.
UI_AA_vhs_done_partial.ch: 已完成: 看完%1卷錄影帶, %2卷看到一半就中斷.
UI_AA_vhs_done_partial.cn: 已完成: 看完%1卷录像带, %2卷看到一半就中断.

UI_AA_vhs_nobook.en: No tape within reach meets the skill-book XP threshold.
UI_AA_vhs_nobook.ch: 伸手範圍內沒有錄影帶達到技能書經驗門檻.
UI_AA_vhs_nobook.cn: 伸手范围内没有录像带达到技能书经验门槛.

UI_MM_opt_autoRead_tt.en: Between sets the character reads a useful book from their own inventory and puts it down the moment endurance is back. Uses Auto Read’s own judgement of what is worth reading.
UI_MM_opt_autoRead_tt.ch: 每組之間, 角色會從自己的物品欄拿出一本有用的書來讀, 耐力一恢復就立刻放下. 判斷哪些書值得讀時, 沿用自動閱讀本身的邏輯.
UI_MM_opt_autoRead_tt.cn: 每组之间, 角色会从自己的物品栏拿出一本有用的书来读, 耐力一恢复就立刻放下. 判断哪些书值得读时, 沿用自动阅读本身的逻辑.

UI_MM_stop_injury.en: Auto training stopped: an injury needs treating first.
UI_MM_stop_injury.ch: 自動訓練已停止: 有傷口需要先處理.
UI_MM_stop_injury.cn: 自动训练已停止: 有伤口需要先处理.

UI_prof_MasterEngineerDesc.en: A multi-disciplinary expert skilled in woodwork, mechanics, metalworking and electrical systems.
UI_prof_MasterEngineerDesc.ch: 跨領域的專家, 精通木工、機械、金屬加工與電力系統.
UI_prof_MasterEngineerDesc.cn: 跨领域的专家, 精通木工、机械、金属加工与电力系统.

UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page1Body.en: Volatile hours follow the world's Sandbox settings (00:00–06:00 by default). At night, Volatiles wake, leave buildings and hunt outdoors. <LINE> <LINE> Volatiles are fast, tough and highly alert. All skill XP gained during Volatile hours is doubled. <LINE> <LINE> When you hear their screams, find shelter or prepare an escape route.
UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page1Body.ch: 夜魔時段依照世界的沙盒設定 (預設為 00:00–06:00). 入夜後, 夜魔會醒來, 離開建築物並在戶外獵捕. <LINE> <LINE> 夜魔速度快、耐打且極為警覺. 在夜魔時段內獲得的所有技能經驗值都會加倍. <LINE> <LINE> 當你聽見牠們的尖叫時, 請找地方躲避或準備好逃生路線.
UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page1Body.cn: 夜魔时段遵循世界的沙盒设置 (默认为 00:00–06:00). 入夜后, 夜魔会苏醒, 离开建筑并在户外捕猎. <LINE> <LINE> 夜魔速度快、耐打且极为警觉. 在夜魔时段内获得的所有技能经验值都会翻倍. <LINE> <LINE> 当你听到它们的尖叫时, 请寻找掩蔽处或准备好逃生路线.

UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page2Body.en: Outside Volatile hours, Volatiles sleep inside buildings. Their heavy breathing can reveal a nest. <LINE> <LINE> A sleeping Volatile may wake if you approach, make noise nearby or hit it. <LINE> <LINE> During the day it may attack an intruder inside the building, but it will not continue the chase outside. Listen, stay quiet and keep an escape route.
UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page2Body.ch: 在夜魔時段之外, 夜魔會在建築物內睡覺. 牠們沉重的呼吸聲可能會暴露巢穴的位置. <LINE> <LINE> 如果你靠近、在附近製造噪音或攻擊牠, 沉睡的夜魔可能會醒來. <LINE> <LINE> 白天牠可能會攻擊闖入建築物內的人, 但不會追到室外繼續追擊. 請仔細聽、保持安靜, 並留好一條逃生路線.
UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page2Body.cn: 在夜魔时段之外, 夜魔会在建筑内睡觉. 它们沉重的呼吸声可能会暴露巢穴的位置. <LINE> <LINE> 如果你靠近、在附近制造噪音或攻击它, 沉睡的夜魔可能会醒来. <LINE> <LINE> 白天它可能会攻击闯入建筑内的人, 但不会追到室外继续追击. 请仔细听、保持安静, 并留好一条逃生路线.

UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page3Body.en: At night, a switched-on lamp fitted with a purple bulb acts as a UV light. Handheld flashlights are not UV sources. <LINE> <LINE> UV forces nearby Volatiles to stop attacking and flee from the light. It does not damage or kill them; it creates only temporary space. <LINE> <LINE> Keep the lamp powered and switched on. If Enable UV Mechanics is disabled in Sandbox settings, purple-bulb lamps have no effect.
UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page3Body.ch: 入夜後, 裝上紫色燈泡並開啟的燈具會作為紫外線光源. 手持手電筒不是紫外線來源. <LINE> <LINE> 紫外線會迫使附近的夜魔停止攻擊並逃離光源. 它不會傷害或殺死牠們; 只能爭取暫時的空間. <LINE> <LINE> 請維持燈具供電並保持開啟. 如果在沙盒設定中停用了「啟用紫外線機制」, 紫色燈泡的燈具就不會有任何效果.
UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page3Body.cn: 入夜后, 装上紫色灯泡并开启的灯具会充当紫外线光源. 手持手电筒不是紫外线源. <LINE> <LINE> 紫外线会迫使附近的夜魔停止攻击并逃离光源. 它不会伤害或杀死它们; 只能争取暂时的空间. <LINE> <LINE> 请保持灯具通电并处于开启状态. 如果在沙盒设置中关闭了 “启用紫外线机制”, 紫色灯泡灯具就不会有任何效果.

UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page4Body.en: You can customize Volatile difficulty, hunting hours, encounters, nests and UV mechanics under Sandbox > Blackout Predators. <LINE> <LINE> Lower settings can reduce the performance cost on busy worlds and multiplayer servers. <LINE> <LINE> For low-end systems, disable UV mechanics and set Active Nest Limit to 0. You can also lower Ambient Volatile Spawn Rate if you want fewer nighttime encounters.
UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page4Body.ch: 你可以在「沙盒 > 黑暗捕食者」中自訂夜魔難度、獵捕時段、遭遇、巢穴與紫外線機制. <LINE> <LINE> 調低設定可以降低繁忙世界與多人伺服器的效能消耗. <LINE> <LINE> 若是低階配備, 請停用紫外線機制並將「活躍巢穴上限」設為 0. 如果你想減少夜間遭遇, 也可以調低「環境夜魔生成率」.
UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Page4Body.cn: 你可以在 “沙盒 > 黑暗捕食者” 中自定义夜魔难度、捕猎时段、遭遇、巢穴与紫外线机制. <LINE> <LINE> 调低设置可以降低繁忙世界与多人服务器的性能消耗. <LINE> <LINE> 若是低配设备, 请关闭紫外线机制并将 “活跃巢穴上限” 设为 0. 如果你想减少夜间遭遇, 也可以调低 “环境夜魔刷新率”.

UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Title.ch: 黑暗捕食者 — 生存指南
UI_BlackoutPredators_Tutorial_Title.cn: 黑暗捕食者 — 生存指南

UI_options_blackoutpredators_showTutoria.en: Opens the Blackout Predators tutorial while a game is loaded. New characters see it automatically once.
UI_options_blackoutpredators_showTutoria.ch: 在遊戲載入後開啟黑暗捕食者的教學. 新角色會自動看到一次.
UI_options_blackoutpredators_showTutoria.cn: 在游戏加载后打开黑暗捕食者的教程. 新角色会自动显示一次.

UI_AA_vhs_capped.en: No tape within reach can grant skill XP. The relevant skills have reached the sandbox media cutoff at level %1.
UI_AA_vhs_capped.ch: 附近沒有還能提供技能經驗值的錄影帶. 相關技能已達到沙盒設定的影音教材上限等級 %1.
UI_AA_vhs_capped.cn: 附近没有还能提供技能经验值的录像带. 相关技能已达到沙盒设置的影音教材上限等级 %1.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_CLEAR.en:
Clear the ground around the generator.

Zombies in the area: {count}.
Kill them or lure them outside the perimeter.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_CLEAR.ch:
清空發電機周圍的地面.

這一帶的殭屍: {count} 隻.
殺死牠們, 或把牠們引到警戒範圍外.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_CLEAR.cn:
清空发电机周围的地面.

这一带的僵尸: {count} 只.
杀死它们, 或把它们引到警戒范围外.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_GATHER.en:
Gather the materials to repair the pump.

Once you have everything, take your tools straight to the installation.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_GATHER.ch:
收集修好水泵所需的材料.

東西湊齊之後, 直接帶著你的工具去那座設施.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_GATHER.cn:
收集修好水泵所需的材料.

东西凑齐之后, 直接带上你的工具去那座设施.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_PUMP_OFF.en:
The pump doesn't respond. Without power, the motor can't start.

Repair the generator first.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_PUMP_OFF.ch:
水泵沒有反應. 沒有電力, 馬達無法啟動.

請先修好發電機.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_PUMP_OFF.cn:
水泵没有反应. 没有电力, 马达无法启动.

请先修好发电机.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_PUMP_ON.en:
The pump is running. The generator is supplying power again.

Return to Mae and tell her what you've checked.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_PUMP_ON.ch:
水泵正在運轉. 發電機再次開始供電.

回去找梅, 告訴她你檢查到的狀況.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_PUMP_ON.cn:
水泵正在运转. 发电机再次开始供电.

回去找梅, 告诉她你检查到的情况.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_ACCEPTED.en: Tell Mae I sent you. She will explain what needs doing.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_ACCEPTED.ch: 告訴梅是我讓你去的. 她會說明需要做什麼.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_ACCEPTED.cn: 告诉梅是我让你去的. 她会说明需要做什么.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_DESCRIPTION.en: Find Mae Turner and ask about the Riverside water installation.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_DESCRIPTION.ch: 找到梅·特納, 詢問河濱鎮供水設施的事.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_DESCRIPTION.cn: 找到梅·特纳, 询问河畔镇供水设施的事.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_OPTION.en: Is there any infrastructure work to do?
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_OPTION.ch: 有什麼基礎設施的工作要做嗎?
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_OPTION.cn: 有什么基础设施的工作要做吗?

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_TEXT.en:
Mae Turner coordinates the repairs. She needs help with the water installation by the W Main St bridge in Riverside.

Talk to her; she can explain the problem.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_TEXT.ch:
梅·特納負責統籌維修工作. 河濱鎮 W Main St 橋邊的供水設施需要人幫忙.

去找她談談; 她可以說明是什麼問題.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRAL_TEXT.cn:
梅·特纳负责统筹维修工作. 河畔镇 W Main St 桥边的供水设施需要人帮忙.

去找她谈谈; 她可以说明是什么问题.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REFERRED.en: {referrer} told me to speak with you.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REPAIR_INVALID.en: Stay beside the mission object, alive and with its repair objective active.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REPAIR_INVALID.ch: 請待在任務目標物旁, 保持存活, 並讓它的修復目標處於進行中.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REPAIR_INVALID.cn: 请待在任务目标物旁, 保持存活, 并让它的修复目标处于进行中.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REPORT.en: The work is finished. Here is my report.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REPORT.ch: 工作完成了. 這是我的報告.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_REPORT.cn: 工作完成了. 这是我的报告.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_RETURN_MAE.en: Return to Mae and tell her how the work went.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_RETURN_MAE.ch: 回去找梅, 告訴她工作進行得如何.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_RETURN_MAE.cn: 回去找梅, 告诉她工作进行得如何.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_UNKNOWN_FACT.en: Additional information: not discovered yet. Ask your contacts.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_UNKNOWN_FACT.ch: 附加資訊: 尚未發現. 去詢問你的聯絡人.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_UNKNOWN_FACT.cn: 附加信息: 尚未发现. 去询问你的联络人.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_ACTIVE.en:
How is the work at the bridge going?

I need to know whether the generator is repaired and you've checked the pump. If you're missing anything, we can go over what you need.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_ACTIVE.ch:
橋邊的工作進行得怎麼樣?

我需要知道發電機修好了沒有, 以及你有沒有檢查過水泵. 如果你還缺什麼, 我們可以再確認一次你需要的東西.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_ACTIVE.cn:
桥边的工作进行得怎么样?

我需要知道发电机修好了没有, 以及你有没有检查过水泵. 如果你还缺什么, 我们可以再确认一次你需要的东西.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_BRIEFI.en:
The generator by the W Main St bridge has stopped working. Without power, the pump can't move water.

We need to restore power before we can tell whether anything else is broken.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_BRIEFI.ch:
W Main St 橋邊的發電機停止運作了. 沒有電力, 水泵就無法抽水.

我們得先恢復供電, 才能判斷還有什麼壞掉.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_BRIEFI.cn:
W Main St 桥边的发电机停止运作了. 没有电力, 水泵就无法抽水.

我们得先恢复供电, 才能判断还有什么坏掉.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_CONTAC.en:
Mae is coordinating repairs to the generator by the W Main St bridge in Riverside.

Talk to her to find out what's needed.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_CONTAC.ch:
梅正在統籌河濱鎮 W Main St 橋邊那台發電機的維修工作.

去找她談談, 了解需要什麼.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_CONTAC.cn:
梅正在统筹河畔镇 W Main St 桥边那台发电机的维修工作.

去找她谈谈, 了解需要什么.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_DESCRI.en:
The generator by the W Main St bridge has failed, leaving Riverside's pump without power. Mae needs you to restore the installation.

- Clear the generator area.
- Repair the generator.
- Check that the pump works.
- Return to Mae and report the result.

Reward:
- 2500 credits.
- 1 hammer.
- 2 wrenches.
- 10 rolls of duct tape.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_DESCRI.ch:
W Main St 橋邊的發電機故障了, 讓河濱鎮的水泵失去電力. 梅需要你恢復這座設施.

- 清空發電機周圍區域.
- 修好發電機.
- 檢查水泵能否運轉.
- 回去向梅回報結果.

獎勵:
- 2,500 信用點.
- 一把錘子.
- 兩把扳手.
- 十捲膠帶.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_DESCRI.cn:
W Main St 桥边的发电机坏了, 让河畔镇的水泵失去电力. 梅需要你恢复这座设施.

- 清空发电机周围区域.
- 修好发电机.
- 检查水泵能否运转.
- 回去向梅汇报结果.

奖励:
- 2,500 信用点.
- 一把锤子.
- 两把扳手.
- 十卷胶带.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_FACT.en:
That generator powers the water pump. Without it, we don't even have a chance of restoring the supply.

Starting it will let us check the pump, but electricity won't fix pipes or worn parts. We'll have to see how it responds.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_FACT.ch:
那台發電機為水泵供電. 少了它, 我們連恢復供水的機會都沒有.

把它啟動起來, 我們就能檢查水泵, 但電力不會修好管線或磨損的零件. 只能看它反應如何.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_FACT.cn:
那台发电机为水泵供电. 少了它, 我们连恢复供水的机会都没有.

把它启动起来, 我们就能检查水泵, 但电力不会修好管道或磨损的零件. 只能看它反应如何.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_THANKS.en:
Then we have power again and the pump starts. Thank you for taking care of it. Here's what I promised:

- 2500 credits.
- 1 hammer.
- 2 wrenches.
- 10 rolls of duct tape.

But the water is still coming through weakly. The pump is worn out; getting it running wasn't enough. We need to repair that part too.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_THANKS.ch:
這樣我們就重新有電, 水泵也啟動了. 謝謝你處理這件事. 這是我答應給你的東西:

- 2,500 信用點.
- 一把錘子.
- 兩把扳手.
- 十捲膠帶.

不過水流還是很弱. 水泵已經磨損, 光是讓它運轉還不夠. 那個部分我們也得修好.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_THANKS.cn:
这样我们就重新有电, 水泵也启动了. 谢谢你处理这件事. 这是我答应给你的东西:

- 2,500 信用点.
- 一把锤子.
- 两把扳手.
- 十卷胶带.

不过水流还是很弱. 水泵已经磨损, 光是让它运转还不够. 那个部分我们也得修好.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_TITLE.ch: 河濱鎮的用水: 電力
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_TITLE.cn: 河畔镇的用水: 电力

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_ACTIVE.en:
What do you still need to finish the pump?

If you're still looking for parts, we can go over what you need. Once you have everything, go straight to repair it, then come back and tell me the result.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_ACTIVE.ch:
要修好水泵, 你還缺什麼?

如果你還在找零件, 我們可以再確認一次你需要的東西. 東西湊齊之後就直接去修, 然後回來告訴我結果.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_ACTIVE.cn:
要修好水泵, 你还缺什么?

如果你还在找零件, 我们可以再确认一次你需要的东西. 东西凑齐之后就直接去修, 然后回来告诉我结果.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_BRIEFING.en:
The pump runs, but its parts are worn and the connections are losing pressure. That's why so little water is getting through.

It needs repairing where it stands. The problem is that I have no materials left for that work; you'll have to find them.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_BRIEFING.ch:
水泵能運轉了, 但它的零件已經磨損, 接頭也在漏失水壓. 這就是出水量這麼少的原因.

它得就地修理. 問題是那項工作我已經沒有材料了; 得由你去找.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_BRIEFING.cn:
水泵能运转了, 但它的零件已经磨损, 接头也在漏失水压. 这就是出水量这么少的原因.

它得就地修理. 问题是那项工作我已经没有材料了; 得由你去找.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_CONTACT.en:
The generator is running, but the pump still needs repairs.

Talk to Mae about the missing parts before returning to the installation.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_CONTACT.ch:
發電機正在運轉, 但水泵仍需要修理.

回到那座設施之前, 先找梅談談缺少的零件.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_CONTACT.cn:
发电机正在运转, 但水泵仍需要修理.

回到那座设施之前, 先找梅谈谈缺少的零件.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_DESCRIPTION.en:
The pump starts, but wear prevents it from maintaining pressure. Mae needs you to repair it; this time you must find the materials.

- Gather the repair materials.
- Take your tools straight to the pump and repair it.
- Return to Mae and report the result.

The repair restores drinking water to plumbed fixtures within fifty tiles, on all floors.

Reward:
- 2500 credits.
- 1 pipe wrench.
- 6 metal pipes.
- 1 blowtorch.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_DESCRIPTION.ch:
水泵能啟動了, 但磨損讓它無法維持水壓. 梅需要你修好它; 這次材料得由你自己找.

- 收集修理所需的材料.
- 直接帶著工具到水泵那裡修好它.
- 回去向梅回報結果.

修復後, 五十格範圍內各樓層的管線設施都會恢復飲用水.

獎勵:
- 2,500 信用點.
- 一把管鉗.
- 六根金屬管.
- 一把噴燈.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_DESCRIPTION.cn:
水泵能启动了, 但磨损让它无法维持水压. 梅需要你修好它; 这次材料得由你自己找.

- 收集修理所需的材料.
- 直接带上工具到水泵那里修好它.
- 回去向梅汇报结果.

修复后, 五十格范围内各楼层的管道设施都会恢复饮用水.

奖励:
- 2,500 信用点.
- 一把管钳.
- 六根金属管.
- 一个喷灯.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_FACT.en:
Restoring pressure will bring drinking water to the fixtures connected to these pipes, including those on upper floors and in basements.

The reach is local: about fifty paces around the pump. It won't fix all of Riverside's network, but those nearby will have water again.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_FACT.ch:
恢復水壓之後, 接在這些管線上的設施就會有飲用水, 包含樓上和地下室的那些.

影響範圍是局部的: 水泵周圍約五十步. 這不會修好整個河濱鎮的管網, 但附近的人又會有水用了.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_FACT.cn:
恢复水压之后, 接在这些管道上的设施就会有饮用水, 包括楼上和地下室的那些.

影响范围是局部的: 水泵周围约五十步. 这不会修好整个河畔镇的管网, 但附近的人又会有水用了.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_OFFER.ch: 關於修理那台磨損的水泵…
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_OFFER.cn: 关于修理那台磨损的水泵…

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_THANKS.en:
That's what we needed. With the pump repaired, the nearby fixtures can supply water again.

Here's your pay:

- 2500 credits.
- 1 pipe wrench.
- 6 metal pipes.
- 1 blowtorch.

We haven't fixed all of Riverside, but we've brought back something people need every day. Thank you for finishing the work.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_THANKS.ch:
這就是我們需要的結果. 水泵修好之後, 附近的設施又能供水了.

這是你的報酬:

- 2,500 信用點.
- 一把管鉗.
- 六根金屬管.
- 一把噴燈.

我們沒有修好整個河濱鎮, 但把大家每天都需要的東西找回來了. 謝謝你完成這項工作.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_THANKS.cn:
这就是我们需要的结果. 水泵修好之后, 附近的设施又能供水了.

这是你的报酬:

- 2,500 信用点.
- 一把管钳.
- 六根金属管.
- 一个喷灯.

我们没有修好整个河畔镇, 但把大家每天都需要的东西找回来了. 谢谢你完成这项工作.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_TITLE.cn: 河畔镇的用水: 水压

UI_BurdJournals_JournalKeptFavorite.cn: 已收藏的日记保留在你的物品栏中.

UI_BurdJournals_JournalKeptPending.en: Journal kept in your inventory while its records finish updating.
UI_BurdJournals_JournalKeptPending.ch: 日記記錄更新完成前, 會保留在你的物品欄中.
UI_BurdJournals_JournalKeptPending.cn: 日记记录更新完成前, 会保留在你的物品栏中.

UI_BurdJournals_MaintenanceComplete.ch: 日記筆記已修訂: 恢復 %1%%.
UI_BurdJournals_MaintenanceComplete.cn: 日记笔记已修订: 恢复 %1%%.

UI_BurdJournals_PassiveBaselineUncertain.en: Original passive starting levels are unknown. An admin can correct this baseline.
UI_BurdJournals_PassiveBaselineUncertain.ch: 無法得知被動技能的原始起始等級. 管理員可以修正這份基準資料.
UI_BurdJournals_PassiveBaselineUncertain.cn: 无法得知被动技能的原始初始等级. 管理员可以修正这份基准数据.

UI_BurdJournals_SkillDetailNextRecovery.ch: 距離下次恢復 1%% 還需 %1 個遊戲小時.
UI_BurdJournals_SkillDetailNextRecovery.cn: 距离下次恢复 1%% 还需 %1 个游戏小时.

UI_BurdJournals_SkillDetailPenalty.ch: 下次閱讀: %1%% | 磨損: %2 點 | 範圍: %3
UI_BurdJournals_SkillDetailPenalty.cn: 下次阅读: %1%% | 磨损: %2 点 | 范围: %3

UI_AA_openbox_blocked.en: Found boxes, but none of them can be opened right now. Try again in a moment.
UI_AA_openbox_blocked.ch: 找到了盒裝物品, 但目前都無法開啟. 稍後再試一次.
UI_AA_openbox_blocked.cn: 找到了盒装物品, 但目前都无法打开. 稍后再试一次.

UI_AA_openbox_nothing.ch: 這裡沒有任何還裝在盒子裡的東西.
UI_AA_openbox_nothing.cn: 这里没有任何还装在盒子里的东西.

UI_AA_openbox_option_all.ch: 開啟伸手範圍內所有盒裝物品
UI_AA_openbox_option_all.cn: 打开伸手范围内所有盒装物品

UI_AA_openbox_option_tt.en: Opens %1 of the %2 within reach, one after another. Any sitting in a container are fetched, and what comes out goes back where the box came from. Loose rounds weigh more than the box they came in.
UI_AA_openbox_option_tt.ch: 依序開啟伸手範圍內 %2 當中的 %1 個. 放在容器裡的會自動取出, 開出來的內容物會放回盒子原本所在的位置. 散裝子彈比原本的盒裝更重.
UI_AA_openbox_option_tt.cn: 依次打开伸手范围内 %2 当中的 %1 个. 放在容器里的会自动取出, 开出来的内容物会放回盒子原本所在的位置. 散装子弹比原本的盒装更重.

UI_AA_opt_vhsBookXpThreshold_tt.en: When the book gate is on, a skill tape is watched only when its active book bonus reaches this percentage of the current book’s full XP multiplier. 100%% requires the whole book. Skills with no skill book and tapes that teach an unknown recipe are still watched.
UI_AA_opt_vhsBookXpThreshold_tt.ch: 啟用書本限制時, 只有當該技能目前生效的書本加成達到這本書完整經驗倍率的這個百分比, 才會觀看對應的錄影帶. 設為100%%就必須讀完整本書. 沒有技能書的技能, 以及會教你未知配方的錄影帶, 一樣會照常觀看.
UI_AA_opt_vhsBookXpThreshold_tt.cn: 启用书本限制时, 只有当该技能当前生效的书本加成达到这本书完整经验倍率的这个百分比, 才会观看对应的录像带. 设为100%%就必须读完整本书. 没有技能书的技能, 以及会教你未知配方的录像带, 一样会照常观看.

UI_AA_unpack_blocked.en: Found cartons, but none of them can be unpacked right now. Try again in a moment.
UI_AA_unpack_blocked.ch: 找到了紙箱, 但目前都無法拆開. 稍後再試一次.
UI_AA_unpack_blocked.cn: 找到了纸箱, 但目前都无法拆开. 稍后再试一次.

UI_AA_unpack_nothing.ch: 這裡沒有任何還整箱未拆的東西.
UI_AA_unpack_nothing.cn: 这里没有任何还整箱未拆的东西.

UI_AA_unpack_option_all.ch: 拆開伸手範圍內所有紙箱
UI_AA_unpack_option_all.cn: 拆开伸手范围内所有纸箱

UI_AA_unpack_option_tt.en: Unpacks %1 of the %2 within reach into boxes of twelve, one after another. Any sitting in a container are fetched, and the boxes go back where the carton came from.
UI_AA_unpack_option_tt.ch: 依序把伸手範圍內 %2 當中的 %1 個拆成 12 個盒裝物品. 放在容器裡的會自動取出, 拆出的盒子會放回紙箱原本所在的位置.
UI_AA_unpack_option_tt.cn: 依次把伸手范围内 %2 当中的 %1 个拆成 12 个盒装物品. 放在容器里的会自动取出, 拆出的盒子会放回纸箱原本所在的位置.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_BRIEFING_ACCEPT.en: All right. I'll take care of it.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_BRIEFING_ACCEPT.ch: 好. 這件事我來處理.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_BRIEFING_ACCEPT.cn: 好. 这件事我来处理.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_BRIEFING_LATER.en: I need to think about it.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_BRIEFING_LOCATION.ch: 再跟我說一次那在哪裡.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_BRIEFING_LOCATION.cn: 再跟我说一次那在哪儿.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_BRIEFING_REVIEW.en: Let's go over the job again.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_BRIEFING_REVIEW.ch: 我們再確認一次這項工作.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_BRIEFING_REVIEW.cn: 我们再确认一次这项工作.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_BRIEFING_STEPS.en: What do you need me to do?

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_READY_TO_REPORT.en: Did you finish the work? Tell me how it turned out.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_READY_TO_REPORT.ch: 工作完成了嗎? 告訴我結果如何.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_READY_TO_REPORT.cn: 工作完成了吗? 告诉我结果如何.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_DANGER.en:
Find a way out before approaching, and don't let yourself get trapped between the machines.

If you lure them away, circle around before returning so they don't follow you back to the generator.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_DANGER.ch:
靠近之前先找好退路, 別讓自己被夾在機器之間.

如果你把牠們引開, 回來前先繞一圈, 免得牠們跟著你回到發電機那裡.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_DANGER.cn:
靠近之前先找好退路, 别让自己被夹在机器之间.

如果你把它们引开, 回来前先绕一圈, 免得它们跟着你回到发电机那里.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_DANGER.en: How do I approach the bridge without getting cornered?
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_DANGER.ch: 我要怎麼靠近那座橋才不會被逼到死角?
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_DANGER.cn: 我要怎么靠近那座桥才不会被逼到死角?

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_INSTRU.en:
First clear the ground around the generator. There are zombies in the area; kill them or lure them away so you can work.

Then repair the generator and check whether the pump starts. Don't dismantle it yet.

Once you've checked it, come back and tell me the result.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_INSTRU.ch:
先清空發電機周圍的地面. 那一帶有殭屍; 殺死牠們或把牠們引開, 你才有辦法工作.

然後修好發電機, 檢查水泵能不能啟動. 先不要拆解它.

檢查完之後, 回來告訴我結果.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_INSTRU.cn:
先清空发电机周围的地面. 那一带有僵尸; 杀死它们或把它们引开, 你才有办法工作.

然后修好发电机, 检查水泵能不能启动. 先不要拆解它.

检查完之后, 回来告诉我结果.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_INSTRU.en: Walk me through the job. What should I take?
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_INSTRU.ch: 跟我說一下這項工作. 我該帶什麼?
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_INSTRU.cn: 跟我说一下这项工作. 我该带什么?

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_INTRO.en:
We have a problem with Riverside's water supply, and I could use your help.

Can you check the installation by the bridge?
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_INTRO.ch:
河濱鎮的供水出了問題, 我需要你幫忙.

你能去檢查橋邊那座設施嗎?
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_INTRO.cn:
河畔镇的供水出了问题, 我需要你帮忙.

你能去检查桥边那座设施吗?

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_LOCATI.en:
By the W Main St bridge in Riverside. The generator and pump are close to each other.

The location is marked in your logbook. Once you get the generator running, check the pump before coming back.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_LOCATI.ch:
在河濱鎮 W Main St 橋邊. 發電機和水泵離得很近.

位置已經標在你的日誌裡. 把發電機發動之後, 先檢查水泵再回來.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_LOCATI.cn:
在河畔镇 W Main St 桥边. 发电机和水泵离得很近.

位置已经标在你的日志里. 把发电机启动之后, 先检查水泵再回来.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_REPORT.en: The generator and pump are working.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_REPORT.ch: 發電機和水泵都能運轉了.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_REPORT.cn: 发电机和水泵都能运转了.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_REQUIR.en:
Before you leave, let's go over what you'll need:

{requirements}

I'll provide the materials used up in the repair when you accept. You'll need to bring your own tools and know how to use them.

Once you've repaired the generator, checked the pump and come back to tell me the result, I'll give you:

- 2500 credits.
- 1 hammer.
- 2 wrenches.
- 10 rolls of duct tape.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_REQUIR.ch:
你出發之前, 我們先確認你會需要什麼:

{requirements}

你接下這項工作時, 修理過程中會消耗的材料由我提供. 工具要自己帶, 也要懂得怎麼用.

等你修好發電機、檢查過水泵, 回來告訴我結果之後, 我會給你:

- 2,500 信用點.
- 一把錘子.
- 兩把扳手.
- 十捲膠帶.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_GENERATOR_REQUIR.cn:
你出发之前, 我们先确认你会需要什么:

{requirements}

你接下这项工作时, 修理过程中会消耗的材料由我提供. 工具要自己带, 也要懂得怎么用.

等你修好发电机, 检查过水泵, 回来告诉我结果之后, 我会给你:

- 2,500 信用点.
- 一把锤子.
- 两把扳手.
- 十卷胶带.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_ACCEPTED.en:
Thank you for seeing this through.

Gather the parts and take everything straight to the pump. You don't need to bring the materials to me; you'll need them there for the work.

Once the repair is finished, come back and tell me the result. I'll have your pay ready.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_ACCEPTED.ch:
謝謝你把這件事做到底.

收集好零件, 然後把東西全部直接帶到水泵那裡. 材料不用拿來給我; 你在那裡工作時會用到.

修好之後, 回來告訴我結果. 我會把報酬準備好.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_ACCEPTED.cn:
谢谢你把这件事做到底.

收集好零件, 然后把东西全部直接带到水泵那里. 材料不用拿来给我; 你在那里干活时会用到.

修好之后, 回来告诉我结果. 我会把报酬准备好.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_INSTRUCTION.en:
Gather the materials first. Once you have everything, take your tools to the pump and repair it there; you don't need to stop here beforehand.

Even though you've cleared the place before, look around carefully before starting. Then come back and tell me how it turned out.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_INSTRUCTION.ch:
先收集材料. 東西湊齊之後, 把工具帶到水泵那裡就地修理; 不必先繞回我這裡.

雖然你之前已經清空過那裡, 開工前還是先仔細看看四周. 之後回來告訴我結果如何.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_INSTRUCTION.cn:
先收集材料. 东西凑齐之后, 把工具带到水泵那里就地修理; 不必先绕回我这里.

虽然你之前已经清空过那里, 开工前还是先仔细看看四周. 之后回来告诉我结果如何.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_INSTRUCTION.en: What is different about repairing the pump?
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_INSTRUCTION.ch: 修理水泵有什麼不一樣?
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_INSTRUCTION.cn: 修理水泵有什么不一样?

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_INTRO.en:
About that second repair: we need the pump to deliver enough pressure again.

Can you take care of it too? This time we'll have to find the parts before starting.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_INTRO.ch:
關於第二次維修: 我們得讓水泵重新輸出足夠的水壓.

這件事也能交給你嗎? 這次得先找到零件才能開工.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_INTRO.cn:
关于第二次维修: 我们得让水泵重新输出足够的水压.

这件事也能交给你吗? 这次得先找到零件才能开工.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_LOCATION.en:
It's the same pump by the W Main St bridge in Riverside, near the generator you repaired.

It's marked in your logbook. Take the parts there and come back to me after repairing it.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_LOCATION.ch:
就是河濱鎮 W Main St 橋邊那台水泵, 在你修好的發電機旁邊.

它已經標在你的日誌裡. 把零件帶過去, 修好之後回來找我.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_LOCATION.cn:
就是河畔镇 W Main St 桥边那台水泵, 在你修好的发电机旁边.

它已经标在你的日志里. 把零件带过去, 修好之后回来找我.

UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_REQUIREMENT.en:
To repair the pump, you'll need:

{requirements}

This time I have no materials to give you. You'll have to gather them and bring your tools; make sure you have the skills for the work too.

Once you've repaired it and come back to report, I'll give you:

- 2500 credits.
- 1 pipe wrench.
- 6 metal pipes.
- 1 blowtorch.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_REQUIREMENT.ch:
要修好水泵, 你會需要:

{requirements}

這次我沒有材料可以給你. 材料得由你自己收集, 工具也要自己帶; 也要確認你具備這項工作所需的技能.

等你修好它並回來回報之後, 我會給你:

- 2,500 信用點.
- 一把管鉗.
- 六根金屬管.
- 一把噴燈.
UI_KCMAIN_STORIES_WATER_PUMP_REQUIREMENT.cn:
要修好水泵, 你会需要:

{requirements}

这次我没有材料可以给你. 材料得由你自己收集, 工具也要自己带; 也要确认你具备这项工作所需的技能.

等你修好它并回来汇报之后, 我会给你:

- 2,500 信用点.
- 一把管钳.
- 六根金属管.
- 一个喷灯.

UI_KCMain_ModOptions_EnableMainMenuLight.en: Adds repeated bright flashes to the main-menu background. Disabled by default. Leave disabled if you are sensitive to flashing lights.
UI_KCMain_ModOptions_EnableMainMenuLight.ch: 在主選單背景加入反覆出現的強烈閃光. 預設為關閉. 如果你對閃爍光線敏感, 請保持關閉.
UI_KCMain_ModOptions_EnableMainMenuLight.cn: 在主菜单背景加入反复出现的强烈闪光. 默认为关闭. 如果你对闪烁光线敏感, 请保持关闭.

UI_MM_opt_stopInjury.ch: 有未處理的傷勢時停止
UI_MM_opt_stopInjury.cn: 有未处理的伤势时停止

UI_MM_opt_stopInjury_tt.en: Stops for active bleeding, unbandaged deep wounds and unsplinted arm or leg fractures. Splinted fractures, bandaged wounds and fractures that cannot be splinted do not stop training.
UI_MM_opt_stopInjury_tt.ch: 出血中, 未包紮的深傷口, 以及未上夾板的手臂或腿部骨折都會讓訓練停止. 已上夾板的骨折, 已包紮的傷口, 以及無法上夾板的骨折則不會停止訓練.
UI_MM_opt_stopInjury_tt.cn: 出血中, 未包扎的深伤口, 以及未上夹板的手臂或腿部骨折都会让训练停止. 已上夹板的骨折, 已包扎的伤口, 以及无法上夹板的骨折则不会停止训练.

UI_BCI_ShowClothingDebugInfo_tooltip.en: Show item type, body location, and equipped worn location on clothing tooltips.
UI_BCI_ShowClothingDebugInfo_tooltip.ch: 在衣物提示說明中顯示物品類型、身體部位與實際穿戴部位.
UI_BCI_ShowClothingDebugInfo_tooltip.cn: 在衣物提示信息中显示物品类型、身体部位与实际穿戴部位.

UI_AA_opt_medPoultices_tt.en: Off by default. Uses a suitable poultice before bandaging, only when no wound is bleeding. Never replaces an active poultice or removes a bandage.
UI_AA_opt_medPoultices_tt.ch: 預設關閉. 只在沒有任何傷口在流血時, 於包紮前敷上合適的藥膏. 絕不會換掉正在生效的藥膏, 也不會拆掉繃帶.
UI_AA_opt_medPoultices_tt.cn: 默认关闭. 只在没有任何伤口在流血时, 于包扎前敷上合适的药膏. 绝不会换掉正在生效的药膏, 也不会拆掉绷带.

UI_AA_pack_blocked.en: No complete matching batch can be packed right now.
UI_AA_pack_blocked.ch: 目前沒有可以打包的完整同款批次.
UI_AA_pack_blocked.cn: 目前没有可以打包的完整同款批次.

UI_AA_pack_nothing.ch: 這裡沒有任何可以打包的東西.
UI_AA_pack_nothing.cn: 这里没有任何可以打包的东西.

UI_AA_packammo_option_tt.en: Packs every complete matching batch of ammo within reach into boxes. Any leftovers stay loose.
UI_AA_packammo_option_tt.ch: 把伸手範圍內每一批完整的同款子彈裝成盒裝. 湊不成一盒的維持散裝.
UI_AA_packammo_option_tt.cn: 把伸手范围内每一批完整的同款子弹装成盒装. 凑不成一盒的保持散装.

UI_AA_packboxes_option_tt.en: Packs every complete set of 12 matching ammo boxes within reach into cartons. Any leftovers stay boxed.
UI_AA_packboxes_option_tt.ch: 把伸手範圍內每 12 個同款盒裝子彈湊成一組, 裝進紙箱. 湊不滿的維持盒裝.
UI_AA_packboxes_option_tt.cn: 把伸手范围内每 12 个同款盒装子弹凑成一组, 装进纸箱. 凑不满的保持盒装.

UI_TABAS_AutoClothesChangeExcludedFullTy.ch: 自動更換衣物時保留的物品
UI_TABAS_AutoClothesChangeExcludedFullTy.cn: 自动更换衣物时保留的物品

UI_TABAS_AutoClothesChangeExcludedFullTy.en: Enter item FullTypes (Module.ItemName) to keep equipped when automatically changing clothes. Separate multiple entries with commas. <LINE> Case-sensitive; spaces around entries are ignored. <LINE> Example: Base.Shirt_Denim, Base.Trousers_Denim <LINE> Leave empty to use only the existing exclusions. <LINE> Note: Clothing worn while bathing will still get wet, including items listed here. Wearing too many clothes will reduce bathing benefits.

UI_ModOptions_SRM_ShowCustomModsMenu_Too.en:
If enabled (default), show the Custom Mods Menu when another mod adds custom slices to the radial menu.
If disabled, the Custom Mods Menu will not be displayed.
UI_ModOptions_SRM_ShowCustomModsMenu_Too.ch:
啟用時 (預設開啟), 若其他模組在環形選單中加入自訂區塊, 便會顯示自訂模組選單.
停用時, 不會顯示自訂模組選單.
UI_ModOptions_SRM_ShowCustomModsMenu_Too.cn:
启用时 (默认开启), 如果其他模组在环形菜单中添加自定义选项, 就会显示自定义模组菜单.
关闭时, 不会显示自定义模组菜单.

UI_ModOptions_SRM_ShowSRMAfterVanilla.cn: 在原版菜单之后显示 SRM

UI_ModOptions_SRM_ShowSRMAfterVanilla_To.en:
If enabled (default), the vanilla radial menus (vehicle, animal menu) will be displayed before the Smart Radial Menu.
If disabled, SRM is displayed first before the vanilla radial menus.
UI_ModOptions_SRM_ShowSRMAfterVanilla_To.ch:
啟用時 (預設開啟), 原版環形選單 (載具、動物選單) 會顯示在智慧環形選單 (SRM) 之前.
停用時, 智慧環形選單 (SRM) 會先於原版環形選單顯示.
UI_ModOptions_SRM_ShowSRMAfterVanilla_To.cn:
启用时 (默认开启), 原版环形菜单 (载具、动物菜单) 会显示在智能环形菜单 (SRM) 之前.
关闭时, 智能环形菜单 (SRM) 会先于原版环形菜单显示.

UI_LSHS_Yoga_Max.en: A true force of nature, capable of achieving a state of tranquility that would humble most monks, your legendary physical feats would be the envy of any circus contortionist. You're at the top of every pose that's been created, even some that haven't. Congrats, Zen guru, you've earned it! <LINE>
UI_LSHS_Yoga_Max.ch: 你是真正的自然之力, 能達到讓多數僧侶自嘆不如的寧靜境界, 而你那傳奇般的體能表現, 連馬戲團的軟骨功表演者都會羨慕. 所有已被創造出來的姿勢你都已臻化境, 連還沒被創造出來的也是. 恭喜你, 禪意大師, 這是你應得的! <LINE>

UI_LSPerk_Art_1.en: The life of an artist is a noble pursuit filled with potential. Cover every wall of your home with serene landscapes and create wondrous sculptures that will make post-apocalyptic life worth living. Sure, for now, you may only possess the abilities of a (not very talented) small child, but thankfully there's almost no one left alive to judge you! <LINE>
UI_LSPerk_Art_1.ch: 藝術家的人生是充滿潛力的崇高追求. 用寧靜的風景畫鋪滿家中每一面牆, 創作出讓末日後的生活值得一過的絕妙雕塑. 當然, 現在的你大概只有 (天分還不太好的) 小孩程度, 但幸好活著的人幾乎都沒了, 沒人會批評你! <LINE>
UI_LSPerk_Art_1.cn: 艺术家的人生是充满潜力的崇高追求. 用宁静的风景画铺满家中每一面墙, 创作出让末日后的生活值得一过的绝妙雕塑. 当然, 现在的你大概只有 (天分还不太好的) 小孩水平, 但幸好活着的人几乎都没了, 没人会批评你! <LINE>

You can easily tell

槍械何時卡彈.
UI_trait_ammocountdesc.cn:
你能轻易分辨
枪械何时卡壳.

UI_trait_gunnutdesc.en:
You have a passion for guns.
You know all recipes for ammo reloading.
Reload 25%% faster military weapons (M16 and M14).
When shooting you can get cases
directly into inventory.
UI_trait_gunnutdesc.ch:
你對槍械充滿熱情.
你知道所有彈藥復裝的配方.
軍用武器 (M16 與 M14) 的裝填速度快 25%%.
射擊時彈殼會
直接進入物品欄.
UI_trait_gunnutdesc.cn:
你对枪械充满热情.
你知道所有弹药复装的配方.
军用武器 (M16 和 M14) 的装填速度快 25%%.
射击时弹壳会
直接进入物品栏.

Reload 50%% faster military weapons (M16, AK47, M14, M249, SVD, M24).

軍用武器 (M16, AK47, M14, M249, SVD, M24) 的裝填速度快 50%%.

军用武器 (M16, AK47, M14, M249, SVD, M24) 的装填速度快 50%%.
能组装军用武器.

You have the training to fire heavy firearms.
The chances of suffering laceration or fractures are reduced to 0.
when firing heavy firearms.
with strength and fitness levels equal to or greater than 5.

你受過操作重型槍械的訓練.
發生撕裂傷或骨折的機率降為 0.

力量與體格等級達到 5 或以上.

条件为以重型枪械射击时.
力量与体格等级达到 5 或以上.

UI_optionscreen_ExactMinuteClock_AlarmOn.ch: 僅鬧鐘設定圖示 (保留原版時鐘)
UI_optionscreen_ExactMinuteClock_AlarmOn.cn: 仅闹钟设置图标 (保留原版时钟)

UI_optionscreen_ExactMinuteClock_AlarmOn.en: Leaves the game's own 10-minute clock untouched and only adds the alarm-set gear icon on top of it. Turn on if you don't want the exact-minute display, just the quick alarm button.
UI_optionscreen_ExactMinuteClock_AlarmOn.ch: 不更動遊戲本身以 10 分鐘為單位的時鐘, 只在上面加上設定鬧鐘的齒輪圖示. 如果你不需要精確到分鐘的顯示, 只想要快捷鬧鐘按鈕, 請開啟此選項.
UI_optionscreen_ExactMinuteClock_AlarmOn.cn: 不改动游戏本身以 10 分钟为单位的时钟, 只在上面添加设置闹钟的齿轮图标. 如果你不需要精确到分钟的显示, 只想要快捷闹钟按钮, 请开启此选项.

UI_trait_BrittleBonesDesc.en: Your bones fracture more severely and take longer to heal (default: 2x fracture duration).
UI_trait_BrittleBonesDesc.ch: 你的骨折更嚴重, 癒合也更久 (預設: 骨折持續時間2倍).
UI_trait_BrittleBonesDesc.cn: 你的骨折更严重, 愈合也更久 (默认: 骨折持续时间2倍).

UI_trait_ColdAverseDesc.en: Cold bothers you more than most. Below the configured core body temperature threshold (default: 36.5°C), stress and discomfort increase once per minute. The colder you become, the stronger the effect.
UI_trait_ColdAverseDesc.ch: 你比多數人更怕冷. 核心體溫低於設定門檻 (預設: 36.5°C) 時, 壓力與不適每分鐘增加一次. 體溫越低, 效果越強.
UI_trait_ColdAverseDesc.cn: 你比大多数人更怕冷. 核心体温低于设定阈值 (默认: 36.5°C) 时, 压力和不适每分钟增加一次. 体温越低, 效果越强.

UI_trait_ColdLovingDesc.en: You feel at home in the cold. Below the configured core body temperature threshold (default: 36.5°C), stress and discomfort decrease once per minute. The colder you become, the stronger the effect.
UI_trait_ColdLovingDesc.ch: 你在寒冷中自在如家. 核心體溫低於設定門檻 (預設: 36.5°C) 時, 壓力與不適每分鐘減少一次. 體溫越低, 效果越強.
UI_trait_ColdLovingDesc.cn: 你在寒冷中如鱼得水. 核心体温低于设定阈值 (默认: 36.5°C) 时, 压力和不适每分钟减少一次. 体温越低, 效果越强.

UI_trait_HeatAverseDesc.en: Heat bothers you more than most. Above the configured core body temperature threshold (default: 37.5°C), stress and discomfort increase once per minute. The hotter you become, the stronger the effect.
UI_trait_HeatAverseDesc.ch: 你比多數人更怕熱. 核心體溫高於設定門檻 (預設: 37.5°C) 時, 壓力與不適每分鐘增加一次. 體溫越高, 效果越強.
UI_trait_HeatAverseDesc.cn: 你比大多数人更怕热. 核心体温高于设定阈值 (默认: 37.5°C) 时, 压力和不适每分钟增加一次. 体温越高, 效果越强.

UI_trait_HeatLovingDesc.en: You feel at home in the heat. Above the configured core body temperature threshold (default: 37.5°C), stress and discomfort decrease once per minute. The hotter you become, the stronger the effect.
UI_trait_HeatLovingDesc.ch: 你在炎熱中自在如家. 核心體溫高於設定門檻 (預設: 37.5°C) 時, 壓力與不適每分鐘減少一次. 體溫越高, 效果越強.
UI_trait_HeatLovingDesc.cn: 你在炎热中如鱼得水. 核心体温高于设定阈值 (默认: 37.5°C) 时, 压力和不适每分钟减少一次. 体温越高, 效果越强.

UI_trait_StrongBonesDesc.en: Your bones fracture less severely and heal sooner (default: 0.5x fracture duration).
UI_trait_StrongBonesDesc.ch: 你的骨折較輕, 癒合也較快 (預設: 骨折持續時間0.5倍).
UI_trait_StrongBonesDesc.cn: 你的骨折较轻, 愈合也较快 (默认: 骨折持续时间0.5倍).

UI_trait_TVJunkieDesc.en:
You need your daily television fix.
By default, receive at least four television interaction commands (Boredom/Unhappiness/etc. increase) within 24 active in-game hours to count as having watched. Once the configured online time passes without a qualifying watch, boredom and unhappiness increase every minute. Time while offline does not count.
UI_trait_TVJunkieDesc.ch:
你每天都得看電視過過癮.
預設須在24個遊戲內活躍小時內收到至少四次電視互動指令 (無聊/不快等增減) 才算有看過. 超過設定的上線時間仍未有效收看, 無聊與不快會每分鐘增加. 離線期間不列入計算.
UI_trait_TVJunkieDesc.cn:
你每天都得看电视过过瘾.
默认须在24个游戏内活跃小时内收到至少四次电视互动指令 (无聊/不开心等增减) 才算看过. 超过设定的在线时间仍未有效收看, 无聊和不开心会每分钟增加. 离线期间不计入.

UI_OC_ClearDisplayOverrides_confirm_vani.cn: 要清除所有已保存的显示分类覆盖, 并恢复原版默认值吗?

UI_OC_DisableItemPinning_tooltip.en: When enabled, the pin button is hidden and pinned items sort back into their normal place. Your pins are kept and return if you turn this back off. Takes effect immediately.
UI_OC_DisableItemPinning_tooltip.ch: 啟用後會隱藏釘選按鈕, 已釘選的物品回到原本的排序位置. 你的釘選會保留, 關閉此選項後即恢復. 立即生效.
UI_OC_DisableItemPinning_tooltip.cn: 启用后会隐藏置顶按钮, 已置顶的物品回到原本的排序位置. 你的置顶会保留, 关闭此选项后即恢复. 立即生效.

UI_OC_DisableItemRenaming_tooltip.en: When enabled, the rename button is hidden. Names you already gave items are kept. Takes effect immediately.
UI_OC_DisableItemRenaming_tooltip.ch: 啟用後會隱藏重新命名按鈕. 已替物品取的名稱會保留. 立即生效.
UI_OC_DisableItemRenaming_tooltip.cn: 启用后会隐藏重命名按钮. 已给物品取的名称会保留. 立即生效.

UI_OC_UseVanillaDefaults.en: Use vanilla display categories as defaults
UI_OC_UseVanillaDefaults.ch: 以原版顯示分類作為預設
UI_OC_UseVanillaDefaults.cn: 以原版显示分类作为默认

UI_OC_UseVanillaDefaults_tooltip.en: When enabled, items start in the display categories vanilla (and other mods' scripts) give them instead of the organizedCategories ones. Your manual overrides, renamed categories, colors and the Sort... window keep working; the custom sort order is saved separately for each mode. Takes effect from the main menu: apply it there, or return to the main menu, then load a save.
UI_OC_UseVanillaDefaults_tooltip.ch: 啟用後, 物品一開始會使用原版 (及其他模組指令碼) 指定的顯示分類, 而非 organizedCategories 的分類. 你的手動覆寫, 重新命名的分類, 顏色與「排序…」視窗照常運作; 自訂排序會依模式分別儲存. 於主選單生效: 在主選單套用, 或返回主選單後再讀取存檔.

Loading a save while away from the zone also blanks the faded values.
