UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_189_Content.en:
Here are some helpful points to communicate to potential buyers and lessees in order to achieve sales success.

MERCIA LANG 4000
Mercia Lang's elegant grand tourer is available in a variety of striking paints, all with opulent wooden interior detailing and your choice of plush cloth or genuine calf leather upholstery. The 4000 may be optioned with one of two inline six-cylinder engines, ideal for undisturbed sojourning, a powerful eight-cylinder vee-block, or an exclusive vee-twelve powerplant, unrivaled in performance both during highway passes and over-the-road racing. Either six-cylinder engine may be paired with a five-speed manual transmission, and a four-speed automatic is standard for all powertrains. Mercia Lang's 4000 is also available as a luxurious roadster, with its fully automatic hydraulic fabric convertible roof in an array of fetching colors. The 4000 was awarded second place in the 1990 Continental Car of the Year Awards.

CHEVALIER COSSETTE
The venerable Cossette has been updated just for 1993. The most pure-spirited of American performance vehicles, the Cossette remains a mainstay in our nation's enduring legacy as the maker of the world's finest cars. Offered in impressive and patriotic colors, the Cossette is a low-slung symbol of American exceptionalism, evident by sight alone. But the true might of the Cossette's all-American power is fully revealed when the driver reclines in his seat and lays his foot upon the accelerator pedal. All Cossettes come standard with a six-liter vee-eight engine producing three-hundred horsepower, mated to Chevalier's time-tested four-speed automatic transmission or a finely engineered six-speed manual sourced from partners in Germany. The Cossette is available in two exciting bodystyles, as an exotic targa coupe with easily removable roof panel and as a timeless convertible roadster with a color-coded canvas top. For those who most desire the unparalleled, however, the Cossette yet still delivers, as the record-breaking ZedX5 edition remains available for special order. Also, available for 1993 only is a 40th anniversary edition Cossette with unique ruby metallic paint.

Keeping these details in mind will prove to make the sales experience better for both you and our customers.

Guys, don't get caught up in all the fruity language if the mark's not biting. Just smile and nod and get them to an office where one of the seniors will deal with them. And for God's sake don't let randoms wander onto the lot, they're all just a waste of time. Smiles are for customers only.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_189_Content.ch:
以下是一些實用重點, 可向潛在買家與承租者說明, 以達成銷售佳績.

麥西亞·朗 4000
麥西亞·朗優雅的豪華旅行跑車提供多種亮眼的烤漆可選, 全車皆配備奢華的木質內裝飾板, 座椅可選柔軟絨布或真正的小牛皮. 4000 可選配兩款直列六缸引擎之一, 最適合不受打擾的悠閒旅程, 也可選配強勁的 V 型八缸引擎, 或專屬的 V 型十二缸動力系統, 無論是高速公路超車還是公路競速, 性能都無可匹敵. 兩款六缸引擎皆可搭配五速手排變速箱, 所有動力系統皆標配四速自排變速箱. 麥西亞·朗 4000 也提供豪華敞篷跑車版本, 配備全自動液壓布質敞篷, 有多種迷人的顏色可選. 4000 曾榮獲 1990 年歐陸年度風雲車大獎第二名.

騎士·珂賽特
歷史悠久的珂賽特專為 1993 年推出改款. 作為最純粹的美國性能車, 珂賽特始終是我國作為世界頂級汽車製造國這份恆久傳承的中流砥柱. 珂賽特提供令人印象深刻, 充滿愛國情懷的配色, 低趴的車身是美國卓越精神的象徵, 光看一眼就能感受. 但珂賽特純美式動力的真正威力, 要等駕駛往椅背一靠, 把腳踩上油門踏板時才會完全展現. 所有珂賽特皆標配輸出三百匹馬力的六公升 V 型八缸引擎, 搭配騎士久經考驗的四速自排變速箱, 或來自德國合作夥伴, 精工打造的六速手排變速箱. 珂賽特提供兩種令人興奮的車身樣式: 可輕鬆拆下車頂板的異國風 Targa 雙門跑車, 以及配有同色帆布車頂, 經典不朽的敞篷跑車. 而對於追求無可比擬之物的人, 珂賽特依然不負所望, 打破紀錄的 ZedX5 版本仍接受特別訂購. 此外, 僅限 1993 年推出的 40 週年紀念版珂賽特擁有獨特的寶石紅金屬烤漆.

牢記這些細節, 將讓您與我們的顧客都擁有更好的購車體驗.

各位, 如果肥羊不上鉤, 就別在那些花俏的說詞上糾纏. 微笑點頭, 把他們帶進辦公室, 讓資深業務去處理. 還有看在老天的份上, 別讓閒雜人等在車場裡亂晃, 他們全都是在浪費時間. 笑容只留給顧客.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_189_Content.cn:
以下是一些实用要点, 可向潜在买家与承租者说明, 以取得销售佳绩.

麦西亚·朗 4000
麦西亚·朗优雅的豪华旅行跑车提供多种亮眼的车漆可选, 全车均配备奢华的木质内饰, 座椅可选柔软绒布或真正的小牛皮. 4000 可选配两款直列六缸发动机之一, 最适合不受打扰的悠闲旅程, 也可选配强劲的 V 型八缸发动机, 或专属的 V 型十二缸动力系统, 无论是高速公路超车还是公路竞速, 性能都无可匹敌. 两款六缸发动机均可搭配五速手动变速箱, 所有动力系统均标配四速自动变速箱. 麦西亚·朗 4000 也提供豪华敞篷跑车版本, 配备全自动液压软顶敞篷, 有多种迷人的颜色可选. 4000 曾荣获 1990 年欧陆年度风云车大奖第二名.

骑士·珂赛特
历史悠久的珂赛特专为 1993 年推出改款. 作为最纯粹的美国性能车, 珂赛特始终是我国作为世界顶级汽车制造国这份恒久传承的中流砥柱. 珂赛特提供令人印象深刻, 充满爱国情怀的配色, 低矮的车身是美国卓越精神的象征, 光看一眼就能感受到. 但珂赛特纯美式动力的真正威力, 要等驾驶者往椅背一靠, 把脚踩上油门踏板时才会完全展现. 所有珂赛特均标配输出三百马力的六升 V 型八缸发动机, 搭配骑士久经考验的四速自动变速箱, 或来自德国合作伙伴, 精工打造的六速手动变速箱. 珂赛特提供两种令人兴奋的车身样式: 可轻松拆下车顶板的异域风 Targa 双门跑车, 以及配有同色帆布车顶, 经典永恒的敞篷跑车. 而对于追求无可比拟之物的人, 珂赛特依然不负所望, 打破纪录的 ZedX5 版本仍接受特别订购. 此外, 仅限 1993 年推出的 40 周年纪念版珂赛特拥有独特的宝石红金属车漆.

牢记这些细节, 将让您与我们的顾客都拥有更好的购车体验.

各位, 如果冤大头不上钩, 就别在那些花哨的说辞上纠缠. 微笑点头, 把他们带进办公室, 让资深销售去处理. 还有看在老天的份上, 别让闲杂人等在车场里乱晃, 他们全都是在浪费时间. 笑容只留给顾客.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_18_Content.en:
In the midst of this bleak and decaying world, we could all use a good laugh, even if it's at the expense of the undead. Here's a collection of zombie-themed jokes and one-liners to lighten the mood and tickle your funny bone:

1- Why don't zombies eat clowns? Because they taste funny!
2- What do you call a zombie with a great sense of humor? A comic rot!
3- Why did the zombie go to the dentist? To improve his *graveyard* smile!
4- What's a zombie's favorite exercise? The dead-lift!
5- Did you hear about the zombie marathon? People were dying to get in!
6- What's a zombie's favorite kind of music? Decomposing!
7- Why did the zombie go to the party alone? Because he had no body to go with him!

Remember, these jokes may not be as lively as they once were, but they still pack a punch. So, share them with your fellow survivors, and let laughter be the soundtrack that drowns out the moans of the undead. After all, a good sense of humor can be the best weapon in our survival arsenal.

Stay alive and keep the laughs coming!

Yours Sincerly,

Jack
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_18_Content.ch:
在這個淒涼又腐朽的世界裡, 我們都需要好好笑一笑, 就算是拿不死族開玩笑也好. 這裡收集了一些殭屍主題的笑話和俏皮話, 讓大家放鬆心情, 搔搔你的笑穴:

1- 殭屍為什麼不吃小丑? 因為味道很好笑!
2- 很有幽默感的殭屍叫什麼? 爛哏諧星!
3- 殭屍為什麼要去看牙醫? 為了改善他那口 *墳場* 笑容!
4- 殭屍最喜歡的運動是什麼? 死 (硬) 舉!
5- 你聽說殭屍馬拉松的事了嗎? 大家都拚死想參加!
6- 殭屍最喜歡哪種音樂? 腐曲 (譜曲)!
7- 殭屍為什麼一個人去派對? 因為沒有半個人陪他, 他自己也只剩半個身體!

記住, 這些笑話也許不如當年那麼「生動」了, 但威力依然不減. 所以, 跟你的倖存者同伴們分享吧, 讓笑聲成為蓋過不死族呻吟的背景音樂. 畢竟, 良好的幽默感可能是我們生存兵器庫中最好的武器.

好好活著, 繼續笑下去!

誠摯的,

傑克
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_18_Content.cn:
在这个凄凉又腐朽的世界里, 我们都需要好好笑一笑, 就算是拿亡灵开玩笑也好. 这里收集了一些僵尸主题的笑话和俏皮话, 让大家放松心情, 戳戳你的笑点:

1- 僵尸为什么不吃小丑? 因为味道很好笑!
2- 很有幽默感的僵尸叫什么? 烂梗笑星!
3- 僵尸为什么要去看牙医? 为了改善他那口 *坟场* 笑容!
4- 僵尸最喜欢的运动是什么? 死 (硬) 拉!
5- 你听说僵尸马拉松的事了吗? 大家都拼死想参加!
6- 僵尸最喜欢哪种音乐? 腐曲 (谱曲)!
7- 僵尸为什么一个人去派对? 因为没有半个人陪他, 他自己也只剩半个身体!

记住, 这些笑话也许不如当年那么“生动”了, 但威力依然不减. 所以, 跟你的幸存者同伴们分享吧, 让笑声成为盖过亡灵呻吟的背景音乐. 毕竟, 良好的幽默感可能是我们生存武器库中最好的武器.

好好活着, 继续笑下去!

诚挚的,

杰克

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_190_Content.en:
Darryl
I want you to know that I came to tell you I really like you.
I kinda think laser tag is lame but I know you and your friends have a lot of fun with it, so I decided to tag along to try to have fun with you. I'm not really having fun but I really like seeing you happy. I don't get why pretending to shoot each other is so much fun for you but I'll do it because it is. Because I really like you.
Do you want to date? We can pretend to shoot stuff together all the time.
I hope you feel the same way. I'm OK with just being friends but I had to let you know.
Trisha
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_190_Content.ch:
達瑞爾
我想讓你知道, 我來是要告訴你我真的很喜歡你.
我有點覺得雷射槍戰很遜, 但我知道你和朋友們玩得很開心, 所以我決定跟著來, 試著和你一起玩得開心. 我其實沒有玩得很開心, 但我真的很喜歡看到你開心的樣子. 我不懂假裝互相射擊為什麼對你來說那麼好玩, 但我還是會玩, 因為它就是好玩嘛. 因為我真的很喜歡你.
你想跟我交往嗎? 我們可以一直一起假裝射東西.
希望你也有同樣的感覺. 只當朋友我也可以接受, 但我一定要讓你知道.
翠夏
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_190_Content.cn:
达里尔
我想让你知道, 我来是要告诉你我真的很喜欢你.
我有点觉得激光枪战很逊, 但我知道你和朋友们玩得很开心, 所以我决定跟着来, 试着和你一起玩得开心. 我其实没有玩得很开心, 但我真的很喜欢看到你开心的样子. 我不懂假装互相射击为什么对你来说那么好玩, 但我还是会玩, 因为它就是好玩嘛. 因为我真的很喜欢你.
你想跟我交往吗? 我们可以一直一起假装射东西.
希望你也有同样的感觉. 只当朋友我也可以接受, 但我一定要让你知道.
特丽莎

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_191_Content.en:
KRIS
WE ARE NOT DOING YOUR SONG!!!
I told you on the bus when you freakin crowed the lyrics into our sorry ears. YOU JUST CHANGED THE WORDS TO A WANDERING UNDEAD TRACK! I don't know WHY you REFUSE to believe us even AFTER we all sang the ORIGINAL SONG FROM MEMORY RIGHT IN FRONT OF YOU.
Just bang the damn drums like you're suppose to and STOP BOTHERING ME ABOUT IT.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_191_Content.ch:
克里斯
我們才不會演你的歌!!!
你在巴士上扯著嗓子把歌詞吼進我們可憐的耳朵裡時, 我就跟你說過了. 你只是把「流浪不死族」的一首歌改了歌詞而已! 我們全都當著你的面憑記憶把原曲唱了一遍, 我真不懂你為什麼還是拒絕相信.
給我乖乖照規矩打你的鼓, 別再拿這件事煩我.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_191_Content.cn:
克里斯
我们才不会演你的歌!!!
你在大巴上扯着嗓子把歌词吼进我们可怜的耳朵里时, 我就跟你说过了. 你只是把“流浪亡灵”的一首歌改了歌词而已! 我们全都当着你的面凭记忆把原曲唱了一遍, 我真不懂你为什么还是拒绝相信.
给我乖乖照规矩打你的鼓, 别再拿这件事烦我.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_192_Content.en:
Howdy, cowpokes!
Y'all are invited to join in our weekly "Ghost Town Gunfight" right here in Historic Coalfield!

Experience an authentic old-fashioned western shootout! Take a side between the earnest townsfolk of Coalfield and the dastardly Powder Bandits and fight to win the west! Will you join Sheriff Sunny and Crimson Ringo as protectors of the rule of law and order, or are you keen to posse up with Powder Joe and his gangers to get your way? Grab your big iron and get ready to throw down, every Friday at high noon! Yeehaw!

Registration for participation in Historic Coalfield's "Ghost Town Gunfight" reenactment is $500. In-person only. First come, first serve. Registration ends one week prior to the event. No firearms are allowed at any time on Historic Coalfield property. Weather permitting. No refunds.
Contact Josh Avellone at the main office for information.
Copyright 1993 Historic Coalfield.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_192_Content.ch:
各位牛仔, 你們好!
誠摯邀請大家參加我們每週舉辦的「鬼鎮槍戰」, 就在煤田鎮歷史園區!

體驗道地的老式西部槍戰! 選邊站吧, 加入煤田鎮正直的鎮民, 或是卑劣的火藥強盜團, 為贏得西部而戰! 你會加入桑尼警長與緋紅林哥, 成為法律與秩序的守護者, 還是想跟火藥喬和他的幫派搭夥, 為所欲為? 拿起你的大傢伙, 準備開打, 每週五正午準時開戰! 呀呼!

報名參加煤田鎮歷史園區「鬼鎮槍戰」重演活動的費用為 $500. 僅限現場報名. 先到先得. 報名於活動前一週截止. 煤田鎮歷史園區範圍內任何時間皆禁止攜帶槍械. 視天氣狀況舉行. 恕不退費.

KT is dedicated to reliable communications for all customers and we assure you that we are investigating the cause and source of the current outage around the clock. KT Department of Public Outreach

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_195_Content.en:
A friendly reminder from your emergency department:

The Old Distillery north of town is off-limits!
We all are familiar with the Old Distillery. It was the pride of Ekron back in the day. But as interesting as it is, there's a reason for the no trespassing signs and big barbwire fences. The structures are unsafe and there's likely oil and gas still in the groundwater on the property. We have also had reports of transients camping there. And the railbed remains property of the railroad company. Plus, rumor holds that the main hall is haunted by a worker shot there a hundred years ago, so it's best to steer clear!

Thanks for your understanding.
Ekron Emergency Services
"Committed to preserving our historic town's safety."

感謝您的理解.

「致力維護我們這座歷史小鎮的安全.」

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_19_Content.en:
Hey there!

So, I find myself in a bathroom during the zombie apocalypse. It's quite a sight, let me tell you. I never thought I'd be writing a letter while sitting on a toilet seat, but desperate times call for desperate measures, right?

First things first, let me assure you that this bathroom is fully stocked with toilet paper. Yes, you heard that right! I hit the jackpot in the midst of chaos. It's like winning the lottery, except the prize is soft and absorbent.

Now, don't get me wrong, surviving the zombie apocalypse is no joke. But there's something oddly hilarious about trying to take care of business while the world is falling apart outside. You know, finding humor in the absurdity of it all.

I've had to come up with creative strategies to distract myself from the moans and groans of the undead roaming around. Counting tiles on the wall, playing toilet paper basketball, or even having conversations with myself to maintain some form of sanity. It's a one-person sitcom in here!

I must say, though, the bathroom has become my sanctuary. It's the one place where I can escape the chaos, even if only for a few minutes. The porcelain throne has become my throne of solitude and contemplation. Who knew the bathroom would become my fortress of calm in a world gone mad?

As I sit here, contemplating the meaning of life and the importance of clean underwear, I can't help but wonder if future civilizations will dig up these bathrooms and ponder over the artifacts they find. Perhaps they'll think that this was some kind of secret communication chamber.

Anyway, I hope this note brings a smile to your face. Remember, even in the most dire situations, it's important to find laughter. Life may be messy right now, but at least I have a toilet seat to keep me company.

Stay safe out there, and may your toilet always be stocked with the finest of paper.

Flushingly yours,

Kyle
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_19_Content.ch:
嗨!

所以呢, 我在殭屍末日中困在一間廁所裡. 跟你說, 這景象可真壯觀. 我從沒想過自己會坐在馬桶上寫信, 但非常時期就得用非常手段, 對吧?

首先, 讓我向你保證, 這間廁所的衛生紙存量充足. 沒錯, 你沒聽錯! 我在一片混亂中中了頭獎. 就像中樂透一樣, 只不過獎品又軟又吸水.

好啦, 別誤會, 在殭屍末日中求生可不是開玩笑的. 但在外面世界分崩離析的時候, 還努力在這裡解決生理需求, 這事就是有種莫名的滑稽. 你懂的, 在這一切荒謬之中找點樂子.

為了讓自己不去聽外頭遊蕩的活死人的呻吟與哀號, 我得想些有創意的辦法分散注意力. 數牆上的磁磚, 玩衛生紙投籃, 甚至自言自語, 好維持一點理智. 這裡簡直是一人情境喜劇!

不過我得說, 這間廁所已經成了我的避難所. 這是唯一能讓我逃離混亂的地方, 哪怕只有幾分鐘. 這座陶瓷寶座成了我獨處與沉思的王座. 誰想得到在這個瘋狂的世界裡, 廁所會成為我的寧靜堡壘?

坐在這裡思考人生的意義和乾淨內褲的重要性時, 我忍不住想, 未來的文明會不會挖出這些廁所, 對他們找到的文物苦思冥想. 也許他們會以為這裡是某種秘密通訊室.

總之, 希望這張紙條能讓你露出微笑. 記住, 即使在最糟糕的處境中, 找到歡笑也很重要. 現在的生活或許一團亂, 但至少我還有馬桶座陪著我.

在外面要注意安全, 願你的馬桶永遠備有最上等的衛生紙.

沖水般地敬上,

凱爾

所以呢, 我在僵尸末日中困在一间厕所里. 跟你说, 这景象可真壮观. 我从没想过自己会坐在马桶上写信, 但非常时期就得用非常手段, 对吧?

首先, 让我向你保证, 这间厕所的卫生纸存量充足. 没错, 你没听错! 我在一片混乱中中了头奖. 就像中彩票一样, 只不过奖品又软又吸水.

好啦, 别误会, 在僵尸末日中求生可不是开玩笑的. 但在外面世界分崩离析的时候, 还在这里努力解决生理需求, 这事就是有种莫名的滑稽. 你懂的, 在这一切荒谬之中找点乐子.

为了不去听外面游荡的活死人的呻吟和哀嚎, 我得想些有创意的办法分散注意力. 数墙上的瓷砖, 玩卫生纸投篮, 甚至自言自语, 好保持一点理智. 这里简直是一人情景喜剧!

不过我得说, 这间厕所已经成了我的避难所. 这是唯一能让我逃离混乱的地方, 哪怕只有几分钟. 这座陶瓷宝座成了我独处与沉思的王座. 谁能想到在这个疯狂的世界里, 厕所会成为我的宁静堡垒?

坐在这里思考人生的意义和干净内裤的重要性时, 我忍不住想, 未来的文明会不会挖出这些厕所, 对他们找到的文物苦思冥想. 也许他们会以为这里是某种秘密通讯室.

总之, 希望这张纸条能让你露出微笑. 记住, 即使在最糟糕的处境中, 找到欢笑也很重要. 现在的生活或许一团糟, 但至少我还有马桶座陪着我.

在外面要注意安全, 愿你的马桶永远备有最上等的卫生纸.

冲水般地敬上,

凯尔

My dearest Ava,

I am writing this letter to you with a heavy heart, knowing that it may never reach you. I was bit, and I am not sure how much time I have left. All I can do now is express my deepest regrets and apologies for the way things ended between us.

I can't help but think about all the times I let my work consume me, and how I let it get in the way of our relationship. I should have made more time for you and our family. I should have fought for us, instead of running away from our problems. I know that my actions have hurt you deeply, and for that, I am truly sorry.

As I sit here, alone and afraid, I can't help but think about all the moments we shared together. The way your laugh lit up my world, the way your touch made my heart race. I regret not cherishing those moments more, and not being the husband and father that you deserved.

But most of all, I regret leaving you when you needed me the most. I should have been there to hold you, to protect you, and to keep you safe. Instead, I left you to face this horror alone. And for that, I am truly sorry.

I wish I could turn back time, to fix things between us, but unfortunately, it's too late. All I can do now is pray that you are safe. Please know that I love you, and I will love you until my dying breath. I hope that one day you can forgive me, and th--

*The writing becomes increasingly faint and difficult to read as the letter comes to an end, the words barely legible. The letter ends abruptly*

我忍不住想起那些我讓工作吞噬自己的時光, 想起我如何讓它妨礙了我們的感情. 我早該多花點時間陪妳和我們的家人. 我早該為我們奮鬥, 而不是逃避我們的問題. 我知道我的所作所為深深傷害了妳, 對此, 我真的很抱歉.

當我獨自一人, 心懷恐懼地坐在這裡, 我忍不住想起我們共度的所有時光. 妳的笑聲點亮我的世界, 妳的撫觸讓我心跳加速. 我後悔沒有更加珍惜那些時刻, 後悔沒能成為妳應得的丈夫與父親.

但我最後悔的, 是在妳最需要我的時候離開了妳. 我早該在妳身邊擁抱妳, 保護妳, 守護妳的安全. 我卻丟下妳獨自面對這場恐怖. 對此, 我真的很抱歉.

我希望能讓時光倒流, 修補我們之間的關係, 但很遺憾, 已經太遲了. 現在我唯一能做的, 就是祈禱妳平安無事. 請妳知道我愛妳, 我會愛妳直到嚥下最後一口氣. 我希望有一天妳能原諒我, 並且--

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_200_Content.en:
What else do you do when you're stuck in a spot but write? Masturbate, I guess, but that's not really my thing. Especially with slobbering idiots wandering around everywhere I look.

Jay and Lonnie invited me up here after the army pulled out. They held out in their apartment. Paid off to be a couple of paranoid dudes with a bunch of knives and guns. Kinda just luck that I survived, I guess. Just kept my head down. Met them at their "base," like they're PMC grunts or something, and we made a plan to loot this place. Figured many hands make light work and I know how to use a gun. Plus I had a working car that didn't have its exhaust sawn off like Lonnie's truck. So we got over here and I took up watch while the guys started looking for whatever could fit in the "armory" back at "base." Everything was pretty quiet until something set off an alarm down the block. Sickos started stumbling out of all the apartment blocks up the street, going right on past us, so no big deal. Then I heard my car start and the engine gun and that was it. They took off out the back exit, drove right through the conga line in the street, and here I am still. Alone and surrounded.

I've just been sitting back here eating chips and jerky. I'm not angry. Just kinda bummed. Didn't really want to live with a couple of dudes like that long-term anyway, but I think I wanted to, y'know, live. The sickos get really dangerous in crowds and it's like an all-you-can-eat barbecue out there. Some are smushing up against the windows. So I guess this is it. Either going to learn what it's like to be pulled pork or get sick and join the party. I'd blow my brains out if I wasn't sure I'd screw it up and still be half-alive while they eat me. Ugh.

I'm going to try for the river, I guess. Slip out the back and hope I'm still lucky enough to make it to the water. Sink or swim then. Probably still wind up on the menu, stinking like river water. Like a crawdad or mudpuppy or something. If one of you guys comes back and finds this, atleast take care of my car. It sure saved your asses.

Lexa
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_200_Content.ch:
被困在一個地方的時候, 除了寫東西還能幹嘛? 我猜還能自慰, 但那不太是我的菜. 尤其是放眼望去到處都有流著口水的白痴在晃.

軍隊撤走之後, 傑伊和朗尼邀我來這裡. 他們一直守在自己的公寓裡. 當一對帶著一堆刀槍, 疑神疑鬼的傢伙, 結果還真值得. 我能活下來大概只是運氣好吧. 就是一直保持低調. 我在他們的「基地」跟他們碰頭, 說得好像他們是私人軍事公司的大頭兵一樣, 然後我們計畫來洗劫這個地方. 想說人多好辦事, 而且我會用槍. 再加上我有一輛還能開的車, 排氣管沒像朗尼那輛卡車一樣被鋸掉. 所以我們就過來了, 我負責把風, 他們兩個開始找任何能塞進「基地」那間「軍械庫」的東西. 一切都很安靜, 直到街區那頭有什麼東西觸發了警報. 病鬼們開始從街上所有的公寓大樓裡踉蹌走出來, 直接從我們旁邊經過, 所以也沒什麼大不了. 接著我聽到我的車發動, 引擎轟的一聲, 就這樣了. 他們從後門開溜, 直接開車衝過街上排成長龍的屍群, 而我還在這裡. 孤身一人, 四面受困.

我就一直坐在後面吃洋芋片和肉乾. 我不生氣. 只是有點沮喪. 本來也不太想跟那種傢伙長期住在一起, 但我想我還是想, 你知道的, 活下去. 病鬼成群的時候真的很危險, 外面簡直像吃到飽烤肉大會. 有些已經擠在窗戶上了. 所以我猜就這樣了. 要嘛體會一下變成手撕豬肉的滋味, 要嘛染病加入派對. 要不是我確定自己會搞砸, 被牠們吃的時候還半死不活, 我早就一槍轟掉自己的腦袋了. 唉.

我大概會試著往河邊去吧. 從後面溜出去, 希望自己的運氣還夠好, 能跑到水邊. 到時候就看是沉是浮了. 搞不好最後還是會變成別人的盤中餐, 渾身河水的臭味. 就像小龍蝦或泥螈之類的. 如果你們其中一個回來發現這張紙條, 至少照顧好我的車. 它可是救了你們的狗命.

萊克莎

我連試都沒試. 你沒能及時趕到, 我的身體不肯讓我丟下你繼續走.

我想相信你做到了. 但你本該就在這裡, 像以前每次遇到壞事時那樣緊握著我的手. 天啊, 真希望你在這裡. 我們最後那個吻還不夠.

告訴我, 我沒有連你也失去, 告訴我你還在我身邊, 親吻我的手, 撫摸我的頭髮, 直到我睡著. 就像我們剛有康妮的那時候一樣.

你總是這樣做, 但那一刻有些不同. 就好像你同時在對我們兩個這麼做, 你對我們倆的愛直直穿透了我. 也許有點自私, 但我現在需要那份愛.

艾迪, 噢艾迪… 求你告訴我, 我沒有連你也失去
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_206_Content.cn:
艾迪, 我们本来说好要一起走的.

你说你会在第二码头跟我们会合. 我们等了. 我们一直在等.

船开走了. 现在我盯着河面, 不知道你到底有没有逃出来. 河里到处是尸体, 都是走投无路想游到对岸的人.

我连试都没试. 你没能及时赶到, 我的身体不肯让我丢下你继续走.

我想相信你做到了. 但你本该就在这里, 像以前每次遇到坏事时那样紧握着我的手. 天啊, 真希望你在这里. 我们最后那个吻还不够.

告诉我, 我没有连你也失去, 告诉我你还在我身边, 亲吻我的手, 抚摸我的头发, 直到我睡着. 就像我们刚有康妮的那时候一样.

你总是这样做, 但那一刻有些不同. 就好像你同时在对我们两个这么做, 你对我们俩的爱直直穿透了我. 也许有点自私, 但我现在需要那份爱.

艾迪, 噢艾迪… 求你告诉我, 我没有连你也失去

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_207_Content.en:
Anna, don't stop for anyone.

Forget the checkpoints--they're wrecked. Take the back streets, cut through the scrapyard. If you see the church on Fifth, you're close.

We'll be waiting. But not forever.

God knows I'd love to hug you once more. R =)
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_207_Content.ch:
安娜, 別為任何人停下來.

別管檢查站了--它們都毀了. 走後街, 穿過廢料場. 如果看到第五街的教堂, 就快到了.

我們會等妳. 但不會永遠等下去.

天知道我多想再抱妳一次. R =)
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_207_Content.cn:
安娜, 别为任何人停下来.

别管检查站了--它们都毁了. 走后街, 穿过废料场. 如果看到第五街的教堂, 就快到了.

我们会等你. 但不会一直等下去.

天知道我多想再抱你一次. R =)

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_208_Content.en:
The boats were full before we even got close. Shouting, shoving--people grabbed onto the rails like it'd keep them safe. Then someone fired a shot, and everything went to hell.

We ran. No choice. But now we're stuck on the wrong side of the river. And you're still out there.

If you do find this, look up. My lights will guide you home (yeah, those you always hated, but guess what: theyre useful now LOL).
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_208_Content.ch:
我們還沒靠近, 船就已經滿了. 大家叫喊, 推擠--人們抓著欄杆, 好像這樣就能保命. 接著有人開了一槍, 一切都亂成一團.

我們逃了. 別無選擇. 但現在我們困在河不對的那一岸. 而你還在外面.

如果你真的找到這個, 抬頭看. 我的燈會指引你回家 (對, 就是你一直很討厭的那些燈, 但你猜怎樣: 它們現在派上用場了 LOL).
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_208_Content.cn:
我们还没靠近, 船就已经满了. 大家叫喊, 推搡--人们抓着栏杆, 好像这样就能保命. 接着有人开了一枪, 一切都乱成了一锅粥.

我们跑了. 别无选择. 但现在我们被困在河不对的那一岸. 而你还在外面.

如果你真找到了这个, 抬头看. 我的灯会指引你回家 (对, 就是你一直很讨厌的那些灯, 但你猜怎么着: 它们现在派上用场了 LOL).

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_209_Content.en:
Mia, I still wear your jacket.

The sleeves are too long, the zipper's busted, but it smells like you, and I refuse to take it off.

If you're still reading these, just know: When quarantine's up, i'm taking you to Ushuaia. No more excuses from me, promise.

-- Karen <3 <3
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_209_Content.ch:
米亞, 我還穿著妳的夾克.

袖子太長, 拉鍊也壞了, 但上面有妳的味道, 我說什麼都不肯脫下來.

如果妳還在讀這些, 只要知道: 隔離一結束, 我就帶妳去烏斯懷亞. 我不會再找藉口了, 我保證.

-- 凱倫 <3 <3
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_209_Content.cn:
米娅, 我还穿着你的夹克.

袖子太长, 拉链也坏了, 但上面有你的味道, 我说什么都不肯脱下来.

如果你还在读这些, 只要知道: 隔离一结束, 我就带你去乌斯怀亚. 我不会再找借口了, 我保证.

-- 凯伦 <3 <3

Not much left for gifts, but I found a candy bar in the supply stash and figured that was good enough. The candles? Yeah, I had to improvise... don't laugh.

You're still here. You're still breathing. That's worth celebrating.

你還在. 你還在呼吸. 這就值得慶祝.

爸爸
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_211_Content.cn:

你还在. 你还在呼吸. 这就值得庆祝.

爸爸

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_212_Content.en:
Mom, I'm still looking for you.

I know the safe zone fell, but I refuse to believe that means you're gone. I'll check every shelter, every outpost, every mile of road until I find your stubborn, beautiful face.

Stay put. I'll find you.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_212_Content.ch:
媽, 我還在找妳.

我知道安全區已經淪陷了, 但我拒絕相信那代表妳已經不在了. 我會找遍每個避難所, 每個前哨站, 每一哩路, 直到找到妳那張固執又美麗的臉.

待在原地別動. 我會找到妳的.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_212_Content.cn:
妈, 我还在找你.

我知道安全区已经沦陷了, 但我拒绝相信那意味着你已经不在了. 我会找遍每个避难所, 每个前哨站, 每一英里的路, 直到找到你那张倔强又美丽的脸.

待在原地别动. 我会找到你的.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_218_Content.en:
I was watching the TV, and the shows just randomly started playing old episodes on all the channels. So I was watching Life and Living, and at the end, when it was midnight, through the static of the TV I heard strange and sorrowful voices, talking about some person named Harry. They were saying that if they hear this, to leave Louisville ASAP. I don't know why but then I heard someone playing the piano, and I then saw my window was open, the static was worse, I went to the living room, and a plushy was playing it...

I buried the piano since it's probably haunted, And I got shot in the leg from some stranger. If you find the living room covered in blood it's fine, I'm gonna steal cleaning supplies.

P.S: I hope you get back from raiding the mall, and if you found any food, we're gonna need it!
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_218_Content.ch:
我在看電視, 結果所有頻道突然莫名其妙開始播舊節目. 我就看著「生存大挑戰」, 到最後半夜時, 我從電視雜訊中聽到奇怪又哀傷的聲音, 在講一個叫哈利的人. 他們說如果聽到這段話, 就盡快離開路易斯維爾. 我不知道為什麼, 但接著我聽到有人在彈鋼琴, 然後我發現我的窗戶開著, 雜訊變得更嚴重, 我走到客廳, 結果是一隻絨毛玩偶在彈琴…

我把鋼琴埋了, 因為它大概鬧鬼, 然後我被一個陌生人射中了腿. 如果你發現客廳滿是血, 沒事的, 我會去偷些清潔用品.

P.S: 希望你搜刮完購物中心能平安回來, 如果你找到任何食物, 我們會需要的!
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_218_Content.cn:
我在看电视, 结果所有频道突然莫名其妙开始播旧节目. 于是我看着“生存大挑战”, 到最后半夜的时候, 我从电视的雪花噪声里听到奇怪又悲伤的声音, 在说一个叫哈利的人. 他们说如果听到这段话, 就尽快离开路易斯维尔. 我不知道为什么, 但接着我听到有人在弹钢琴, 然后我发现我的窗户开着, 噪声变得更严重, 我走到客厅, 结果是一个毛绒玩偶在弹琴…

我把钢琴埋了, 因为它可能闹鬼, 然后我被一个陌生人打中了腿. 如果你发现客厅满是血, 没事的, 我会去偷些清洁用品.

P.S: 希望你搜刮完商场能平安回来, 如果你找到任何食物, 我们会用得上的!

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_22_Content.en: Hey Bob - I'm sorry, but your dog wouldn't shut up no matter what we did. We decided to let him loose in the woods. The noise made it too late to save the house so we packed up and moved to the other side of town. We're okay though. Use your walkie-talkie to find us and be careful.\nAgain, I'm so sorry it had to be like this. Please don't look for him, you'll only get yourself killed.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_22_Content.ch: 嘿, 鮑伯 - 很抱歉, 但不管我們怎麼做, 你的狗就是不肯安靜. 我們決定把牠放到樹林裡. 那些吵鬧聲讓房子已經保不住了, 所以我們收拾東西搬到鎮的另一頭. 不過我們都沒事. 用你的對講機找我們, 小心點.\n再說一次, 我真的很抱歉事情變成這樣. 請不要去找牠, 你只會害自己送命.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_22_Content.cn: 嘿, 鲍勃 - 很抱歉, 但不管我们怎么做, 你的狗就是不肯安静. 我们决定把它放进树林里. 那些噪音让房子已经守不住了, 所以我们收拾东西搬到了镇子另一头. 不过我们都没事. 用你的对讲机找我们, 小心点.\n再说一次, 真的很抱歉事情只能这样. 请别去找它, 你只会把自己害死.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_24_Content.en:
There it is again. That uneasy feeling of dread is washing over this house. Windows are all covered and boarded, and what little light can crack through the boards? It lights up a mirror; my face is on there. Why am I so pale?

The neighbors-oh, I hear them alright-are scrambling about like cockroaches, stocking up their vehicles with whatever they can carry. Why do they try? Don't they see that there is no hope?

It doesn't matter; I must take care of my sister. She is always hungry, always biting at the air. Our poor housecat became her dinner last night. Most would think me insane, but she is my sister. She is sick; it will pass.

I managed to snatch our neighbors dog before they left in a hurry. They did not even bother looking for their pet; they were too afraid of inevitability, I suppose, and had no time to find a mere mutt.

Has it been a week or two? I don't remember. Oh, and she still screams. Again. Wanting... more. There is nothing left to give her. Wait, Is that a dead child on the porch?

It's been a month now. I'm hungry and thirsty. She has been quiet for some time in her bedroom.

Perhaps I should check on her...
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_24_Content.ch:
又來了. 那股令人不安的恐懼感又籠罩了這棟房子. 窗戶全都遮起來釘上木板了, 而從木板縫透進來的那一點點光呢? 它照亮了一面鏡子; 我的臉就在上面. 我為什麼這麼蒼白?

鄰居們--喔, 我聽得一清二楚--像蟑螂一樣慌亂地四處亂竄, 把能帶的東西全塞進車裡. 他們何必掙扎? 難道他們看不出來已經沒有希望了嗎?

無所謂; 我得照顧我妹妹. 她總是很餓, 總是對著空氣咬. 我們可憐的家貓昨晚成了她的晚餐. 大多數人會覺得我瘋了, 但她是我妹妹. 她生病了; 會好起來的.

鄰居匆忙離開前, 我設法抓到了他們的狗. 他們甚至懶得去找自己的寵物; 我想他們太害怕那不可避免的結局, 也沒時間找一隻區區雜種狗.

已經過了一週還是兩週? 我不記得了. 喔, 她還在尖叫. 又來了. 想要… 更多. 已經沒有東西能給她了. 等等, 門廊上那是個死掉的小孩嗎?

已經一個月了. 我又餓又渴. 她在臥室裡已經安靜好一陣子了.

也許我該去看看她…
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_24_Content.cn:
又来了. 那股令人不安的恐惧感又笼罩了这栋房子. 窗户全都遮住并钉上了木板, 而从木板缝里透进来的那一点点光呢? 它照亮了一面镜子; 我的脸就映在上面. 我为什么这么苍白?

邻居们--哦, 我听得一清二楚--像蟑螂一样慌乱地四处乱窜, 把能带的东西全塞进车里. 他们何必挣扎? 难道他们看不出来已经没有希望了吗?

无所谓; 我得照顾我妹妹. 她总是很饿, 总是对着空气咬. 我们可怜的家猫昨晚成了她的晚餐. 大多数人会觉得我疯了, 但她是我妹妹. 她生病了; 会好起来的.

邻居匆忙离开前, 我设法抓到了他们的狗. 他们甚至懒得去找自己的宠物; 我想他们太害怕那无法避免的结局, 也没时间去找一条区区的杂种狗.

已经过了一周还是两周? 我不记得了. 哦, 她还在尖叫. 又来了. 想要… 更多. 已经没有东西能给她了. 等等, 门廊上那是个死掉的小孩吗?

已经一个月了. 我又饿又渴. 她在卧室里已经安静好一阵子了.

也许我该去看看她…

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_25_Content.en: I believe it was a week before the evacuation order was issued for Knox County. The surrounding air was awful to the nose, as if a field of cows had died and rotted away somewhere in this god-forsaken land. My wife, Hannah, wanted to stay here in our new home in Rosewood, despite the smell. I prepare my morning routine of waking up the kids for school and showering for work as if it were any other day. Though, at the time, we did not know any better.\n\nThree days later, our neighbors can be seen packing in a hurry, as if we were at war. Well, the man in that house is a military man; surely he must know something. As I approached him and asked, he only replied with a chilling word and a stern look,
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_25_Content.ch: 我記得那是諾克斯縣發布撤離令前一週左右. 周遭的空氣臭得要命, 好像在這片被神遺棄的土地上某處, 有一整片田的牛死掉爛光了. 我太太漢娜儘管聞到那股味道, 還是想留在我們位於羅斯伍德的新家. 我照常進行早晨的例行公事, 叫孩子們起床上學, 洗澡準備上班, 就像平常任何一天. 不過, 當時我們確實什麼都不知道.\n\n三天後, 可以看到鄰居們匆匆忙忙地收拾行李, 彷彿我們正處於戰爭之中. 嗯, 那棟房子的男主人是個軍人; 他一定知道些什麼. 當我走過去問他時, 他只用一個令人發寒的字眼和嚴厲的眼神回答,
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_25_Content.cn: 我记得那是诺克斯县发布撤离令前一周左右. 周围的空气臭得要命, 好像在这片被上帝遗弃的土地上某处, 有一整片田的牛死掉烂光了. 我妻子汉娜尽管闻到那股味道, 还是想留在我们位于罗斯伍德的新家. 我照常进行早晨的例行公事, 叫孩子们起床上学, 洗澡准备上班, 就像平常任何一天. 不过, 当时我们确实什么都不知道.\n\n三天后, 可以看到邻居们匆匆忙忙地收拾行李, 仿佛我们正处于战争之中. 嗯, 那栋房子的男主人是个军人; 他一定知道些什么. 当我走过去问他时, 他只用一个令人发寒的字眼和严厉的眼神回答,

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_26_Content.en:
James, im sorry to tell you this but your dog Maxie passed away.

I dont know what happened to him, but last week he just randomly got ill. He didnt move around much and i swear he was drooling when he sees my neighbour. Yesterday, i took him to the vet, but he died on the way there man. I know how much he meant to you, hes been with you ever since we met back in Bolton.

If you want to keep your mind off of him, i can drive you to the burger joint in Riverside. I will be buying.

Take care mate.
-Michal
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_26_Content.ch:
詹姆斯, 很抱歉要告訴你這個, 但你的狗麥西過世了.

我不知道牠怎麼了, 但上週牠突然就病了. 牠幾乎不太動, 而且我發誓牠看到我鄰居時還在流口水. 昨天我帶牠去看獸醫, 但牠在路上就死了, 老兄. 我知道牠對你有多重要, 自從我們當年在博爾頓認識以來, 牠就一直陪著你.

如果你想轉移注意力, 我可以載你去河畔鎮的漢堡店. 我請客.

保重, 兄弟.
-米哈爾
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_26_Content.cn:
詹姆斯, 很抱歉要告诉你这个, 但你的狗麦西去世了.

保重, 兄弟.
-米哈尔

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_2_Content.en:
The world as I knew it has ended. I never thought the virus that had been making headlines for weeks would reach me, not here, not now. But it did, and it brought with it an unimaginable horror.

I remember sitting in my hotel room, flipping through channels, trying to distract myself from the unease that had been building inside me for days. And then I heard it, the screams. At first, I thought it was just some kind of accident, but as the noise grew louder and more frantic, I knew something was very, very wrong. I peered out the window and what I saw will haunt me forever.

People, my neighbors, running, panicked, and behind them, the dead, risen, hunting. My heart raced as I slammed the window shut and locked it tight. I knew then that this was the end of the world. And I was trapped in a hotel room with only a few supplies, and no idea of what to do next.

I'm writing this now, with shaking hands, tears streaming down my face, knowing that I might not make it out of this alive. But I have to try. I have to fight.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_2_Content.ch:
我所熟悉的世界已經結束了. 我從沒想過那個連續好幾週登上頭條的病毒會找上我, 不是在這裡, 不是現在. 但它來了, 還帶來了難以想像的恐怖.

我記得我坐在飯店房間裡, 不停轉台, 想讓自己從這幾天一直累積的不安中分心. 然後我聽到了, 尖叫聲. 起初我以為只是什麼意外, 但隨著聲音越來越大, 越來越慌亂, 我知道事情非常, 非常不對勁. 我往窗外看, 看到的景象將永遠糾纏著我.

人們, 我的鄰居們, 奔跑著, 驚慌失措, 而在他們身後, 是死而復生的屍體, 正在獵捕他們. 我心跳加速, 用力關上窗戶並牢牢鎖上. 那時我就知道這是世界末日. 而我被困在飯店房間裡, 只有少量物資, 也不知道接下來該怎麼辦.

我現在正寫下這些, 雙手顫抖, 淚流滿面, 知道自己可能無法活著離開. 但我必須試試. 我必須奮戰.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_2_Content.cn:
我所熟悉的世界已经终结了. 我从没想过那个连续好几周登上头条的病毒会找上我, 不是在这里, 不是现在. 但它来了, 还带来了难以想象的恐怖.

我记得我坐在酒店房间里, 不停换台, 想让自己从这几天一直积累的不安中分心. 然后我听到了, 尖叫声. 起初我以为只是什么意外, 但随着声音越来越大, 越来越慌乱, 我知道事情非常, 非常不对劲. 我往窗外看, 看到的景象将永远纠缠着我.

人们, 我的邻居们, 奔跑着, 惊慌失措, 而在他们身后, 是死而复生的尸体, 正在猎杀他们. 我心跳加速, 用力关上窗户并牢牢锁上. 那时我就知道这是世界末日. 而我被困在酒店房间里, 只有少量物资, 也不知道接下来该怎么办.

我现在正写下这些, 双手颤抖, 泪流满面, 知道自己可能无法活着离开. 但我必须试试. 我必须奋战.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_30_Content.en: In the morning, I sat with him and watched the dawn. The smell had cleared, the sun shone on emerald grass. My husband will never share another sunrise with me, at least not until we meet on the opposite shore. I understand that it would be a sin to simply end it now, the easy way. There is still time I have to spend on this earth, I just wish I could understand why. I've prayed on it every night, prayed every morning. Waited. There was no rescue, there was no deliverance. He's buried somewhere nice, and though I know I should be at peace it still hurts so bad. Don't know if I'm being tested. It feels like I've been abandoned by the world itself. -Sophie
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_30_Content.ch: 早上, 我陪他坐著看日出. 那股氣味已經散去, 陽光灑在翠綠的草地上. 我的丈夫再也不能和我一起迎接日出了, 至少在我們於彼岸重逢之前都不行. 我明白就這樣用輕鬆的方式了結一切是一種罪. 我在這世上還有該度過的時日, 只希望我能明白為什麼. 我每晚都為此祈禱, 每個早晨也祈禱. 等待著. 沒有救援, 也沒有救贖. 他葬在一個美好的地方, 雖然我知道我應該釋懷, 但還是好痛好痛. 不知道這是不是一場考驗. 感覺就像被整個世界拋棄了. -蘇菲
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_30_Content.cn: 早上, 我陪他坐着看日出. 那股气味已经散去, 阳光洒在翠绿的草地上. 我的丈夫再也不能和我一起迎接日出了, 至少在我们于彼岸重逢之前都不行. 我明白就这样用轻松的方式了结一切是一种罪. 我在这世上还有该度过的时日, 只希望我能明白为什么. 我每晚都为此祈祷, 每个早晨也祈祷. 等待着. 没有救援, 也没有救赎. 他葬在一个美好的地方, 虽然我知道我应该释怀, 但还是好痛好痛. 不知道这是不是一场考验. 感觉就像被整个世界抛弃了. -苏菲

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_32_Content.en: Keith, the Military lifted the roadblocks. They are apparently pulling back to form another quarantine line. Hopefully I can get me and Jason across before they lock down the border again and get him to a Hospital. If I don't come back we either got through or they caught us. I'm sorry but I couldn't wait for you. Jason is getting worse and worse and he needs professional help; the Antibiotics weren't helping. Use whatever you were able to scrounge up while you were gone and stay safe. Remember to keep the windows and doors covered; also be sure to lock them. Try to conserve the food left in the house. The MOST important thing though is to avoid the sick; don't make noise or draw their attention. I'll try to find a way to get in contact with you to let you know we made it and plan on getting you out too.\n-Lilith
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_32_Content.ch: 基斯, 軍方撤除了路障. 他們顯然正在後撤, 要建立另一道隔離線. 希望我能在他們再次封鎖邊界前帶著傑森過去, 送他去醫院. 如果我沒回來, 那我們不是成功過去了, 就是被他們抓住了. 對不起, 但我等不了你了. 傑森的情況越來越糟, 他需要專業的治療; 抗生素沒有效果. 用你出門時搜刮到的東西, 保護好自己. 記得把門窗遮好; 也一定要鎖上. 盡量省著吃屋裡剩下的食物. 不過最重要的是避開那些病人; 不要發出聲音或引起他們注意. 我會想辦法聯絡你, 讓你知道我們成功了, 也會計劃把你接出去. \n-莉莉絲
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_32_Content.cn: 基斯, 军方撤除了路障. 他们显然正在后撤, 要建立另一道隔离线. 希望我能在他们再次封锁边界前带着杰森过去, 送他去医院. 如果我没回来, 那我们不是成功过去了, 就是被他们抓住了. 对不起, 但我等不了你了. 杰森的情况越来越糟, 他需要专业的治疗; 抗生素没有效果. 用你出门时搜刮到的东西, 保护好自己. 记得把门窗遮好; 也一定要锁上. 尽量省着吃屋里剩下的食物. 不过最重要的是避开那些病人; 不要发出声音或引起他们注意. 我会想办法联系你, 让你知道我们成功了, 也会计划把你接出去. \n-莉莉丝

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_33_Content.en:
To whoever finds this I worked Logistics for the Military Force trying to contain the infection ravaging Knox Country. We are currently pulling out of this Sector, however we are leaving a good bit of gear behind. If you are here that means you are looking for items to help in your survival in our absence. In our failure here is my gift to you:

This legal document authorizes the civilian in its possession the authorization to acquire and make use of any and all gear abandoned at this Military Facility to aid in their survival. If we are able to retake the Sector and re-establish control make sure to hand them this document to show you are not a looter and have been approved to make use of this equipment under my authority.

They may ask for it back but you won't go to jail for it. I hope we succeed in our goal and can save everyone in Knox Country before you can find this message.
-Sgt. Major Douglas
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_33_Content.ch:
致發現這封信的人: 我在軍方負責後勤, 這支部隊試圖遏止肆虐諾克斯地區的感染. 我們目前正撤出這個區域, 但會留下不少裝備. 如果你在這裡, 代表你正在尋找能在我們離開後幫助你生存的物資. 在我們失敗之際, 這是我送你的禮物: 

本法律文件授權持有此文件的平民, 取得並使用本軍事設施內遺留的任何及所有裝備, 以協助其生存. 如果我們能奪回此區域並重新恢復控制, 務必將此文件交給他們, 證明你不是掠奪者, 而是經我授權核准使用這些裝備. 

他們可能會要你歸還, 但你不會因此坐牢. 希望我們能達成目標, 在你發現這封信之前拯救諾克斯地區的所有人. 
-道格拉斯士官長
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_33_Content.cn:
致发现这封信的人: 我在军方负责后勤, 这支部队试图遏制肆虐诺克斯地区的感染. 我们目前正撤出这个区域, 但会留下不少装备. 如果你在这里, 说明你正在寻找能在我们离开后帮助你生存的物资. 在我们失败之际, 这是我送你的礼物: 

本法律文件授权持有此文件的平民, 获取并使用本军事设施内遗留的任何及所有装备, 以协助其生存. 如果我们能夺回此区域并重新恢复控制, 务必将此文件交给他们, 证明你不是掠夺者, 而是经我授权批准使用这些装备. 

他们可能会要你归还, 但你不会因此坐牢. 希望我们能达成目标, 在你发现这封信之前拯救诺克斯地区的所有人. 
-道格拉斯军士长

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_34_Content.en:
I don't know what I'm going to do now. Never should've let Debbie and that creep pick me up. I just wanted to get out so bad, I guess I can't judge driving high, or drunk, or whatever.

At least I wasn't doing sixty when I hit stuff...

My chest hurts so bad. Dragged myself this far without getting spotted, but the crash was so LOUD! God, Debbie.. I can't believe what's happening out there. I'm so sorry. I'm so afraid.

I can't even take a deep breath. I just wish I could take a deep breath! Maybe writing more will help. Just gotta find some more paper. And a decent bandage, and maybe something to take the edge off...
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_34_Content.ch:
我不知道現在該怎麼辦. 真不該讓黛比和那個怪胎載我的. 我只是太想離開這裡了, 我想我也沒資格批評人家嗑藥開車, 或酒駕, 或什麼的. 

至少撞上東西的時候我沒開到時速六十…

我的胸口好痛. 一路把自己拖到這裡都沒被發現, 但那場車禍的聲音實在太大了! 天啊, 黛比… 真不敢相信外面發生的事. 對不起. 我好害怕. 

我連深呼吸都沒辦法. 真希望我能深呼吸一下! 也許多寫一點會有幫助. 只是得再找些紙. 還有像樣的繃帶, 也許再找點能讓我好受點的東西…
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_34_Content.cn:
我不知道现在该怎么办. 真不该让黛比和那个怪胎载我的. 我只是太想离开这里了, 我想我也没资格批评别人嗑药开车, 或酒驾, 或什么的. 

至少撞上东西的时候我没开到时速六十…

我的胸口好痛. 一路把自己拖到这里都没被发现, 但那场车祸的声音实在太大了! 天啊, 黛比… 真不敢相信外面发生的事. 对不起. 我好害怕. 

我连深呼吸都做不到. 真希望我能深呼吸一下! 也许多写一点会有帮助. 只是得再找些纸. 还有像样的绷带, 也许再找点能让我好受点的东西…

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_35_Content.en: Dale, things are looking a bit nasty out there. Lots of people are starting to get ill and I think they'll start to panic. If you left your house before I could get to your place and come in for work be sure to double check all the locks on the doors and shudders. Last thing we need is some scared nutcase stealing one of our guns and waving it around the emergency room. After you lock everything down go home to your family; you'll get a full day's pay. Stay safe.\n-Bill
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_35_Content.ch: 戴爾, 外面的情況看起來有點糟. 很多人開始生病, 我想他們很快就會恐慌起來. 如果你在我趕到你家之前就已經出門來上班, 務必再檢查一遍門和百葉窗的所有鎖. 我們最不需要的就是哪個嚇壞的瘋子偷走我們的槍, 在急診室裡揮來揮去. 把一切鎖好之後就回家陪家人; 你會拿到一整天的工資. 注意安全. \n-比爾
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_35_Content.cn: 戴尔, 外面的情况看起来有点糟. 很多人开始生病, 我想他们很快就会恐慌起来. 如果你在我赶到你家之前就已经出门来上班, 务必再检查一遍门和百叶窗的所有锁. 我们最不需要的就是哪个吓坏的疯子偷走我们的枪, 在急诊室里挥来挥去. 把一切锁好之后就回家陪家人; 你会拿到一整天的工资. 注意安全. \n-比尔

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_38_Content.en:
Thursday 7/6/1993
4:32 PM

Talon was supposed to get out of prison two days ago, and now it's going on day three. He was supposed to call me when he's ready to be picked up. This timing could not be any worse... I've been trying to get in touch with someone on the phone but nobody is answering. I'm terrified that the worst may have happened - that he was left to die in his cell or something. I have no way of getting over there with everything going on and even if I did, I doubt they would let me in. News says to stay indoors... I feel so helpless and angry. Everything that's going on would be a little easier if I were with him.

Thursday 7/6/1993
11 PM

I can't sleep... the news hasn't changed since my last entry. I'm sitting here in the light of my TV and they just keep repeating the same stuff, so I'm starting to wonder if it's even live any more. This news lady on the screen could already be dead and here I've been, listening to her BS. I feel so guilty sitting here waiting for an update, so I've accepted that I have to take things in to my own hands. It's what you do for the people you love - even if you're scared. I am very scared, but that's my best friend and he may need my help. This will be my last entry before heading to the prison at dawn.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_38_Content.ch:
7/6/1993 星期四
下午 4:32

塔隆兩天前就該出獄了, 現在都快第三天了. 他說好準備好讓人接的時候會打電話給我. 這時機糟到不能再糟了… 我一直試著打電話聯絡人, 但沒人接. 我好怕最糟的情況已經發生了 - 怕他被丟在牢房裡等死之類的. 現在外面這麼亂, 我根本沒辦法過去, 就算過得去, 我也懷疑他們會不會讓我進去. 新聞說要待在室內… 我覺得好無助又好氣. 如果我在他身邊, 現在發生的一切或許會好受一點. 

7/6/1993 星期四
晚上 11 點

我睡不著… 從上一篇日記到現在, 新聞都沒有變. 我坐在電視的光線裡, 他們只是不停重複同樣的內容, 我開始懷疑這到底還是不是直播. 螢幕上這位女主播可能早就死了, 而我還一直在這裡聽她胡扯. 坐在這裡等最新消息讓我好內疚, 所以我接受了自己必須親自採取行動. 為了所愛的人, 就該這麼做 - 即使你很害怕. 我非常害怕, 但他是我最好的朋友, 他可能需要我的幫助. 這是我黎明前往監獄前的最後一篇日記.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_39_Content.en:
November 17th, 1993
I'm Marcus, and this is my cabin. I live out in the wilderness of Kentucky with my trusty companion, Rust. He's a great dog. When I heard the chaos unfolding in Kentucky, I knew right away what I had to do. After all, I have no family or friends to worry about. As my job required me to keep an eye on wildlife and people. But, thanks to my training, I am able to fend for myself out here. As long as nature provides.

November 19th, 1993
I was out foraging this morning when I noticed two of those things slowly making their way towards my cabin. What could have drawn them there? Perhaps Rust? I took them out quietly with a shovel, as I did not want to use my hunting rifle. In case there were more of them. Rust was nowhere near the cabin, but instead out in the forest hunting squirrels, it seems. Leaving the foraged food inside, I check the corpses for anything useful and bury them at least 30 feet away from here.

November 28th, 1993
Today I scored a fair game. A deer. It'll be good to stock up on venison for the winter. However, I'll have an extra mouth to feed. I found this frightened little girl in the forest. This poor child was all alone, dirty, and in ragged clothing. How did she manage to survive all alone out here? It did not matter; I took her in and showed her where she could clean herself up. It's a good thing I had extra clothes lying around from campers who abandoned their belongings in the woods. I fed her soup and sat her by the antique stove to keep her warm. She told me she was only six years old. How cruel can the world get?

December 13th, 1993
Alice-yes, that is her name. She told me a few days later, after she was able to speak properly. She looks healthier now, but her night terrors are still an occurrence. I do my best to take care of her. She keeps good company with Rust. At least I know I can count on him to keep her safe. Often, when I leave to forage or hunt, I remind Alice what to do in case of an emergency as well as to always stay near the cabin. We're short on salt, which is needed for meat preservation. A trip to nearby farm houses shouldn't be too dangerous, as they're far from any major city or town. Other than Ekron.

December 14th, 1993
Yesterday, after my trip to acquire some salt and other supplies, I arrived home to find Alice running away in fear from three of those things chasing after her. I quickly got rid of them with my hunting knife and proceeded to clam Alice down. After a few minutes, she explained where they came from. Evidently, some fools had camped up near a river, which makes noise. And since noise attracts these things, well, things did not end well for them, it seems. I think it's time for us to move deeper into the woods. I know of an abandoned cabin that hasn't been used by anyone for almost a decade. It will be far safer there than here. Today, I spent the day packing things up with Alice. Preparing for the journey ahead of us.

December 15th, 1993
Me and Alice are now leaving this cabin. She's been my home for years due to my job. But things aren't the same anymore, and I need to keep this girl safe at all costs. It is my duty as a man and as a ranger.

To whomever finds this small log of notes: I left one of my hunting rifles under the bed with as little ammunition as I could leave behind. There is enough water in the well, and the antique stove should keep you warm during the winter.

Alice and I will be living deep in the woods, away from all this. I hope that one day this horror goes away.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_39_Content.ch:
1993 年 11 月 17 日
我是馬可斯, 這是我的小屋. 我和忠實的夥伴拉斯特住在肯塔基州的荒野裡. 牠是條很棒的狗. 當我聽說肯塔基州陷入一片混亂時, 我立刻就知道該怎麼做. 畢竟我沒有家人或朋友需要擔心. 我的工作本來就要留意野生動物和人. 多虧了我受過的訓練, 我在這裡能夠自給自足. 只要大自然還供應得了. 

1993 年 11 月 19 日
今天早上我出門搜尋時, 發現有兩隻那種東西正慢慢往我的小屋走來. 是什麼把它們引來的? 也許是拉斯特? 我用鏟子悄悄解決了它們, 因為我不想用獵槍, 以防還有更多. 拉斯特當時根本不在小屋附近, 看來是跑到森林裡獵松鼠去了. 我把搜尋到的食物放進屋裡, 檢查屍體上有沒有有用的東西, 再把它們埋在離這裡至少 30 英尺遠的地方. 

1993 年 11 月 28 日
今天我獵到了不錯的獵物. 一頭鹿. 正好可以為冬天儲備鹿肉. 不過, 我得多養一張嘴了. 我在森林裡發現了一個受驚的小女孩. 這可憐的孩子孤零零的, 渾身髒兮兮, 穿著破爛的衣服. 她是怎麼獨自在這裡活下來的? 這不重要; 我收留了她, 帶她去可以梳洗的地方. 幸好我手邊有些多的衣服, 是露營客丟在樹林裡的東西. 我餵她喝湯, 讓她坐在古典火爐旁取暖. 她說她才六歲. 這世界還能殘酷到什麼地步? 

1993 年 12 月 13 日
愛麗絲 - 對, 那是她的名字. 幾天後她能好好說話了, 才告訴我. 她現在看起來健康多了, 但還是會做惡夢. 我盡力照顧她. 她和拉斯特很合得來. 至少我知道可以靠牠保護她的安全. 每次我出門搜尋或打獵, 都會提醒愛麗絲遇到緊急狀況該怎麼做, 還有一定要待在小屋附近. 我們的鹽快用完了, 而保存肉類需要鹽. 去附近的農舍跑一趟應該不會太危險, 因為那些地方離大城鎮都很遠. 以革倫除外. 

1993 年 12 月 14 日
昨天我出門去弄些鹽和其他物資, 回到家時發現愛麗絲正驚恐地逃跑, 後面有三隻那種東西在追她. 我很快就用獵刀解決了它們, 接著安撫愛麗絲. 過了幾分鐘, 她跟我說了它們是從哪裡來的. 顯然有幾個笨蛋在河邊紮營, 河水會發出聲音. 而聲音會吸引這些東西, 嗯, 看來他們的下場不太好. 我想是時候搬到樹林更深處了. 我知道有一間廢棄小屋, 將近十年沒人用過. 那裡會比這裡安全得多. 今天我和愛麗絲花了一整天打包東西, 為接下來的旅程做準備. 

1993 年 12 月 15 日
我和愛麗絲現在要離開這間小屋了. 因為工作的關係, 它當了我好幾年的家. 但現在一切都不一樣了, 我必須不惜一切代價保護這個女孩. 這是我身為男人, 也身為護林員的責任. 

致發現這本小筆記的人: 我在床底下留了一把獵槍, 也留下了我能省下的一點彈藥. 井裡的水很充足, 古典火爐能讓你在冬天保暖. 

愛麗絲和我會住在樹林深處, 遠離這一切. 希望有一天這場惡夢會結束.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_39_Content.cn:
1993 年 11 月 17 日
我是马库斯, 这是我的小屋. 我和忠实的伙伴拉斯特住在肯塔基州的荒野里. 它是条很棒的狗. 当我听说肯塔基州陷入一片混乱时, 我立刻就知道该怎么做. 毕竟我没有家人或朋友需要担心. 我的工作本来就要留意野生动物和人. 多亏了我受过的训练, 我在这里能够自给自足. 只要大自然还供应得了. 

1993 年 11 月 19 日
今天早上我出门搜寻时, 发现有两只那种东西正慢慢往我的小屋走来. 是什么把它们引来的? 也许是拉斯特? 我用铲子悄悄解决了它们, 因为我不想用猎枪, 以防还有更多. 拉斯特当时根本不在小屋附近, 看来是跑到森林里猎松鼠去了. 我把搜寻到的食物放进屋里, 检查尸体上有没有有用的东西, 再把它们埋在离这里至少 30 英尺远的地方. 

1993 年 11 月 28 日
今天我猎到了不错的猎物. 一头鹿. 正好可以为冬天储备鹿肉. 不过, 我得多养一张嘴了. 我在森林里发现了一个受惊的小女孩. 这可怜的孩子孤零零的, 浑身脏兮兮, 穿着破烂的衣服. 她是怎么独自在这里活下来的? 这不重要; 我收留了她, 带她去可以梳洗的地方. 幸好我手边有些多的衣服, 是露营者丢在树林里的东西. 我喂她喝汤, 让她坐在旧式壁炉旁取暖. 她说她才六岁. 这世界还能残酷到什么地步? 

1993 年 12 月 13 日
爱丽丝 - 对, 那是她的名字. 几天后她能好好说话了, 才告诉我. 她现在看起来健康多了, 但还是会做噩梦. 我尽力照顾她. 她和拉斯特很合得来. 至少我知道可以靠它保护她的安全. 每次我出门搜寻或打猎, 都会提醒爱丽丝遇到紧急情况该怎么做, 还有一定要待在小屋附近. 我们的盐快用完了, 而保存肉类需要盐. 去附近的农舍跑一趟应该不会太危险, 因为那些地方离大城镇都很远. 以革伦除外. 

1993 年 12 月 14 日
昨天我出门去弄些盐和其他物资, 回到家时发现爱丽丝正惊恐地逃跑, 后面有三只那种东西在追她. 我很快就用猎刀解决了它们, 接着安抚爱丽丝. 过了几分钟, 她跟我说了它们是从哪里来的. 显然有几个笨蛋在河边扎营, 河水会发出声音. 而声音会吸引这些东西, 嗯, 看来他们的下场不太好. 我想是时候搬到树林更深处了. 我知道有一间废弃小屋, 将近十年没人用过. 那里会比这里安全得多. 今天我和爱丽丝花了一整天打包东西, 为接下来的旅程做准备. 

1993 年 12 月 15 日
我和爱丽丝现在要离开这间小屋了. 因为工作的关系, 它当了我好几年的家. 但现在一切都不一样了, 我必须不惜一切代价保护这个女孩. 这是我身为男人, 也身为护林员的责任. 

致发现这本小笔记的人: 我在床底下留了一把猎枪, 也留下了我能省下的一点弹药. 井里的水很充足, 旧式壁炉能让你在冬天保暖. 

爱丽丝和我会住在树林深处, 远离这一切. 希望有一天这场噩梦会结束.

Jim
Sorry, man, I was busy listening to the HAM radio and thought I heard another group of survivors. I've been trying to communicate with them.

Jim
I will be out late tonight. I think I found a nice stash of food the previous day. It seems safe, as there aren't any biters there.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_41_Content.en:
To anyone who finds this sheet of paper. Know that I was not a bad person. I was just a survivor.

It has been almost a year since the outbreak occurred. I had to do things I'm not proud of to survive. Abandoned family, friends, and strangers of all kinds. Living in this apartment complex, I managed to stock up on supplies to the point that they are filling up my bedroom with things I've been collecting. Often, when I get out to scavenge at night, I can see those zombies just pacing about. I know, zombies-how cliche. But hey, this is the real deal. It has happened here in Kentucky, of all places! Why do I only go out at night? Because it seems to be safest from both people and zombies. As those things can't be clearly seen when it is completely dark. However, their sense of hearing is quite frightening.

Often, I find groups of other survivors here in Louisville. All with the same goal in mind: to survive. Some are good, and some are just plain horrible.

One night, I had no choice. It wasn't my fault; I know I shouldn't have, but I had no choice! I was stupid enough to infiltrate another group's stash house. because I thought they weren't home. This group isn't the greatest of people or the brightest. They often harass or, on rare occasions, kill other survivors for their supplies. Anyway, here I was, inside, and I managed to picklock their backdoor with ease. It was dark; that's smart. They kept their lights off. However, my eyesight is fair in the dark. A few doors down, I found their stash, and I packed up what I could take with me. Make sure everything is as it should be. I lock the door as if no one has ever passed by. That was when I heard someone crying at the door next to their stash. I opened it, and inside was a woman who was chained to a pipe. She notices me and begins to panic. I do my best to calm her down. UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_42_Content.en:
Attention survivor,
If you are reading this, it means you are still alive amidst this Hell. I write this note to warn you about the Knox Event and its sinister origins. SPIFFCO, the restaurant chain, is the root cause of this nightmare. Their establishments have been spreading a mysterious illness, turning people into the undead horrors that now roam the streets.

I fear that I too have fallen victim to their vile scheme. The food they claim is beef seems far from it, and I suspect there's something much darker hidden within their meals. It is crucial to avoid consuming anything from SPIFFCO if you wish to stay alive and uninfected.

Stay vigilant and trust no one. The world we once knew has become a living nightmare, and the only way to survive is to remain cautious and resourceful. If you encounter others, be careful whom you trust, as the virus may have already taken hold of them.

We must find a way to fight back against this darkness and restore humanity. Share this warning with anyone you can, as information may be our greatest weapon against this zombie apocalypse.
Stay strong and keep hope alive.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_42_Content.ch:
倖存者請注意,
如果你正在讀這封信, 代表你在這片地獄中仍然活著. 我寫下這封信, 是要警告你關於諾克斯事件及其邪惡的源頭. 連鎖餐廳斯皮福公司 (SPIFFCO) 正是這場噩夢的罪魁禍首. 他們的分店一直在散播一種神秘的疾病, 把人變成如今在街上遊蕩的不死怪物.

我擔心自己也已經成了他們卑劣陰謀的受害者. 他們聲稱是牛肉的食物, 根本一點也不像, 我懷疑他們的餐點裡藏著更黑暗的東西. 如果你想活下去且不被感染, 務必避免吃任何斯皮福公司的東西.

保持警覺, 別相信任何人. 我們曾經熟悉的世界已經變成活生生的噩夢, 唯一的生存之道就是保持謹慎, 善用資源. 如果你遇到其他人, 要小心該信任誰, 因為病毒可能已經控制了他們.

我們必須找到方法對抗這片黑暗, 恢復人性. 盡可能把這個警告分享給每一個人, 因為資訊可能是我們對抗這場殭屍末日最強大的武器.
保持堅強, 別讓希望熄滅.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_42_Content.cn:
幸存者请注意,
如果你正在读这封信, 说明你在这片地狱中仍然活着. 我写下这封信, 是要警告你关于诺克斯事件及其邪恶的根源. 连锁餐厅斯皮福公司 (SPIFFCO) 正是这场噩梦的罪魁祸首. 他们的门店一直在传播一种神秘的疾病, 把人变成如今在街上游荡的不死怪物.

我担心自己也已经成了他们卑劣阴谋的受害者. 他们声称是牛肉的食物, 根本一点也不像, 我怀疑他们的餐点里藏着更黑暗的东西. 如果你想活下去且不被感染, 务必避免吃任何斯皮福公司的东西.

保持警惕, 别相信任何人. 我们曾经熟悉的世界已经变成活生生的噩梦, 唯一的生存之道就是保持谨慎, 善用资源. 如果你遇到其他人, 要小心该信任谁, 因为病毒可能已经控制了他们.

我们必须找到办法对抗这片黑暗, 恢复人性. 尽可能把这个警告分享给每一个人, 因为信息可能是我们对抗这场僵尸末日最强大的武器.
保持坚强, 别让希望熄灭.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_43_Content.en:
Its been about 14 days in Rosewood, had to kill some infected just to be able to get me some cans of food and coffee, not looking too good in my end. Writing this helps me release myself and i hope that if i die, my canned goods can be used to help someone else.

*The bottom part of the paper is heavily crumpled and the handwriting is messy, almost as if it was written on a rush*

You will not believe me what ive just seen, some guy was running out of this store laughing his ass off whilst he was throwing bananas at this one zombie. Bananas! Now I admit, it was funny as hell when the zombie just fell on its back and smashed its head against the wall faster than i could count, but i knew i couldnt stay out here for long-

*The front side of the paper ran out of space, you flip the paper to the back and the handwriting is now relaxed and you wont have to squint to read it now. There is a slight banana smudge on the right side*

Man, those bananas were pretty good to be honest. Guy sure knows his stuff!
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_43_Content.ch:
在羅斯伍德已經大約14天了, 為了弄到幾罐食物和咖啡, 不得不殺掉一些感染者, 我這邊的情況不太妙. 寫下這些能讓我宣洩一下, 我希望如果我死了, 我的罐頭能拿去幫助別人.

*紙張下半部皺得很厲害, 字跡也很潦草, 幾乎像是匆忙寫下的*

你絕對不會相信我剛剛看到了什麼, 有個傢伙從這家店裡跑出來, 一邊笑到不行一邊朝一隻殭屍丟香蕉. 香蕉耶! 我承認, 那隻殭屍直接往後滑倒, 腦袋撞上牆的速度快到我都來不及數, 真是好笑得要命, 但我知道我不能在外面待太久-

*紙張正面的空間用完了, 你把紙翻到背面, 字跡現在變得從容, 你不用再瞇著眼睛讀了. 右側有一小塊香蕉汙漬*

老實說, 那些香蕉還真不錯. 那傢伙果然很懂!
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_43_Content.cn:
在罗斯伍德已经大约14天了, 为了弄到几罐食物和咖啡, 不得不杀掉一些感染者, 我这边的情况不太妙. 写下这些能让我发泄一下, 我希望如果我死了, 我的罐头能拿去帮助别人.

*纸张下半部分皱得很厉害, 字迹也很潦草, 几乎像是匆忙写下的*

你绝对不会相信我刚刚看到了什么, 有个家伙从这家店里跑出来, 一边笑得前仰后合一边朝一只僵尸扔香蕉. 香蕉啊! 我承认, 那只僵尸直接仰面滑倒, 脑袋撞上墙的速度快到我都来不及数, 真是好笑得要命, 但我知道我不能在外面待太久-

*纸张正面的空间用完了, 你把纸翻到背面, 字迹现在变得从容, 你不用再眯着眼睛读了. 右侧有一小块香蕉污渍*

说实话, 那些香蕉还真不错. 那家伙果然很懂行!

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_44_Content.en: Uncle Bob, the phone lines are still down, so it's just letters from me for the time being. Just wanted to let you know that I'm okay, despite everything that's been going down these past few days. I normally wouldn't have this much time to write, but our wing's on lockdown today. Can't separate the truth from the con talk these days, but what I do know is some sicko was caught eating his cellmate. We all saw the guy, covered in blood and grayer than the cold, hard concrete beneath our toes, getting wheeled out by the COs strapped to those chairs that they put Hannibal Lecter in. Yeah, straight out of the Silence of the Lambs movie, mask and all. I didn't know they actually had stuff like that! If he ever leaves the hole, which I sure as hell hope he doesn't, he'll be taking the nickname
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_44_Content.ch: 鮑伯叔叔, 電話線路還是不通, 所以暫時只能寫信給你了. 只是想讓你知道我沒事, 儘管這幾天發生了這麼多事. 我平常不會有這麼多時間寫信, 但我們這一區今天封鎖了. 這陣子很難分清楚哪些是真相, 哪些是犯人瞎扯, 但我確定的是, 有個變態被抓到在吃他的獄友. 我們都看到那傢伙了, 滿身是血, 臉色比我們腳下冰冷堅硬的水泥地還要灰, 被獄警綁在漢尼拔·萊克特坐的那種椅子上推出去. 對, 就像《沉默的羔羊》電影裡那樣, 連面罩都有. 我都不知道他們真的有那種東西! 如果他哪天離開禁閉室 (我真心希望他不會), 他肯定會被冠上綽號
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_44_Content.cn: 鲍勃叔叔, 电话线路还是不通, 所以暂时只能给你写信了. 只是想让你知道我没事, 尽管这几天发生了这么多事. 我平常不会有这么多时间写信, 但我们这片监区今天封锁了. 这阵子很难分清哪些是真相, 哪些是犯人瞎扯, 但我确定的是, 有个变态被抓到在吃他的狱友. 我们都看到那家伙了, 满身是血, 脸色比我们脚下冰冷坚硬的水泥地还要灰, 被狱警绑在汉尼拔·莱克特坐的那种椅子上推出去. 对, 就像《沉默的羔羊》电影里那样, 连面罩都有. 我都不知道他们真的有那种东西! 如果他哪天离开禁闭室 (我真心希望他不会), 他肯定会被冠上绰号

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_45_Content.en:
*Most of the writing would be covered in tears*

Dear Johnny,

It's me, Evan. I am not sure what happened to you and Eli out there in West Point as only Eli has returned and he sadly passed away 4 days ago on July 13th due to gun wound infection without having the chance to tell us what happened to you, and now he's dead but he was my brother.
I will wait for your return one more day.

Johhny, now I know why you haven't returned. Not because you're dead, not because you're infected, but because YOU KILLED MY BROTHER. The bullet we took out of him was YOUR GUN'S BULLET. You really thought WE were dead weight, SO YOU KILLED MY 14 YEARS OLD BROTHER.

Now, I am a Christian man, but if I EVER find you, you will WISH you NEVER MET ME OR MY BROTHER. Pray, Johnny, because now you took away the only purpose I had. Now, IM COMING FOR YOU JOHNNY.

Yours HATEFULLY Evan

p.s. your wife's dead, Johnny.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_45_Content.ch:
*大部分字跡都被淚水浸濕了*

親愛的強尼,

是我, 伊凡. 我不知道你和伊萊在西點那邊發生了什麼事, 因為只有伊萊回來了, 而他很不幸地在4天前, 也就是7月13日, 因槍傷感染去世了, 他還沒來得及告訴我們你發生了什麼事. 現在他死了, 但他是我的弟弟.
我會再等你回來一天.

強尼, 現在我知道你為什麼沒回來了. 不是因為你死了, 不是因為你被感染了, 而是因為你殺了我弟弟. 我們從他身上取出的子彈是你的槍的子彈. 你真的覺得我們是累贅, 所以你殺了我14歲的弟弟.

我是個基督徒, 但如果我哪天找到你, 你會希望你從來沒遇過我和我弟弟. 禱告吧, 強尼, 因為你奪走了我唯一的活下去的目標. 現在, 我要來找你了, 強尼.

滿懷恨意的伊凡

附註: 你老婆死了, 強尼.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_45_Content.cn:

是我, 伊万. 我不知道你和伊莱在西点那边发生了什么事, 因为只有伊莱回来了, 而他很不幸地在4天前, 也就是7月13日, 因枪伤感染去世了, 他还没来得及告诉我们你发生了什么事. 现在他死了, 但他是我的弟弟.
我会再等你回来一天.

强尼, 现在我知道你为什么没回来了. 不是因为你死了, 不是因为你被感染了, 而是因为你杀了我弟弟. 我们从他身上取出的子弹是你的枪的子弹. 你真的觉得我们是累赘, 所以你杀了我14岁的弟弟.

我是个基督徒, 但如果我哪天找到你, 你会希望你从来没遇见过我和我弟弟. 祈祷吧, 强尼, 因为你夺走了我唯一活下去的目标. 现在, 我要来找你了, 强尼.

满怀恨意的伊万

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_49_Content.en:
The nasty girls are shooting on sight now. They're not even bothering to hide it anymore, anyone trying to leave, or trying to enter, gets shot dead. Used to be they'd just arrest you, quarantine you then let you go into the city to evac, that's what my sister said on the radio before she and a few dozen others got ferried across the river into Indiana.

I write this letter to anybody who might find it from my deathbed. Me and my cousin Jesse tried to approach the gate, wanting to get in, to evacuate like everyone else, but the moment we came into sight, they killed Jesse, blew his brains out all over the concrete with an M16, and then they popped me a few times.

I managed to get away, to get back to my car, but I'm losing blood just steady enough that I've got maybe twenty minutes left as I write this. My last will and testament to whoever comes across this letter, praying it hasn't been soaked through:

You can have all my gear. I won't be needing it. If you're able and willing, try to get to Indianapolis, that's where they took my sister Vivian. Give her this note, so she's not left in the dark.

I love you Viv.

Mitchell
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_49_Content.ch:
那群惡婆娘現在見人就開槍. 她們甚至懶得再掩飾了, 任何想離開或想進去的人, 都會被當場射殺. 以前她們只會逮捕你, 把你隔離, 然後放你進城撤離, 我姐姐在無線電裡就是這麼說的, 之後她和其他幾十個人就被渡船送過河到印第安納州去了.

我在臨終的病榻上, 寫下這封信給任何可能發現它的人. 我和我表弟傑西想靠近大門, 想進去, 像其他人一樣撤離, 但我們一出現在視線範圍內, 她們就殺了傑西, 用M16把他的腦漿轟得灑滿水泥地, 接著又朝我開了好幾槍.

我設法逃走了, 回到我的車上, 但我一直在穩定失血, 寫下這封信時大概只剩二十分鐘了. 這是我給任何發現這封信的人的遺囑, 祈禱它還沒被血浸透:

我的裝備你都可以拿走. 我用不到了. 如果你有能力也願意, 試著去印第安納波利斯, 他們把我姐姐薇薇安帶到那裡了. 把這張字條交給她, 別讓她被蒙在鼓裡.

我愛妳, 薇薇.

米契爾
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_49_Content.cn:
那帮臭娘们现在见人就开枪. 她们甚至懒得再掩饰了, 任何想离开或想进去的人, 都会被当场射杀. 以前她们只会逮捕你, 把你隔离, 然后放你进城撤离, 我姐姐在无线电里就是这么说的, 之后她和其他几十个人就被渡船送过河到印第安纳州去了.

我在临终的病榻上, 写下这封信给任何可能发现它的人. 我和我表弟杰西想靠近大门, 想进去, 像其他人一样撤离, 但我们一出现在视线范围内, 她们就杀了杰西, 用M16把他的脑浆轰得洒满水泥地, 接着又朝我开了好几枪.

我设法逃走了, 回到我的车上, 但我一直在稳定失血, 写下这封信时大概只剩二十分钟了. 这是我给任何发现这封信的人的遗嘱, 祈祷它还没被血浸透:

我的装备你都可以拿走. 我用不上了. 如果你有能力也愿意, 试着去印第安纳波利斯, 他们把我姐姐薇薇安带到那里了. 把这张纸条交给她, 别让她被蒙在鼓里.

我爱你, 薇薇.

米切尔

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_4_Content.en:
It has been 6 days but it still feels like yesterday, the day you were gone forever from me. Whenever I woke up and open my eyes to see that you aren't on the bed with me like it used to anymore, it feels tiring, sorrowful, and hopeless... 

It's like a piece of something deep inside my heart is missing that makes me so stressed... I haven't thought I would smoke or drink till it happens, am I this broken? Tsk, It's not like you or anyone gonna give me an answer anyway.

This new world without you is starting and the old world is ending, I am going go to live on to see and feel the sunlight of another day so that the life you had sacrificed for me would be worth something.

I've missed you so much, Jim...
I will make it worth your life.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_4_Content.ch:
已經過了6天, 但感覺就像昨天, 那天你永遠離開了我. 每當我醒來睜開眼睛, 看到你不再像以前那樣躺在我身邊, 就覺得好累, 好悲傷, 好絕望… 

就像內心深處有一塊東西不見了, 讓我壓力好大… 在這件事發生之前, 我從沒想過自己會抽菸喝酒, 我真的這麼崩潰嗎? 嘖, 反正你或任何人也不會給我答案.

沒有你的新世界正在開始, 舊世界正在結束, 我會繼續活下去, 去看, 去感受新一天的陽光, 讓你為我犧牲的生命有所價值.

我好想你, 吉姆…
我會讓你的犧牲值得.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_4_Content.cn:

就像内心深处有一块东西不见了, 让我压力好大… 在这件事发生之前, 我从没想过自己会抽烟喝酒, 我真的这么崩溃吗? 啧, 反正你或任何人也不会给我答案.

没有你的新世界正在开始, 旧世界正在结束, 我会继续活下去, 去看, 去感受新一天的阳光, 让你为我牺牲的生命有所价值.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_50_Content.en:
If I die, let it be from age.
Let me die doing what I love best,
Without fear, without rage.

If I die, let my friends know their worth.
How with them I am blessed,
as I'm buried in the Earth.

If I die, may my enemies live well.
It's better for them to live without guilt,
Than have them ultimately dwell.

If I die, may I be free of illness.
Remember my childhood with no fail,
And laid to rest with no sickness.

When I die, and it won't be long,
Let me die when I can see myself clearly;
When I come to terms with the concept of Death
When my legacy brought a change to someone who knew me.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_50_Content.ch:
若我死去, 願是因為年老.
讓我在做最愛的事時死去,
沒有恐懼, 沒有憤怒.

若我死去, 讓我的朋友知道他們的可貴.
有他們相伴我何其有幸,
當我長眠於大地.

若我死去, 願我的敵人過得好.
讓他們無愧地活著,
好過讓他們終究耿耿於懷.

若我死去, 願我無病無痛.
務必記住我的童年,
安息時不帶一絲病痛.

當我死去, 而那不會太久,
讓我在能看清自己時死去;
當我坦然接受死亡的概念
當我留下的一切改變了某個認識我的人.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_59_Content.en: 7/1/93 3:54 AM\nWas in Japan somewhere. It was beautiful. Nobody spoke English but that was OK. The sky was grey and blustery, trees everywhere blowing in the wind, rain was coming. I loved it. I was looking for somebody, I think a guy I'd read about once. Knew where he was supposed to live but nobody there knew his name. Maybe it was a penname. Maybe he wasn't even real. That'd be OK, too, because it was still so beautiful there. Wish I could go for real. Maybe I will someday. Hope I have the dream again.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_59_Content.ch: 93/7/1 凌晨 3:54\n夢到自己在日本某處. 那裡好美. 沒人會說英語, 但沒關係. 天空灰濛濛的, 風很大, 到處都是在風中搖曳的樹, 快下雨了. 我好喜歡. 我在找一個人, 好像是我曾經讀過的某個人. 我知道他應該住在哪裡, 但那裡沒人知道他的名字. 也許那是筆名. 也許他根本不存在. 那也沒關係, 因為那裡還是那麼美. 真希望能真的去一趟. 也許總有一天會去吧. 希望我還能再做這個夢.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_59_Content.cn: 93/7/1 凌晨 3:54\n梦到自己在日本某处. 那里好美. 没人会说英语, 但没关系. 天空灰蒙蒙的, 风很大, 到处都是在风中摇曳的树, 快下雨了. 我好喜欢. 我在找一个人, 好像是我曾经读到过的某个人. 我知道他应该住在哪里, 但那里没人知道他的名字. 也许那是笔名. 也许他根本不存在. 那也没关系, 因为那里还是那么美. 真希望能真的去一趟. 也许总有一天会去吧. 希望我还能再做这个梦.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_5_Content.en:
Two weeks passed on as the world goes by, surprisingly the water is still on and the power is still running.

A few days ago, maybe on day 8 or 9, I noticed that the Government have been kicking around from time to time but was not here to save me or anyone who was still breathing. Instead, they dropped a supply for us... aren't they supposed to rescue us? Doesn't matter... At least I got some supplies to keep me going but helicopters are loud. Loud is bad and they draw more attention to those things.
I need to keep moving away from them...

Yesterday, I went on a run and found an annotated map in one of the vehicles. There's some writing there and it mentioned me, from the look of it. James seems to be the owner of the map, a friend of mine, and Jim... I know Daryl too.
The map said Daryl is sick and James had been looking for me...
I don't see James anywhere, maybe he's dead...? Left a question in my mind with this map I decided to go and see If Daryl is still holding out there. I arrived in the evening, the house is mostly barricaded but left one window which I can get in, I checked inside but I don't see Daryl or any clue that he was still alive or not... On the bright side, their house is stacked with food and guns.

James and Daryl, wherever you are, alive or not. I hope you will find peace... like my husband.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_5_Content.ch:
兩週過去了, 世界依舊運轉, 令人意外的是自來水和電力都還沒停.

幾天前, 大概是第 8 或第 9 天, 我發現政府不時會在附近出沒, 但他們不是來救我或任何還活著的人. 他們反而給我們空投了補給… 他們不是應該來救我們嗎? 算了… 至少我拿到了一些能撐下去的補給, 但直升機很吵. 吵就是壞事, 會把更多那些東西引過來.
我得一直遠離它們…

昨天我出去搜刮, 在一輛車裡找到一張有註記的地圖. 上面寫了些東西, 看起來有提到我. 地圖的主人似乎是詹姆斯, 他是我的朋友, 還有吉姆… 我也認識達瑞爾.
地圖上寫著達瑞爾生病了, 而詹姆斯一直在找我…
我到處都沒看到詹姆斯, 也許他已經死了…? 這張地圖在我心裡留下了疑問, 我決定去看看達瑞爾是不是還在那裡撐著. 我傍晚抵達, 房子大部分都封死了, 只留下一扇我能爬進去的窗戶. 我進去檢查, 但沒看到達瑞爾, 也找不到任何他是死是活的線索… 往好處想, 他們家裡堆滿了食物和槍.

詹姆斯, 達瑞爾, 不論你們在哪裡, 是生是死, 希望你們都能得到安息… 就像我丈夫一樣.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_5_Content.cn:
两周过去了, 世界依旧运转, 令人意外的是自来水和电力都还没停.

几天前, 大概是第 8 或第 9 天, 我发现政府不时会在附近出没, 但他们不是来救我或任何还活着的人. 他们反而给我们空投了补给… 他们不是应该来救我们吗? 算了… 至少我拿到了一些能撑下去的补给, 但直升机很吵. 吵就是坏事, 会把更多那些东西引过来.
我得一直远离它们…

昨天我出去搜刮, 在一辆车里找到一张有标注的地图. 上面写了些东西, 看起来有提到我. 地图的主人似乎是詹姆斯, 他是我的朋友, 还有吉姆… 我也认识达里尔.
地图上写着达里尔生病了, 而詹姆斯一直在找我…
我到处都没看到詹姆斯, 也许他已经死了…? 这张地图在我心里留下了疑问, 我决定去看看达里尔是不是还在那里撑着. 我傍晚到达, 房子大部分都封死了, 只留下一扇我能爬进去的窗户. 我进去查看, 但没看到达里尔, 也找不到任何他是死是活的线索… 往好处想, 他们家里堆满了食物和枪.

詹姆斯, 达里尔, 不论你们在哪里, 是生是死, 希望你们都能得到安息… 就像我丈夫一样.

Introduction

This chapter is designed to help the Home Mechanic maintain the Chevalier Primani for peak performance, economy, safety, and long life.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_67_Content.en: I should've stayed in Cincinnati. I should've, because it's hell here. I never thought it would ever get like this. It's worse than the Avondale riots, and I never believed I'd see anything like that again. Oh my God. I should've stayed. I should've. Louisville is falling apart. Lexington will be next. They're going to martial law. The roads are empty sometimes. I had to come down here, I had to, just to see if there was anything I could do, but I can't, for Lorna or anybody. I should've stayed in Cincinnati, because instead of watching the city light up the nightsky like we did all those years ago, this is how I'm spending my last day. I'm sorry.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_67_Content.ch: 我應該待在辛辛那提的. 我真該待在那裡, 因為這裡簡直是地獄. 我從沒想過事情會變成這樣. 這比埃文代爾暴動還糟, 我從沒想過會再看到那種場面. 我的天啊. 我應該留下的. 我真該留下. 路易斯維爾正在崩潰. 下一個就是列克星頓. 他們要實施戒嚴了. 道路有時候空無一人. 我非來這裡不可, 真的非來不可, 只是想看看有沒有什麼我能做的, 但我什麼也做不了, 不管是為了洛娜還是任何人. 我應該待在辛辛那提的, 因為我沒能像多年前那樣看著城市照亮夜空, 而是這樣度過我的最後一天. 對不起.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_67_Content.cn: 我应该待在辛辛那提的. 我真该待在那里, 因为这里简直是地狱. 我从没想过事情会变成这样. 这比埃文代尔暴动还糟, 我从没想过会再看到那种场面. 我的天啊. 我应该留下的. 我真该留下. 路易斯维尔正在崩溃. 下一个就是列克星敦. 他们要实施戒严了. 道路有时候空无一人. 我非来这里不可, 真的非来不可, 只是想看看有没有什么我能做的, 但我什么也做不了, 不管是为了洛娜还是任何人. 我应该待在辛辛那提的, 因为我没能像多年前那样看着城市照亮夜空, 而是这样度过我的最后一天. 对不起.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_6_Content.en:
Day 28... It has been quiet since the end of the first week as the rotten walking corpse roams the earth. These things seem to appear more and more every day, bigger and bigger in number all around the place... I need to set up a perimeter around Riverside now.

I have been outside of Riverside town to explore the region, and ran into a lot of what's left of the old world... It's just the same everywhere, no survivors, just the world and me and the undead.

I also stopped by at the army quarter by South East of Rosewood as well and of course, nothing but one military personnel who got left behind. They seemed to be in a hurry and left their stuff behind including their vehicle and equipment that I can use... I'm going to need it.
When I was driving out to get back onto the highway I heard it, a military helicopter flying in a distance. I cried for help as I quickly reached out for a flare and pop it up but... It flew over me and eventually crashed down into the field not so far away.
I thought I was safe but nowhere is safe... I drove over just to see what's left of the crash site and the infected crew, airborne must have gotten into them and makes their bird lose their control...

I started to question myself If he was still here with me, watching from above as I struggled and thrive to survive... Just a little hope that will make me make it to the next day.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_6_Content.ch:
第 28 天… 自從第一週結束後就一直很安靜, 腐爛的行屍在大地上遊蕩. 那些東西似乎每天都越來越多, 到處數量越聚越大… 我現在得在河畔周圍建立防線了.

我離開河畔鎮去探索這一帶, 遇見了許多舊世界的殘骸… 到處都一樣, 沒有倖存者, 只有這個世界, 我和不死者.

我也順道去了羅斯伍德東南方的軍營, 當然, 那裡什麼都沒有, 只有一名被丟下的軍人. 他們似乎走得很匆忙, 留下了東西, 包括我能用的車輛和裝備… 我會需要它們的.
當我開車準備回到公路上時, 我聽到了, 一架軍用直升機在遠處飛行. 我一邊大喊求救, 一邊趕緊抓起照明彈點燃發射, 但是… 它從我頭頂飛過, 最後墜毀在不遠處的田野裡.
我以為自己安全了, 但沒有哪裡是安全的… 我開車過去看看墜機現場還剩下什麼, 機組人員都被感染了, 一定是空氣傳播的病毒感染了他們, 才讓那架直升機失控…

我開始問自己, 如果他還在我身邊, 從天上看著我掙扎求生… 只要一點點希望, 就能讓我撐到明天.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_6_Content.cn:
第 28 天… 自从第一周结束后就一直很安静, 腐烂的行尸在大地上游荡. 那些东西似乎每天都越来越多, 到处数量越聚越大… 我现在得在河畔周围建立防线了.

我离开河畔镇去探索这一带, 遇见了许多旧世界的残骸… 到处都一样, 没有幸存者, 只有这个世界, 我和不死者.

我也顺道去了罗斯伍德东南方的军营, 当然, 那里什么都没有, 只有一名被丢下的军人. 他们似乎走得很匆忙, 留下了东西, 包括我能用的车辆和装备… 我会需要它们的.
当我开车准备回到公路上时, 我听到了, 一架军用直升机在远处飞行. 我一边大喊求救, 一边赶紧抓起照明弹点燃发射, 但是… 它从我头顶飞过, 最后坠毁在不远处的田野里.
我以为自己安全了, 但没有哪里是安全的… 我开车过去看看坠机现场还剩下什么, 机组人员都被感染了, 一定是空气传播的病毒感染了他们, 才让那架直升机失控…

我开始问自己, 如果他还在我身边, 从天上看着我挣扎求生… 只要一点点希望, 就能让我撑到明天.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_72_Content.en:
What to do in an Emergency
Stay calm! This is the best thing to do! Don't feel bad if you feel sad or mad, just think about it!
Stay inside! Unless there's a flood, we should all stay inside unless we need to get some sun!
Stay occupied! We can play board games, tell stories, dress up in silly costumes, and more!
Stay fasting! Food might be hard to get. So let's only eat a little bit, like we're out camping!
Stay safe! Strangers might come to the house. While some will be nice, we can't help everyone!
Thank God for everything we have - our house, our lives, and most of all our family!

緊急情況該怎麼做
保持冷靜! 這是最好的做法! 覺得難過或生氣也沒關係, 好好想一想就好!
待在室內! 除非淹水, 不然我們都應該待在室內, 除非需要曬曬太陽!
找事情做! 我們可以玩桌遊, 說故事, 穿上搞笑的服裝, 還有更多!
節制飲食! 食物可能很難取得. 所以我們只吃一點點, 就像去露營一樣!
注意安全! 可能會有陌生人來家裡. 雖然有些人很友善, 但我們沒辦法幫助每個人!
感謝上帝賜給我們的一切: 我們的房子, 我們的生命, 最重要的是我們的家人!

Sky Chief says it ain't his or hers,
Napalm sticks to zeds.

Zeds all banging on a house,
Might just be after one mouse,
Crying bad into her blouse,
Napalm sticks to zeds.

Catch some cars rolling all around,
Those ain't our boots down on the ground,
Drop about fifteen-thousand pounds,
Napalm sticks to zeds.

Doing good for doing bad,
Ain't nothing about it sad,
Think at all and you'll go mad,
Napalm sticks to zeds.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_76_Content.ch:
我們炸慢的, 炸快的, 炸死的,
盡全力把他們染成紅色,
然後在床上吃早餐,
凝固汽油彈黏殭屍.

飛得低又一臉兇相,
飛行員喝的是汽油,
灑點油料把現場燒光,
凝固汽油彈黏殭屍.

看到那邊那棟農舍沒,
看我用照明彈標記它,
血和內臟噴得到處都是,
凝固汽油彈黏殭屍.

看到幾個行屍但不太確定,
說不定他們是倖存者,
天空酋長說那不是他的人也不是她的人,
凝固汽油彈黏殭屍.

殭屍全在敲一棟房子,
說不定只是在追一隻老鼠,
她哭得淚濕了上衣,
凝固汽油彈黏殭屍.

逮到幾輛車在四處亂跑,
地上那些不是我們的弟兄,
丟下大約一萬五千磅,
凝固汽油彈黏殭屍.

做壞事也算做好事,
這沒什麼好難過的,
只要去想你就會發瘋,
凝固汽油彈黏殭屍.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_76_Content.cn:
我们炸慢的, 炸快的, 炸死的,
尽全力把他们染成红色,
然后在床上吃早餐,
凝固汽油弹粘僵尸.

飞得低又一脸凶相,
飞行员喝的是汽油,
洒点油料把现场烧光,
凝固汽油弹粘僵尸.

看到那边那栋农舍没,
看我用照明弹标记它,
血和内脏喷得到处都是,
凝固汽油弹粘僵尸.

看到几个行尸但不太确定,
说不定他们是幸存者,
天空酋长说那不是他的人也不是她的人,
凝固汽油弹粘僵尸.

僵尸全在敲一栋房子,
说不定只是在追一只老鼠,
她哭得泪湿了上衣,
凝固汽油弹粘僵尸.

逮到几辆车在四处乱跑,
地上那些不是我们的弟兄,
丢下大约一万五千磅,
凝固汽油弹粘僵尸.

做坏事也算做好事,
这没什么好难过的,
只要去想你就会发疯,
凝固汽油弹粘僵尸.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_77_Content.en: Looters aren't going to come for us, Jenny. What the heck would they even want here? Markers and hole punchers? If it even gets that bad, the idiots who go out looting want expensive stuff, or stuff they can use. 32-inch TVs and CD changers and guns and stuff. We've got staplers and paperclips. Don't think we're going to get held up any time soon. If you're really worried, we can talk about changing the schedule tomorrow when I come in, OK? See you then.\nDan
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_77_Content.ch: 珍妮, 搶劫的人不會找上我們的. 他們到底會想要這裡的什麼? 麥克筆和打孔機嗎? 就算情況真的糟到那種地步, 那些出去搶劫的白痴要的是值錢的東西, 或是用得上的東西. 32 吋電視, CD 換片機, 槍之類的. 我們這裡只有釘書機和迴紋針. 我不覺得短時間內會有人來搶我們. 如果妳真的很擔心, 明天我進來的時候我們可以談談調整班表, 好嗎? 到時見.\n丹
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_77_Content.cn: 珍妮, 抢劫的人不会找上我们的. 他们到底会想要这里的什么? 记号笔和打孔机吗? 就算情况真的糟到那种地步, 那些出去抢劫的白痴要的是值钱的东西, 或者用得上的东西. 32 英寸电视, CD 换碟机, 枪之类的. 我们这里只有订书机和回形针. 我不觉得短时间内会有人来抢我们. 如果你真的很担心, 明天我来上班的时候我们可以谈谈调整排班, 好吗? 到时见.\n丹

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_7_Content.en:
A month and week passed... In the evening summer as I was drinking to forget the reality I can't forget about that day on how it take his life forever, away from my life. It got me thinking and pushed myself to find him once again, it was the Riverside church... went back there and it was quiet and beautiful as usual apart from a wall of blood that I painted red.

That day, we fled out of the church and went into one of the houses, he was holding the door but then it broke down before... they mauled him alive, I could only run away and don't look back. Now I am here again in the house where I last saw him, there is a pile of blood, guts, and flesh all around but no sign of him but a trail of blood that leads to the backyard of the house. I followed the trail as what've his remains started to appear more and more and eventually, his hand with still a wedding ring on it... the same one as mine, as I was looking down at it I heard weird knocking sounds behind a woods and hoping to myself that it would be him and when I see it... I can't believe my own eyes.

It was my husband, Jim. With his half, the bottom of his body from his stomach was torn off, both of his hands as well, and one missing eyeball. Still in that black suit like on that wedding day, bloodied and muddied... beyond recognizable but I know it is him.
I- I can't hold myself back from this and not breaks into tears and collapse down, looking at him as he tried to reach out for me to take a bite but he was in a bad shape that he can't even crawl to me.
In the end, I finished him and set him free from this pain... for ever.

I brought what's left of his body back afterward to a proper burial, now his grave won't be empty anymore...
I've found you.

After the burial that night, I even dreamed about him, about the world without the infection where we live happily but it was just a fantasy...
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_7_Content.ch:
一個月又一週過去了… 夏日的傍晚, 我喝著酒想忘掉現實, 卻忘不了那天它是怎麼永遠奪走了他的生命, 把他從我的生命中帶走. 這讓我開始思考, 也逼著自己再去找他一次. 那是河畔的教堂… 我回到那裡, 一如往常安靜又美麗, 除了那面被我染紅的血牆.

那天, 我們逃出教堂, 躲進其中一棟房子. 他擋著門, 但門還是在… 之前就被撞壞了, 他們活生生地撕咬他, 我只能逃跑, 不敢回頭. 現在我又回到最後一次見到他的那棟房子, 四周都是一灘灘的血, 內臟和碎肉, 卻沒有他的蹤影, 只有一道血跡通往房子的後院. 我沿著血跡走, 他的殘骸越來越多, 最後是他的手, 上面還戴著結婚戒指… 跟我手上的一模一樣. 我低頭看著它的時候, 聽到樹林後面傳來奇怪的敲擊聲, 心裡暗自希望那會是他, 而當我看到的時候… 我簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛.

是我的丈夫, 吉姆. 他只剩一半, 從肚子以下的下半身被扯掉了, 兩隻手也是, 還少了一顆眼球. 他還穿著那套黑西裝, 就像婚禮那天一樣, 滿身是血和泥… 已經面目全非, 但我知道那就是他.
我- 我再也忍不住, 崩潰大哭, 癱倒在地, 看著他想伸手抓我咬上一口, 但他的狀況糟到連爬向我都做不到.
最後, 我了結了他, 讓他從這份痛苦中解脫… 永遠.

之後我把他剩下的遺體帶回去好好安葬, 現在他的墳墓不會再是空的了…
我找到你了.

那晚安葬完之後, 我甚至夢到了他, 夢到一個沒有感染的世界, 我們在那裡幸福地生活, 但那只是幻想…

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_83_Content.en: I knew it, and nobody believed me. I told them all this would come. I didn't know what it would be, but I could sense it in the air. Ever since the commies gave up, I've known it was only a matter of time for something else to come along. Another joke on us. Something else to fight, something else to kill. And here it is. Inside us. Turning us on each other. Making US into THEM. Well I'm not going that way. I'm on my own road, I'm at the wheel of this life. I've got everything I need right here, and I'm going to need it all to get where I'm going. Anyone finds this, good luck to you if you're a red-blooded American survivor, but if you're one of them, Johnson Dukakis says f!ck you.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_83_Content.ch: 我就知道, 可是沒人相信我. 我早就告訴過他們這一天會來. 我不知道會是什麼, 但我能在空氣中感覺到. 自從那些共產黨認輸之後, 我就知道遲早會有別的東西冒出來. 又一個拿我們開的玩笑. 又一個要對抗的東西, 又一個要殺的東西. 現在它來了. 就在我們體內. 讓我們自相殘殺. 把我們變成他們. 哼, 我才不要走上那條路. 我走我自己的路, 這條命的方向盤握在我手上. 我需要的一切都在這裡了, 而我要全部用上才能到達我要去的地方. 誰找到這個, 如果你是個熱血的美國倖存者, 祝你好運, 但如果你是他們的一員, 強森·杜卡基斯送你一句: 去你X的.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_83_Content.cn: 我就知道, 可是没人相信我. 我早就告诉过他们这一天会来. 我不知道会是什么, 但我能在空气中感觉到. 自从那些共产党认输之后, 我就知道迟早会有别的东西冒出来. 又一个拿我们开的玩笑. 又一个要对抗的东西, 又一个要杀的东西. 现在它来了. 就在我们体内. 让我们自相残杀. 把我们变成他们. 哼, 我才不要走上那条路. 我走我自己的路, 这条命的方向盘握在我手上. 我需要的一切都在这里了, 而我要全部用上才能到达我要去的地方. 谁找到这个, 如果你是个热血的美国幸存者, 祝你好运, 但如果你是他们的一员, 约翰逊·杜卡基斯送你一句: 去你X的.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_88_Content.en:
THE TRUTH OF THE MATTER
I, Mandy Potemkin, am going to kill all of my coworkers and then myself on 7/8/93. I do not intend to do this out of hatred for them, as they are my friends and have done no wrong but what they have been forced to, as I will now. I am not of unsound mind and do not do this out of something as foolish as momentary passion or as worthless as monetary debt. No, I do this to prove to the world the truth of the matter, that we are all victims of a system and government which do not care for us. Our lives have such little worth to our capitalist and authoritarian rulers that we might as well be mindless drones, marching ever onwards, only consuming, never creating. But I believe by killing myself and my friends, I may not only save us from suffering any longer into this worthless future, but too damage the machinations of our seemingly untouchable overlords and prove to others like us that we can make a difference if only we act and react with haste and with force. This is the truth of the matter, that violence must be done.

I plan to enact my plan first by:
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_88_Content.ch:
事情的真相
我, 曼蒂·波坦金, 將在 93 年 7 月 8 日殺死我所有的同事, 然後自殺. 我這麼做並不是因為恨他們, 他們是我的朋友, 除了被迫去做的事之外沒有做錯任何事, 就像我現在一樣. 我神智清楚, 也不是出於一時衝動這種愚蠢的理由, 或是金錢債務這種毫無價值的理由. 不, 我這麼做是為了向世界證明事情的真相: 我們都是一個不在乎我們的體制與政府的受害者. 我們的生命對那些資本主義與威權主義的統治者來說如此微不足道, 我們跟沒有思想的工蜂也沒什麼兩樣, 永遠向前行進, 只會消耗, 從不創造. 但我相信, 藉由殺死自己和我的朋友, 我不只能讓我們免於在這毫無價值的未來中繼續受苦, 還能破壞那些看似無法撼動的霸主們的陰謀, 並向其他和我們一樣的人證明, 只要我們迅速而有力地行動與回應, 就能帶來改變. 這就是事情的真相: 暴力勢在必行.

我打算首先透過以下方式執行我的計畫:

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_8_Content.en:
3 Months later... How long can I keep going? I ask myself this question every dawn and sunset as I am uncertain about the current life I am having. I woke up, I go kill those rotten walking corpses, I live and repeat. It seems like I have no goals in my life but to keep living for him that... Does it still worth it? Do I make him proud of me? Or I should be the one who's up there instead... Maybe I died on the same day as you on our wedding day just so I can see and you stay with me forever. 

I am not sure but I started to hear some voices lately, but it was just me and no one else. Was that your voice calling me when I don't wanna keep going? Was that you that always calm me down when I want to end my own life?
*Am I going insane?*

The feelings of anxiety and loneliness are slowly breaking through the cracks like poison in my bone. Sometimes I am not sure which sounds is real anymore... but his voice always comforts me and it keeps me going, although how can I keep going like this?
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_8_Content.ch:
3 個月後… 我還能撐多久? 每天日出和日落時我都這樣問自己, 因為我對現在的生活感到茫然. 我醒來, 去殺那些腐爛的行屍, 活下去, 然後重複. 我的人生好像沒有任何目標, 只剩為了他繼續活下去… 這樣還值得嗎? 我有讓他以我為傲嗎? 還是說, 該在天上的人應該是我才對… 也許我在我們婚禮那天就跟你一起死了, 只為了能看見你, 讓你永遠留在我身邊. 

我不確定, 但最近我開始聽到一些聲音, 可是明明只有我一個人, 沒有別人. 在我不想再撐下去的時候呼喚我的, 是你的聲音嗎? 在我想結束自己生命時總能讓我平靜下來的, 是你嗎?
*我要瘋了嗎?*

焦慮和孤獨的感覺正慢慢從裂縫中滲進來, 就像骨子裡的毒. 有時候我已經分不清哪些聲音是真的了… 但他的聲音總是安慰著我, 讓我繼續走下去, 可是我又能這樣撐多久呢?
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_8_Content.cn:
3 个月后… 我还能撑多久? 每天日出和日落时我都这样问自己, 因为我对现在的生活感到茫然. 我醒来, 去杀那些腐烂的行尸, 活下去, 然后重复. 我的人生好像没有任何目标, 只剩为了他继续活下去… 这样还值得吗? 我有让他以我为傲吗? 还是说, 该在天上的人应该是我才对… 也许我在我们婚礼那天就跟你一起死了, 只为了能看见你, 让你永远留在我身边. 

我不确定, 但最近我开始听到一些声音, 可是明明只有我一个人, 没有别人. 在我不想再撑下去的时候呼唤我的, 是你的声音吗? 在我想结束自己生命时总能让我平静下来的, 是你吗?
*我要疯了吗?*

焦虑和孤独的感觉正慢慢从裂缝中渗进来, 就像骨子里的毒. 有时候我已经分不清哪些声音是真的了… 但他的声音总是安慰着我, 让我继续走下去, 可是我又能这样撑多久呢?

Don't eat any of this stuff unless you want them to hear your colon exploding and come swarm you as the salmon takes its revenge. I know it looks good, but you're worth more than a bite of sushi. Try the river if you're really hurting for some fish and shrimp. Might see you there. Good luck.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_90_Content.ch: 想自殺有更好的方法. 別吃這裡的任何東西, 除非你想讓他們聽到你的結腸爆炸的聲音, 然後在鮭魚展開復仇的時候蜂擁而上. 我知道看起來很好吃, 但你的命比一口壽司值錢. 如果你真的很想吃魚和蝦, 去河邊試試吧. 說不定會在那裡遇到你. 祝好運.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_90_Content.cn: 想自杀有更好的方法. 别吃这里的任何东西, 除非你想让他们听到你的结肠爆炸的声音, 然后在三文鱼展开复仇的时候蜂拥而上. 我知道看起来很好吃, 但你的命比一口寿司值钱. 如果你真的很想吃鱼和虾, 去河边试试吧. 说不定会在那里遇到你. 祝好运.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_91_Content.en: Chris, we are NOT going to JPG! Even if we could get across the bridges (because not all of us can swim, Chris!) into Indiana, do you know how crazy it is to try to get into ANY military base? You should just try walking right into Fort Knox! I get that JPG seemed all nice and peaceful when we went there as kids, but this isn't a field trip, and nobody (not even the soldiers) know where not to step in that place to not get blown into tiny chunks. Hell, the entire range might be freaking radioactive! Listen, dude, we just need to find somewhere quiet to wait this whole thing out, and it doesn't need to be 100 miles away in an old bomb test site, alright? We're over at Michelle's if you want to hang out, but leave this at home, OK? Love you.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_91_Content.ch: 克里斯, 我們才不要去 JPG! 就算我們過得了橋 (因為不是每個人都會游泳, 克里斯!) 進到印第安納州, 你知道要闖進任何一座軍事基地有多瘋狂嗎? 你乾脆直接走進諾克斯堡算了! 我懂, 我們小時候去 JPG 的時候那裡看起來很美好又平靜, 但這不是校外教學, 而且沒有人 (連軍人也不例外) 知道在那裡哪些地方不能踩, 才不會被炸成碎片. 該死, 整個靶場說不定都有輻射! 聽著, 老兄, 我們只需要找個安靜的地方等這一切過去, 不需要跑到 100 英里外的舊炸彈試驗場, 好嗎? 想來找我們的話, 我們在蜜雪兒家, 但這個想法就留在家裡吧, 好嗎? 愛你.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_91_Content.cn: 克里斯, 我们才不要去 JPG! 就算我们过得了桥 (因为不是每个人都会游泳, 克里斯!) 进到印第安纳州, 你知道要闯进任何一座军事基地有多疯狂吗? 你干脆直接走进诺克斯堡算了! 我懂, 我们小时候去 JPG 的时候那里看起来很美好又平静, 但这不是春游, 而且没有人 (连军人也不例外) 知道在那里哪些地方不能踩, 才不会被炸成碎片. 该死, 整个靶场说不定都有辐射! 听着, 哥们, 我们只需要找个安静的地方等这一切过去, 不需要跑到 100 英里外的旧炸弹试验场, 好吗? 想来找我们的话, 我们在米歇尔家, 但这个想法就留在家里吧, 好吗? 爱你.

UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_92_Content.en: A farmer looked over his crops and saw they were wilting for there had been no rain for a week. He went to the hill and asked of the highest powers to bring rain so that those who depended on him would not know hunger. And the rains came and stayed for two weeks, tearing down an immense oak which grew over the farmer's home and smashed it all. He again went to the hill and cursed the rain, demanding for it to stop. And so the rain stopped and returned the sun, endless and blazing, for two months, burning the farmer's crop and stripping the whole land of life. He returned to the hill and with parched lips begged only for shade. And the sunset arrived only for sunrise to never come, leaving the world dark. Unable to see, the farmer could not find the hill again, and so all creation was plunged into lifeless darkness forever.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_92_Content.ch: 一位農夫望著他的莊稼, 發現它們因為整整一週沒下雨而枯萎了. 他走上山丘, 向至高的力量祈求降雨, 好讓那些依靠他的人不至於挨餓. 於是雨來了, 一下就是兩週, 沖倒了一棵長在農夫家上方的巨大橡樹, 把他的家整個壓垮. 他又走上山丘咒罵這場雨, 要它停下. 於是雨停了, 太陽重新出現, 無止無盡, 炙熱灼人, 持續了兩個月, 燒毀了農夫的莊稼, 也奪走了整片大地的生機. 他回到山丘上, 用乾裂的嘴唇只求一片陰涼. 於是夕陽落下, 旭日卻再也沒有升起, 世界從此陷入黑暗. 農夫什麼也看不見, 再也找不到那座山丘, 於是萬物從此永遠墜入了毫無生機的黑暗之中.
UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_92_Content.cn: 一位农夫看着他的庄稼, 发现它们因为整整一周没下雨而枯萎了. 他走上山丘, 向至高的力量祈求降雨, 好让那些依靠他的人不至于挨饿. 于是雨来了, 一下就是两周, 冲倒了一棵长在农夫家上方的巨大橡树, 把他的家整个压垮. 他又走上山丘咒骂这场雨, 要它停下. 于是雨停了, 太阳重新出现, 无止无尽, 炽热灼人, 持续了两个月, 烧毁了农夫的庄稼, 也夺走了整片大地的生机. 他回到山丘上, 用干裂的嘴唇只求一片阴凉. 于是夕阳落下, 旭日却再也没有升起, 世界从此陷入黑暗. 农夫什么也看不见, 再也找不到那座山丘, 于是万物从此永远坠入了毫无生机的黑暗之中.
