UI_profdesc_specialops_breacher.en: Shock trooper. Closes distance hard, knocks zombies down on the charge, shrugs off pain.
UI_profdesc_specialops_breacher.ch: 突擊兵. 猛力拉近距離, 衝鋒時能撞倒殭屍, 無視疼痛.
UI_profdesc_specialops_breacher.cn: 突击兵. 猛力拉近距离, 冲锋时能撞倒僵尸, 无视疼痛.

UI_profdesc_specialops_demoengineer.en: Explosives, field repairs, and tactical electronics. Targeted breach charges, jury-rig fixes, radios, and controlled-entry tools.
UI_profdesc_specialops_demoengineer.ch: 炸藥、戰地維修與戰術電子設備. 定向破門炸藥、臨時修理、無線電與受控突入工具.
UI_profdesc_specialops_demoengineer.cn: 炸药、战地维修与战术电子设备. 定向破门炸药、临时修理、无线电与受控突入工具.

UI_profdesc_specialops_marksman.en: Precision overwatch. Aiming talent beyond skill caps — faster aim settle, first-shot lethality, and rock-steady focus.
UI_profdesc_specialops_marksman.ch: 精準掩護射擊. 超越技能上限的瞄準天賦 — 更快穩定準星、首發致命, 專注力堅如磐石.
UI_profdesc_specialops_marksman.cn: 精准掩护射击. 超越技能上限的瞄准天赋 — 更快稳定准星、首发致命, 专注力坚如磐石.

UI_profdesc_specialops_medic.en: Battlefield doctor. Stabilizes nearby wounded allies with a fast, supply-driven Field Triage action and keeps them calm under pressure.
UI_profdesc_specialops_medic.ch: 戰場醫生. 以快速且消耗物資的戰地檢傷穩定附近受傷隊友的傷勢, 並讓他們在壓力下保持冷靜.
UI_profdesc_specialops_medic.cn: 战场医生. 以快速且消耗物资的战地检伤稳定附近受伤队友的伤势, 并让他们在压力下保持冷静.

UI_profdesc_specialops_rifleman.en: Elite gunfighter. Stacked training starts near the vanilla firearm skill caps. Shoots while moving, moves faster, and firearms weigh much less.
UI_profdesc_specialops_rifleman.ch: 精英槍手. 疊加訓練讓起始等級接近原版槍械技能上限. 可邊移動邊射擊、移動更快, 槍械重量大幅減輕.
UI_profdesc_specialops_rifleman.cn: 精英枪手. 叠加训练让起始等级接近原版枪械技能上限. 可边移动边射击、移动更快, 枪械重量大幅减轻.

UI_profdesc_specialops_scoutghost.en: Recon specialist. Silent steps, night cloak, and scout sense that marks nearby threats while you stay unseen.
UI_profdesc_specialops_scoutghost.ch: 偵察專家. 無聲腳步、夜間隱匿, 以及在你保持隱蔽時標示附近威脅的偵察感知.
UI_profdesc_specialops_scoutghost.cn: 侦察专家. 无声脚步、夜间隐匿, 以及在你保持隐蔽时标示附近威胁的侦察感知.

UI_profdesc_specialops_squadleader.en: Commands the detachment. High Aiming/Reloading and a non-stacking squad aura that calms nearby allies and reduces new incoming Endurance loss.
UI_profdesc_specialops_squadleader.ch: 指揮整支分隊. 高瞄準/裝填等級, 以及不可疊加的小隊光環, 能安撫附近隊友並減少新承受的耐力消耗.
UI_profdesc_specialops_squadleader.cn: 指挥整支分队. 高瞄准/装填等级, 以及不可叠加的小队光环, 能安抚附近队友并减少新承受的耐力消耗.

UI_trait_specialops_adrenalinesurge_Desc.en: At 40% Endurance or lower near a zombie, gain 25% extra Endurance-loss resistance for 45 seconds. 5-minute cooldown.
UI_trait_specialops_adrenalinesurge_Desc.ch: 耐力在 40%% 以下且靠近殭屍時, 獲得額外 25%% 耐力消耗抗性, 持續 45 秒. 冷卻 5 分鐘.
UI_trait_specialops_adrenalinesurge_Desc.cn: 耐力在 40%% 以下且靠近僵尸时, 获得额外 25%% 耐力消耗抗性, 持续 45 秒. 冷却 5 分钟.

UI_trait_specialops_ballisticgenius_Desc.en: Gifted shooter. While aiming and standing still, your sights settle much faster than normal.
UI_trait_specialops_ballisticgenius_Desc.ch: 天生神射手. 站定瞄準時, 準星穩定的速度比一般快上許多.
UI_trait_specialops_ballisticgenius_Desc.cn: 天生神射手. 站定瞄准时, 准星稳定的速度比一般快上许多.

UI_trait_specialops_bloodlust_Desc.en: A qualifying nearby kill restores 15% Endurance only. 2-minute cooldown; only the nearest eligible operator benefits.
UI_trait_specialops_bloodlust_Desc.ch: 在附近完成符合條件的擊殺時只恢復 15%% 耐力. 冷卻 2 分鐘; 只有最近的符合條件幹員受益.
UI_trait_specialops_bloodlust_Desc.cn: 在附近完成符合条件的击杀时只恢复 15%% 耐力. 冷却 2 分钟; 只有最近的符合条件干员受益.

UI_trait_specialops_breachercharge_Desc.en: Shock entry. Sprinting into zombies can knock them down.
UI_trait_specialops_breachercharge_Desc.ch: 衝擊突入. 衝刺撞向殭屍可將其撞倒.
UI_trait_specialops_breachercharge_Desc.cn: 冲击突入. 冲刺撞向僵尸可将其撞倒.

UI_trait_specialops_closequarters_Desc.ch: +2 斧頭, +2 短刀, +2 長棍.
UI_trait_specialops_closequarters_Desc.cn: +2 斧头, +2 短刀, +2 长棍.

UI_trait_specialops_combathardened_Desc.en: Desensitized muscle memory. Panic and fear are heavily suppressed in danger.
UI_trait_specialops_combathardened_Desc.ch: 麻木的肌肉記憶. 身處危險時恐慌與恐懼會大幅受到抑制.
UI_trait_specialops_combathardened_Desc.cn: 麻木的肌肉记忆. 身处危险时恐慌和恐惧会大幅受到抑制.

UI_trait_specialops_combatmobility_Desc.en: Faster combat movement. While moving under an active zombie threat, new Endurance loss is reduced; it does not restore Endurance or remove Fatigue.
UI_trait_specialops_combatmobility_Desc.ch: 戰鬥移動更快. 在殭屍威脅下移動時, 新承受的耐力消耗降低; 不會恢復耐力或消除疲勞.
UI_trait_specialops_combatmobility_Desc.cn: 战斗移动更快. 在僵尸威胁下移动时, 新承受的耐力消耗降低; 不会恢复耐力或消除疲劳.

UI_trait_specialops_combattriage_Desc.en: Unlocks supply-driven Field Triage for nearby wounded allies. Your presence suppresses panic, but never passively heals wounds or infection.
UI_trait_specialops_combattriage_Desc.ch: 解鎖消耗物資的戰地檢傷, 可用於附近受傷的隊友. 你的存在能抑制恐慌, 但絕不會被動治療傷口或感染.
UI_trait_specialops_combattriage_Desc.cn: 解锁消耗物资的战地检伤, 可用于附近受伤的队友. 你的存在能抑制恐慌, 但绝不会被动治疗伤口或感染.

UI_trait_specialops_commandpresence_Desc.en: Leadership under fire. Nearby allies gain panic suppression and bounded resistance to new incoming Endurance loss; it never restores Endurance or health.
UI_trait_specialops_commandpresence_Desc.ch: 炮火下的領導力. 附近隊友獲得恐慌抑制與有上限的新承受耐力消耗抗性; 絕不會恢復耐力或生命.
UI_trait_specialops_commandpresence_Desc.cn: 炮火下的领导力. 附近队友获得恐慌抑制与有上限的新承受耐力消耗抗性; 绝不会恢复耐力或生命.

UI_trait_specialops_conditioning_Desc.ch: +2 體格, +2 力量, +2 衝刺.
UI_trait_specialops_conditioning_Desc.cn: +2 体格, +2 力量, +2 冲刺.

UI_trait_specialops_controlleddemo_Desc.en: Knows flame bombs, timers, and targeted SOS charges that breach doors and windows without a wide-area blast.
UI_trait_specialops_controlleddemo_Desc.ch: 懂得製作火焰炸彈、計時器, 以及能炸開門窗且不會造成大範圍爆炸的定向 SOS 炸藥.
UI_trait_specialops_controlleddemo_Desc.cn: 懂得制作火焰炸弹、定时器, 以及能炸开门窗且不会造成大范围爆炸的定向 SOS 炸药.

UI_trait_specialops_deadeye_Desc.en: Precision under stress. Reduced panic while aiming and sharper long-range focus.
UI_trait_specialops_deadeye_Desc.ch: 壓力下依然精準. 瞄準時恐慌降低, 遠距離專注力更敏銳.
UI_trait_specialops_deadeye_Desc.cn: 压力下依然精准. 瞄准时恐慌降低, 远距离专注力更敏锐.

UI_trait_specialops_demolitions_Desc.en: Trained in charges, wiring, and field repairs. Strong technical foundation.
UI_trait_specialops_demolitions_Desc.ch: 受過炸藥、配線與戰地維修訓練. 擁有紮實的技術基礎.
UI_trait_specialops_demolitions_Desc.cn: 受过炸药、接线与战地维修训练. 拥有扎实的技术基础.

UI_trait_specialops_demolitionsspec_Desc.en: +3 Electrical and stronger field engineering instincts.
UI_trait_specialops_demolitionsspec_Desc.ch: +3 電工, 以及更強的戰地工程直覺.
UI_trait_specialops_demolitionsspec_Desc.cn: +3 电工, 以及更强的战地工程直觉.

UI_trait_specialops_fieldbreaching_Desc.en: Knows pipe bombs, noise makers, smoke, aerosol charges, and cheaper SOS field-expedient versions.
UI_trait_specialops_fieldbreaching_Desc.ch: 懂得製作鋼管炸彈、噪音製造器、煙霧彈、噴霧罐炸藥, 以及更便宜的 SOS 戰地簡易版本.
UI_trait_specialops_fieldbreaching_Desc.cn: 懂得制作土制炸弹、噪音发生器、烟雾弹、喷雾罐炸药, 以及更便宜的 SOS 战地简易版本.

UI_trait_specialops_fieldmedic_Desc.en: Advanced First Aid training without passive wound healing or infection reduction.
UI_trait_specialops_fieldmedic_Desc.ch: 進階急救訓練, 但不含被動傷口治療或降低感染.
UI_trait_specialops_fieldmedic_Desc.cn: 进阶急救训练, 但不含被动伤口治疗或降低感染.

UI_trait_specialops_fieldsurgeon_Desc.en: +3 First Aid and advanced trauma readiness.
UI_trait_specialops_fieldsurgeon_Desc.ch: +3 急救, 以及進階創傷處置準備.
UI_trait_specialops_fieldsurgeon_Desc.cn: +3 急救, 以及进阶创伤处置准备.

UI_trait_specialops_ghostprotocol_Desc.en: Silent movement discipline. Greatly reduced chance to attract attention while sneaking.
UI_trait_specialops_ghostprotocol_Desc.ch: 無聲移動紀律. 潛行時引起注意的機率大幅降低.
UI_trait_specialops_ghostprotocol_Desc.cn: 无声移动纪律. 潜行时引起注意的几率大幅降低.

UI_trait_specialops_gunfighter_Desc.en: Fire on the move with faster aim settle, less strain, better combat movement, and much lighter firearms.
UI_trait_specialops_gunfighter_Desc.ch: 可邊移動邊射擊, 準星穩定更快、負擔更少、戰鬥移動更佳, 槍械也輕上許多.
UI_trait_specialops_gunfighter_Desc.cn: 可边移动边射击, 准星稳定更快、负担更少、战斗移动更佳, 枪械也轻上许多.

UI_trait_specialops_ironwill_Desc.en: Unbreakable mindset. Unhappiness and boredom drain far slower.
UI_trait_specialops_ironwill_Desc.ch: 不屈不撓的心態. 不快樂與無聊的累積速度大幅減緩.
UI_trait_specialops_ironwill_Desc.cn: 不屈不挠的心态. 不开心和无聊的累积速度大幅减缓.

UI_trait_specialops_juryrig_Desc.en: Knows SOS Field Repair and Advanced Field Repair — use them on damaged weapons and tools to restore condition with scrap and tape.
UI_trait_specialops_juryrig_Desc.ch: 懂得 SOS 戰地維修與進階戰地維修 — 可用廢料與膠帶修理受損的武器與工具, 恢復耐久度.
UI_trait_specialops_juryrig_Desc.cn: 懂得 SOS 战地维修与进阶战地维修 — 可用废料和胶带修理受损的武器和工具, 恢复耐久度.

UI_trait_specialops_lightweapons_Desc.en: Firearms in your inventory weigh significantly less, so you can carry more guns and ammo.
UI_trait_specialops_lightweapons_Desc.ch: 物品欄中的槍械重量大幅減輕, 讓你能攜帶更多槍枝與彈藥.
UI_trait_specialops_lightweapons_Desc.cn: 物品栏中的枪械重量大幅减轻, 让你能携带更多枪支和弹药.

UI_trait_specialops_loadoutassault_Desc.en: Start with a shotgun, shells, and a sledgehammer.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutassault_Desc.ch: 開局攜帶霰彈槍、霰彈與大鎚.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutassault_Desc.cn: 开局携带霰弹枪、霰弹和大锤.

UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcarbine_Desc.en: Start with an assault rifle, magazines, and basic combat kit.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcarbine_Desc.ch: 開局攜帶突擊步槍、彈匣與基本戰鬥裝備.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcarbine_Desc.cn: 开局携带突击步枪、弹匣和基本战斗装备.

UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcovert_Desc.en: Start with a suppressed-style pistol kit, knife, and stealth gear.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcovert_Desc.ch: 開局攜帶消音風格手槍套組、刀子與潛行裝備.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcovert_Desc.cn: 开局携带消音风格手枪套装、刀具和潜行装备.

UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcqc.ch: 初始配置: 近身戰鬥
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcqc.cn: 初始配置: 近身战斗

UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcqc_Desc.en: Start with a pistol, melee weapons, and close-quarters kit.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcqc_Desc.ch: 開局攜帶手槍、近戰武器與近身戰鬥裝備.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutcqc_Desc.cn: 开局携带手枪、近战武器和近身战斗装备.

UI_trait_specialops_loadoutheavy_Desc.en: Start with an assault rifle, lots of ammo, and heavy provisions.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutheavy_Desc.ch: 開局攜帶突擊步槍、大量彈藥與充足補給.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutheavy_Desc.cn: 开局携带突击步枪、大量弹药和充足补给.

UI_trait_specialops_loadoutmarksman.ch: 初始配置: 精確射手
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutmarksman.cn: 初始配置: 精确射手

UI_trait_specialops_loadoutmarksman_Desc.en: Start with a hunting rifle, ammo, and overwatch kit.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutmarksman_Desc.ch: 開局攜帶獵槍、彈藥與掩護射擊裝備.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutmarksman_Desc.cn: 开局携带猎枪、弹药和掩护射击装备.

UI_trait_specialops_loadoutparatrooper_D.en: Start with a carbine kit, rope, bag, and drop-zone survival gear.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutparatrooper_D.ch: 開局攜帶卡賓槍套組、繩子、背包與空降區生存裝備.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutparatrooper_D.cn: 开局携带卡宾枪套装、绳子、背包和空降区生存装备.

UI_trait_specialops_loadoutsupport_Desc.en: Start with medical supplies, food, water, and utility gear.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutsupport_Desc.ch: 開局攜帶醫療物資、食物、水與實用裝備.
UI_trait_specialops_loadoutsupport_Desc.cn: 开局携带医疗物资、食物、水和实用装备.

UI_trait_specialops_nightops_Desc.en: Comfortable in the dark. Much less panic at night.
UI_trait_specialops_nightops_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中自在無比. 夜間恐慌大幅降低.
UI_trait_specialops_nightops_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中自在无比. 夜间恐慌大幅降低.

UI_trait_specialops_oneshotdoctrine_Desc.en: After you settle your aim, the first firearm hit hits much harder and can stagger the target. Re-aim to ready the next killing shot.
UI_trait_specialops_oneshotdoctrine_Desc.ch: 穩定瞄準後, 第一發槍械命中的威力大幅提升, 並可能使目標踉蹌. 重新瞄準即可準備下一發致命射擊.
UI_trait_specialops_oneshotdoctrine_Desc.cn: 稳定瞄准后, 第一发枪械命中的威力大幅提升, 并可能使目标踉跄. 重新瞄准即可准备下一发致命射击.

UI_trait_specialops_operator_Desc.en: Years of black-ops deployments. Strong baseline combat fitness, weapons handling, and a base carry capacity of 20 before Strength and condition modifiers. Starts with an armorer manual for suppressors and laser modules.
UI_trait_specialops_operator_Desc.ch: 多年黑色行動部署經驗. 擁有紮實的基礎戰鬥體能與武器操作能力, 在力量與狀態修正前的基礎負重為 20. 開局攜帶一本記載消音器與雷射模組的軍械士手冊.
UI_trait_specialops_operator_Desc.cn: 多年黑色行动部署经验. 拥有扎实的基础战斗体能与武器操作能力, 在力量与状态修正前的基础负重为 20. 开局携带一本记载消音器与激光模块的军械师手册.

UI_trait_specialops_painkiller_Desc.en: Adds strong, capped pain and strain resistance. Injuries and existing pain still require treatment.
UI_trait_specialops_painkiller_Desc.ch: 提供強大但有上限的疼痛與負擔抗性. 傷勢與既有疼痛仍需治療.
UI_trait_specialops_painkiller_Desc.cn: 提供强大但有上限的疼痛与负担抗性. 伤势与已有疼痛仍需治疗.

UI_trait_specialops_pathfinder_Desc.ch: +2 輕巧, +2 潛行, +2 靈活.
UI_trait_specialops_pathfinder_Desc.cn: +2 轻巧, +2 潜行, +2 灵活.

UI_trait_specialops_quickdraw_Desc.en: Faster weapon handling instincts. Better Aiming and Reloading foundation.
UI_trait_specialops_quickdraw_Desc.ch: 武器操作直覺更快. 擁有更好的瞄準與裝填基礎.
UI_trait_specialops_quickdraw_Desc.cn: 武器操作直觉更快. 拥有更好的瞄准与装填基础.

UI_trait_specialops_runngun_Desc.en: Fire on the move. Aim settles much faster while moving, and panic/fatigue build slower. Crosshair still blooms a bit vs standing still (vanilla), but far less than a normal shooter.
UI_trait_specialops_runngun_Desc.ch: 邊移動邊射擊. 移動時準星穩定速度大幅提升, 恐慌/疲勞累積較慢. 與站定時相比準星仍會略微擴散 (原版機制), 但遠少於一般射手.
UI_trait_specialops_runngun_Desc.cn: 边移动边射击. 移动时准星稳定速度大幅提升, 恐慌/疲劳积累较慢. 与站定时相比准星仍会略微扩散 (原版机制), 但远少于一般射手.

UI_trait_specialops_scoutsense_Desc.en: While sneaking (and enabled), nearby zombies pulse as green HUD pins and edge arrows for about 1–2 seconds — including contacts behind you and through walls. Toggle with N (Options → Key Bindings) or the world context menu.
UI_trait_specialops_scoutsense_Desc.ch: 潛行時 (且已啟用), 附近的殭屍會以綠色 HUD 標記與畫面邊緣箭頭閃現約 1–2 秒 — 包括你身後及牆後的目標. 可按 N 切換 (選項 → 按鍵設定) 或使用世界右鍵選單.
UI_trait_specialops_scoutsense_Desc.cn: 潜行时 (且已启用), 附近的僵尸会以绿色 HUD 标记与屏幕边缘箭头闪现约 1–2 秒 — 包括你身后及墙后的目标. 可按 N 切换 (选项 → 按键设置) 或使用世界右键菜单.

UI_trait_specialops_secondwind_Desc.en: At 20% Endurance or lower, restore 30% Endurance. 10-minute cooldown; recovery scales with sandbox settings.
UI_trait_specialops_secondwind_Desc.ch: 耐力在 20%% 以下時恢復 30%% 耐力. 冷卻 10 分鐘; 恢復量依沙盒設定調整.
UI_trait_specialops_secondwind_Desc.cn: 耐力在 20%% 以下时恢复 30%% 耐力. 冷却 10 分钟; 恢复量依沙盒设置调整.

UI_trait_specialops_shadowcloak_Desc.en: At night while sneaking, your ghost effect is stronger — zombies forget you across a wider radius.
UI_trait_specialops_shadowcloak_Desc.ch: 夜間潛行時, 你的幽靈效果更強 — 殭屍會在更大範圍內遺忘你.
UI_trait_specialops_shadowcloak_Desc.cn: 夜间潜行时, 你的幽灵效果更强 — 僵尸会在更大范围内遗忘你.

UI_trait_specialops_shadowops_Desc.ch: +3 潛行, +2 輕巧, +1 瞄準.
UI_trait_specialops_shadowops_Desc.cn: +3 潜行, +2 轻巧, +1 瞄准.

UI_trait_specialops_silentstep_Desc.en: While sneaking, nearby zombies lose interest more easily and struggle to keep a lock on you.
UI_trait_specialops_silentstep_Desc.ch: 潛行時, 附近的殭屍更容易失去興趣, 也難以持續鎖定你.
UI_trait_specialops_silentstep_Desc.cn: 潜行时, 附近的僵尸更容易失去兴趣, 也难以持续锁定你.

UI_trait_specialops_squadaura_Desc.en: Active command radius. Nearby allies gain strong panic suppression and non-stacking resistance to new incoming Endurance loss; it never restores Endurance or health.
UI_trait_specialops_squadaura_Desc.ch: 主動指揮範圍. 附近的盟友獲得強力的恐慌抑制, 以及對新受到的耐力流失的不疊加抗性; 它永遠不會恢復耐力或生命值.
UI_trait_specialops_squadaura_Desc.cn: 主动指挥范围. 附近的盟友获得强力的恐慌抑制, 以及对新受到的耐力流失的不叠加抗性; 它永远不会恢复耐力或生命值.

UI_trait_specialops_steadyhands_Desc.en: Rock-solid aiming discipline that suppresses panic while aiming without removing fatigue.
UI_trait_specialops_steadyhands_Desc.ch: 堅如磐石的瞄準紀律, 能在瞄準時抑制恐慌, 但不會消除疲勞.
UI_trait_specialops_steadyhands_Desc.cn: 坚如磐石的瞄准纪律, 能在瞄准时抑制恐慌, 但不会消除疲劳.

UI_trait_specialops_stimulantprotocol_De.en: Additional First Aid and fitness training for sustained field operations.
UI_trait_specialops_stimulantprotocol_De.ch: 額外的急救與體能訓練, 以應付持久的野戰行動.
UI_trait_specialops_stimulantprotocol_De.cn: 额外的急救与体能训练, 以应对持久的野外作战.

UI_trait_specialops_survivalexpert_Desc.ch: +3 搜尋, +3 耕作, +3 誘捕.
UI_trait_specialops_survivalexpert_Desc.cn: +3 搜寻, +3 耕作, +3 诱捕.

UI_trait_specialops_tacticalawareness_De.en: Situational mastery. Panic spikes are crushed; you stay composed in chaos.
UI_trait_specialops_tacticalawareness_De.ch: 精通臨場應變. 恐慌飆升會被壓下; 你在混亂中仍能保持鎮定.
UI_trait_specialops_tacticalawareness_De.cn: 精通临场应变. 恐慌飙升会被压下; 你在混乱中仍能保持镇定.

UI_trait_specialops_tacticalelectronics_.en: Knows generators, makeshift radios, remote triggers, timers, and improvised lights.
UI_trait_specialops_tacticalelectronics_.ch: 熟悉發電機、簡易無線電、遙控引爆器、計時器與簡易照明.
UI_trait_specialops_tacticalelectronics_.cn: 熟悉发电机、简易无线电、遥控引爆器、定时器与简易照明.

UI_trait_specialops_traumaresponse_Desc.en: Additional First Aid training for recognizing and responding to battlefield trauma.
UI_trait_specialops_traumaresponse_Desc.ch: 額外的急救訓練, 用於辨識並處理戰場創傷.
UI_trait_specialops_traumaresponse_Desc.cn: 额外的急救训练, 用于识别并处理战场创伤.

UI_trait_specialops_unstoppable_Desc.en: At 35 health or lower, restore 35% Endurance only. 12-minute cooldown; recovery scales with sandbox settings.
UI_trait_specialops_unstoppable_Desc.ch: 生命值降至 35 或以下時, 僅恢復 35%% 耐力. 冷卻時間 12 分鐘; 恢復量依沙盒設定調整.
UI_trait_specialops_unstoppable_Desc.cn: 生命值降至 35 或以下时, 仅恢复 35%% 耐力. 冷却时间 12 分钟; 恢复量随沙盒设置调整.

UI_trait_specialops_warhero_Desc.en: +2 Aiming, +2 Reloading, +2 Sprinting from prior deployments.
UI_trait_specialops_warhero_Desc.ch: +2 瞄準, +2 裝填, +2 衝刺, 來自先前的部署經歷.
UI_trait_specialops_warhero_Desc.cn: +2 瞄准, +2 装填, +2 冲刺, 来自以往的部署经历.

UI_KA_ADMIN_DESTROYED.ch: NPC 實例與屍體已銷毀
UI_KA_ADMIN_DESTROYED.cn: NPC 实例与尸体已销毁

UI_KA_ADMIN_STORE_ERROR.ch: 無法初始化 NPC 儲存空間
UI_KA_ADMIN_STORE_ERROR.cn: 无法初始化 NPC 存储

UI_KCNPC_NOT_PERMITTED.en: This NPC does not allow that order.
UI_KCNPC_NOT_PERMITTED.ch: 此 NPC 不接受該命令.
UI_KCNPC_NOT_PERMITTED.cn: 此 NPC 不接受该命令.

UI_KCNPC_ROUTE_REQUIRED.en: There is no known route HOME. First record the route by having the NPC follow you from HOME.
UI_KCNPC_ROUTE_REQUIRED.ch: 沒有已知的回家路線. 請先讓 NPC 從家裡跟隨你, 以記錄路線.
UI_KCNPC_ROUTE_REQUIRED.cn: 没有已知的回家路线. 请先让 NPC 从家里跟随你, 以记录路线.

UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_AMOUNT_EXC.en: The amount exceeds the available balance or the destination capacity.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_AMOUNT_EXC.ch: 金額超過可用餘額或目的地容量.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_AMOUNT_EXC.cn: 金额超过可用余额或目标容量.

UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_EMPTY.en: You are not carrying any wallets or cards.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_EMPTY.ch: 你身上沒有任何錢包或卡片.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_EMPTY.cn: 你身上没有任何钱包或卡片.

UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_NO_DESTINA.en: You need another wallet or card to transfer money.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_NO_DESTINA.ch: 你需要另一個錢包或卡片才能轉帳.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_NO_DESTINA.cn: 你需要另一个钱包或卡片才能转账.

UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_SELECT_HEL.en: Select the source on the left and the destination on the right. The primary account is shown in yellow.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_SELECT_HEL.ch: 在左側選擇來源, 在右側選擇目的地. 主要帳戶以黃色顯示.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_MONEY_MANAGER_SELECT_HEL.cn: 在左侧选择来源, 在右侧选择目标. 主账户以黄色显示.

UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CAPACITY.en: The destination wallet cannot hold the entire balance. No money has been transferred.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CAPACITY.ch: 目的地錢包無法容納全部餘額. 未轉出任何金錢.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CAPACITY.cn: 目标钱包无法容纳全部余额. 未转出任何钱款.

UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CONSOLIDATE.en: Gather balances into the active wallet
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CONSOLIDATE.ch: 將餘額集中到使用中的錢包
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CONSOLIDATE.cn: 将余额集中到当前钱包

UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CONSOLIDATED.ch: 已從 {count} 個錢包轉出 ${amount} 到 {name}.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CONSOLIDATED.cn: 已从 {count} 个钱包转出 ${amount} 到 {name}.

UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CONSOLIDATE_PREVI.en: Destination: {name}. Transfer ${amount} from {count} wallets. Empty wallets are kept; cards are not included.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CONSOLIDATE_PREVI.ch: 目的地: {name}. 從 {count} 個錢包轉出 ${amount}. 空錢包會保留; 不包含卡片.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CONSOLIDATE_PREVI.cn: 目标: {name}. 从 {count} 个钱包转出 ${amount}. 空钱包会保留; 不包含卡片.

UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CONSOLIDATE_UNAVA.en: You need an active wallet and a balance in other wallets in your inventory.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CONSOLIDATE_UNAVA.ch: 物品欄中需要有一個使用中的錢包, 且其他錢包內有餘額.
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_CONSOLIDATE_UNAVA.cn: 物品栏中需要有一个当前钱包, 且其他钱包中有余额.

UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_RENAME_PROMPT.en: Wallet or card name (leave blank to restore the original):
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_RENAME_PROMPT.ch: 錢包或卡片名稱 (留空以還原原名):
UI_KCTRADERS_UI_WALLET_RENAME_PROMPT.cn: 钱包或卡片名称 (留空以恢复原名):

UI_equipment_options_reset_layout_toolti.en: Dock the equipment panel back onto the inventory and open it again. Use this if the panel stopped following your inventory. Only does anything in game.
UI_equipment_options_reset_layout_toolti.ch: 將裝備面板重新停靠回物品欄並再次開啟. 若面板不再跟隨物品欄, 請使用此選項. 僅在遊戲中有效.
UI_equipment_options_reset_layout_toolti.cn: 将装备面板重新停靠回物品栏并再次打开. 如果面板不再跟随物品栏, 请使用此选项. 仅在游戏中有效.

UI_options_QoLC_BiggerAvatar_Desc.en: Enlarges the 3D character model on the in game info panel.
UI_options_QoLC_BiggerAvatar_Desc.ch: 放大遊戲內資訊面板上的 3D 角色模型.
UI_options_QoLC_BiggerAvatar_Desc.cn: 放大游戏内信息面板上的 3D 角色模型.

UI_options_QoLC_BiggerAvatar_Enabled_too.en: Turn off to restore the vanilla avatar size. Takes effect immediately.
UI_options_QoLC_BiggerAvatar_Enabled_too.ch: 關閉即可恢復原版頭像大小. 立即生效.
UI_options_QoLC_BiggerAvatar_Enabled_too.cn: 关闭即可恢复原版头像大小. 立即生效.

UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Accessible_too.en: Takes the healthy and danger colors from the 'Good' and 'Bad' highlight colors on the game's Accessibility page, with the warning color halfway between. Off uses green, amber and red.
UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Accessible_too.ch: 健康色與危險色取自遊戲「輔助功能」頁面中的「正面」與「負面」突顯顏色, 警告色則取兩者中間. 關閉時使用綠色, 琥珀色和紅色.
UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Accessible_too.cn: 健康色与危险色取自游戏“辅助功能”页面中的良好显示颜色与低劣显示颜色, 警告色则取两者中间. 关闭时使用绿色, 琥珀色和红色.

UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Desc.en: Shows how worn a weapon or tool is, without hovering it. Turns itself off if a mod that draws its own condition, such as Clean HotBar, is installed.
UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Desc.ch: 不必將滑鼠移到上面, 即可顯示武器或工具的磨損程度. 若安裝了自行繪製耐久度的 MOD (例如 Clean HotBar), 此功能會自動關閉.
UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Desc.cn: 无需将鼠标悬停其上, 即可显示武器或工具的磨损程度. 若安装了自行绘制耐久度的模组 (例如 Clean HotBar), 此功能会自动关闭.

UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Enabled_toolti.en: Draws a bar under each equipped weapon and each item on the hotbar, changing color under half and again under a quarter.
UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Enabled_toolti.ch: 在每把已裝備的武器與快捷欄上的每個物品下方繪製一條耐久度條, 低於一半時變色, 低於四分之一時再次變色.
UI_options_QoLC_Condition_Enabled_toolti.cn: 在每把已装备的武器与快捷栏上的每个物品下方绘制一条耐久度条, 低于一半时变色, 低于四分之一时再次变色.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_AmmoIcons_toolt.en: Gives each ammo box and magazine its own icon. Takes effect after a restart.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_AmmoIcons_toolt.ch: 讓每種彈藥盒與彈匣都有自己的圖示. 重新啟動後生效.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_AmmoIcons_toolt.cn: 让每种弹药盒与弹匣都有自己的图标. 重启后生效.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_BookIcons_toolt.en: Gives all twenty four skill book families their own icon. Takes effect after a restart.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_BookIcons_toolt.ch: 讓全部二十四個技能書系列都有自己的圖示. 重新啟動後生效.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_BookIcons_toolt.cn: 让全部二十四个技能书系列都有自己的图标. 重启后生效.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_Capacity_toolti.en: Stops a container's name running into the weight printed beside it.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Capacity_toolti.ch: 避免容器名稱與旁邊顯示的重量重疊.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Capacity_toolti.cn: 避免容器名称与旁边显示的重量重叠.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_Desc.en: Turn individual features on or off. Features with settings of their own have their switch in their own section below.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Desc.ch: 個別開啟或關閉各項功能. 有自身設定的功能, 其開關位於下方各自的區塊中.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Desc.cn: 单独开启或关闭各项功能. 有自身设置的功能, 其开关位于下方各自的分区中.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_FlagBook_toolti.en: Reads the first page of a book that is still too advanced, so a second copy is recognisable later.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_FlagBook_toolti.ch: 閱讀仍太艱深之書籍的第一頁, 以便之後認出另一本相同的書.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_FlagBook_toolti.cn: 阅读仍过于深奥的书籍的第一页, 以便之后认出另一本相同的书.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_Flashlight_tool.en: Hang a torch off either belt slot, the way a screwdriver or a walkie talkie already can. Attaching one does not switch it on. Takes effect on the next start.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Flashlight_tool.ch: 可將手電筒掛在任一側腰帶欄位, 就像螺絲起子或對講機原本就能做到的一樣. 掛上時不會自動開啟. 下次啟動遊戲後生效.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Flashlight_tool.cn: 可将手电筒挂在任一侧腰带槽位, 就像螺丝刀或对讲机原本就能做到的那样. 挂上时不会自动打开. 下次启动游戏后生效.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_FoodCategories_.en: Separates food that spoils from food that keeps in the inventory. Takes effect after a restart.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_FoodCategories_.ch: 在物品欄中將易腐壞的食物與耐存放的食物分開. 重新啟動後生效.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_FoodCategories_.cn: 在物品栏中将易腐烂的食物与耐储的食物分开. 重启后生效.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_Generator_toolt.en: Adds how long the fuel lasts to the generator window, and highlights the squares it powers.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Generator_toolt.ch: 在發電機視窗中加入燃料可持續的時間, 並標示其供電的格子.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Generator_toolt.cn: 在发电机窗口中加入燃料可持续的时间, 并高亮显示其供电的格子.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_Hotbar_tooltip.en: Drag hotbar slots into the order you want, and click a slot to use it. Off restores the vanilla hotbar.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Hotbar_tooltip.ch: 將快捷欄格位拖曳成你想要的順序, 點選格位即可使用. 關閉時恢復原版快捷欄.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Hotbar_tooltip.cn: 将快捷栏槽位拖动成你想要的顺序, 点击槽位即可使用. 关闭时恢复原版快捷栏.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_Material_toolti.en: Adds what a garment is made of to its tooltip, colored by fabric.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Material_toolti.ch: 在衣物的說明提示中加入其材質, 並依布料上色.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_Material_toolti.cn: 在衣物的提示信息中加入其材质, 并按布料着色.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_MoodleQuarters_.en: Squares off one more quarter of a moodle's plate for each level it climbs, so the stack reads at a glance. Stands down on its own if Moodle Quarters or Moodles in Lua is installed, since both replace the same panel.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_MoodleQuarters_.ch: 狀態圖示每升一級, 就將其底板再框出四分之一, 讓整列狀態一眼就能看懂. 若已安裝 Moodle Quarters 或 Moodles in Lua, 此功能會自動停用, 因為兩者都會取代同一個面板.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_MoodleQuarters_.cn: 状态图标每升一级, 就将其底板再框出四分之一, 让整列状态一眼就能看懂. 若已安装 Moodle Quarters 或 Moodles in Lua, 此功能会自动停用, 因为两者都会替换同一个面板.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_TakeAmount_tool.en: Adds a typed amount to the grab menu, alongside vanilla's one, half and all.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_TakeAmount_tool.ch: 在拿取選單中加入可自行輸入的數量, 與原版的一個, 一半和全部並列.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_TakeAmount_tool.cn: 在拿取菜单中加入可自行输入的数量, 与原版的一个, 一半和全部并列.

UI_options_QoLC_Features_XpView_tooltip.en: The skills panel says what a boost is really worth. Off restores the vanilla percentages, which understate it.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_XpView_tooltip.ch: 技能面板會顯示加成的實際效果. 關閉時恢復原版的百分比顯示, 但它會低估加成.
UI_options_QoLC_Features_XpView_tooltip.cn: 技能面板会显示加成的实际效果. 关闭时恢复原版的百分比显示, 但它会低估加成.

UI_options_QoLC_Overlays_Desc.en: Full-screen tints that react to your moodles.
UI_options_QoLC_Overlays_Desc.ch: 會隨你的狀態變化的全螢幕色調.
UI_options_QoLC_Overlays_Desc.cn: 会随你的状态变化的全屏色调.

UI_options_QoLC_Overlays_Enabled_tooltip.en: Turn off every moodle overlay. Each overlay still has its own strength slider below.
UI_options_QoLC_Overlays_Enabled_tooltip.ch: 關閉即可停用所有狀態覆蓋效果. 每種覆蓋效果在下方仍有各自的強度滑桿.
UI_options_QoLC_Overlays_Enabled_tooltip.cn: 关闭即可停用所有状态覆盖效果. 每种覆盖效果在下方仍有各自的强度滑块.

UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Desc.en: Sort a container's duplicates by condition, how full they are, or what they are worth eating.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Desc.ch: 依耐久度, 剩餘量或食用價值, 排序容器中的重複物品.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Desc.cn: 按耐久度, 剩余量或食用价值, 排序容器中的重复物品.

UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Enabled_tooltip.en: Adds the sort options to a container's right click menu. Off removes them and leaves the two settings below with nothing to do.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Enabled_tooltip.ch: 在容器的右鍵選單中加入排序選項. 關閉時會移除這些選項, 下方兩項設定也將失去作用.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Enabled_tooltip.cn: 在容器的右键菜单中加入排序选项. 关闭时会移除这些选项, 下方两项设置也将失去作用.

UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Extras_tooltip.en: Adds two more ways to sort clothing and weapons, at the cost of a longer menu.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Extras_tooltip.ch: 為衣物與武器新增兩種排序方式, 代價是選單變長.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Extras_tooltip.cn: 为衣物与武器新增两种排序方式, 代价是菜单变长.

UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Speak_tooltip.en: The character mentions it rather than walking over to do nothing.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Speak_tooltip.ch: 角色會直接說出來, 而不是白走過去什麼也沒做.
UI_options_QoLC_Reorder_Speak_tooltip.cn: 角色会直接说出来, 而不是白走过去什么也没做.

UI_FurniturePushPull_AttachedObjectUnsaf.en: Remove or detach the object on top before moving this furniture.
UI_FurniturePushPull_AttachedObjectUnsaf.ch: 移動這件家具前, 請先移除或拆下上方的物品.
UI_FurniturePushPull_AttachedObjectUnsaf.cn: 移动此家具前, 请先移除或拆下上方的物品.

UI_LPP_Tooltip_RopeInBag.en: Your rope is in a bag. Move it to your main inventory.
UI_LPP_Tooltip_RopeInBag.ch: 你的繩索在背包裡. 請將它移到主物品欄.
UI_LPP_Tooltip_RopeInBag.cn: 你的绳索在背包里. 请将它移到主物品栏.

UI_LPP_Tooltip_WeaponInBag.en: Your weapon is in a bag. Move it to your main inventory.
UI_LPP_Tooltip_WeaponInBag.ch: 你的武器在背包裡. 請將它移到主物品欄.
UI_LPP_Tooltip_WeaponInBag.cn: 你的武器在背包里. 请将它移到主物品栏.

UI_TAS_Grid_DragHint.en: Drag a trait onto a level range of a spectrum to customize it.
UI_TAS_Grid_DragHint.ch: 將特質拖曳到譜系的等級區間上以進行自訂.
UI_TAS_Grid_DragHint.cn: 将特质拖到谱系的等级区间上以进行自定义.

UI_TAS_ShortSightedNoteGained.en: Short-sightedness gained from low level: it gets removed when you level up.
UI_TAS_ShortSightedNoteGained.ch: 低等級階段獲得的近視: 升級後會被移除.
UI_TAS_ShortSightedNoteGained.cn: 低等级阶段获得的近视: 升级后会被移除.

UI_TAS_ShortSightedNoteInitial.en: Initial short-sightedness: this trait never gets removed.
UI_TAS_ShortSightedNoteInitial.ch: 初始近視: 該特質永遠不會被移除.
UI_TAS_ShortSightedNoteInitial.cn: 初始近视: 该特质永远不会被移除.

UI_TAS_Action_notsad.en: Being in a good mood (not sad)

UI_BloodlustO:death-rampage:start:1.en: It is so over... for you.

UI_BloodlustO:death-rampage:start:2.en: You all are going down with me...
UI_BloodlustO:death-rampage:start:2.ch: 你們全都要跟我一起陪葬…
UI_BloodlustO:death-rampage:start:2.cn: 你们全都要跟我一起陪葬…

UI_trait_bloodlusto:bloodlusto_Desc.en: Your desire to kill is insatiable, and it only gets worse as you shower in blood of your enemies, having the time of your life.
UI_trait_bloodlusto:bloodlusto_Desc.ch: 你的殺戮慾望永不滿足, 而且當你沐浴在敵人的鮮血中、享受人生最美好的時光時, 它只會越來越強烈.
UI_trait_bloodlusto:bloodlusto_Desc.cn: 你的杀戮欲望永不满足, 而且当你沐浴在敌人的鲜血中、享受人生最美好的时光时, 它只会越来越强烈.

UI_Hands_doubleClickGrab_tt.en: Toggle double-click functionality. Incompatible with Grab and Drop.
UI_Hands_doubleClickGrab_tt.ch: 切換雙擊功能. 與 Grab and Drop 不相容.
UI_Hands_doubleClickGrab_tt.cn: 切换双击功能. 与Grab and Drop不兼容.

UI_Hands_secondaryFirst_tt.en: Stow and Place deals with the off-hand first when on.
UI_Hands_secondaryFirst_tt.ch: 開啟時, 收納與放置會優先處理副手.
UI_Hands_secondaryFirst_tt.cn: 开启时, 收纳与放置会优先处理副手.

UI_Hands_southpaw_tt.en: Swap LMB and RMB handedness (LMB is primary by default)
UI_Hands_southpaw_tt.ch: 交換滑鼠左鍵與右鍵的對應手 (預設左鍵為主手)
UI_Hands_southpaw_tt.cn: 交换鼠标左键与右键的对应手 (默认左键为主手)

UI_Hands_useAltClick_tt.en: Toggle between Alt+Mouse or a rebindable keypress.
UI_Hands_useAltClick_tt.ch: 在 Alt+滑鼠與可重新設定的按鍵之間切換.
UI_Hands_useAltClick_tt.cn: 在Alt+鼠标与可重新绑定的按键之间切换.

UI_optionscreen_binding_Drop Equipped Ba.en: Drop bags on your back or in your hands
UI_optionscreen_binding_Drop Equipped Ba.ch: 丟下背上或手中的包包

UI_EPR_Volume_tooltip.en: Volume of every sound the mod plays: startup and shutdown, repair work, alarms, blackouts and the facility hum.
UI_EPR_Volume_tooltip.ch: 此模組播放的所有音效的音量: 啟動與關機、維修作業、警報、停電以及設施運轉聲.
UI_EPR_Volume_tooltip.cn: 此模组播放的所有音效的音量: 启动与关机、维修作业、警报、停电以及设施运转声.

UI_EPR_WaterDisabled.en: Water restoration is disabled in sandbox settings.
UI_EPR_WaterDisabled.ch: 沙盒設定中已停用恢復供水.
UI_EPR_WaterDisabled.cn: 沙盒设置中已禁用恢复供水.

UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_BytecodeBloodCap.en: Directly patches IsoGridSquare.splatBlood in JVM bytecode to instantly return if a tile already has blood. Completely eliminates chunk FBO texture rebinding stalls in high-kill combats.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_BytecodeBloodCap.ch: 直接在 JVM 位元組碼中修補 IsoGridSquare.splatBlood, 若地塊已有血跡便立即返回. 徹底消除高擊殺量戰鬥中區塊 FBO 材質重新繫結造成的卡頓.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_BytecodeBloodCap.cn: 直接在JVM字节码中修补IsoGridSquare.splatBlood, 若地块已有血迹则立即返回. 彻底消除高击杀量战斗中区块FBO纹理重新绑定造成的卡顿.

UI_ModOptions_JVM_BytecodeBloodCap.en: Bytecode Blood Overdraw Cap (Zero FBO Staleness)
UI_ModOptions_JVM_BytecodeBloodCap.ch: 位元組碼血跡過度繪製上限 (零 FBO 過期)
UI_ModOptions_JVM_BytecodeBloodCap.cn: 字节码血迹过度绘制上限 (零FBO过期)

UI_MPOptim_CustomPresetsHeader.ch: [*] 自訂使用者預設設定檔

UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_ChunkCacheSize.en: Number of world chunks retained in RAM cache for instant zero-lag road streaming.
UI_MPOptim_Tooltip_JVM_ChunkCacheSize.ch: 保留在 RAM 快取中的世界區塊數量, 讓道路串流即時零延遲.

UI_MarkXI_ENGINEERING_RESET_WARNING.en:
Use this function only for a critical freeze, broken animation, texture, or Mark XI system state.

If the suit is worn, its runtime is fully reset. If the suit is parked, the bound mannequin and any stranded bound components nearby are reconstructed after 3 seconds. Saved durability and power state are preserved where recoverable.

This recovery tool can repair older broken saves, but perfect restoration cannot be guaranteed in every mod-conflict scenario.
UI_MarkXI_ENGINEERING_RESET_WARNING.ch:
僅在嚴重卡死、動畫或貼圖損壞, 或 Mark XI 系統狀態異常時使用此功能.

若戰甲正穿在身上, 其執行狀態會完全重設. 若戰甲處於停放狀態, 綁定的人體模型與附近任何遺落的綁定部件會在 3 秒後重建. 可復原的已儲存耐久度與電力狀態會被保留.

此復原工具可修復舊版的損壞存檔, 但無法保證在所有 MOD 衝突情況下都能完美復原.
UI_MarkXI_ENGINEERING_RESET_WARNING.cn:
仅在严重卡死、动画或贴图损坏, 或 Mark XI 系统状态异常时使用此功能.

若战甲正穿在身上, 其运行状态会完全重置. 若战甲处于停放状态, 绑定的人体模型与附近任何遗落的绑定部件会在 3 秒后重建. 可恢复的已保存耐久度与电力状态会被保留.

此恢复工具可修复旧版的损坏存档, 但无法保证在所有 MOD 冲突情况下都能完美恢复.

UI_MarkXI_MP_WARNING_TEXT.en:
Mark XI Suit is developed primarily for single-player.

Because of the way Project Zomboid multiplayer works, and because the suit contains a large number of interconnected systems and components, multiplayer support is currently in beta.

Bugs and errors may occur in multiplayer, including critical issues that can affect your equipment, the suit state, or the safety of your character.

The mod author continues to work on multiplayer updates and fixes, but fully stable operation of the suit in multiplayer cannot currently be guaranteed.

Use the suit in multiplayer at your own risk.
UI_MarkXI_MP_WARNING_TEXT.ch:
Mark XI 戰甲主要為單人遊戲開發.

由於《殭屍毀滅工程》多人遊戲的運作方式, 加上戰甲包含大量相互關聯的系統與元件, 多人遊戲支援目前仍處於測試階段.

多人遊戲中可能出現錯誤與異常, 包括可能影響你的裝備、戰甲狀態或角色安全的嚴重問題.

MOD 作者會持續進行多人遊戲的更新與修正, 但目前無法保證戰甲在多人遊戲中完全穩定運作.

在多人遊戲中使用戰甲, 風險自負.
UI_MarkXI_MP_WARNING_TEXT.cn:
Mark XI 战甲主要为单人游戏开发.

由于《僵尸毁灭工程》多人游戏的运作方式, 加上战甲包含大量相互关联的系统与组件, 多人游戏支持目前仍处于测试阶段.

多人游戏中可能出现错误与异常, 包括可能影响你的装备、战甲状态或角色安全的严重问题.

MOD 作者会持续进行多人游戏的更新与修复, 但目前无法保证战甲在多人游戏中完全稳定运行.

在多人游戏中使用战甲, 风险自负.

UI_profdesc_MarkXI_Philanthropist.en: A wealthy engineer and inventor who solves problems with technology. Exceptionally skilled with electronics and capable with automotive mechanics.

UI_ProjectExile_ForecastLockedTooltip.en: Uncheck and Apply to drag the forecast while wearing a Skyseer watch. Check again to lock it and let mouse clicks pass through. Its position is remembered on this computer.
UI_ProjectExile_ForecastLockedTooltip.ch: 取消勾選並套用後, 即可在配戴觀天者手錶時拖曳預報. 再次勾選可將其鎖定, 並讓滑鼠點選穿透. 位置會記錄在這台電腦上.
UI_ProjectExile_ForecastLockedTooltip.cn: 取消勾选并应用后, 即可在佩戴观天者手表时拖动预报. 再次勾选可将其锁定, 并让鼠标点击穿透. 位置会保存在这台电脑上.

UI_ProjectExile_ForecastResetTooltip.en: Immediately returns the forecast below the clock and speed controls, clearing your saved position.
UI_ProjectExile_ForecastResetTooltip.ch: 立即將預報移回時鐘與速度控制下方, 並清除已儲存的位置.
UI_ProjectExile_ForecastResetTooltip.cn: 立即将预报移回时钟与速度控制下方, 并清除已保存的位置.

UI_ProjectExile_HuntersInsightDragPrevie.en: Drag to move; aim to see target details.
UI_ProjectExile_HuntersInsightDragPrevie.ch: 拖曳以移動; 瞄準以檢視目標詳情.
UI_ProjectExile_HuntersInsightDragPrevie.cn: 拖动以移动; 瞄准以查看目标详情.

UI_ProjectExile_HuntersInsightLockedTool.en: Uncheck and Apply to drag the overlay while wearing Hunter's Insight eyewear. It stays visible without aiming while unlocked. Lock it again to show it only while aiming and let mouse clicks pass through.
UI_ProjectExile_HuntersInsightLockedTool.ch: 取消勾選並套用後, 即可在配戴獵人洞察眼鏡時拖曳覆蓋層. 解鎖期間即使不瞄準也會顯示. 再次鎖定後只會在瞄準時顯示, 並讓滑鼠點選穿透.
UI_ProjectExile_HuntersInsightLockedTool.cn: 取消勾选并应用后, 即可在佩戴猎人洞察眼镜时拖动覆盖层. 解锁期间即使不瞄准也会显示. 再次锁定后只会在瞄准时显示, 并让鼠标点击穿透.

UI_ProjectExile_HuntersInsightResetToolt.en: Immediately returns Hunter's Insight below the clock and speed controls. The forecast's position is unchanged.
UI_ProjectExile_HuntersInsightResetToolt.ch: 立即將獵人洞察移回時鐘與速度控制下方. 預報的位置不受影響.
UI_ProjectExile_HuntersInsightResetToolt.cn: 立即将猎人洞察移回时钟与速度控制下方. 预报的位置不受影响.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferChooseSource.en: Choose the blessed item to transfer from.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferChooseSource.cn: 选择要转出祝福的祝福物品.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferChooseTarget.en: Choose the unblessed item to receive its blessings.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferChooseTarget.ch: 選擇要接收祝福的無祝福物品.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferChooseTarget.cn: 选择要接收祝福的无祝福物品.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferCleanTarget.en: The receiving item must be unblessed.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferCleanTarget.ch: 接收的物品必須沒有祝福.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferCleanTarget.cn: 接收的物品必须没有祝福.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferCost.en: Consumes 1 Saint's Withered Finger on success.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferCost.ch: 成功時消耗 1 根聖徒的枯萎手指.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferCost.cn: 成功时消耗 1 根圣徒的枯萎手指.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferIncompatible.en: This item cannot receive every blessing on the source.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferIncompatible.ch: 此物品無法承載來源上的所有祝福.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferIncompatible.cn: 此物品无法承载来源上的所有祝福.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferKeepItems.en: Keep both items in your inventory.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferKeepItems.ch: 將兩件物品都留在物品欄中.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferKeepItems.cn: 将两件物品都留在物品栏中.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferNoSources.en: Carry an identified, unequipped blessed item.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferNoSources.ch: 攜帶一件已鑑定且未裝備的祝福物品.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferNoSources.cn: 携带一件已鉴定且未装备的祝福物品.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferOneItem.en: Select one item for each slot.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferOneItem.ch: 每個欄位各選擇一件物品.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferOneItem.cn: 每个槽位各选择一件物品.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferReady.en: Transfer all blessings from the source to the new item.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferReady.ch: 將來源的所有祝福轉移到新物品.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferReady.cn: 将来源的所有祝福转移到新物品.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferSameCategory.en: Choose an item in the same equipment category.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferSameCategory.ch: 選擇同一裝備類別的物品.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferSameCategory.cn: 选择同一装备类别的物品.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferSlotHint.en: Drag an item into each slot, or click to choose.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferSlotHint.ch: 將物品拖曳到各欄位, 或點選以選擇.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferSlotHint.cn: 将物品拖到各槽位, 或点击以选择.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferSourceRemains.en: Both items remain. The source becomes unblessed.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferSourceRemains.ch: 兩件物品都會保留. 來源物品將失去祝福.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferSourceRemains.cn: 两件物品都会保留. 来源物品将失去祝福.

UI_ProjectExile_TransferUnavailable.en: These items cannot be used for this transfer.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferUnavailable.ch: 這些物品無法用於此次轉移.
UI_ProjectExile_TransferUnavailable.cn: 这些物品无法用于此次转移.

UI_CoolSit_CompactMenu_tt.en: Put the lean entries inside the Cool Sit submenu, and calibration and presets under Cool Sit > Options.

UI_TLOS_CoveredOutdoorHighlights_Tooltip.ch: 醒目提示被露臺、門廊、加油站遮棚及遮陽篷頂遮蔽但確實可見的殭屍. 停用此項不影響建築、車輛或樓梯的醒目提示. 預設: 啟用.
UI_TLOS_CoveredOutdoorHighlights_Tooltip.cn: 高亮被露台、门廊、加油站顶棚及遮阳篷顶遮挡但确实可见的僵尸. 禁用此项不影响建筑、车辆或楼梯的高亮. 默认: 启用.

UI_CHB_CannotPlace.en: There is not enough free space for the boiler here.
UI_CHB_CannotPlace.ch: 這裡沒有足夠的空間放置鍋爐.
UI_CHB_CannotPlace.cn: 这里没有足够的空间放置锅炉.

UI_CHB_ConnectConflictNeedConfirm.en: Another boiler is already active here. Confirm the switch.
UI_CHB_ConnectConflictNeedConfirm.ch: 這裡已有另一座鍋爐在運作. 請確認切換.
UI_CHB_ConnectConflictNeedConfirm.cn: 这里已有另一座锅炉在运行. 请确认切换.

UI_CHB_ConnectInvalidBoiler.en: This boiler cannot be connected to the heating system.
UI_CHB_ConnectInvalidBoiler.ch: 這座鍋爐無法連接至暖氣系統.
UI_CHB_ConnectInvalidBoiler.cn: 这座锅炉无法连接到供暖系统.

UI_CHB_ConnectMustBeIndoors.en: Residential boilers must be placed inside a valid enclosed room before they can be connected to the heating system.
UI_CHB_ConnectMustBeIndoors.ch: 住宅鍋爐必須放在有效的封閉房間內, 才能連接至暖氣系統.
UI_CHB_ConnectMustBeIndoors.cn: 住宅锅炉必须放在有效的封闭房间内, 才能连接到供暖系统.

UI_CHB_ConnectNeedIndustrialManual.en: Read "Industrial Heating Systems: Technical Manual" before connecting an industrial boiler.
UI_CHB_ConnectNeedIndustrialManual.ch: 連接工業鍋爐前, 請先閱讀「工業暖氣系統: 技術手冊」.
UI_CHB_ConnectNeedIndustrialManual.cn: 连接工业锅炉前, 请先阅读“工业供暖系统: 技术手册”.

UI_CHB_ConnectNeedIndustrialSkills.en: Connecting an industrial boiler requires Electrical level 3 and Carpentry level 2.
UI_CHB_ConnectNeedIndustrialSkills.ch: 連接工業鍋爐需要電工等級3與木工等級2.
UI_CHB_ConnectNeedIndustrialSkills.cn: 连接工业锅炉需要电工等级3与木工等级2.

UI_CHB_ConnectNeedResidentialManual.en: Read "Home Heating: Boiler Installation & Maintenance" before connecting a residential boiler.
UI_CHB_ConnectNeedResidentialManual.ch: 連接住宅鍋爐前, 請先閱讀「家用暖氣: 鍋爐安裝與維護」.
UI_CHB_ConnectNeedResidentialManual.cn: 连接住宅锅炉前, 请先阅读“家庭供暖: 锅炉安装与维护”.

UI_CHB_ConnectNeedResidentialSkills.en: Connecting a residential boiler requires Electrical level 1.
UI_CHB_ConnectNeedResidentialSkills.ch: 連接住宅鍋爐需要電工等級1.
UI_CHB_ConnectNeedResidentialSkills.cn: 连接住宅锅炉需要电工等级1.

UI_CHB_ConnectReplaceConfirm.cn:

UI_CHB_DevDenied.en: Developer Mode is disabled or Add Item permission is missing.
UI_CHB_DevDenied.ch: 開發者模式已停用, 或缺少新增物品權限.
UI_CHB_DevDenied.cn: 开发者模式已禁用, 或缺少添加物品权限.

UI_CHB_DevSpawned.en: A boiler item and digital watch were added to inventory.
UI_CHB_DevSpawned.ch: 已將一個鍋爐物品與電子錶加入物品欄.
UI_CHB_DevSpawned.cn: 已将一个锅炉物品与电子表添加到物品栏.

UI_CHB_DismantleNeedsWrench.en: A wrench is required to dismantle the boiler.

UI_CHB_Dismantled.en: Boiler dismantled. Salvaged materials were left on the floor.
UI_CHB_Dismantled.ch: 鍋爐已拆解. 回收的材料留在地上.
UI_CHB_Dismantled.cn: 锅炉已拆解. 回收的材料留在地上.

UI_CHB_EnableResidentialSpawn_Tooltip.en: Allow the Home Boiler and Compact Boiler to appear in basements. Spawn is decided only when a player first enters the basement.
UI_CHB_EnableResidentialSpawn_Tooltip.ch: 允許家用鍋爐與小型鍋爐出現在地下室. 只在玩家首次進入地下室時決定是否生成.
UI_CHB_EnableResidentialSpawn_Tooltip.cn: 允许家用锅炉与小型锅炉出现在地下室. 只在玩家首次进入地下室时决定是否生成.

UI_CHB_EnableSystemAging_Tooltip.en: Gradually increases water consumption as the building heating system ages after the electricity shutoff. Year 1 has no penalty; year 10 and later uses 95 percent more water. Boiler repairs cannot remove this permanent system wear.
UI_CHB_EnableSystemAging_Tooltip.ch: 停電後, 隨著建築暖氣系統老化, 耗水量會逐漸增加. 第1年沒有懲罰; 第10年起耗水量增加百分之95. 修理鍋爐無法消除這種永久性的系統磨損.
UI_CHB_EnableSystemAging_Tooltip.cn: 停电后, 随着建筑供暖系统老化, 耗水量会逐渐增加. 第1年没有惩罚; 第10年起耗水量增加百分之95. 修理锅炉无法消除这种永久性的系统磨损.

UI_CHB_FootprintNotFound.en: Could not identify the full footprint of this boiler.
UI_CHB_FootprintNotFound.ch: 無法辨識這座鍋爐的完整佔地範圍.
UI_CHB_FootprintNotFound.cn: 无法识别这座锅炉的完整占地范围.

UI_CHB_InfoUnservedStructureMany.ch: {VALUE}座玩家建造的建築未獲供暖
UI_CHB_InfoUnservedStructureMany.cn: {VALUE}座玩家建造的建筑未获供暖

UI_CHB_InfoUnservedStructureOne.ch: {VALUE}座玩家建造的建築未獲供暖
UI_CHB_InfoUnservedStructureOne.cn: {VALUE}座玩家建造的建筑未获供暖

UI_CHB_Mode_Comfort_Tooltip.en: Low, nearly constant power use around refrigerator level. Outdoor temperature has only a minor effect on consumption.
UI_CHB_Mode_Comfort_Tooltip.ch: 低且近乎恆定的耗電, 約與冰箱相當. 室外溫度對耗電量影響很小.
UI_CHB_Mode_Comfort_Tooltip.cn: 低且近乎恒定的耗电, 约与冰箱相当. 室外温度对耗电量影响很小.

UI_CHB_Mode_Hardcore_Tooltip.en: Power use is close to real electric heating. In severe cold the boiler puts a very heavy load on a generator and requires frequent refuelling.
UI_CHB_Mode_Hardcore_Tooltip.ch: 耗電量接近真實電暖設備. 嚴寒時鍋爐會對發電機造成極大負載, 需要頻繁補充燃料.
UI_CHB_Mode_Hardcore_Tooltip.cn: 耗电量接近真实电暖设备. 严寒时锅炉会对发电机造成极大负载, 需要频繁补充燃料.

UI_CHB_Mode_Normal_Tooltip.en: Balanced heating with a noticeable fuel cost. Open exterior doors increase energy use, especially in severe cold.
UI_CHB_Mode_Normal_Tooltip.ch: 均衡的暖氣效果, 燃料消耗明顯. 敞開的外門會增加耗能, 嚴寒時尤其明顯.

UI_CHB_OptionsCompatibility_Tooltip.en: Experimental fallback for other mods that extend or replace the standard power grid. Use the separate LG Extended Electricity option for LG support. If CHB cannot directly detect normal grid power or a vanilla generator, this option allows a boiler to use electricity reported on its square by another mod. In multiplayer, the server Sandbox setting is authoritative. Fuel and load accounting for external power sources may differ from normal CHB operation.
UI_CHB_OptionsCompatibility_Tooltip.ch: 針對其他擴充或取代標準電網之模組的實驗性備援方案. 支援LG時請使用另外的LG Extended Electricity選項. 若CHB無法直接偵測到一般電網電力或原版發電機, 此選項允許鍋爐使用其他模組回報在其所在格子上的電力. 多人遊戲中以伺服器的沙盒設定為準. 外部電源的燃料與負載計算可能與CHB一般運作不同.
UI_CHB_OptionsCompatibility_Tooltip.cn: 针对其他扩展或替代标准电网之模组的实验性后备方案. 支持LG时请使用单独的LG Extended Electricity选项. 若CHB无法直接检测到普通电网电力或原版发电机, 此选项允许锅炉使用其他模组报告在其所在格子上的电力. 多人游戏中以服务器的沙盒设置为准. 外部电源的燃料与负载计算可能与CHB正常运行不同.

UI_CHB_OptionsLGExtendedElectricity_Tool.en: Enable compatibility with LG Extended Electricity. When enabled and LG Extended Electricity is active, CHB can use electricity delivered to the boiler square through LG's extended network. In multiplayer, the server Sandbox setting is authoritative. CHB does not add this external boiler load to LG generator fuel or breaker accounting.
UI_CHB_OptionsLGExtendedElectricity_Tool.ch: 啟用與LG Extended Electricity的相容性. 啟用且LG Extended Electricity正在運作時, CHB可使用透過LG擴充電網送達鍋爐所在格子的電力. 多人遊戲中以伺服器的沙盒設定為準. CHB不會將這項外部鍋爐負載計入LG發電機的燃料或斷路器計算.
UI_CHB_OptionsLGExtendedElectricity_Tool.cn: 启用与LG Extended Electricity的兼容性. 启用且LG Extended Electricity正在运行时, CHB可使用通过LG扩展电网送达锅炉所在格子的电力. 多人游戏中以服务器的沙盒设置为准. CHB不会将这项外部锅炉负载计入LG发电机的燃料或断路器计算.
