UI_DHCS_Flavor_Freezer.en: The sealed lid cuts the room down to darkness and breath.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Freezer.ch: 密封的蓋子把世界縮小成只剩黑暗和呼吸.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Freezer.cn: 密封的盖子把世界缩小成只剩黑暗和呼吸.

UI_DHCS_Flavor_HoldingBreath.en: Your chest tightens as you force every sound back down.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_HoldingBreath.ch: 你強壓下每一點聲音, 胸口愈發緊繃.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_HoldingBreath.cn: 你强压下每一点声音, 胸口愈发紧绷.

UI_DHCS_Flavor_Impact.en: The hiding place shudders under a real impact.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Impact.ch: 藏身處在一記重擊下劇烈晃動.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Impact.cn: 藏身处在一记重击下剧烈晃动.

UI_DHCS_Flavor_Locker.en: Cold metal presses in around you.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Locker.ch: 冰冷的金屬從四周壓迫著你.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Locker.cn: 冰冷的金属从四周压迫着你.

UI_DHCS_Flavor_Panic.en: Panic is taking over. Calm down or you will burst out.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Panic.ch: 恐慌正在吞噬你. 冷靜下來, 不然你會衝出去.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Panic.cn: 恐慌正在吞噬你. 冷静下来, 不然你会冲出去.

UI_DHCS_Flavor_Peeking.en: You ease the cover aside and risk a look.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Peeking.ch: 你輕輕推開遮蔽, 冒險往外看.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Peeking.cn: 你轻轻推开遮挡, 冒险往外看.

UI_DHCS_Flavor_Sleeping.en: You curl up as best you can and try not to move.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Sleeping.ch: 你盡可能蜷縮起來, 試著不要動.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Sleeping.cn: 你尽可能蜷缩起来, 试着不要动.

UI_DHCS_Flavor_Threatened.en: Footsteps and snarls are converging on your hiding place.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Threatened.ch: 腳步聲和低吼聲正朝你的藏身處逼近.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Threatened.cn: 脚步声和低吼声正朝你的藏身处逼近.

UI_DHCS_Flavor_Trash.en: The stale air is thick, and every small shift sounds too loud.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Trash.ch: 混濁的空氣十分沉悶, 每個細微的動作聽起來都太大聲.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Trash.cn: 浑浊的空气十分沉闷, 每个细微的动作听起来都太大声.

UI_DHCS_Flavor_Wardrobe.en: Clothes and old wood muffle the world outside.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Wardrobe.ch: 衣物和老木頭隔絕了外面的世界.
UI_DHCS_Flavor_Wardrobe.cn: 衣物和老木头隔绝了外面的世界.

UI_DHCS_InventoryFitNote.en: The inventory meter shows raw storage load; hiding uses compressed physical bulk.
UI_DHCS_InventoryFitNote.ch: 物品欄量表顯示的是原始的收納負載; 躲藏時採用的是壓縮後的實際體積.
UI_DHCS_InventoryFitNote.cn: 物品栏量表显示的是原始的收纳负载; 躲藏时采用的是压缩后的实际体积.

UI_DHCS_MustRemainStanding.en: You must remain standing while hidden here.
UI_DHCS_MustRemainStanding.ch: 躲在這裡時你必須保持站立.
UI_DHCS_MustRemainStanding.cn: 躲在这里时你必须保持站立.

UI_DHCS_NotEnoughRoomToSit.en: There is not enough room to sit inside this %1.
UI_DHCS_NotEnoughRoomToSit.ch: 這個%1裡沒有足夠的空間坐下.
UI_DHCS_NotEnoughRoomToSit.cn: 这个%1里没有足够的空间坐下.

UI_DHCS_Option_ShowPlayerSpotting.ch: 顯示發現玩家的彈出視窗

UI_DHCS_Option_ShowPlayerSpotting_Toolti.en: When checked, the spotting popup appears when you discover another player hiding. Uncheck it to hide only the popup. Spotting still works, the surprise sound still plays, and peeking is unchanged. While the popup is hidden, Get Over Here!/pull-out is unavailable for spotted players. Default: On.
UI_DHCS_Option_ShowPlayerSpotting_Toolti.ch: 勾選時, 你發現其他玩家躲藏時會出現發現彈出視窗. 取消勾選則只會隱藏彈出視窗. 發現機制仍會運作, 驚嚇音效仍會播放, 窺視也不受影響. 彈出視窗隱藏時, 無法對被發現的玩家使用「給我過來!」/拉出. 預設: 開啟.
UI_DHCS_Option_ShowPlayerSpotting_Toolti.cn: 勾选时, 你发现其他玩家躲藏时会出现发现弹窗. 取消勾选则只会隐藏弹窗. 发现机制仍会运作, 惊吓音效仍会播放, 窥视也不受影响. 弹窗隐藏时, 无法对被发现的玩家使用“给我过来!”/拉出. 默认: 开启.

UI_DHCS_Option_ShowStatusPanel_Tooltip.en: When checked, the status panel opens automatically when you enter a hiding place, provided the server-wide setting also allows it. Uncheck it to keep the panel closed on entry; you can still reopen it by right-clicking your occupied hiding place. Default: On.
UI_DHCS_Option_ShowStatusPanel_Tooltip.ch: 勾選時, 只要伺服器設定也允許, 你進入藏身處時會自動開啟狀態面板. 取消勾選則進入時保持面板關閉; 你仍可以右鍵點選你所在的藏身處重新開啟. 預設: 開啟.
UI_DHCS_Option_ShowStatusPanel_Tooltip.cn: 勾选时, 只要服务器设置也允许, 你进入藏身处时会自动打开状态面板. 取消勾选则进入时保持面板关闭; 你仍可以右键点击你所在的藏身处重新打开. 默认: 开启.

UI_DHCS_PhysicalFit.ch: 進入後的實際容納: 已使用 %1 / %2.
UI_DHCS_PhysicalFit.cn: 进入后的实际容纳: 已使用 %1 / %2.

UI_DHCS_PhysicalFitBreakdown.ch: 身體 %1 + 攜帶裝備 %2 + 存放物品 %3.
UI_DHCS_PhysicalFitBreakdown.cn: 身体 %1 + 携带装备 %2 + 存放物品 %3.

UI_DHCS_Reason_BodyTooLarge.en: You are too large to fit your body inside.
UI_DHCS_Reason_BodyTooLarge.ch: 你的身體太大, 塞不進去.
UI_DHCS_Reason_BodyTooLarge.cn: 你的身体太大, 塞不进去.

UI_DHCS_Reason_Encumbered.en: Too heavily encumbered to climb inside.
UI_DHCS_Reason_Encumbered.ch: 負重過重, 爬不進去.
UI_DHCS_Reason_Encumbered.cn: 负重过重, 爬不进去.

UI_DHCS_Reason_NoSafePath.en: There is no safe path to this hiding place.
UI_DHCS_Reason_NoSafePath.ch: 沒有通往這個藏身處的安全路徑.
UI_DHCS_Reason_NoSafePath.cn: 没有通往这个藏身处的安全路径.

UI_DHCS_Reason_NotEnoughSpace.en: Not enough physical space inside to fit your body.
UI_DHCS_Reason_NotEnoughSpace.ch: 裡面沒有足夠的實際空間容納你的身體.
UI_DHCS_Reason_NotEnoughSpace.cn: 里面没有足够的实际空间容纳你的身体.

UI_DHCS_Reason_NotUsable.en: Reason: This hiding place is not currently usable.
UI_DHCS_Reason_NotUsable.ch: 原因: 這個藏身處目前無法使用.
UI_DHCS_Reason_NotUsable.cn: 原因: 这个藏身处目前无法使用.

UI_DHCS_Reason_ObjectTooLarge.en: This hiding place is too large to conceal you safely.
UI_DHCS_Reason_ObjectTooLarge.ch: 這個藏身處太大, 無法安全地掩護你.
UI_DHCS_Reason_ObjectTooLarge.cn: 这个藏身处太大, 无法安全地掩护你.

UI_DHCS_Reason_TooFullNamed.en: The %1 is too full once your body and all gear are accounted for.
UI_DHCS_Reason_TooFullNamed.ch: 算上你的身體和所有裝備後, %1太滿了.
UI_DHCS_Reason_TooFullNamed.cn: 算上你的身体和所有装备后, %1太满了.

UI_DHCS_SleepBlocked.en: The danger and banging make sleep impossible.
UI_DHCS_SleepBlocked.ch: 危險和撞擊聲讓你無法入睡.
UI_DHCS_SleepBlocked.cn: 危险和撞击声让你无法入睡.

UI_DHCS_SleepTooltip1.en: Sleep for a limited time in an uncomfortable hiding place.
UI_DHCS_SleepTooltip1.ch: 在不舒適的藏身處睡一段有限的時間.
UI_DHCS_SleepTooltip1.cn: 在不舒适的藏身处睡一段有限的时间.

UI_DHCS_SleepTooltip2.en: Nearby danger, banging, cold, or being discovered will wake you.
UI_DHCS_SleepTooltip2.ch: 附近的危險、撞擊聲、寒冷或被發現都會把你吵醒.
UI_DHCS_SleepTooltip2.cn: 附近的危险、撞击声、寒冷或被发现都会把你吵醒.

UI_DHCS_Status_CannotHide.ch: 狀態: 無法躲在這裡.
UI_DHCS_Status_CannotHide.cn: 状态: 无法躲在这里.

UI_DHCS_StorageDoesNotBlock.en: Storage fullness does not block this hiding place.
UI_DHCS_StorageDoesNotBlock.ch: 儲物空間是否已滿不影響這個藏身處.
UI_DHCS_StorageDoesNotBlock.cn: 储物空间是否已满不影响这个藏身处.

UI_PNC_Trait_Bisexual_Description.en: Can be romantically attracted to men and women.
UI_PNC_Trait_Bisexual_Description.ch: 可能對男性與女性產生戀愛情感.
UI_PNC_Trait_Bisexual_Description.cn: 可能对男性与女性产生恋爱情感.

UI_PNC_Trait_BlandPalate_Description.ch: 偏好簡單, 清淡的食物.
UI_PNC_Trait_BlandPalate_Description.cn: 偏好简单, 清淡的食物.

UI_PNC_Trait_Flirty_Description.en: Is comfortable expressing romantic interest early.
UI_PNC_Trait_Flirty_Description.ch: 能自在地及早表達愛意.
UI_PNC_Trait_Flirty_Description.cn: 能自在地及早表达爱意.

UI_PNC_Trait_Friendly_Description.en: Forms positive first impressions more easily but is affected more by prolonged isolation.
UI_PNC_Trait_Friendly_Description.ch: 更容易對他人形成良好的第一印象, 但受長期孤立的影響更大.
UI_PNC_Trait_Friendly_Description.cn: 更容易对他人形成良好的第一印象, 但受长期孤立的影响更大.

UI_PNC_Trait_Gay_Description.en: Can be romantically attracted to people of the same gender.
UI_PNC_Trait_Gay_Description.ch: 可能對同性別的人產生戀愛情感.
UI_PNC_Trait_Gay_Description.cn: 可能对同性别的人产生恋爱情感.

UI_PNC_Trait_HasBrother_Description.en: Start with your brother already at your side as a loyal companion.
UI_PNC_Trait_HasBrother_Description.ch: 開局時你的兄弟就已經在你身邊, 是忠誠的同伴.
UI_PNC_Trait_HasBrother_Description.cn: 开局时你的兄弟就已经在你身边, 是忠诚的同伴.

UI_PNC_Trait_HasDad_Description.en: Start with your father already at your side as a loyal companion.
UI_PNC_Trait_HasDad_Description.ch: 開局時你的父親就已經在你身邊, 是忠誠的同伴.
UI_PNC_Trait_HasDad_Description.cn: 开局时你的父亲就已经在你身边, 是忠诚的同伴.

UI_PNC_Trait_HasFriend_Description.en: Start with a trusted friend already at your side as a loyal companion.
UI_PNC_Trait_HasFriend_Description.ch: 開局時一位信賴的朋友就已經在你身邊, 是忠誠的同伴.
UI_PNC_Trait_HasFriend_Description.cn: 开局时一位信赖的朋友就已经在你身边, 是忠诚的同伴.

UI_PNC_Trait_HasMom_Description.en: Start with your mother already at your side as a loyal companion.
UI_PNC_Trait_HasMom_Description.ch: 開局時你的母親就已經在你身邊, 是忠誠的同伴.
UI_PNC_Trait_HasMom_Description.cn: 开局时你的母亲就已经在你身边, 是忠诚的同伴.

UI_PNC_Trait_HasSister_Description.en: Start with your sister already at your side as a loyal companion.
UI_PNC_Trait_HasSister_Description.ch: 開局時你的姊妹就已經在你身邊, 是忠誠的同伴.
UI_PNC_Trait_HasSister_Description.cn: 开局时你的姐妹就已经在你身边, 是忠诚的同伴.

UI_PNC_Trait_IsMarried_Description.en: Start with your lover already at your side as a loyal companion.
UI_PNC_Trait_IsMarried_Description.ch: 開局時你的愛人就已經在你身邊, 是忠誠的同伴.
UI_PNC_Trait_IsMarried_Description.cn: 开局时你的爱人就已经在你身边, 是忠诚的同伴.

UI_PNC_Trait_Jealous_Description.en: Reacts more strongly to perceived romantic rivalry.
UI_PNC_Trait_Jealous_Description.ch: 對察覺到的情敵反應更強烈.
UI_PNC_Trait_Jealous_Description.cn: 对察觉到的情敌反应更强烈.

UI_PNC_Trait_Reserved_Description.en: Requires greater familiarity before expressing romantic interest.
UI_PNC_Trait_Reserved_Description.ch: 需要更熟悉對方才會表達愛意.
UI_PNC_Trait_Reserved_Description.cn: 需要更熟悉对方才会表达爱意.

UI_PNC_Trait_SpiceLover_Description.en: Prefers strongly seasoned and spicy food.
UI_PNC_Trait_SpiceLover_Description.ch: 偏好重口味與辛辣的食物.
UI_PNC_Trait_SpiceLover_Description.cn: 偏好重口味与辛辣的食物.

UI_PNC_Trait_Unpossessive_Description.en: Reacts less strongly to harmless romantic attention involving a partner.
UI_PNC_Trait_Unpossessive_Description.ch: 對伴侶受到無害的示好反應較不強烈.
UI_PNC_Trait_Unpossessive_Description.cn: 对伴侣受到无害的示好反应较不强烈.

UI_PNC_Trait_Withdrawn_Description.en: Builds familiarity more slowly but is less affected by isolation.
UI_PNC_Trait_Withdrawn_Description.ch: 建立熟悉感較慢, 但受孤立的影響較小.
UI_PNC_Trait_Withdrawn_Description.cn: 建立熟悉感较慢, 但受孤立的影响较小.

UI_options_TSWIM_Volume_tooltip.en: Volume of the swimming, entering and leaving water sounds (0 = silent). Also follows the game's Sound slider.
UI_options_TSWIM_Volume_tooltip.ch: 游泳, 入水與出水音效的音量 (0 = 靜音). 也會跟隨遊戲的音效滑桿.
UI_options_TSWIM_Volume_tooltip.cn: 游泳, 入水和出水音效的音量 (0 = 静音). 同时也受游戏音效滑块影响.

UI_CU_Amputated.en: The limb is gone. Seal the stump.
UI_CU_Amputated.ch: 肢體沒了. 把殘肢封住.
UI_CU_Amputated.cn: 肢体没了. 把残肢封住.

UI_CU_AteLimb.en: You will not forget the taste.

UI_CU_BladeCold.en: The blade went cold before it sealed. Put it back in the fire and wait for it to glow.
UI_CU_BladeCold.ch: 刀刃在封住傷口前就冷掉了. 把它放回火裡, 等它燒到發紅.
UI_CU_BladeCold.cn: 刀刃在封住伤口前就冷掉了. 把它放回火里, 等它烧到发红.

UI_CU_Botch_aspirated.en: Botched: it went down into the lung

UI_CU_Botch_choke.en: Botched: it went down the wrong way

UI_CU_Botch_crooked.en: Botched: the bone was set crooked

UI_CU_Botch_dirty.en: Botched: the dressing is loose and won't stay clean
UI_CU_Botch_dirty.ch: 失誤: 敷料鬆脫, 保持不了乾淨
UI_CU_Botch_dirty.cn: 失误: 敷料松脱, 保持不了干净

UI_CU_Botch_fragment.en: Botched: a fragment is still in there
UI_CU_Botch_fragment.ch: 失誤: 還有一塊碎片在裡面
UI_CU_Botch_fragment.cn: 失误: 还有一块碎片在里面

UI_CU_Botch_infect.en: Botched: dirt got into the wound
UI_CU_Botch_infect.ch: 失誤: 髒東西跑進傷口了
UI_CU_Botch_infect.cn: 失误: 脏东西跑进伤口了

UI_CU_Botch_jolt.ch: 失誤: 骨折處被震到了
UI_CU_Botch_jolt.cn: 失误: 骨折处被震到了

UI_CU_Botch_loose.en: Botched: too loose - it's still bleeding
UI_CU_Botch_loose.ch: 失誤: 太鬆了 - 還在流血
UI_CU_Botch_loose.cn: 失误: 太松了 - 还在流血

UI_CU_Botch_missed.en: Botched: some of the dirt is still in there
UI_CU_Botch_missed.ch: 失誤: 還有些髒東西在裡面
UI_CU_Botch_missed.cn: 失误: 还有些脏东西在里面

UI_CU_Botch_nausea.ch: 失誤: 感覺不太對勁
UI_CU_Botch_nausea.cn: 失误: 感觉不太对劲

UI_CU_Botch_pressure.en: Botched: too tight - it's crushing the limb
UI_CU_Botch_pressure.ch: 失誤: 太緊了 - 壓迫到肢體
UI_CU_Botch_pressure.cn: 失误: 太紧了 - 压迫到肢体

UI_CU_Botch_rash.en: Botched: the skin is reacting to it
UI_CU_Botch_rash.ch: 失誤: 皮膚對它起反應了
UI_CU_Botch_rash.cn: 失误: 皮肤对它起反应了

UI_CU_Botch_selfcut.en: Botched: the blade slipped into your hand
UI_CU_Botch_selfcut.ch: 失誤: 刀刃滑進你的手
UI_CU_Botch_selfcut.cn: 失误: 刀刃滑进你的手

UI_CU_Botch_sore.en: Botched: the stump is rubbed sore
UI_CU_Botch_sore.ch: 失誤: 殘肢被磨痛了
UI_CU_Botch_sore.cn: 失误: 残肢被磨痛了

UI_CU_Botch_stitchdirt.en: Botched: dirt stitched into the wound
UI_CU_Botch_stitchdirt.ch: 失誤: 髒東西被縫進傷口裡
UI_CU_Botch_stitchdirt.cn: 失误: 脏东西被缝进伤口里

UI_CU_Botch_swelling.en: Botched: too tight - the limb is swelling inside it
UI_CU_Botch_swelling.ch: 失誤: 太緊了 - 肢體在裡面腫起來
UI_CU_Botch_swelling.cn: 失误: 太紧了 - 肢体在里面肿起来

UI_CU_Botch_torn.ch: 失誤: 傷口撕得更大了
UI_CU_Botch_torn.cn: 失误: 伤口撕得更大了

UI_CU_CantClimb.en: You can't climb that like this.

UI_CU_CantExercise.en: That exercise needs the limb you lost.
UI_CU_CantExercise.ch: 這項運動需要你失去的那個肢體.
UI_CU_CantExercise.cn: 这项运动需要你失去的那个肢体.

UI_CU_CarryFell.en: You go down, and so do they.
UI_CU_CarryFell.ch: 你倒下了, 對方也跟著倒下.
UI_CU_CarryFell.cn: 你倒下了, 对方也跟着倒下.

UI_CU_CarryHandsFull.en: You need both hands for that -- they go down.
UI_CU_CarryHandsFull.ch: 那需要雙手 -- 對方摔下去了.
UI_CU_CarryHandsFull.cn: 那需要双手 -- 对方摔下去了.

UI_CU_CarryTooHeavy.en: You can't hold them any longer.

UI_CU_Crawling.en: Without legs you can only crawl.
UI_CU_Crawling.ch: 沒有腿, 你只能爬行.
UI_CU_Crawling.cn: 没有腿, 你只能爬行.

UI_CU_Defib_NoChange.en: Nothing changes on the monitor. Charge it again - the shock has to land inside the band on the gauge.
UI_CU_Defib_NoChange.ch: 監視器上沒有任何變化. 再充一次電 - 電擊必須落在儀表的區間內.
UI_CU_Defib_NoChange.cn: 监护仪上没有任何变化. 再充一次电 - 电击必须落在仪表的区间内.

UI_CU_Event_cough.en: A coughing fit doubles you over.
UI_CU_Event_cough.ch: 一陣劇咳讓你彎下了腰.
UI_CU_Event_cough.cn: 一阵剧咳让你弯下了腰.

UI_CU_Event_headrush.en: You stand up too fast and the room tilts.
UI_CU_Event_headrush.ch: 你站得太快, 整個房間都歪了.
UI_CU_Event_headrush.cn: 你站得太快, 整个房间都歪了.

UI_CU_Event_heatfaint.en: The heat takes your legs out.

UI_CU_Event_palpitations.en: Your heart lurches in your chest.
UI_CU_Event_palpitations.ch: 你的心臟在胸口猛地一跳.
UI_CU_Event_palpitations.cn: 你的心脏在胸口猛地一跳.

UI_CU_Event_retch.en: You retch on an empty stomach.

UI_CU_Event_seizure.ch: 你失去了對身體的控制.
UI_CU_Event_seizure.cn: 你失去了对身体的控制.

UI_CU_Fibrillation.en: Your heart is fluttering out of rhythm.
UI_CU_Fibrillation.ch: 你的心臟正失序地顫動.
UI_CU_Fibrillation.cn: 你的心脏正失序地颤动.

UI_CU_FirearmOff.en: Firearm episodes are turned off in this server's sandbox settings.
UI_CU_FirearmOff.ch: 此伺服器的沙盒設定已關閉槍枝事件.
UI_CU_FirearmOff.cn: 此服务器的沙盒设置已关闭枪械事件.

UI_CU_Flashback_3.en: Their face. You keep seeing their face.
UI_CU_Flashback_3.ch: 那張臉. 你一直看到那張臉.
UI_CU_Flashback_3.cn: 那张脸. 你一直看到那张脸.

UI_CU_Flashback_5.en: You're back there. You're right back there.
UI_CU_Flashback_5.ch: 你又回到那裡了. 你就在那裡.
UI_CU_Flashback_5.cn: 你又回到那里了. 你就在那里.

UI_CU_Flashback_6.ch: 呼吸. 已經結束了. 已經結束了.
UI_CU_Flashback_6.cn: 呼吸. 已经结束了. 已经结束了.

UI_CU_HandMissing.en: You have no hand to hold that with.

UI_CU_LimbKept.en: You are holding what used to be part of someone.
UI_CU_LimbKept.ch: 你手上拿著的, 曾經是某人身體的一部分.
UI_CU_LimbKept.cn: 你手上拿着的, 曾经是某人身体的一部分.

UI_CU_NeedCrutch.en: Hold a crutch to walk properly on one leg. Hospitals and medical clinics have them.
UI_CU_NeedCrutch.ch: 拿著拐杖才能用單腳正常行走. 醫院和診所有拐杖.
UI_CU_NeedCrutch.cn: 拿着拐杖才能用单腿正常行走. 医院和诊所有拐杖.

UI_CU_NeedHelpProsthetic.en: With no arms, somebody else has to put it on for you.
UI_CU_NeedHelpProsthetic.ch: 沒有手臂的話, 得由別人幫你裝上.
UI_CU_NeedHelpProsthetic.cn: 没有手臂的话, 得由别人帮你装上.

UI_CU_NeedLegs.en: You can't do that without legs to stand on.
UI_CU_NeedLegs.ch: 沒有腿可以站, 你做不到.
UI_CU_NeedLegs.cn: 没有腿可以站, 你做不到.

UI_CU_NoArms.en: That takes a hand you no longer have. A prosthetic arm would do it.
UI_CU_NoArms.ch: 那需要一隻你已經沒有的手. 義肢手臂可以做到.
UI_CU_NoArms.cn: 那需要一只你已经没有的手. 假肢手臂可以做到.

UI_CU_NotCured.en: It was already in your blood.
UI_CU_NotCured.ch: 它早就進到你的血液裡了.
UI_CU_NotCured.cn: 它早就进到你的血液里了.

UI_CU_Overdose_NothingHasEverBeenWrongNo.en: Nothing has ever been wrong. Nothing at all.
UI_CU_Overdose_NothingHasEverBeenWrongNo.ch: 從來沒有任何不對勁. 什麼都沒有.
UI_CU_Overdose_NothingHasEverBeenWrongNo.cn: 从来没有任何不对劲. 什么都没有.

UI_CU_Overdose_NothingYouFeelNothingAtAl.en: Nothing. You feel nothing at all.
UI_CU_Overdose_NothingYouFeelNothingAtAl.ch: 什麼都沒有. 你什麼都感覺不到.
UI_CU_Overdose_NothingYouFeelNothingAtAl.cn: 什么都没有. 你什么都感觉不到.

UI_CU_Overdose_TooMuchInOneArm.en: That is a lot of %1 in one arm.
UI_CU_Overdose_TooMuchInOneArm.ch: 一條手臂打了這麼多%1, 太多了.
UI_CU_Overdose_TooMuchInOneArm.cn: 一条手臂打了这么多%1, 太多了.

UI_CU_Overdose_WarmAllOfItWarm.ch: 溫暖. 一切都, 好溫暖.
UI_CU_Overdose_WarmAllOfItWarm.cn: 温暖. 一切都, 好温暖.

UI_CU_Overdose_YouAreBreathingButBarely.ch: 你還在呼吸, 但很微弱.
UI_CU_Overdose_YouAreBreathingButBarely.cn: 你还在呼吸, 但很微弱.

UI_CU_Overdose_YouCanTGetABreathIn.en: You can't get a breath in.

UI_CU_Overdose_YouCanTMakeYourselfBreath.en: You can't make yourself breathe in.

UI_CU_Overdose_YouComeBackUpYouWishYou.en: You come back up. You wish you hadn't.
UI_CU_Overdose_YouComeBackUpYouWishYou.ch: 你醒過來了. 你希望自己沒有醒.
UI_CU_Overdose_YouComeBackUpYouWishYou.cn: 你醒过来了. 你希望自己没有醒.

UI_CU_Overdose_YouHaveNoIdeaHowLongYou.en: You have no idea how long you were out.
UI_CU_Overdose_YouHaveNoIdeaHowLongYou.ch: 你不知道自己昏迷了多久.
UI_CU_Overdose_YouHaveNoIdeaHowLongYou.cn: 你不知道自己昏迷了多久.

UI_CU_Overdose_YourChestHasLockedItWonT.en: Your chest has locked. It won't move.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourChestHasLockedItWonT.ch: 你的胸口僵住了. 它動不了.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourChestHasLockedItWonT.cn: 你的胸口僵住了. 它动不了.

UI_CU_Overdose_YourHeadIsNotRightSomethi.en: Your head is not right. Something is missing.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourHeadIsNotRightSomethi.ch: 你的腦袋不對勁. 少了什麼東西.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourHeadIsNotRightSomethi.cn: 你的脑袋不对劲. 少了什么东西.

UI_CU_Overdose_YourKneesGiveYouDonTMind.en: Your knees give. You don't mind.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourKneesGiveYouDonTMind.ch: 你的膝蓋一軟. 你不在乎.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourKneesGiveYouDonTMind.cn: 你的膝盖一软. 你不在乎.

UI_CU_Overdose_YourSkinCrawlsEverythingI.ch: 你渾身起雞皮疙瘩. 全身都在癢.
UI_CU_Overdose_YourSkinCrawlsEverythingI.cn: 你浑身起鸡皮疙瘩. 全身都在痒.

UI_CU_PTSD_Onset.en: It keeps coming back. It isn't going to stop.
UI_CU_PTSD_Onset.ch: 它一直回來. 它不會停止的.
UI_CU_PTSD_Onset.cn: 它一直回来. 它不会停止的.

UI_CU_Proc_NoChange.en: That did not clear it. Badly done work only sets it back - try again, more carefully.
UI_CU_Proc_NoChange.ch: 這樣沒有解決. 做得不好只會讓情況倒退 - 再試一次, 更小心一點.
UI_CU_Proc_NoChange.cn: 这样没有解决. 做得不好只会让情况倒退 - 再试一次, 更小心一点.

UI_CU_Rhythm_vtach.en: Your heart is racing out of control.

UI_CU_RollAgain.en: You have the strength to roll again.

UI_CU_Rolling.en: With no arms or legs, all you can do is roll.
UI_CU_Rolling.ch: 沒有手腳, 你唯一能做的就是滾動.
UI_CU_Rolling.cn: 没有手脚, 你唯一能做的就是滚动.

UI_CU_Squeamish.en: You can't look at it. Your hands won't hold still.
UI_CU_Squeamish.ch: 你不敢看. 你的手停不住地抖.
UI_CU_Squeamish.cn: 你不敢看. 你的手停不住地抖.

UI_CU_TooHeavy.en: You can't carry that like this.
UI_CU_TooHeavy.ch: 你這個樣子搬不動那個.
UI_CU_TooHeavy.cn: 你这个样子搬不动那个.

UI_CU_TooMiserable.en: What's the point... (too low to treat yourself - somebody else can, and anything urgent you still will)
UI_CU_TooMiserable.ch: 有什麼意義… (太消沉了, 無法自行治療 - 別人可以幫你, 而緊急狀況你仍會處理)
UI_CU_TooMiserable.cn: 有什么意义… (太消沉了, 无法自行治疗 - 别人可以帮你, 而紧急状况你仍会处理)

UI_CU_TwoHanded.en: You need two hands for that.

UI_CU_WheelchairOut.en: Get out of the wheelchair first.

UI_CU_Witness_suicide.ch: 不. 不, 不, 不 -
UI_CU_Witness_suicide.cn: 不. 不, 不, 不 -

UI_trait_CU_ArmLegDesc.en: Surviving the Knox Event cost you an arm and a leg, funny huh? You start with only your right arm and right leg.
UI_trait_CU_ArmLegDesc.ch: 在諾克斯事件中倖存讓你付出了一條手臂和一條腿的代價, 很好笑吧? 你開局只剩右手臂和右腿.
UI_trait_CU_ArmLegDesc.cn: 在诺克斯事件中幸存让你付出了一条手臂和一条腿的代价, 很好笑吧? 你开局只剩右臂和右腿.

UI_trait_CU_CreeperDesc.en: Both of your arms were amputated. You need someone else to put a prosthesis on.
UI_trait_CU_CreeperDesc.ch: 你的雙臂都被截肢了. 需要別人幫你裝上義肢.
UI_trait_CU_CreeperDesc.cn: 你的双臂都被截肢了. 需要别人帮你装上假肢.

UI_trait_CU_ProsArmDesc.en: One of your arms has been replaced with a prosthetic. It's functional, but far from natural.
UI_trait_CU_ProsArmDesc.ch: 你的一條手臂已換成義肢. 它能用, 但遠不如原本自然.
UI_trait_CU_ProsArmDesc.cn: 你的一条手臂已换成假肢. 它能用, 但远不如原本自然.

UI_trait_CU_ProsLegDesc.en: One of your legs has been replaced with a prosthetic. Walking isn't quite the same anymore.
UI_trait_CU_ProsLegDesc.ch: 你的一條腿已換成義肢. 走路的感覺已經不太一樣了.
UI_trait_CU_ProsLegDesc.cn: 你的一条腿已换成假肢. 走路的感觉已经不太一样了.

UI_trait_CU_ProsUserDesc.en: You've spent enough time around prosthetics to know how to use and maintain them. (+2 Prosthetics, 25%% more Prosthetics XP)
UI_trait_CU_ProsUserDesc.ch: 你和義肢相處夠久了, 知道怎麼使用和保養它們. (+2 義肢, 義肢經驗 +25%%)
UI_trait_CU_ProsUserDesc.cn: 你和假肢相处够久了, 知道怎么使用和保养它们. (+2 假肢, 假肢经验 +25%%)

UI_trait_CU_QuadriplegicDesc.en: You have no arms and no legs. You can only roll a few metres before you are too exhausted to move, and you cannot hold or climb anything. You can lift light things in your teeth, gnaw scrap wood off wooden objects (it hurts), and lash the wood together with duct tape into a crude prosthetic.
UI_trait_CU_QuadriplegicDesc.ch: 你沒有手臂也沒有腿. 你只能滾動幾公尺就會累到動不了, 而且無法手持或攀爬任何東西. 你可以用牙齒叼起輕的東西, 從木製物件上啃下廢木材 (會痛), 再用布膠帶把木頭綁成簡易義肢.
UI_trait_CU_QuadriplegicDesc.cn: 你没有手臂也没有腿. 你只能滚动几米就会累到动不了, 而且无法手持或攀爬任何东西. 你可以用牙齿叼起轻的东西, 从木制物件上啃下废木材 (会痛), 再用管道胶带把木头绑成简易假肢.

UI_trait_CU_SlugDesc.en: Both of your legs were amputated.

UI_trait_CU_TheseusDesc.en: But are you still the same man? All of your limbs have been replaced by prosthetics.
UI_trait_CU_TheseusDesc.ch: 但你還是同一個人嗎? 你的四肢全都換成了義肢.
UI_trait_CU_TheseusDesc.cn: 但你还是同一个人吗? 你的四肢全都换成了假肢.

UI_trait_CU_UnfinishedDesc.en: You are not done yet. The first time your heart stops and the clock runs out on you, it starts again - guaranteed, once, however long the odds. After that you take your chances with everybody else.
UI_trait_CU_UnfinishedDesc.ch: 你還沒完. 你的心臟第一次停止、時間耗盡時, 它會重新跳動 - 保證一次, 不管機會多渺茫. 之後你就和其他人一樣聽天由命了.
UI_trait_CU_UnfinishedDesc.cn: 你还没完. 你的心脏第一次停止、时间耗尽时, 它会重新跳动 - 保证一次, 不管机会多渺茫. 之后你就和其他人一样听天由命了.

UI_TIMWriter_MissingBook.en: Missing materials (notebook, 3 leather strips, thread, needle and a writing tool)
UI_TIMWriter_MissingBook.ch: 缺少材料 (空筆記本, 3 條皮革條, 縫線, 針與書寫工具)
UI_TIMWriter_MissingBook.cn: 缺少材料 (笔记本, 3 条皮革条, 线, 针和书写工具)

UI_TIMWriter_MissingMagazine.en: Missing materials (notebook or 5 sheets of paper and a writing tool)
UI_TIMWriter_MissingMagazine.ch: 缺少材料 (空筆記本或 5 張紙, 以及書寫工具)
UI_TIMWriter_MissingMagazine.cn: 缺少材料 (笔记本或 5 张纸, 以及书写工具)

UI_trait_academicwriterdesc.en: Your pen teaches what your skill proves. You can write perk books when you are 2 levels above the skill in question (volume 1 from level 4; level 10 lets you write volume 5). Each book consumes an empty notebook, 1 thread use and 3 leather strips; a needle and a pencil are required but not consumed.
UI_trait_academicwriterdesc.ch: 你的筆傳授你技能所證明的一切. 當你的技能等級比該技能書高 2 級時, 即可撰寫技能書 (等級 4 可寫第 1 卷; 等級 10 可寫第 5 卷). 每本書消耗一本空白筆記本, 1 次線的用量與 3 條皮革條; 需要針與鉛筆, 但不會消耗.
UI_trait_academicwriterdesc.cn: 你的笔传授你技能所证明的一切. 当你的技能等级比该技能书高 2 级时, 即可撰写技能书 (等级 4 可写第 1 卷; 等级 10 可写第 5 卷). 每本书消耗一本空白笔记本, 1 次线的用量和 3 条皮革条; 需要针和铅笔, 但不会消耗.

UI_trait_addictivegeekdesc.en: Without your daily comics you get unbearable. If you spend 6 hours without reading comics or magazines, you gain 10%% unhappiness, boredom and stress every 30 minutes.
UI_trait_addictivegeekdesc.ch: 少了每天的漫畫你就會變得難以忍受. 若你 6 小時沒有閱讀漫畫或雜誌, 每 30 分鐘會增加 10%% 的不快樂, 無聊與壓力.
UI_trait_addictivegeekdesc.cn: 少了每天的漫画你就会变得难以忍受. 如果你 6 小时没有阅读漫画或杂志, 每 30 分钟会增加 10%% 的不开心, 无聊和压力.

UI_trait_alcoholhaterdesc.en: Your body rejects any drink. Drinking alcohol gives nausea as high as your drunkenness level (completely drunk means maximum nausea), plus 10%% unhappiness and stress per level. The effects decay along with the drunkenness.
UI_trait_alcoholhaterdesc.ch: 你的身體排斥任何酒. 飲酒會造成與醉酒程度同等的噁心 (完全爛醉代表噁心達到最高), 且每級額外增加 10%% 的不快樂與壓力. 效果會隨醉意一同消退.
UI_trait_alcoholhaterdesc.cn: 你的身体排斥任何酒. 饮酒会造成与醉酒程度相同的恶心 (完全烂醉意味着恶心达到最高), 并且每级额外增加 10%% 的不开心和压力. 效果会随醉意一同消退.

UI_trait_badchauffeurdesc.en: Behind the wheel everything goes wrong. Passengers of the vehicle you drive take 25%% more damage from accidents (you take this damage too).
UI_trait_badchauffeurdesc.ch: 一坐上駕駛座就諸事不順. 你駕駛的車輛中, 乘客受到的事故傷害增加 25%% (你自己也會承受此傷害).
UI_trait_badchauffeurdesc.cn: 一坐上驾驶座就诸事不顺. 你驾驶的车辆中, 乘客受到的事故伤害增加 25%% (你自己也会承受此伤害).

UI_trait_badstitchingdesc.en: Your repairs barely hold. Your clothes are twice as fragile to wear and holes.
UI_trait_badstitchingdesc.ch: 你的修補勉強撐得住. 你的衣物對磨損與破洞的脆弱程度加倍.
UI_trait_badstitchingdesc.cn: 你的修补勉强撑得住. 你的衣物对磨损和破洞的脆弱程度翻倍.

UI_trait_badstudentdesc.en: Learning next to the best makes you feel small. While within 4 cells of a player at least two levels above you in a skill, you gain 20%% less multiplier on that skill.
UI_trait_badstudentdesc.ch: 在高手身旁學習讓你自慚形穢. 當你位於某技能比你高至少兩級的玩家 4 格範圍內時, 你在該技能獲得的倍率減少 20%%.
UI_trait_badstudentdesc.cn: 在高手身旁学习让你自惭形秽. 当你位于某技能比你高至少两级的玩家 4 格范围内时, 你在该技能获得的倍率减少 20%%.

UI_trait_balddesc.en: Your head has been smooth as stone for as long as you remember. You start bald and your hair never grows back.
UI_trait_balddesc.ch: 從你有記憶以來, 你的頭就光滑得像顆石頭. 你開局就是光頭, 而且頭髮永遠不會再長回來.
UI_trait_balddesc.cn: 从你有记忆以来, 你的头就光滑得像块石头. 你开局就是光头, 而且头发永远不会再长回来.

UI_trait_barefooterdesc.en: Asphalt and dirt are no match for your soles. Your feet always have 80%% protection, even when barefoot.
UI_trait_barefooterdesc.ch: 柏油路與泥土都敵不過你的腳底板. 你的雙腳永遠擁有 80%% 的防護, 即使赤腳也一樣.
UI_trait_barefooterdesc.cn: 柏油路和泥土都敌不过你的脚底板. 你的双脚永远拥有 80%% 的防护, 即使赤脚也一样.

UI_trait_bloodaddictdesc.en: You need to see blood daily to stay calm. If you go more than 2 hours without seeing or interacting with blood (on your body, clothes or weapons), you start gaining 10%% stress, unhappiness and boredom every hour.
UI_trait_bloodaddictdesc.ch: 你每天都需要見血才能保持冷靜. 若超過 2 小時沒有看見或接觸血液 (身上, 衣物或武器上), 你每小時會開始增加 10%% 的壓力, 不快樂與無聊.
UI_trait_bloodaddictdesc.cn: 你每天都需要见血才能保持冷静. 如果超过 2 小时没有看见或接触血液 (身上, 衣物或武器上), 你每小时会开始增加 10%% 的压力, 不开心和无聊.

UI_trait_bookexpertdesc.en: Reading comes naturally to you: you grasp every idea on the fly. Perk books give 25%% more experience multiplier.
UI_trait_bookexpertdesc.ch: 閱讀對你而言再自然不過: 你能即時領會每個概念. 技能書提供的經驗倍率增加 25%%.
UI_trait_bookexpertdesc.cn: 阅读对你而言再自然不过: 你能即时领会每个概念. 技能书提供的经验倍率增加 25%%.

UI_trait_bookloverdesc.en: You love books: a good reading session always does you good. Any book, skill books included, removes unhappiness, stress and boredom.
UI_trait_bookloverdesc.ch: 你熱愛書本: 好好讀一段書總是對你有益. 任何書籍, 包括技能書, 都能消除不快樂, 壓力與無聊.
UI_trait_bookloverdesc.cn: 你热爱书本: 好好读一段书总是对你有益. 任何书籍, 包括技能书, 都能消除不开心, 压力和无聊.

UI_trait_booknovicedesc.en: Reading really costs you: the pages resist you. Perk books give 25%% less experience multiplier.
UI_trait_booknovicedesc.ch: 閱讀對你來說真的很吃力: 書頁彷彿在跟你作對. 技能書提供的經驗倍率減少 25%%.
UI_trait_booknovicedesc.cn: 阅读对你来说真的很吃力: 书页仿佛在跟你作对. 技能书提供的经验倍率减少 25%%.

UI_trait_boringdesc.en: Your flat tone kills the conversation. Players within 6 cells of you gain boredom twice as fast, and so do you. If you are alone, the trait has no effect.
UI_trait_boringdesc.ch: 你平板的語調讓對話冷場. 你 6 格範圍內的玩家無聊增加速度加倍, 你自己也是. 若你獨自一人, 此特質沒有效果.
UI_trait_boringdesc.cn: 你平板的语调让对话冷场. 你 6 格范围内的玩家无聊增加速度翻倍, 你自己也是. 如果你独自一人, 此特质没有效果.

UI_trait_carelesskillerdesc.en: You fight carelessly and end up drenched. You get covered in blood 25%% faster than the rest.
UI_trait_carelesskillerdesc.ch: 你打起架來毫不顧忌, 最後總是渾身濕透. 你沾上血跡的速度比別人快 25%%.
UI_trait_carelesskillerdesc.cn: 你打起架来毫不顾忌, 最后总是浑身湿透. 你沾上血迹的速度比别人快 25%%.

UI_trait_carnivoredesc.en: Your diet is simple: meat, period. Eating well-cooked or canned meat removes 20%% stress, unhappiness and boredom, on top of the benefits it already gives.
UI_trait_carnivoredesc.ch: 你的飲食很簡單: 就是肉, 沒別的. 食用煮熟的肉或罐裝肉, 除了原有的好處之外, 還會消除 20%% 的壓力, 不快樂與無聊.
UI_trait_carnivoredesc.cn: 你的饮食很简单: 就是肉, 没别的. 食用煮熟的肉或罐装肉, 除了原有的好处之外, 还会消除 20%% 的压力, 不开心和无聊.

UI_trait_clumsynursedesc.en: Your medical touch leaves a lot to be desired. First aid actions performed on others take you twice as long.
UI_trait_clumsynursedesc.ch: 你的醫療手法還有很大的進步空間. 對他人進行急救動作時, 你花費的時間加倍.
UI_trait_clumsynursedesc.cn: 你的医疗手法还有很大的进步空间. 对他人进行急救动作时, 你花费的时间翻倍.

UI_trait_comfortabledesc.en: Wearing anything means feeling comfortable. No piece of equipment or clothing produces discomfort.
UI_trait_comfortabledesc.ch: 穿什麼都覺得舒適. 任何裝備或衣物都不會造成不適.
UI_trait_comfortabledesc.cn: 穿什么都觉得舒适. 任何装备或衣物都不会造成不适.

UI_trait_divorcedfatherdesc.en: You cook wildly, without measure or order. Every ingredient you add to a preparation provides 15%% less proteins, calories and satiety.
UI_trait_divorcedfatherdesc.ch: 你做菜毫無章法, 既不量也不講順序. 你加入料理的每種食材提供的蛋白質, 熱量與飽足感減少 15%%.
UI_trait_divorcedfatherdesc.cn: 你做菜毫无章法, 既不计量也不讲顺序. 你加入料理的每种食材提供的蛋白质, 热量和饱腹感减少 15%%.

UI_trait_drivehaterdesc.en: Every mile is torture. Driving any vehicle increases 5%% stress, unhappiness and boredom for every 100 meters driven while moving.
UI_trait_drivehaterdesc.ch: 每一英里都是折磨. 駕駛任何車輛時, 行駛中每開 100 公尺, 壓力, 不快樂與無聊就增加 5%%.
UI_trait_drivehaterdesc.cn: 每一英里都是折磨. 驾驶任何车辆时, 行驶中每开 100 米, 压力, 不开心和无聊就增加 5%%.

UI_trait_driveloverdesc.en: The engine is your medicine. Driving any vehicle reduces 5%% stress, unhappiness and boredom for every 100 meters driven while moving.
UI_trait_driveloverdesc.ch: 引擎就是你的良藥. 駕駛任何車輛時, 行駛中每開 100 公尺, 壓力, 不快樂與無聊就減少 5%%.
UI_trait_driveloverdesc.cn: 引擎就是你的良药. 驾驶任何车辆时, 行驶中每开 100 米, 压力, 不开心和无聊就减少 5%%.

UI_trait_drunkenfooldesc.en: Drunk, you are better party entertainment than a fighter. Melee damage is reduced 20%% per drunkenness level.
UI_trait_drunkenfooldesc.ch: 喝醉的你比起戰士更適合當派對的餘興節目. 每一級醉意使近戰傷害減少 20%%.
UI_trait_drunkenfooldesc.cn: 喝醉的你比起战士更适合当派对的余兴节目. 每一级醉意使近战伤害减少 20%%.

UI_trait_drunkenmasterdesc.en: Boozing awakens a fighter out of this world. Melee damage increases 10%% per drunkenness level.
UI_trait_drunkenmasterdesc.ch: 杯中物喚醒了一位超凡脫俗的戰士. 每一級醉意使近戰傷害增加 10%%.
UI_trait_drunkenmasterdesc.cn: 杯中物唤醒了一位超凡脱俗的战士. 每一级醉意使近战伤害增加 10%%.

UI_trait_extrovertdesc.en: You recharge in company. You lose unhappiness and stress while within 4 cells of other players (10%% every half hour).
UI_trait_extrovertdesc.ch: 你在人群中充電. 當你位於其他玩家 4 格範圍內時, 會減少不快樂與壓力 (每半小時 10%%).
UI_trait_extrovertdesc.cn: 你在人群中充电. 当你位于其他玩家 4 格范围内时, 会减少不开心和压力 (每半小时 10%%).

UI_trait_fieldnursedesc.en: Your hands know their job in the middle of chaos. Performing first aid on others no longer requires their confirmation, and just opening the other's health panel stops their bleeding (it resumes if you stop checking on the patient without bandaging or stitching them).
UI_trait_fieldnursedesc.ch: 即使身處混亂, 你的雙手也知道該做什麼. 對他人進行急救不再需要對方確認, 而且只要開啟對方的健康面板就能止住其出血 (若你沒有包紮或縫合就停止關照傷患, 出血會恢復).
UI_trait_fieldnursedesc.cn: 即使身处混乱, 你的双手也知道该做什么. 对他人进行急救不再需要对方确认, 而且只要打开对方的健康面板就能止住其出血 (如果你没有包扎或缝合就停止查看伤患, 出血会恢复).

UI_trait_filthydesc.en: Grime follows you everywhere you go. You accumulate a flat 10%% of dirt every hour.
UI_trait_filthydesc.ch: 無論走到哪裡, 髒汙都跟著你. 你每小時固定累積 10%% 的髒汙.
UI_trait_filthydesc.cn: 无论走到哪里, 污垢都跟着你. 你每小时固定累积 10%% 的污垢.

UI_trait_fragilefeetdesc.en: Your feet are glass. When barefoot, they have 80%% more chances of getting hurt.
UI_trait_fragilefeetdesc.ch: 你的雙腳就像玻璃. 赤腳時, 受傷的機率增加 80%%.
UI_trait_fragilefeetdesc.cn: 你的双脚就像玻璃. 赤脚时, 受伤的几率增加 80%%.

UI_trait_friendlydesc.en: People feel at ease around you. Players within 4 cells of you gradually lose unhappiness and stress (10%% every half hour).
UI_trait_friendlydesc.ch: 人們在你身邊感到自在. 你 4 格範圍內的玩家會逐漸減少不快樂與壓力 (每半小時 10%%).
UI_trait_friendlydesc.cn: 人们在你身边感到自在. 你 4 格范围内的玩家会逐渐减少不开心和压力 (每半小时 10%%).

UI_trait_fullhairdesc.en: Your mane knows no scissors. Your hair grows 50%% faster than normal.
UI_trait_fullhairdesc.ch: 你的一頭濃髮從不怕剪刀. 你的頭髮生長速度比平常快 50%%.
UI_trait_fullhairdesc.cn: 你的一头浓发从不怕剪刀. 你的头发生长速度比平常快 50%%.

UI_trait_funnydesc.en: Laughter is contagious. Players within 6 cells of you never gain boredom, and neither do you. In both cases boredom decays gradually, not at once, to keep it realistic.
UI_trait_funnydesc.ch: 笑聲會傳染. 你 6 格範圍內的玩家永遠不會變得無聊, 你自己也是. 兩種情況下無聊都會逐漸消退, 而非一次消失, 以保持真實感.
UI_trait_funnydesc.cn: 笑声会传染. 你 6 格范围内的玩家永远不会变得无聊, 你自己也是. 两种情况下无聊都会逐渐消退, 而非一次消失, 以保持真实感.

UI_trait_geekdesc.en: For you comics never run out. You can read comics and magazines 4 times before their re-read cooldown kicks in.
UI_trait_geekdesc.ch: 對你來說漫畫永遠讀不膩. 你可以閱讀漫畫與雜誌 4 次, 之後才會進入重讀冷卻時間.
UI_trait_geekdesc.cn: 对你来说漫画永远读不腻. 你可以阅读漫画和杂志 4 次, 之后才会进入重读冷却时间.

UI_trait_goodstitchingdesc.en: Every stitch strengthens what it touches. Your clothes are twice as resistant to wear and holes (they get damaged once every two times).
UI_trait_goodstitchingdesc.ch: 每一針都讓所縫之處更加牢固. 你的衣物對磨損與破洞的抵抗力加倍 (每兩次才會受損一次).
UI_trait_goodstitchingdesc.cn: 每一针都让所缝之处更加牢固. 你的衣物对磨损和破洞的抵抗力翻倍 (每两次才会受损一次).

UI_trait_grandmotherdesc.en: Your pot is a neighborhood legend. Every ingredient you add to a preparation provides 10%% more proteins, calories and satiety.
UI_trait_grandmotherdesc.ch: 你的燉鍋是街坊間的傳奇. 你加入料理的每種食材提供的蛋白質, 熱量與飽足感增加 10%%.
UI_trait_grandmotherdesc.cn: 你的炖锅是街坊间的传奇. 你加入料理的每种食材提供的蛋白质, 热量和饱腹感增加 10%%.

UI_trait_hemophiliadesc.en: Oddly, blood soothes you instead of terrifying you. Blood on you, your clothes or weapons removes unhappiness, stress and fear, the exact opposite of hemophobia.
UI_trait_hemophiliadesc.ch: 說也奇怪, 血液非但不讓你害怕, 反而讓你平靜. 你身上, 衣物或武器上的血跡會消除不快樂, 壓力與恐懼, 與怕血正好相反.
UI_trait_hemophiliadesc.cn: 说也奇怪, 血液非但不让你害怕, 反而让你平静. 你身上, 衣物或武器上的血迹会消除不开心, 压力和恐惧, 与恐惧血液正好相反.

UI_trait_herodesc.en: When a group of zombies grabs a player, you can shove them ALL with a single shove (up to 10 in one push), with a 100%% chance of knocking them to the ground.
UI_trait_herodesc.ch: 當一群殭屍抓住某位玩家時, 你只要推一下就能把牠們「全部」推開 (一次最多 10 隻), 且有 100%% 機率將牠們推倒在地.
UI_trait_herodesc.cn: 当一群僵尸抓住某位玩家时, 你只要推一下就能把它们“全部”推开 (一次最多 10 只), 并且有 100%% 几率将它们推倒在地.

UI_trait_individualistdesc.en: Every person for themselves. If a group of zombies grabs a player within 8 cells of you, you deal 95%% less damage and gain maximum panic and stress. It only goes away if you leave or the player dies.
UI_trait_individualistdesc.ch: 人人自掃門前雪. 若一群殭屍抓住你 8 格範圍內的玩家, 你造成的傷害減少 95%%, 且恐慌與壓力會升到最高. 只有在你離開或該玩家死亡時才會消失.
UI_trait_individualistdesc.cn: 人人自扫门前雪. 如果一群僵尸抓住你 8 格范围内的玩家, 你造成的伤害减少 95%%, 并且恐慌和压力会升到最高. 只有在你离开或该玩家死亡时才会消失.

UI_trait_introvertdesc.en: Crowds drain you. You gain stress while within 4 cells of other players (20%% every half hour).
UI_trait_introvertdesc.ch: 人群讓你筋疲力盡. 當你位於其他玩家 4 格範圍內時, 會增加壓力 (每半小時 20%%).
UI_trait_introvertdesc.cn: 人群让你筋疲力尽. 当你位于其他玩家 4 格范围内时, 会增加压力 (每半小时 20%%).

UI_trait_irresponsibledriverdesc.en: Driving gives you a moment of clarity: your drunkenness is suppressed while you drive, but the party goes on once you stop.
UI_trait_irresponsibledriverdesc.ch: 開車讓你頭腦清醒片刻: 駕駛時你的醉意會被壓制, 但一停車派對就繼續.
UI_trait_irresponsibledriverdesc.cn: 开车让你头脑清醒片刻: 驾驶时你的醉意会被压制, 但一停车派对就继续.

UI_trait_knoximmunedesc.en: The virus seeks your body but never finds it. Zombification reaches 90%% and is fully removed: you never turn.
UI_trait_knoximmunedesc.ch: 病毒想找上你的身體, 卻始終找不到. 殭屍化會到達 90%% 後完全清除: 你永遠不會屍變.
UI_trait_knoximmunedesc.cn: 病毒想找上你的身体, 却始终找不到. 僵尸化会达到 90%% 后完全清除: 你永远不会尸变.

UI_trait_knoxvulnerabledesc.en: Your body is a poor host for the virus. Zombification increases twice as fast.
UI_trait_knoxvulnerabledesc.ch: 你的身體是病毒的糟糕宿主. 殭屍化的速度加倍.
UI_trait_knoxvulnerabledesc.cn: 你的身体是病毒的糟糕宿主. 僵尸化的速度翻倍.

UI_trait_leisurewriterdesc.en: Your imagination makes the apocalypse more bearable. You can write leisure books, magazines and comics that remove between 5%% and 40%% unhappiness, stress and boredom (each state with its own random chance). Books consume an empty notebook, 1 thread use and 3 leather strips; magazines and comics consume a notebook or 5 sheets of paper. A pencil is required but not consumed, and you can name your works when you finish them.
UI_trait_leisurewriterdesc.ch: 你的想像力讓末日變得比較好熬. 你可以撰寫消遣書籍, 雜誌與漫畫, 可消除 5%% 至 40%% 的不快樂, 壓力與無聊 (每種狀態各自隨機). 書籍消耗一本空白筆記本, 1 次線的用量與 3 條皮革條; 雜誌與漫畫消耗一本筆記本或 5 張紙. 需要鉛筆, 但不會消耗, 完成作品時還可以為其命名.
UI_trait_leisurewriterdesc.cn: 你的想象力让末日变得比较好熬. 你可以撰写消遣书籍, 杂志和漫画, 可消除 5%% 至 40%% 的不开心, 压力和无聊 (每种状态各自随机). 书籍消耗一本空白笔记本, 1 次线的用量和 3 条皮革条; 杂志和漫画消耗一本笔记本或 5 张纸. 需要铅笔, 但不会消耗, 完成作品时还可以为其命名.

UI_trait_manadmirerdesc.en: You have a weakness for them, even zombies. You deal 15%% less damage to male zombies and gain 8%% stress and unhappiness for each one you kill.
UI_trait_manadmirerdesc.ch: 你對他們毫無抵抗力, 連殭屍也不例外. 你對男性殭屍造成的傷害減少 15%%, 每殺死一隻就增加 8%% 的壓力與不快樂.
UI_trait_manadmirerdesc.cn: 你对他们毫无抵抗力, 连僵尸也不例外. 你对男性僵尸造成的伤害减少 15%%, 每杀死一只就增加 8%% 的压力和不开心.

UI_trait_manhaterdesc.en: Men set your nerves on edge, alive or dead. You deal 10%% more damage to male zombies and lose 2%% stress and unhappiness for each one you kill.
UI_trait_manhaterdesc.ch: 無論死活, 男人都讓你神經緊繃. 你對男性殭屍造成的傷害增加 10%%, 每殺死一隻就減少 2%% 的壓力與不快樂.
UI_trait_manhaterdesc.cn: 无论死活, 男人都让你神经紧绷. 你对男性僵尸造成的伤害增加 10%%, 每杀死一只就减少 2%% 的压力和不开心.

UI_trait_medicalloverdesc.en: Healing others gives you a will to live. Performing first aid, on yourself or others, removes 5%% unhappiness, stress and boredom per action.
UI_trait_medicalloverdesc.ch: 治療他人讓你有了活下去的意志. 進行急救時, 無論對象是自己或他人, 每次動作都會消除 5%% 的不快樂, 壓力與無聊.
UI_trait_medicalloverdesc.cn: 治疗他人让你有了活下去的意志. 进行急救时, 无论对象是自己还是他人, 每次动作都会消除 5%% 的不开心, 压力和无聊.

UI_trait_medicalphobiadesc.en: Just seeing bandages turns you the color of death. Performing first aid, on yourself or others, increases 5%% unhappiness, stress and boredom per action.
UI_trait_medicalphobiadesc.ch: 光是看到繃帶就讓你臉色慘白如死. 進行急救時, 無論對象是自己或他人, 每次動作都會增加 5%% 的不快樂, 壓力與無聊.
UI_trait_medicalphobiadesc.cn: 光是看到绷带就让你脸色惨白如死. 进行急救时, 无论对象是自己还是他人, 每次动作都会增加 5%% 的不开心, 压力和无聊.

UI_trait_mentordesc.en: Your experience is contagious. Players within 4 cells of you gain 20%% more skill multiplier, but only on skills where you are at least two levels ahead of them.
UI_trait_mentordesc.ch: 你的經驗具有感染力. 你 4 格範圍內的玩家獲得的技能倍率增加 20%%, 但僅限於你領先他們至少兩級的技能.
UI_trait_mentordesc.cn: 你的经验具有感染力. 你 4 格范围内的玩家获得的技能倍率增加 20%%, 但仅限于你领先他们至少两级的技能.

UI_trait_nightlorddesc.en: You transform at sunset. From 10 pm to 4 am, your unhappiness and boredom can only reach 25%%.
UI_trait_nightlorddesc.ch: 日落時你判若兩人. 晚上 10 點至凌晨 4 點, 你的不快樂與無聊最多只會達到 25%%.
UI_trait_nightlorddesc.cn: 日落时你判若两人. 晚上 10 点至凌晨 4 点, 你的不开心和无聊最多只会达到 25%%.

UI_trait_physicallyfitdesc.en: Your engine never knows exhaustion. You never suffer muscle fatigue: that mechanic is off for you.
UI_trait_physicallyfitdesc.ch: 你的引擎從不知疲憊. 你永遠不會肌肉疲勞: 此機制對你停用.
UI_trait_physicallyfitdesc.cn: 你的引擎从不知疲惫. 你永远不会肌肉疲劳: 此机制对你关闭.

UI_trait_poorconditiondesc.en: Your body overheats at the slightest effort. Muscle fatigue grows twice as fast.
UI_trait_poorconditiondesc.ch: 稍一用力你的身體就過熱. 肌肉疲勞累積速度加倍.
UI_trait_poorconditiondesc.cn: 稍一用力你的身体就过热. 肌肉疲劳累积速度翻倍.

UI_trait_readinghaterdesc.en: Texts get on your nerves: reading only gets you worked up. No leisure book removes negative states (magazines aside) and reading any kind of book gives 10%% stress, 10%% boredom and 10%% unhappiness.
UI_trait_readinghaterdesc.ch: 文字讓你心煩: 閱讀只會讓你更焦躁. 消遣書籍無法消除任何負面狀態 (雜誌除外), 且閱讀任何種類的書都會增加 10%% 壓力, 10%% 無聊與 10%% 不快樂.
UI_trait_readinghaterdesc.cn: 文字让你心烦: 阅读只会让你更焦躁. 消遣书籍无法消除任何负面状态 (杂志除外), 并且阅读任何种类的书都会增加 10%% 压力, 10%% 无聊和 10%% 不开心.

UI_trait_reliablechauffeurdesc.en: You drive with a steady hand and checked seatbelts. Passengers of the vehicle you drive take half the damage from accidents (you still take full damage).
UI_trait_reliablechauffeurdesc.ch: 你開車手穩, 安全帶也都確認過. 你駕駛的車輛中, 乘客受到的事故傷害減半 (你自己仍承受全額傷害).
UI_trait_reliablechauffeurdesc.cn: 你开车手稳, 安全带也都确认过. 你驾驶的车辆中, 乘客受到的事故伤害减半 (你自己仍承受全额伤害).

UI_trait_rubberlegsdesc.en: You fall like a cat and get up like one. Falls from any height deal 50%% less damage.
UI_trait_rubberlegsdesc.ch: 你像貓一樣落地, 也像貓一樣起身. 從任何高度摔落造成的傷害減少 50%%.
UI_trait_rubberlegsdesc.cn: 你像猫一样落地, 也像猫一样起身. 从任何高度摔落造成的伤害减少 50%%.

UI_trait_smokinghaterdesc.en: Tobacco smoke turns your stomach. Smoking gives 15%% nausea and unhappiness per cigarette.
UI_trait_smokinghaterdesc.ch: 菸草的煙味讓你反胃. 每抽一根菸會增加 15%% 的噁心與不快樂.
UI_trait_smokinghaterdesc.cn: 烟草的烟味让你反胃. 每抽一根烟会增加 15%% 的恶心和不开心.

UI_trait_spaghettilegsdesc.en: Your legs give way at any fall. Falls from any height deal 20%% more damage.
UI_trait_spaghettilegsdesc.ch: 你的雙腿一摔就軟. 從任何高度摔落造成的傷害增加 20%%.
UI_trait_spaghettilegsdesc.cn: 你的双腿一摔就软. 从任何高度摔落造成的伤害增加 20%%.

UI_trait_squeamishdesc.en: Your stomach is delicate and any stench turns you. Bad smells raise the 'something smells bad' state twice as fast.
UI_trait_squeamishdesc.ch: 你的胃很敏感, 任何惡臭都讓你作嘔. 難聞的氣味使「有東西很臭」狀態上升速度加倍.
UI_trait_squeamishdesc.cn: 你的胃很敏感, 任何恶臭都让你作呕. 难闻的气味使“有东西很臭”状态上升速度翻倍.

UI_trait_survivorolfactiondesc.en: Nothing beats your hardened nose. Bad smells do not affect you: the 'something smells bad' state never rises, under any circumstance.
UI_trait_survivorolfactiondesc.ch: 沒有什麼比得上你久經磨練的鼻子. 難聞的氣味對你毫無影響: 「有東西很臭」狀態在任何情況下都不會上升.
UI_trait_survivorolfactiondesc.cn: 没有什么比得上你久经磨练的鼻子. 难闻的气味对你毫无影响: “有东西很臭”状态在任何情况下都不会上升.

UI_trait_thebeastdesc.en: Nobody withstands your shove. Pushing zombies knocks them 20%% to 80%% further back (random) and they have 25%% more chances of falling.
UI_trait_thebeastdesc.ch: 沒人擋得住你的推擊. 推開殭屍時, 擊退距離增加 20%% 至 80%% (隨機), 且牠們倒地的機率增加 25%%.
UI_trait_thebeastdesc.cn: 没人挡得住你的推击. 推开僵尸时, 击退距离增加 20%% 至 80%% (随机), 并且它们倒地的几率增加 25%%.

UI_trait_thriftydesc.en: You know how to squeeze everything to the last drop. Your drainables are spent once every two uses: they last twice as long.
UI_trait_thriftydesc.ch: 你懂得把每樣東西用到最後一滴. 你的消耗品每使用兩次才消耗一次: 能用兩倍久.
UI_trait_thriftydesc.cn: 你懂得把每样东西用到最后一滴. 你的消耗品每使用两次才消耗一次: 能用两倍久.

UI_trait_uncomfortabledesc.en: Nothing fits as it should. Every piece of equipment and clothing is 50%% more uncomfortable than normal.
UI_trait_uncomfortabledesc.ch: 沒有一樣東西合身. 每件裝備與衣物都比平常不舒適 50%%.
UI_trait_uncomfortabledesc.cn: 没有一样东西合身. 每件装备和衣物都比平常不舒适 50%%.

UI_trait_unfriendlydesc.en: Your presence sours everyone around you. Players within 4 cells of you gradually gain unhappiness and stress (10%% every half hour).
UI_trait_unfriendlydesc.ch: 你的存在讓身邊所有人都不痛快. 你 4 格範圍內的玩家會逐漸增加不快樂與壓力 (每半小時 10%%).
UI_trait_unfriendlydesc.cn: 你的存在让身边所有人都不痛快. 你 4 格范围内的玩家会逐渐增加不开心和压力 (每半小时 10%%).

UI_trait_vaindesc.en: Your image is everything and you draw on it in adversity. While made up, your stress and unhappiness cannot exceed 50%%.
UI_trait_vaindesc.ch: 形象就是一切, 逆境中你靠它撐下去. 化妝時, 你的壓力與不快樂不會超過 50%%.
UI_trait_vaindesc.cn: 形象就是一切, 逆境中你靠它撑下去. 化妆时, 你的压力和不开心不会超过 50%%.

UI_trait_vegetariandesc.en: The smell of meat disgusts you. Eating meat or anything containing it has no positive effect and also gives 30%% stress and unhappiness.
UI_trait_vegetariandesc.ch: 肉的氣味讓你作嘔. 食用肉類或任何含肉的食物不會帶來任何正面效果, 還會增加 30%% 的壓力與不快樂.
UI_trait_vegetariandesc.cn: 肉的气味让你作呕. 食用肉类或任何含肉的食物不会带来任何正面效果, 还会增加 30%% 的压力和不开心.

UI_trait_wastefuldesc.en: Everything slips through your fingers. Your drainables are spent two at a time instead of one: they last half as long.
UI_trait_wastefuldesc.ch: 什麼東西都會從你指縫間溜走. 你的消耗品每次消耗兩份而非一份: 只能用一半的時間.
UI_trait_wastefuldesc.cn: 什么东西都会从你指缝间溜走. 你的消耗品每次消耗两份而非一份: 只能用一半的时间.

UI_trait_weaklingdesc.en: Your arms could not lift a shadow. Pushing zombies has 70%% fewer chances of knocking them down.
UI_trait_weaklingdesc.ch: 你的手臂連影子都舉不起來. 推開殭屍時將牠們推倒的機率減少 70%%.
UI_trait_weaklingdesc.cn: 你的手臂连影子都举不起来. 推开僵尸时将它们推倒的几率减少 70%%.

UI_trait_womanadmirerdesc.en: You have a weakness for them, even zombies. You deal 15%% less damage to female zombies and gain 8%% stress and unhappiness for each one you kill.
UI_trait_womanadmirerdesc.ch: 你對她們毫無抵抗力, 連殭屍也不例外. 你對女性殭屍造成的傷害減少 15%%, 每殺死一隻就增加 8%% 的壓力與不快樂.
UI_trait_womanadmirerdesc.cn: 你对她们毫无抵抗力, 连僵尸也不例外. 你对女性僵尸造成的伤害减少 15%%, 每杀死一只就增加 8%% 的压力和不开心.

UI_trait_womanhaterdesc.en: Women set your nerves on edge, alive or dead. You deal 10%% more damage to female zombies and lose 2%% stress and unhappiness for each one you kill.
UI_trait_womanhaterdesc.ch: 無論死活, 女人都讓你神經緊繃. 你對女性殭屍造成的傷害增加 10%%, 每殺死一隻就減少 2%% 的壓力與不快樂.
UI_trait_womanhaterdesc.cn: 无论死活, 女人都让你神经紧绷. 你对女性僵尸造成的伤害增加 10%%, 每杀死一只就减少 2%% 的压力和不开心.

UI_trait_worsttailordesc.en: Your hands were not meant for a needle. Repairing or patching clothes uses twice the thread and scraps.
UI_trait_worsttailordesc.ch: 你的手天生就不是拿針的料. 修補或縫補衣物時, 消耗的線與布料加倍.
UI_trait_worsttailordesc.cn: 你的手天生就不是拿针的料. 修补或缝补衣物时, 消耗的线和布料翻倍.

UI_optionscreen_binding_UseLaser_Toggle.ch: 切換槍械雷射瞄準器開關
UI_optionscreen_binding_UseLaser_Toggle.cn: 切换枪械激光瞄准器开关

UI_trait_LegendaryWelderApprenticeDesc.en: Apprentice in the art of welding.

UI_trait_LegendaryWelderExpertDesc.en: Expert in the art of welding.

UI_trait_LegendaryWelderMasterDesc.en: Legendary master in the art of welding.

UI_AA_farm_done.en: Farming done: %1 harvested, %2 watered, %3 treated, %4 sown.
UI_AA_farm_done.ch: 農耕完成: 收穫%1, 澆水%2, 治療%3, 播種%4.
UI_AA_farm_done.cn: 农耕完成: 收获%1, 浇水%2, 治疗%3, 播种%4.

UI_AA_farm_heavy.en: Stopped: the harvest is getting too heavy.
UI_AA_farm_heavy.ch: 已停止: 收成太重了.
UI_AA_farm_heavy.cn: 已停止: 收成太重了.

UI_AA_farm_nothing.en: Nothing to do on these crops right now.
UI_AA_farm_nothing.ch: 這些作物目前沒有需要處理的事.
UI_AA_farm_nothing.cn: 这些作物目前没有需要处理的事.

UI_AA_farm_nowater.en: Stopped: out of water and no source in reach.
UI_AA_farm_nowater.ch: 已停止: 水用完了, 附近也沒有水源.
UI_AA_farm_nowater.cn: 已停止: 水用完了, 附近也没有水源.

UI_AA_farm_tend_tt.en: Harvests, treats and waters every crop within %1 tiles, nearest first. What it does is set in Mod Options.
UI_AA_farm_tend_tt.ch: 由近到遠, 收穫、治療並澆灌%1格內的所有作物. 具體執行哪些工作可在模組選項中設定.
UI_AA_farm_tend_tt.cn: 由近及远, 收获、治疗并浇灌%1格内的所有作物. 具体执行哪些工作可在模组选项中设置.

UI_AA_fish_nets_done.ch: 已檢查漁網: %1. 已補餌漁網: %2.
UI_AA_fish_nets_done.cn: 已检查渔网: %1. 已补饵渔网: %2.

UI_AA_fish_nets_nothing.ch: 目前還沒有需要檢查的漁網.
UI_AA_fish_nets_nothing.cn: 目前还没有需要检查的渔网.

UI_AA_fish_nets_tt.en: Checks every net that has waited at least an hour and re-baits empty ones with Chum.
UI_AA_fish_nets_tt.ch: 檢查每張已放置至少一小時的漁網, 並用散餌為空漁網補餌.
UI_AA_fish_nets_tt.cn: 检查每张已放置至少一小时的渔网, 并用散饵为空渔网补饵.

UI_AA_fish_nohook.en: The rod has no hook - fish will not bite without one.
UI_AA_fish_nohook.ch: 釣竿沒有魚鉤 - 沒有魚鉤, 魚不會上鉤.
UI_AA_fish_nohook.cn: 鱼竿没有鱼钩 - 没有鱼钩, 鱼不会上钩.

UI_AA_fish_nolure.ch: 魚餌用完了. 釣到%1條.
UI_AA_fish_nolure.cn: 鱼饵用完了. 钓到%1条.

UI_AA_fish_nowater.en: No water to cast at between 4 and 14 tiles away.
UI_AA_fish_nowater.ch: 4到14格範圍內沒有可以拋竿的水域.
UI_AA_fish_nowater.cn: 4到14格范围内没有可以抛竿的水域.

UI_AA_fish_rod_lost.en: Fishing stopped: the rod is gone (did the line snap?). %1 caught.
UI_AA_fish_rod_lost.ch: 釣魚停止: 釣竿不見了 (可能是斷線了). 釣到%1條.
UI_AA_fish_rod_lost.cn: 钓鱼停止: 鱼竿不见了 (可能是断线了). 钓到%1条.

UI_AA_fish_rod_tt.en: Casts, waits for a bite, reels in carefully and re-baits the hook between casts. Moving or pressing ESC stops it.
UI_AA_fish_rod_tt.ch: 拋竿、等待魚上鉤、小心收線, 並在每次拋竿之間重新掛餌. 移動或按 ESC 鍵即可停止.
UI_AA_fish_rod_tt.cn: 抛竿、等待鱼上钩、小心收线, 并在每次抛竿之间重新挂饵. 移动或按 ESC 键即可停止.

UI_AA_fish_unsupported.en: The game's fishing code was not found - rod fishing is unavailable.
UI_AA_fish_unsupported.ch: 找不到遊戲的釣魚程式碼 - 無法使用釣竿釣魚.
UI_AA_fish_unsupported.cn: 找不到游戏的钓鱼代码 - 无法使用鱼竿钓鱼.

UI_AA_gen_done.ch: 已修理發電機: %1. 已使用電子零件: %2.
UI_AA_gen_done.cn: 已修理发电机: %1. 已使用电子废料: %2.

UI_AA_gen_noscrap.en: Out of Electronics Scrap. Generators repaired: %1.
UI_AA_gen_noscrap.ch: 電子零件用完了. 已修理發電機: %1.
UI_AA_gen_noscrap.cn: 电子废料用完了. 已修理发电机: %1.

UI_AA_gen_nothing.ch: 附近沒有受損的發電機.
UI_AA_gen_nothing.cn: 附近没有受损的发电机.

UI_AA_gen_running.en: A running generator cannot be repaired - switch it off first.
UI_AA_gen_running.ch: 運轉中的發電機無法修理 - 請先關閉它.
UI_AA_gen_running.cn: 运行中的发电机无法修理 - 请先关闭它.

UI_AA_gen_tt_toggle.en: It is running: it will be switched off for the repair and back on afterwards.
UI_AA_gen_tt_toggle.ch: 發電機正在運轉: 修理時會先關閉, 修好後再重新開啟.
UI_AA_gen_tt_toggle.cn: 发电机正在运行: 修理时会先关闭, 修好后再重新开启.

UI_AA_logs_full.en: The container is full. Logs hauled: %1.
UI_AA_logs_full.ch: 容器已滿. 已搬運原木: %1.
UI_AA_logs_full.cn: 容器已满. 已搬运原木: %1.

UI_AA_logs_notallowed.en: This container does not take logs.

UI_AA_logs_tt.en: Carries the logs lying within %1 tiles into this container, as many per trip as you can carry.
UI_AA_logs_tt.ch: 把%1格內散落的原木搬進這個容器, 每趟都搬你拿得動的最大量.
UI_AA_logs_tt.cn: 把%1格内散落的原木搬进这个容器, 每趟都搬你拿得动的最大量.

UI_AA_logs_unreachable.en: Could not reach the container. Logs hauled: %1.
UI_AA_logs_unreachable.ch: 無法抵達容器. 已搬運原木: %1.
UI_AA_logs_unreachable.cn: 无法到达容器. 已搬运原木: %1.

UI_AA_opt_farmCure_tt.en: Sprays mildew, flies, aphids and slugs with the matching treatment, when you carry one.
UI_AA_opt_farmCure_tt.ch: 身上帶有對應的防治藥劑時, 會對白粉病、蒼蠅、蚜蟲和蛞蝓噴灑.
UI_AA_opt_farmCure_tt.cn: 身上带有对应的防治药剂时, 会对白粉病、苍蝇、蚜虫和蛞蝓喷洒.

UI_AA_opt_farmHarvest_tt.en: Harvests every crop that is ready. The job stops when the produce gets too heavy, so you decide where it goes.
UI_AA_opt_farmHarvest_tt.ch: 收穫所有可收成的作物. 收成太重時作業會停止, 讓你自己決定要放到哪裡.
UI_AA_opt_farmHarvest_tt.cn: 收获所有可收获的作物. 收成太重时作业会停止, 让你自己决定要放到哪里.

UI_AA_opt_farmReach_tt.en: How far from the clicked crop the job works. Every plot inside it is tended, nearest first.
UI_AA_opt_farmReach_tt.ch: 以點選的作物為中心的作業範圍. 範圍內的每塊田地都會由近到遠照料.
UI_AA_opt_farmReach_tt.cn: 以点击的作物为中心的作业范围. 范围内的每块田地都会由近及远照料.

UI_AA_opt_farmRefill.en: Refill water at a nearby source

UI_AA_opt_farmRefill_tt.en: When the watering can runs dry it is refilled at the nearest rain barrel, sink or well inside the farm radius.
UI_AA_opt_farmRefill_tt.ch: 澆水壺中的水用完時, 會到農耕半徑內最近的集雨桶、洗手台或水井補水.
UI_AA_opt_farmRefill_tt.cn: 洒水壶里的水用完时, 会到农耕半径内最近的雨水收集桶、水池或水井补水.

UI_AA_opt_farmSowSeason.en: Only sow seeds that are in season

UI_AA_opt_farmSowSeason_tt.en: When the server plays with growing seasons, seeds out of season are greyed out in the menu.
UI_AA_opt_farmSowSeason_tt.ch: 伺服器啟用生長季節時, 非當季的種子在選單中會顯示為灰色.
UI_AA_opt_farmSowSeason_tt.cn: 服务器启用生长季节时, 非当季的种子在菜单中会显示为灰色.

UI_AA_opt_farmSow_tt.en: Adds 'Sow empty furrows with...' entries for the seeds you carry. The plain 'Tend crops' entry never sows.
UI_AA_opt_farmSow_tt.ch: 為你攜帶的種子加入「在空的種植地播種…」選項. 一般的「照料附近的作物」選項永遠不會播種.
UI_AA_opt_farmSow_tt.cn: 为你携带的种子添加“在空犁沟中播种…”选项. 普通的“照料附近的作物”选项永远不会播种.

UI_AA_opt_farmWater_tt.en: Waters a plant when it is below its own water need, and never above its own maximum - overwatering hurts plants in the base game too.
UI_AA_opt_farmWater_tt.ch: 植物水分低於自身需求時才澆水, 而且絕不超過其上限 - 在原版遊戲中澆太多水同樣會傷害植物.
UI_AA_opt_farmWater_tt.cn: 植物水分低于自身需求时才浇水, 而且绝不超过其上限 - 在原版游戏中浇水过多同样会伤害植物.

UI_AA_opt_fishMax_tt.en: 0 keeps fishing until the bait runs out or you stop it.
UI_AA_opt_fishMax_tt.ch: 設為0則會一直釣, 直到魚餌用完或你手動停止.
UI_AA_opt_fishMax_tt.cn: 设为0则会一直钓, 直到鱼饵用完或你手动停止.

UI_AA_opt_fishNetBait_tt.en: A net whose bait has run out gets Chum from your inventory - the only bait a net takes.
UI_AA_opt_fishNetBait_tt.ch: 魚餌用完的漁網會從你的物品欄補上散餌 - 這是漁網唯一能用的魚餌.
UI_AA_opt_fishNetBait_tt.cn: 鱼饵用完的渔网会从你的物品栏补上散饵 - 这是渔网唯一能用的鱼饵.

UI_AA_opt_fishReach_tt.en: How far from where you click placed fishing nets are looked for.
UI_AA_opt_fishReach_tt.ch: 以點選位置為中心, 搜尋已放置漁網的範圍.
UI_AA_opt_fishReach_tt.cn: 以点击位置为中心, 搜索已放置渔网的范围.

UI_AA_opt_fishRod_tt.en: Fishes with your rod: casts, waits for a bite, reels in and re-baits the hook between casts. It plays the game's own fishing minigame, carefully - a fish can still get away.
UI_AA_opt_fishRod_tt.ch: 用你的釣竿釣魚: 拋竿、等待魚上鉤、收線, 並在每次拋竿之間重新掛餌. 它會謹慎地玩遊戲本身的釣魚小遊戲 - 魚還是有可能跑掉.
UI_AA_opt_fishRod_tt.cn: 用你的鱼竿钓鱼: 抛竿、等待鱼上钩、收线, 并在每次抛竿之间重新挂饵. 它会谨慎地玩游戏自带的钓鱼小游戏 - 鱼还是有可能跑掉.

UI_AA_opt_genFixAll.ch: 修理附近所有受損的發電機
UI_AA_opt_genFixAll.cn: 修理附近所有受损的发电机

UI_AA_opt_genFixAll_tt.en: One click repairs every generator below 100% within reach, nearest first. Off: only the generator you clicked.
UI_AA_opt_genFixAll_tt.ch: 點一下就由近到遠修理附近所有低於100%%的發電機. 關閉: 只修理你點選的發電機.
UI_AA_opt_genFixAll_tt.cn: 点一下就由近及远修理附近所有低于100%%的发电机. 关闭: 只修理你点击的发电机.

UI_AA_opt_genReach_tt.en: How far from the clicked generator other damaged generators are looked for.
UI_AA_opt_genReach_tt.ch: 以點選的發電機為中心, 搜尋其他受損發電機的範圍.
UI_AA_opt_genReach_tt.cn: 以点击的发电机为中心, 搜索其他受损发电机的范围.

UI_AA_opt_genReturnItems.ch: 把未用完的電子零件放回去
UI_AA_opt_genReturnItems.cn: 把未用完的电子废料放回去

UI_AA_opt_genReturnItems_tt.en: Electronics Scrap fetched from crates or the floor and not used goes back where it came from.
UI_AA_opt_genReturnItems_tt.ch: 從箱子或地上拿來但沒用到的電子零件會放回原處.
UI_AA_opt_genReturnItems_tt.cn: 从箱子或地上拿来但没用到的电子废料会放回原处.

UI_AA_opt_genToggle.en: Switch a running generator off for the repair
UI_AA_opt_genToggle.ch: 修理時關閉運轉中的發電機
UI_AA_opt_genToggle.cn: 修理时关闭运行中的发电机

UI_AA_opt_genToggle_tt.en: The game will not repair a running generator. With this on it is switched off, repaired and switched back on - even if the job is stopped early. Off: running generators are skipped.
UI_AA_opt_genToggle_tt.ch: 遊戲不允許修理運轉中的發電機. 開啟後會先關閉發電機, 進行修理, 再重新開啟 - 即使作業提前停止, 仍會重新開啟. 關閉: 跳過運轉中的發電機.

UI_trait_AlcoholicMildDesc.en:
You are mildly dependent on alcohol.
Drinking enough resets withdrawal, while stronger intoxication steadily reduces stress and panic.
After a sober delay, withdrawal gradually rises to mild severity and remains there. It continuously builds stress that cannot be relieved while withdrawal is active, and may cause sickness, headaches, temperature swings, disturbed sleep, screams, or shaky hands that drop held items. Withdrawal timing and effect chances are configurable.
UI_trait_AlcoholicMildDesc.ch:
你對酒精有輕度依賴.
喝足夠的酒可重置戒斷, 醉意更深時則會穩定減輕壓力與恐慌.
清醒一段時間後, 戒斷會逐漸升至輕度並維持在該程度. 戒斷期間會持續累積無法緩解的壓力, 並可能造成噁心、頭痛、體溫波動、睡眠受擾、尖叫, 或雙手顫抖而掉落手持物品. 戒斷時程與各效果機率皆可調整.
UI_trait_AlcoholicMildDesc.cn:
你对酒精有轻度依赖.
喝够酒可以重置戒断, 而醉得更深时会持续减轻压力和恐慌.
清醒一段时间后, 戒断会逐渐升至轻度并保持在该程度. 戒断期间会持续积累无法缓解的压力, 并可能导致恶心、头痛、体温波动、睡眠受扰、尖叫, 或双手颤抖而掉落手持物品. 戒断时间和各效果几率均可配置.

UI_trait_AlcoholicModerateDesc.en:
You are moderately dependent on alcohol.
Drinking enough resets withdrawal, while stronger intoxication steadily reduces stress and panic.
After a sober delay, withdrawal gradually rises through mild to moderate severity, holds at its peak, then subsides to persistent mild withdrawal. It continuously builds stress that cannot be relieved while withdrawal is active, and may cause sickness, headaches, temperature swings, disturbed sleep, screams, or shaky hands that drop held items. Withdrawal timing and effect chances are configurable.
UI_trait_AlcoholicModerateDesc.ch:
你對酒精有中度依賴.
喝足夠的酒可重置戒斷, 醉意更深時則會穩定減輕壓力與恐慌.
清醒一段時間後, 戒斷會由輕度逐漸升至中度, 在高峰維持一段時間後, 再消退為持續的輕度戒斷. 戒斷期間會持續累積無法緩解的壓力, 並可能造成噁心、頭痛、體溫波動、睡眠受擾、尖叫, 或雙手顫抖而掉落手持物品. 戒斷時程與各效果機率皆可調整.
UI_trait_AlcoholicModerateDesc.cn:
你对酒精有中度依赖.
喝够酒可以重置戒断, 而醉得更深时会持续减轻压力和恐慌.
清醒一段时间后, 戒断会从轻度逐渐升至中度, 在峰值维持一段时间后, 再消退为持续的轻度戒断. 戒断期间会持续积累无法缓解的压力, 并可能导致恶心、头痛、体温波动、睡眠受扰、尖叫, 或双手颤抖而掉落手持物品. 戒断时间和各效果几率均可配置.

UI_trait_AlcoholicSevereDesc.en:
You are severely dependent on alcohol.
Drinking enough resets withdrawal, while stronger intoxication steadily reduces stress and panic.
After a sober delay, withdrawal gradually rises through mild and moderate to severe intensity, holds at its peak, then subsides to persistent moderate withdrawal. It continuously builds stress that cannot be relieved while withdrawal is active, and may cause sickness, headaches, temperature swings, disturbed sleep, screams, or shaky hands that drop held items. Withdrawal timing and effect chances are configurable.
UI_trait_AlcoholicSevereDesc.ch:
你對酒精有重度依賴.
喝足夠的酒可重置戒斷, 醉意更深時則會穩定減輕壓力與恐慌.
清醒一段時間後, 戒斷會由輕度、中度逐漸升至重度, 在高峰維持一段時間後, 再消退為持續的中度戒斷. 戒斷期間會持續累積無法緩解的壓力, 並可能造成噁心、頭痛、體溫波動、睡眠受擾、尖叫, 或雙手顫抖而掉落手持物品. 戒斷時程與各效果機率皆可調整.
UI_trait_AlcoholicSevereDesc.cn:
你对酒精有重度依赖.
喝够酒可以重置戒断, 而醉得更深时会持续减轻压力和恐慌.
清醒一段时间后, 戒断会从轻度、中度逐渐升至重度, 在峰值维持一段时间后, 再消退为持续的中度戒断. 戒断期间会持续积累无法缓解的压力, 并可能导致恶心、头痛、体温波动、睡眠受扰、尖叫, 或双手颤抖而掉落手持物品. 戒断时间和各效果几率均可配置.

UI_trait_GymHaterDesc.en:

UI_trait_GymHaterDesc.ch:
你特別討厭在健身房鍛鍊, 寧可用其他任何方式鍛鍊肌肉.
目前等級進度介於 5%% 到 95%% 之間時, 鍛鍊 (伏地挺身、波比跳等) 獲得的體格與力量經驗值減半, 且鍛鍊疲勞的累積預設加倍.
UI_trait_GymHaterDesc.cn:
你特别讨厌在健身房锻炼, 宁愿用其他任何方式锻炼肌肉.
当前等级进度介于 5%% 到 95%% 之间时, 锻炼 (俯卧撑、波比跳等) 获得的体格与力量经验值减半, 且锻炼疲劳的积累默认翻倍.

UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortFreezing2.cn: 冻伤可不是配饰, 亲爱的.

UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortFreezing3.en: Even the zombies would put on a coat.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortFreezing3.ch: 連殭屍都會想穿件外套.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortFreezing3.cn: 连僵尸都会想穿件外套.

UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortHot.en: Way too hot. Peel something off before you melt.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortHot.ch: 太熱了. 在融化之前先脫掉幾件吧.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortHot.cn: 太热了. 在融化之前先脱掉几件吧.

UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortHot2.en: Sweating buckets. Less is more today.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortHot2.ch: 汗如雨下. 今天穿得越少越好.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortHot2.cn: 汗如雨下. 今天穿得越少越好.

UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortHot3.en: Overdressed for this heat, and not in the fun way.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortHot3.ch: 這種熱天穿太多了, 而且一點都不好玩.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortHot3.cn: 这么热的天穿太多了, 而且一点都不好玩.

UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortVeryCold.en: Goosebumps everywhere, and not the fun kind.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortVeryCold.ch: 全身起雞皮疙瘩, 而且不是令人心動的那種.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortVeryCold.cn: 浑身起鸡皮疙瘩, 而且不是让人心动的那种.

UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortVeryCold2.en: Gorgeous, but the cold is getting very personal.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortVeryCold2.ch: 美是美, 但寒意已經直往身上鑽了.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortVeryCold2.cn: 美是美, 但寒意已经直往身上钻了.

UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortVeryCold3.en: Add a layer. Or three. Or a warm someone.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortVeryCold3.ch: 加一件吧. 或三件. 或找個暖呼呼的人.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortVeryCold3.cn: 加一件吧. 或者三件. 或者找个暖乎乎的人.

UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortWarm.en: Toasty. Lose a layer, nobody will complain.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortWarm.ch: 暖烘烘的. 脫掉一件吧, 沒人會抱怨的.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortWarm.cn: 暖烘烘的. 脱掉一件吧, 没人会有意见的.

UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortWarm2.en: Getting warm in here. Unbutton something.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortWarm2.ch: 這裡變熱了. 解開幾顆扣子吧.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortWarm2.cn: 这里变热了. 解开几颗扣子吧.

UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortWarm3.en: A little steamy. Not entirely a bad thing.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortWarm3.ch: 有點熱氣騰騰. 也不全是壞事.
UI_TBYW_Status_ComfortWarm3.cn: 有点热气腾腾. 也不全是坏事.

UI_TBYW_Status_FetchCancelled.en: Never mind. "%1" stays where it was.

UI_BestLock_HotwireLockBroken.en: The ignition lock is broken. The key won't go in.
UI_BestLock_HotwireLockBroken.ch: 點火鎖壞了. 鑰匙插不進去.
UI_BestLock_HotwireLockBroken.cn: 点火锁坏了. 钥匙插不进去.

UI_ETW_TranslationsStatus_MaintainersWeb.ch: 翻譯現已改在 Weblate 上進行, 任何人都能參與, 不必下載模組或翻找檔案.

UI_FNVG_Color_tooltip.en: The color of the night vision overlay

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Label.en: Show the hotbar when switching items
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Label.ch: 切換物品時顯示快捷欄
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Label.cn: 切换物品时显示快捷栏

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Desc.en: When the item in either hand changes, the bottom hotbar comes into view and hides again after the panel delay. Requires Animate bottom bar.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Desc.ch: 任一手上的物品變更時, 底部快捷欄會顯示出來, 並在面板收起延遲過後再次隱藏. 需要啟用底部欄動畫.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_EquipReveal_Desc.cn: 任意一只手上的物品变化时, 底部快捷栏会显示出来, 并在面板收回延迟过后再次隐藏. 需要启用底部栏动画.

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_InventoryLink_Label.ch: 物品欄與容器同時顯示
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_InventoryLink_Label.cn: 物品栏与容器同时显示

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_InventoryLink_Desc.en: When the inventory or the container comes into view, the other one comes with it, so you can move items without either one hiding. Requires Animate inventories and containers.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_InventoryLink_Desc.ch: 物品欄或容器其中一個顯示時, 另一個也會一起顯示, 讓你搬移物品時兩者都不會隱藏. 需要啟用物品欄與容器動畫.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_InventoryLink_Desc.cn: 物品栏或容器其中一个显示时, 另一个也会随之显示, 这样移动物品时两者都不会隐藏. 需要启用物品栏与容器动画.

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_KeepHands_Desc.en: While the left sidebar is hidden, both hand slots stay in place and show what you are holding. Also applies while aiming with Hide all HUD while aiming. The rest of the sidebar stays hidden.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_KeepHands_Desc.ch: 左側欄隱藏時, 雙手欄位仍會留在原位, 顯示你手上拿的東西. 啟用瞄準時隱藏所有 HUD 時, 瞄準期間同樣適用. 側欄的其餘部分維持隱藏.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_KeepHands_Desc.cn: 左侧栏隐藏时, 双手栏位仍保留在原位, 显示你手中持有的物品. 启用瞄准时隐藏所有HUD时, 瞄准期间同样适用. 侧栏其余部分保持隐藏.

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_MinimapVehicle_Label.ch: 在車內保持顯示小地圖
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_MinimapVehicle_Label.cn: 在车内保持显示小地图

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_MinimapVehicle_Desc.en: With Animate minimap with fade enabled, the open minimap stays visible while you are in a vehicle and fades again after you leave it. Aiming with Hide all HUD while aiming still hides it.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_MinimapVehicle_Desc.ch: 啟用小地圖淡入淡出動畫時, 已開啟的小地圖在你乘車期間會保持可見, 下車後才再次淡出. 啟用瞄準時隱藏所有 HUD 時, 瞄準仍會將它隱藏.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_MinimapVehicle_Desc.cn: 启用小地图淡入淡出动画时, 打开的小地图在你乘车期间会保持可见, 下车后再次淡出. 启用瞄准时隐藏所有HUD时, 瞄准仍会将其隐藏.

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_OtherPanels_Desc.en: Extends the in-place fade to any other window open on screen, including windows from other mods. It appears when the cursor enters its area and fades after the panel delay. Confirmations, right-click menus, tooltips, text boxes in use and anything being dragged are left alone.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_OtherPanels_Desc.ch: 將原地淡出效果延伸到畫面上開啟的任何其他視窗, 包括其他模組的視窗. 游標進入其區域時顯示, 並在面板收起延遲過後淡出. 確認對話方塊, 右鍵選單, 工具提示, 正在使用的文字方塊以及拖曳中的任何東西都不受影響.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_OtherPanels_Desc.cn: 将原地淡出效果扩展到屏幕上打开的任何其他窗口, 包括其他模组的窗口. 光标进入其区域时显示, 并在面板收回延迟过后淡出. 确认框, 右键菜单, 工具提示, 正在使用的文本框以及正在拖动的任何东西都不受影响.

UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_PauseShowAll_Desc.en: While the game is paused or the Esc menu is open, every hidden panel comes back into view. When the game resumes, each one hides again on its normal timing.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_PauseShowAll_Desc.ch: 遊戲暫停或開啟 Esc 選單時, 所有隱藏的面板都會重新顯示. 遊戲繼續後, 各面板會依平常的時機再次隱藏.
UI_SIMBA_AutoHide_PauseShowAll_Desc.cn: 游戏暂停或打开Esc菜单时, 所有隐藏的面板都会重新显示. 游戏恢复后, 各面板会按正常时机再次隐藏.

RM_30af2059-1537-4beb-a7e0-b28b6f15c626.en: Hey hey, How are you all today?
RM_30af2059-1537-4beb-a7e0-b28b6f15c626.ch: 嘿嘿, 大家今天過得如何?
RM_30af2059-1537-4beb-a7e0-b28b6f15c626.cn: 嘿嘿, 大家今天过得如何?

RM_5ab46bf2-05b3-49d7-95db-9d90db7144dc.en: What do we need? First - Let's Heat some water
RM_5ab46bf2-05b3-49d7-95db-9d90db7144dc.ch: 我們需要什麼? 首先 - 把水加熱
RM_5ab46bf2-05b3-49d7-95db-9d90db7144dc.cn: 我们需要什么? 首先 - 把水加热

RM_777a5d02-d3cc-46b7-9697-996034d6ca9e.en: There! Most of our work's done, all we need now is patience!
RM_777a5d02-d3cc-46b7-9697-996034d6ca9e.ch: 好了! 大部分的工作都完成了, 現在只需要一點耐心!
RM_777a5d02-d3cc-46b7-9697-996034d6ca9e.cn: 好了! 大部分的工作都完成了, 现在只需要一点耐心!

RM_7882f5ee-271a-4051-bac9-8eac5e425618.en: The best start of our mornings!

RM_79940cc2-04c8-497a-beaf-b7ebc5885599.en: And it's as easy as that! Some Hot Brewed Coffee!
RM_79940cc2-04c8-497a-beaf-b7ebc5885599.ch: 就是這麼簡單! 一杯熱騰騰的沖泡咖啡!
RM_79940cc2-04c8-497a-beaf-b7ebc5885599.cn: 就是这么简单! 一杯热腾腾的冲泡咖啡!

RM_7b901f5b-71cb-4762-a338-2d0ac4d54f25.en: Let that Hot Water slowly Brew our Coffee!
RM_7b901f5b-71cb-4762-a338-2d0ac4d54f25.ch: 讓熱水慢慢沖泡出我們的咖啡!
RM_7b901f5b-71cb-4762-a338-2d0ac4d54f25.cn: 让热水慢慢冲泡出我们的咖啡!

RM_909bad9d-b7ff-42d5-b60c-1857be5598b9.cn: VHS: Sapph 的烹饪秀 EP1 (咖啡)

RM_94f3b733-566e-4c5e-ae09-e23f9ac8f171.en: Hope you all enjoyed it - see you all, next time~[img=music]
RM_94f3b733-566e-4c5e-ae09-e23f9ac8f171.ch: 希望大家喜歡 - 我們下次見~[img=music]
RM_94f3b733-566e-4c5e-ae09-e23f9ac8f171.cn: 希望大家喜欢 - 我们下次见~[img=music]

RM_96e0f364-6b24-46fb-bc60-fd955249c5cc.en: Second - Get some Coffee Beans, Grind it on a Grinder like this!
RM_96e0f364-6b24-46fb-bc60-fd955249c5cc.ch: 接著 - 拿一些咖啡豆, 像這樣用研磨機磨碎!
RM_96e0f364-6b24-46fb-bc60-fd955249c5cc.cn: 接着 - 拿一些咖啡豆, 像这样用研磨机磨碎!

RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.en: and... There! Now, we just need some paper or cloth filters.
RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.ch: …好了! 現在, 我們只需要一些濾紙或濾布.
RM_d5c8295d-d935-4729-b8a8-a6e5d8f2bc6e.cn: …好了! 现在, 我们只需要一些滤纸或滤布.

RM_ee8c853f-75c4-4771-9e07-c945b8a9f349.en: <Noises> Or if you're bold, you can even use a Mortar and Pestle...<Noises>
RM_ee8c853f-75c4-4771-9e07-c945b8a9f349.ch: <Noises> 或者你夠大膽的話, 甚至可以用研缽和杵…<Noises>
RM_ee8c853f-75c4-4771-9e07-c945b8a9f349.cn: <Noises> 或者你够大胆的话, 甚至可以用研钵和杵…<Noises>

RM_ef323d59-b334-4635-9969-d0a404c1d578.ch: 今天我們要沖泡的是… 咖啡
RM_ef323d59-b334-4635-9969-d0a404c1d578.cn: 今天我们要冲泡的是… 咖啡

RM_VPS_Extra.en: Ebenezer Missionary Baptist Church - Rosewood, Kentucky - 1982
RM_VPS_Extra.ch: 以便以謝宣道浸信會 - 肯塔基州羅斯伍德 - 1982
RM_VPS_Extra.cn: 以便以谢宣道浸信会 - 肯塔基州罗斯伍德 - 1982

RM_VPS_T1_01.ch: 以便以謝宣道浸信會, 肯塔基州羅斯伍德.
RM_VPS_T1_01.cn: 以便以谢宣道浸信会, 肯塔基州罗斯伍德.

RM_VPS_T1_02.en: This is the Lord's day, and we are recording.
RM_VPS_T1_02.ch: 今天是主日, 我們正在錄音.
RM_VPS_T1_02.cn: 今天是主日, 我们正在录音.

RM_VPS_T1_03.en: Thirty of us bought that camera together.
RM_VPS_T1_03.ch: 我們三十個人合錢買了那台攝影機.
RM_VPS_T1_03.cn: 我们三十个人凑钱买了那台摄像机.

RM_VPS_T1_04.en: I hope you know what that cost.
RM_VPS_T1_04.ch: 我希望你們知道那花了多少錢.
RM_VPS_T1_04.cn: 我希望你们知道那花了多少钱.

RM_VPS_T1_05.en: Tommy Culver, I can see you.
RM_VPS_T1_05.ch: 湯米·卡爾弗, 我看得見你.
RM_VPS_T1_05.cn: 汤米·卡尔弗, 我看得见你.

RM_VPS_T1_06.en: Turn with me to Genesis, chapter four.
RM_VPS_T1_06.ch: 跟我一起翻到創世記第四章.
RM_VPS_T1_06.cn: 跟我一起翻到创世记第四章.

RM_VPS_T1_07.en: Verse two first. It is a small verse.
RM_VPS_T1_07.ch: 先看第二節. 那是很短的一節.
RM_VPS_T1_07.cn: 先看第二节. 那是很短的一节.

RM_VPS_T1_08.en: "And Abel was a keeper of sheep,

RM_VPS_T1_09.en: but Cain was a tiller of the ground."

RM_VPS_T1_10.en: Hold onto the farmer. We will want him.
RM_VPS_T1_10.ch: 記住那個種地的. 我們以後會用到他.
RM_VPS_T1_10.cn: 记住那个种地的. 我们以后会用到他.

RM_VPS_T1_11.ch: 不是今天. 但還是把他記著.
RM_VPS_T1_11.cn: 不是今天. 但还是把他记着.

RM_VPS_T1_13.en: "And it came to pass, when they were in the field,

RM_VPS_T1_14.en: that Cain rose up against Abel his brother,
RM_VPS_T1_14.ch: 該隱起來打他兄弟亞伯,
RM_VPS_T1_14.cn: 该隐起来打他兄弟亚伯,

RM_VPS_T1_17.en: Not in a temple. Not before a judge.
RM_VPS_T1_17.ch: 不在殿裡. 不在審判官面前.
RM_VPS_T1_17.cn: 不在殿里. 不在审判官面前.

RM_VPS_T1_18.en: Where there was nobody to see it.
RM_VPS_T1_18.ch: 在沒有一個人看得見的地方.
RM_VPS_T1_18.cn: 在没有一个人看得见的地方.

RM_VPS_T1_19.en: No court out there. No witness. No sentence.
RM_VPS_T1_19.ch: 那外頭沒有法庭. 沒有見證人. 沒有判決.
RM_VPS_T1_19.cn: 那外头没有法庭. 没有见证人. 没有判决.

RM_VPS_T1_20.en: Somebody had to do all of it.
RM_VPS_T1_20.ch: 這一切, 都得有人自己動手.
RM_VPS_T1_20.cn: 这一切, 都得有人自己动手.

RM_VPS_T1_21.ch: 該隱把自己立成了[col=191,102,255]行刑的人[/].
RM_VPS_T1_21.cn: 该隐把自己立成了[col=191,102,255]行刑的人[/].

RM_VPS_T1_22.en: He took an office he was never given.
RM_VPS_T1_22.ch: 他擔起了一個從來沒有交給他的職分.
RM_VPS_T1_22.cn: 他担起了一个从来没有交给他的职分.

RM_VPS_T1_23.en: That is what murder is, church -
RM_VPS_T1_23.ch: 教會啊, 殺人就是這麼一回事 -
RM_VPS_T1_23.cn: 教会啊, 杀人就是这么一回事 -

RM_VPS_T1_24.en: a man doing God's work for Him, badly,
RM_VPS_T1_24.ch: 一個人替神做祂的工, 做得一塌糊塗,
RM_VPS_T1_24.cn: 一个人替神做他的工, 做得一塌糊涂,

RM_VPS_T1_26.en: The Lord asks where his brother is.
RM_VPS_T1_26.ch: 主問他, 你兄弟在哪裡.
RM_VPS_T1_26.cn: 主问他, 你兄弟在哪里.

RM_VPS_T1_28.ch: 我豈是看守我兄弟的嗎? 」
RM_VPS_T1_28.cn: 我岂是看守我兄弟的吗? ”

RM_VPS_T1_30.en: And the Lord does not argue with him.

RM_VPS_T1_33.en: the voice of thy brother's[col=217,31,31] blood[/]

RM_VPS_T1_34.en: crieth unto me from the ground."

RM_VPS_T1_37.en: and I have never once gotten past that line.
RM_VPS_T1_37.ch: 卻從來沒有一次能越過這一句.
RM_VPS_T1_37.cn: 却从来没有一次能越过这一句.

RM_VPS_T1_40.en: But[col=102,191,255] savagery[/] is not the sin the Lord names.
RM_VPS_T1_40.ch: 但[col=102,191,255]兇殘[/]不是主指出來的那個罪.
RM_VPS_T1_40.cn: 但[col=102,191,255]凶残[/]不是主指出来的那个罪.

RM_VPS_T1_41.en: He does not say thou hast killed.

RM_VPS_T1_42.en: He says what hast thou done.
RM_VPS_T1_42.ch: 祂說的是, 你做了甚麼事呢.
RM_VPS_T1_42.cn: 他说的是, 你做了什么事呢.

RM_VPS_T1_43.en: The killing was the smaller part.
RM_VPS_T1_43.ch: 殺人是其中比較小的那一半.
RM_VPS_T1_43.cn: 杀人是其中比较小的那一半.

RM_VPS_T1_44.en: Cain thought that field was empty.
RM_VPS_T1_44.ch: 該隱以為那片田是空的.
RM_VPS_T1_44.cn: 该隐以为那片田是空的.

RM_VPS_T1_45.en: He thought a thing done where nobody looks
RM_VPS_T1_45.ch: 他以為在沒有人看的地方做的事,
RM_VPS_T1_45.cn: 他以为在没有人看的地方做的事,

RM_VPS_T1_46.en: is a thing that did not happen.

RM_VPS_T1_48.en: Verse eleven: the earth opened her mouth.
RM_VPS_T1_48.ch: 第十一節: 地開了口.
RM_VPS_T1_48.cn: 第十一节: 地开了口.

RM_VPS_T1_49.en: It took what he gave it, and it kept it.
RM_VPS_T1_49.ch: 地接了他所給的, 而且留住了.
RM_VPS_T1_49.cn: 地接了他所给的, 而且留住了.

RM_VPS_T1_51.en: Cain ate his supper and slept. It did not.
RM_VPS_T1_51.ch: 該隱吃了晚飯, 睡了覺. 它沒有.
RM_VPS_T1_51.cn: 该隐吃了晚饭, 睡了觉. 它没有.

RM_VPS_T1_52.en: My grandmother had a word for a thing
RM_VPS_T1_52.ch: 我祖母對一樣東西有個說法,
RM_VPS_T1_52.cn: 我奶奶对一样东西有个说法,

RM_VPS_T1_53.en: that will not be reasoned with.
RM_VPS_T1_53.ch: 就是那種怎麼講道理都講不通的東西.
RM_VPS_T1_53.cn: 就是那种怎么讲道理都讲不通的东西.

RM_VPS_T1_54.en: She called a deed like that[col=191,102,255] fell[/].
RM_VPS_T1_54.ch: 她管那樣的行為叫[col=191,102,255]狠絕[/].
RM_VPS_T1_54.cn: 她管那样的行为叫[col=191,102,255]狠绝[/].

RM_VPS_T1_55.en: It does not only mean wicked.

RM_VPS_T1_56.en: It means it has already made up its mind.
RM_VPS_T1_56.ch: 那意思是, 它早已下定了決心.
RM_VPS_T1_56.cn: 那意思是, 它早已下定了决心.

RM_VPS_T1_57.en: Now hear the part I came to say.
RM_VPS_T1_57.ch: 現在聽我今天真正要說的那一段.
RM_VPS_T1_57.cn: 现在听我今天真正要说的那一段.

RM_VPS_T1_59.en: Cain never heard a thing. Not one thing.
RM_VPS_T1_59.ch: 該隱甚麼也沒聽見. 一點也沒有.
RM_VPS_T1_59.cn: 该隐什么也没听见. 一点也没有.

RM_VPS_T1_60.en: He walked out of that field in the quiet.
RM_VPS_T1_60.ch: 他在一片安靜裡走出了那片田.
RM_VPS_T1_60.cn: 他在一片安静里走出了那片田.

RM_VPS_T1_62.en: and the only ear in all creation
RM_VPS_T1_62.ch: 而在一切受造之物中, 唯一
RM_VPS_T1_62.cn: 而在一切受造之物中, 唯一

RM_VPS_T1_63.en: tuned to hear it was the ear of God.
RM_VPS_T1_63.ch: 聽得見那聲音的耳朵, 是神的耳朵.
RM_VPS_T1_63.cn: 听得见那声音的耳朵, 是神的耳朵.

RM_VPS_T1_65.en: Some of you have done things in a field.
RM_VPS_T1_65.ch: 你們有些人在田裡做過事.
RM_VPS_T1_65.cn: 你们有些人在田里做过事.

RM_VPS_T1_67.en: You are just not the one who can hear it.
RM_VPS_T1_67.ch: 只是你不是那個聽得見的人.
RM_VPS_T1_67.cn: 只是你不是那个听得见的人.

RM_VPS_T1_68.en: Verse fifteen, and then the sister sings.
RM_VPS_T1_68.ch: 第十五節, 然後請姊妹起唱.
RM_VPS_T1_68.cn: 第十五节, 然后请姊妹起唱.

RM_VPS_T1_69.en: "And the LORD set a mark upon Cain,
RM_VPS_T1_69.ch: 「耶和華就給該隱立一個記號,
RM_VPS_T1_69.cn: “耶和华就给该隐立一个记号,

RM_VPS_T1_70.en: lest any finding him should kill him."

RM_VPS_T1_71.en: God marked the murderer to keep him alive.
RM_VPS_T1_71.ch: 神給那殺人的立記號, 是為了留他的命.
RM_VPS_T1_71.cn: 神给那杀人的立记号, 是为了留他的命.

RM_VPS_T1_72.en: Next time there is a mark on a door in Egypt.
RM_VPS_T1_72.ch: 下一次, 記號是在埃及的一扇門上.
RM_VPS_T1_72.cn: 下一次, 记号是在埃及的一扇门上.

RM_VPS_T1_73.en: The Lord is merciful to the sinner,

RM_VPS_T1_74.en: and He is[col=191,102,255] merciless[/] to the sin,

RM_VPS_T1_75.en: and He is both at once,
RM_VPS_T1_75.ch: 而祂在同一刻是這兩樣,
RM_VPS_T1_75.cn: 而他在同一刻是这两样,

RM_VPS_T1_76.en: and that is the hardest thing I know.
RM_VPS_T1_76.ch: 這是我所知道最難的一件事.
RM_VPS_T1_76.cn: 这是我所知道最难的一件事.

RM_VPS_T1_77.ch: 姊妹 - 你來給我們起頭領唱.
RM_VPS_T1_77.cn: 姊妹 - 你来给我们起头领唱.

RM_VPS_T1_78.en: If this word has blessed you, write to us.
RM_VPS_T1_78.ch: 若這道使你得了福, 就寫信給我們.
RM_VPS_T1_78.cn: 若这道使你得了福, 就写信给我们.

RM_VPS_T1_80.ch: 郵政信箱 41 號, 肯塔基州羅斯伍德.
RM_VPS_T1_80.cn: 邮政信箱 41 号, 肯塔基州罗斯伍德.

RM_VPS_T1_81.en: Tape one of three. The Lord willing, a two.
RM_VPS_T1_81.ch: 三卷中的第一卷. 主若許可, 還有第二卷.
RM_VPS_T1_81.cn: 三卷中的第一卷. 主若许可, 还有第二卷.

RM_VPS_T1_HYMN1.en: [img=music] There is a fountain filled with[col=217,31,31] blood[/] [img=music]

RM_VPS_T1_HYMN2.ch: [img=music] 從以馬內利的血脈湧出 [img=music]
RM_VPS_T1_HYMN2.cn: [img=music] 从以马内利的血脉涌出 [img=music]

RM_VPS_T1_HYMN3.en: [img=music] And sinners plunged beneath that flood [img=music]
RM_VPS_T1_HYMN3.ch: [img=music] 罪人投身在那洪流之下 [img=music]
RM_VPS_T1_HYMN3.cn: [img=music] 罪人投身在那洪流之下 [img=music]

RM_VPS_T2_01.ch: 以便以謝宣道浸信會, 羅斯伍德.
RM_VPS_T2_01.cn: 以便以谢宣道浸信会, 罗斯伍德.

RM_VPS_T2_03.en: Three weeks ago I left you in a field.
RM_VPS_T2_03.ch: 三週前, 我把你們留在一片田地裡.
RM_VPS_T2_03.cn: 三周前, 我把你们留在一片田地里.

RM_VPS_T2_04.en: Some of you have not slept right since.
RM_VPS_T2_04.ch: 從那之後, 你們有些人就沒睡好.
RM_VPS_T2_04.cn: 从那之后, 你们有些人就没睡好.

RM_VPS_T2_06.en: I left you with a mark, as well.
RM_VPS_T2_06.ch: 我也留給了你們一個銘印.
RM_VPS_T2_06.cn: 我也留给了你们一个铭印.

RM_VPS_T2_07.en: God set one on Cain to keep him breathing.
RM_VPS_T2_07.ch: 神在該隱身上立了一個, 為要讓他繼續呼吸.
RM_VPS_T2_07.cn: 神在该隐身上立了一个, 为要让他继续呼吸.

RM_VPS_T2_08.en: This morning we put one on a door.
RM_VPS_T2_08.ch: 今天早上, 我們把一個抹在門上.
RM_VPS_T2_08.cn: 今天早上, 我们把一个抹在门上.

RM_VPS_T2_10.en: Now Pharaoh has been asked nine times.
RM_VPS_T2_10.ch: 如今, 法老已經被求過九次.
RM_VPS_T2_10.cn: 如今, 法老已经被求过九次.

RM_VPS_T2_13.en: Scripture says he hardened his own heart.
RM_VPS_T2_13.ch: 聖經說, 是他自己硬著心.
RM_VPS_T2_13.cn: 圣经说, 是他自己硬着心.

RM_VPS_T2_14.en: Scripture says the Lord hardened it.
RM_VPS_T2_14.ch: 聖經也說, 是主使他的心剛硬.
RM_VPS_T2_14.cn: 圣经也说, 是主使他的心刚硬.

RM_VPS_T2_15.en: Don't you go smoothing that over.
RM_VPS_T2_15.ch: 你們可別把這事給抹平了.
RM_VPS_T2_15.cn: 你们可别把这事给抹平了.

RM_VPS_T2_16.en: A man can want a thing long enough
RM_VPS_T2_16.ch: 一個人可以想要一樣東西, 想得夠久,
RM_VPS_T2_16.cn: 一个人可以想要一样东西, 想得够久,

RM_VPS_T2_17.en: that God stops taking it away from him.
RM_VPS_T2_17.ch: 久到神不再從他手裡拿走.
RM_VPS_T2_17.cn: 久到神不再从他手里拿走.

RM_VPS_T2_18.en: That is the Lord honoring it, not breaking it.
RM_VPS_T2_18.ch: 那是主看重那意願, 不是折斷它.
RM_VPS_T2_18.cn: 那是主看重那意愿, 不是折断它.

RM_VPS_T2_22.en: Not one firstborn has died yet,

RM_VPS_T2_23.en: and God has already changed what year it is.
RM_VPS_T2_23.ch: 神就已經改了這是哪一年.
RM_VPS_T2_23.cn: 神就已经改了这是哪一年.

RM_VPS_T2_24.en: He dates it from the[col=217,31,31] blood[/], not the leaving.
RM_VPS_T2_24.ch: 祂從那[col=217,31,31]血[/]算起, 不從離開埃及算起.
RM_VPS_T2_24.cn: 他从那[col=217,31,31]血[/]算起, 不从离开埃及算起.

RM_VPS_T2_25.en: Verse seven. Take a lamb. Take the[col=217,31,31] blood[/].
RM_VPS_T2_25.ch: 第七節. 取一隻羊羔. 取那[col=217,31,31]血[/].
RM_VPS_T2_25.cn: 第七节. 取一只羊羔. 取那[col=217,31,31]血[/].

RM_VPS_T2_26.en: "And strike it on the two side posts

RM_VPS_T2_27.en: and on the upper door post of the houses."

RM_VPS_T2_29.en: The Lord Himself passes through Egypt tonight.
RM_VPS_T2_29.ch: 今夜, 主親自要走過埃及.
RM_VPS_T2_29.cn: 今夜, 主亲自要走过埃及.

RM_VPS_T2_33.en: A token. A mark on the door.
RM_VPS_T2_33.ch: 一個記號. 門上的一道銘印.
RM_VPS_T2_33.cn: 一个记号. 门上的一道铭印.

RM_VPS_T2_34.en: That[col=217,31,31] blood[/] did not stop the destroyer
RM_VPS_T2_34.ch: 那[col=217,31,31]血[/]攔住滅命的, 並不是因為
RM_VPS_T2_34.cn: 那[col=217,31,31]血[/]拦住灭命的, 并不是因为

RM_VPS_T2_36.en: There is no strength in[col=217,31,31] blood[/] on a doorframe.
RM_VPS_T2_36.ch: 門框上那[col=217,31,31]血[/]裡沒有一點力量.
RM_VPS_T2_36.cn: 门框上那[col=217,31,31]血[/]里没有一点力量.

RM_VPS_T2_37.en: A child could wash it off.
RM_VPS_T2_37.ch: 一個孩子就能把它洗掉.
RM_VPS_T2_37.cn: 一个孩子就能把它洗掉.

RM_VPS_T2_38.en: It stopped him because it said
RM_VPS_T2_38.ch: 它攔住了他, 是因為它說明了
RM_VPS_T2_38.cn: 它拦住了他, 是因为它说明了

RM_VPS_T2_40.en: It said: this one is spoken for.
RM_VPS_T2_40.ch: 它說: 這一家已經有主了.
RM_VPS_T2_40.cn: 它说: 这一家已经有主了.

RM_VPS_T2_41.en: Verse twenty-three calls him the destroyer.
RM_VPS_T2_41.ch: 第二十三節稱他為滅命的.
RM_VPS_T2_41.cn: 第二十三节称他为灭命的.

RM_VPS_T2_42.en: Not an accident. Something sent, with work to do.
RM_VPS_T2_42.ch: 不是意外. 是被差來的, 帶著要辦的事.
RM_VPS_T2_42.cn: 不是意外. 是被差来的, 带着要办的事.

RM_VPS_T2_43.en: That was[col=191,102,255] destruction[/] with an order on it.

RM_VPS_T2_44.en: Every house in Egypt got what was coming.
RM_VPS_T2_44.ch: 埃及每一戶都得了該得的.
RM_VPS_T2_44.cn: 埃及每一户都得了该得的.

RM_VPS_T2_45.en: The marked houses got what was coming
RM_VPS_T2_45.ch: 帶著銘印的那些房子, 該來的
RM_VPS_T2_45.cn: 带着铭印的那些房子, 该来的

RM_VPS_T2_47.en: Now the knife that took that lamb was sharp.
RM_VPS_T2_47.ch: 取了那羊羔性命的刀, 是鋒利的.
RM_VPS_T2_47.cn: 取了那羊羔性命的刀, 是锋利的.

RM_VPS_T2_48.en: Somebody knew how to do it quick,

RM_VPS_T2_49.en: because a dull blade makes a thing suffer,
RM_VPS_T2_49.ch: 因為鈍刃會讓一條性命受苦,
RM_VPS_T2_49.cn: 因为钝刃会让一条性命受苦,

RM_VPS_T2_50.en: and they were not permitted to make it suffer.
RM_VPS_T2_50.ch: 而他們不被允許讓牠受苦.
RM_VPS_T2_50.cn: 而他们不被允许让它受苦.

RM_VPS_T2_51.en: And that lamb had done nothing.
RM_VPS_T2_51.ch: 而那羊羔什麼也沒做過.
RM_VPS_T2_51.cn: 而那羊羔什么也没做过.

RM_VPS_T2_52.en: What was done to it was an[col=191,102,255] execution[/].
RM_VPS_T2_52.ch: 對牠所做的, 是一場[col=191,102,255]處決[/].
RM_VPS_T2_52.cn: 对它所做的, 是一场[col=191,102,255]处决[/].

RM_VPS_T2_53.en: It is not a sacrifice if nothing dies.
RM_VPS_T2_53.ch: 若沒有東西死去, 那就不是獻祭.
RM_VPS_T2_53.cn: 若没有东西死去, 那就不是献祭.

RM_VPS_T2_54.en: There was a cost. There is always a cost.
RM_VPS_T2_54.ch: 這是有代價的. 從來都有代價.
RM_VPS_T2_54.cn: 这是有代价的. 从来都有代价.

RM_VPS_T2_55.en: Somebody's hands were not clean that night.
RM_VPS_T2_55.ch: 那一夜, 有人的手是不乾淨的.
RM_VPS_T2_55.cn: 那一夜, 有人的手是不干净的.

RM_VPS_T2_56.ch: 希伯來書第九章第二十二節.
RM_VPS_T2_56.cn: 希伯来书第九章第二十二节.

RM_VPS_T2_60.en: There is no other door. There never was.
RM_VPS_T2_60.ch: 沒有別的門. 從來沒有.
RM_VPS_T2_60.cn: 没有别的门. 从来没有.

RM_VPS_T2_61.en: You do not get bound to a thing for free.
RM_VPS_T2_61.ch: 你不可能白白就與一樣東西結下羈絆.
RM_VPS_T2_61.cn: 你不可能白白就与一样东西结下羁绊.

RM_VPS_T2_62.en: And while we are stood in Hebrews nine -
RM_VPS_T2_62.ch: 既然我們還站在希伯來書第九章 -
RM_VPS_T2_62.cn: 既然我们还站在希伯来书第九章 -

RM_VPS_T2_63.en: verse fourteen. Put a finger in it.
RM_VPS_T2_63.ch: 第十四節. 用手指夾住這一頁.
RM_VPS_T2_63.cn: 第十四节. 用手指夹住这一页.

RM_VPS_T2_65.en: offered himself without spot to God..."
RM_VPS_T2_65.ch: 將自己無瑕無疵獻給神…"
RM_VPS_T2_65.cn: 将自己无瑕无疵献给神…"

RM_VPS_T2_68.en: I am not ready and neither are you.
RM_VPS_T2_68.ch: 我還沒預備好, 你們也沒有.
RM_VPS_T2_68.cn: 我还没预备好, 你们也没有.

RM_VPS_T2_69.en: Leave the finger in. We come back.
RM_VPS_T2_69.ch: 手指別拿開. 我們會回來.
RM_VPS_T2_69.cn: 手指别拿开. 我们会回来.

RM_VPS_T2_70.en: Now some of you are in a[col=217,31,31] covenant[/],
RM_VPS_T2_70.ch: 你們有些人正在一個[col=217,31,31]盟約[/]裡,
RM_VPS_T2_70.cn: 你们有些人正在一个[col=217,31,31]盟约[/]里,

RM_VPS_T2_71.en: and the feeling has gone out of it.
RM_VPS_T2_71.ch: 而那份感覺已經從裡面走了.
RM_VPS_T2_71.cn: 而那份感觉已经从里面走了.

RM_VPS_T2_72.en: You promised when you were full of something,
RM_VPS_T2_72.ch: 你許諾的時候, 心裡是滿的,
RM_VPS_T2_72.cn: 你许诺的时候, 心里是满的,

RM_VPS_T2_74.en: and you are still keeping it.

RM_VPS_T2_75.ch: 親愛的, 那不是失敗.
RM_VPS_T2_75.cn: 亲爱的, 那不是失败.

RM_VPS_T2_77.en: and it is the greater half of the thing.
RM_VPS_T2_77.ch: 而那才是這件事更重的一半.
RM_VPS_T2_77.cn: 而那才是这件事更重的一半.

RM_VPS_T2_78.en: A[col=217,31,31] covenant[/] is not the feeling.
RM_VPS_T2_78.ch: 一個[col=217,31,31]盟約[/]不是那份感覺.
RM_VPS_T2_78.cn: 一个[col=217,31,31]盟约[/]不是那份感觉.

RM_VPS_T2_79.en: It is the mark on the door

RM_VPS_T2_80.en: after the feeling has left the house.
RM_VPS_T2_80.ch: 在感覺離開了這屋子之後.
RM_VPS_T2_80.cn: 在感觉离开了这屋子之后.

RM_VPS_T2_81.en: The[col=217,31,31] blood[/] on that door asked no questions.
RM_VPS_T2_81.ch: 門上那[col=217,31,31]血[/]沒有問過任何問題.
RM_VPS_T2_81.cn: 门上那[col=217,31,31]血[/]没有问过任何问题.

RM_VPS_T2_82.en: It marked them, and what was marked belonged,
RM_VPS_T2_82.ch: 它給他們立了銘印, 凡帶了銘印的就有了歸屬,
RM_VPS_T2_82.cn: 它给他们立了铭印, 凡带了铭印的就有了归属,

RM_VPS_T2_84.en: Whatever you have put your[col=217,31,31] blood[/] into -
RM_VPS_T2_84.ch: 凡是你把[col=217,31,31]血[/]投進去的東西 -
RM_VPS_T2_84.cn: 凡是你把[col=217,31,31]血[/]投进去的东西 -

RM_VPS_T2_88.en: you are marked to it now.
RM_VPS_T2_88.ch: 你如今已經被銘印在它上面了.
RM_VPS_T2_88.cn: 你如今已经被铭印在它上面了.

RM_VPS_T2_90.ch: 不是那句許諾. 是那道銘印.
