RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L01.en: Welcome to Proxima Medical, and congratulations on joining the team.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L01.ch: 歡迎加入Proxima醫療, 也恭喜你成為團隊的一員.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L01.cn: 欢迎来到Proxima医疗, 恭喜你加入这个团队.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L02.en: This tape covers your First Aid certification. Every associate completes it before working the floor.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L02.ch: 這卷帶子是你的急救認證課程. 每位員工正式上工前都必須完成這門課程.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L02.cn: 这盒录像带是你的急救认证课程. 每位员工上岗前都必须完成这门课程.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L03.en: Keep your handbook open to section four and follow along at your own pace.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L03.ch: 把手冊翻到第四節放在旁邊, 照自己的步調跟著做.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L03.cn: 把手册翻到第四节放在旁边, 按自己的节奏跟着做.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L04.en: Safety comes first here. The techniques on this tape have saved lives, including some of our own.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L04.ch: 在這裡安全第一. 這卷帶子裡的技術救過人命, 其中也包括我們自己的同事.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L04.cn: 在这里安全第一. 这盒录像带里的技术救过人命, 其中也包括我们自己的同事.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L05.en: Retrieve the training dummy at your station. Module one: wound dressing. Wrap firm and even, and follow along.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L05.ch: 去拿你工作站上的練習假人. 第一單元: 傷口包紮. 纏得紮實均勻, 跟著做.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L05.cn: 去取你工位上的练习假人. 第一单元: 伤口包扎. 缠得紧实均匀, 跟着做.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L06.en: Take your time with each drill. Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L06.ch: 每個演練都慢慢來. 慢就是穩, 穩就是快.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L06.cn: 每个练习都慢慢来. 慢就是稳, 稳就是快.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L07.en: When you finish, your supervisor will have a sign-off sheet to confirm your certification.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L07.ch: 做完之後, 你的主管手上有一張簽核表, 用來確認你的認證.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L07.cn: 完成之后, 你的主管手上有一张签字确认表, 用来确认你的认证.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L08.en: Module two: the sterile field. Always disinfect before you dress a wound. A clean wound heals faster.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L08.ch: 第二單元: 無菌區. 包紮傷口前一定要先消毒. 乾淨的傷口好得更快.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L08.cn: 第二单元: 无菌区. 包扎伤口前一定要先消毒. 干净的伤口愈合更快.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L09.en: Excellent, all clean. Proxima was founded on a simple idea: good medicine should reach the people who need it.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L09.ch: 很好, 都乾淨了. Proxima創立的理念很簡單: 好的醫療應該送到需要的人手上.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L09.cn: 很好, 都干净了. Proxima创立的理念很简单: 好的医疗应该送到需要的人手里.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L10.en: Module three: foreign body removal. Use tweezers, keep your hands steady, and clear the site before closing.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L10.ch: 第三單元: 取出異物. 用鑷子, 手要穩, 縫合前先把傷口清乾淨.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L10.cn: 第三单元: 取出异物. 用镊子, 手要稳, 缝合前先把伤口清理干净.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L11.en: If a step doesn't click the first time, rewind and run it again. Repetition is how this becomes second nature.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L11.ch: 某個步驟第一次沒抓到訣竅, 就倒帶重看一次. 反覆練習才能變成本能.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L11.cn: 某个步骤第一次没掌握, 就倒带重看一遍. 反复练习才能变成本能.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L12.en: You're doing well. Most associates find the second half easier once the basics settle in.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L12.ch: 你表現得很好. 多數員工把基礎練熟之後, 都覺得後半段輕鬆多了.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L12.cn: 你表现得很好. 多数员工把基础掌握牢之后, 都觉得后半段轻松多了.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L13.en: Module four: immobilization. A proper splint keeps an injured limb stable until you can get help.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L13.ch: 第四單元: 固定. 正確的夾板能讓受傷的肢體保持穩定, 撐到你找到援助.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L13.cn: 第四单元: 固定. 正确的夹板能让受伤的肢体保持稳定, 撑到你找到救援.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L14.en: Our associates take real pride in looking out for one another. That starts with knowing this material.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L14.ch: 我們的員工很自豪能彼此照應. 而這要從熟悉這些內容開始.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L14.cn: 我们的员工很自豪能互相照应. 而这要从熟悉这些内容开始.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L15.en: Module five: suturing. Even spacing, steady tension, and a clean close. Practice until it feels routine.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L15.ch: 第五單元: 縫合. 針距均勻, 張力穩定, 收口乾淨. 練到變成習慣動作為止.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L15.cn: 第五单元: 缝合. 针距均匀, 张力稳定, 收口干净. 练到成为习惯动作为止.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L16.en: Almost there. One more module, and it's the one that ties everything together.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L16.ch: 快到了. 還剩一個單元, 而它會把前面全部串起來.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L16.cn: 快到了. 还剩一个单元, 而它会把前面所有内容串起来.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L17.en: Keep your skills sharp, this will be an annual re-training requirement for continued employment at Proxima.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L17.ch: 保持技術純熟, 這門課是在Proxima繼續任職的年度複訓要求.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L17.cn: 保持技术熟练, 这门课是在Proxima继续任职的年度复训要求.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L18.en: Module six: full trauma response. Every technique in sequence, performed perfectly now and under pressure. This is what it all builds toward.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L18.ch: 第六單元: 完整創傷處置. 所有技術依序操作, 現在要做到完美, 壓力下也要做到. 前面所有課程都是為了這一關.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L18.cn: 第六单元: 完整创伤处理. 所有技术按顺序操作, 现在要做到完美, 有压力时也一样. 前面所有课程都是为了这一关.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L19.en: That completes the practical portion. Please turn your supervisor signed certification with Human Resources on the second floor.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L19.ch: 實作部分到此結束. 請把主管簽好的認證繳交到二樓的人力資源部.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L19.cn: 实操部分到此结束. 请把主管签好的认证交到二楼的人力资源部.

RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L20.en: Welcome to Proxima Medical. We're glad to have you. See your supervisor for your floor assignment.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L20.ch: 歡迎加入Proxima醫療. 很高興有你加入. 去找你的主管確認你的樓層工作分配.
RM_Tikitown_Proxima_L20.cn: 欢迎来到Proxima医疗. 很高兴你能加入. 去找你的主管确认你的楼层岗位分配.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000012.cn: 但这些系统需要维护, 而作为被选中的人, 你们已经…

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000013.en: Inducted into Project Oasis, your specialized skills will become crucial in the days ahead.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000013.ch: 加入了綠洲計畫, 你的專業技能在未來的日子裡將至關重要.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000013.cn: 加入了绿洲计划, 你的专业技能在未来的日子里将至关重要.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000014.en: Generators require lubrication and coolant, and may need repairs.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000014.ch: 發電機需要潤滑劑與冷卻液, 也可能需要維修.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000014.cn: 发电机需要润滑剂和冷却液, 也可能需要维修.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000015.en: The water pump will require charcoal to filter the water to ensure potability.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000015.ch: 抽水機需要木炭來過濾水源, 確保水可以飲用.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000015.cn: 水泵需要木炭来过滤水源, 确保水可以饮用.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000016.en: And the decontamination system required NBC tablets to ensure maximum safety.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000016.ch: 而除汙系統需要核生化錠劑, 以確保最高安全.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000016.cn: 而洗消系统需要核生化药片, 以确保最高安全.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000017.en: But first, take your first steps to read through the pamphlets the Department have left behind.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000017.ch: 但首先, 請先踏出第一步, 仔細閱讀部門留下的小冊子.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000017.cn: 但首先, 请先迈出第一步, 仔细阅读部门留下的小册子.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000018.en: These will outline in greater detail what you will need to do, and the steps...
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000018.ch: 這些冊子會更詳細地說明你需要做的事, 以及…
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000018.cn: 这些册子会更详细地说明你需要做的事, 以及…

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000019.en: You will need to take in the dark times ahead of you.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000019.ch: 在前方的黑暗時期裡你必須採取的步驟.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000019.cn: 在前方的黑暗时期里你必须采取的步骤.

RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000020.en: When in doubt, check NOAH for the latest situation within and without.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000020.ch: 有疑問時, 請檢視 NOAH, 了解內外的最新狀況.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000020.cn: 有疑问时, 请查看 NOAH, 了解内外的最新状况.

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000001.ch: 綠洲計畫, 醫療教學系列
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000001.cn: 绿洲计划, 医疗教学系列

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000002.ch: 第 01 卷: 基本傷口護理
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000002.cn: 第 01 卷: 基本伤口护理

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000005.en: If bleeding is severe, apply pressure.
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000005.ch: 如果出血嚴重, 請加壓止血.
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000005.cn: 如果出血严重, 请加压止血.

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000007.ch: 消毒時感到疼痛是正常的.
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000007.cn: 消毒时感到疼痛是正常的.

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-00000000000a.en: VHS: PROJECT OASIS, MEDICAL INSTRUCTION SERIES, TAPE 01: BASIC WOUND CARE
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-00000000000a.ch: VHS: 綠洲計畫, 醫療教學系列, 第 01 卷: 基本傷口護理
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-00000000000a.cn: VHS: 绿洲计划, 医疗教学系列, 第 01 卷: 基本伤口护理

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-00000000000c.ch: 第 01 卷: 基本傷口護理
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-00000000000c.cn: 第 01 卷: 基本伤口护理

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000010.en: Ensure the wound is fully covered.

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000012.en: Replace it if it becomes dirty.

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000014.ch: 如果出現感染, 再次消毒.
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000014.cn: 如果出现感染, 再次消毒.

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000016.ch: 如果有抗生素, 請服用.
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000016.cn: 如果有抗生素, 请服用.

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000019.ch: 服用阿斯匹靈以減輕不適.
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000019.cn: 服用阿司匹林以减轻不适.

RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000022.ch: 妥善照護才能確保存活.
RM_d468123f-899c-4488-902e-000000000022.cn: 妥善护理才能确保存活.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000001.en: TAPE 01: NUCLEAR EXPOSURE SURVIVAL - FEAT. DEAN PORCH
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000001.ch: 錄影帶 01: 核輻射暴露求生 - 主講: 迪恩·波奇
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000001.cn: 录像带 01: 核辐射暴露求生 - 主讲: 迪恩·波奇

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000003.en: I'm Dean, and this tape is being recorded for the US Government.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000003.ch: 我是迪恩, 這卷錄影帶是為美國政府錄製的.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000003.cn: 我是迪恩, 这盘录像带是为美国政府录制的.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000004.en: Now, I'm sure you've all been out in winter time, but let me tell you,
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000004.ch: 我相信各位都在冬天出過門, 不過讓我告訴你們,
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000004.cn: 我相信各位都在冬天出过门, 不过让我告诉你们,

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000005.en: Nuclear winter is so, so much worse.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000005.ch: 核子冬天可是糟糕得太多、太多了.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000005.cn: 核冬天可是糟糕得太多、太多了.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000006.en: Now it's not all doomsday, you can survive out there.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000006.ch: 不過也不全是世界末日, 你在外面還是活得下去的.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000006.cn: 不过也不全是世界末日, 你在外面还是活得下去的.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000007.en: But you're going to need to be prepared.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000008.en: First off, the most important thing is your NBC suit.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000008.ch: 首先, 最重要的是你的 NBC 防護服.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000008.cn: 首先, 最重要的是你的 NBC 防护服.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000009.en: This is the Type C suit. It's a thick rubberized suit, lined with charcoal,
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000009.ch: 這是 C 型防護服. 它是一件厚實的橡膠防護服, 內襯活性碳,
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000009.cn: 这是 C 型防护服. 它是一件厚实的橡胶防护服, 内衬活性炭,

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-00000000000a.ch: VHS: 綠洲計畫, 暴露求生
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-00000000000a.cn: VHS: 绿洲计划, 暴露求生

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000010.en: Combined with your gas mask will keep you safe and the bad stuff out.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000010.ch: 搭配你的防毒面具, 就能保護你的安全, 把有害物質擋在外面.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000010.cn: 配合你的防毒面具, 就能保护你的安全, 把有害物质挡在外面.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000011.en: Before you get ready to go out into the winter wonderland, make sure you check your suit.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000011.ch: 在你準備踏進冬季仙境之前, 務必檢查你的防護服.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000011.cn: 在你准备踏进冬季仙境之前, 务必检查你的防护服.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000012.en: And make sure you check your filters too! You won't have time to swap them.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000012.ch: 也務必檢查你的濾罐! 到時候你可沒時間更換.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000012.cn: 也务必检查你的滤罐! 到时候你可没时间更换.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000013.en: If you think you've come in contact with radiation, pop those potassium iodine pills.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000013.ch: 如果你覺得自己接觸到了輻射, 趕快吞下那些碘化鉀藥片.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000013.cn: 如果你觉得自己接触到了辐射, 赶紧吞下那些碘化钾药片.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000014.en: Another thing is going to be the cold, you'll want to stay warm. So layer up!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000014.ch: 另一件事是寒冷, 你得保持溫暖. 所以多穿幾層!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000014.cn: 另一件事是寒冷, 你得保暖. 所以多穿几层!

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000015.en: Long john's, long sleeve shirts, button up shirts, every layer counts!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000015.ch: 長袖衛生衣褲、長袖上衣、排扣襯衫, 每一層都很重要!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000015.cn: 秋衣秋裤、长袖上衣、纽扣衬衫, 每一层都很重要!

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000016.en: If they give you Nikethamide, that'll help stave of the worst effects of hypothermia.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000016.ch: 如果他們發給你尼可剎米, 那能幫你抵擋失溫最嚴重的影響.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000016.cn: 如果他们发给你尼可刹米, 那能帮你抵挡失温最严重的影响.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000017.en: And finally, make sure you thoroughly decontaminate afterwards.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000017.ch: 最後, 事後一定要徹底除汙.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000017.cn: 最后, 事后一定要彻底洗消.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000018.en: These decon tablets smell like strawberry, but don't drink or eat it!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000018.ch: 這些除汙錠聞起來像草莓, 但千萬別喝也別吃!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000018.cn: 这些洗消片闻起来像草莓, 但千万别喝也别吃!

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000019.en: It'll make you sick or worse!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000019.ch: 那會讓你生病, 甚至更糟!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000019.cn: 那会让你生病, 甚至更糟!

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000020.en: Remember, we're all in it together out there.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000020.ch: 記住, 在外面我們都是同舟共濟.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000020.cn: 记住, 在外面我们都是同舟共济.

RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000021.en: Keep your head on straight, and you'll come back alive.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000021.ch: 保持頭腦清醒, 你就能活著回來.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000021.cn: 保持头脑清醒, 你就能活着回来.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000001.en: State your name and the facility from which you escaped.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000001.ch: 說出你的姓名, 以及你逃出的機構.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000001.cn: 说出你的姓名, 以及你逃出的机构.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000002.en: Man, name don’t even matter. Y’all already know where I was — Kentucky State, out near Rosewood.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000002.ch: 老兄, 名字根本不重要. 你們早就知道我待在哪了——肯塔基州立監獄, 就在羅斯伍德那邊.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000002.cn: 老兄, 名字根本不重要. 你们早就知道我待在哪了——肯塔基州立监狱, 就在罗斯伍德那边.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000003.en: Life sentence. Caught a murder charge — first degree. No appeal, no parole, no damn hope.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000003.ch: 無期徒刑. 背了一條謀殺罪——一級謀殺. 不能上訴, 不能假釋, 一點他媽的希望都沒有.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000003.cn: 无期徒刑. 背了一条谋杀罪——一级谋杀. 不能上诉, 不能假释, 一点他妈的希望都没有.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000004.en: Then Day Six came, and everything flipped.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000004.ch: 然後第六天來了, 一切都翻轉了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000004.cn: 然后第六天来了, 一切都翻转了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000005.en: Describe the condition of the prison prior to the incident.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000005.ch: 描述事件發生前監獄的狀況.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000005.cn: 描述事件发生前监狱的状况.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000006.en: You ever sit in a box so long, the walls start talkin’ to you? That shit’ll eat you alive slow.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000006.ch: 你有沒有在一個箱子裡關到牆壁開始跟你講話? 那鬼玩意會慢慢把你活活吞掉.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000006.cn: 你有没有在一个箱子里关到墙壁开始跟你说话? 那鬼玩意会慢慢把你活活吞掉.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000007.en: Then outta nowhere — boom — it felt like Christmas came early.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000007.ch: 結果突然間——砰——感覺就像聖誕節提早到了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000007.cn: 结果突然间——砰——感觉就像圣诞节提前到了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000008.en: We started noticing somethin’ off ‘round Day Four.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000008.ch: 我們大概第四天就開始發現不對勁了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000008.cn: 我们大概第四天就开始发现不对劲了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000009.en: Folks coughin’, not regular sick — nah, this was deep. Wet. Like they lungs was tryna crawl out they chest.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000009.ch: 大家都在咳, 不是一般的生病——不, 這咳得很深. 有痰. 好像肺要從胸口爬出來一樣.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000009.cn: 大家都在咳, 不是一般的生病——不, 这咳得很深. 有痰. 好像肺要从胸口爬出来一样.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000010.en: But who gives a fuck when inmates get sick, right?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000010.ch: 可是囚犯生病了, 誰他媽在乎啊, 對吧?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000010.cn: 可是囚犯生病了, 谁他妈在乎啊, 对吧?

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000011.en: Then Day Five hit. Shit got wild.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000011.ch: 然後第五天到了. 事情整個失控.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000011.cn: 然后第五天到了. 事情彻底失控.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000012.en: Some dude in C Block lost his damn mind — beat his cellie to death barehanded.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000012.ch: C 區有個傢伙突然他媽的發瘋——赤手空拳把他的室友活活打死.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000012.cn: C 区有个家伙突然他妈的发疯——赤手空拳把他的狱友活活打死.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000013.en: Face looked like it went through a blender.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000013.ch: 那張臉看起來像被丟進果汁機攪過.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000013.cn: 那张脸看起来像被扔进搅拌机搅过.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000014.en: At first, we thought it was just stress. Maybe some bad shit the guards were sneakin’ in.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000014.ch: 一開始, 我們以為只是壓力太大. 也許是獄警偷偷帶進來的什麼爛貨.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000014.cn: 一开始, 我们以为只是压力太大. 也许是狱警偷偷带进来的什么烂货.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000015.en: But then it happened again. Another body. Same mess.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000015.ch: 但後來又發生了. 又一具屍體. 一樣的慘狀.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000015.cn: 但后来又发生了. 又一具尸体. 一样的惨状.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000016.en: We ain’t stupid. We could feel it in the air.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000016.ch: 我們又不笨. 我們感覺得到空氣中的不對勁.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000016.cn: 我们又不傻. 我们感觉得到空气中的不对劲.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000017.en: Guards stopped runnin’ their mouths. Got quiet. Real tight.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000017.ch: 獄警不再耍嘴皮子. 變得很安靜. 繃得很緊.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000017.cn: 狱警不再耍嘴皮子. 变得很安静. 绷得很紧.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000018.en: No more transfers. No more movement. Doors stayed shut.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000018.ch: 不再轉監. 不再移動. 門一直關著.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000018.cn: 不再转监. 不再走动. 门一直关着.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000019.en: Continue with the events of Day Six.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000019.ch: 繼續講述第六天發生的事.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000019.cn: 继续讲述第六天发生的事.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000020.en: Middle of the night — maybe 3 a.m. — I wake up to this bangin’.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000020.ch: 半夜——大概凌晨 3 點——我被一陣撞擊聲吵醒.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000020.cn: 半夜——大概凌晨 3 点——我被一阵撞击声吵醒.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000021.en: Not no regular knockin’. I mean full-body slammin’. Over and over.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000021.ch: 不是普通的敲門聲. 我是說整個身體在撞. 一次又一次.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000021.cn: 不是普通的敲门声. 我是说整个身子在撞. 一次又一次.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000022.en: Metal screamin’, skin smackin’, bones crackin’.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000022.ch: 金屬在尖叫, 皮肉在拍打, 骨頭在碎裂.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000022.cn: 金属在尖叫, 皮肉在拍打, 骨头在碎裂.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000023.en: Cats was hittin’ they cell doors with everything they had — heads, shoulders, fists.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000023.ch: 那些傢伙用他們所有的部位去撞牢門——頭、肩膀、拳頭.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000023.cn: 那些家伙用他们所有的部位去撞牢门——头、肩膀、拳头.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000024.en: Blood all over. Fingers broke. Bones pokin’ through.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000024.ch: 到處都是血. 手指斷了. 骨頭都戳出來了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000024.cn: 到处都是血. 手指断了. 骨头都戳出来了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000025.en: But they ain’t stop. Didn’t even feel it.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000025.ch: 但他們沒停下來. 根本感覺不到痛.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000025.cn: 但他们没停下来. 根本感觉不到痛.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000026.en: They wasn’t mad. They was just... gone. Empty.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000026.ch: 他們不是在發怒. 他們只是… 失去神智了. 空了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000026.cn: 他们不是在发怒. 他们只是… 没了. 空了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000027.en: Then we hear the alarms. Riot squad rushin’ in — black armor, masks, lookin’ like stormtroopers.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000027.ch: 接著我們聽到警報. 鎮暴隊衝進來——黑色護甲、面罩, 看起來像帝國風暴兵.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000027.cn: 接着我们听到警报. 防暴队冲进来——黑色护甲、面罩, 看起来像帝国冲锋队.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000028.en: One of ‘em shoutin’ somethin’ ‘bout a 'containment breach.'
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000028.ch: 其中一個在吼什麼「收容失效」.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000028.cn: 其中一个在吼什么“收容失效”.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000029.en: But man... that shit was already done. It was over.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000029.ch: 但老兄… 那事早就完了. 已經結束了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000029.cn: 但老兄… 那事早就完了. 已经结束了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000030.en: Did the riot police open the cells?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000030.ch: 鎮暴警察有打開牢房嗎?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000030.cn: 防暴警察有打开牢房吗?

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000031.en: Not on purpose. But when folks started screamin’, one of them officers dropped his belt — keys, baton, radio — whole kit.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000031.ch: 不是故意的. 但大家開始尖叫的時候, 其中一個警官的腰帶掉了——鑰匙、警棍、無線電——整套裝備.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000031.cn: 不是故意的. 但大家开始尖叫的时候, 其中一个警官的腰带掉了——钥匙、警棍、对讲机——整套装备.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000032.en: Poor bastard. Think somethin’ ripped his throat out.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000032.ch: 可憐的混蛋. 好像有什麼東西把他的喉嚨扯了出來.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000032.cn: 可怜的混蛋. 好像有什么东西把他的喉咙扯了出来.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000033.en: Blood sprayed the wall like a damn art piece.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000033.ch: 血噴得滿牆都是, 像他媽的一件藝術品.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000033.cn: 血喷得满墙都是, 像他妈的一件艺术品.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000034.en: I grabbed the keys. My cellmates ran one way — I dipped the other.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000034.ch: 我抓了鑰匙. 我的室友往一邊跑——我往另一邊溜.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000034.cn: 我抓了钥匙. 我的狱友往一边跑——我往另一边溜.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000035.en: I knew that prison better than I know my own damn face.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000035.ch: 我對那座監獄比對我自己這張臉還熟.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000035.cn: 我对那座监狱比对我自己这张脸还熟.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000037.en: Hell yeah. This wasn’t no group project. I saw an opening, I took it.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000037.ch: 當然啊. 這又不是什麼分組作業. 我看到機會, 就抓住了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000037.cn: 当然啊. 这又不是什么小组作业. 我看到机会, 就抓住了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000039.en: I ran past at least a hundred fools — fightin’, screamin’, bitin’ each other like animals.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000039.ch: 我跑過至少一百個蠢蛋——在打架、在尖叫、像動物一樣互咬.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000039.cn: 我跑过至少一百个蠢货——在打架、在尖叫、像动物一样互咬.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000040.en: Couldn’t tell who was infected, who was just pissed off. Didn’t matter.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000040.ch: 分不出誰被感染了, 誰只是氣瘋了. 也無所謂.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000040.cn: 分不出谁被感染了, 谁只是气疯了. 也无所谓.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000041.en: I seen one dude chewin’ on a CO’s face like it was fried chicken.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000041.ch: 我看到一個傢伙在啃一個獄警的臉, 好像在吃炸雞.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000041.cn: 我看到一个家伙在啃一个狱警的脸, 好像在吃炸鸡.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000042.en: Another had his brother pinned up, tryin’ to choke him out.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000042.ch: 另一個把他兄弟壓在牆上, 想把他掐昏.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000042.cn: 另一个把他兄弟按在墙上, 想把他掐晕.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000043.en: Prison teach you one thing — don’t look too hard at anything. That came in real handy.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000043.ch: 監獄教會你一件事——什麼都別看太仔細. 這招那時可真派上用場.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000043.cn: 监狱教会你一件事——什么都别看太仔细. 这招那时可真派上用场.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000044.en: Gunshots everywhere. At first it was quick bursts. Then longer. Then… silence.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000044.ch: 到處都是槍聲. 一開始是短點放. 然後變長. 然後… 一片死寂.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000044.cn: 到处都是枪声. 一开始是短点射. 然后变长. 然后… 一片死寂.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000045.en: I slipped through the service tunnel by the dock. Found a back room, climbed up through the roof hatch.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000045.ch: 我從碼頭旁的維修通道溜了出去. 找到一間後面的房間, 從屋頂的艙口爬了上去.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000045.cn: 我从码头旁的检修通道溜了出去. 找到一间后面的房间, 从屋顶的舱口爬了上去.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000046.en: After that, it was just fences and timing.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000046.ch: 之後, 就只剩圍籬跟時機了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000046.cn: 之后, 就只剩围栏和时机了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000048.en: Yeah. Found some house, on the edge of town. Quiet. Empty.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000048.ch: 對. 在鎮的邊上找到一間房子. 很安靜. 沒人.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000048.cn: 对. 在镇子边上找到一间房子. 很安静. 没人.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000049.en: Snatched some clothes out the dryer, cleaned up, crashed on the couch.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000049.ch: 從烘衣機裡抓了幾件衣服, 清理了一下, 就倒在沙發上睡了.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000049.cn: 从烘干机里抓了几件衣服, 收拾了一下, 就倒在沙发上睡了.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000050.en: That was the best sleep I had in years. Even with the planes flyin’ low like the world was about to end for real.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000050.ch: 那是我這幾年睡得最好的一覺. 就算飛機飛得很低, 好像世界真的要完蛋了也一樣.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000050.cn: 那是我这几年睡得最好的一觉. 就算飞机飞得很低, 好像世界真的要完蛋了也一样.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000052.en: Fortunate? I was buried alive in that place. Waitin’ to die slow and quiet.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000052.ch: 幸運? 我在那地方等於被活埋了. 等著慢慢地、安靜地死掉.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000052.cn: 幸运? 我在那地方等于被活埋了. 等着慢慢地、安静地死掉.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000053.en: Then the world goes to shit — and somehow, that’s what saved me?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000053.ch: 然後世界整個爛掉了——結果不知怎麼的, 那竟然救了我?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000053.cn: 然后世界整个烂掉了——结果不知怎么的, 那居然救了我?

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000054.en: Call it luck. Call it God. Call it whatever. Prison’s gone. Guards dead. Doors wide open.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000054.ch: 說是運氣也好. 說是上帝也好. 隨便你怎麼說. 監獄沒了. 獄警死了. 大門敞開.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000054.cn: 说是运气也好. 说是上帝也好. 随便你怎么说. 监狱没了. 狱警死了. 大门敞开.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000055.en: And for the first time in forever… I got a say in where I go next.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000055.ch: 而且這麼久以來第一次… 我能決定自己接下來要去哪.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000055.cn: 而且这么久以来第一次… 我能决定自己接下来要去哪.

RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000057.en: Hold up… what you mean by that? You said y’all was lettin’ me go!
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000057.ch: 等等… 你這話什麼意思? 你們說過會放我走的!
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000057.cn: 等等… 你这话什么意思? 你们说过会放我走的!

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000001.ch: 綠洲計畫, 醫療教學系列
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000001.cn: 绿洲计划, 医疗教学系列

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000002.ch: 第 04 卷: 骨折治療
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000002.cn: 第 04 卷: 骨折治疗

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000006.ch: 不要施加不必要的力量.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000006.cn: 不要施加不必要的力量.

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000009.en: Head and torso fractures cannot be splinted.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000009.ch: 頭部和軀幹骨折無法上夾板.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000009.cn: 头部和躯干骨折无法上夹板.

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-00000000000a.en: VHS: PROJECT OASIS, MEDICAL INSTRUCTION SERIES, TAPE 04: FRACTURE TREATMENT
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-00000000000a.ch: VHS: 綠洲計畫, 醫療教學系列, 第 04 卷: 骨折治療
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-00000000000a.cn: VHS: 绿洲计划, 医疗教学系列, 第 04 卷: 骨折治疗

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-00000000000c.ch: 第 04 卷: 骨折治療
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-00000000000c.cn: 第 04 卷: 骨折治疗

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000015.ch: 骨折需要很長的癒合時間.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000015.cn: 骨折需要很长的愈合时间.

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000018.ch: 如果有止痛藥, 請服用.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000018.cn: 如果有止痛药, 请服用.

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000021.ch: 可以的話, 尋求協助.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000021.cn: 可以的话, 寻求帮助.

RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000023.ch: 妥善照護才能確保存活.
RM_d8a8fa8f-be1a-462d-8377-000000000023.cn: 妥善护理才能确保存活.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_01.en: Nature is all around me, so you know exactly who's welcoming you back.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_01.ch: 大自然就在我身邊, 所以你們很清楚是誰在歡迎你們回來.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_01.cn: 大自然就在我身边, 所以你们很清楚是谁在欢迎你们回来.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_02.en: I'm your host, Dean, on another episode of Exposure Survival!
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_02.ch: 我是主持人迪恩, 歡迎收看新一集的荒野求生!
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_02.cn: 我是主持人迪恩, 欢迎收看新一集的荒野求生!

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_03.en: Everyone knows that a REAL hunter...
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_03.ch: 大家都知道, 真正的獵人…
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_03.cn: 大家都知道, 真正的猎人…

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_04.en: ... is nothing wihout his trusty bow.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_04.ch: …要是少了他可靠的弓, 就什麼都不是.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_04.cn: …要是少了他可靠的弓, 就什么都不是.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_06.en: Strip it clean. No bark, no problems.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_06.ch: 把它剝乾淨. 沒有樹皮, 就沒有麻煩.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_06.cn: 把它剥干净. 没有树皮, 就没有麻烦.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_07.en: Cut notches at each tip for the string.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_07.ch: 在兩端各切一道凹槽來掛弦.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_07.cn: 在两端各切一道凹槽来挂弦.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_08.en: Make sure the bow is loose when you string it.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_08.ch: 上弦的時候, 要確保弓是放鬆的.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_08.cn: 上弦的时候, 要确保弓是放松的.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_09.en: Don't want it snapping back on you, ey?
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_09.ch: 你可不想讓它反彈打到你自己, 對吧?
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_09.cn: 你可不想让它反弹打到你自己, 对吧?

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_10.en: Firing a bow without an arrow can break it bad.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_10.ch: 沒搭箭就空放弓弦, 可能會把弓弄壞.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_10.cn: 没搭箭就空放弓弦, 可能会把弓弄坏.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_11.ch: 而且你自己會傷得更慘!
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_11.cn: 而且你自己会伤得更惨!

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_13.en: ... when carving em, split em straight.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_14.en: A crooked shaft wastes your effort.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_14.ch: 彎曲的箭桿只會白費你的功夫.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_14.cn: 弯曲的箭杆只会白费你的功夫.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_15.en: Shape a stone point, then fasten it tight.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_15.ch: 把石頭磨成箭頭, 然後牢牢綁緊.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_15.cn: 把石头磨成箭头, 然后牢牢绑紧.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_16.ch: 箭羽能讓箭矢飛得穩定.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_16.cn: 箭羽能让箭矢飞得稳定.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_17.en: You can use feathers, or even wood or duct tape in a pinch.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_17.ch: 你可以用羽毛, 急用時甚至可以用木片或布膠帶.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_17.cn: 你可以用羽毛, 急用时甚至可以用木片或管道胶带.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_18.en: Nock each arrow securely. If it slips off the string, it cannot fly straight.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_18.ch: 每支箭都要牢牢搭好. 如果從弦上滑脫, 就沒辦法直直飛出去.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_18.cn: 每支箭都要牢牢搭好. 如果从弦上滑脱, 就没办法直直飞出去.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_19.en: Nock securely, draw smoothly, and anchor consistently.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_19.ch: 搭箭要穩, 拉弓要順, 靠位要一致.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_19.cn: 搭箭要稳, 拉弓要顺, 靠位要一致.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_20.en: And only draw right when you're about to fire.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_20.ch: 而且只在準備放箭時才拉弓.
RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_20.cn: 而且只在准备放箭时才拉弓.

RM_ACExposureSurvivalE9_Item.ch: 節目錄影帶: 荒野求生 E9

Farming_Tooltip_AlreadyCare.en: You have already cared this plant at this stage.
Farming_Tooltip_AlreadyCare.ch: 你在這個階段已經照料過這株植物了.
Farming_Tooltip_AlreadyCare.cn: 你在这个阶段已经照料过这株植物了.

Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 老兄… 這貨還真不賴.
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 老兄… 这货还真不赖.

Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Man, I am like... totally baked right now.
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 天啊, 我現在整個… 茫翻了.
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 天啊, 我现在整个… 嗨翻了.

Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 豬頭, 我的十字弓咧?
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 伙计, 我的十字弓呢?

Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl4.en: I can see through time, man. Also there are zombies.
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl4.ch: 老兄, 我能看穿時間. 而且還有殭屍.
Moodles_moodleGF_Good_desc_lvl4.cn: 老兄, 我能看穿时间. 而且还有僵尸.

Moodles_KDBadTrip_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: Make it stop. Please make it stop.
Moodles_KDBadTrip_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 讓它停下來. 拜託, 讓它停下來.
Moodles_KDBadTrip_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 让它停下来. 拜托, 让它停下来.

Moodles_KDBadTrip_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: THIS IS THE WORST THING EVER

Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl2.en: You're the best. You can do anything
Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 你最強了. 沒有你辦不到的事
Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 你最强了. 没有你办不到的事

Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl3.en: It's only you. You can do whatever you want.
Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 世界只有你. 你想做什麼都行.
Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 世界只有你. 你想做什么都行.

Moodles_KDCokedUp_Good_desc_lvl4.en: I AM THE KING OF THE WORLD

Moodles_KDCrackedUp_Good_desc_lvl1.en: You feel so goood and energetic
Moodles_KDCrackedUp_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 你感覺超級爽, 精力全開
Moodles_KDCrackedUp_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 你感觉超级爽, 精力全开

Moodles_KDCrackedUp_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 你從沒這麼精力充沛過
Moodles_KDCrackedUp_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 你从没这么精力充沛过

Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: You wouldn't mind having a little something.

Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: You really want some. Real bad.
Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 你真的很想來一點. 非常想.
Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 你真的很想来一点. 非常想.

Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: You can't stop thinking about it.

Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: You'd do anything for a hit right now.
Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 現在只要能來一口, 你什麼都肯做.
Moodles_KDCraving_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 现在只要能来一口, 你什么都肯做.

Moodles_KDDizy_Good_desc_lvl3.en: Everything starts to turn around you..

Moodles_KDDizy_Good_desc_lvl4.en: You have no repairs. The hell is happening
Moodles_KDDizy_Good_desc_lvl4.ch: 你徹底暈頭轉向了. 這他媽是怎麼回事
Moodles_KDDizy_Good_desc_lvl4.cn: 你彻底晕头转向了. 这他妈是怎么回事

Moodles_KDFocused_Good_desc_lvl1.en: You're feeling more concentrated than usual
Moodles_KDFocused_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 你比平常更能集中注意力
Moodles_KDFocused_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 你比平常更能集中注意力

Moodles_KDGoodTrip_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 顏色更鮮豔, 聲音更清晰.
Moodles_KDGoodTrip_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 颜色更鲜艳, 声音更清晰.

Moodles_KDGoodTrip_Good_desc_lvl4.ch: 我即一切, 亦即虛無
Moodles_KDGoodTrip_Good_desc_lvl4.cn: 我即一切, 亦即虚无

Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: Your head is a little fuzzy.

Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: Your head is pounding. Why did you do this.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 你頭痛欲裂. 你當初到底在想什麼.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 你头痛欲裂. 你当初到底在想什么.

Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: Everything hurts and you're still drunk.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 渾身都痛, 而且你還醉著.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 浑身都痛, 而且你还醉着.

Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl4.en: Never again. I mean it this time.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl4.ch: 再也不喝了. 這次是說真的.
Moodles_KDHangover_Bad_desc_lvl4.cn: 再也不喝了. 这次是说真的.

Moodles_KDLoosened_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Life seems not so bad now.

Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: You feel a bit out of place

Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: Things around you are strange but not in a positive way.
Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 周遭的一切變得怪異, 而且不是好的那種.
Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 周遭的一切变得怪异, 而且不是好的那种.

Moodles_KDNastyTrip_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: You starting to feel really uncomfortable

Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl1.en: A pleasant warmth spreads through your body.
Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 一股舒服的暖意流遍全身.
Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 一股舒服的暖意流遍全身.

Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Your eyelids feel heavy... so heavy.

Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl3.en: You're somewhere between here and nowhere.
Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 你飄在此處與虛無之間.
Moodles_KDNodding_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 你飘在此处与虚无之间.

Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl1.en: Something doesn't feel right in your body.
Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl1.ch: 你的身體感覺不太對勁.
Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn: 你的身体感觉不太对劲.

Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl2.en: Your heart is racing. Or is it stopping ?
Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl2.ch: 你的心臟狂跳. 還是快停了?
Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl2.cn: 你的心脏狂跳. 还是快停了?

Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl3.en: You can barely breathe. This is bad.
Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl3.ch: 你幾乎喘不過氣. 情況很糟.
Moodles_KDOverdosing_Bad_desc_lvl3.cn: 你几乎喘不过气. 情况很糟.

Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl1.en: You feel strangely calm and sleepy.
Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 你感到異樣的平靜與睏倦.
Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 你感到异样的平静与困倦.

Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 一切都變得緩慢而遙遠.
Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 一切都变得缓慢而遥远.

Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl3.en: Moving feels like swimming through concrete.
Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 動一下就像在水泥裡游泳.
Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 动一下就像在水泥里游泳.

Moodles_KDSedated_Good_desc_lvl4.en: You can barely keep your eyes open.

Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl1.en: You feel a rush of energy you've never felt before.
Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 一股前所未有的能量衝上腦門.
Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 一股前所未有的能量冲上脑门.

Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl2.en: Your mind is racing. You can't stop moving.
Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 你的思緒狂奔. 停不下來.
Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 你的思绪狂奔. 停不下来.

Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl3.en: Your heart is pounding. Is that normal ?
Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 你的心臟猛烈跳動. 這正常嗎?
Moodles_KDTweaking_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 你的心脏猛烈跳动. 这正常吗?

Moodles_NnCMethadone_Good_desc_lvl1.en: Withdrawal held off. Less than 6 hours left.
Moodles_NnCMethadone_Good_desc_lvl1.ch: 戒斷反應暫時被壓住了. 剩餘不到 6 小時.
Moodles_NnCMethadone_Good_desc_lvl1.cn: 戒断反应暂时被压住了. 剩余不到 6 小时.

Moodles_NnCMethadone_Good_desc_lvl2.ch: 戒斷反應暫時被壓住了. 剩餘 6-12 小時.
Moodles_NnCMethadone_Good_desc_lvl2.cn: 戒断反应暂时被压住了. 剩余 6-12 小时.

Moodles_NnCMethadone_Good_desc_lvl3.ch: 戒斷反應暫時被壓住了. 剩餘 12-18 小時.
Moodles_NnCMethadone_Good_desc_lvl3.cn: 戒断反应暂时被压住了. 剩余 12-18 小时.

Moodles_NnCMethadone_Good_desc_lvl4.ch: 戒斷反應暫時被壓住了. 剩餘 18-24 小時.
Moodles_NnCMethadone_Good_desc_lvl4.cn: 戒断反应暂时被压住了. 剩余 18-24 小时.

Moodles_NnCMethadone_Good_lvl1._note: 美沙冬 moodle 四級 EN 同為 Medicated, 譯名一致; 語意取 desc「戒斷反應暫時被壓住」＝正在藥效控制下。

Moodles_NnCSteroid_Good_lvl1._note: EN 俚語 Juiced＝正在用類固醇; 四級同文。中文無對等俚語, 取直白且兩岸通用的「類固醇加持」/「类固醇加持」。

Moodles_NnCHangover_Bad_desc_lvl1.ch:
即將結束.
+疲勞, -耐力, +無聊, +不悅, +不適
Moodles_NnCHangover_Bad_desc_lvl1.cn:
马上就会结束.
+疲劳, -耐力, +无聊, +不快, +不适

Moodles_Malnourished_cause_both.en: You need more calories and protein.
Moodles_Malnourished_cause_both.ch: 你需要更多熱量與蛋白質.
Moodles_Malnourished_cause_both.cn: 你需要更多热量和蛋白质.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bleeding_desc_lvl3.ch: 因大量失血而極度虛弱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bleeding_desc_lvl3.cn: 因大量失血而极度虚弱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl1.ch: 找些事來打發時間, 或者娛樂娛樂.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl1.cn: 找些事来打发时间, 或者娱乐一下.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl2.en: Why does nothing interesting ever happen around here?
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl2.ch: 為什麼一點有趣的事情都沒有?
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl2.cn: 怎么一点有趣的事情都没有?

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl3.en: Can barely take it any more. Isn't there ANYTHING fun to do?
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl3.ch: 受不了了. 不能做點有意思的事情嗎?
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl3.cn: 受不了了. 就没有什么好玩的事可以做吗?

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl4.en: They never said the end of the world would be like this...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl4.ch: 怎麼沒人告訴我世界末日這麼無聊啊…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl4.cn: 也没人告诉我世界末日有这么无聊啊…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_CantSprint_desc_lvl1.en: Heavy clothing, bulky bags, or large items are making you unable to sprint.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_CantSprint_desc_lvl1.ch: 厚重的衣物, 臃腫的揹包或攜帶大型物品使你無法衝刺.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_CantSprint_desc_lvl1.cn: 厚重的衣物, 臃肿的背包或携带大型物品使你无法冲刺.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Dead_desc_lvl4.en: This is how you died. High risk of becoming rat food.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Dead_desc_lvl4.ch: 這就是你生命的終點. 馬上就要成為鼠群的盤中餐了.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Dead_desc_lvl4.cn: 这就是你的死因. 很可能要沦为老鼠的食物了.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl2.en: Had one too many. Co-ordination slightly impaired.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl2.ch: 喝得稍微有點多. 身體協調能力輕微受影響.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl2.cn: 喝得稍微有点多. 身体有一点不协调.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl3.en: Had a few too many. Co-ordination impaired.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl3.ch: 喝多了. 身體協調能力出現嚴重影響.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl3.cn: 喝多了. 身体不协调了.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl4.en: 'Iss you an' me 'gainst the wurld. I love you. I LOVE YOU.'
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl4.ch: 「你…和我…一起對抗…這世界. 我愛你. 我愛你!」
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl4.cn: “你…和我…一起对抗…这世界. 我爱你. 我爱你!”

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl1.en: Hard to run or swing a weapon. Why not have a rest in a comfy chair?
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl1.ch: 難以奔跑或揮舞武器. 為什麼不在舒服的椅子上休息一會兒?
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl1.cn: 难以奔跑或挥舞武器. 为什么不在舒服的椅子上休息一会儿?

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl2.en: Can barely jog or swing a weapon.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl2.ch: 幾乎無法奔跑或揮舞武器.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl2.cn: 几乎无法奔跑或挥舞武器.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl3.en: Can barely walk or swing a weapon.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl3.ch: 幾乎無法走動或揮舞武器.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl3.cn: 几乎无法走动或挥舞武器.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl4.en: Can barely move or swing a weapon.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl4.ch: 幾乎無法移動或揮舞武器.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl4.cn: 几乎无法移动或挥舞武器.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl1.en: Gnawing hunger entirely absent. For now.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl1.ch: 不再感到飢餓了. 至少暫時如此.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl1.cn: 不再感到饥饿了. 至少暂时如此.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl2.en: Tummy full. Goodness making its way through your system.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl2.ch: 肚子飽飽. 營養對你的身體有幫助.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl2.cn: 肚子饱饱. 营养对你的身体有帮助.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl3.en: Stomach contented. You feel healthier and stronger.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl3.ch: 肚子好撐. 力量和生命恢復提升.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl3.cn: 肚子好撑. 力量和生命恢复提升.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl4.en: Couldn't manage another single, solitary bite.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl3.en: Sneezing and coughing. You feel sick and slow.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl3.ch: 伴隨打噴嚏和咳嗽. 你感到不適且行動遲緩.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl3.cn: 打喷嚏和咳嗽. 你感觉病了且行动迟缓.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl4.en: Continually coughing and sneezing. You'd better look after yourself.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl4.ch: 不斷咳嗽和打噴嚏. 你最好照顧好自己.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl4.cn: 不断咳嗽和打喷嚏. 你得照顾好自己.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl2.en: Carrying too much. You're slowed by the weight.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl2.ch: 拿得太多了. 因負重而減速.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl2.cn: 背得太多了. 因负重而减速.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl3.en: Carrying far too much. You can barely move.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl3.ch: 拿得實在太多了. 快動不了了.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl3.cn: 背得实在太多了. 快动不了了.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl4.en: Can't take much more! You're going to hurt yourself carrying all that.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl4.ch: 不能再拿了! 拿這麼多會傷到自己的.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl4.cn: 不能再带了! 背这么多东西会伤到自己的.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl1.en: Could do with a bite to eat.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl2.en: Could eat a horse right now. Growing weaker.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl2.ch: 餓到可以吞下一整匹馬. 身體逐漸虛弱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl2.cn: 饿得能吞下一整匹马. 身体逐渐虚弱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl4.en: Just a crumb, a berry, a cockroach, anything...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl4.ch: 一點麵包屑, 一顆漿果, 一隻蟑螂, 啥都行…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl4.cn: 一点面包屑, 一颗浆果, 一只蟑螂, 啥都行…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.en: Consider wearing less clothing. You feel thirstier.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.ch: 考慮脫掉一些衣服. 更易口渴.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.cn: 考虑脱掉一些衣服. 更易口渴.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.ch: 口渴. 出汗. 過度暴露在陽光下.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.cn: 口渴. 出汗. 过度暴露在阳光下.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.en: Nauseous, unable to concentrate, and desperate for liquids.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.ch: 噁心想吐, 無法集中精神, 急需喝水.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.cn: 恶心想吐, 无法集中精神, 急需喝水.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.en: Delirious. The heat is melting your life away. Get somewhere colder!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.ch: 神智不清. 高溫正在消磨你的生命. 快去涼快的地方!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv.cn: 神志不清. 高温正在消磨你的生命. 快去凉快的地方!

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl.en: It feels a bit nippy round here...
You need to find ways to keep warm.
Man alive, it is SO cold.
You're going out. You may be some time.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl.ch: 你得出去了, 可能要很久才會回來.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl.cn: 你得出去了, 可能要很久才会回来.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl2.ch: 因受傷或疾病而感到虛弱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl2.cn: 因受伤或疾病而感到虚弱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl3.en: Severely weakened by injuries or illness.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl3.ch: 因受傷或疾病而感到十分虛弱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl3.cn: 因受伤或疾病而感到十分虚弱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl4.en: Not going gently into that good night...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl4.ch: 不願溫順地走進那良夜…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl4.cn: 不愿温和地走进那良夜…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.ch: 哎呀, 有東西發出難聞的氣味.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.cn: 哎呀, 有东西发出难闻的气味.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.ch: 真噁心, 有東西發出刺鼻的臭味.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.cn: 真恶心, 有东西发出刺鼻的臭味.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.en: A vile stink makes you feel ill.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.ch: 一種令人作嘔的惡臭讓你感到不適.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.cn: 一种令人作呕的恶臭让你感到不适.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.en: You can't breathe. Get away from here!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.ch: 你無法呼吸. 快離開這裡!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_lv.cn: 你无法呼吸. 快离开这里!

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl2.en: Throbbing pain. It's hard to keep focused.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl2.ch: 陣陣抽痛. 很難保持注意力.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl2.cn: 阵阵疼痛. 很难保持注意力.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl3.en: The pain brings tears to your eyes. It's hard to go on.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl3.ch: 疼出了眼淚. 堅持不下去了.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl3.cn: 疼出了眼泪. 坚持不下去了.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl4.en: Searing pain shoots through your body. It's hard to even think.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl4.ch: 灼痛感傳遍全身. 無法思考.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl4.cn: 剧痛贯穿你的全身. 甚至无法思考.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Panic_desc_lvl1.en: Do your best to remain calm.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Panic_desc_lvl2.ch: 焦慮不已, 手在發抖.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Panic_desc_lvl2.cn: 焦虑不已. 手在发抖.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl3.ch: 很虛弱, 非常不舒服.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl3.cn: 很虚弱, 非常不舒服.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl4.en: Increasing danger of becoming rat food.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl4.ch: 被老鼠吃掉的危險越來越高.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl4.cn: 沦为老鼠食物的危险越来越高.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl2.ch: 心在狂跳. 思維混亂.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl2.cn: 心在狂跳. 思维混乱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl3.en: Shaking hands. Impossible to think straight. Make it stop!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl3.ch: 手在發抖, 無法正常思考. 快冷靜下來!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl3.cn: 手在发抖, 无法正常思考. 快冷静下来!

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl4.en: You're at your limit! This can't go on...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl4.ch: 到達極限了! 不能再這樣下去了…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl4.cn: 到达极限了! 不能再这样下去了…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl2.en: It's well past your bedtime. Growing weak with tiredness.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl2.ch: 已經過了平時睡覺的時間了. 開始因睏倦而虛弱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl2.cn: 已经过了平时睡觉的时间了. 开始因困倦而虚弱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl3.en: Can barely think straight. Weak with tiredness.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl3.ch: 快不能思考了. 因睏倦而虛弱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl3.cn: 快不能思考了. 因困倦而虚弱.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl4.en: So weak and tired. Desperately, inhumanly tired.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl4.ch: 又虛弱又睏倦. 累到絕望, 累到不像人.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl4.cn: 又虚弱又困倦. 累到绝望, 累到不像人.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.en: Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you uncomfortable and unhappy.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.ch: 你的衣服, 環境或其他東西讓你感到不舒服和不開心.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.cn: 你的衣服, 环境或其他东西让你感到不舒服和不开心.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.en: Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you very uncomfortable and unhappy.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.ch: 你的衣服, 環境或其他東西讓你感到非常不舒服和不開心.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.cn: 你的衣服, 环境或其他东西让你感到非常不舒服和不开心.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.en: Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you extremely uncomfortable and unhappy.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.ch: 你的衣服, 環境或其他東西讓你感到極度不舒服和不開心.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_l.cn: 你的衣服, 环境或其他东西让你感到极度不舒服和不开心.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl1.en: Having a hard time lately. Seek some way to forget your troubles.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl1.ch: 最近壓力很大. 找些事幹, 忘掉煩惱.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl1.cn: 最近压力很大. 找些事做来忘掉烦恼.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl2.en: You always feel on the edge of tears. Nothing seems to go your way.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl2.ch: 你總是在快哭出來的邊緣. 似乎一切都不順.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl2.cn: 你总是处在快哭出来的边缘. 似乎一切都不顺.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl3.en: Ravaged by mourning and desperation. You're losing hope...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl3.ch: 被哀悼與絕望摧殘. 你正在失去希望…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl3.cn: 被哀悼与绝望摧残. 你正在失去希望…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl4.en: What's the point in going on? Nothing good will ever happen...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl4.ch: 繼續下去有什麼意義? 永遠不會有好事發生…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl4.cn: 继续下去有什么意义? 永远不会有好事发生…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl1.en: Slightly damp from rain, sweat, or something else...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl1.ch: 因為雨水、汗水或其他東西而有點潮濕…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl1.cn: 因为雨水、汗水或其他东西而有点潮湿…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl2.en: Damp from rain, sweat, or something else...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl2.ch: 因為雨水、汗水或其他東西而潮濕…
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl2.cn: 因为雨水、汗水或其他东西而潮湿…

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl4.en: You're going to catch a cold!

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl1.en: The wind's making it feel a little colder.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl2.en: The wind's making it feel somewhat colder.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl3.en: The wind's making it feel a lot colder.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl4.en: The wind feels like you're being stabbed with icicles.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl4.ch: 風吹起來像被冰柱刺穿一樣.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl4.cn: 风吹起来像被冰锥刺穿一样.

MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Zombie_desc_lvl4.en: Sudden attraction to gunshots, house alarms, and human flesh.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Zombie_desc_lvl4.ch: 突然被槍聲、住宅警報器和人肉吸引.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Zombie_desc_lvl4.cn: 突然被枪声、住宅警报器和人肉吸引.

Moodles_BloodlustO_Bloodlust_Bad_desc_lv.en: The craving for a kill is overwhelming, may the next soul you see rest in peace
Moodles_BloodlustO_Bloodlust_Bad_desc_lv.ch: 對殺戮的渴望難以抑制, 願你見到的下一個靈魂安息
Moodles_BloodlustO_Bloodlust_Bad_desc_lv.cn: 对杀戮的渴望难以抑制, 愿你见到的下一个灵魂安息

Moodles_BloodlustO_BloodyFrenzy_Bad_desc.en: You're dying. All that matters now is killing until your last breath.
Moodles_BloodlustO_BloodyFrenzy_Bad_desc.ch: 你快死了. 現在唯一重要的就是殺戮, 直到嚥下最後一口氣.
Moodles_BloodlustO_BloodyFrenzy_Bad_desc.cn: 你快死了. 现在唯一重要的就是杀戮, 直到咽下最后一口气.

Moodles_BloodlustO_BloodyFrenzy_Bad_desc.en: Next one goes to grave with you.
Moodles_BloodlustO_BloodyFrenzy_Bad_desc.ch: 下一個要陪你一起進墳墓.
Moodles_BloodlustO_BloodyFrenzy_Bad_desc.cn: 下一个要陪你一起进坟墓.

Moodles_BloodlustO_BloodyFrenzy_Good_des.en: Your body burns itself for killing, fueled by the death
Moodles_BloodlustO_BloodyFrenzy_Good_des.ch: 你的身體為了殺戮燃燒自己, 以死亡為燃料
Moodles_BloodlustO_BloodyFrenzy_Good_des.cn: 你的身体为了杀戮燃烧自己, 以死亡为燃料

Moodles_BloodlustO_BloodyFrenzy_Good_des.en: One strike is all it takes.

Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.en: The battle is fading, and so is your borrowed energy
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.ch: 戰鬥漸漸平息, 你借來的精力也隨之消退
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.cn: 战斗渐渐平息, 你借来的精力也随之消退

Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.en: You're collapsing from all the pain you've been ignoring
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.ch: 你因一直忽視的所有疼痛而崩潰
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.cn: 你因一直忽视的所有疼痛而崩溃

Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.en: Every limit you've stretched to kill just a bit more is ripping through your body
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.ch: 為了多殺一點而突破的每一個極限, 正在撕裂你的身體
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.cn: 为了多杀一点而突破的每一个极限, 正在撕裂你的身体

Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.en: Time to pay for every second you thought you could keep going
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.ch: 是時候為你以為自己還能撐下去的每一秒付出代價了
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Bad_.cn: 是时候为你以为自己还能撑下去的每一秒付出代价了

Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.en: You're burning more energy than you have, but you won't feel it until you stop fighting
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.ch: 你消耗的精力超過了你所擁有的, 但在停止戰鬥前你不會察覺
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.cn: 你消耗的精力超过了你所拥有的, 但在停止战斗前你不会察觉

Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.en: You lost touch with reality on how exhausted you really are, killing is all that matters
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.ch: 你已無法真實感受到自己有多疲憊, 殺戮才是唯一重要的
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.cn: 你已无法真实感受到自己有多疲惫, 杀戮才是唯一重要的

Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.en: Your body is screaming past its limits... Too bad you couldn't care less right now
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.ch: 你的身體在超越極限地尖叫… 可惜你現在根本不在乎
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.cn: 你的身体在超越极限地尖叫… 可惜你现在根本不在乎

Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.en: Your body has been running on pure bloodlust... It won't hold much longer
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.ch: 你的身體一直靠純粹的嗜血運轉… 撐不了多久了
Moodles_BloodlustO_BufferedExertion_Good.cn: 你的身体一直靠纯粹的嗜血运转… 撑不了多久了

Moodles_BloodlustO_FightlessCombat_Bad_d.en: Why aren't you fighting? Kill them all!
Moodles_BloodlustO_FightlessCombat_Bad_d.ch: 你為什麼不戰鬥? 殺光他們!
Moodles_BloodlustO_FightlessCombat_Bad_d.cn: 你为什么不战斗? 杀光他们!

Moodles_BloodlustO_FrenzyBacklash_Bad_de.en: You burned more than just your bloodlust
Moodles_BloodlustO_FrenzyBacklash_Bad_de.ch: 你燃燒的不只是你的嗜血
Moodles_BloodlustO_FrenzyBacklash_Bad_de.cn: 你燃烧的不只是你的嗜血

Moodles_BloodlustO_FrenzyBacklash_Bad_de.en: Bursts of overwhelming power take a toll on your body
Moodles_BloodlustO_FrenzyBacklash_Bad_de.ch: 一陣陣壓倒性的力量正在折損你的身體
Moodles_BloodlustO_FrenzyBacklash_Bad_de.cn: 一阵阵压倒性的力量正在损耗你的身体

Moodles_BloodlustO_FrenzyBacklash_Bad_de.en: Every surge of impossible strength is finally destroying you

description.cn: 目前只有一个挑战出生点。此出生点会把你放在巡之丘私立高中的屋顶上。僵尸会在校内生成。祝你玩得开心！

description.en: <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> SHELTER IN PLACE ALERT FOR MEGURIGAOKA CITY <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> BREAKING - MEGURIGAOKA OVERRUN <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Kanagawa Newspaper | 10 April 2012 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> On the morning of 10 April 2012, riots and violent outbreaks began in the city of Megurigaoka in the Kanagawa prefecture. While the root cause is still unknown, public officials believe it to be some form of mass hysteria brought about by some form of illness.  <LINE> <LINE> The same public officials recommend locking your doors and STAYING INSIDE. Do not leave your homes at any cost, and if you find yourself with others, stay together, and STAY INSIDE. Do not attempt to flee, do not retrieve your children from school. <LINE> <LINE> Stay indoors, the prefectural police will have this situation under control, you will be safe. More information will be made available soon.
description.ch: <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> 巡之丘市就地避難警報 <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> 突發——巡之丘淪陷 <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> 神奈川新聞 | 2012年4月10日 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> 2012年4月10日上午，神奈川縣巡之丘市開始發生暴動與暴力事件。雖然根本原因仍不明朗，官方認為這是某種疾病引發的集體歇斯底里。 <LINE> <LINE> 官方建議市民鎖好門窗並留在室內。無論如何都不要離開家中；若身邊有其他人，請待在一起，並留在室內。不要試圖逃離，也不要前往學校接回您的孩子。 <LINE> <LINE> 請待在室內，縣警將控制住局勢，您會安全的。更多資訊將於稍後公布。
description.cn: <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> 巡之丘市就地避难警报 <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> 突发——巡之丘沦陷 <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> 神奈川新闻 | 2012年4月10日 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> 2012年4月10日上午，神奈川县巡之丘市开始发生暴动与暴力事件。虽然根本原因仍不明朗，官方认为这是某种疾病引发的集体癔症。 <LINE> <LINE> 官方建议市民锁好门窗并留在室内。无论如何都不要离开家中；若身边有其他人，请待在一起，并留在室内。不要试图逃离，也不要前往学校接回您的孩子。 <LINE> <LINE> 请待在室内，县警将控制住局势，您会安全的。更多信息将于稍后公布。

description.en: Typically, Student and Teacher professions will spawn in schools on other spawns, but if you want to bypass that and play any profession in the school, use this spawn. <LINE> <LINE> Also, in the current B42 build while writing this, custom professions' spawns don't properly spawn the player in the correct location. To spawn in the school in MP, spawn here.
description.ch: 通常情況下，選擇學生或教師職業時，角色會在其他出生點的學校中出生；如果你想跳過這個限制、讓任何職業都能在學校出生，請使用此出生點。 <LINE> <LINE> 另外，在撰寫本文時的 B42 版本中，自訂職業的出生點無法正確地把玩家放到指定位置。若要在多人遊戲中於學校出生，請在此出生。
description.cn: 通常情况下，选择学生或教师职业时，角色会在其他出生点的学校中出生；如果你想跳过这个限制、让任何职业都能在学校出生，请使用此出生点。 <LINE> <LINE> 另外，在撰写本文时的 B42 版本中，自定义职业的出生点无法正确地把玩家放到指定位置。若要在多人游戏中于学校出生，请在此出生。

description.en: "<IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/TikitownMapPreview.png,800,450><LINE><CENTRE><SIZE:large>TIKITOWN<LINE><TEXT>Tikitown is a thriving mid-sized city nestled between Riverside and Westpoint of Rosewood. Once a humble rural town, it has grown into a bustling urban hub<LINE><LINE>Its transformation was fueled by an influx of commuters drawn to its quiet landscape following the opening of Tikitown's commuter rail station.<LINE><LINE>he addition of a Kentucky University satellite campus and the expansion of the city's docks further cemented its status as an economic powerhouse in this once-sleepy bend of the Ohio River.
description.ch: <IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/TikitownMapPreview.png,800,450><LINE><CENTRE><SIZE:large>提基鎮<LINE><TEXT>提基鎮是一座繁榮的中型城市, 坐落於河畔鎮與羅斯伍德的西點之間. 這裡曾是個樸實的鄉村小鎮, 如今已發展成熱鬧的都市中心<LINE><LINE>提基鎮通勤鐵路車站啟用後, 寧靜的景致吸引大批通勤族湧入, 推動了這座城市的轉變.<LINE><LINE>肯塔基大學分校的設立與城市碼頭的擴建, 更進一步鞏固了它在俄亥俄河這段昔日沉寂河灣上的經濟重鎮地位.
description.cn: <IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/TikitownMapPreview.png,800,450><LINE><CENTRE><SIZE:large>提基镇<LINE><TEXT>提基镇是一座繁荣的中型城市, 坐落于河畔镇与罗斯伍德的西点之间. 这里曾是一个朴素的乡村小镇, 如今已发展成繁华的城市中心<LINE><LINE>提基镇通勤铁路车站开通后, 宁静的风光吸引了大批通勤者涌入, 推动了这座城市的蜕变.<LINE><LINE>肯塔基大学分校的设立和城市码头的扩建, 进一步巩固了它在俄亥俄河这段曾经沉寂的河湾上的经济重镇地位.

description.en: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> TAYLORSVILLE <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> A small town located south on the Ohio River, west of West Point. Taylorsville's friendly Southern hospitality makes it the perfect place to come for a relaxing visit and an even better place to call "home." Come and see for yourself, all that Taylorsville has to offer!
description.ch: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> 泰勒斯維爾 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> 位於俄亥俄河以南、西點鎮以西的小鎮. 泰勒斯維爾友善的南方人情味, 讓這裡成為放鬆小旅行的絕佳去處, 更是讓人想稱之為「家」的好地方. 快來親身看看泰勒斯維爾能帶給你的一切吧!
description.cn: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> 泰勒斯维尔 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> 位于俄亥俄河以南、西点镇以西的小镇. 泰勒斯维尔友善的南方式热情好客, 让这里成为放松游玩的完美去处, 更是可以称之为“家”的好地方. 快来亲眼看看泰勒斯维尔能带给你的一切吧!

_rule_cn: 【cn 欄鐵律】cn 必須與 ch 同等對待——逐鍵對照 en 原文直寫大陸慣用簡中，**禁止用 opencc / t2s 或任何簡繁轉換器整批產生**。理由：t2s 只換字形不換詞彙，產出的是「字是簡體、詞是台灣說法」，簡中讀者一眼看得出來；而且有一類錯誤所有 gate 都攔不到——助詞「著」在簡化字表中存在（著名/著作/顯著/土著），所以「抱著」轉完仍是「抱著」，大陸須寫「抱着」。2026-08-08 全庫稽核實證：抽樣 63 鍵就抓到 16 個詞級分歧，全庫掃出 595 鍵需修正（洋装→连衣裙、运作→运行、点选→点击、后车厢→后备箱、抱著→抱着…）。歷史債：現存 own 鍵中約 18,822 鍵（68%）為當時 t2s 產物，已做過一輪詞級稽核，但那是事後補救不是替代方案；**新增鍵一律逐筆撰寫**。機械防線：verify [14] own 層 CN 用字（擋 著/牠/妳/「」），詞級在地化無法機械判定，靠本規則。
